providers.description: Volt is a desktop application (Mac, Windows, and Chrome) that supercharges WhatsApp for professionals and sales teams — turning long voice notes into readable transcripts and summaries, scheduling messages, adding keyboard-first navigation, organizing chats into focused workspaces, and sending personalized broadcasts. Message content stays under WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption and never passes through Volt's own servers. For agents and AI models, Volt runs an authenticated remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes WhatsApp contacts, chats, messages, groups, and lists as tools. Volt is backed by 500 Global, EQT Ventures, and IVP.

providers.name: Wonder Workshop
providers.description: Wonder Workshop (GitHub org "playi", originally Play-i) is an educational technology company that makes the Dash, Dot, and Cue programmable robots and the Make Wonder K-8 coding and robotics learning platform, used by more than 40,000 schools across 65 countries. Its developer surface is a set of official SDKs that give granular realtime control of the physical robots' sensors and actuators over Bluetooth Low Energy: WonderPy (Python, on PyPI), @wonderworkshop/wwjs (JavaScript, on npm), and an iOS/Android robot framework shipped in the playground sample-app repository. There is no HTTP/cloud REST API, OAuth, or webhook surface; integration happens locally over BLE. Backed by GV.

providers.name: Workwell Technologies
providers.description: Workwell Technologies, Inc. is a Carlsbad, California workforce management company backed by Battery Ventures, best known for its uAttend cloud-connected time and attendance platform and uPunch punch clocks. uAttend pairs biometric time clocks (fingerprint, facial recognition, RFID, voice control) with cloud software for time tracking, scheduling, overtime alerts, and optional payroll processing for small businesses. The WorkWell Technologies API exposes employee, timecard, and punch data from uAttend accounts over HTTPS with API-key authentication, supporting payroll and HRIS integrations.

providers.name: Ylookup
providers.description: Ylookup is a London-based fintech (founded 2025, EQT Ventures-backed) building an agentic workflow engine for fund administration, corporate services, tax, audit, and deal advisory firms. Its platform embeds trusted AI agents into existing tools (Excel, PDFs, Investran, Paxus) as a centralized processing layer — no data migration required — with specialized agents for extracting data from financial documents (LPAs, debt agreements, KYC/AML and tax forms), real-time reconciliation across spreadsheets and sources, financial analysis, and four-eye review. The company reports an average 76% time saved across live processes such as fund-accounting migration, client onboarding, financial-statement preparation, and K-1 data extraction. Ylookup publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its identity and published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: Yum China
providers.description: Yum China Holdings is the largest restaurant company in China by system sales, operating KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, Lavazza, Little Sheep, and Huang Ji Huang restaurants. As the exclusive licensee of Yum! Brands in mainland China, Yum China serves over 16,000 restaurants across China and operates Super App platforms with over 590 million loyalty members.

providers.name: Attuned Intelligence
providers.description: Attuned Intelligence is a healthcare voice AI company that automates hospital and community health center call centers with supervised, EHR-integrated Voice AI Agents. Its agents answer every patient call instantly and in the caller's language, resolve needs end-to-end (appointment booking, medication refills, triage routing), and provide real-time human oversight with transcripts and reporting so automation stays safe and auditable. Founded in 2024 by leaders from DeepMind, Google Health, AssemblyAI, and DocuSign, the company emerged from stealth in October 2025 with $13M in funding backed by Threshold Ventures, and serves customers including Cambridge Health Alliance and Lowell Community Health Center. The platform is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant. Attuned publishes no first-party developer/product API; its Wix-hosted marketing site exposes a generic hosted Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content and business details.

providers.name: Babylon.js
providers.description: Babylon.js is an Apache-2.0 licensed, TypeScript-first open-source 3D engine and rendering framework sponsored by Microsoft and developed in the public BabylonJS GitHub organization. It targets WebGL, WebGPU, and WebXR in the browser, and DirectX, Metal, Vulkan, OpenGL, and OpenGL ES natively through Babylon Native — including a Babylon React Native binding for mobile. The framework ships as a family of scoped npm packages (`@babylonjs/core`, `gui`, `loaders`, `materials`, `inspector`, `serializers`, `post-processes`, `procedural-textures`, `node-editor`) plus a rich tooling surface — the Playground IDE, Sandbox asset viewer, Inspector, Spector.js, the Node Material / Geometry / Particle / Render-Graph editors, a community Editor, the Babylon Toolkit (Unity / Unreal exporters), and DCC exporters for 3ds Max, Maya, and Blender — all backed by the public Snippet API at `snippet.babylonjs.com` that powers shareable Playground and node-editor assets.

providers.name: Back Office
providers.description: Back Office, Inc. operates Finally (finally.com), a Miami-based fintech that provides a unified, AI-powered bookkeeping, accounting, and finance suite for growing small and medium-sized businesses. The platform combines automated bookkeeping and ledger management, accounts payable and bill pay, expense management, corporate cards with built-in controls, invoicing, payment processing, payroll across 150+ countries, and credit monitoring, with AI agents that classify transactions, reconcile accounts, close the books, and prepare audits. Founded in 2018 and trusted by over 3,500 companies, Finally publishes a SOC 2 trust center but does not currently expose a public developer API or developer portal; this profile tracks its identity, web properties, and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BestDoc
providers.description: BestDoc is a healthcare patient-relationship-management (PRM) company that helps hospitals improve the patient experience across inpatient and outpatient care. Its platform includes BestDoc Concierge for inpatient experience management (non-clinical requests, room food ordering, discharge management), BestDoc Practice for outpatient patient-request management, BestDoc Survey for omni-channel patient feedback, an AI Reply Assistant for automated review responses, and continued-care engagement tools. BestDoc integrates with hospital information systems (HIS), EMRs, and payment gateways. BestDoc Technology Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 27001:2013 certified company operating from Kochi, Bangalore, and Dubai. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Bloomfilter
providers.description: Bloomfilter is a process intelligence platform that gives enterprises end-to-end visibility, traceability, and control over how AI agents and humans execute software delivery work. It unifies data across development and design tools such as Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Figma into a structured, AI-enabled data stream and builds a connected process graph across the software development lifecycle. Teams use Bloomfilter to govern hybrid human-agent workflows through process mining, compliance monitoring, cycle-time analysis, and performance measurement, so leaders can see how work actually flows and where value is created or lost. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Boku
providers.description: Boku is a global mobile payments network that connects digital merchants to more than 200 local payment methods — mobile wallets, real-time account-to-account bank transfers, and direct carrier billing — across 70+ countries, reaching over 7 billion payment accounts. Through its Boku Direct payment gateway API, merchants such as Epic Games, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Netflix, Sony, Spotify, and Tencent accept local payments, run subscriptions, and settle globally. Boku processes over $9 billion in payments annually and is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange (LON:BOKU).

providers.name: CACI International
providers.description: CACI International provides information technology, professional services, and managed solutions to U.S. federal government agencies in the defense, intelligence, homeland security, and civilian markets. The company delivers expertise and technology across C3I, cyber, digital solutions, enterprise IT, mission support, space, and spectrum superiority domains.

providers.name: Caidya
providers.description: Caidya is a full-service, global clinical research organization (CRO) formed from the April 2021 merger of dMed and Clinipace, rebranded to Caidya in October 2022. It runs clinical development programs end to end — pre-IND and regulatory strategy, early phase, Phase II/III delivery, study start-up, trial feasibility, clinical operations, risk-based quality management, medical monitoring, clinical data management, biometrics, medical writing, pharmacovigilance, quality assurance and post-marketing surveillance — across oncology and hematology, cardiovascular-metabolic, rare disease, pediatrics, gastroenterology, nephrology, dermatology, ophthalmology, cell and gene therapy, neurology, immunology and infectious disease. The company took a $165M strategic growth investment from Rubicon Founders and announced a strategic combination with Simbec-Orion. Caidya is a clinical services provider rather than a software vendor: it integrates with sponsor-preferred EDC, eCOA, IRT, CTMS, eTMF and safety platforms rather than publishing a developer program or a public API of its own.

providers.name: Canary Technologies
providers.description: Canary Technologies is an AI-powered hospitality management platform trusted by more than 20,000 hotels across 90+ countries, including brands such as Marriott International, Four Seasons, Choice Hotels, Wyndham, and IHG. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, Canary provides digital guest management — contactless mobile check-in/checkout, tablet registration, upsells, guest messaging, digital tipping, and Canary AI — along with PCI-compliant secure transactions and fraud prevention. The company maintains its own integration tooling and a partner/enterprise API that connects to 80+ property-management, payment, and hospitality systems (Oracle Hospitality, Mews, Cloudbeds, Sabre, Adyen, Shift4, and others), launching 5-10 new integrations per quarter. Canary does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI; API access is granted to hotel partners and integration providers.

providers.name: CareRev
providers.description: CareRev is a healthcare workforce management and on-demand labor marketplace that connects hospitals and health systems directly with local, credentialed clinical professionals — registered nurses, LPN/LVNs, CNAs, surgical and ER techs, medical assistants, respiratory therapists, phlebotomists and mental health techs — without a traditional staffing agency in the middle. Facilities post open shifts from their existing scheduling and HR systems and vetted clinicians browse, claim and self-schedule them in the CareRev mobile app, while CareRev handles credential verification, compliance and payment. The product line spans the CareRev Marketplace (external on-demand talent), IRP+ (internal resource pool control and float-pool visibility for a health system's own staff) and Smart Rates (dynamic rate modeling to control labor spend). CareRev is certified by The Joint Commission under its Health Care Staffing Services program and serves more than 650 facilities across the United States. Integration with a facility's VMS, scheduling and workforce-management stack (including UKG Dimensions via the UKG Connect Technology Partner Program) is delivered through private, partner-scoped API connections; CareRev publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API contract as of this profiling pass.

providers.name: Chefaa
providers.description: Chefaa is Egypt's leading digital pharmacy and pharmacy-benefits platform, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Cairo. Its GPS-enabled, AI-powered consumer app connects more than 1.5 million monthly users with a nationwide network of over 1,500 partner pharmacies, letting patients upload, order, schedule, and refill both insured and non-insured prescriptions with home delivery, medication reminders, and pharmacist chat support. On the B2B side Chefaa operates a full-stack supply layer for pharmacies and corporates — including Chefaa Supply (direct procurement with deferred payment and consolidated delivery) and the Makhazen pharmacy-supply app — plus the Chefaa Prime subscription for SMEs and consumers. Chefaa is a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Chefaa publishes consumer and B2B web/mobile products but does not expose a public developer API program, so the enrichment below is limited to its public web, security, and domain surface.

providers.name: Cocoon
providers.description: Cocoon is next-generation employee leave management software that automates the complexities of compliance, claims, and payroll for every type of employee leave (parental, medical, caregiver, accommodation, bereavement, and personal) across all 50 U.S. states. It factors in state, federal, company, and insurance benefits to calculate eligibility, generate designation notices, and streamline the leave experience for both employees and HR teams. Cocoon connects to 20+ HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, ADP, Paylocity, UKG, and more) via API integrations that sync employee data in real time. Founded in 2020 by former Stripe and Square leaders and backed by Index Ventures and First Round Capital, Cocoon was acquired by TriNet in April 2026. Cocoon is a consumer of HRIS/payroll APIs rather than a publisher of a public developer API; no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal are published.

providers.name: Concourse
providers.description: Concourse builds AI agents for corporate finance teams. Its platform lets finance, accounting, and data teams query financial data in natural language, generate board and investor reporting with commentary, and run forecasts and scenarios against real-time data. Concourse connects natively to financial and operational systems including QuickBooks, NetSuite, Ramp, Snowflake, Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, Brex, Rippling, Gusto, BigQuery, and Databricks, and says it cuts manual finance work by over 75%. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and backed by CRV, raising a $12M Series A alongside general availability. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Courtyard
providers.description: Courtyard (courtyard.io) is a marketplace and tokenization service for physical collectibles — trading cards, luxury watches, and other graded assets. Collectors vault a physical item in Courtyard's insured facility and receive a blockchain-backed digital token (an NFT on Ethereum/Polygon) representing verified ownership, which can then be instantly bought, sold, bid on, or redeemed for physical shipment. The platform combines a "Proof of Integrity" authentication process, KYC-gated onboarding, a hosted wallet with fiat funding, digital pack drops and auctions, and a curated showroom experience. Courtyard is a Forerunner Ventures portfolio company operating in the commerce / collectibles sector; it exposes a consumer web application and smart contracts rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: CrowdStreet
providers.description: Crowd Street (formerly CrowdStreet) is an online private-markets investing platform that gives accredited investors direct access to commercial real estate, private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real estate fund offerings. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, the company operates a marketplace where sponsors raise capital and members subscribe to individual deals, diversified funds, and managed portfolios, alongside an education center, glossary, and research library. Crowd Street Capital LLC is a FINRA-member broker-dealer and Crowd Street Advisors LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser. The platform is delivered as a members-only investor web application; as of this profile Crowd Street publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Detail
providers.description: Detail is a video creation and editing app for iOS and macOS built by Detail Technologies B.V., a Point Nine portfolio company. It combines multi-camera recording, AI-powered auto-editing (silence removal, zoom cuts, captions, titles, and music), live multi-platform streaming to YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, and LinkedIn, a built-in teleprompter, green-screen background removal, and automatic captions, aimed at creators, podcasters, and streamers producing polished video quickly. Detail won the 2025 App Store Award for iPad App of the Year and was a 2026 Apple Design Award finalist. It is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Devv
providers.description: Devv (devv.ai) is an AI coding agent and instant-backend platform that lets indie builders, small teams, and non-technical creators ship full-stack, AI-powered web applications from natural-language prompts. It began as a developer-focused AI search engine and was rebuilt as Devv 2.0 into a no-code app builder with a three-step workflow. The platform pairs code generation with built-in backend integrations — authentication, database, email, LLM chat, image and audio generation — plus third-party connectors such as OpenRouter, Replicate, and ElevenLabs, alongside web search and web reader tooling. Devv is a product company rather than a public API provider: it publishes docs, a dated changelog, and an llms.txt, but exposes no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or hosted MCP server at this time. Backed by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: DSG Sports Analytics
providers.description: DSG Sports Analytics, operated by Data Sports Group, is a sports data provider offering live scores, statistics, historical data, fixtures, player and team information, and odds across more than 80 sports including soccer, basketball, American football, cricket, tennis, ice hockey, e-sports, and Olympic disciplines. The DSG Sports Data API delivers this content in JSON and XML over HTTPS using credential-based authentication.

providers.name: EchoLeads
providers.description: EchoLeads is an autonomous AI voice sales platform out of T-Hub, Hyderabad, India, that replaces manual SDR work with AI agents running a full omnichannel workflow: outbound cold calling and inbound response, real-time BANT qualification, WhatsApp Business follow-up, Instagram DM lead capture, live intent-based lead scoring, human handoff, CRM sync, and calendar booking during the call. It sells into real estate, insurance, SaaS, healthcare, financial services and e-commerce, supports English, Hindi and regional Indian languages, and claims TRAI-compliant outbound calling. It is backed by Google for Startups, T-Hub and Math Nuage (DST, Government of India). Agent-native surface is real and verified — a live llms.txt, a full llms-full.txt content index, an RFC 9116 security.txt, and an AI-crawler-permissive robots.txt. The API surface is not: a REST API is self-declared in llms-full.txt (trigger calls, retrieve transcripts, push lead scores) but the documentation page returns 502, api.echoleads.ai has no listener, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, Postman collection or MCP server is published on any host.

providers.name: EDDA Technology
providers.description: EDDA Technology, Inc. is a Princeton, New Jersey medical imaging software company behind the IQQA platform for computer-assisted radiology and surgery. IQQA delivers 3D quantitative image analysis, automated segmentation and volumetric measurement over CT and MR studies, supporting pre-surgical planning and simulation, intra-operative guidance and monitoring, post-operative follow-up evaluation, and clinical training across liver, lung, kidney and interventional oncology. Products include IQQA-BodyImaging, IQQA-Guide, IQQA-Chest, IQQA-Liver, IQQA-Liver Function, IQQA-eQMR and the IQQA-eFusion edge-AI surgical navigation system. The company is FDA cleared and CE marked under EU MDR 2017/745, and raised a US$150 million round led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 with OrbiMed participation in April 2021. EDDA publishes no developer API for IQQA — it is regulated medical device software deployed on-premises in hospitals — so the only public API surface catalogued here is the WordPress REST API serving eddatech.com content.

providers.name: Eden Health
providers.description: Eden Health was a primary and virtual care company that delivered app-based medical care, behavioral health, and care navigation to employers and their employees, integrating with health systems and insurers (backed by Insight Partners). It was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its public marketing site is no longer reachable over TLS, but its primary backend service — the "Grdn" (Guardian) API at api.edenhealth.com — still serves a Swagger 2.0 description covering patients, appointments, membership, documents, care teams, and clinician tooling.

providers.name: Fresha
providers.description: Fresha is a marketplace and business-management platform for the beauty and wellness industry — salons, barbershops, spas, medspas and independent professionals. Consumers discover and instantly book appointments across 120+ countries (over one billion appointments booked), while businesses run scheduling and calendar, client management, point of sale, integrated card and online payments, automated messaging (SMS, WhatsApp and email) and marketing. Fresha is subscription-free for businesses, monetizing through payment processing, marketing add-ons and new-client marketplace fees, and is backed by investors including Partech and KKR. Fresha does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; its public engineering footprint is the open-source @fresha Web API tooling on GitHub (OpenAPI lint, diff and codegen).

providers.name: Genalyte
providers.description: Genalyte, Inc. is a San Diego, California in-vitro diagnostics company building point-of-care blood testing systems based on silicon photonic microring resonator technology. Founded by Cary Gunn, the company developed the Maverick Diagnostic System and its successor Merlin, an automated benchtop analyzer that runs hematology, chemistry and immunoassay panels — including CBC, lipid panel and comprehensive metabolic panel — from small whole-blood or serum volumes and returns results in roughly twenty to thirty minutes while the patient is still in the clinic. A cloud verification layer the company markets as CloudLab quality-checks results and routes them into electronic medical record systems. Genalyte received FDA clearance for a thyroid stimulating hormone immunoassay performed on a silicon chip and previously held an FDA Emergency Use Authorization for a rapid COVID-19 antibody test. The company is investor-backed (Khosla Ventures, Verily Life Sciences and others) and is a HIPAA covered entity that publishes a Notice of Privacy Practices. As of this profile Genalyte publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: General Intuition
providers.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab building large action foundation models that can perceive, predict, and act across space and time in both virtual and physical environments. Spun out of the gaming clip platform Medal, the company trains its spatial-temporal reasoning models on billions of action-labeled gameplay clips - recordings of exactly which buttons a player pressed and when - to teach AI agents how to move through and reason about the world. Its Mira world model powers applications across games, simulation, and robotics. Founded in 2025 and based in New York City, General Intuition has raised $454M total, including a $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation, and is onboarding first partners to a commercial API ahead of a broader developer release.

providers.name: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur
providers.description: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur / IIT KGP) is a public technical and research university in West Bengal, India, and the first of the IITs, ranked #222 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its public digital footprint centers on machine-readable scholarly infrastructure rather than a formal developer program: the Central Library operates a DSpace-based Institutional Digital Repository (the first IR among the IITs) and the institute maintains an IRINS research-profile portal hosted by INFLIBNET that ingests data from ORCID, Scopus, and Crossref. Operational systems such as the ERP/SSO platform are gated to enrolled members and expose no public API documentation. No official institution-wide developer portal was found; this profile catalogs the publicly reachable, standards-based endpoints only.

providers.name: Insightec
providers.description: Insightec Ltd. is an Israeli medical device company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Tirat Carmel, Israel, that develops and sells MR-guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS) systems under the Exablate brand. Its Exablate Neuro platform focuses more than a thousand ultrasound beams through the intact skull to ablate a target deep in the brain without an incision, and is approved for essential tremor and Parkinson's disease, including staged bilateral treatment. The Exablate body platform is used for uterine fibroids, palliation of bone metastases, and prostate indications, and the company runs clinical programs in blood-brain-barrier opening and glioblastoma. Insightec publishes a public product documentation portal of operator manuals and handbooks for the Exablate systems, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs, or agent surface; its systems integrate with GE and Siemens MR scanners as clinical devices rather than through a public API.

providers.name: Invicti
providers.description: Invicti is an enterprise web application security solution providing automated vulnerability scanning, DAST, and API security testing. The Invicti platform includes API Discovery capabilities that help build a complete inventory of an organization's internal and external API assets.

providers.name: Kaniko
providers.description: Kaniko is an open-source tool from Google that builds container images from a Dockerfile inside a container or Kubernetes cluster without requiring a Docker daemon. It executes each command within a Dockerfile in userspace, enabling secure container builds in environments where running a Docker daemon is impractical or insecure. The project was archived on June 3, 2025, and is now read-only.

providers.name: Keepit
providers.description: Keepit is a SaaS backup and recovery platform providing independent cloud-to-cloud data protection for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and other SaaS applications.

providers.name: LendingPad
providers.description: LendingPad is a cloud-based mortgage loan origination system (LOS) that lets brokers, lenders, and institutions originate, process, underwrite, close, and fund residential mortgage loans with real-time, multi-user collaboration across the borrower, broker, lender, and service-provider lifecycle. It ships in Broker, Lender, Processing, and Institution editions and runs a large Partners Marketplace of integrated vendors (credit, AUS, AVM/appraisal, title, compliance, doc-prep, pricing/PPE, POS, CRM, and investors such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, UWM, and Rocket Mortgage). LendingPad exposes an Enterprise API for loan data exchange, but access is gated - it is limited to Lender Edition clients under an executed API Agreement and NDA, keys and testing-site access are issued by the support desk, and there is no public developer portal or self-serve API reference. The API entries below are honestly modeled from the vendor-integration and marketplace capabilities LendingPad describes publicly; endpoint-level surfaces are not published and are not fabricated here.

providers.name: Lovable
providers.description: Lovable is an AI app builder that generates full-stack web applications from natural- language prompts, with live preview, GitHub sync, and Supabase / Firebase integration. Lovable's developer-facing surface is in early release: the "Build with URL" API generates apps from a shareable URL, and the Lovable MCP Server lets AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor) manage Lovable projects via Model Context Protocol.

providers.name: Magic
providers.description: Magic is an embedded-wallet and authentication platform offering passwordless login (magic links, OAuth, WebAuthn, SMS) plus white-label Embedded Wallets and Server Wallets. Primary surface is the Magic SDK; an Admin REST API exists for user lookup, token validation, and metadata.

providers.name: Make the Dot
providers.description: Make the Dot is an AI-powered product development platform for fashion and apparel teams. It unifies design, development, and merchandising workflows so brands can build production-ready collections digitally — reducing physical sampling, accelerating time to market, and connecting the tools teams already use (PLM, Shopify, NuOrder, Airtable, Google Suite, Salesforce, Coloro, fabric mills, and Browzwear). It serves everyone from independent Shopify brands to billion-dollar apparel companies. Make the Dot is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a web application and a help center but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Media Chain
providers.description: Mediachain (Mediachain Labs) was a decentralized universal media library and attribution protocol built on IPFS and blockchain technology, designed to let creators and applications collaborate on open metadata about creative works and track the provenance and ownership of online images and other media. Founded in 2016 with seed funding from Andreessen Horowitz and Union Square Ventures, the company was acqui-hired by Spotify in April 2017 to help build fair, blockchain-based royalty attribution for rightsholders. The company is now defunct and its primary domain (mediachain.io) is a parked page, but its open-source protocol, design documentation, Protocol Buffer definitions, and first-party client libraries (the `aleph`/`mcclient` JavaScript client on npm and the `mediachain-client` Python reader on PyPI) remain public under the github.com/mediachain organization. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from its surviving open-source surface.

providers.name: Milkman
providers.description: Milkman is an open-source, JavaFx-based, plugin-driven request/response workbench and desktop alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It supports multiple protocols including HTTP/REST, GraphQL, gRPC (with server reflection and streaming), WebSocket, Socket.IO, JDBC/SQL, Cassandra CQL, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

providers.name: Mirantis
providers.description: Mirantis provides enterprise Kubernetes and container platform solutions for multi-cloud, hybrid-cloud, and edge deployments. Its product line includes Mirantis Kubernetes Engine (MKE), k0rdent Enterprise, Mirantis OpenStack for Kubernetes (MOSK), Mirantis Container Runtime, Mirantis Secure Registry, Lens Desktop, and the open source k0s Kubernetes distribution and k0smotron orchestrator.

providers.name: Nilus
providers.description: Nilus is an AI-powered treasury management platform ("your agentic workforce for treasury") that gives finance teams real-time cash visibility across banks, entities and currencies. Its modular platform pairs pre-built AI agents with connectivity to 20,000+ banks and payment service providers (via SWIFT, host-to-host and API) and major ERPs (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Dynamics 365) to automate reconciliation, cash-flow forecasting, payment workflows, FX exposure tracking, debt-covenant monitoring and idle-cash investment. Founded in 2021 by Daniel Kalish (ex-PayPal) and Danielle Shaul (ex-Fundbox), Nilus is based in New York with a Tel Aviv presence, is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Felicis and Vesey Ventures, and serves customers including Alloy, Taboola, Made In Cookware and Planned Parenthood. Nilus operates as a closed B2B SaaS and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI contract or developer portal.

providers.name: Orolabs
providers.description: ORO Labs provides an agentic procurement orchestration platform for enterprise spend management. It coordinates people, processes, systems, and data so employees can get what they need without friction, unifying intake management, supplier onboarding and lifecycle, risk and compliance orchestration, and AI-driven workflow automation. The platform offers a no-code workflow builder, a purpose-built agent builder for custom procurement AI agents, and bring-your-own-LLM flexibility, with secure, semantically rich integrations across the procuretech landscape. ORO Labs is backed by Felicis and Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: PredictionIO
providers.description: Apache PredictionIO is an open source machine learning server that lets developers and data scientists build, deploy, and serve predictive engines as web services. Originally the commercial product prediction.io from TappingStone, it was acquired by Salesforce in 2016, donated to the Apache Software Foundation, and graduated as a top-level Apache project before being retired to the Apache Attic. It exposes a REST-based Event Server for collecting event data and an Engine Query API for real-time predictions, built on Apache Spark, MLlib, HBase, Elasticsearch, and Akka HTTP, with official SDKs for Python, Ruby, PHP, and Scala/Java. This profile enriches the original portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Pretto
providers.description: Pretto is a French online mortgage brokerage (courtier en credit immobilier) operated by FINSPOT SAS, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Paris. It runs a digital platform that lets borrowers simulate a home loan, compare rates across more than 125 partner banks, assemble a financing file and be accompanied by a human credit expert through to signature, and it publishes a transparent, non-negotiable fee schedule instead of the bank-funded commission model used by most French brokers. Pretto also operates Pretto Galaxie, a B2B network that opens the same technology stack — semi-automated file assembly, an embeddable loan simulator, a client portal, a commission dashboard and a back-office service — to independent brokers, and Pretto Search, a consumer property-search product priced against real borrowing capacity. FINSPOT is registered with ORIAS (17000916) as a banking/payment-services and insurance broker and is supervised by the ACPR. As of this pass Pretto publishes no public developer program: the api.pretto.fr host serves its API reference behind HTTP Basic auth and the developers.pretto.fr ReadMe hub is deactivated.

providers.name: PrimeRevenue
providers.description: PrimeRevenue is a global financial technology company providing working capital and B2B payment solutions through a bank-agnostic, ERP-integrated platform. Its offerings include Supply Chain Finance (buyers extend payment terms while suppliers are paid early), Receivables Finance (suppliers sell invoices for early payment without buyer disclosure), Dynamic Discounting (early payment at variable discount rates), and Payments as a Service (a modern B2B payment layer). The platform manages more than $25B in daily assets, has accelerated over 12.5M invoices, and supports 30+ languages. PrimeRevenue does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate, security, and compliance surface. Backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Qlik Mashups
providers.description: APIs and resources for building custom visualizations and analytics applications using Qlik Sense mashups.

providers.name: RefleXion Medical
providers.description: RefleXion Medical is a privately held therapeutic oncology company headquartered in Hayward, California, founded in 2009 by Sam Mazin and Akshay Nanduri around the biology-guided radiotherapy (BgRT) concept conceived at Stanford University in 2007. The company designs, manufactures and commercializes the RefleXion X1 radiotherapy platform and SCINTIX biology-guided radiotherapy, which uses onboard PET detectors to sense emissions from an injected radiopharmaceutical and autonomously direct external-beam radiotherapy delivery with sub-second latency. The RefleXion X1 received FDA clearance for SRS, SBRT and IMRT in 2020, and SCINTIX therapy was FDA cleared in February 2023 for treating tumors in the lung or bone arising from primary and metastatic cancer. RefleXion has raised more than $500 million from investors including TPG's The Rise Fund, KCK Group, PSP Investments, Sofinnova, Pfizer Ventures and Johnson & Johnson Innovation. RefleXion is a medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: SmartSuite
providers.description: SmartSuite is a collaborative work management platform that helps teams plan, track, and manage workflows, projects, and everyday tasks using customizable solutions, tables, records, and automations. The platform combines spreadsheet, database, project management, and workflow automation capabilities into a unified workspace. SmartSuite's REST API provides programmatic access to Solutions, Tables, Records, and Fields using token-based authentication.

providers.name: Southwestern Energy
providers.description: Southwestern Energy Company (SWN) is one of the largest producers of natural gas in the United States, with exploration and production operations focused primarily on the Marcellus and Haynesville shales. In October 2024, Southwestern Energy completed a merger with Expand Energy Corporation (formerly Chesapeake Energy), though the SWN brand and investor relations infrastructure continues to operate under swn.com. As a Fortune 500 energy company, SWN focuses on responsible development of natural gas resources in the Appalachian Basin and Gulf Coast regions.

providers.name: Speak
providers.description: Speak (Speakeasy Labs, Inc.) is an AI-powered language learning application focused on spoken fluency rather than grammar drills or vocabulary memorization. Its proprietary "Speak Method" has learners study real phrases, practice them across contexts, and then apply them in back-and-forth conversation with an AI tutor that gives real-time pronunciation and fluency feedback. Speak teaches Spanish, French, Korean, Japanese, Italian, German, and Chinese, plus English for non-English speakers, and offers B2B language training for organizations across Korea, Japan, Spain, Taiwan, and France. The company is backed by Accel and the OpenAI Startup Fund and partners with OpenAI. Speak runs a production application backend at api.usespeak.com (an OAuth2/OIDC issuer) but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; the surfaces below were discovered from the company's public well-known and llms.txt endpoints.

providers.name: Strategic Blue
providers.description: Strategic Blue is a UK-headquartered cloud FinOps company founded in 2010 by Dr James Mitchell, a former commodities trader. It specialises in AWS rate optimization through commitment management, delivering Reserved Instance and Savings Plan savings of up to 40-45% without lock-in, forecasting burden, or technical compromise. Strategic Blue treats cloud like a commodity, applying price-risk-management techniques from financial markets to optimize AWS discounts. Its Automate service serves commercial enterprises while Accelerate serves the UK public sector. The company operates on a least-privilege model, accessing only cost and usage metadata and never customer cloud environments. It is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001 certified, CSA STAR and Cyber Essentials registered, and an AWS Advanced and Google Cloud Premier partner.

providers.name: Summer 2
providers.description: SummerOS (formerly reached at gosummer.com, which now 308-redirects to summeros.com) is an AI-driven asset-intelligence platform for short-term rental operators, owners, investors, and property managers. It provides professional-grade revenue forecasting, competitive market intelligence, and portfolio-wide performance analytics, plus an AI assistant (Sunny AI), so short-term rental teams can make data-driven pricing and investment decisions instead of relying on spreadsheets. It connects to property-management systems (Guesty, Hospitable, Streamline, Track) rather than exposing a public developer API. Surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio lead and enriched from its live public surface.

providers.name: Turintech
providers.description: TurinTech AI builds Artemis, a code and AI optimization platform that searches configuration spaces across models, runtime, hardware, and source code to make production AI systems and software faster, cheaper, and more reliable without changing the existing stack. Artemis spans AI inference, agentic software, latency-critical infrastructure, and planning & scheduling, and is driven through the Artemis CLI, which imports Git repositories, generates and validates AI-optimized code versions (via LLM, agent, or genetic-algorithm methods), runs compile/test/benchmark validation, and opens optimization pull requests. TurinTech also offers evoML for automated machine-learning model building. Access is via the Artemis CLI and platform using an API key (ARTEMIS_API_KEY). The company is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: UrbanSitter
providers.description: UrbanSitter is an online marketplace that connects families with trusted local caregivers, including babysitters, nannies, child care providers, daycares and preschools, tutors, pet sitters, senior caregivers, and household help. Operated by UrbanSitter, Inc., the platform lets parents browse caregiver profiles, read reviews from other families, compare pay rates, and book and pay sitters, while caregivers find and manage child care and home care jobs. UrbanSitter runs its platform on a private Spring Boot API (Swagger UI is IP-safelisted) and does not publish a public developer program.

providers.name: Valdera
providers.description: Valdera is the AI-powered sourcing and procurement platform for chemicals, ingredients, and raw materials, matching buyers with vetted global suppliers across a database of 400K+ suppliers and 1.7M+ unique chemistries. Buyers get supplier discovery, RFQs, and negotiation in one place; suppliers receive relevant inbound RFQs and fulfill orders on the platform. Valdera is a web platform, not an API provider — it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Vetcove
providers.description: Vetcove is a free purchasing and procurement platform for veterinary clinics and animal-health organizations that lets a practice shop every distributor and manufacturer at once. It consolidates accounts from suppliers such as Henry Schein, Patterson Vet, MWI, and Midwest Veterinary into one interface where staff compare live pricing and availability, place and track orders, and manage inventory across vendors without changing existing supplier relationships. The service is delivered as a web application and mobile app and is free to veterinary clinics and nonprofits. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: VuMedi
providers.description: VuMedi (Vumedi, Inc.) operates a video education platform for physicians and other healthcare professionals. Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Oakland, California, with offices in Saint Louis Park, Minnesota and Zagreb, Croatia, the platform aggregates a library of long-form educational videos, webinars, conference coverage and case discussions contributed by key opinion leaders and academic medical centers across more than twenty-five clinical specialties. Physicians use it to watch surgical technique videos, follow live and on-demand webinars, discuss cases with peers and presenters, and stay current on clinical evidence. The company monetizes through industry partnerships with pharmaceutical and medical-device brands rather than a subscription paywall. As of August 2026 VuMedi publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs or MCP server; its public surface is the consumer web application, an iOS app, and a set of static marketing and policy pages.

providers.name: Amazon Web Services
providers.description: A network index of all Amazon Web Services (AWS) API profiles maintained by the API Evangelist organization, covering all AWS services across compute, storage, database, networking, security, AI/ML, and more.

providers.name: AngularJS
providers.description: AngularJS (Angular.js, version 1.x) is the original Angular JavaScript framework for building dynamic single-page web applications, created by Google. It introduced MVC patterns to front-end development with two-way data binding, dependency injection, directives, filters, services, and controllers. AngularJS reached End of Life on December 31, 2021 and is no longer actively maintained. Developers should migrate to the modern Angular framework (v14+).

providers.name: ANN Inc.
providers.description: ANN Inc. is the former parent company of Ann Taylor and LOFT, specialty retailers of women's apparel, shoes, and accessories. ANN Inc. was acquired by Ascena Retail Group in 2015 and subsequently sold to Sycamore Partners in December 2020 for $540 million, alongside Lane Bryant and Lou & Grey brands. The brands now operate under KnitWell Group (formerly Premium Apparel LLC), a Sycamore Partners holding company that also owns Talbots. Ann Taylor and LOFT offer affiliate programs for digital publishers.

providers.name: Antares Therapeutics
providers.description: Antares Therapeutics is a Boston- and South San Francisco-based precision medicine company developing small-molecule therapies against validated but previously undruggable targets in cancer and other serious diseases. Spun out of Scorpion Therapeutics following Eli Lilly's March 2025 acquisition of Scorpion, Antares launched in June 2025 with a $177 million Series A co-led by Omega Funds, Atlas Venture, Lightspeed Venture Partners, BVF Partners and Cormorant Asset Management. The company combines medicinal chemistry (proprietary compound libraries and next-generation mass spectrometry to find new chemical pockets), target biology (first-in-class preclinically validated targets and allosteric approaches to clinically validated ones), and predictive sciences (physics-based modeling, machine learning and molecular dynamics) to shorten discovery cycles. Its most advanced program is expected to enter the clinic in 2026, with multiple additional preclinical programs and discovery collaborations with Novartis, AstraZeneca and Pierre Fabre Laboratories. Antares is a private, preclinical-stage biotechnology company and publishes no public product API, developer portal or SDK surface.

providers.name: Apache Sqoop
providers.description: Apache Sqoop is a command-line tool designed for efficiently transferring bulk data between Apache Hadoop and structured data stores such as relational databases. It supports parallel import and export of data, incremental loads, and direct database connectors for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and DB2. Note: Apache Sqoop has been retired to the Apache Attic as of 2021. Users are encouraged to migrate to Apache Spark or Apache NiFi.

providers.name: Bark
providers.description: Bark is a digital safety and parental-controls company that helps families keep children safer online and in the real world. Its AI-powered platform monitors texts, email, social media, web browsing, and 30+ apps across more than 20 content categories, flagging potential issues such as online predators, cyberbullying, self-harm, and adult content, and pairs that monitoring with screen-time management, app blocking, web filtering, and GPS location alerts. Bark ships as an app for existing iOS and Android devices as well as purpose-built hardware including the Bark Phone, Bark Watch, and Bark Home.

providers.name: BitTorrent
providers.description: BitTorrent is the company behind the BitTorrent peer-to-peer file-sharing protocol and the uTorrent and BitTorrent desktop and web torrent clients, one of the most widely deployed distributed content-delivery technologies on the internet. Now part of the TRON ecosystem, BitTorrent also operates BitTorrent Chain (BTTC) — a layer-2 proof-of-stake cross-chain scaling and interoperability network bridging TRON, Ethereum, and BSC — along with the BTT token, the BTFS decentralized storage layer, and BitTorrent Speed. Its developer surface spans the local uTorrent Web UI API for controlling torrent clients and the BitTorrent Chain developer documentation for building on the BTTC network. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bstow
providers.description: Bstow is a fintech-for-good startup whose flagship product, Cheerful Giving, lets nonprofits and their supporters raise money through spare-change round-up donations, recurring gifts, and branded campaign pages. Backed by 500 Global, Bstow's Cheerful Giving product now operates as part of the Goodworld social-impact platform (goodworldnow.com), which layers on giving forms, events, peer-to-peer and workplace/payroll giving, text engagement, and an impact CRM. The platform documents webhooks and partner integrations (Salesforce, Stripe, PayPal, Klaviyo, Zapier, Fundraise Up) but does not publish a public, self-serve API reference or OpenAPI specification; API access is arranged directly with the vendor through a sales-gated developer portal. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: CarMax
providers.description: CarMax (NYSE: KMX) is the largest retailer of used cars in the United States, operating an omnichannel business that spans brick-and-mortar stores, carmax.com online purchasing, home delivery, financing, appraisals, and trade-ins. CarMax does not publish a public developer portal, but its engineering organization operates an extensive internal API program built around distinct API roles (Data Access Layer, Business Logic Layer, Server-Driven UI, Backend for Frontend). Public-facing APIs documented by the CarMax Engineering Blog include a Store Locations API and a Vehicle Inventory API, and CarMax has publicly discussed a Server-Driven UI API that controls vehicle search filters across web and mobile. Partner and syndication integrations are handled case by case rather than through a self-service portal.

providers.name: Caya
providers.description: Caya (Caya GmbH, Berlin) is a German intelligent document processing (IDP) company whose Document Automation Suite digitizes, classifies, and routes business documents end to end. Its core capabilities are Post Scan (physical mail intake with OCR and automatic classification), Document Extractions (AI-powered structured data extraction), and Document Automations (rule-based routing and distribution into downstream systems). Caya connects to 100+ tools across accounting, ERP, HR, cloud storage, and e-signature, and hosts data in a high-security Frankfurt data center. It is certified and compliant against ISO 27001, GDPR/DSGVO, DORA, GoBD, and German HGB/AO retention rules, with a public Vanta-hosted trust center. Surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cequence Security
providers.description: Cequence Security delivers the Unified API Protection (UAP) platform, combining external API attack-surface discovery, posture and compliance analysis, inline runtime protection, and testing into a single solution for defending web applications, APIs, and AI endpoints against business logic abuse, bot attacks, and fraud. The Cequence product family is organized into API Spyder (agentless external discovery), API Sentinel (API inventory, posture, and compliance), API Spartan (runtime bot and abuse defense), API Security Testing (shift-left OpenAPI conformance and vulnerability testing), and Cequence Defender (inline reverse-proxy enforcement of API policy).

providers.name: Cheniere Energy
providers.description: Cheniere Energy, Inc. is an international energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas, and is the leading producer and exporter of liquefied natural gas (LNG) in the United States. Cheniere operates the Sabine Pass LNG terminal in Louisiana and the Corpus Christi LNG terminal in Texas, providing full-service LNG solutions including liquefaction, vessel loading, and regasification to customers worldwide. Cheniere does not currently expose a public developer API; supplier and contractor integration is handled through a dedicated portal, and investors and customers are served through corporate, sustainability, and IR channels.

providers.name: Cline
providers.description: Cline (formerly Claude Dev) is an open-source autonomous coding agent. The Cline VS Code extension has 5M+ installs; JetBrains is in early access; the Cline CLI is also available. Edits files, runs commands, uses the browser, and federates to multiple LLM providers. An MCP Marketplace extends Cline with custom tools. There is also a hosted/managed offering (Cline.bot) with free and paid tiers plus enterprise sales.

providers.name: CO2 AI
providers.description: CO2 AI is an enterprise sustainability platform that helps organizations measure, reduce, and report carbon emissions across their entire value chain. It combines trustworthy emissions data, AI-powered workflows, and supply-chain collaboration to baseline and track Scope 1, 2, and 3 corporate footprints, compute audit-ready product carbon footprints (PCF) at scale across thousands of SKUs (PACT, TfS, PEF, ISO aligned), engage suppliers for primary data, and build decarbonization plans ranked by Marginal Abatement Cost. Backed by Partech and surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a climate-sector company profile. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile captures the company's security, trust, and legal surface.

providers.name: Columnar
providers.description: Columnar is a data-infrastructure company advancing open standards for database connectivity. It builds and maintains tooling around ADBC (Apache Arrow Database Connectivity), including dbc — a cross-platform command-line package manager that installs and manages ADBC drivers across macOS, Linux, and Windows and eight programming languages — and databow, a command-line SQL query tool over ADBC. Columnar also ships the DuckDB ADBC community extension and publishes Agent Skills so AI agents can connect to and query databases through ADBC. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and is built on the Apache Arrow open-source ecosystem.

providers.name: Connect-RPC
providers.description: Connect is a slim framework for building browser-friendly and gRPC-compatible HTTP APIs from Protocol Buffer schemas. Servers built with Connect speak the Connect protocol, gRPC, and gRPC-Web simultaneously, while clients can switch between protocols without changing code. Connect provides type-safe SDKs for Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Swift, Kotlin, and Python, plus the Buf-generated `protoc-gen-connect-*` code generators. The project is open source under the Apache 2.0 license and is maintained by Buf.

providers.name: Face Reality Skincare
providers.description: Face Reality Skincare is a professional acne-treatment skincare brand whose online store, at facerealityskincare.com, is built on Shopify. Beyond the consumer storefront, the store publishes a full agent-commerce surface: a hosted Storefront MCP server (5 shop/cart tools), a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a Shopify Customer Account API exposed via OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 discovery, and a published llms.txt / agents.md describing how AI shopping agents may browse, build carts, and hand off to a human-approved checkout. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched into the API Evangelist network from its live public discovery documents.

providers.name: Flux CD
providers.description: Flux is a set of continuous and progressive delivery solutions for Kubernetes that are open and extensible, enabling GitOps-based automation for keeping Kubernetes clusters in sync with sources of configuration like Git repositories.

providers.name: Frame Security
providers.description: Frame Security is an AI-powered human risk management and security awareness platform that defends organizations against human-targeted attacks such as phishing, deepfakes, and social engineering. Frame generates personalized security awareness training in 70+ languages, hyper-realistic email, voice, and video phishing and deepfake simulations built from an organization's own context, employee risk scoring with targeted interventions, automated phishing triage of reported suspicious emails, and cross-platform reporting and integrations. The company is backed by Index Ventures and raised a $50M round in 2026.

providers.name: Heex Technologies
providers.description: Heex Technologies builds the Smart-Data Platform, an event-based data management solution for autonomous systems, robotics, and ADAS/AD vehicles. Instead of moving raw big data off fleets, Heex lets engineering teams define Smart Events with pre-set triggers so software agents capture only the most relevant, context-rich data ("Smart-Data") directly at the edge or in the cloud. The platform spans a Heex Agent/SDK deployed on robots and vehicles (Ubuntu x86_64/ARM, ROS/ROS2), a Heex CLI for operating the SDK and Heex Cloud, and a web platform for triggers, events, recordings, and fleet monitoring. It is used across AMRs, industrial robots, smart mobility, and off-road autonomy, with customers and partners including NVIDIA, Siemens, RATP, Vinci, Stanley Robotics, Apex.AI and Helm.AI. Backed by Techstars, Google for Startups, and AWS Activate.

providers.name: HelloVerify
providers.description: HelloVerify is India's leading background verification (BGV) and employee screening company, delivering fast, accurate, and compliant primary-source verification for employment, education, healthcare credentialing, immigration, and enterprise workforce programs. The platform has completed 20M+ verifications for 2000+ organizations across 120+ countries, offering AI-powered background checks, customer KYC with identity and liveness, vendor due diligence (Certifier), and instant messaging-based verification (HelloV). HelloVerify operates an audited information-security and compliance program (ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, Cyber Essentials, GDPR) and serves regulators, enterprises, SMBs, and applicants worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a dcvc portfolio company; no public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: HSBC USA
providers.description: HSBC USA is the United States arm of HSBC Holdings plc, operating principally through HSBC Bank USA, N.A., a nationally chartered bank supervised by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC). After exiting mass-market domestic retail banking in 2022 — selling its East Coast branches and national online deposit business to Citizens and its West Coast branches to Cathay Bank — HSBC refocused its US operations on global wholesale, commercial and corporate banking, global banking and markets, and wealth management for internationally connected clients. On the open-finance front, HSBC USA does not publish a US-specific first-party developer program; public API access is provided through HSBC's group-wide corporate and institutional Developer Portal (developer.hsbc.com), whose transaction-banking API products serve US wholesale clients but require registration and login to reach the actual API reference and specifications. There is no publicly downloadable OpenAPI, and consumer-permissioned data access for remaining US accounts is mediated through third-party aggregators rather than a documented first-party consumer data-sharing API.

providers.name: Illuminate Education
providers.description: Illuminate Education is a K-12 education technology company providing assessment, data analytics, and Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) tools to schools and districts. Its platform serves roughly 17 million students across 5,200 schools and districts in all 50 states, taking a "whole child" approach that combines academic and social-emotional-behavioral data. Marquee products are FastBridge (universal screening and progress monitoring), DnA (standards-based assessment creation and scoring), and eduCLIMBER (MTSS collaboration and district data management). Illuminate does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI; data exchange runs through education-interoperability standards (LTI 1.0/1.1 Certified, OneRoster, Ed-Fi 2.5+, QTI) and partner/SIS/LMS integrations. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners, headquartered in Irvine, California.

providers.name: Imagen
providers.description: Imagen (Imagen Technologies) is an AI-enabled, sub-specialized diagnostic imaging partner for independent practices, hospitals, and health systems. It combines in-clinic imaging equipment, FDA-cleared AI algorithms, and a 24/7 teleradiology network of fellowship-trained, board-certified specialists to deliver rapid, accurate radiology interpretations, plus advanced analytics for care-gap identification. Imagen operates across 23 states, serving roughly 3.5 million patients, and is backed by GV and Threshold Ventures. The company publishes a security program covering SOC 2 Type II, the HITRUST CSF, and HIPAA. Imagen Technologies exposes no public developer API surface at this time. (Note the distinct namesake company Imagen AI, imagen-ai.com, an AI photo-editing product that does publish an API and SDK.)

providers.name: Impulse Dynamics
providers.description: Impulse Dynamics is a medical-device company that created Cardiac Contractility Modulation (CCM) therapy, delivered by the implantable Optimizer Smart and Optimizer Smart Mini pulse generators for patients with moderate-to-severe chronic heart failure who remain symptomatic despite guideline-directed medical therapy. Incorporated in 1997, with US headquarters in Marlton, New Jersey, the company won the first-ever FDA Breakthrough Device designation and received FDA approval for the Optimizer Smart in March 2019; the device has been CE marked since October 2016 and is now approved in more than 30 countries plus China. Impulse Dynamics operates no developer programme: there is no developer portal, API documentation, API reference, SDK, CLI, sandbox, pricing or sign-up, and nothing clinical or device-related is exposed as an API. It is catalogued here because its corporate website runs a live, anonymous, self-describing WordPress REST API advertising 420 routes across 30 namespaces, because that same install exposes two Model Context Protocol servers, and because the company publishes a substantive vulnerability disclosure programme with two PGP-published security contacts covering its medical devices, health software and infrastructure.

providers.name: Imubit
providers.description: Imubit is a Houston-based industrial AI company behind the Optimizing Brain, the process industry's first Closed Loop AI Optimization (AIO) solution powered by deep reinforcement learning. Its cloud-based platform learns a dynamic model from a plant's own historian and DCS data, then writes optimal setpoints back through existing control-system infrastructure to continuously optimize throughput, yield, energy use and emissions. Imubit reports 100+ closed-loop applications deployed across refining, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals and polymers, cement and building materials, and mining, minerals and metals, and is trusted by 7 of the 10 largest U.S. refiners. Imubit publishes no public developer API; its GitHub organization ships open-source Python libraries for pulling data from industrial historians (OSIsoft PI, Aspen IP21) and supporting infrastructure.

providers.name: Juno Journey
providers.description: Juno Journey is an AI-powered Learning & Development (L&D) platform that unifies employee training, personalized development planning, skills analytics, and performance management into a single "HumAIn Workforce Platform." Its Juno Agents automate course authoring, build adaptive personal development plans, deliver real-time in-context knowledge assistance, and surface live capability analytics, while a built-in LMS aggregates 150+ external content providers. The product connects to HRIS, identity, messaging, calendar, and performance systems through pre-built integrations (Slack, Okta, Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, Personio, Cornerstone, Google Drive, Microsoft Azure). Juno Journey is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. As of this profile it publishes a marketing site, pricing, a knowledge hub, a blog, a status page, and a public trust center (ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Lansweeper
providers.description: Lansweeper is an IT asset discovery and management platform that automatically scans and inventories hardware, software, users, and cloud resources across on-premises, cloud, and OT environments. It provides a unified technology asset intelligence platform used for IT asset management (ITAM), cybersecurity asset management (CAAM), software asset management, and compliance. The Lansweeper Data API is a GraphQL endpoint that exposes the technology asset intelligence stored in your Lansweeper sites using Bearer token authentication.

providers.name: Leah
providers.description: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi and legally ContractPod Technologies Limited, is a London-headquartered enterprise agentic AI company that unifies contract lifecycle management, legal transformation, procurement, and finance operations into a single autonomous system. Its Leah Agentic OS platform provides skills-based orchestration, agentic workflows, a natural-language app builder, a library of domain-specific legal, contracting, procurement, and finance agents, and the Leah Maestro enterprise orchestrator. Leah is a five-time Gartner CLM Visionary, is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and is used by enterprises including PwC, KPMG, Philips, Alaska Airlines, MUFG, and Cushman & Wakefield. Leah ships pre-built connectors and describes open REST APIs for enterprise integration, but maintains no public developer portal or published API reference — API access is unlocked through the enterprise contract.

providers.name: LeapYear
providers.description: LeapYear Technologies built an enterprise platform for differentially private analytics and machine learning, letting organizations run statistics, SQL-style queries, feature engineering, and supervised and unsupervised model training against their most sensitive data while a mathematically provable privacy guarantee bounds what any single record can leak. The product shipped as a self-hosted server, LeapYear Core, driven by a first-party Python client library that exposes databases, tables, views, users, groups, permissions, privacy profiles, and per-database privacy budgets as programmable resources. Snowflake announced its intent to acquire LeapYear in February 2023 and closed the acquisition for $62.0 million in cash, folding the differential privacy technology and team into the Snowflake Data Cloud clean-room capabilities. The standalone company surface is now retired: leapyear.io no longer answers on HTTPS. The surviving public developer surface is the hosted LeapYear Python client reference for version 4.1.1.

providers.name: Matplotlib
providers.description: Matplotlib is a comprehensive open source library for creating static, animated, and interactive visualizations in Python. It provides a MATLAB-like interface via pyplot and an object-oriented API for full customization of publication-quality figures and plots.

providers.name: Mirza
providers.description: Mirza is a public benefits infrastructure platform that helps government agencies, health plans and MCOs, health systems, and employers enroll people in social safety-net programs (Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, childcare subsidies, and more) and keep them covered as eligibility rules change. It matches individuals to 200+ benefits across all 50 states, verifies eligibility from existing data rather than paperwork, prevents disenrollment through early exemption detection, and generates audit-ready compliance documentation including H.R.1 Medicaid community-engagement support. Mirza integrates with existing eligibility systems rather than replacing them. Founded in 2020 by Siran Cao and Mel Faxon; backed by 500 Global and others.

providers.name: Monnai
providers.description: Monnai is a global consumer-insights infrastructure company that delivers real-time, AI-ready data for decisioning across the entire customer lifecycle. Its Insights API unifies fragmented identity, device, phone, email, and behavioral signals from a proprietary data consortium into clean, contextual 360-degree profiles, enabling financial institutions, fintechs, ecommerce, and marketplaces to power acquisition, onboarding (KYC/AML), risk assessment and fraud detection, credit decisioning, and collections. Monnai provides localized coverage across 190+ countries with a privacy-first, encryption-backed approach. The API is secured with OAuth 2.0. Monnai is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Newman
providers.description: Newman is the open source command-line companion for Postman that runs Postman collections from the CLI for automated API testing in CI/CD pipelines.

providers.name: Nova Labs
providers.description: Nova Labs, Inc. is the company behind the Helium Network, a decentralized wireless network that replaces traditional carrier infrastructure with community-hosted Hotspots and is coordinated on the Solana blockchain and incentivized with the HNT token. Helium operates two networks: a global LoRaWAN network for low-power IoT devices and a cellular/Wi-Fi offload network for mobile connectivity (Helium Mobile). Nova Labs open-sources the network's protocol surface as gRPC/Protobuf service definitions (the helium/proto config, router, and proof-of-coverage services) and publishes a set of first-party client libraries, a command-line tool, and Rust crates for cryptography and protobuf types. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from Nova Labs' public developer surface; much of the legacy Helium IoT REST API tooling is archived following the network's migration to Solana.

providers.name: Operant
providers.description: Operant AI is a San Francisco-based runtime security company (founded 2021, backed by Felicis) that protects cloud and AI applications with real-time, Kubernetes-native "3D Runtime Defense" — discovery, detection, and defense across APIs, services, LLMs, and agents. Its platform delivers automatic API discovery and catalogs, API-to-API microsegmentation, protocol-specific authentication/authorization, traffic rate limiting, inline auto-redaction of sensitive/PII data, and OWASP/MITRE guardrails that block a majority of the OWASP Top 10 threats. Product lines include Agent Protector, Endpoint Protector, AI Gatekeeper, an MCP Gateway, and Cloud Application Detection and Response (CADR). Operant is SOC 2 Type II compliant and publishes open-source tooling such as Woodpecker (red teaming for AI and cloud).

providers.name: PyTorch
providers.description: APIs and resources for PyTorch, an open source machine learning framework for tensor computation and deep learning developed by Meta.

providers.name: Shift Technology
providers.description: Shift Technology is an insurance-focused artificial intelligence company that builds purpose-built AI agents automating critical insurance workflows, including claims processing and automation, fraud and financial-crime detection, coverage assessment, subrogation, and payment integrity. Founded in Paris and now operating globally, Shift serves 120+ insurance customers across more than 30 countries and has analyzed billions of policies, claims, and supporting documents. Shift deploys as cloud SaaS and integrates with insurer core systems through its technology, data, and service partner programs. The company does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or self-service developer portal; integrations are delivered as enterprise engagements. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the artifacts here capture the company's public security, compliance, and domain posture rather than a public API.

providers.name: Shopee
providers.description: Shopee is Southeast Asia's largest e-commerce marketplace, operated by Sea Limited and active across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, and select markets in Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile) and Europe (Spain, Poland). Shopee Open Platform (open.shopee.com) exposes a partner / seller-facing REST API (v2) covering shop configuration, product / SKU management, order processing, logistics and shipping label generation, returns and refunds, discounts and vouchers, payments, push notifications, and global cross-border product management. Authentication uses a partner ID + partner key with per-shop access tokens issued via OAuth- style shop authorization.

providers.name: Shoptiques
providers.description: Shoptiques is an online marketplace that brings thousands of independently owned local boutiques online, letting shoppers discover unique, one-of-a-kind fashion and home decor from over 5,000 stores. Founded in 2012 by Olga Vidisheva, the business rebranded its merchant/POS arm as Material in 2023 while continuing to operate the Shoptiques consumer marketplace. The storefront at shoptiques.com now runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-facing commerce surface: a published llms.txt / agents.md, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect + OAuth 2.0 authentication, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for buyer-approved, agent-driven shopping and checkout.

providers.name: Sudowrite
providers.description: Sudowrite is an AI writing platform built specifically for fiction and creative writers, used by 300,000+ authors from debut novelists to bestselling professionals. Its fiction-trained Muse AI model, alongside Story Bible (AI-powered character, worldbuilding, plot, and style memory), First Draft chapter drafting, and tools like Write, Rewrite, Describe, Expand, Brainstorm, and Canvas, helps writers draft, revise, and develop stories faster without sacrificing their voice. Sudowrite also offers a 1,000+ plugin marketplace, multi-model support (Sudowrite Muse, Claude, GPT, Gemini), and web plus iOS/Android apps. Named "a salvation" by The New Yorker and featured in The New York Times, The Verge, Time, and Wired. Sudowrite publishes no public developer API; the surface here is its consumer product, docs, and support properties.

providers.name: Thamarah Al-Jill Co LLC
providers.description: Thamarah Al-Jill Co LLC operates AMUSED Co (amusedco.com), a Saudi Arabia-based online marketplace for authenticated, curated pre-loved luxury — designer handbags and women's clothing from houses such as Louis Vuitton, Hermes and Chanel at up to 70% off retail. Under a "Resell, Rebuy, Relove" model, buyers shop verified second-hand pieces (backed by a one-year authentication money-back guarantee) and sellers list their own unused items; payment options include credit card, Mada and Tamara. The store is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is built on Shopify and is fully agent-native: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and implements the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) over an MCP endpoint, with Shopify Customer Accounts OpenID Connect for buyer authentication.

providers.name: The Carlyle Group
providers.description: The Carlyle Group (NASDAQ: CG) is a global investment firm that deploys private capital across Global Private Equity, Global Credit, Global Investment Solutions (AlpInvest), and carveouts such as Carlyle Direct Lending. Carlyle does not publish a public developer API. Institutional LPs, co-investors, and portfolio companies interact with the firm through a set of private, authentication-gated portals: LP Connect for fund investors, Carlyle Direct Lending's portal for direct lending clients, the Carlyle Global Portfolio Solutions (resources.carlyle.com) portal, and brand experiences such as Carlyle & Co. Integrations with fund administrators, custodians, and placement agents run through bespoke secure file exchange and vendor-managed APIs.

providers.name: Token
providers.description: Token Security is a cybersecurity company that secures non-human identities (NHIs) and AI agents across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments. Its platform continuously discovers every AI agent, service account, and machine identity, maps ownership and security posture, detects identity threats, and automates remediation. Capabilities span NHI inventory, security posture management, lifecycle management, secrets, and identity threat detection and response. The company also ships the Token MCP Server and a native Token AI Agent so security teams can query and act on NHI data conversationally from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Cursor. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, GGV Capital, and Qiming, Token Security serves enterprise security teams, CISOs, and IAM professionals governing machine and agent identity at scale.

providers.name: TOPdesk
providers.description: TOPdesk is a Netherlands-based service management vendor offering an ITSM and Enterprise Service Management platform used by IT, facilities, HR, and customer service teams for incident management, change management, asset management, self-service portals, and shared service workflows. The TOPdesk REST API uses application password authentication (basic auth) and exposes resources for incidents, changes, assets, persons, operators, and locations for building integrations against on-premises and SaaS TOPdesk environments.

providers.name: Uare.ai
