Because the reference documentation and OpenAPI live behind that login, the endpoints listed here are honestly modeled from public help content and product pages rather than pulled from an open specification.

providers.name: Virgo
providers.description: Virgo builds AI foundation models for gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy, targeting gut-mediated diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer. Its flagship model, EndoDINO, was trained on the largest known endoscopy dataset (130,037 videos / ~3.5 billion frames), and EndoML is the GI-specific tooling environment for building clinical and research workflows on top of it. Virgo Cloud provides video capture and management for endoscopy procedures, while Virgo Trials accelerates clinical trials with automatic data capture, endoscopic scoring, placebo-response prediction, subgroup identification, and AI biomarker discovery. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: wanelo
providers.description: wanelo ("The intelligent everything store") is an AI-powered shopping storefront offering natural-language and visual product discovery, personalized recommendations, and a buy-for-me assistant, built on Shopify. It exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, ucp.dev) with a hosted MCP endpoint for catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OpenID Connect and a published /llms.txt (mirroring /agents.md). Originally a social-shopping product backed by Slow Ventures, wanelo.com now operates as an agent-ready commerce store. Read-only catalog browsing (products/collections/search JSON) requires no authentication.

providers.name: Zatanna
providers.description: Zatanna is a Y Combinator (W2026) startup based in San Francisco that creates APIs for software that doesn't have any. It reverse-engineers the back ends of web-based cloud and on-prem software — ERPs (SAP), PMS/POS systems, insurance portals, and marketplaces — by observing real workflows, reconstructing the underlying request sequences, and hosting them as clean, callable APIs. Rather than relying on slow browser automation or computer-use agents, Zatanna gives AI agents faster, cheaper, and more reliable integrations, with a reliability layer that handles session management, authentication, and change detection. The agent-facing surface is a hosted, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at api.zatanna.ai.

providers.name: Zone & Company
providers.description: Zone & Co (Zone & Company) is a NetSuite-native financial operations software vendor whose SuiteApp suite automates the back office across five product families - Quote to Cash (ZoneBilling billing and revenue recognition, ZonePayments Stripe integration), Procure to Pay (ZoneProcure, ZoneCapture, ZoneApprovals), Treasury (ZoneLiquidity cash forecasting, ZoneReconcile), Payroll Management (ZonePayroll, Employee Portal), and Record to Report (ZoneReporting on Power BI, Data Warehouse, ZoneExtract, Solution 7). The products are delivered as native Oracle NetSuite SuiteApps distributed through the SuiteApp Marketplace rather than as a standalone public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Aceable
providers.description: Aceable (Aceable Brands) is an Austin, Texas mobile-first online education company founded in 2013 that builds state-accredited licensing and continuing-education courses across four brands: Aceable (drivers ed, defensive driving and traffic school in 40+ US states), Aceable Agent (real estate pre-license, post-license and CE in 16 states, plus PrepAgent exam prep in all 50), Aceable Insurance (Property & Casualty and Life & Health pre-license in 13 states, CE in CA/IL/TX) and Aceable Mortgage (NMLS-approved MLO pre-license and CE in 7 states plus the required 20-hour national component; NMLS Provider ID 1400102). More than 20 million students have been licensed through Aceable, at roughly 1.5 million per year. The company raised about $106M across five rounds from Silverton Partners, Floodgate, Sageview Capital and HGGC, and operates a B2B partner program (affiliate and bulk-buy) for driving schools, school districts, brokerages, carriers and mortgage employers. Aceable publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its platform API at api.aceable.com is a private, application-ID-gated backend serving the Aceable web and mobile apps.

providers.name: Addus HomeCare
providers.description: Addus HomeCare Corporation (NASDAQ: ADUS) is a US provider of personal care, home health and hospice services delivered in the home and community, headquartered at 6303 Cowboys Way, Frisco, Texas. It serves consumers across roughly three dozen states through a large field workforce of caregivers, nurses and therapists, with revenue coming predominantly from Medicaid and Medicaid-managed-care programs, Medicare and managed-care payers rather than from software. Addus is a care-delivery organization, not a software vendor: contract discovery on 2026-08-30 found no developer program, no public API, no SDK, no published package on any registry and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its clinical and operational systems are supplied by partners — Homecare Homebase for the home-based care platform under a joint development agreement announced in April 2021, and CellTrak for Electronic Visit Verification — and any system-to-system exchange (HL7, payer X12 EDI, state EVV aggregators) is scoped by partner contract rather than by a public developer portal. Two earlier hosts on this profile, api.addus.com and developer.addus.com, were probed and do not resolve; they have been removed.

providers.name: Alif Semiconductor
providers.description: Alif Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Pleasanton, California with engineering operations in Grenoble, France. It designs secure, AI/ML-enabled 32-bit microcontrollers and fusion processors for edge computing, built around Arm Cortex-M55 cores and dedicated Arm Ethos-U55 Neural Processing Units. Its Ensemble (E1C, E1, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8) and Balletto (B1) product families target battery-powered edge AI and generative-AI workloads, pairing hardware AI acceleration with autonomous aiPM power management and a multilayered hardware Root of Trust security subsystem. Alif ships an embedded developer surface rather than a public web API: a Zephyr-based SDK, CMSIS Device Family Packs, VS Code project templates, the Conductor configuration tool, evaluation kits, datasheets, and reference manuals published across its support hub and GitHub organization. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and Mayfield.

providers.name: API League
providers.description: API League is a comprehensive API marketplace aggregating 60+ best-in-class APIs across categories including books, news, humor, food, knowledge, art, web, text processing, and media. It offers code examples in 21 languages, SDKs, Postman collections, and free API key access for developers to launch projects quickly.

providers.name: AuditBoard
providers.description: AuditBoard (rebranded in 2026 as Optro) is an AI-powered GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) SaaS platform used by more than half of the Fortune 500 to run their audit, risk, and compliance programs. Its connected-risk suite spans Controls Management (SOX), OpsAudit (operational/internal audit), RiskOversight (enterprise/operational risk), CrossComply (IT risk and cybersecurity compliance), ESG, RegComply (regulatory compliance), and AI Governance. Optro exposes a developer platform at developer.auditboard.com (a login-gated ReadMe portal) for programmatic access, plus documented integrations with systems such as ServiceNow, Workiva, and Microsoft 365. AuditBoard was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched here from its public web surface; the API reference itself sits behind an end-user login, so no public OpenAPI is captured.

providers.name: Boompop
providers.description: Boompop is a corporate event management and planning SaaS platform that helps companies organize offsites, conferences, team gatherings, and other business events. The platform pairs AI-powered planning tools that generate briefs, agendas, and logistics with hotel and vendor sourcing (AI-powered RFPs and rate negotiation), guest and RSVP management, itinerary and event websites, budget and expense tracking, and 24/7 AI messaging. Tiers range from a free Starter plan through a per-event Pro plan to Full Service white-glove planning with a dedicated expert. Boompop was named the 7th fastest-growing software company on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list. It is SOC 2 certified and GDPR compliant, and offers passwordless login plus Google and Microsoft single sign-on. Boompop is backed by Wing Venture Capital. Boompop does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Brickanta
providers.description: Brickanta is a Stockholm-based agentic AI platform built for the construction industry, deploying specialized AI agents to automate pre-construction and project workflows including bid analysis, cost estimation, procurement package generation, document and contract review, compliance, and quality assurance. The platform reads drawings, specs, and contracts to surface risks and gaps, turns raw RFPs into discipline-specific procurement packages, and builds a searchable knowledge base from every finished project. Brickanta raised an $8M seed round led by Northzone in early 2026 and serves construction teams across eleven countries. The company exposes a customer application and a public trust portal but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: BrightHire
providers.description: BrightHire is an interview intelligence platform that helps talent and hiring teams run more consistent, equitable, and effective hiring processes. Its AI copilots and agents support the full interview lifecycle — interview planning, AI-assisted screening interviews, automated interview notes and highlights, structured decision support, and interviewer coaching — with deep integrations into applicant tracking systems, video conferencing, and collaboration tools. BrightHire is a closed SaaS product with no public developer API; it exposes value through partner ATS, calendar, and conferencing integrations rather than a documented API surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as an index-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Build
providers.description: Build is an AI-native operating partner for the built world, pairing autonomous AI agents (its "Dougie" platform) with deep domain expertise to accelerate commercial real estate and infrastructure development. The platform automates mission-critical development workflows including site selection, due diligence, underwriting, investment-committee memos, test-fit analysis, market and zoning research, environmental diligence, and ESG reporting. Build serves institutional clients across data centers, industrials, energy, power, office, telecommunications, mixed-use, hotels, and multifamily. Backed by Index Ventures; profiled in the API Evangelist network. Build is a services company and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Calypso Migration
providers.description: Nasdaq Calypso Migration services support financial institutions in migrating data and configurations between Calypso environments. Calypso (formerly Adenza / Calypso Technology) is a cross-asset front-to-back capital markets technology platform used by banks, asset managers, central banks, and clearing houses worldwide. Migration capabilities cover upgrading between Calypso versions, moving between on-premise and cloud deployments, and consolidating multiple Calypso installations. These services are delivered through Nasdaq professional services rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Calypso Workstation
providers.description: Nasdaq Calypso Workstation is the user-facing desktop component of the Nasdaq Calypso (formerly Adenza / Calypso Technology) capital markets platform. It gives capital markets professionals access to market data, trading operations, risk management, and portfolio analytics across asset classes. The Workstation is an integrated client application rather than a publicly documented REST API; programmatic integration is delivered through the broader Calypso platform interfaces used by banks, asset managers, central banks, and clearing houses.

providers.name: Changelog
providers.description: Changelog is a media company and podcast network for developers covering open source and software development. Founded by Adam Stacoviak and Jerod Santo, Changelog produces world-class developer podcasts including The Changelog, which features deep technical interviews and conversations with the people and teams driving open source software forward. Changelog also publishes a weekly developer news newsletter and operates an open source platform (changelog.com) built with Elixir and Phoenix.

providers.name: CloudNuro
providers.description: CloudNuro is an enterprise SaaS management and FinOps platform that combines SaaS discovery (shadow IT), SaaS subscription and license optimization, user lifecycle and compliance management, SaaS-Chargeback and cost allocation, and Cloud FinOps for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. It offers 400+ pre-built connectors to leading SaaS, IaaS, IAM, ITSM, HR, and security platforms. CloudNuro is SOC 2 Type II certified and has been recognized by Gartner in the SaaS Management Platforms market guide.

providers.name: CoLab Software
providers.description: CoLab is an AI-powered design review platform for engineering and product-development teams. It pairs collaborative CAD viewing with AI peer checking and automated lessons-learned capture so distributed teams can run faster virtual design reviews, surface issues earlier, and turn expert engineering knowledge into faster, better-documented decisions. CoLab also publishes a REST-based Enterprise API (50+ endpoints) for two-way integration with PLM/PDM and other engineering systems — provisioning workspaces, users, and roles, importing files and feedback, and extracting review activity — with audit logging on every action. Enterprise API access is currently gated behind a waitlist. CoLab operates under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018, TISAX, and FedRAMP High.

providers.name: Comscore
providers.description: Comscore is a cross-platform media measurement and audience analytics company that provides a trusted, independent currency for planning, transacting, and evaluating media across digital, social, television, streaming/CTV, movies, and programmatic advertising. Its products measure audiences, brands, and consumer behavior for media buyers and sellers, spanning advertising effectiveness, CTV and video measurement, programmatic targeting (Proximic by Comscore), social intelligence, and box-office tracking. Comscore publishes first-party audience- measurement SDKs for Android, iOS/tvOS, and Flutter used to instrument content and apps, and maintains an ISO/IEC 27001-certified trust and security program. It does not currently expose a public self-serve REST API or developer portal.

providers.name: Convex
providers.description: Convex Group Limited is an international specialty insurer and reinsurer founded in 2019 by Stephen Catlin and Paul Brand, headquartered in London with operations in Bermuda, Luxembourg, Guernsey and the United States. Convex writes complex commercial and specialty risk across property, casualty, marine, energy, aviation, cyber, political risk and credit, crisis management, accident and health, and equine/livestock/aquaculture, and writes property, casualty and specialty treaty reinsurance through Convex Re Limited in Bermuda and London. Convex Insurance UK Limited is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the FCA and PRA; it is a London company-market carrier rather than a Lloyd's syndicate, and it reported roughly $5.2bn of gross written premium in 2024. Convex operates a named Digital Underwriting function that publicly describes building "a suite of insurance specific APIs" for automated quote and bind on high-volume, low-complexity specialty books, delivered either through a Convex-hosted broker portal or by connecting Convex products into a broker's or client's existing portal via API. That API programme is real but entirely partner-gated: as of 2026-07-25 Convex publishes no public developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine- readable definition, no sandbox and no self-serve signup. The api.convexin.com host is live but answers every anonymous request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized, the digital.convexin.com broker application is an authenticated Unqork-hosted portal, and the Convex Quick Quote event-insurance surface is behind a broker account registration form. Integration is arranged through the Business Development team, not through documentation. No ACORD, AL3, NGDS or IVANS reference appears anywhere on Convex's public web presence.

providers.name: Cron
providers.description: Cron was a next-generation calendar application for professionals and teams, backed by Initialized Capital and later acquired by Notion, where it was rebranded and relaunched as Notion Calendar. The product offered a fast, keyboard-driven desktop and mobile calendar with multi-account scheduling, time-zone handling, team availability, and deep Notion workspace integration (calendar events linked to Notion pages and databases). Cron is an end-user consumer product and does not expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, a dated changelog (retired January 2024 at the Notion Calendar rebrand), a blog, and help documentation now hosted within Notion. This profile captures Cron's public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Drillster
providers.description: Drillster is a digital learning platform that uses adaptive, repetition-based technology to help users acquire and retain knowledge and skills through personalized drills, quizzes, and learning modules.

providers.name: Fidelity Investments
providers.description: One of the largest financial services companies in the world providing investment management, retirement planning, brokerage, and wealth management services. Manages trillions of dollars in assets and serves tens of millions of individual investors and institutions. Fidelity does not run a public developer portal; partner integrations are delivered through curated marketplace relationships and through Fidelity Institutional / Wealthscape for advisors.

providers.name: Figure Markets
providers.description: Figure Markets is a blockchain-native digital-asset marketplace built on the Provenance Blockchain that lets individuals and institutions trade, borrow against, and earn yield on crypto and real-world assets from a single account. Its exchange runs on Connamara's EP3 matching engine with FIX and REST APIs, offering a central limit order book for crypto (BTC, ETH, and more), equities, bonds, alternative assets, and YLDS, the first SEC-registered yielding stablecoin. Products include Figure Exchange (pro trading), crypto-backed loans, Democratized Prime (HELOC-backed yield), and self-custodied wallets, bridging traditional order-book finance with on-chain clearing and settlement. The company is backed by DCM Ventures. The trading API is served from api.figuremarkets.com and is access-controlled; no public OpenAPI is currently published.

providers.name: FirstVet
providers.description: FirstVet is a digital veterinary care company offering 24/7 online video consultations with licensed veterinarians for dogs, cats, and other pets. Founded in Sweden, FirstVet operates a consumer telehealth platform across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States, providing virtual vet appointments, healthy pet checkups, follow-up care, and triage guidance on whether a case needs an in-clinic referral. The company partners with pet insurers and employers to offer covered or subsidized access to its subscription-based virtual care. FirstVet is a portfolio company of Creandum. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; FirstVet publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Instadapp
providers.description: Instadapp is a decentralized finance (DeFi) middleware company that scales DeFi for users and developers through non-custodial Smart Accounts. Its core DSA (DeFi Smart Accounts / DeFi Smart Layer) protocol aggregates lending, DEX, and yield protocols behind a single upgradable smart-contract layer, driven by a composable cast() function, with connectors and resolvers for protocols such as Aave, Compound, MakerDAO, and Uniswap. Instadapp also builds Fluid (a capital-efficient lending and DEX protocol), Avocado (a smart-contract wallet with account, gas, and smart-contract execution), and Instadapp Lite (simplified DeFi vaults). It supports Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Fantom, Gnosis, Scroll, and Polygon zkEVM. The developer surface is on-chain smart contracts plus first-party JavaScript and TypeScript SDKs published to npm; there is no first-party REST API. Instadapp is backed by Pantera Capital.

providers.name: JSON
providers.description: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight, text-based, language-independent data interchange format that uses human-readable text to represent structured data as key-value pairs and arrays. JSON is standardized by RFC 8259 (December 2017), which obsoletes RFC 7159 (2014) and RFC 4627 (2006). It has become the de facto standard for data exchange in web APIs, configuration files, and NoSQL databases due to its simplicity and broad language support.

providers.name: LiveAction
providers.description: LiveAction is a network observability and intelligence platform that provides visibility and monitoring across physical, virtual, cloud, and SD-WAN infrastructure. Its product family includes LiveNX (network performance monitoring using flow, API, SNMP, and cloud telemetry), LiveWire (network forensics and packet capture), LiveSP (monitoring for service providers), and Omnipeek (protocol analyzer), alongside AI-driven operations offerings. LiveAction's products expose product-embedded REST APIs authenticated with API tokens for automation and integration; there is no public hosted developer API or OpenAPI specification, as the APIs run on customer-operated deployments and the reference is served in-product. LiveAction is part of BlueCat Networks and a portfolio company of Insight Partners.

providers.name: Marketing Evolution
providers.description: Marketing Evolution is an enterprise marketing measurement and analytics company whose stated mission is to "make marketing knowable." It ships two products. Substrate is positioned as a system of record for marketing performance, unifying fragmented media, audience, commerce and third-party data, enriching it, and publishing standardized output to data warehouses, BI tools, CDPs and agents. Darwin is the decisioning layer on top, running unified marketing measurement (MMM plus multi-touch attribution), budget scenario modeling and ROI forecasting, media performance intelligence, and always-on agents with automated anomaly detection. Roughly thirty published connectors cover the major ad platforms, warehouses, CRM and BI systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners and sells exclusively through an enterprise demo-request motion. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; its API host, api.marketingevolution.com, returns HTTP 403 to every anonymous request, and its published integration mechanism is data-plane (SFTP, Amazon S3, Snowflake data shares) rather than a public request/response API.

providers.name: Mars
providers.description: Mars, Incorporated is one of the world's largest privately held companies, producing confectionery, pet food, food, and providing veterinary care. The company owns iconic brands including M&M's, Snickers, Twix, Milky Way, Skittles, Wrigley, Orbit, Extra, Pedigree, Whiskas, Royal Canin, IAMS, and Sheba, and operates Mars Petcare clinical brands including Banfield Pet Hospital, VCA Animal Hospitals, BluePearl, and Antech Diagnostics. Mars operates in over 80 countries. Mars operates a public Azure-API-Management developer portal at developer.mars.com for partner and B2B integrations, alongside closed channels such as the Mars Supplier Gateway.

providers.name: Maxima
providers.description: Maxima is an AI-native accounting and financial-close automation platform for enterprise finance teams. Its AI agents automate the core work of the accounting close — journal entries, cash coding, payroll entries, bank and balance-sheet reconciliations, flux (variance) analysis, and fixed-asset depreciation — while connecting natively to the systems finance teams already use (the company advertises 150+ integrations across ERPs, banks, and payroll providers). Maxima is an early-stage, enterprise-focused company backed by Kleiner Perkins. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this pass the company runs a corporate marketing site and a gated web application (app.maximahq.com) and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: MORI
providers.description: MORI (Baby Mori) is a UK-based, online-first baby and children's brand founded in 2015 by Akin Onal, known for soft essentials made from a proprietary bamboo and organic cotton fabric blend. Its direct-to-consumer range spans sleepwear, daywear, footwear, blankets and muslins, nursery and home goods, and a Sleep Club subscription, shipping across the UK, US, and Europe. MORI operates as a Shopify-hosted e-commerce business and does not publish a first-party developer API. Its machine-readable surface is provided natively by the Shopify platform: a live Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (search_catalog, get_cart, update_cart, get_product_details, search_shop_policies_and_faqs), a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, an agent-instructions /llms.txt (mirrored at /agents.md), and the Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth discovery. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: NATIX
providers.description: NATIX Network is a decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) network building what it calls the world's largest on-street camera network to power Physical AI, autonomous driving, and real-time mapping. Drivers use the Drive& smartphone app and the VX360 plug-and-earn smart camera for Tesla to collect, validate, anonymize, and monetize multi-camera dashcam footage, earning $NATIX token rewards. NATIX packages the resulting data into training datasets, edge cases, and OpenScenario/OpenDrive simulation scenarios for AI and mapping customers, and runs an on-chain token economy with staking, governance, and xNodes. As of 2026 it reports 2.89M+ registered drivers and coverage across 33 countries. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; enrichment confirms NATIX publishes no public REST/GraphQL developer API — the surface is consumer apps, an on-chain token, and a proprietary partner Vision SDK.

providers.name: Pactum
providers.description: Pactum is an AI procurement negotiation platform that deploys autonomous agents to conduct commercial supplier negotiations at scale while enforcing buyer-defined policies and guardrails. Its agent suite spans requisition alignment and negotiation, tactical and post-sourcing sourcing, price-list, discount, payment-terms, and rebate negotiations, letting enterprise procurement teams reach agreements on long-tail spend that would otherwise go unnegotiated. Pactum is a venture-backed enterprise SaaS company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, so this record captures the company's identity plus its published security, trust, and disclosure surface.

providers.name: Page
providers.description: Page is an AI-powered government relations (GR) platform that tracks legislation, regulatory activity, and policy developments across 70+ jurisdictions in real time. It provides bill tracking, regulatory affairs monitoring, live hearing and vote alerts, lobbying and parliamentary questions data, smart alerts, AI analysis of policy trends, and detailed politician and staff directories, alongside Wonk — an AI assistant for policy research and document generation. Page serves enterprises, multi-client firms, law firms, government agencies, associations, and nonprofits. It is headquartered in Washington, DC with an additional office in Waterloo, Ontario, and is backed by Canaan Partners. Page holds SOC 2 Type II certification. As of this profile Page exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Pendulumlife
providers.description: Pendulum (pendulumlife.com) is a direct-to-consumer probiotics and metabolic-health company founded by PhD scientists from Johns Hopkins, Harvard, Berkeley and Stanford. It sells next-generation probiotic supplements such as Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, Glucose Control (a medical probiotic clinically shown to improve A1C in type 2 diabetes) and Polyphenol Booster. Surfaced as a portfolio company of felicis and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Enrichment finding: the site is a Shopify-hosted storefront and Pendulum publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or documentation; the only machine surface is Shopify's platform customer-account OIDC discovery endpoint.

providers.name: Real Estate Institute of Australia
providers.description: The Real Estate Institute of Australia (REIA), founded in 1924 and based in Canberra, is the national federation of the eight state and territory Real Estate Institutes (REINSW, REIV, REIQ, REIWA, REISA, REIT, REIACT, REINT), which between them represent roughly 85% of Australian real estate businesses and agents. REIA is a policy, research and accreditation body, not an operator of market infrastructure: it administers the REIA National Principles of Conduct that underpin state institute codes and training, awards Associate (AREI) and Fellow accreditations, runs the Australasian Auctioneering Championships (AUSTROS) jointly with REINZ and the National Awards for Excellence (NAFE), makes submissions to the Commonwealth Government, and publishes the quarterly Housing Affordability Report (HAR) and Real Estate Market Facts (REMF) series that Federal Treasury, the Reserve Bank, state treasuries and investment banks subscribe to. It sits well above the transaction rail in the Australian value chain - listings run through REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain, settlement through PEXA, valuation through PropTrack and CoreLogic, and title through the state land registries - and REIA touches none of those pipes. Its API posture is therefore an honest absence: no developer portal, no API subdomain, no OpenAPI or OData contract, and no RESO reference anywhere on its estate, because RESO is a NAR-mandated United States construct with no Australian counterpart. What REIA sells is data, not access to it - the HAR and REMF reports are AUD 450 subscriptions and each of the 7 HAR and 15 REMF underlying datasets is a separate AUD 280 subscription, delivered as documents through a platformOS/Insites ecommerce storefront with Stripe checkout behind an email-and-password account. Policy submissions, standalone research reports and the strategic plan are freely downloadable PDFs; the quarterly numbers are not, and there is no open data.

providers.name: Acquire.com (fka MicroAcquire)
providers.description: Acquire.com (formerly MicroAcquire) is an online marketplace for buying and selling startups and online businesses. It connects vetted buyers with founders looking to sell, offering deal discovery, financial metrics, escrow and closing tooling, buyer memberships, and M&A education through the Acquire Academy. Founded by Andrew Gazdecki and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, the platform operates as a self-serve acquisition marketplace (app.acquire.com) rather than a developer API provider. This profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, SDKs, or webhook surface is currently published.

providers.name: AegisAI
providers.description: AegisAI is an AI-native email security platform that deploys a network of autonomous AI agents to detect and stop advanced inbound email threats — spear phishing, business email compromise (BEC), zero-day phishing, malicious attachments, and QR-code attacks — before they reach the inbox. It integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace via API in about five minutes with no MX record changes, can run in monitoring mode, provides explainable incident response with Indicators of Compromise for CISOs, and reduces false positives by up to 90%. Founded by former Google Safe Browsing, reCAPTCHA, and Web Risk leaders Cy Khormaee (CEO) and Ryan Luo (CTO), AegisAI raised a $13M seed round co-led by Accel and Foundation Capital in 2025 and is SOC 2 Type II certified.

providers.name: Anomali
providers.description: Anomali is an enterprise cybersecurity vendor whose Agentic SOC Platform unifies threat intelligence, security data, and agentic AI. Its flagship ThreatStream is a leading Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) that operationalizes indicators of compromise across a Unified Security Data Lake with SIEM, SOAR, and XDR capabilities. Anomali exposes a ThreatStream REST API (api.threatstream.com) for managing intelligence, observables, investigations, and integrations, and maintains a partner marketplace of prebuilt integrations. This API Evangelist profile was seeded from the general-catalyst portfolio and enriched from Anomali's public surfaces (status page, security/responsible-disclosure program, privacy and terms pages, GitHub organization, and blog).

providers.name: Apiable
providers.description: Apiable is an API portal platform that enables businesses to create single-tenant, white-label developer portals with custom domains, branding, and API product management. It supports API monetization, developer self-service onboarding, usage metrics, subscription lifecycle management, and integrates with API gateways including Amazon API Gateway and Kong.

providers.name: April
providers.description: April (aPriori, apr.io) is a MEV-powered liquid staking protocol on the Monad blockchain. Users stake MON tokens through aPriori's self-custodial staking vault and receive aprMON, a reward-bearing liquid staking token that accrues proof-of-stake plus MEV yield and can be used across Monad DeFi while retaining full custody. The protocol also operates Swapr (a DEX aggregator), an order-flow segmentation and MEV infrastructure layer, and the $APR token with an APR Boost rewards program. aPriori is documented on GitBook with an introduction, a Monad testnet guide, a MON faucet guide, and a smart-contract integration reference; it is a smart-contract protocol rather than a keyed REST API. Surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a crypto portfolio lead.

providers.name: Arka
providers.description: Arka is a custom packaging company that lets ecommerce brands design, order, and ship eco-friendly custom boxes, mailers, and sustainable packaging online. Arka offers low minimums, fast turnaround, and plug-in integrations with commerce platforms including Shopify, BigCommerce, and Square so merchants can reorder packaging alongside their fulfillment workflow. Arka's storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface — a published /llms.txt, an agentic-discovery sitemap, OIDC/OAuth 2.0 discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and complete buyer-approved checkouts. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled here as part of the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Atmos Energy
providers.description: Atmos Energy is one of the largest natural-gas-only distributors in the United States, delivering natural gas to residential, commercial, public-authority, and industrial customers across multiple states including Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Colorado, Kansas, and Virginia. The company provides online account management, a Builder Portal for developers and contractors, and digital service request capabilities for natural gas connections and meter installations.

providers.name: Backerkit
providers.description: BackerKit is a crowdfunding and pledge-management platform for professional creators. It began as backer-survey and data-management software that helps creators who funded projects on Kickstarter and Indiegogo collect shipping addresses, sell add-ons and pre-orders, charge cards, and manage backer data for reward fulfillment. It has since grown into a full crowdfunding platform of its own, powering campaigns end to end and, in 2024, roughly one in every four dollars raised on Kickstarter. BackerKit is a Y Combinator company. It exposes integration API keys (API key, secret, and Store GUID) so creators can connect fulfillment services such as ShipStation, but it does not publish a public, self-serve developer API, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs; developer access is account-scoped and configured inside the BackerKit dashboard.

providers.name: Baxus
providers.description: BAXUS is a peer-to-peer marketplace for buying, selling, trading, and storing fine and rare wine and spirits, built on the Solana blockchain. Founded in 2021 by Tzvi Wiesel and based in Woodland Park, New Jersey, BAXUS authenticates physical bottles and holds them in climate-controlled vaults, then tokenizes each as an NFT that serves as a digital certificate of ownership and provenance. Beyond the marketplace and Vault, BAXUS operates the BoozApp collection app, an open-source AI whiskey sommelier agent (BOB), and Whisky-Goggles AI bottle recognition. Its backend API at services.baxus.co powers bottle search, marketplace listings, and user bar collections. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Beautiful Soup
providers.description: Beautiful Soup is a Python library for pulling data out of HTML and XML files, widely used for web scraping and screen scraping tasks. It provides a parse tree API with simple methods for navigating, searching, and modifying parsed HTML/XML documents. Beautiful Soup automatically handles encoding, supports multiple parsers (html.parser, lxml, html5lib), and integrates with CSS selectors via the Soup Sieve library. Current stable version is 4.14.3.

providers.name: Canopy Connect
providers.description: Canopy Connect is an insurance infrastructure platform that lets consumers and businesses quickly and securely share property and casualty insurance information through integrations with 400+ carriers covering 95%+ of the U.S. auto and homeowners markets. The API returns structured policy, driver, vehicle, claims, and property data in seconds, replacing manual verification workflows used across mortgage lending, auto finance, insurance carriers, and embedded insurance products.

providers.name: Code4rena
providers.description: Code4rena (C4) is a competitive smart-contract security auditing platform that connects Web3/DeFi projects (sponsors) with a global community of security researchers (wardens) through time-boxed competitive audits and ongoing bug bounties. Sponsors fund an audit, wardens compete to surface vulnerabilities, and judges rate severity, validity, and quality to distribute awards via a ranked-curve incentive model. Over five years the platform ran 512+ audits, engaged 16,600+ researchers, and surfaced 26,898 findings including 1,607 high-severity vulnerabilities. Code4rena announced it is winding down operations, seeing active competitions and bounties through to completion. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a paradigm portfolio company; the platform is web/app-based with GitBook documentation and does not publish a public REST/GraphQL API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Cuemath
providers.description: Cuemath is an India-headquartered education technology company founded in 2013 by Manan Khurma that delivers live, one-to-one online math tutoring to students in grades K through 12 across more than 80 countries. Its MathFit framework and LEAP learning platform pair certified tutors with an interactive, gamified curriculum aligned to US Common Core standards, spanning arithmetic, algebra, geometry, pre-calculus, AP calculus and standardized test preparation. Cuemath sells directly to families as a subscription tutoring product; it operates a consumer web and mobile application rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: data.gov.uk CKAN Publishing Service
providers.description: data.gov.uk CKAN Publishing Service is a national government open-data portal for United Kingdom running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 57,757 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: DataSnipper
providers.description: DataSnipper is an AI-powered, agentic productivity platform built specifically for audit, tax, and finance teams. It automates repetitive testing and analysis work - extracting, matching, and analyzing data across documents and systems - while keeping human professionals in control of final decisions. Capabilities include AI Agents for end-to-end workflows (revenue testing, tests of detail, royalty calculations), Excel Agents that run analysis directly inside spreadsheets, and document intelligence that collects and cross-references evidence. The platform serves external audit, internal audit, tax, financial control, government audit, and advisory teams, with a security-first posture (no training on customer data, encryption, and 24-hour document deletion). Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Donnees Quebec
providers.description: Donnees Quebec is a provincial government open-data portal for Canada running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 1,608 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Donut
providers.description: Donut is an employee experience platform that helps companies design, automate, and scale people programs directly inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. Best known for its intro and coffee-chat pairing bot, Donut runs onboarding journeys, team-connection and watercooler programs, peer recognition, and engagement surveys, and imports data from 50+ HRIS systems (BambooHR, Greenhouse, Workday) alongside Zoom, Google Meet, and calendar integrations. It is trusted by 20,000+ teams including Anthropic, Figma, Carta, and Ramp. Donut authenticates users via Slack OAuth and is SOC 2 compliant. It does not currently publish a public developer API; its GitHub organization ships a Slack app template and internal tooling.

providers.name: EvolveApp INC.
providers.description: EvolveApp INC. (Evolve) is an AI-native enablement and performance platform for corporate learning and workforce training. Its product suite spans the Evolve LMS for courses, learning paths and branded academies; Evolve Generate for AI-powered course creation from raw materials; Evolve Studio for advanced authoring; an Assessment Center for skills and behavioral evaluation; an AI Knowledge Base instant-answer engine; and AI-driven Simulations for job-critical practice. Evolve serves 100+ enterprise clients and 2.9M+ learners worldwide, is SOC 2 (Type 1 and 2), ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant, and offers iOS and Android apps. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Hackernoon
providers.description: HackerNoon is an independent technology publishing platform and community CMS, founded in 2016 by David Smooke and headquartered in Edwards, Colorado. It operates a free, open library of more than 150,000 practitioner-authored, human-edited technology stories from 35,000+ contributing engineers, covering AI, software engineering, Web3, cybersecurity, startups and science, and serves roughly 3-4 million monthly readers. The company builds and open-sources the publishing software behind the site — the Chowa collaborative editor, the Pixel Icon Library, the HackerNoon pixel font and the Editing Protocol — and monetises through business blogging credits, targeted ads, newsletters and AI content licensing. HackerNoon publishes no public API: probed on 2026-08-22, it serves no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or A2A surface. Its machine-readable surface is a content and AI-access one — an llms.txt, a per-crawler robots.txt policy, RSS feeds and sitemaps — with a "live content feed API" advertised in llms.txt as coming in Q3 2026 and not yet shipped.

providers.name: Health Resources and Services Administration
providers.description: The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) is the primary Federal agency for improving access to health care services for people who are uninsured, isolated, or medically vulnerable. HRSA provides data and web services for healthcare resources, facility locations, and program information.

providers.name: Intermedia
providers.description: Intermedia is a cloud communications company serving over 145,000 businesses with an AI-powered platform spanning voice, video conferencing, chat, SMS, contact center, business email, productivity, file sharing, security, and archiving. The Intermedia Extend API platform exposes Voice, Meeting, Analytics, Address Book, and Contact Center APIs for embedding communications into CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, and custom business applications.

providers.name: Investly
providers.description: Investly is a European fintech invoice-financing marketplace that helps growing small and medium-sized businesses unlock working capital by financing their outstanding 30-180 day invoices. Businesses sell their approved invoices through a reverse-auction marketplace where investors bid to fund them, giving merchants the best available price from multiple funding providers and access to cash in 1-3 working days rather than waiting on customer payment terms. Founded by Siim Maivel and operating across Estonia and the United Kingdom, Investly is backed by Speedinvest, Startup Wise Guys, and Founders Capital. The platform serves established businesses across manufacturing, wholesale, construction, logistics, and business-services sectors and has funded invoices worth tens of millions of pounds to date. Investly runs a production HAL/HATEOAS backend API at api.investly.co, though it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Llama
providers.description: Llama is Meta's family of open-weight large language models, available for download, self-hosting, and via Meta's hosted Llama API for chat completions, text generation, and embeddings. The ecosystem also includes the open-source llama-models, llama-stack, and PurpleLlama safety projects on GitHub.

providers.name: London Datastore
providers.description: London Datastore is a open data portal open-data portal for GB running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately an open datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Lovys
providers.description: Lovys is a European digital neo-insurance provider offering flexible, subscription-based cover for home (habitation), smartphone, and pet insurance, designed to be managed entirely online and adjusted month to month. Beyond its direct-to-consumer product, Lovys operates a Partner API (the "Lovys Partner API") that lets resellers and platforms embed insurance into their own experiences: creating and managing real-time quotes, retrieving plans, pricing and coverage options, capturing and managing customer data, enabling policy purchase and activation, and handling the policy lifecycle, updates, and renewals. The Partner API is fronted by Azure API Management and authenticated with OAuth2 via Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Active Directory B2C. The public developer portal (docs.lovys.com) documents getting-started, onboarding, quoting, purchase, and end-to-end partner guides alongside an API reference covering account, customer, quote, basket, orders, payments, policies, and reference-data resources.

providers.name: Luminal
providers.description: Luminal is an AI inference-optimization company that compiles machine-learning models ahead-of-time into optimized native code for GPUs and ASICs, aiming to deliver the fastest, highest-throughput inference available. Its core product is an open-source, high-performance general-purpose inference compiler written in Rust (the "luminal" crate), built around static computation graphs, a compile-time-checked GraphTensor API, composable neural-network modules, and pluggable graph compilers. Luminal ships two deployment paths: Luminal Cloud, a managed serverless inference service with automatic scaling, and licensed on-prem deployment with dedicated support and custom optimization. The company is backed by Felicis.

providers.name: Machinify
providers.description: Machinify is an AI-powered healthcare payment integrity platform that streamlines and automates payment processes for health plans. Its products - Coordinate (claims coordination), Subrogate (subrogation management), Audit (payment audit), Pay (payment processing), and Pharmacy (pharmacy payment integrity) - run on a unified data layer that combines claims and medical records, healthcare foundation models trained on billions of data points, and task-specific AI agents with continuous-improvement feedback loops. Machinify reports 85+ customers including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, coverage of 270 million member lives, and more than $6B in annual cost avoidance and recoveries. The company is backed by Battery Ventures and GV. Machinify does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference.

providers.name: Olyns
providers.description: Olyns is a Silicon Valley company, founded in 2019, that operates an AI-powered reverse vending and retail media network built around the Olyns Cube — a self-serve kiosk that accepts beverage containers and rigid plastic packaging, uses computer vision to identify and sort each item at the point of deposit, pays the consumer their deposit (CRV) refund electronically, and carries a 55-inch screen that Olyns sells as digital-out-of-home advertising inventory. Cubes are placed with supermarkets, big-box retailers, pharmacies and gas stations, and the advertising side is sold both directly and programmatically through Screenverse. Olyns ships consumer and operations software — a mobile/web wallet app at app.olyns.com and a self-service ad portal at ads.olyns.com — but publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: OnTheMarket
providers.description: OnTheMarket is the third-largest residential property portal in the United Kingdom, operating onthemarket.com. It was founded in 2013 by Agents' Mutual Limited as an agent-owned challenger to Rightmove and Zoopla, listed on AIM as OnTheMarket plc, and was acquired outright by CoStar Group in December 2023 for approximately GBP 99 million. In a market with no MLS and no cooperative listing standard, OnTheMarket sits at the demand end of the value chain: consumers search the portal, and listings arrive from member estate agents' CRM systems rather than from a shared data pool. Its API posture is honest and narrow. There is no public developer portal — developer., developers., api. and docs.onthemarket.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /api-docs all return 404 on the main site. What does exist is a member-only integration surface: the OnTheMarket Real Time Datafeed (RTDF), a Rightmove-RTDF-compatible feed API served from the live, OnTheMarket-operated host realtime-api.onthemarket.com, used by agency CRM vendors to push listings and pull branch enquiries on behalf of member agents. No machine-readable contract for it is published anywhere; OnTheMarket's developer guide is distributed under agreement, and every path on the host returns 404 to an anonymous caller. There is no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData $metadata document and no Universal Property Identifier anywhere in the stack — RESO is a North American construct and the UK has never adopted it, so "certified but unreachable" does not apply here; there is no certification layer in this market at all. OnTheMarket publishes no open data. The genuinely open UK property layer belongs to the public sector — HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and Ordnance Survey — and none of it comes from the portals. OnTheMarket's own Terms of Use go further than most and expressly forbid automated access to any page other than the home page.

providers.name: Peanut App
providers.description: Peanut is a social networking app connecting women through all stages of womanhood — from fertility and pregnancy to motherhood and menopause. Founded in 2017 by Michelle Kennedy, the platform provides a safe, moderated space where more than five million women find friends, join life-stage communities and groups, ask questions, and access expert content. Peanut is a consumer mobile-first product (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of partech and enriched with the artifacts the company genuinely publishes (llms.txt and domain-security posture).

providers.name: Queensland Government Data
providers.description: Queensland Government Data is a open data portal open-data portal for Australia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 188,778 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Realtyna
providers.description: Realtyna provides real estate technology including IDX, RESO Web API integrations, MLS data routing, and a WordPress-based property platform (WPL). Their API Plugin exposes the WPL platform via a RESTful, JSON-based HTTP interface for building custom front-ends and mobile applications. Realtyna also offers MLS API, Organic RESO API, and the MLS Router API for enterprise MLS integration.

providers.name: RetainIQ
providers.description: RetainIQ is a full-service retention-marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, delivering lifecycle email and SMS programs. Its work spans automated flows (welcome, cart abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, replenishment), weekly strategic campaign sends with design and copywriting, and deliverability/segmentation/list-hygiene infrastructure. A proprietary 1:1 personalization engine generates variant product blocks at scale. A Klaviyo Gold Master Partner and Omnisend partner, RetainIQ integrates with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Omnisend; plans start at $990/mo on month-to-month terms. It operates as a marketing-services agency and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. RetainIQ Global Inc. previously shipped a self-serve Shopify app (listed 2021, free to install, $999 per 100K personalization credits); that listing is still live but appears retired in place — its application host returns a Cloudflare 522 and the developer website named on the listing now redirects to a domain-for-sale page.

providers.name: Savant
providers.description: Savant (heysavant.com) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an operational memory layer for AI-native enterprises. It integrates with existing company tools such as Slack, Salesforce, and Google Workspace to capture both documented and undocumented operational knowledge, including procedures, exceptions, judgment calls, and edge cases, then structures that knowledge and serves it to employees and AI agents at critical decision moments. Founded in 2026 in San Francisco by Anthony Kim (CEO) and Kevin Yu (CTO), Savant positions itself as the company brain that every AI-native enterprise runs on. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, product guides, a changelog, a status page, and support and legal pages, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API reference surface.

providers.name: Silicon Labs
providers.description: Silicon Labs (Silabs) is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Austin, Texas that designs silicon, software, and solutions for a more connected, IoT world. Its portfolio includes wireless connectivity SoCs and modules for Bluetooth, Bluetooth Mesh, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, and proprietary sub-GHz protocols, along with 32-bit microcontrollers, sensors, and timing devices. Developers build on Silicon Labs hardware using the Simplicity Studio IDE, the Simplicity SDK (formerly Gecko SDK), the docs.silabs.com developer documentation, and the Silicon Labs Community. Silicon Labs is a hardware and embedded-software provider rather than a web-API vendor: its public developer surface is embedded C/C++ SDKs, tools, and reference examples on GitHub (github.com/SiliconLabs), not a hosted REST API — so this profile carries identity, developer-portal, and security signals rather than API specifications.

providers.name: Simon Property Group
providers.description: Simon Property Group is the largest retail real estate investment trust (REIT) in the United States, owning, developing, and managing premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations. Simon's portfolio includes an interest in 254 properties: traditional malls, premium outlets, Mills centers, lifestyle centers, and other retail properties in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company operates ShopSimon, an e-commerce platform, and Simon Innovation Group to advance retail technology innovation. Simon had trailing twelve-month revenue of approximately $6.36 billion as of 2025 and a market capitalization of approximately $67 billion.

providers.name: Stericycle
providers.description: Stericycle is a Fortune 500 compliance company specializing in regulated medical waste disposal, sharps management, pharmaceutical waste, secure information destruction, and healthcare compliance training. In November 2024, Stericycle was acquired by Waste Management (WM) for approximately $7.2 billion. The company operates as WM Healthcare Solutions division, serving hospitals, clinics, medical offices, dental practices, veterinary facilities, and other healthcare organizations. Stericycle's MyStericycle customer portal enables online account management, scheduling, compliance training, and billing.

providers.name: Swift Medical
providers.description: Swift Medical develops AI-powered wound and skin care management software for healthcare organizations across acute, post-acute, home health, and hospice settings. Its flagship Skin & Wound app captures calibrated wound images on mobile devices, applies computer-vision tissue analytics and auto-tracing to measure and classify wounds, and coordinates care through longitudinal documentation backed by the company's database of more than 32 million wound images. The platform emphasizes secure, compliant handling of protected health information (SOC 2 Type 2, encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access, MFA) and single sign-on via Okta and Microsoft. Swift Medical does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is handled through direct engagement and enterprise SSO/EHR arrangements. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.description: Tempus AI (NASDAQ: TEM) is a precision medicine company that has built one of the world's largest libraries of de-identified clinical and molecular data, paired with an operating system to make that data accessible for diagnostics and research, starting with cancer. Its products span genomic profiling (xT / xR), AI-enabled clinical tools (Hub, One, Next), the Lens real-world data and agentic AI platform for life sciences, cardiology and radiology AI (ECG-AI, Pixel), and a consumer health app (Olivia). Tempus does not currently publish a self-serve, documented public developer API; integrations are delivered through enterprise and EHR channels (HL7 / FHIR, e.g. Epic) under partner agreements.

providers.name: Tomorrow Health
providers.description: Tomorrow Health is an AI-powered platform for home-based care that connects providers, payors, and durable medical equipment (DMEPOS) suppliers, using intelligent automation to simplify ordering, routing, and reviewing home healthcare services. Its Horizon Suite includes AI Ordering, AI Fax Intake, and THEA (Tomorrow Health Expert Assistant). Headquartered in New York and backed by a16z, Bond Capital, and Obvious Ventures. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is currently published; the customer application is a private authenticated web app.

providers.name: Tulip Interfaces
providers.description: Tulip is a manufacturing operations platform that enables frontline operations teams to build apps, connect machines and devices, and analyze production data without code. The Tulip REST API provides programmatic access to apps, tables, connectors, stations, automations, and analytics, supporting integration with ERP, MES, and industrial equipment on the shop floor.

providers.name: Unlearn.AI
providers.description: Unlearn.AI provides an AI-powered platform that streamlines clinical trial development using digital twins of patients and advanced data analytics. Its TrialPioneer workspace spans trial planning and simulation (Scout literature search, Hindsight data exploration, SimLab scenario modeling), advanced trial monitoring with anomaly detection, and digital-twin control-arm forecasting that reduces control arm sizes and shortens enrollment. Backed by Insight Partners; no public developer API surface is published.

providers.name: Unmind
providers.description: Unmind is a workplace mental health platform that supports employees, develops leaders, and strengthens organisational performance through therapy, coaching, manager training, crisis care, an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), wellbeing content, insights and assessments, and Nova, an AI wellbeing coach. Customers include Uber, MLB, Samsung, British Airways, Diageo, and the NHS. Unmind publishes no public developer API; api.unmind.com is a private Apollo GraphQL backend serving its own apps.

providers.name: Upside
providers.description: Upside is a two-sided commerce platform that connects brick-and-mortar retailers with consumers through personalized cash-back offers on everyday purchases like fuel, groceries, and dining. More than 5 million users have earned over $1B in cash back through its app, while retailers use the Upside Marketplace, Measurement, and Loyalty+ products to drive proven incremental profit. For technology partners, Upside offers a partner-gated, enterprise-ready API that delivers personalized, evergreen offers inside partner apps, though it publishes no public developer portal or self-serve API documentation.

providers.name: Wordsmith
providers.description: Wordsmith is an Edinburgh-based legal AI platform built for in-house legal teams, marketed as a Slack-native legal copilot that lets non-legal staff self-serve compliant answers, templates, and contract reviews directly in the tools they already use. The product line includes the Wordsmith Assistant (a chat surface that answers routine legal questions, summarises documents, and runs contract review against organisation-specific Playbooks), Templates (parameterised DOCX/Markdown document generation with placeholder fields and fallback clause logic), Playbooks (codified review rules used to flag non-standard terms in NDAs, MSAs, DPAs and similar agreements and to propose pre-approved compromise positions), and a growing set of channel integrations centred on Slack, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft Word, Google Docs/Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Notion, Confluence, Dropbox, Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, Ironclad, Juro, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Linear, Granola, Google Sheets, and Excel, plus programmatic reach via an MCP server, Zapier, and n8n. Wordsmith exposes a public REST API documented at wordsmithai.mintlify.app with Bearer-token authentication and resources for Assistants (ask a question with optional file attachments, poll question status, list assistants available to the account), Files (presigned upload URLs for documents), Playbooks (list accessible review playbooks), Templates (list accessible templates), User (get-me for the authenticated user and organisation), plus signed Webhooks for asynchronous notifications. The company was founded in October 2023 by Ross McNairn (CEO, formerly Head of Product at Skyscanner and CPTO at TravelPerk), Robbie Falkenthal (COO), and Volodymyr Giginyak (CTO), is headquartered in Edinburgh with offices in London and New York, raised a $25M Series A from Index Ventures in June 2025 at a reported $100M valuation, and counts Trustpilot, Skyscanner, AutoTrader, Deliveroo, BT, Trip.com, Coursera, Canva, The Financial Times, Remote.com, Multiverse, and Docplanner among its customers. Pricing is published as an Individual plan at $450 per user per month and a custom Enterprise plan, with a 30-minute book-a-demo flow as the primary onboarding path. WORDSMITH is a registered trade mark of Wordsmith Law LLP and is used under licence by Wordsmith AI.

providers.name: Xepelin
providers.description: Xepelin is a Chilean-founded fintech operating in Chile and Mexico that provides digital financial services for small and mid-sized businesses, including invoice factoring (adelanto de facturas), supplier payment financing (confirming), working capital credit lines, and collections and payments management, alongside XData, a financial-intelligence product for evaluating clients and suppliers. The company reports more than 60,000 business customers and over five billion USD financed in the last three years, with digital credit approval in under 24 hours. Xepelin does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Xtype
providers.description: xtype is an automated governance platform for ServiceNow, giving enterprises visibility, control, orchestration, and compliance across every instance in their ServiceNow estate — tracking changes, access decisions, and configurations and enforcing policy in real time. Products include xtype Enterprise and the free xtype View. The company is backed by ServiceNow Ventures, Columbia Capital, Norwest Venture Partners, Inner Loop Capital, and SaaS Venture Capital, with offices in Covina (CA), Tel Aviv, and Vienna. xtype publishes no public developer API: api.xtype.io is a live Kong gateway with no publicly documented routes.

providers.name: Abercrombie and Fitch
providers.description: Abercrombie & Fitch is a global specialty retailer of casual apparel, accessories, and personal care products operating multiple lifestyle brands including Abercrombie, Hollister, and Gilly Hicks. The company operates through a direct-to-consumer model with both e-commerce and physical retail stores across global markets.

providers.name: Accurx
providers.description: Accurx is a United Kingdom clinical communication and workflow company, founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, whose software is used across NHS primary care, secondary care, and community and mental health services to message patients, run patient triage, batch-message cohorts, book and remind appointments, and (via its Scribe product) draft clinical notes with AI. Accurx integrates around the NHS as an assured IM1 live supplier, using NHS Digital's interoperability standards for primary care and connecting bi-directionally to the GP clinical-system duopoly (EMIS Health, TPP SystmOne) and Vision, plus NHS national services including the Personal Demographics Service (PDS), NHS Single Sign-On, NHS Login, and the NHS App. Accurx is a consumer and integrator of NHS FHIR and IM1 interfaces rather than a publisher of its own public developer API: as of this review it operates no public developer portal, no self-serve REST/FHIR API, and no downloadable OpenAPI or FHIR CapabilityStatement. Third-party and trust integrations are arranged through its partnerships and integration teams under partner agreement.

providers.name: Almanac Labs
providers.description: Almanac Labs, Inc. builds Almanac, an enterprise wiki and async collaboration platform that consolidates a team's scattered documents into a single, organized source of truth. Almanac combines fast document editing, wikis, version control, approvals, and workflow/task management to replace tools like Confluence, Notion, and Asana, and it publishes company handbooks and community-powered documentation. The Almanac API (V1, private beta) lets workspaces import and move files and folders, view users and groups, read and update document properties, manage who has access to documents, and access and update metadata for documents and folders. Almanac integrates with Slack, Figma, Loom, and GitHub, and is backed by General Catalyst. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Almanac's public surface.

providers.name: Ambiq Micro
providers.description: Ambiq Micro is a semiconductor company that designs ultra-low-power System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions for battery-powered and endpoint-AI devices. Its proprietary Subthreshold Power Optimized Technology (SPOT) platform lets its Apollo family of Arm Cortex-M microcontrollers and Artasie real-time clocks run at extremely low energy, powering wearables, hearables, healthcare, smart-home, industrial and gaming devices. Ambiq's developer surface is an embedded C/C++ toolchain - the AmbiqSuite SDK and the open-source neuralSPOT AI SDK/Toolkit - plus a set of first-party Python AI toolkits (heartKIT, sleepKIT, physioKIT, neuralspotx) published on PyPI and GitHub (AmbiqAI, AmbiqMicro). This is not a web/REST API provider; it is profiled here for its open-source developer and AI SDK footprint.

providers.name: Arc
providers.description: Arc is an intelligent cash management platform for technology companies that consolidates business banking, treasury, debt capital, and AI-powered financial services into a single dashboard. Customers can sweep idle cash into yield-bearing accounts, manage liquidity across multiple accounts, raise debt capital, and access AI tooling for financial operations. Arc also offers a Global Treasury product that lets qualifying startups invest in US Treasury Bills as non-US entities while safeguarding funds in US brokerage accounts. The platform is primarily delivered through a hosted web application rather than a public REST API, and integrations are coordinated through Arc's solutions and customer success teams. Arc is positioned as a unified financial operating system for venture-backed and growth-stage technology businesses.

providers.name: Arkema
providers.description: Arkema S.A. is a French specialty materials company headquartered in La Defense, Paris and listed on Euronext Paris under ticker AKE. The group is organized around three Specialty Materials segments — Adhesive Solutions (anchored by the Bostik brand), Advanced Materials (high-performance polymers including Kynar PVDF, Rilsan polyamides, Pebax elastomers, Sartomer photocurable resins) and Coating Solutions (acrylic monomers, waterborne and solvent-borne resins, additives) — plus a smaller Intermediates business. Arkema employs roughly 21,000 people across 55 countries with about 154 production plants and 17 R&D centers, generating around EUR 9.1 billion in 2025 revenue. Strategy is anchored in materials science, decarbonization and a validated 1.5 degree SBTi pathway toward Net-Zero by 2050. Arkema does not publish a public developer portal or REST API; customer integrations and product data are exchanged through commercial sales channels, the Product Finder web UI and Safety Data Sheet downloads.

providers.name: AstroPay
providers.description: AstroPay is a Uruguay-founded fintech and electronic money institution offering a multicurrency wallet, virtual and physical AstroCards, FX, and cross-border money transfers for consumers across Latin America, plus a business platform that lets merchants accept payments, issue cards, manage payroll, and pay out to wallets and bank accounts. AstroPay is regulated as an EMI in the UK, Denmark, Isle of Man, and Brazil, and operates the AstroPay wallet across Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Uruguay, and additional global corridors with support for ARS, BRL, CLP, COP, EUR, GBP, MXN, PEN, USD, USDT, and UYU. For developers, AstroPay exposes a comprehensive REST platform spanning payments, payouts, PIX instant payments in Brazil, issued cards, savings accounts, scheme transfers, user account management, tokenization (PCI-compliant card collection), settlements, transaction reporting, hosted and embedded Checkout, QR-code POS, Wallet-on-File account linking, Cashouts, and Webhooks — accessed through `developers.astropay.com` with HMAC-signed callbacks and an OAuth/API-key authentication model.

providers.name: August
providers.description: August (August Home) makes Wi-Fi smart locks, keypads, doorbell cameras, and the August Connect bridge for keyless, app-controlled home entry. Founded in San Francisco and originally backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Uncork Capital, August was acquired by Assa Abloy and its product line is now unified with Yale Home; the two brands share the August mobile app. August does not publish a public device-control API for consumers — third-party integrations rely on community-reverse-engineered endpoints or aggregators such as Seam, and Yale/August partners use the developer.august.com portal. Its august.com storefront (hosted on Shopify) does, however, expose an agent-native commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp and a hosted shopping MCP server at /api/ucp/mcp for buy-for-me agents, alongside Shopify customer-account OpenID Connect discovery.

providers.name: Beside
providers.description: Beside (operated by Interface, Inc. / Heart Hands, Inc.) is an AI-powered business phone system built for contractors, field teams, and small-to-medium businesses. Its AI receptionist answers inbound calls 24/7, captures caller details, qualifies and routes leads, books appointments, and produces automatic call summaries and searchable transcripts, alongside team phone management, shared inboxes, roles and permissions, unlimited US/Canada calls and texts, spam blocking, and integrations with CRMs such as HubSpot, Attio, and Follow Up Boss (plus 7,000+ apps via Zapier). Beside advertises forthcoming compatibility with MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT, but publishes no public API today. Surfaced as a portfolio company of eqt-ventures.

providers.name: Biome Makers
providers.description: Biome Makers is a global agricultural technology company founded in 2015 and headquartered in El Macero, California, that uses soil microbiome DNA sequencing and machine learning to measure and restore soil health. Its BeCrop platform decodes the functionality of soil microbial communities across 200+ crops in 56+ countries, delivering agronomic recommendations, agricultural-input validation, and supply-chain sustainability benchmarking to farmers, ag retailers, CPG companies, and research labs. Products include BeCrop Farm, BeCrop Test, BeCrop Trials, and BeCrop Rate. BeCrop is accessible via API for large-scale partner integrations, though the developer API is partner-gated and no public OpenAPI specification is currently published.

providers.name: ChowNow
providers.description: ChowNow is a Playa Vista, Los Angeles-based restaurant technology company providing commission-free online ordering, branded mobile apps, marketing tools, and operational software purpose-built for independent restaurants. Founded in 2011, ChowNow powers ordering websites, native iOS/Android apps, QR-code dine-in ordering, catering, email and SMS marketing, a rewards program, Flex Delivery, order aggregation, and centralized menu management for 20,000+ restaurants. The platform integrates with 20+ point-of-sale systems including Toast, Square, Revel, Clover, Lightspeed, Heartland Genius, Skytab, and PosiTouch, and syndicates restaurant menus through a Discovery Network spanning Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, and other channels, with optional hand-off to DoorDash, UberEats, and Grubhub for last-mile delivery. ChowNow's business model is flat-fee software-as-a-service for restaurants rather than per-order commissions, and the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks reference, or open developer portal. Third-party integration is handled through pre-built connectors managed inside the restaurant dashboard and a private partnerships program; prospective POS, delivery, and technology partners apply through a partnerships form rather than self-serve API documentation. The company's public GitHub presence consists primarily of forks of open-source Python/JavaScript tooling and archived internal libraries, with no SDK, client library, or specification repositories.

providers.name: Cleanly
providers.description: Cleanly was a US-based on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning startup (backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator) that has since rebranded and now operates as ByNext at bynext.co. ByNext is an app-based, on-demand laundry, dry cleaning, and home cleaning pickup and delivery service operating 7 days a week (8am-8pm) with 24-48 hour turnaround across metro markets including New York City, New Jersey, the Washington D.C. area, and Los Angeles. Booking is handled through its iOS and Android apps with real-time driver tracking, pay-per-pound or subscription pricing, and free pickup and delivery. Cleanly/ByNext exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's public web and consumer-app footprint. The original cleanly.com domain now redirects to bynext.co.

providers.name: CrowdMade
