This is an EDI-and-bilateral-integration carrier with a customer-contract portal veneer, not a public API provider.

providers.name: Everything But The House
providers.description: Everything But The House (EBTH) is a Blue Ash, Ohio online estate sale and consignment auction marketplace founded in 2008 by Jacquie Denny and Brian Graves. It runs curated, full-service online estate sales — cataloging, photography, appraisal, payment and shipping — for homeowners, estate managers, dealers and collectors, and sells the resulting antiques, fine art, jewelry, coins, watches, furniture and collectibles to buyers through timed online auctions where most lots open at one dollar. EBTH sells a consumer marketplace and a consignment service, not a developer platform: the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK or webhook catalog. Its public GitHub organization contains only forks of third-party Ruby gems, its mobile apps are webview wrappers around ebth.com, and the only GraphQL endpoint on the site is an internal one that robots.txt disallows. The single machine-facing surface it does operate is a public Uptime Kuma status page at status.ebth.com.

providers.name: Food Market Hub
providers.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.

providers.name: Forecastr
providers.description: Forecastr is a startup financial planning and forecasting platform, founded in 2018 in Louisville, Kentucky, that helps founders and finance teams build investor-ready financial models, track cash flow and runway, plan headcount, budget expenses, and run what-if scenario analysis. It pairs cloud-based forecasting software (a spreadsheet-style formula builder, pre-built templates, drag-and-drop dashboards, and shareable live models) with fractional CFO services, and keeps actuals current through accounting integrations with QuickBooks Online and Xero. Forecastr is an API consumer of those accounting platforms rather than a public API provider; it publishes no developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Fueloyal
providers.description: Fueloyal is an automotive IoT and connected-vehicle platform company that builds proprietary IoT gateway hardware and software for fleet management, fuel management, predictive maintenance, dual dash cameras, EV services, and OEM connected-vehicle solutions. Its products help fleets and vehicle manufacturers monitor, connect, and service vehicles, with an OEM connected-platform and marketplace for delivering connected-vehicle services and mobile apps. Backed by Techstars, Fueloyal was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Gatheround
providers.description: Gatheround (formerly Icebreaker) is a video meeting platform for engaging, interactive, and inclusive virtual gatherings — team all-hands, onboarding, workshops, learning sessions, and community events. It layers structured agendas, breakout rooms, group shares, Q&A, polls, quizzes, and photo booths on top of video, with recording, moderation, upvoting, and ready-made templates aimed at people-operations, community, and team leaders. Founded in 2018 and backed by Bloomberg Beta and Salesforce Ventures, Gatheround was acquired by Donut in December 2024. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Gobble
providers.description: Gobble is a meal-kit delivery service that ships chef-prepped dinner kits designed to be cooked in about fifteen minutes, marketed as "restaurant-level delicious in minutes." The company preps and portions seasonal ingredients before shipping them in refrigerated boxes to customers' doorsteps, and offers three flexible subscription plans - Classic, Lean & Clean (650 calories or less, low carb, lean proteins), and Vegetarian - with no long-term commitment. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Gobble operates a direct-to-consumer subscription business and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or developer documentation. This profile captures its public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: hampr
providers.description: hampr is an app-based, on-demand laundry pickup and delivery service founded by Laurel Hess and backed by Techstars. Members bag their dirty laundry, tap the hampr mobile app, and a local independent "washr" collects, professionally washes, dries, folds, and returns it to their door within 24 hours at flat-rate per-load pricing with free pickup and delivery. hampr operates across 16+ US states with 1,500+ washrs, 11,000+ members, and 300,000+ loads completed, and also runs hampr for business, a commercial laundry solution for salons, spas, gyms, and short-term rentals. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; hampr is a consumer/commercial mobile service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: HandUp
providers.description: HandUp is a San Francisco-based public-benefit crowdfunding platform that makes giving to nonprofit organizations and the people they serve easy, secure, and transparent. Launched in 2013 and backed by 500 Global and Version One Ventures, HandUp partners with 501(c)(3) nonprofits whose mission is to serve people experiencing poverty and homelessness. Donors give directly to individual campaigns or to pooled funds such as the National Fund and the HandUp Fund; partner nonprofits then distribute the donations to cover basics like food, clothing, and housing, and report progress and metrics back to donors.

providers.name: Helpling
providers.description: Helpling is an online marketplace that connects households with vetted, insured independent cleaners for on-demand and recurring home-cleaning services. Founded in Berlin and operating across 200+ cities in Germany and other European markets, the platform lets customers compare cleaner profiles and ratings, book and reschedule appointments, and pay online, with liability insurance covering each booking. Helpling operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile app product (iOS and Android) plus separate provider and agency portals; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. It was surfaced through the point-nine venture portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Herbie, Herbie Plan
providers.description: Herbie is an AI-powered estate planning platform and law firm that lets individuals and partner organizations create wills, trusts, and related legal documents online. Its agentic engine encodes the principles, laws, and practice of estate planning into a system that drafts and assembles documents at scale, paired with an AI copilot for natural-language guidance and optional attorney review through Herbie Legal. Herbie is offered directly to consumers and as an embeddable "estate planning as a service" offering for wealth management firms, insurance companies, and employers. Herbie was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Honeyhomes
providers.description: Honey Homes is a home-maintenance membership service that pairs each member with a dedicated, vetted handyman who handles repairs, upgrades, seasonal upkeep, and preventive maintenance around the house. Members book visits, add tasks, receive photo updates, and stay connected to their handyman and team through a companion mobile app. Founded in 2021 by Vishwas and Avantika Prabhakara and backed by Khosla Ventures, the company operates as a licensed, bonded, and insured General Contractor and serves select California and Texas markets including the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; the company exposes a consumer mobile app but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Hyperganic
providers.description: Hyperganic is a Munich- and Singapore-based deep-tech software company building algorithmic engineering technology for additive manufacturing (3D printing). Its flagship product, HyDesign, is a browser-based application for creating, customizing, and optimizing 3D-printed latticed parts, combining implicit (meshless) modeling with validated materials and cloud simulation. Capabilities include lattice grading, TPMS structures, shell/offset and emboss/skin editing, image modulation, meshless linear-elastic simulation, topology optimization, and Lattice Boltzmann CFD. It serves lightweighting, thermal management, metamaterials, mass customization, tooling, and bioengineering use cases across aerospace, automotive, and sports. Backed by HV Capital. Hyperganic does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Immigram LTD
providers.description: Immigram is a UK relocation and immigration platform that helps IT specialists, engineers, founders, and entrepreneurs move to the United Kingdom, primarily via the Global Talent Visa (Tech Nation endorsement route) as well as Skilled Worker, settlement (ILR/naturalization), family, US O-1, and Spanish Startup visa paths. The company pairs immigration legal expertise with an AI-assisted platform that scores eligibility in advance, collects and reviews applicant data into a case, and tracks the process through a live dashboard with data-driven guidance and support. Founded in 2019 and backed by the 500 Global accelerator, Immigram is a services/SaaS provider and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Italic
providers.description: Italic is a direct-to-consumer home goods brand founded in 2018, bringing Mediterranean-inspired beauty to everyday living. The company sells premium bedding, bath towels and robes, beach cabana towels, cashmere throws, decor, and kitchenware (chef knives and flatware), organized into themed collections such as Havana, Amalfi, and Riviera. Italic operates a membership program, "Italic Bold," and runs a Shopify-based storefront with a customer help center, wholesale and trade programs, and an active blog. Backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Kindred Ventures, Italic is a consumer e-commerce retailer with no public developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Jobbatical
providers.description: Jobbatical is a global mobility and immigration platform that helps companies manage international employee relocations, work visas, residence permits, and cross-border compliance across 45+ countries. It combines AI-powered case automation with expert immigration support to streamline eligibility assessments, visa and permit applications, renewal tracking, and settlement services for HR and mobility teams. The product centralizes case management, document processing, visa form automation, real-time status tracking, and renewal alerts, and offers pay-as-you-go or pre-purchased credit (FlexyPocket) pricing. Backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: JusticeText
providers.description: JusticeText is an AI-powered discovery and evidence-review platform built for public defenders and criminal defense attorneys. It transcribes and translates audio and video evidence (body-worn camera, dashcam, jail calls, and courtroom proceedings) in more than 100 languages, syncs multiple camera angles into unified timelines, generates AI summaries of lengthy materials, and produces court-ready exhibits with clipping, redaction, and closed captioning. Its MirandaAI assistant surfaces connections across discovery, builds timelines, and flags inconsistencies. JusticeText is backed by 500 Global and Bloomberg Beta. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; JusticeText ships a web application but does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: kelaHealth
providers.description: kelaHealth is a healthcare AI company that improves surgical outcomes through its Surgical Intelligence Service, an AI-enabled API delivering patient-specific predictive insights at critical decision points across the perioperative process. Models trained on millions of surgical procedures predict individual patient risk across nine major complication categories, identify modifiable factors, and recommend stratified interventions tailored to hospital standards. The service integrates into existing medtech and healthcare software applications using EHR, robotic, and social-determinants-of-health data to help providers improve growth, efficiency, quality, and safety. kelaHealth is HIPAA compliant and backed by Techstars. It does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; its API is delivered through partner integrations.

providers.name: Lantern
providers.description: Lantern (legal entity Employer Direct Healthcare, LLC dba Lantern Specialty Care) is a US specialty care platform that connects members with high-quality, lower-cost care for surgery, cancer and infusion therapy — the complex, high-cost episodes that account for roughly half of healthcare spending. Founded in 2011 as SurgeryPlus and later expanded into cancer and infusion care, Lantern sells to employers, public-sector employers, labor union trusts, health plans and benefits consultants, pairing a hand-selected "Network of Excellence" of specialists with dedicated care teams that navigate a member end to end through a treatment journey. Lantern is backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Lantern publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDKs or discovery surface — this profile captures its public company, trust and security posture only.

providers.name: Lumafield
providers.description: Lumafield is a manufacturing technology company that builds accessible industrial X-ray computed tomography (CT) scanning hardware and AI-powered cloud analysis software. Its Neptune and Triton scanners pair with the Voyager cloud platform so engineers and manufacturers can inspect the inside of parts non-destructively, measure dimensions and GD&T against CAD, detect porosity, cracks, inclusions and wall-thickness defects, and automate inspection at production volume. Lumafield delivers CT as a unified hardware, cloud, and analytics system rather than a public developer API; this profile catalogs its public developer-adjacent surfaces (support/knowledge base, release notes, and an llms.txt documentation index) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LVMH
providers.description: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton is the world's largest luxury goods conglomerate, headquartered in Paris and operating over 75 prestigious brands. Its portfolio spans fashion and leather goods (Louis Vuitton, Christian Dior, Fendi, Loewe, Celine), wines and spirits (Moët & Chandon, Hennessy, Veuve Clicquot), perfumes and cosmetics (Givenchy, Guerlain), watches and jewelry (Tiffany & Co., Bulgari, TAG Heuer), and selective retailing (Sephora, DFS). LVMH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the group level; technical and partner integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed innovation partnerships such as the Aura Blockchain Consortium.

providers.name: Md Ally
providers.description: MD Ally is a New York-based digital health company that integrates telehealth into the 911 emergency response system. Its platform lets emergency dispatchers route low-acuity, non-emergency callers to a virtual care tier, connecting patients with telehealth clinicians, in-network resources, and social services instead of dispatching EMS or defaulting to an emergency-room visit. MD Ally works with public safety agencies and payers to expand traditional two-tier dispatch models, reduce unnecessary ambulance transports and ER visits, and improve patient navigation. Backed by General Catalyst and Techstars.

providers.name: Mineral Forecast
providers.description: Mineral Forecast is a geosciences AI company (backed by Techstars) that helps mineral exploration and mining teams identify the best drilling targets. Its explainable-AI geoscientific platform ingests exploration data to accelerate prospecting and site targeting across base metals, ferrous and industrial metals, industrial minerals, precious metals, and rare earth elements. Products include an AI geosciences platform, AI targeting, AI geological explainability analytics, and a Geo-Insights Hub, positioned as a human-centered decision-support tool for experienced geologists worldwide. As of this enrichment pass Mineral Forecast operates a B2B product and marketing website with no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface; engagement is via request-a-demo and sales.

providers.name: Moneybox
providers.description: Moneybox is a London-based digital wealth management company, operating as Digital Moneybox Limited, whose mobile app helps people in the United Kingdom save and invest — round-ups on everyday spending, Stocks & Shares ISAs, Cash ISAs, Lifetime ISAs, general investment accounts, savings accounts and personal pensions including pension consolidation. It is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and appears in the UK Open Banking app directory as an account aggregator, meaning it CONSUMES bank open banking APIs to read customer transactions rather than publishing an API of its own. As profiled on 2026-08-26, Moneybox runs no public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK, sandbox or partner API surface exists on any Moneybox-controlled host. The one machine-readable artifact it publishes is an RFC 9116 security.txt served from every moneyboxapp.com host.

providers.name: MyFavorito
providers.description: MyFavorito is a fan-empowered sports sponsorship platform that turns fan loyalty into revenue for sports clubs. Fans choose their favorite club, brands activate campaigns, and clubs earn money through a digital marketplace that connects sponsors, clubs, and supporters. The platform combines sponsorship, fan engagement, and CRM tooling for grassroots clubs, top clubs, and brands. Backed by 500 Global and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api/developer/docs host, OpenAPI, well-known, or llms.txt), so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Nines
providers.description: Nines was a teleradiology and medical-imaging AI startup founded in 2017 and backed by Accel and 8VC (a $16.5M Series A in 2019), co-founded by CEO David Stavens. It built FDA-cleared AI algorithms — NinesAI Emergent Triage (for intracranial hemorrhage and mass effect) and NinesMeasure (a lung-nodule algorithm) — alongside a live teleradiology practice. On 2022-02-18, Sirona Medical acquired Nines' AI technology, clinical data pipeline, machine-learning engines, and key personnel, folding the FDA-cleared devices into RadOS, Sirona's cloud-native Radiology Operating System (reporter, viewer, PACS, worklist, and platform AI). The nines.com domain now redirects to sironamedical.com. There is no public developer API today; a RadOS "Amplify" SDK (TypeScript/Python, REST + streaming APIs, event subscriptions) is on Sirona's roadmap as an early-access program for design partners.

providers.name: Nowlun Holding Corp.
providers.description: Nowlun is a digital freight-forwarding platform serving the Middle East and North Africa that lets businesses compare instant ocean-freight quotes from 30+ shipping lines, book FCL and bulk sea shipments, arrange inland trucking to and from ports, track cargo through transit, and handle customs clearance. Beyond its shipper-facing web application, Nowlun operates a live, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://nowlun.com/mcp, secured with RFC 8414 authorization-server and RFC 9728 protected-resource discovery (Authorization Code + PKCE, "mcp" scope). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: OpenSponsorship
providers.description: OpenSponsorship is a two-sided sports sponsorship and influencer marketing marketplace that connects brands with a network of more than 25,000 professional athletes, teams, sports creators, and health and wellness influencers across 150+ sports. Brands pay a monthly subscription to search the roster, post campaigns, submit proposals, manage contracts, and track ROI, while athletes and their agents join for free with OpenSponsorship taking a commission on secured deals. The platform layers AI-based matching, social-content search, campaign management, and reporting on top of a managed service that handles matching, outreach, contracts, and reporting. OpenSponsorship exposes no public developer API at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Oze
providers.description: Oze is an African fintech platform on a mission to help small businesses grow, with a stated vision of building 100 million profitable businesses. Operating across Ghana, Nigeria, Rwanda, and Madagascar, Oze offers a Business App for bookkeeping, invoicing, inventory management, and online sales; no-collateral SME loans; and lending-management software that banks and microfinance institutions use to issue loans to small businesses. The company reports serving over 300,000 businesses. Oze is backed by Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. At the time of this enrichment pass Oze publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: PayPro Global
providers.description: PayPro Global is an all-in-one Merchant of Record platform that lets SaaS, software, video game, and AI tool companies sell globally. The platform handles international payments, subscription billing, tax compliance, fraud prevention, and revenue recovery, and exposes APIs and webhooks for managing subscriptions, payments, and customer data.

providers.name: PermitFlow
providers.description: PermitFlow is an AI-powered construction permitting platform that simplifies permit preparation, submission, and tracking nationwide for contractors, home builders, commercial contractors, architects, developers, and home-services businesses. The product handles permitting paperwork across municipalities with AI agents for intake, research, submission, coordination, and issuance, and covers permit management, inspections and closeouts, and license and registration management. Backed by Accel, Felicis, and Initialized Capital, PermitFlow operates an internal product API (api.permitflow.com) and web application (app.permitflow.com) but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Pilot
providers.description: Pilot provides bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for startups and small businesses, pairing purpose-built financial software with a team of finance experts and former operators. Its offerings include monthly bookkeeping, corporate tax preparation and filing, R&D tax credit studies, fractional CFO and COO support, and stock administration. Pilot serves venture-backed startups and growing SMBs, integrating with accounting and payroll tools to deliver accurate books and financial reporting. Pilot is backed by CRV, Foundry Group, Index Ventures, SV Angel, Techstars, and Union Square Ventures. As of this profile Pilot does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its product is delivered as a managed service through its web application.

providers.name: Prism Data
providers.description: Prism Data is a cash flow underwriting infrastructure and analytics platform that helps lenders expand approvals and lower losses by turning raw bank transaction data into decisioning signals. Its products include CashScore (a cash-flow-based credit score), transaction Categories, Income verification, and Insights, delivered through an API and the Pulse dashboard for credit underwriting across the United States and Canada. Developer API documentation is published at docs.prismdata.com behind a developer login.

providers.name: Quad/Graphics
providers.description: Quad (NYSE: QUAD), formerly Quad/Graphics, is a Sussex, Wisconsin marketing experience company that pairs one of North America's largest commercial printing platforms with data, creative, media and marketing-technology services. Its offer spans audience targeting and consumer analytics, creative and content production through its Betty agency, omnichannel media planning and placement through its Rise agency, catalog, magazine, direct mail and packaging production, in-store retail media displays, postal optimization and logistics, and the QuadMed employee health business. Quad markets three named marketing-technology platforms — At-Home Connect for automated triggered direct mail, Local Connect for multi-location marketing, and In-Store Connect for retail media — and advertises API integration with CRM and marketing-automation platforms for At-Home Connect, but publishes no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification for any of them.

providers.name: RedCircle
providers.description: RedCircle is a podcast advertising, hosting, and monetization platform founded in 2018 that turns podcast host-read endorsements into measurable results for brands and creators. For podcasters it provides podcast hosting, RSS distribution to directories, dynamic ad insertion, a cross-promotions marketplace, instant payouts, automated transcript and video generation, and audience analytics. For brands it operates a fully managed host-read ad platform that pairs proprietary data with authentic creator voices to run and measure campaigns at scale. RedCircle also documents OpenRAP, its remote ad-pipeline / VAST configuration for dynamic ad insertion. The platform is offered as SaaS tiers (Growth, Pro, and Enterprise) rather than as a public developer API; there is no published developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: Remoov
providers.description: Remoov is a San Francisco-based full-service removal, resale, donation, and recycling company that helps households and businesses declutter by picking up unwanted furniture and goods, then reselling them on consignment (via reperch.com), donating them to charities, or recycling them responsibly. Customers schedule a pickup, receive a quote, and earn a share of resale proceeds. Remoov also serves realtors, stagers, property managers, and living communities as partners. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; Remoov publishes a consumer web app and help desk but no public developer API.

providers.name: Rinse
providers.description: Rinse is a laundry and dry cleaning delivery service that picks up customers' clothes from home, professionally cleans them, and returns them on a recurring or one-off schedule. It runs a wash & fold and dry cleaning model in which uniformed valets handle evening pickup and delivery (typically 7pm-10pm) across major U.S. metros including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington D.C., Boston, Seattle, and Austin, plus Toronto. Rinse emphasizes convenience, garment care, sustainability, and employing its valets as W-2 employees with benefits. The company is backed by Partech and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Rinse publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Royal LePage
providers.description: Royal LePage is Canada's largest residential real estate brokerage brand, founded in Toronto in 1913 as A.E. LePage and operated today under franchise and corporately-owned brokerages by Bridgemarq Real Estate Services (TSX: BRE), an affiliate of Brookfield. It spans roughly 20,000 licensed REALTORS across 600-plus offices nationwide, and sits in the value chain as a brokerage/franchisor rather than as a data platform. Its consumer search at royallepage.ca is a downstream CONSUMER of listing data, not a publisher of it - the site states its inventory is "226,755 active MLS listings via the CREA DDF network," meaning the machine-readable feed belongs to the Canadian Real Estate Association's Data Distribution Facility, not to Royal LePage. On API posture the honest finding is that there is none published for developers - no developer portal, no documented API, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata, no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification anywhere in evidence (RESO is a US NAR-adjacent regime and is simply absent from the Canadian brokerage layer), and no SDKs, webhooks, or Postman collections. Account registration on the site creates a Virtual Office Website (VOW) relationship with Royal LePage Real Estate Services, Brokerage that restricts data to personal, non-commercial use, and the legal notice expressly forbids "spiders, robots, crawlers, data mining tools, or the like." Any programmatic access to the underlying Canadian listing record runs through CREA membership and the DDF licence, not through Royal LePage.

providers.name: Satellogic
providers.description: Satellogic is an Argentine-founded, U.S.-listed (NASDAQ: SATL) vertically integrated Earth observation company that designs, builds, and operates its own NewSat constellation to deliver sub-meter, high-frequency multispectral and hyperspectral satellite imagery. Its commercial platform Aleph unifies archive search, tasking, analysis, and delivery into a single web and API experience, available in both the legacy Aleph V1 (Tasking, Archive, Analysis, Delivery APIs) and the unified Aleph V2 Orders API. Satellogic also markets Aleph Observer for persistent daily monitoring of designated sites, Constellation-as-a-Service for priority and large-scale tasking, and Space Systems for customers who wish to purchase and operate their own Mark V class satellites. Imagery is delivered via API, FTP, and a reseller network, with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials authentication against auth.platform.satellogic.com and product APIs under api.satellogic.com.

providers.name: Savana
providers.description: Savana is a Malvern, Pennsylvania based financial software company, founded in 2009, that sells a cloud-native, API-first Digital Delivery Platform to banks, credit unions and fintechs. The platform sits above the core banking system rather than replacing it, unifying banker-facing experiences (CRM, BPM, servicing, assisted account opening) and customer-facing experiences (online and mobile banking, digital account opening) across any core, and shipping 140+ pre-built configurable servicing workflows. Savana markets a set of "Banking APIs" that orchestrate whole servicing processes — not just data exchange — between assisted and self-service channels, but as of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; documentation and the status page are reachable only by authenticated customers. Savana raised a $45M Series A led by Georgian with participation from Fiserv in 2022.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Stash
providers.description: Stash is an investing and banking app that enables fractional share investing, automated portfolio building, bank account management with a Stock-Back debit card, custodial accounts for minors, IRA retirement accounts, and financial education content. Stash serves over one million customers and has $4.3 billion under management, offering subscription-based access to a hybrid DIY and robo-advisor investing experience starting at $3 per month.

providers.name: Sycamore
providers.description: Sycamore (Sycamore Labs, Inc.) is a Palo Alto, California company building a "trusted agent operating system for the enterprise" — a platform for large organizations to build, deploy, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents across their existing systems with enterprise-grade security, human oversight, and organizational intelligence that compounds over time. Its stated pillars are a progressive trust system where agents earn autonomy through demonstrated reliability, adaptive system generation from natural language, continuous learning from outcomes, and collective multi-agent coordination. The company emerged from stealth in March 2026 with a $65M seed round led by Coatue and Lightspeed. As of this profile Sycamore is pre-product with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this repo captures its public company identity, security posture, and machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: Teamtailor
providers.description: Teamtailor is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and employer branding platform that helps companies attract, engage, and hire candidates with customizable career sites, recruitment workflows, candidate communications, and analytics. The platform supports collaborative hiring, GDPR compliance, and a marketplace of integrations. Teamtailor's API follows the JSON:API specification with regional base URLs and uses token-based authentication with Public, Internal, and Admin key permission levels.

providers.name: The Vanguard Group
providers.description: The Vanguard Group is an American investor-owned asset manager headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, and is "the largest provider of mutual funds in the world" and the second-largest exchange-traded fund (ETF) provider after BlackRock's iShares. Vanguard manages approximately $12 trillion in assets as of 2025 and employs roughly 20,000 people (the "crew") as of December 31, 2024. The firm was founded on May 1, 1975 by John C. ("Jack") Bogle and is structured as a mutual: "Vanguard is owned by the funds managed by the company and is therefore owned by its customers." Salim Ramji was appointed Chief Executive Officer in July 2024. Vanguard's business spans index and active mutual funds, ETFs, personal advisor services, retirement plan recordkeeping (Vanguard Retirement Plan Services), institutional asset management, fixed income, and a financial-advisor channel served through Vanguard Financial Advisor Services. Vanguard operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Despite that scale, Vanguard does not publish a public developer API program — there is no public OpenAPI specification, no SDKs, no CLI, no public webhooks, and no Vanguard-published public RSS feed. Investor, advisor, recordkeeping, and distribution-platform integrations are delivered through authentication-gated portals (investor.vanguard.com, advisors.vanguard.com, institutional.vanguard.com), PDF reporting, brokerage/custodian rails, fund-administrator data feeds, and industry recordkeeping interfaces.

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: Trust Token
providers.description: TrustToken, founded in San Francisco in 2017 and rebranded as Archblock in November 2022, builds infrastructure for moving institutional funds and real-world assets onto blockchain rails. The company created the TrueUSD (TUSD) stablecoin and the TrueCurrencies family, and launched TrueFi, an on-chain under-collateralized lending protocol governed by the TRU token. Today Archblock operates a marketplace and fund-tokenization platform for institutional capital at app.archblock.com, with smart contracts, audits, and bug bounty programs published through its trusttoken GitHub organization. Backed by a16z, Founders Fund, BlockTower, and Morgan Creek.

providers.name: Whatifi
providers.description: Whatifi is a visual financial modeling and scenario planning platform for small and medium businesses, letting founders, fractional CFOs, VFX and gaming studios, and startups model, forecast, and share runway, staffing, capacity, and profit scenarios without spreadsheets or formulas. The product uses an event-based canvas of 30+ pre-built business logic "Events" to build and compare "what if" forecasts in real time, and connects to accounting and banking data through integrations with Excel, Google Sheets, Xero, QuickBooks, Plaid, Railz, and OpenAI. Whatifi is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Whatifi publishes a marketing site, a Notion-hosted help center, and a web application, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Zaapi
providers.description: Zaapi is an all-in-one conversational AI and chat-commerce platform built for Southeast Asia's micro, small, and medium-sized e-commerce sellers. Founded in 2021 by Wilfried Buiron and launched in Thailand, Zaapi unifies customer conversations from Facebook, Instagram, LINE, WhatsApp, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, email, and a seller's own website into a single shared inbox, then layers AI agents, automations, broadcast campaigns, and analytics on top to turn those channels into revenue. It is backed by Partech, Global Founders Capital, and Flourish Ventures. As of this profile Zaapi exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; webhook connectivity was signalled on the product roadmap but is not yet published.

providers.name: ZenBusiness
providers.description: ZenBusiness is a business formation and compliance platform that helps entrepreneurs start, run, and grow their companies. It offers LLC and corporation formation, registered-agent service, annual-report and compliance management, EIN/tax filing, business banking and bookkeeping, domain registration, and website building, alongside an AI business guide called Velo. ZenBusiness is a direct-to-consumer/SMB service with no publicly documented developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ablefy
providers.description: ablefy (formerly elopage) is a German all-in-one sales and monetization platform for coaches, creators, trainers, consultants, and online educators. It provides conversion-optimized checkout with 12+ payment methods (PayPal, Klarna, SEPA, cards, Apple/Google Pay) across multiple currencies, an integrated LMS for online courses, memberships and subscriptions, community and live events, e-ticketing, automated invoicing with international tax/OSS compliance, and an optional reseller (merchant-of-record) model. Sellers can automate workflows through the ablefy API, webhooks, and access-token authentication, plus a Zapier integration and email-marketing connectors. The platform reports 80,000+ sellers, 6M+ customers serviced, and over EUR 2 billion in processed transactions across 13+ years of operation.

providers.name: AiFi
providers.description: AiFi is a spatial-intelligence platform that uses camera-only computer vision to understand human behavior in physical spaces. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, it powers autonomous checkout, frictionless identity and entry, real-time fraud prevention, historical journey analytics and an operational co-pilot across retail, stadiums and arenas, quick-service restaurants, travel hubs, healthcare, campuses and government border control. The platform needs no shelf sensors or RFID and tracks shoppers with anonymous skeletal keypoint detection rather than facial recognition by default. AiFi publishes a suite of retailer-facing OASIS APIs that bridge its platform to POS (NCR, Oracle, Square) and payment (Stripe, Adyen) systems, but the developer documentation is served only to authenticated accounts through an AiFi Keycloak single sign-on.

providers.name: All Sports API
providers.description: All Sports API is a fast, reliable, and comprehensive sports data API providing livescore feeds, fixtures, standings, and historical data for major sports worldwide. The platform offers JSON pull-based APIs for football (soccer), basketball, cricket, and tennis, with hockey, baseball, and American football available as additional sports. The API base URL is apiv2.allsportsapi.com and uses API key authentication with sport-specific endpoints accessed via the met query parameter. All Sports API also provides free embeddable widgets (results, fixtures, standings, livescore) and WordPress plugins. Plans include a 14-day free trial.

providers.name: AMERCO
providers.description: AMERCO, operating as U-Haul Holding Company, is America's largest do-it-yourself moving and storage company. The company provides truck and trailer rentals, self-storage facilities, moving supplies, and portable moving and storage containers through its U-Haul brand. AMERCO operates the Moving Help marketplace connecting consumers to moving service providers, the U-Haul Self-Storage Affiliate Network, and WebSelfStorage management software for independent storage facilities. It also operates AMERITAS Life Insurance and Oxford Life Insurance subsidiaries.

providers.name: API-Sports
providers.description: API-Sports is a leading provider of real-time sports data and statistics APIs for businesses and developers. They offer 35+ APIs covering football, basketball, baseball, tennis, rugby, volleyball, handball, ice hockey, MMA, and more, with live scores, fixtures, standings, player statistics, and historical data accessible via a unified API key authentication model.

providers.name: Avant Arte
providers.description: Avant Arte is a global online art marketplace for discovering and collecting limited edition prints, sculptures and digital works produced in close collaboration with leading contemporary artists. Founded in the Netherlands, the platform works directly with 250+ artists on exclusive editions and release "draws", offering authentication, custom framing, gift cards, and expert collector support. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures in the marketplaces sector. Avant Arte does not publish a public developer API; this profile has been enriched from its public web, security, and organizational surfaces.

providers.name: Bigfinite
providers.description: Bigfinite (now Aizon) is a B2B SaaS provider of AI-powered manufacturing intelligence for pharmaceutical manufacturers and CDMOs. The platform turns GxP manufacturing process data into ML-driven recommendations to improve yield, reduce deviations, and prevent batch loss without replacing existing MES, LIMS, or historian systems. Its product stack spans Aizon Execute (intelligent electronic batch records), Aizon Unify (a GxP manufacturing data platform with ALCOA++ integrity), Aizon Predict (operationalized ML for yield optimization, CPV, and predictive quality), and Aizon Agentic Studio (a natural-language application builder). Aizon runs single-tenant on AWS and maintains ISO 27001, ISO 27017, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11 compliance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from public web surfaces; the company publishes no public API.

providers.name: Cabela's
providers.description: Cabela's is a specialty retailer of hunting, fishing, camping, and outdoor recreation merchandise, operating retail stores and an e-commerce platform. Cabela's is a subsidiary of Bass Pro Shops following the 2017 acquisition, and continues to operate under its own brand with retail locations and a consumer-facing web storefront.

providers.name: Cleardata
providers.description: ClearDATA is healthcare's dedicated cloud security, compliance, and operations partner, helping providers, payers, health-tech software companies, medical device makers, and life sciences organizations build and run on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud in a HIPAA- and HITRUST-aligned way. Its offering spans Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) with 300+ healthcare-specific safeguards, Managed Detection & Response (MDR), automated Cloud Compliance, and Cloud Operations, delivered through the CyberHealth platform and managed/professional services. ClearDATA is an AWS Level 1 MSSP and Microsoft Gold Partner, and maps controls to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, NIST, ISO, PCI, and GDPR. ClearDATA is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; ClearDATA does not publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: CNCF
providers.description: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) is part of the Linux Foundation and hosts critical components of the global cloud-native technology infrastructure - including Kubernetes, Prometheus, Envoy, etcd, OpenTelemetry, CloudEvents, gRPC, and CNI. CNCF stewards open-source project governance and publishes the Cloud Native Interactive Landscape, a community-curated dataset (landscape.yml) of cloud-native projects and products with metadata such as GitHub stars, contributor counts, funding, and headquarters location.

providers.name: CyberVadis
providers.description: CyberVadis is a Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPCRM) platform that runs evidence-based cybersecurity assessments of vendors and suppliers at scale. Its assessment methodology maps to global frameworks and standards including NIST, ISO 27001, DORA, NIS2 and GDPR, producing standardized security ratings, prioritized improvement plans, and continuous monitoring with external attack surface management (EASM). CyberVadis pairs a managed assessment service with a self-service platform offering SSO, unlimited users, and API/GRC integrations (for example ServiceNow) so organizations can embed third-party risk workflows into existing systems. Part of the EcoVadis group and backed by Partech. The platform exposes an enterprise, contract-gated API (a monitored "API Integrations" component on its public status page) but publishes no open developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: Deblock
providers.description: Deblock is a fintech company offering a hybrid financial app that combines a fully licensed current account with a French IBAN and a Visa debit card alongside a self-custodial (non-custodial) crypto wallet, so customers hold their own private keys while spending fiat and crypto in everyday life. Founded by former Revolut and Ledger team members and registered with France's AMF as a digital-asset service provider, Deblock lets users buy, sell and swap crypto through an integrated exchange, earn interest on their current account balance, and round spare change up into Bitcoin. Its consumer product is delivered as a mobile app under the tagline "Own Your Money"; Deblock does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from the Speedinvest venture portfolio.

providers.name: Dialogus
providers.description: Dialogus is a frontier AI voice lab building infrastructure for enterprise-grade voice agents that resolve, trace, and control every live conversation across phone systems, internal workflows, and customer systems. Its platform connects voice agents to phone systems, internal tools, databases, CRMs, and messaging channels, with human escalation flows, monitoring, and compliance built in. Agents run a Listen, Reason, Act, and Report loop that detects turns, silence, and intent, constrains the model with workflow state and policies, executes approved tools, and produces auditable transcripts and outcomes. Dialogus targets live customer support, phone order-taking into the POS, and past-due collections, and positions itself as SOC 2 compliant for live operations. Founded by ex-Google, Meta, and Microsoft engineers, it is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: DigiLens
providers.description: DigiLens Inc. is a Sunnyvale, California company that designs and manufactures holographic waveguide optics and augmented reality display systems for extended reality (XR). Its Crystal Waveguides are produced with a proprietary photopolymer material set, inkjet printing and a holographic contact-copy process rather than etching, and are supplied to partners including Samsung, Corning, Panasonic, Sony, Continental, Mitsubishi Chemical and Goertek for smartglasses, automotive head-up displays, smart helmets and avionics head-up guidance. DigiLens also ships ARGO, a standalone, rugged enterprise AR headset running DigiOS — an Android-based operating system with voice UI, gaze and scroll-wheel interaction, projector control and Microsoft Intune MDM certification. Developers build for ARGO in Unity or Android Studio on top of the DigiOS SDK and Qualcomm Snapdragon Spaces, with samples published in the digilens-ar GitHub organization and documentation on the DigiLens developer portal. DigiLens has raised a Series D led by Samsung Electronics at a valuation above $500M.

providers.name: Docket
providers.description: Docket (docket.io, formerly DocketAI) is an AI marketing agent for B2B teams that engages website visitors in real-time conversations to answer product questions from verified knowledge, qualify buyer intent, and book meetings directly into the CRM. It converts inbound traffic into "Agent Qualified Leads" (AQLs) using real-time visitor profiling from CRM history and intent signals, reasoning-based responses powered by its Sales Knowledge Lake (which ingests 50+ data sources including Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack, Google Drive, Notion and SharePoint), and multi-channel voice/text support across 40+ languages. Docket deploys via a JavaScript snippet with no engineering required, and is offered as an annual SaaS subscription rather than a public developer API. The company is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant, and is backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: Eloquent AI
providers.description: Eloquent AI builds autonomous AI operators for financial services and other regulated industries, automating complex customer operations end-to-end without requiring engineering or custom APIs. Its agents observe standard operating procedures and team actions, then securely drive CRMs, browsers, and desktop applications to resolve inquiries, process refunds, and manage returns. Marquee products include Fixer (a 24/7 autonomous customer-service agent), Closer (an AI sales representative), Navigator (an onboarding and support co-pilot), and Custom Agent (tailored enterprise agents). The platform layers a self-healing engine and an evals framework for quality assurance and regulatory compliance, and deploys across email, chat, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice with integrations into Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot, and Stripe. Founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, it serves banking, insurance, fintech, cash advance, debt recovery, and SaaS. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the developer documentation portal is currently password-protected, so no public API specification is available yet.

providers.name: FlexGen Power Systems
providers.description: FlexGen Power Systems is a Durham, North Carolina energy storage technology company founded in 2009 that designs, integrates and operates grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and the software that runs them. Its flagship product is HybridOS, a hardware-agnostic energy management system (EMS) for multi-source, multi-site battery and solar portfolios, alongside HybridOS Control BMS (a US-built battery management system), a solar power plant controller (PPC), EMS retrofit, activation and lifecycle services, and data-center power solutions. FlexGen has been named a BloombergNEF Tier 1 energy storage company, acquired Clean Energy Services (CES) and the assets of Powin, and states that HybridOS exposes automated APIs and historian data API access to customers. No public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published; the HybridOS API surface is reached only through customer deployments and the login-gated FlexGen customer portal.

providers.name: FlowGPT
providers.description: FlowGPT is a community platform for discovering, sharing, and chatting with AI prompts, characters, and chatbots. Backed by DCM Ventures, it operates as a ChatGPT prompt and AI-character marketplace where creators publish prompts, roleplay characters, and AI apps across categories such as programming, marketing, business, and entertainment, and users engage them through free chat, leaderboards, bounties, and paid membership tiers. FlowGPT publishes user- and creator-facing product documentation (guide.flowgpt.com) but does not currently expose a public developer REST API, OpenAPI definition, or first-party SDK; programmatic access today is limited to unofficial community wrappers over its internal endpoints.

providers.name: Gannett
providers.description: Gannett Co., Inc. is a diversified media and digital marketing solutions company and the publisher of USA TODAY and a network of more than 200 local daily newspapers across the United States. It now presents its corporate identity as USA TODAY Co. — www.gannett.com 301-redirects its corporate pages to www.usatodayco.com, and investors.gannett.com resolves to investors.usatodayco.com. Through the USA TODAY Network and LocaliQ, its digital marketing services arm for small and medium-sized businesses, Gannett delivers news, audience and advertising technology. Gannett publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract: developer.gannett.com and developer.usatoday.com both redirect to consumer sites, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP or A2A surface is served on any of its hosts. What it does publish machine-readably is a publisher-side control surface — an RFC 9116 security.txt, a Global Privacy Control signal, an llms.txt on localiq.com, and a 958-line robots.txt that denies the major AI crawlers site-wide while re-allowing a commercial subset of shopping, money and sponsor-content paths.

providers.name: Innoviti
providers.description: Innoviti Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based payment technology company and RBI-authorized payment aggregator (online and, since January 2026, in-store) operating under India's Payment & Settlements Act 2007. Founded in 2002, Innoviti builds collections, reconciliation, and revenue-assurance infrastructure for large organized retail. Its products include innoviti unipay (an enterprise payment and reconciliation platform for omnichannel settlements and leakage control), innoviti genie (a sales acceleration and dealer-margin platform for mobile and electronics retail), and innoviti link (a POS-free mobile collection app accepting cards, UPI, and EMI). The company serves enterprise retailers including Samsung, Reliance Retail, Tanishq, Shoppers Stop, and More Retail, holds multiple payment-communication patents, and maintains PCI DSS, PCI P2PE, and PCI PIN certifications. Added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Invaluable
providers.description: Invaluable is the world's leading online marketplace for fine art, antiques and collectibles, founded in 1986. The platform aggregates live and timed auctions from more than 5,000 premier auction houses across 53 countries, giving collectors worldwide a single place to discover, bid on, and win items — with over 260,000 items listed at any time and an archive of 66+ million price records. Invaluable also operates AuctionZip and a Private Label / Connect white-label offering, and provides a partner-only Catalog Upload API that lets auction-management software companies add, edit, and delete lots in timed and live sales directly from their own systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Jest
providers.description: Jest is a delightful JavaScript testing framework with a focus on simplicity. It works with projects using Babel, TypeScript, Node, React, Angular, Vue and more. Jest provides snapshot testing, parallel execution, built-in mocking, and code coverage out of the box.

providers.name: Jobvite
providers.description: Jobvite, part of Employ Inc., is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruiting platform that helps enterprises source, hire, and onboard talent. The platform combines candidate relationship management, recruitment marketing, branded career sites, and onboarding workflows. Jobvite provides REST APIs that facilitate real-time data exchange in JSON for candidate records, requisitions, applications, and the Onboard New Hire endpoint.

providers.name: Latent Health
providers.description: Latent Health (branded "Latent") is an enterprise pharmacy intelligence company that applies a clinical agentic engine to the medication-access workflow for hospital and health-system pharmacy teams. The platform spans four stages — Identify (care-gap detection, eligibility screening, site-of-care routing), Access (prior authorization, clinical review, appeal generation, benefit routing, payer outreach), Capture (340B eligibility auditing, leakage analytics, financial dashboards), and Engage (patient outreach, queue management, outcomes analytics). It ingests patient charts and EHR data, claims, payer policies, and drug labels, and is described as chart-native and EHR-agnostic across Epic and Cerner. The company reports deployment across 50+ health systems covering 2M+ patients annually, and raised an $80M Series A led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital. Latent Health publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs as of this profile; it is an enterprise platform sold to health systems, and its public surface is limited to marketing, case studies, press, and a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Lateral
providers.description: Lateral was a Berlin- and Hobart-based AI research software company founded in 2013 that built machine-learning powered content recommendation and document navigation tools. Its early product was a conceptual text-matching and recommendation API that let developers insert documents and retrieve semantically similar content, with pre-populated corpora covering arXiv, PubMed, Wikipedia, news and SEC filings. The company later pivoted to an LLM-assisted research workspace for navigating information across large document sets, and published open-source research on hyperbolic-space word embeddings (Poincare embeddings, hyperplane hashers, WARP recommenders). Lateral was permanently shut down on 26 June 2025; the team pointed users to a successor open-source research platform at coordination.network. The public API, its documentation host and the application host are all retired, so this profile documents a historical API surface and the client libraries that remain published.

providers.name: LeapYear Technologies
providers.description: LeapYear Technologies built an enterprise platform for differentially private analytics and machine learning, letting organizations compute over highly sensitive data and share it across internal silos and external partners with mathematically proven privacy guarantees. LeapYear Core was licensed, self-hosted software rather than a public multi-tenant API: customers ran their own server and reached it through a first-party Python client, with every computation drawing down a quantified privacy exposure budget enforced by the server. Snowflake announced its intent to acquire LeapYear on 2023-02-07 and closed on 2023-02-10 for USD 62.0 million in cash, primarily for talent and developed technology, folding the differential privacy capability into its Global Data Clean Room offering. The company no longer operates independently, leapyear.io is now a Snowflake-controlled redirect, and the only surviving first-party documentation is the Python client API reference on its readthedocs host.

providers.name: Metamarkets Group
providers.description: Metamarkets was a real-time analytics platform for programmatic advertising, giving ad exchanges, SSPs, DSPs, and ad networks interactive dashboards over billions of daily bid, impression, click, and spend events. Its Real-time Data Ingestion (RDI) API accepted continuous streams of OpenRTB-based JSON event records over authenticated HTTPS POST, surfacing them in the Metamarkets dashboard within seconds. Founded in 2010 and the birthplace of the Druid analytics database (now Apache Druid), Metamarkets was acquired by Snap Inc. in 2017; its successor products live on as Rill Data. This profile enriches the dcvc portfolio lead from the surviving public documentation at docs.metamarkets.com.

providers.name: MIT
providers.description: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) operates an internal developer portal that exposes APIs for the institution's information systems. The MIT developer environment publishes APIs such as the Roles API for managing institutional roles and authorizations. Access to the developer portal and most APIs requires MIT authentication via Shibboleth / Touchstone single sign-on, making the catalog primarily available to community members, partners, and authorized integrators rather than to the general public.

providers.name: NUnit
providers.description: NUnit is a unit-testing framework for all .NET languages. Initially ported from JUnit, the current production release has been completely rewritten with many new features and support for a wide range of .NET platforms. NUnit is a software testing framework, not a remote HTTP API service.

providers.name: Ordana
providers.description: Ordana provides AI agents that run wholesale order-desk operations for distributors, reading every order across email, fax, PDF, EDI, voice, SMS and chat, resolving exceptions, communicating with retailers, and closing orders directly into the customer's ERP. Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Owner.com
providers.description: Owner.com is an all-in-one, done-for-you digital platform for independent restaurants - an AI-built website with SEO, commission-free online and direct ordering, a branded mobile app, email/SMS and push marketing, automated campaigns, a loyalty and rewards program, plus delivery and catering management and reporting - sold as a per-location monthly subscription. Owner.com is a closed SaaS product operated as a managed service for small and independent restaurant operators. It does NOT publish a public or partner developer API, SDK, or developer portal, and exposes no documented, self-serve, programmatic endpoints. It advertises "POS integrations" (Toast, Clover, Square) and payment integrations (Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay), but these are configured by Owner.com's own team as part of onboarding rather than offered as documented API surfaces to third-party developers. As of this writing there is no programmatic API to model - this entry is documented honestly as a no-public-API provider.

providers.name: Qwak
providers.description: Qwak is an end-to-end production machine learning platform that lets data science and ML engineering teams build, train, deploy, monitor, and manage models with minimal engineering friction. The platform unifies MLOps, LLMOps, and a Feature Store, covering model registry and management, GPU/CPU training, production deployment as real-time API endpoints, batch inference or streaming, real-time monitoring and anomaly detection, LLM prompt management, and vector storage. Developers interact with the platform through the `qwak` CLI, the Python SDKs (qwak-sdk, qwak-core, qwak-inference), and a public Go SDK. Qwak was acquired by JFrog and rebranded JFrog ML; its documentation now lives on docs.jfrog.com and the successor SDK is `frogml`. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Rebellions
providers.description: Rebellions is an AI infrastructure company that designs energy-efficient AI inference hardware (NPUs) and the software stack to deploy large language and multimodal models on it at scale. Its products include the Rebel100 inference chip (FP8, HBM3e), the ATOM-Max Server and POD, and RebelServer. The RBLN SDK compiles and serves HuggingFace Transformers/Diffusers, PyTorch, and TensorFlow models on RBLN accelerators, with integrations for vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, TorchServe, and Kubernetes. Rebellions does not expose a public REST/HTTP API; developers integrate through first-party Python SDKs (optimum-rbln, vllm-rbln), the RBLN compiler and driver, and the model zoo. Backed by Kindred Ventures and partnered with Samsung, Arm, IBM, and AWS.

providers.name: Ridecell
providers.description: Ridecell is an AI-powered asset intelligence and orchestration platform for automotive leasing, fleet, and finance companies. Its five intelligence modules (Client, Spend, Supplier, Asset, and Operational Intelligence) and the "Maya" AI agent monitor fleets, flag invoice overcharges, track garage/supplier performance, optimize vehicle remarketing and residual value, and resolve idle-vehicle inefficiencies. The platform processes 12M+ events daily across 500K+ assets, 100+ connected systems, and 14+ countries. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital. Ridecell does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK; this profile captures its public information, security, and compliance surfaces.

providers.name: Romit
providers.description: Romit was a bank-agnostic digital wallet and payment-gateway platform for the card-not-present merchant-acquiring industry, built by a team of ex-Robocoin (bitcoin ATM) founders and backed by the 500 Global (500 Startups) accelerator. The Romit Merchant Suite let merchants stop chargebacks, reduce fraud and resolve disputes, while its consumer wallet let customers securely store payment methods, view transactions and communicate with merchants. Its OAuth2 REST API (api.romit.io/v1) exposed Banking (cards + linked bank accounts), Identity/KYC, Transfer (authorize/capture/refund/void money movement), Subscription, Plan and Invoice resources. Romit (romit.io) has since ceased operations; this profile captures the API surface derived from the surviving public evidence.

providers.name: Rx Redefined
providers.description: Rx Redefined Inc is a healthcare technology company in Arroyo Grande, California, founded in 2018, that operates a patented, compliance-focused DMEPOS (durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics and supplies) platform for physicians. The platform lets a medical practice become a licensed physician-owned DMEPOS supplier and distribute medical supplies — insulin pumps, breast pumps, ostomy pouches, urinary catheters — directly to its own patients instead of handing the order to a third-party supplier. It ships two products: a Full-Service product built around physician personal performance, and an In-Office product built around the in-office ancillary services exception. The platform covers CMS licensing onboarding, electronic ordering with per-order compliance and eligibility checks, supply-chain integration with 10+ U.S. distribution centers, and end-to-end revenue-cycle and audit management. The company reports use across 350+ U.S. clinics and runs on ISO 27001 certified infrastructure with HIPAA controls. The product is a customer-only web application at app.rxredefined.com; Rx Redefined publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Siemens Healthineers
providers.description: Siemens Healthineers AG is a German medical technology company (XETRA SHL) covering medical imaging, laboratory diagnostics, point-of-care testing, advanced therapies, and cancer care (following the April 2021 Varian Medical Systems acquisition for USD 16.4 billion). Its digital surface is anchored by the teamplay digital health platform, the Digital Marketplace, syngo.via OpenApps, and the Frontier Development Kit, with developer access offered through a gated teamplay developer portal that exposes APIs for single sign-on, licensing, user roles and permissions, the teamplay receiver plug-in, DICOM image access, customer-specific report submission, and status indicator notifications. No public OpenAPI specifications are published; the API catalog and reference documentation sit behind teamplay developer account authentication.

providers.name: Thorin
providers.description: Thorin is an applied-AI startup incubated and backed by 8VC (Joe Lonsdale), building a workbench for company agents. Its product at app.thorin.com pairs a personal agent that acts as your delegate with project agents that own shared team workflows, connecting business systems (Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Gong, Salesforce, Affinity, and MCP) and organizing company context into feeds that power reusable skills and scheduled automations. Thorin observes work across email, chat, meetings, and documents to build a real-time model of how a business operates, then automates recurring processes such as deal flow, deal-prep briefs, and inbox switchboards. Seed-stage, based in San Francisco. This profile documents Thorin's product and documentation surface; no public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Vallor
providers.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Vega
providers.description: Vega (vega.io) is the operating system for agentic SecOps, a post-SIEM security operations platform whose Security Analytics Mesh (SAM) powers AI-native federated detection, agentic triage, and analytics on every security data source in place, with no ingestion or migration. Founded in 2024 and backed by Cyberstarts, Accel, Redpoint, and CRV, Vega raised $120M (announced September 2025) and continuously assesses detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK. The platform is sales-led; its application and developer documentation sit behind a customer login.

providers.name: Wenrix
providers.description: Wenrix is an AI infrastructure company for the travel industry, providing embedded AI that helps Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) and Travel Management Companies (TMCs) drive revenue and operational efficiency from search through post-trip servicing. Founded in 2017 and backed by Insight Partners, Wenrix processes roughly $12 billion in annual air volume across 60+ global OTAs and TMCs. Its platform is delivered as three API-first products: FareSight, a predictive price-assurance engine that optimizes pricing across EDIFACT, NDC, GDS, aggregators, and low-cost carriers at both search and post-booking stages; FlexEngine, a flight-flexibility solution offering short- and long-term flexibility, refund guarantees, and price-lock through a single API; and DeepFlow, a post-booking servicing automation layer that automates cancellations, refunds, and changes at 93%+ automation rates and is available as either an API or an MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server. Wenrix operates from offices in Tel Aviv, New York, and Barcelona.

providers.name: Acadia Healthcare
providers.description: Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACHC) is a Franklin, Tennessee-based Fortune 1000 behavioral healthcare provider operating a national network of acute inpatient psychiatric hospitals, specialty substance use disorder treatment facilities, residential treatment centers, and outpatient comprehensive treatment clinics across the United States. It is a clinical services operator rather than a software company: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API reference, and no machine-readable contract of any kind. A MuleSoft CloudHub gateway is deployed at api.acadiahealthcare.com, but every anonymous path on it returns an empty-body HTTP 404, and the developer host previously recorded here (developer.acadiahealthcare.com) does not resolve. Not to be confused with Acadia Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: ACAD), an unrelated company.

providers.name: Aceiss
providers.description: Aceiss is a security monitoring and access-visibility platform that gives CISOs and risk managers continuous insight into who has access to their GitHub organizations and repositories. It monitors user access across repositories, detects unauthorized or anomalous activity in real time, and produces governance and compliance reporting mapped to frameworks such as NIST, CIS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CSA STAR, HITRUST, and SOC 2. Aceiss installs from the GitHub Marketplace as a read-only app requiring admin privileges and exposes an API for integrating its real-time access data into existing systems, with spreadsheet and PDF export. The company is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Akeana
providers.description: Akeana is a semiconductor IP company building high-performance RISC-V processor system IP, with the stated mission of elevating RISC-V to world-class performance levels. It licenses customizable processor cores across three families (the ultra-low-power 100 Series for deeply embedded controllers, the 1000 Series for high-performance edge AI and automotive compute, and the ultra-high-performance 5000 Series for data center, networking, and mobile application processors), plus hardware accelerator IP, AMBA-compliant interconnect fabric IP (AXI, ACE, CHI), and system IP (interrupt controllers, IOMMU, PCIe, UCIe). Backed by Kleiner Perkins and Mayfield, Akeana partners with Samsung Foundry, Canonical, Innatera, Axiomise, and proteanTecs. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

providers.name: Allara
providers.description: Allara Health is a virtual women's healthcare platform focused on complex hormonal, metabolic, and gynecological conditions such as PCOS, insulin resistance, endometriosis, thyroid disorders, menopause, and PMDD. Serving more than 85,000 patients across 45 states and D.C., Allara connects members with board-certified OB-GYNs, endocrinologists, women's health nurse practitioners, and registered dietitians for virtual consultations, advanced hormonal and metabolic lab testing, personalized treatment plans, and ongoing care coordination. The company operates consumer-facing web and patient portal applications; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as an index-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Allara Health
providers.description: Allara Health is a telehealth platform specializing in women's hormonal, metabolic, and gynecological health. Founded by Rachel Blank following her own PCOS diagnosis, Allara connects patients with dedicated multidisciplinary care teams of board-certified physicians, OB-GYNs, endocrinologists, nurse practitioners, and registered dietitians who deliver personalized treatment through virtual visits. The platform treats complex conditions including PCOS, insulin resistance, endometriosis, thyroid disorders, fertility concerns, and other metabolic and endocrine issues, combining medical care, nutrition counseling, advanced testing, lifestyle support, and medication when appropriate. Allara accepts most insurance plans and offers self-pay options. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network; Allara is a consumer telehealth service with no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Anine Bing
providers.description: Anine Bing is a Los Angeles-based contemporary womenswear and fashion brand selling apparel, denim, footwear, and accessories direct to consumers through its online store at aninebing.com.
