providers.description: SAP America, Inc. is the US subsidiary of SAP SE, headquartered in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, and serving as the Americas headquarters for the parent company's enterprise software portfolio (ERP, SCM, CRM, HCM, analytics, and cloud platform). SAP America itself does not publish a US-specific developer portal or APIs distinct from the parent SAP SE surface — all API documentation, SDKs, and OpenAPI artifacts are catalogued under the sibling `sap` repository (api.sap.com, SAP Business Accelerator Hub, SAP BTP). This repo is a subsidiary placeholder that exists to (1) record SAP America as a distinct US legal entity for partnership, public-sector, procurement, and FedRAMP / GovCloud contexts, and (2) cross-link to related US-only sibling subsidiaries — most importantly SAP NS2 (SAP National Security Services), the independent US subsidiary that operates SAP workloads in the Cloud Intelligence Enterprise (CIE), the DoD cloud environment, and the Commercially Regulated Environment (CRE) for federal, defense, and intelligence community customers. No tier-1 API artifacts (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, capabilities, plans, rate limits, FinOps) are generated in this repo per the api-evangelist no-empty-artifact rule — they are maintained under the parent `sap` repo and the per-product child repos (`sap-business-technology-platform`, `sap-successfactors`, `sap-ariba`, `sap-concur`, `sap-fieldglass`, `sap-api-management`, `sap-integration-suite`).

providers.name: Scribd
providers.description: Scribd Inc. is an American digital-content media company founded in 2007 by Trip Adler, Jared Friedman and Tikhon Bernstam and headquartered in San Francisco, California. It operates four consumer platforms: Scribd (a document-sharing library), Everand (a subscription service for ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, podcasts and sheet music, formerly the flagship Scribd subscription), SlideShare (presentation hosting) and Fable (a social reading app). Scribd was an early Y Combinator company. Its historical public "Platform" API for uploading, converting and displaying documents is now legacy — the official Ruby client (scribd/rscribd) was archived in 2019, Scribd no longer accepts new API accounts, and the SlideShare developer portal has been retired — so this profile documents the company's identity and the remaining first-party developer artifacts rather than a live API surface.

providers.name: Smore
providers.description: Smore is a newsletter and flyer builder purpose-built for educators, schools, and districts, letting teachers and administrators create accessible, mobile-friendly digital newsletters from customizable templates to keep families and staff informed. The product emphasizes WCAG AA accessibility, translation for multilingual families, and engagement analytics on opens and clicks. Smore is now part of SchoolStatus, the family-engagement platform. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Smore publishes no public developer program, API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface — this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture only.

providers.name: Spiber
providers.description: Spiber Inc. is a Japanese biotechnology and advanced-materials company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. Spiber develops Brewed Protein materials — structural proteins produced by precision fermentation of plant-derived sugars using engineered microbes, then spun into fibers, resins, and films as animal-free, petroleum-free alternatives to silk, wool, cashmere, leather, and synthetic polymers. The company operates fermentation plants in Japan, Thailand, and the United States and supplies apparel, outdoor, automotive, and consumer brands, alongside a research program in synthetic biology, polymer science, and life-cycle assessment. Spiber is a materials manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no developer program, developer portal, SDKs, or product API; the only machine-readable HTTP surface it serves is the read-only WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website.

providers.name: Thematic
providers.description: Thematic is a copyright-free music licensing platform that connects independent content creators with emerging artists. Creators get a permanent, no-cost license to use tracks in their videos in exchange for including a promotional link in the description, which activates YouTube Content ID whitelisting and prevents copyright claims across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and podcasts. Premium ($9.99/mo) and Pro ($24.99/mo) plans unlock the full catalog, podcast licensing, and unlimited downloads. Co-founded with YouTube pioneer Michelle Phan, Thematic serves 1M+ creators and 10,000+ independent artists across 220+ countries. Thematic runs a consumer web and mobile app and does not currently publish a public developer API. Backed by 500 Global and Lux Capital.

providers.name: Themis
providers.description: Themis (askthemis.com) is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) SaaS platform positioned as a "compliance collaboration" tool that streamlines partnerships between companies and their vendors, banks, credit unions, and fintechs by accelerating onboarding, due diligence, and risk assessments. The platform bundles modules for policies, procedures, documents, vendor and risk management, risk register, control mapping, issue and change management, complaints, QA testing, training, audit, key risk indicators (KRI), FINRA 4530, and conflicts of interest. Themis serves banking, payments, lending, crypto/DeFi, exchanges, BaaS, and credit-card sectors, and is used through a hosted web application at portal.askthemis.com. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public or developer API surface. Themis is a portfolio company of Felicis.

providers.name: Tonk
providers.description: Tonk, built by Tonk Labs, is an open-source containerized format, host environment, and protocol for multiplayer, local-first software you keep and share like files. A .tonk bundle packages an application together with its data into a single self-contained file that runs anywhere, works offline, and stays under user control. It is built on a document-based virtual file system using Automerge CRDTs, a browser/WebAssembly runtime compiled from Rust, and peer-to-peer synchronization through WebSocket relays. Tonk ships first-party npm client libraries, a CLI, a sync relay, an authentication library, and an MCP worker rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Electric Capital.

providers.name: TraceAir
providers.description: TraceAir is a construction site intelligence platform for homebuilders and land developers, combining drone photogrammetry and LiDAR scans with cloud analytics to track sitework progress, verify earthwork cut/fill quantities, generate lot layouts and yield estimates, and document builds with 360-degree interior scans across the full project lifecycle from land acquisition to handover. The company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the platform is accessed through its web application.

providers.name: Wattpad
providers.description: Wattpad is a Toronto-based social storytelling platform where a global community of more than 90 million writers and readers create, share, and read serialized original fiction across every genre. Founded in 2006 and acquired by Naver (WEBTOON) in 2021, Wattpad extends its stories into publishing, film, and TV through Wattpad WEBTOON Studios. Wattpad formerly operated a public developer API (developer.wattpad.com), but public access was discontinued around April 2018 and the API is now internal-only, so this profile captures the company's web properties and operational surface rather than an active API program.

providers.name: xChange
providers.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

providers.name: Xpedeon
providers.description: Xpedeon is a construction-specific ERP platform from Algorithms Software Pvt Ltd (30+ years in construction software), serving general contractors, specialist contractors, housebuilders and developers, engineer-to-order manufacturers, and off-site manufacturers across the UK, India, the GCC, and the US. The cloud platform covers construction finance and accounting, job costing and CVR, contract and subcontractor management, procurement, inventory and supply chain, plant and equipment, warehouse management, HR and payroll, CRM, and a mobile app for site teams, and is ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 certified. Xpedeon publishes no public API, developer portal, or integration documentation, but does publish an llms.txt. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Adept
providers.description: Adept was an AI research lab building action-taking foundation models (the ACT family) that can use software tools and complete tasks across business applications. In mid-2024, several Adept co-founders and senior researchers joined Amazon's AGI organization in a non-acquisition arrangement, and Amazon licensed Adept's technology. Adept the entity continues to exist, but it has no current public commercial API; its primary remaining footprint is open-source models published on Hugging Face (Fuyu-8B, Persimmon-8B) and historical research outputs (ACT-1, ACT-2).

providers.name: Administration for Native Americans (ANA)
providers.description: The Administration for Native Americans (ANA) is an agency within the Administration for Children and Families (ACF), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. ANA promotes self-sufficiency and cultural preservation for Native Americans, Alaska Natives, Native Hawaiians, and other Pacific Islander communities by providing social and economic development opportunities through financial assistance, training, and technical assistance. ANA administers a $45 million discretionary grant program in three primary areas: Social and Economic Development Strategies (SEDS), Native Language Preservation and Maintenance, and Environmental Regulatory Enhancement. ANA data on funded projects is publicly available through data.gov and healthdata.gov.

providers.name: Almanac Health
providers.description: Almanac Health is a clinical AI company building a research-validated clinical decision support platform, delivered as Almanac Chat, that brings specialist-grade, evidence-based answers to clinicians at the point of care. Founded by physician-researcher Cyril Zakka, MD, the platform is designed to work within existing electronic health record (EHR) workflows, is governed by institutional controls, and is grounded in peer-reviewed research rather than pharmaceutical promotion. In April 2026 the company raised a $10 million seed round led by F-Prime with participation from General Catalyst and Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web, trust, and security surface; Almanac Health does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Amkor Technology
providers.description: Amkor Technology is the world's largest US-based provider of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services (OSAT), serving integrated device manufacturers, fabless semiconductor companies, and contract foundries. The company offers advanced packaging technologies including flip chip, wafer-level packaging, 2.5D/3D TSV, System-in-Package, and chiplet integration solutions for AI, automotive, communications, computing, consumer electronics, industrial, IoT, and networking markets.

providers.name: Boardroom Governance
providers.description: Boardroom is a governance aggregation platform that helps developers fetch and display governance data across DAOs and decentralized networks. The Boardroom Governance API provides access to proposals, votes, protocols, and voter data for Web3 governance applications.

providers.name: CaaMTech
providers.description: CaaMTech is a pharmaceutical drug discovery company in Issaquah, Washington, founded by Dr. Andrew Chadeayne, engineering next-generation psychedelic-inspired small-molecule therapeutics for mental health conditions. It synthesizes and characterizes novel tryptamines, screens natural and synthetic compounds for safety and efficacy, publishes fundamental crystallographic and pharmacological research, and builds a patent portfolio around the results. CaaMTech operates no developer program and publishes no product API; the only machine-readable surface on caam.tech is the standard WordPress REST API that serves the company site, which does make its research updates, pages and media programmatically readable without credentials, alongside an authenticated WordPress MCP adapter endpoint.

providers.name: Cato Digital
providers.description: Cato Digital is a sustainable bare metal cloud provider that repurposes large-scale, second-life servers from hyperscalers like Meta and NVIDIA to deliver AI & GPU servers (up to 512GB VRAM), ephemeral application servers, and build-your-own storage arrays at 60-75% below major cloud providers. Led by CEO Dean Nelson, the company operates on a "use what we have before we build more" circular-economy principle, tapping underutilized data center capacity and clean energy, and is a founding member of the Infrastructure Masons Climate Accord. Customers provision and manage infrastructure through the Cato console rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: CAVA
providers.description: CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA) is a Washington, D.C.-headquartered Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant company that operates the CAVA brand, serving customizable bowls, pitas, salads and sides built on house-made dips, spreads and dressings. Alongside its restaurants CAVA runs a consumer packaged goods line sold in grocery stores, a digital ordering and delivery channel, a catering business at catering.cava.com, and the CAVA Rewards loyalty program delivered through its iOS and Android apps. The company listed on the New York Stock Exchange in June 2023 and reports an in-house technology program — CavaCore, its data platform, and CAVA Current, a restaurant operating system. CAVA publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its public machine-readable surface is limited to an RFC 9116 security.txt and a published llms.txt.

providers.name: Change.org
providers.description: Change.org is an independent, nonprofit-owned social-change platform where anyone can start, sign, and win petitions. With over 500 million users worldwide, it lets people launch campaigns on social, political, and community issues, collect signatures, engage decision makers, and reach the media to drive real-world outcomes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Change.org's historical public developer/petitions API has been deprecated and is no longer maintained; no first-party OpenAPI, SDK, or hosted MCP server is currently published.

providers.name: Citus Data
providers.description: Citus Data is the company behind Citus, an open source extension that turns PostgreSQL into a distributed database. Rather than forking Postgres, Citus adds sharding, distributed tables, reference tables, and a distributed query planner so applications can scale out across many nodes while keeping full SQL, ACID transactions, and the entire Postgres ecosystem. It is used for multi-tenant SaaS applications, real-time analytics dashboards, and microservices architectures. Founded in San Francisco and acquired by Microsoft in 2019, Citus is developed in the open on GitHub and is also offered as a managed cloud service (Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL); its reference documentation is hosted on Microsoft Learn. Citus is consumed over the standard PostgreSQL wire protocol and SQL, so it exposes no REST/HTTP API, no OAuth surface, and no language SDKs of its own.

providers.name: claimsforce
providers.description: claimsforce GmbH is a Hamburg-based insurtech building AI-powered software for property and casualty claims management and underwriting. Its platform helps insurers, loss-adjusting and expert organizations, and independent adjusters digitize the end-to-end claims process - automating report and calculation generation, enabling video-based remote case assessment, optimizing adjuster disposition and route planning to cut travel time, and surfacing real-time analytics for claims handling and risk management. Named customers include Zurich Gruppe Deutschland, HanseMerkur, Concordia, Crawford, Sedgwick and Die Regulierer. The product is a private, login-only SaaS with no public API or developer portal as of July 2026. The company is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (TUV Rheinland) and backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Clivi
providers.description: Clivi is Mexico's largest digital clinic for diabetes and obesity care, delivering fully online telehealth treatment that combines endocrinologists, internists, nutritionists, and psychologists with continuous glucose monitoring and GLP-1 medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Saxenda, Rybelsus). Founded in 2020 and based in Mexico City, Clivi serves patients nationwide through WhatsApp-based virtual care, home medication delivery via its Farmacia Clivi digital pharmacy, and tiered treatment plans (Clivi Pro, Plus, Total, and Zero). Backed by 500 Global and other investors, Clivi operates as a consumer healthtech service; it publishes no public developer API, but does expose an llms.txt content index for AI agents.

providers.name: CloudLock
providers.description: CloudLock is a cloud-native Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) that protects data, users, and applications across SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, and IDaaS environments. Founded in 2011 and acquired by Cisco in 2016, it is now delivered as Cisco Cloudlock within Cisco Umbrella / Cisco Security Cloud. The platform uses an API-driven model to discover sensitive content, detect policy violations, flag anomalous user behavior, and manage cloud application (OAuth) risk. Developers integrate through the Cisco Cloudlock API (v2), a Bearer-token REST API exposing activities, incidents, incident entities, incident aggregates, policies, apps, entities, IP libraries, and anomalies. Originally a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, CloudLock's developer surface is documented on Cisco DevNet and the Cisco Umbrella documentation hub.

providers.name: Coast Capital Savings
providers.description: Coast Capital Savings is a member-owned financial co-operative headquartered in Surrey, British Columbia, serving over 600,000 members across roughly 45 branches. On November 1, 2018 it became Canada's first British Columbia-based federal credit union (regulated federally rather than provincially), and in May 2026 it completed a merger with Prospera Credit Union. With approximately $21.9 billion CAD in total assets it is one of Canada's largest credit unions. As a cooperative credit union rather than a Schedule I/II bank, Coast Capital operates within Canada's voluntary and still-fragmented open-finance landscape: the federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework legislated under Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC) as overseer, is not yet operational. Coast Capital publishes NO public first-party developer portal or documented API; consumer financial-data access today is aggregator-mediated (e.g. Plaid) via screen-scraping/credential-based connections rather than a first-party API.

providers.name: Common Sense Machines
providers.description: Common Sense Machines (CSM) builds 3D world models with image-to-3D and 3D world simulation APIs aimed at games, robotics, and synthetic data. The CSM Cube product family released a single-click model pipeline with mesh-parts-based topology in early 2026. API access is bundled with mid-tier and enterprise CSM subscription plans.

providers.name: ECI Solutions
providers.description: ECI Solutions is a leading provider of cloud-based business management software for small and medium-sized businesses across manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, field service, and retail. ECI's integrated suites span ERP, e-commerce, CRM, accounting, inventory, and analytics, helping customers streamline operations and grow.

providers.name: El-Dokan
providers.description: El-Dokan (El Dokan Software) is a Cairo, Egypt-based enterprise eCommerce software company founded in 2019 that provides an API-first, headless and composable commerce platform for the MENA region. Its 300+ REST API endpoints and developer tools let brands and retailers make any digital experience shoppable across web, mobile apps, POS, and multi-vendor marketplaces, supporting B2C, D2C, B2B, and marketplace models with 100+ payment, shipping, SMS, and ERP integrations and MENA localization. Customers include Procter & Gamble, Misr Pharmacies, Mobily, Zahran, Switch Plus, and Appetito. El-Dokan raised a $550,000 pre-seed round in 2022 backed by Flat6Labs, EFG EV, 500 Global, and Hala Ventures. Public API documentation (data model, getting started, and API reference) is gated behind a get-access signup.

providers.name: FintechOS
providers.description: FintechOS is an AI-powered financial product operations platform that enables banks, lenders, and insurers to configure, price, launch, and manage financial products with reduced dependency on legacy core systems. The platform combines unified product operations, agentic workflow orchestration, and governed AI to streamline origination, servicing, underwriting, and compliance across banking and insurance. It exposes a low-code development environment with Server SDK and Client SDK layers and REST APIs, documented at docs.fintechos.com, with a gated developer community and an academy for onboarding. Founded in Romania with headquarters in the United Kingdom, FintechOS is a portfolio company of Earlybird and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: FireMon
providers.description: FireMon is a cybersecurity company providing firewall and security policy management across hybrid, on-premises, and cloud environments. Its platform normalizes and governs security policies spanning firewalls, cloud security groups, and microsegmentation tools, delivering compliance automation, policy optimization, change automation, and real-time risk insight. FireMon serves more than 1,700 customers across 70+ countries, concentrated in healthcare, financial services, retail, and manufacturing. Its Security Manager platform exposes a REST API, delivered per-install (self-hosted or cloud appliance) rather than as a single public hosted endpoint. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from FireMon's public web and documentation surface.

providers.name: Flock Freight
providers.description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company and licensed freight brokerage that pioneered shared truckload (STL) shipping through its FlockDirect service. Its AI-powered pooling technology algorithmically combines multiple partial shipments from different businesses into a single multi-stop full truckload, giving shippers truckload-level service, damage rates, and speed without paying for a full trailer, while cutting empty miles and carbon emissions. The platform provides automated spot rating via API, TMS integrations, and EDI connectivity (204/210/211/214/990/997) for shippers and carriers. Backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: Govini
providers.description: Govini (rebranded to Air, air.ai, in 2026) is a defense-technology and decision-analytics company whose Ark platform combines proprietary defense acquisition data with AI-enabled applications to close the national-security "Readiness Gap" across supply chain, science and technology, production, sustainment, logistics, and modernization missions. Ark holds FedRAMP High authorization and a DISA Impact Level 5 (IL5) Provisional Authorization plus service-level IL5 ATOs, making it a closed, government-authorized SaaS platform rather than a public developer API. Led by CEO Tara Murphy Dougherty and backed by investors including Accel and Bain Capital. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and has been enriched with the provider's real public identity, security posture, and published compliance authorizations.

providers.name: Hormona
providers.description: Hormona is a women's hormonal-health company founded in 2020 by Karolina Lofqvist and Jasmine Tagesson, with offices in London, UK and Stockholm, Sweden. It builds a hormone-tracking mobile app together with an at-home hormone monitor and urine-test kits that users scan with a phone camera to get real-time, quantitative hormone results without a lab visit. The app uses AI to learn each user's patterns and predict when PMS or period symptoms are likely, offering 30+ tools to manage hormonal symptoms and supporting women from their first period through perimenopause and menopause. Hormona is distributed on the App Store and Google Play and is used by women in 185+ countries. It is a direct-to-consumer product with no public developer API program.

providers.name: Incredible Health
providers.description: Incredible Health is an AI-native healthcare career marketplace that connects registered nurses, technicians, and technologists with permanent jobs at top hospitals and health systems. It flips traditional recruiting by having employers apply to pre-screened, verified professionals rather than the reverse. The platform serves 1.5 million+ U.S. healthcare workers and 1,500+ employers, including a majority of the nation's top-ranked hospital systems, cutting time-to-hire from a national average of roughly 86 days to under 20. Two purpose-built AI agents power the marketplace: Gale, a career partner for professionals (resume wizard, interview practice), and Lyn, a voice interview agent for employers that integrates with applicant-tracking systems. Founded by Iman Abuzeid, MD, and headquartered in San Francisco, the company is venture-backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Obvious Ventures, and NFX.

providers.name: Mangomint
providers.description: Mangomint is salon and spa business management software covering scheduling, point of sale, payroll, marketing, memberships, and forms. Mangomint has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification. Its only documented programmatic surface is outbound webhooks (appointment booked/updated/canceled, sale completed, form submitted) that Mangomint staff configure by hand over chat support once a customer supplies a receiving endpoint URL; payload schemas and authentication are not published. A small set of one-off, vendor-built integrations (Shopify, Mailchimp, Docovia, Doxy.me, WaiverForever, Gift Up!) are toggled on from the Mangomint dashboard, and there is no listed Zapier app. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: MTech Systems
providers.description: MTech Systems provides full supply chain data management with artificial intelligence and business intelligence functionality for poultry and animal protein producers, including the Amino, Sonar, Proline, and Axis products.

providers.name: NutriSense
providers.description: NutriSense is a metabolic health and wellness company that pairs continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) with 1:1 registered-dietitian coaching and a mobile app. Members receive glucose biosensors, real-time and historical glucose analytics, AI-assisted pattern insights, stress-management sessions, and video consults with credentialed, glucose-certified nutritionists to build sustainable nutrition, weight-loss, and metabolic-health habits. Nutrisense runs a consumer product with a member web and mobile app experience; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. It does publish a machine-readable llms.txt at nutrisense.io/llms.txt.

providers.name: Prax Health
providers.description: Prax Health is a healthcare platform that helps nurse practitioners launch and grow their own independent practices. It provides an all-in-one back office that handles business formation, regulatory and clinical compliance, medical billing, insurance credentialing, an integrated EHR, and ongoing practice consulting. The company's stated mission is to put healthcare back in the hands of providers by removing the administrative and operational burden that keeps clinicians from practicing independently. Prax Health is a venture-backed company (Canaan Partners) and operates a consumer/clinician web application rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it exposes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Prenetics
providers.description: Prenetics Global Limited (NASDAQ: PRE) is a consumer healthcare and longevity company whose flagship brand is IM8, a science-backed daily-nutrition and longevity supplement line co-founded with David Beckham that reached roughly $120M in annual recurring revenue within its first year. The company's IM8 Health direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp that advertises a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, letting AI agents search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout via Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Shopify card handlers. Prenetics itself publishes no separate developer/API program; the agent-commerce surface is the IM8 Health UCP/MCP storefront.

providers.name: Propel
providers.description: Propel, Inc. is a Brooklyn-based fintech company, founded in 2014, that builds financial tools for Americans with low income. Its free consumer app, Providers (formerly Fresh EBT), is used by more than five million people each month to check their SNAP/EBT balances instantly across 49 states, Washington D.C., and U.S. territories, secure their benefits card with locking and fraud monitoring, find exclusive offers and discounts on groceries, phone plans, internet, utilities, and healthcare, receive alerts about benefit policy changes, browse local job and gig-work listings, and predict deposit dates. Propel is a consumer-facing mobile product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it operates a public status page and a signed RFC 9116 security.txt for coordinated vulnerability disclosure. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Nyca Partners, Kleiner Perkins, JPMorgan Chase, Salesforce Ventures, the Financial Health Network, and Flourish Ventures.

providers.name: Resolve Systems
providers.description: Resolve Systems (resolve.io) is an enterprise IT automation and AIOps platform that helps IT and operations teams automate incident resolution, service-desk workflows, and cross-domain remediation at scale. Its "Agentic Resolution Fabric" combines a Knowledge Agent (contextual answers across chat, portals, and collaboration tools), an Automation Agent (autonomous cross-domain workflows that remediate, configure, and orchestrate IT processes in real time), and Agent Assist (enriched diagnostics, related incidents, and next-best actions). Product lines include Resolve Actions, Actions Pro, Actions Express, and Barista, spanning IT process automation (ITPA), robotic process automation, and agentic service management. The company positions itself around cutting manual tickets by up to 90% and reports large aggregate customer savings. Resolve is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. This profile was enriched from public web sources; Resolve does not appear to publish a public, self-service developer API, OpenAPI definition, or open developer portal — integration and automation are delivered through the platform's connectors and customer-gated documentation.

providers.name: RippleHire
providers.description: RippleHire is an enterprise, AI-powered talent acquisition and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) that automates recruitment workflows end to end - demand creation, sourcing, employee referrals, candidate management, interviews, offers, and onboarding. Built on behavioral science, AI agents, and no-code configuration, it helps large organizations hire faster at scale across 50+ countries. Its RHConnect framework provides API-first and no-code integrations with HRMS, job boards, communication, and assessment tools. RippleHire is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Source Beauty
providers.description: Source Beauty is an online beauty and wellbeing marketplace serving Egypt, selling skincare, makeup, fragrance, hair care, body care, K-beauty and wellness/supplement products from hundreds of local Egyptian and international brands. The consumer-facing storefront (sourcebeauty.com) offers curated brand pages, bundles and gift sets, promotional offers, bilingual English/Arabic shopping, and free shipping on qualifying orders. Source Beauty is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce website only and publishes no public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Sprinter Health
providers.description: Sprinter Health is an in-home preventive and diagnostic healthcare company that pairs trained community health workers ("Sprinters") who visit patients at home with a virtual team of physicians, nurses, and care navigators. Its hybrid Sprinter Care+ model delivers vitals, blood draws, ECGs, cancer and diabetic screenings, wellness visits, medication reconciliation, care-gap closure, health risk assessments, and social-needs screening, and partners with health plans such as Humana, Molina Healthcare, and Anthem. Backed by a16z, Accel, General Catalyst, and GV. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture, and legal/trust properties.

providers.name: Syneos Health
providers.description: Syneos Health is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Syneos Health API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Telesair
providers.description: Telesair, Inc. is a Southern California MedTech company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Irvine, California, that builds respiratory care hardware for patients with respiratory insufficiency. Its flagship product is Bonhawa, a purpose-built High Flow Oxygen Therapy (HFOT) respiratory humidifier that delivers warmed and humidified respiratory gases to spontaneously breathing pediatric and adult patients (10 kg and up) across a 2-80 L/min flow range, with separate pediatric and adult modes, a streamlined disinfection process and a touchscreen interface. Bonhawa holds both FDA 510(k) clearance (October 2023) and the CE Mark under the European Medical Device Regulation (August 2023), and is distributed to US hospitals under an exclusive agreement with Tri-anim Health Services. Telesair also supplies AVEA disposable expiratory filters. Telesair is a medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract. Its only machine-readable agent surface is the Wix platform's Site Visitor Assistant MCP endpoint and an llms.txt served from its own marketing host.

providers.name: Unobravo
providers.description: Unobravo is Europe's largest online psychology service, founded in 2019 by psychologist Danila De Stefano. It matches people with one of 9,500+ individually vetted psychologists and psychotherapists for individual, couples, and group therapy delivered online, serving Italy, Spain, and France as well as Italians abroad, with 500,000+ people supported across more than 10 million online sessions, plus a B2B mental-wellbeing offering (Unobravo Business) and an ECM training academy. Backed by Insight Partners and Northzone. Its backend API (api.unobravo.com) is private, with no public developer surface.

providers.name: US Foods
providers.description: US Foods is one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, serving restaurants, healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, government institutions, and educational facilities. As a Fortune 500 company, US Foods operates a national distribution network with over 70 distribution centers and serves approximately 250,000 customers. The company's digital platform includes the MOXe eCommerce application for ordering and business management, EDI integration for B2B transactions, and a supplier PIM system for product data synchronization. US Foods has undergone significant digital transformation building a data mesh architecture on Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and cloud platforms to support its eCommerce and supply chain operations.

providers.name: Viome
providers.description: Viome (Viome Life Sciences) is a health technology company founded in 2016 by Naveen Jain that uses metatranscriptomic RNA sequencing — a technique originally developed for biodefense at Los Alamos National Laboratory — combined with artificial intelligence to measure active gene expression across the gut microbiome, oral microbiome, and human cells. From at-home stool, saliva, and finger-prick blood samples the company produces over 50 health scores across eight categories (BioAge, Gut Health, Oral Health, Energy, Inflammaging, Mood/Memory/Focus, Immunity, and Heart and Metabolic Health), personalized food recommendations across more than 370 foods, and custom-blended precision supplements and biotics. Products include the Full Body Intelligence, Gut Intelligence, and Oral Health Intelligence tests plus the CancerDetect saliva screening test for oral and throat cancer. Viome operates in over 100 countries, publishes peer-reviewed research in NPJ Genomic Medicine, iScience, and Microbiome, and runs a Life Sciences research division. Viome publishes no public developer API or machine-readable API contract; its consumer app at my.viome.com is served by an undocumented private backend, and the only agent-facing artifact the company publishes is a curated llms.txt.

providers.name: voize
providers.description: voize is a German healthcare AI company (voize GmbH) building a voice-documentation platform for long-term care, skilled nursing, and disability-support facilities. Caregivers speak naturally on a smartphone during patient care and voize's on-device and cloud speech models convert the free speech into structured, categorized entries that sync bi-directionally in real time into the facility's electronic health record (EHR) system. The product reduces documentation burden for nursing staff, works offline, recognizes patient names and corrects grammar, and integrates directly with major EHRs used in skilled nursing. voize is backed by HV Capital and operates in Germany and the United States. It ships a mobile application rather than a public developer API, but exposes EHR integrations, a trust center, and a vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty program on its public surface.

providers.name: ZenMaid
providers.description: ZenMaid is scheduling and business-management software for maid and house cleaning services - booking, calendar/dispatch, automated SMS and email communication, GPS-verified clock-in/out on a cleaner mobile app, online payments and invoicing, payroll, and reporting. ZenMaid has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification of its own. Its only documented programmatic surface is a Zapier integration (triggers - New Customer Created, Appointment Booked, Appointment Cancelled, Appointment Updated, Contact Created/Updated, One-Time Service Created/Updated, Recurring Service Created/Updated/Cancelled, Invoice Created, Invoice Paid; actions - Create Appointment, Create Booking, Create Cleaner, Create Customer) built and maintained by ZenMaid against a private, undocumented backend API. No API keys, base URL, endpoint reference, payload schema, or SDK are published for third-party developers; the public GitHub organization (github.com/zenmaid) has no public repositories. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: Blackrock Neurotech
providers.description: Blackrock Neurotech is a Salt Lake City, Utah based neurotechnology company that designs and manufactures implantable brain-computer interface (BCI) systems and the research instrumentation around them. Its platform pairs Utah Array microelectrode arrays and the next-generation Neuralace interface with the NeuroPort, Cerebus and CerePlex Direct neural signal processors, the CereStim stimulation system, and the Central software suite for acquisition, visualization and offline spike sorting. The company reports more than 19 years of human clinical study, 1,000+ research institutions served and 2,000+ published studies using its hardware. Blackrock does not publish a public web API: its programmatic surface is a set of device and file-format libraries distributed as downloads and GitHub source (cbSDK C++ API, cbMEX MATLAB API, CereStim API, brPY/brpylib Python data loader, and the NPMK MATLAB toolkit). Enrichment probing on 2026-08-02 found no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP, agent card, llms.txt or /.well-known/ discovery surface on any Blackrock host.

providers.name: Blockskye
providers.description: Blockskye is an enterprise travel management and payments platform for large corporate travel programs, founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York. It combines a consumer-grade online booking tool sourced through direct supplier and NDC connectivity, BMAX direct settlement that wires a customer's ERP straight to travel suppliers so booked travel bypasses corporate cards and expense reports, B360 for capturing personal co-brand card loyalty on business trips while holding policy compliance, and real-time reporting across every booking channel, with transactions recorded to a tamper-resistant distributed ledger. Blockskye delivers an end-to-end corporate travel solution in partnership with KAYAK for Business. The platform is sold and operated as an enterprise service: the booking, servicing and settlement application runs at horizon.blockskye.com behind a customer login and the knowledge base sits behind a Freshworks OAuth login. Blockskye operates a live production API host at api.blockskye.com but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Branchtrack
providers.description: BranchTrack is a browser-based authoring platform for building interactive branching scenarios and conversation simulations used in corporate learning and development. Instructional designers and L&D teams create decision-tree simulations with no coding or design skills, then deploy them inside existing LMS platforms or embed them into courses authored in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Adobe Captivate, Gomo, and Lectora. Simulations export as SCORM and xAPI (Tin Can) packages and can be shared as responsive, mobile-native experiences with learner analytics and completion tracking. BranchTrack is a portfolio company of Seedcamp. The platform exposes no first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; third-party embedding is available via the Embedly oEmbed provider, and LMS delivery via SCORM/xAPI.

providers.name: Callab AI
providers.description: Callab AI, built by Clusterlabs, is a cloud-based voice AI platform that connects directly to legacy on-premises PBX/SBC telephony (Cisco UCM, Mitel, FreeSWITCH) via SIP trunk integration, routing calls to AI voice agents with no rip-and-replace migration. The platform automates up to 70% of inbound and outbound call volume across support, sales, and scheduling, with no-code agent building, live human supervision and takeover, semantic knowledge bases, post-call transcription and sentiment analysis, CRM data extraction, and batch outbound campaigns. Callab AI exposes a REST API at docs.callab.ai for programmatic control of agents and calls. A Y Combinator Spring 2026 company founded in 2024, it serves hospitality, logistics, retail, and property management across three continents.

providers.name: Certa
providers.description: Certa (operated by Opinr, Inc. d/b/a Certa) is an AI-native third-party risk management (TPRM) and compliance platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle — onboarding, due diligence, contract management, continuous compliance monitoring, and offboarding — in a single no-code system. Founded by Jag Lamba and headquartered in Saratoga, CA, Certa serves Fortune 500 companies (Honeywell, Uber, Mars, Box, Quantcast) across 120+ countries and 17 languages. The platform covers all risk domains — operational and resilience, infosec and cyber, compliance and legal, financial and credit, reputational, geopolitical, and ESG and ethical risk — via its Studio no-code process designer, Certa Connect (130+ native integrations), and embedded AI agents. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools. External integration is available through an enterprise external API surfaced from the platform; no public OpenAPI or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Cloudpost Networks
providers.description: CloudPost Networks is a Santa Clara, California device-security company founded in 2015 that rebranded as Ordr (ordr.net). It builds an AI-powered device intelligence and network-security platform that discovers, classifies, and secures connected devices across IT, IoT, OT, and IoMT environments, tying device identity to behavioral analytics so organizations can detect risk and automatically apply micro-segmentation and enforcement policies. Ordr serves 500+ healthcare, banking, and manufacturing organizations and integrates with vendors such as Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, and Fortinet. It maintains SOC 2 Type 2 compliance. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is published.

providers.name: Clutter
providers.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Confide *
providers.description: Confide is a confidential messaging application that lets people communicate digitally with the same level of privacy and security as the spoken word. Messages are end-to-end encrypted, ephemeral (they disappear after being read), and screenshot-protected so recipients cannot capture or forward them. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, and Windows across 200+ countries and 15 languages, with a free tier for individuals and small groups and a Confide Plus subscription that unlocks unlimited attachments, message retraction, incognito mode, nicknames, and themes. Confide is a consumer product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record backed by GV in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: connectFirst Credit Union
providers.description: connectFirst Credit Union is a member-owned, cooperative (Schedule-equivalent provincial credit union) financial institution headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, formed on May 3, 2021 by amalgamating four Alberta credit unions (First Calgary Financial, Chinook Financial, Mountain View Financial, and Legacy Financial). At its peak it held over CAD $6 billion in assets under administration and served more than 128,000 members across 41 branches in Central and Southern Alberta, offering retail, commercial, agricultural, and dealer-services banking. Members voted in November 2023 to merge with Servus Credit Union; the legal amalgamation closed May 1, 2024 as "Connect First and Servus Credit Union Ltd." (~CAD $29.3B assets, 600,000+ members), and the unified brand realigned to Servus Credit Union in January 2025 — the connectfirstcu.com domain now 301-redirects to servus.ca. Its open-finance posture is honest and typical of a Canadian credit union: no first-party public developer portal or downloadable OpenAPI, digital banking delivered via the Celero Xpress platform (powered by ebankIT) with core/banking-tech through the Central 1 / Celero cooperative ecosystem, and third-party consumer data access available only through aggregators (Plaid coverage confirmed). Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FCAC-overseen) is legislated but not yet operational, so no mandated open-banking API exists.

providers.name: Daffy
providers.description: Daffy (the Daffy Charitable Fund) is a modern donor-advised fund (DAF) platform that helps people be more generous, more often. Co-founded by Adam Nash, Daffy lets members set aside money for charity, invest it tax-free across ETFs, individual stocks, and 300+ crypto assets, and then recommend grants to any of 1.7M+ eligible US charities on their own timeline. It offers flat-rate membership pricing starting at $3/month, family funds for up to 24 members, advisor integration, and Daffy for Work employer giving. Daffy Charitable Fund is a tax-exempt public charity under IRC 501(c)(3). Backed by Ribbit Capital, it operates as a consumer fintech app with no public developer API surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Dreamforge
providers.description: DreamForge.ai is an AI-powered game creation platform for building, iterating on, and publishing 2D and stylized 3D games directly in the browser. Creators use AI to generate gameplay systems, game-ready art and textures, animation, and playable web builds, then share public play pages under dreamforge.ai/play. The platform pairs a creator-facing web studio (including an Asset Studio) with a consumer application distributed on Steam, iOS, and Android. Founded in 2025 and based in Miami, Florida, DreamForge is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). DreamForge supports stylized 3D world generation, textures, voxels, and billboarding workflows; native 3D model generation is not currently provided. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Equifax
providers.description: Equifax is a consumer credit reporting agency that collects and aggregates information on individuals' credit history, including borrowing and repayment habits. This information is used by lenders and creditors to assess creditworthiness and make decisions about extending credit. Equifax also offers identity theft protection, credit monitoring, and fraud detection services, plus analytics and consulting offerings to help businesses manage risk.

providers.name: Field Medical
providers.description: Field Medical, Inc. is a Carlsbad, California clinical-stage cardiac electrophysiology company founded in 2022 by Dr. Steven Mickelsen to build a second-generation pulsed field ablation (PFA) platform. Its FieldForce Ablation System pairs a focal catheter design with proprietary FieldBending energy and is positioned as the first PFA system purpose-built for ventricular arrhythmia ablation, with atrial fibrillation applications in development. The company holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and a place in the FDA TAP Pilot Program for its VT indication, has published first-in-human VCAS data in Circulation, and has raised roughly $75M across Series A and Series B. Field Medical is a medical device manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public REST/GraphQL API and no SDKs. Its only machine-readable public surface is the llms.txt and anonymous site MCP endpoint that its Wix-hosted corporate website serves.

providers.name: Figures
providers.description: Figures is a European compensation management and pay transparency platform that helps HR teams and managers make strategic salary decisions using real-time market data. It combines salary benchmarking across 3.5M+ datapoints, dynamic salary bands, collaborative compensation review workflows, and pay equity analysis, with modules built for the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Figures connects to 30+ HRIS and performance-review systems to enrich internal pay data, and is used by organizations including KPMG, EY, Qonto, and TotalEnergies. It is backed by Point Nine and Seedcamp. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; Figures does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Flowscope
providers.description: Flowscope is an AI-native process-automation firm (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) that deploys agents to observe how a business actually runs, map and redesign its workflows, then ship the automation into production on top of existing systems in days rather than months. It positions itself as the AI team for mid-market operating businesses that do not have one, selling services-as-software with outcome-aligned pricing rather than a self-serve developer API. Founded in 2025 in San Francisco by Samuel Mirpuri (ex-McKinsey QuantumBlack) and Javier Leguina (founding engineer, ModelML), Flowscope runs forward-deployed agents that shadow employees, baseline the process, redesign the work, and write back into legacy systems of record while a human core keeps judgment and accountability in the loop.

providers.name: Getbasis
providers.description: Basis (getbasis.ai) is an AI-powered accounting platform that builds autonomous agents purpose-built for accountants. Its agents execute accounting workflows end-to-end across tax, audit, advisory, and client accounting services (CAS), shifting accounting professionals from doing the work to reviewing it. The company emphasizes enterprise-grade security and compliance for accounting firms — SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001 certifications, AES-256 encryption, strict tenant isolation, and US-only hosting. Basis is backed by Khosla Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It is a product company with no public developer API, SDK, or API reference at this time.

providers.name: GoPillar
providers.description: GoPillar (operated by CoContest Italy Srl, Rome, Italy) is a crowdsourced architectural and interior design marketplace where homeowners, businesses, and small construction firms launch online design contests and receive dozens of proposals from a global community of 70,000+ registered architects and designers. Clients set a project timeline, brief the community, message participating designers, and select the winning concept, with follow-on one-to-one and offline executive-project services. GoPillar also runs GoPillar Academy, an e-learning platform offering professional BIM, 3D, and design courses plus custom corporate training for architecture and construction firms. GoPillar is a consumer/SMB web platform and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web identity and domain security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GoTenna
providers.description: goTenna is a mobile mesh networking company that builds off-grid, long-range communication hardware and software. Its consumer goTenna Mesh and professional goTenna Pro devices pair with smartphones over Bluetooth to relay text messages, GPS locations, and data across a decentralized VHF/UHF radio mesh with no cell towers, wifi, or satellite dependency. The Aspen Grove mesh protocol stack and the Radio SDK (RSDK) let third-party developers embed goTenna radio connectivity into Android, iOS, and Linux JVM applications for public safety, defense, and outdoor use. goTenna exposes no public REST/web API; developer integration is via the native RSDK, which requires an SDK app token obtained from goTenna.

providers.name: Grailed
providers.description: Grailed is a peer-to-peer online marketplace for buying, selling, and discovering luxury, designer, vintage, and streetwear fashion for both men and women. Founded in 2013 and owned by GOAT Group, the platform lets independent sellers list clothing, footwear, accessories, and jewelry while Grailed facilitates the transaction, offering digital listing verification by trained moderators, purchase protection on qualifying orders, secure third-party payment processing (card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Klarna), and a community trust and seller-rating system. Grailed does not publish a public developer API; it exposes a consumer web and mobile experience, an agent-facing /llms.txt, and a RFC 9116 security.txt with a bug bounty program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Gyft
providers.description: Gyft is a digital gift card platform and marketplace (a Fiserv / First Data company) for buying, sending, storing, and redeeming digital gift cards from more than 250 retail brands. Consumers use the Gyft web app and mobile apps to consolidate and manage gift cards, while businesses use the Gyft API and Gyft SDK to add digital gift cards to their own apps, websites, employee rewards, and incentive programs, and to place bulk corporate orders through Gyft Business. Developer and API access is provisioned to enrolled partners via the Gyft developer portal. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of 500 Global and GV, and enriched here from Gyft's public developer surface.

providers.name: hobbyDB
providers.description: hobbyDB is a database and marketplace for collectibles — a platform that lets anyone catalog, offer, buy, and sell just about any collectible (Funko Pops, action figures, trading cards, die-cast, and more) at any time, from anywhere, in auction-style or fixed-price formats. It pairs a community-curated reference database of collectible items and variants with personal collection-management tools (lists, condition and grading tracking, pre-orders, trades, and import/export) and a peer-to-peer marketplace for transactions between collectors. hobbyDB is a Techstars-backed company.

providers.name: JMock
providers.description: JMock is a library that supports test-driven development of Java code with mock objects. It provides an expressive API for defining expectations and mock behavior in unit tests, integrating with popular testing frameworks including JUnit. The most recent stable release is jMock 2.13.1.

providers.name: Joya Communications
providers.description: Joya Communications Inc. is the consumer software company behind Marco Polo, a video chat application for asynchronous, personal video messaging with the people who matter most. Marco Polo positions itself as a privacy-first alternative to social media, with no ads, no public feeds, and no social engagement metrics, and offers a Marco Polo Plus subscription with premium features. Joya Communications is venture-backed (Battery Ventures) and, as a consumer mobile app company, does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Kimpton AI
providers.description: Kimpton AI is an AI-native investment research platform for institutional portfolio managers at hedge funds, mutual funds, and sustainable equity funds. It ingests market data, SEC filings, 13F holdings, earnings, and a fund's own investment mandates and research documents, then generates daily trade proposals with citations grounded in the fund's actual holdings — keeping human managers in control of every final decision. The platform connects to custodians and OMS/portfolio systems (or accepts direct uploads) to sync positions and P&L, aggregates mandates and research in a document vault, and integrates market-data partners FactSet, Tiingo, Massive, and Plaid. It is a managed service for professional investors and does not currently expose a public developer API. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: Konfig
providers.description: Konfig was a developer-tools startup that generated SDKs, API documentation, interactive demos, and tutorials from OpenAPI Specifications and Postman Collections, delivered primarily through the konfig-cli command-line interface and GitHub Actions automation. The company was sunset in December 2024; founder Dylan Huang announced the closure in a "Closing My Startup" blog post on November 25, 2024. The flagship konfig generator repository's GitHub description now reads "SDK & API Docs Generator. Sunset as of December 2024." This index is retained as a historical record of the platform and the consolidation of the SDK-generation category around Stainless, Fern, and Speakeasy.

providers.name: Lalilo
providers.description: Lalilo is an adaptive reading and literacy web application for primary-school classrooms, founded in Paris in 2016 and acquired by Renaissance (Wisconsin Rapids, USA) in 2021. It delivers roughly 90,000 interactive phonics, fluency and comprehension exercises that adapt in real time to each student, uses speech recognition to assess oral reading aloud, and gives teachers a dashboard for tracking progress and running differentiated small-group instruction. It is used by around 40,000 teachers and 400,000 students a year in France across cycles 2 and 3, with explicit support for DYS, allophone, ULIS, SEGPA and IME learners. Lalilo publishes no public API, developer portal or API documentation: the product is consumed through the teacher and student web applications at app.lalilo.com, and integration or rostering questions are handled through Renaissance support rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Listings API
providers.description: REST API and agent-native platform for managing business listings, citations, reviews, Google Business Profile posts, and local analytics across major publisher directories (Google, Facebook, Bing, Yelp, TripAdvisor). A facade over Synup's federated GraphQL backend, with first-party Python and Node SDKs, a hosted MCP server, and llms.txt.

providers.name: Morado
providers.description: Morado is a Colombian fintech and B2B marketplace for the beauty and wellness industry across Latin America, founded in 2022 by Angela Maria Acosta (an early Rappi employee). It is the "everything store for beauty shops" — giving salons, spas, and independent beauty entrepreneurs (a workforce that is majority women) access to intelligent credit, working-capital lines, inventory supply, inventory management, last-mile logistics, and digital tools through a 100% digital process, even for businesses without a traditional financial history. Credit applications run over WhatsApp with 30/60/90-day revolving lines and 3-12 month term products, serving 32,000+ micro-business clients. Backed by QED Investors, Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global, H20 Capital, Latitud, and Village Global. Public surface is the moradocolombia.com marketing/credit site (built on Wix) — no first-party developer API, though the Wix site exposes a hosted MCP endpoint and an llms.txt.

providers.name: Mosaic
providers.description: Mosaic is a North American brand experience agency with global reach, and one of the pillar agencies of Acosta Group. It works across four service lines — experiential marketing, B2B corporate experiences and events, integrated commerce and shopper programs, and field sales and marketing — plus third-party labor, assisted selling, retail merchandising, sales training, retail execution and surge staffing for retail, B2B and CPG environments. With roots in Toronto and Dallas and offices in Jacksonville, Mosaic says it has spent more than 35 years building brand experiences designed to drive awareness, engagement, conversion and behaviour change. Mosaic publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Moviation, Inc.
providers.description: Moviation, Inc. is a Seoul-based advanced air mobility and premium travel company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. It operates Vonaer, an AI-powered luxury mobility platform that orchestrates on-demand travel across private aviation (jets and helicopters), luxury ground transportation (limousines), super yachts, and curated experiences, with planned expansion into electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) urban air mobility (UAM). Moviation currently runs air-taxi service with conventional helicopters and has partnered with hybrid-eVTOL developer Plana to build out an advanced air mobility (AAM) ecosystem in South Korea. The company reaches customers through the consumer Vonaer app and a concierge membership program; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: muffintech
providers.description: muffintech is a Berlin-based InsurTech building generative AI purpose-trained for the insurance industry. Its conversational assistant, muffinGPT, is pre-trained on 30,000+ insurance conversations and passed the German 34D broker certification exam, supporting insurers, brokers, and broker pools across sales enablement, lead generation and direct sales, and after-sales service (contract inquiries, claims reporting, cross-selling). The platform is modular and customizable, with a privacy-first architecture hosted on Microsoft Azure in Frankfurt, Germany, and is ISO 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant. muffintech raised EUR 3.5M in 2025 to scale its AI-driven insurance solutions. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; muffintech does not currently publish a public developer API surface (no docs, OpenAPI, or SDKs found as of this enrichment pass).

providers.name: Nannostomus
providers.description: Nannostomus provides a sex offender search API covering 771k+ offender records across all 50 U.S. states and 14 territories. It supports search by state and name, with monthly per-state record updates, deduplication, and 99.9% uptime backed by cloud infrastructure. A free tier covers up to 100 requests per month with tiered pay-as-you-go pricing beyond that.

providers.name: Nixpacks
providers.description: Nixpacks is an open-source build tool that converts application source code into OCI-compliant Docker images by combining language-specific providers, Nix packages, and Buildkit. Originally created by Railway as the build system powering the Railway platform, Nixpacks inspects a project's source, selects one or more providers (Node, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, Rust, PHP, Elixir, Deno, Crystal, .NET, Swift, Scala, Dart, Haskell, Gleam, Zig, Clojure, Lunatic, Cobol, Scheme, F#, Staticfile, and more), and produces a reproducible build plan composed of setup, install, build, and start phases. The plan declares Nix packages, apt packages, environment variables, commands, and cache directories, and can be customized via a `nixpacks.toml` file, CLI flags, or environment variables. Compared with Cloud Native Buildpacks, Nixpacks uses Nix as its package layer, ships as a single Rust CLI, and outputs a plain Dockerfile/OCI image without requiring a buildpack lifecycle. The project is MIT licensed and currently in maintenance mode; Railway recommends Railpack as the actively developed successor.

providers.name: Northwestern Mutual
providers.description: Northwestern Mutual is a Milwaukee-based Fortune 500 mutual insurance and financial services company founded in 1857, providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, annuities, investment products, brokerage and wealth management services to individuals, families and businesses through a nationwide network of financial advisors. The company operates a large internal API estate — domain and experience APIs behind an API gateway, with GraphQL used to harmonize them — but publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable contract; its public engineering presence is an open source GitHub organization and a Bugcrowd-managed responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Oferteo
providers.description: Oferteo (oferteo.pl) is a Polish online services marketplace that connects people and businesses seeking services (Zlecający) with local contractors and service providers (Wykonawcy). Clients post a request across hundreds of categories — construction and renovation, IT, legal, health, events, transport and more — and matched providers respond with competitive quotes. The platform layers on verified reviews, a buyer-protection program (Ochrona Zlecających), and native iOS/Android apps for both sides of the marketplace. Oferteo operates nationwide across Poland and reports tens of millions of submitted requests and offers, millions of registered clients, and hundreds of thousands of registered providers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; this profile currently carries verified identity, website link-properties, and infrastructure/security probes.

providers.name: Pango
providers.description: Pango is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-powered operating system for e-commerce post-purchase and logistics operations. The platform positions itself as an "agentic OS" — autonomous AI agents that handle back-office logistics tasks — and consolidates multi-carrier delivery management, checkout delivery options, branded order tracking, and returns processing into a single unified system. Pango advertises multi-carrier orchestration across 100+ shipping providers with AI-powered routing and rate optimization, self-service return portals with automated approvals, warehouse pick-and-pack automation, and AI agents that resolve exceptions and automate workflows. It integrates with major commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce, NetSuite) and 100+ carrier, WMS, marketing, and support partners. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass the company markets an "API-first architecture" but publishes no public developer documentation, API reference, OpenAPI spec, or SDK.

providers.name: Portman
providers.description: Portman is an open source CLI tool that auto-generates Postman collections with contract and variation tests from OpenAPI specifications, supporting OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1, fuzzing, request customization, pre-request scripts, and direct upload to Postman or execution via Newman in CI/CD pipelines.

providers.name: PremiaLab
providers.description: PremiaLab is a portfolio performance and risk analytics platform for institutional investors — asset owners, asset managers, and consultants who collectively manage roughly $20 trillion in assets. Its platform provides a quantitative strategy database of more than 7,000 single- and multi-asset systematic (QIS) strategies from 18 leading investment banks, position-based risk analytics (stress tests, sensitivities and VaR across asset classes), the proprietary Premialab Pure Factors model for decomposing market risk premia, independent price verification with daily index-level reconciliation, and standardized QIS Index futures offered in partnership with Eurex. PremiaLab exposes a client-facing REST API at api.premialab.com that is protected by an OAuth2 / OpenID Connect authorization server; API access is provisioned for institutional clients rather than through self-service developer signup. This profile was surfaced as a Balderton Capital portfolio company and enriched from PremiaLab's public web and authentication surface.

providers.name: Razer
providers.description: Razer is a global lifestyle brand for gamers that designs gaming hardware (Blade laptops, mice, keyboards, headsets and other peripherals), software (Synapse, Cortex) and services. For developers Razer operates the WYVRN immersive gaming platform, exposing the Razer Chroma RGB SDK and REST API for controlling 16.8-million-color lighting across devices, the Razer Sensa HD Haptics and THX Spatial Audio SDKs, Razer ID for user sign-in, and the Razer Gold / Razer Silver virtual-currency payment and rewards APIs for in-app monetization across 34,000+ integrated games and apps.

providers.name: RDF
providers.description: The Resource Description Framework (RDF) is a W3C standard for representing information about resources on the web. RDF is the foundation for linked data and the semantic web, providing a graph-based data model where statements are expressed as subject-predicate-object triples. It enables interoperability between systems by using IRIs to identify resources and relationships, supporting multiple serialization formats including RDF/XML, Turtle, N-Triples, N-Quads, TriG, and JSON-LD. RDF 1.1 is a W3C Recommendation (2014). RDF 1.2 is a Candidate Recommendation (2026) adding triple terms (RDF-star) and directional language-tagged strings.

providers.name: Regular Expressions
providers.description: A sequence of characters that define a search pattern, commonly used for string matching, validation, and text manipulation across programming languages and data processing pipelines. Regular expressions are supported natively in virtually every programming language and are foundational to text processing, log analysis, data validation, and search tooling.

providers.name: Ross Stores
providers.description: Ross Stores, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROST) is the largest off-price apparel and home fashion retailer in the United States, operating over 1,700 Ross Dress for Less and 320+ dd's DISCOUNTS stores across 43 states, the District of Columbia, and Guam. The company sources a broad assortment of in-season, name-brand merchandise at deep discounts (20-60% below department and specialty store prices) through opportunistic buying. Ross operates a highly efficient supply chain powered by AI-driven inventory management, distribution automation, and integrated supplier and partner technology platforms.

providers.name: RTSP
providers.description: Real-Time Streaming Protocol (RTSP) is an application-level network protocol designed for controlling streaming media servers. Defined by IETF RFC 2326 (RTSP 1.0) and RFC 7826 (RTSP 2.0), it acts as a network remote control for multimedia servers, enabling on-demand delivery of real-time audio and video data. RTSP controls sessions between endpoints but relies on RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) for actual media transport. It is widely used in IP cameras, DVR systems, media servers, and live streaming platforms.

providers.name: Shield AI
providers.description: Shield AI builds autonomous defense systems anchored by Hivemind, an AI-powered autonomy stack that pilots aircraft and robotic platforms without GPS or communications. Hardware products include the V-BAT vertical-takeoff ISR aircraft, the Nova quadcopter, and the announced X-BAT AI-piloted VTOL fighter. Hivemind itself is delivered as a layered platform: EdgeOS (real-time C++ autonomy middleware), Pilot (autonomy behavior catalog), Forge (autonomy factory for build, sim, and test), and Commander (C2 and fleet integration). In 2025 Shield AI introduced Hivemind Enterprise, a partner-facing SDK for building, evaluating, testing, and deploying mission autonomy on customer platforms. There is no public, self-service API; access to Hivemind SDKs and developer tooling is gated through partnership and is subject to U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR).

providers.name: SkyFoundry
providers.description: SkyFoundry, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Glen Allen, Virginia, develops SkySpark, an analytics and informatics platform that connects, stores, analyzes, and visualizes data from smart devices, automation and control systems, meters, and sensors to "find what matters" in large equipment and facility datasets. SkySpark automatically detects issues, patterns, deviations, faults, and cost-reduction opportunities across intelligent buildings, industrial, agriculture, energy, government, and healthcare facilities, and has been applied to over 15,000 buildings spanning more than a billion square feet. SkySpark is a native Project Haystack server: external applications integrate through the Haystack HTTP REST API (ops such as read, hisRead, hisWrite, pointWrite, watchSub/watchPoll, eval, commit, and nav) with Zinc, JSON, Trio, and CSV data formats, and authenticate using the Haystack SCRAM (SHA-256) handshake with bearer authTokens. The company sells through a network of 140+ OEM, systems-integrator, and value-added-distributor channel partners rather than a self-service public SaaS.

providers.name: SmartHop
providers.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

providers.name: Switchyards
providers.description: Switchyards is a membership-based neighborhood work club — a 24/7 network of coffee-shop-style workspaces built for focused solo work close to where members live. Each club pairs a bustling cafe with quiet library spaces for deep work, plus bookable phone booths and meeting rooms, free locally roasted coffee and organic tea, and fast internet. Membership runs about $100/month for unlimited access across all locations, and the company is expanding from its Atlanta roots into neighborhoods across the Southeast and beyond. Switchyards is backed by Bullpen Capital and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: The Mom Project
providers.description: The Mom Project is a talent marketplace that connects skilled professionals (with a focus on mothers and caregivers) to remote, hybrid, and onsite roles at family-friendly employers.
