providers.description: These examples use the search API to search the PLOS corpus of scientific articles. These examples are not intended to be a full explanation on the use of Solr. A full Solr query language explanation can be found here and a tutorial here. The construction of PLOS search queries deviates from the standard Solr query URL by using search instead of select when making request to the end point. The primary endpoint is http://api.plos.org/search and supports parameters such as q, fl, wt, start, and rows for querying the PLOS Solr index.

providers.name: PlotBox
providers.description: PlotBox is a deathcare management platform for cemeteries, crematories, and funeral homes. Founded in Northern Ireland, its cloud SaaS combines records management, interactive digital cemetery mapping, financial and trust-fund management, work orders, scheduling, and family-facing records portals to help deathcare providers run compliant, efficient operations. PlotBox serves over 2,000 facilities globally, is hosted on Microsoft Azure, and holds ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications. The company does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Precium
providers.description: Precium is a South African fintech that provides local payment infrastructure for global merchants expanding into Africa. Its enterprise-grade platform handles payment processing across cards, instant EFT, mobile wallets and debit orders, plus intelligent smart routing, network tokenization, automated reconciliation, cross-border settlement, and payment recovery through retries and mandates. Precium exposes a public API and a mandates API (per its status dashboard) and integrates via server-to-server, redirect, and orchestrator paths with webhook status updates, though it does not publish a public API reference or OpenAPI. Backed by Partech, QED Investors, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: RamAIn
providers.description: RamAIn builds AI agents that automate any UI task with natural language. A Y Combinator (W26) company backed by General Catalyst and Nexus Venture Partners, RamAIn operates web portals, desktop apps, and legacy systems the way a human does — reading screens and interacting with UI elements — then compiles those workflows into reusable, self-healing automations that can be published and managed as APIs. It targets high-friction, document-heavy back-office work across mortgage, finance, healthcare, and insurance.

providers.name: Roborock
providers.description: Roborock is a global consumer robotics company best known for its robot vacuum and mop cleaners, wet/dry wash-and-fill floor washers, and connected home-cleaning appliances controlled through the Roborock mobile app. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Beijing, the company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Roborock operates a private cloud that backs its consumer mobile app but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program. It does operate a public Trust Center documenting the security and privacy design of its IoT products, including TÜV Rheinland EN 303 645 and UL Diamond IoT Security certifications.

providers.name: Rondo Energy
providers.description: Rondo Energy is an Alameda, California industrial decarbonization company led by CEO John O'Donnell that builds the Rondo Heat Battery (RHB), a thermal energy storage system that converts intermittent wind and solar electricity into heat stored in thousands of tons of refractory brick at temperatures up to 1,500C and returns it as continuous steam, thermal oil, superheated air, or combined heat and power at rated outputs from 2MWth to over 100MWth. The RHB is sold as a drop-in replacement for a fossil-fuel boiler, via capital purchase, lease, or heat purchase agreement, into cement, food and beverage, chemicals, fuels and ethanol, textiles, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceuticals, and direct air capture. Rondo operates the world's largest industrial heat battery and has announced a 90GWh factory plan with Siam Cement Group, backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Catalyst, Energy Impact Partners, Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund, Rio Tinto, SABIC, Aramco Ventures, and the European Investment Bank. Rondo sells hardware and delivered heat, not software: it publishes no developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Roofr
providers.description: Roofr is an all-in-one roofing software and CRM built for roofing contractors, bundling aerial roof measurement reports, an instant online estimator, digital proposals with e-signature, integrated payments, material ordering, a job calendar, and pipeline/CRM tooling into one platform to help roofers win, run, and close jobs. Roofr does not publish a public developer API or self-serve documentation: the only API key it issues (under Settings and Integrations) exists to connect Roofr to Zapier, and any broader programmatic access is sales-gated behind a demo. Automation for external systems is delivered primarily through Zapier triggers (new Instant Estimator lead, proposal signed, proposal marked lost) rather than a documented REST API. Roofr is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital.

providers.name: Salt Security
providers.description: Salt Security provides an AI-powered API security platform that discovers all APIs, stops API attacks in real-time, and provides remediation insights. The platform delivers full lifecycle API security through API discovery, posture governance, and advanced threat protection using patented AI and ML technology. Salt Security announced an Agentic AI Security platform and MCP Discovery capabilities in 2026.

providers.name: SiFi
providers.description: SiFi (الحلول المبسطة المالية) is a Saudi Arabian fintech company offering a comprehensive corporate spend-management platform for businesses in the Kingdom. Licensed by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and serving more than 5,000 clients, SiFi provides physical and virtual corporate cards with spending controls, real-time expense tracking, employee reimbursements, accounting automation, local vendor payments and international transfers (coming soon), and a cashback rewards program, delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. SiFi is backed by QED Investors. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Silk Labs
providers.description: Silk Labs was an on-device artificial intelligence startup founded in 2015 by former Mozilla CTO Andreas Gal together with Chris Jones and Michael Vines, a team drawn from Mozilla's Firefox OS effort. The company's open-source Silk platform layered a Node.js runtime on Android so developers could build Internet of Things applications entirely in JavaScript, and it later shipped work on the "Sense" AI home camera focused on running real-time visual and audio recognition directly on the device. Silk Labs was backed by investors including 500 Global and was acquired by Apple in November 2018, after which it ceased independent operations; the silklabs.com domain is now parked on Apple nameservers. Its open-source Silk code, GitHub organization, and npm packages remain publicly available and are captured in this profile.

providers.name: Skan
providers.description: Skan AI is an enterprise process-intelligence and agentic-AI platform that observes how work actually happens across desktop, web, mainframe, legacy, VDI, and office applications without integrations, then distills those observations into a "context graph of work" that powers AI agents to execute complex business processes. The platform layers Observation, Distillation, Context (Agent Operating Procedures), Agents, and Control, and ships as Process Intelligence, Engineering Intelligence, and an AI Agent Builder. Skan serves financial services, insurance, healthcare, high tech, and energy/utilities with in-environment processing so customer data never leaves the enterprise perimeter. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from that portfolio. Skan is an enterprise SaaS product; it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — its documentation portal is gated and its architecture is described as cloud-native and API-first for in-product integration only.

providers.name: Solvely Ai
providers.description: Solvely is an all-in-one AI study platform for students from K-12 through graduate level, trusted by more than 10 million students across 5,000+ universities worldwide. It combines multi-model homework help with step-by-step solutions, an AI note taker that transcribes lectures into structured notes, a quiz maker, an essay writer, math and equation solvers (algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics), auto-generated flashcards and study guides, mock exams, an exam predictor, and cheat sheets. Solvely is available on the web, iOS, Android, and as a Chrome/Edge browser extension, with free and paid (Solvely Unlimited) tiers. It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Spear
providers.description: Spear is a developer platform focused on API development workflows, providing tools for API design, collaboration, and delivery. The platform enables teams to build, test, and ship APIs faster through a unified workspace experience.

providers.name: Spiffy
providers.description: Get Spiffy, Inc. (Spiffy) is a B2B SaaS and operations company that sells a mobile service operating system to franchise car dealerships. Its core product, Mobile 360, is an enterprise platform covering scheduling, dispatch, route optimization, technician management, digital vehicle inspections, DMS integration and customer communication, sold as a turnkey program alongside van upfits, connected devices (Easy Tread, Easy Flow, Smart Tumbler) and technician training. Spiffy also runs fleet and Amazon DSP service programs, and operates a customer booking portal and a fleet portal. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Apex, North Carolina, the company has raised more than $90M and reports over 4 million completed services, with OEM work including a Hyundai Motor America pilot. Spiffy publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; its Fleet portal API is an internal, credentialed surface with no published contract.

providers.name: Standardization
providers.description: Standardization is the process of implementing and developing technical standards based on the consensus of different parties, including firms, users, interest groups, standards organizations, and governments. The goal is to establish uniform engineering or technical criteria, methods, processes, and practices. Key standards bodies include ISO (International Organization for Standardization), IEEE, IETF, W3C, OASIS, and national bodies such as ANSI, BSI, and DIN. In the API space, standardization covers OpenAPI Specification (OAS), AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and emerging protocols including MCP. Proper standardization reduces legal and operational risk while supporting audit readiness, interoperability, and long-term maintainability.

providers.name: TNL Mediagene
providers.description: TNL Mediagene is a next-generation digital and technology media group serving millennial and Gen Z audiences across Asia. Formed from the 2023 merger of Taiwan's The News Lens and Japan's Mediagene, the group operates more than twenty media brands spanning news, business, technology, lifestyle, and sports — including The News Lens, INSIDE, Cool3c, Gizmodo Japan, Business Insider Japan, Lifehacker Japan, Roomie, and licensed titles such as Digiday Japan and Glossy Japan. Beyond publishing, the company runs advertising and marketing technology (the Ad2iction DSP), an AI-driven customer data and audience analytics platform, e-commerce properties, and market-research services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is listed on Nasdaq as TNMG. The group publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI, and no SDK. Its one public, machine-readable integration surface is the Ad2iction header-bidding adapter shipped inside Prebid.js — a first-party-maintained open-source module that posts bid requests to https://ads.ad2iction.com/html/prebid/, documented on the Prebid.org bidder registry rather than on a TNL Mediagene developer site.

providers.name: TravelJoy
providers.description: TravelJoy is software for travel advisors and agencies — a client CRM, itinerary and proposal builder, secure payment collection, forms and questionnaires, and automated client communication combined in one platform. Travel professionals use it to manage trips, capture and nurture leads, send branded proposals, gather traveler details, and collect payments. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass TravelJoy publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK program; this profile tracks its identity and public web properties for discovery.

providers.name: Universal Electronics
providers.description: Universal Electronics Inc. (UEI) is a global leader in universal control and sensing technologies for the smart home, known for its QuickSet software platform, UEI TIDE smart thermostats and sensors, the Nevo white-label control platform, and the One For All retail remote-control brand. QuickSet Cloud provides device discovery, interoperability, and entertainment control via a device knowledge graph spanning roughly one million devices across 12,000 brands, with web APIs and native SDKs (Linux, Android, RDK, Android TV) offered to OEM and service-provider partners through a gated developer portal at developer.quicksetcloud.com. Surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company; UEI publishes no public self-serve API.

providers.name: WalkMe
providers.description: WalkMe is a Digital Adoption Platform delivering in-app guidance, walkthroughs, and analytics that help users navigate and adopt enterprise applications.

providers.name: Womaness
providers.description: Womaness is a women-founded midlife wellness brand created to modernize aging for women and to help them navigate the phases their bodies move through around menopause. The direct-to-consumer company sells clean, estrogen-free, doctor-approved and clinically tested skincare, supplements, sexual-health and menopause-support products (including Let's Neck serum, Melt for You inserts and Daily V Soothe) through a Shopify-hosted online store and select retail partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API surface.

providers.name: Aisle Planner
providers.description: Aisle Planner is a cloud-based business management platform for wedding and event professionals - planners, venues, caterers, florists, and photographers - bundling lead management, proposals/contracts with e-signatures, invoicing and online payments, timelines, budgets, guest and vendor management, seating charts, event websites, and online RSVP into one system. Aisle Planner does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, and no OpenAPI definition. The only "API key" Aisle Planner issues is a private per-account key found in Business Settings that plugs into a single pre-built Zapier integration - triggers are new project, new lead, and payment received; actions are create wedding project, create event project, and create lead - it is not a general-purpose, self-serve REST API a third-party developer can register for and call directly.

providers.name: Avatr Technology
providers.description: AVATR Technology (Chongqing) Co., Ltd. (阿维塔科技) is a Chinese premium intelligent electric-vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Chongqing, founded in 2018 as a joint venture in which Changan Automobile and CATL are the two largest shareholders and Huawei supplies the smart-cockpit and advanced driver-assistance stack. Its vehicles — the AVATR 11 and 12, the volume 06 and 07 (battery-electric and range-extended), and the limited 011 and 012 — are built on the jointly developed CHN smart-EV platform, a six-layer architecture spanning the mechanical, energy, electronic/electrical architecture, vehicle operating system, vehicle function application and cloud big-data layers. AVATR produced 73,606 vehicles in 2024 and sells through mainland China plus overseas markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, Sri Lanka, the UAE and Qatar, with design and engineering offices in Shanghai and Munich. AVATR is a vehicle manufacturer, not a software vendor: www.avatr.com is a marketing and configurator site with no developer portal, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable specification. The only live agent surface anywhere on an AVATR hostname is platform-provided — the official Hong Kong site runs on Wix and exposes the Wix Site MCP endpoint plus a Wix-generated llms.txt over its public marketing content.

providers.name: Brevis
providers.description: Brevis is a highly efficient ZK coprocessor and zkVM that empowers smart contracts to read from the full historical on-chain data across all supported blockchains and run customizable computations in a completely trust-free way. Developers build application circuits with the Brevis SDK (available in Go and TypeScript), implementing a Data Access Module to specify the historical blockchain data needed, an App Circuit for the computation logic, and an App Contract to receive ZK-verified or coChain-verified results on-chain. Brevis also operates ProverNet, an open marketplace for zero-knowledge proofs, and Pico, an open-source high-performance zkVM. Backed by Polychain.

providers.name: coachhub
providers.description: CoachHub is a global digital coaching platform (headquartered in Berlin) that lets enterprises deliver scalable, measurable one-to-one coaching to their entire workforce through web and mobile apps. Its network spans 3,500+ certified business coaches across 90+ countries with sessions in 80+ languages, matched to learners via AI, and it ships an AI coaching companion (AIMY). CoachHub serves 1,000+ enterprise clients and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Sofina, HV Capital, Partech and Speedinvest. It offers an account-managed integration approach (SSO, automated provisioning and data sync) with HR/LMS systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle, Ceridian and Microsoft Teams, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs or GitHub repositories. The platform is ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 Type II, TISAX and PCI DSS Level 1 certified and GDPR/CCPA compliant.

providers.name: Collective Medical
providers.description: Collective Medical is a full-continuum, real-time care collaboration network for healthcare, connecting hospitals, health systems, post-acute providers, health plans, and payers so care teams can coordinate around complex, high-risk, and vulnerable patients across the entire patient journey. Founded in Utah and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Kleiner Perkins, the platform is known for its real-time event notifications, ADT-based care-coordination alerts, and shared clinical insights used by emergency departments and care-management teams. Collective Medical was acquired by PointClickCare in 2020 and is now fully integrated into PointClickCare; its former developer, login, support, and legal surfaces are served through PointClickCare properties (developer.pointclickcare.com and pointclickcare.com). This profile tracks the Collective Medical brand within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cometa
providers.description: Cometa (getcometa.com / cometaedu.com) is a Mexican education technology company that provides an operating system for private schools. More than 500 private schools in Mexico use Cometa to run and automate their operations across a set of integrated modules: Cobranzas (tuition collections with WhatsApp and email payment reminders and dashboards), Tienda en linea (an online store for uniforms, materials and services with vendor management), Admisiones y Reinscripciones (admissions and re-enrollment workflows), Comunicaciones (AI-assisted, multi-channel family communications with engagement analytics), Calificaciones (grade entry and SEP-compliant report cards and digital credentials), and Gestion Escolar (attendance, incident logging and administrative workflows). Cometa is a 500 Global portfolio company. It was surfaced as a stub in the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass Cometa publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation surface.

providers.name: Dave
providers.description: Dave is a U.S. consumer financial-technology company (Nasdaq: DAVE), founded in 2016 and headquartered in Los Angeles, that operates a mobile banking app serving roughly 14 million members. Its products include ExtraCash short-term cash advances of up to $500 (underwritten with its CashAI cash-flow model rather than credit scores), an FDIC-insured Dave Checking account with early direct deposit and Round-Up savings, and a Goals savings account. Banking services are provided through partner banks such as Coastal Community Bank. Dave is a consumer app and does not publish a first-party public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal: there is no developer.dave.com / docs.dave.com, and api.dave.com is the app's private, undocumented mobile backend. Programmatic access to Dave-held consumer data is aggregator-mediated — Dave both consumes Plaid (to let members link external accounts) and is reachable as a supported institution through open-finance aggregators. This profile captures its public identity, aggregator-only open-finance posture, commercial link surface, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ERGO NEXT Insurance
providers.description: ERGO NEXT Insurance (formerly NEXT Insurance) is a Palo Alto, California technology-first Property & Casualty insurer focused on the specific needs of U.S. small and medium-sized business owners. Founded in 2016, the company offers fully digital commercial coverage including General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Business Owner's Policy (BOP), Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Tools & Equipment, Employment Practices Liability, Product Liability, and Liquor Liability — serving more than 750,000 customers across 1,300+ professions. In March 2025 Munich Re signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of NEXT Insurance at a valuation of $2.6 billion; ERGO Group AG (Munich Re's primary insurance arm) closed the full acquisition on July 1, 2025 and on January 15, 2026 the company rebranded as ERGO NEXT Insurance, becoming Munich Re/ERGO's foothold in the U.S. SMB market. ERGO NEXT's partner-facing surface is NEXT Connect, an embedded insurance platform that lets payroll, point-of-sale, accounting, e-commerce, payments, banking, and fintech platforms quote and bind small-business coverage from within their own product through low-code components and API calls. NEXT Connect aggregates 15+ carriers (including ERGO NEXT itself, Travelers, Liberty Mutual, Chubb, CNA, The Hartford) and is documented in the wild through embedded-payroll partners such as Check, Gusto Embedded, Intuit QuickBooks, Square, LegalZoom, and Amazon Business Prime, but ERGO NEXT does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve SDKs — partner onboarding is gated through a partnerships team. The company also offers a pay-as-you-go Workers' Comp product that integrates with partner payroll runs so premium is calculated against actual per-cycle W-2 wages.

providers.name: Every
providers.description: Every is an AI-native, all-in-one back-office and finance platform built for startups, unifying incorporation, business banking and cards, treasury and cash management, global payroll, HR and benefits, AI-assisted bookkeeping, and startup tax preparation (including R&D tax credits) into a single system. It offers free Delaware C-corp formation, business checking with cashback debit cards, treasury-bill and money-market investing, and bundled per-stage plans for new founders through established startups. Backed by Redpoint Ventures. Every does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, commercial, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Extensity
providers.description: ExtensityAI is an AI research company building trustworthy, verifiable AI for enterprise environments through a neurosymbolic architecture that combines large language models with symbolic validation and knowledge-graph reasoning. Its flagship open-source framework, SymbolicAI, treats LLMs as programmable, differentiable primitives (Symbol objects) governed by Design-by-Contract validation, giving developers source-traceable, contract-enforced AI they can run on-premise with sovereign data control. The company also ships developer tooling including the ontoloom MCP server for building and exploring OWL 2 ontologies with AI agents. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Fivestars
providers.description: Fivestars was a customer loyalty, rewards, and payments platform for small and mid-sized brick-and-mortar merchants, founded in 2010 and headquartered in San Francisco. It combined an automated marketing engine, a customer loyalty and rewards program, and integrated card payments so local businesses could turn one-time shoppers into repeat customers. Fivestars was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, and Y Combinator. The company was acquired by SumUp in 2021 and its product has since been folded into SumUp Connect (SumUp Loyalty); fivestars.com now redirects to SumUp's loyalty program. Fivestars publishes no public API, no developer portal and no machine-readable contract — api.fivestars.com resolves but returns 404 on every spec and well-known path, and developers.fivestars.com does not resolve. Fivestars-branded surfaces that remain live include the marketing site, merchant dashboard, help center and a public status page, plus one first-party iOS library (TapiSDK) for legacy cPay terminal integrators. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical company record.

providers.name: Francis Medical
providers.description: Francis Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota, founded in 2018 by Michael Hoey and named for his father, who died of prostate cancer in 1991. It develops the Vanquish Water Vapor Ablation System, a transurethral outpatient platform that ablates targeted prostate tissue using the thermal energy stored in sterile water vapor delivered in short bursts through a catheter, with the aim of treating localized disease while avoiding the incontinence and sexual dysfunction associated with radical prostatectomy and radiation. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2023 and 510(k) clearance for prostate tissue ablation in December 2025, and it is running the VAPOR 1 and VAPOR 2 clinical studies alongside a long-term registry; it has signalled intent to extend the same water vapor platform to bladder and kidney cancer. Francis Medical has raised roughly $160 million to date, including an $80 million Series C in January 2025 co-led by Solas BioVentures and Arboretum Ventures, with earlier participation from Coloplast. It is led by president and CEO Mike Kujak. Francis Medical publishes a physician locator, an electronic instructions-for-use (eIFU) library and a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy for its devices and embedded software, but operates no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Harness Wealth
providers.description: Harness — the company that launched as Harness Wealth, and today a wholly owned business of Multiplier, Inc. — is a New York City firm that runs an advisory platform for tax and wealth practices. It operates three connected surfaces: a marketplace that matches individuals with complex financial situations (equity compensation, liquidity events, business owners, real estate, high net worth) to vetted tax advisors; a client portal and workflow platform that tax firms run their engagements, documents, questionnaires and e-file on; and Harness Wealth Advisers, LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser that recommends third-party advisers. Harness publishes no public developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, CLI or webhook documentation on any Harness host, and the product is delivered entirely as an end-user web application at app.harness.co.

providers.name: Icertis
providers.description: Icertis is an AI-native contract intelligence company that turns enterprise contracts into structured, actionable data and measurable business outcomes. Its Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform manages agreements across their full lifecycle — authoring, negotiation, execution, obligation management, and ongoing analytics — spanning sell-side, buy-side, and corporate contracts. The platform pairs a configurable contract data model with AI capabilities (the "Vera" AI assistant and agent-powered drafting, redlining, and negotiation) trained on millions of contracts. Icertis serves large enterprises across manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, technology, financial services, and the public sector, and integrates with ERP, CRM, CPQ, and procurement systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and Coupa. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Icertis' public web presence.

providers.name: InvestaX
providers.description: InvestaX is a Singapore-based, MAS-licensed tokenization platform for real-world assets (RWAs), operated by IC SG Pte. Ltd. under a Capital Markets Services license (CMS100635) and a Recognised Market Operator license from the Monetary Authority of Singapore. The platform provides end-to-end infrastructure for the issuance, distribution, secondary trading, and custody of security tokens and tokenized securities, plus a Tokenization SaaS product for institutional issuers and RWA investment products such as tokenized money market funds and private credit. It supports multiple blockchain protocols including Ethereum, Polygon, BASE, Algorand, Tezos, and Hedera. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: LabDoor
providers.description: Labdoor is an independent San Francisco-based supplement testing company that buys top-selling vitamins, supplements, protein powders and energy drinks off retail shelves and online stores and sends samples to FDA-registered analytical laboratories for chemical analysis of active ingredients and potential contaminants. It grades every product on Label Accuracy, Product Purity, Nutritional Value, Ingredient Safety and Projected Efficacy, then publishes the resulting rankings, scores and expert reports for free so consumers can compare products, and it funds that testing through retail sales and through Labdoor Enterprise certification and custom-testing services sold to manufacturers. Labdoor publishes no public developer API, SDKs, developer portal or API documentation as of July 2026.

providers.name: Mattilda
providers.description: Mattilda is a financial management platform for private educational institutions across Latin America, operating in Mexico, Colombia, and Ecuador. It automates tuition collection and payment processing, offers tuition advances that guarantee schools receive full monthly tuition on the first day regardless of family payment rates, and provides academic operations and admissions tools under its Algebraix product line. Families can pay through multiple channels, including WhatsApp. Mattilda operates under the oversight of Mexico's financial authorities CNBV and CONDUSEF and is backed by QED Investors. Mattilda does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation portal; this profile captures the company's public identity, status page, and Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Prescience Inc
providers.description: Prescience, Inc. is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) health benefits platform for employers, building "healthcare for the age of abundant intelligence." It uses machine-learning underwriting to design custom, largely self-insured health plans that aim to cut employer healthcare spend 20-50% versus traditional PEO and insurer plans, pairing $0-deductible coverage, included GLP-1 medications, wearables, and a 24/7 AI Care Companion for members. The company sells to employers, private-equity portfolios, and providers, and publicly attests to SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance. As of this profile it exposes a marketing and member/employer web application only - no public API, developer portal, SDKs, MCP server, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Revel Ai Health
providers.description: RevelAi Health is a healthcare technology company building a conversational AI platform for orthopedic and musculoskeletal care teams. Its AI agent, "kimi," automates patient outreach, triage, clinical documentation, and follow-up across the care episode, supporting value-based care models, quality reporting, and Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROM) collection. The platform offers multilingual population-health outreach across voice, text, and email, ambient clinical documentation, and AI-augmented staffing and task management for ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals and health systems, and physician practices. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and maintains SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance programs. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: Seed Health
providers.description: Seed Health is a microbiome science company founded in 2017 by Ara Katz and Raja Dhir, headquartered in Los Angeles County, California. It develops and sells clinically studied probiotic, prebiotic and synbiotic consumer products — most notably the DS-01 Daily Synbiotic, the PDS-08 Pediatric Daily Synbiotic and the VS-01 Vaginal Synbiotic — direct to consumers via a subscription commerce site at seed.com, alongside SeedLabs, its environmental and applied-microbiology research arm. Seed publishes a substantial public science, editorial (Cultured) and help-center surface, and maintains a small public GitHub organization, but it operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no published API reference, no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI or MCP contract, and its internal storefront API paths are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt. Its practitioner program is fulfilled through Fullscript and email rather than through any integration surface.

providers.name: VanMoof
providers.description: VanMoof is an Amsterdam-based e-bike company that designs and sells smart electric city bikes with integrated anti-theft technology, GPS tracking, and a companion rider app. Originally backed by Balderton Capital and relaunched after its 2023 restructuring, VanMoof operates a connected-bike platform, but publishes no public developer API — the app and bike APIs are private, and existing client libraries are community-built and reverse-engineered.

providers.name: Visby Medical
providers.description: Visby Medical is a molecular diagnostics company that has miniaturized the gold-standard PCR laboratory onto a single-use, palm-sized point-of-care device, delivering lab-quality results in about 30 minutes without any instrument, sample transport, or lab infrastructure. Its consumer offering (sold direct at visby.com) is an FDA-authorized at-home women's sexual health test that detects Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, and Trichomoniasis, paired with same-day telehealth consultation on a positive result. Visby also builds point-of-care PCR platforms for clinical and respiratory pathogen testing. The company is backed by venture investors including Amplify Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks Visby Medical as a company; the business is a hardware diagnostics and direct-to-consumer commerce operation and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Zeroqode
providers.description: Zeroqode is a leading no-code development platform and Bubble agency that provides app templates, plugins, courses, and automation tools for building scalable applications without coding. It offers 800+ plugins for Bubble.io, the Air Native mobile app conversion service, and Framer plugins. Zeroqode helps founders and developers build apps 10x faster using no-code and AI tooling.

providers.name: 410 Labs
providers.description: 410 Labs is a lean product studio based in Baltimore, Maryland, founded in 2010 by Dave Troy and Matthew Koll with the mission of helping people communicate and access information in new and better ways. The company is best known for Mailstrom, a web-based inbox management and email cleanup tool that groups messages by sender, subject, time, and size so users can act on thousands of related emails at once across Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Apple, AOL, Exchange, and any IMAP mail service. 410 Labs also built the Chuck iPhone app for fast on-the-go email triage, and earlier products Shortmail and Replyz. It is a consumer productivity software company that does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties for the API Evangelist network. 410 Labs was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Acretrader
providers.description: AcreTrader is a farmland investment platform headquartered in Fayetteville, Arkansas that lets accredited investors buy fractional, passive ownership stakes in individual US row-crop, permanent-crop and timberland farms. AcreTrader sources and vets each farm, then handles the legal entity, farm management and administration while investors earn returns from annual cash rent and long-term land appreciation. Securities are offered through North Capital Private Securities Corporation, a FINRA/SIPC member broker-dealer that is not an affiliate of the platform. Since 2018 AcreTrader has enabled investment in over 140 farmland properties spanning roughly 44,000 acres across 20 states, and its investment management arm, AcreTrader Management LLC, reports net IRR of 9.4% to 30.3% on realized deals. Proterra Investment Partners LP acquired AcreTrader in August 2025. AcreTrader publishes no public developer API, no developer portal and no machine-readable specification; contract discovery was run in full against acretrader.com and api.acretrader.com on 2026-08-10 and every discovery path returned 404.

providers.name: Carrot Fertility
providers.description: Carrot Fertility is a global fertility and family-building benefits platform for employers and health plans, providing members with comprehensive reproductive and family-forming support across more than 195 countries. Carrot covers fertility care and preservation (egg, sperm, and embryo freezing), IVF and other assisted reproduction, surrogacy, adoption, pregnancy and postpartum support, low- and no-cost fertility options, gender-affirming care, and menopause and midlife care. Delivered as a B2B employee benefit with member and provider portals, Carrot pairs concierge care navigation with a network of clinics and experts. The company is HIPAA-compliant and maintains SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, and HITRUST attestations. This API Evangelist profile tracks Carrot as a healthcare provider surfaced from the Uncork Capital portfolio; Carrot does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Chief Human Capital Officers Council
providers.description: The Chief Human Capital Officers (CHCO) Council is the principal interagency forum to advise and coordinate the activities of members on matters of modernization of human resources (HR) systems, improved quality of human resources information, and legislation affecting human resources operations and organizations across the U.S. federal government. Established under the Chief Human Capital Officers Act of 2002 (5 U.S.C. 1401-1402), the Council is chaired by the Director of the U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) with the Deputy Director for Management at OMB serving as Vice Chair. The CHCO Council coordinates federal human capital management strategy, supports the Federal HR workforce, advances workforce planning and talent acquisition, and oversees performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, and HR policy implementation across departments and agencies.

providers.name: Cortico
providers.description: Cortico (Cortico Health Technologies) is a Vancouver, British Columbia based healthcare connection platform, founded in 2019, that links patients, medical clinics, and health records across Canada and the United States. Its patient-engagement suite layers online booking, automated appointment reminders, secure two-way patient messaging, digital intake forms, telemedicine, specialist e-referrals, payments, and AI-driven administrative automation on top of the electronic medical records (EMRs) clinics already run — most notably a supported two-way integration with OSCAR EMR through that system's REST/SOAP web services, plus SMART on FHIR contextual launch and robotic process automation (RPA). Cortico is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and compliant with HIPAA, PIPEDA, and PHIPA. Cortico consumes EMR and FHIR interfaces rather than publishing its own public developer API: as of this review there is no public developer portal, API reference, or FHIR CapabilityStatement, and integration is delivered through a partnership and onboarding model rather than self-serve API access.

providers.name: Courier Health
providers.description: Courier Health is the patient experience platform for life sciences and biopharma. It gives pharmaceutical patient services, market access, and field reimbursement teams a single command center to manage the patient journey from prescription through long-term treatment adherence, using AI-generated patient summaries, workflow automation and orchestration, and integration of data across systems and partners. The company reports gains in patient starts, six-month persistency, and team productivity, and delivers the product as a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II SaaS platform. Courier Health is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: Cuponomia
providers.description: Cuponomia is a Brazilian coupons and cashback platform that helps consumers save money on online purchases from more than 2,000 partner retailers. A pioneer in popularizing free discount coupons in Brazil, the company expanded into cashback in 2019 and now operates a website, a browser extension, and mobile apps alongside a Prime membership tier. It is backed by 500 Global. Cuponomia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Digbi Health
providers.description: Digbi Health is a digital therapeutics company delivering a precision-biology virtual clinic for food-related and inflammatory illnesses — obesity, cardiometabolic disease, type 2 diabetes, digestive disorders (IBS, GERD), MSK chronic pain, PCOS, sleep and mental health. Its FoodRx program combines host-genetics and gut-microbiome testing with app-based coaching, precision nutrition, and pre/probiotic therapies, delivered to members through health plans and employers. Digbi Health is backed by Accel. The company operates a consumer-facing storefront and member app rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the public web, agent, and security surfaces observable at digbihealth.com.

providers.name: Duetto Research
providers.description: Duetto Research is a hospitality technology company whose cloud platform, marketed as Duetto, delivers a Revenue & Profit Operating System (RP-OS) for hotels, casinos, and resorts. The platform pairs real-time dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, group and block business management, and profitability benchmarking so revenue teams can optimize rates and total property profit across more than 20,000 properties in over 100 countries. Its marquee products include GameChanger (dynamic pricing and rate optimization), ScoreBoard (forecasting and reporting), BlockBuster (group business), Advance (AI-driven rate recommendations), GameTime (select-service revenue management), and HotStats (profitability benchmarking). Duetto connects with the property management systems, booking engines, and channel managers hotels already use through a large partner-integration ecosystem rather than a self-serve public developer API. Backed by Battery Ventures; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: EcoMap Technologies
providers.description: EcoMap Technologies is an ecosystem intelligence software company (Baltimore, MD) that helps economic development organizations, chambers of commerce, universities, arts agencies, bioscience associations, and state and local governments map, connect, and measure their entrepreneurial ecosystems. Its platform turns scattered regional resource directories, referrals, and stakeholder relationships into a measurable, reportable network. Products span EcoMap Discover (resource hub and navigation), the Ecosystem Relationship Manager, an AI-powered Ecosystem ChatBot, the Economic Intelligence Monitor for regional benchmarking, and a Nonprofit Intelligence Dashboard. EcoMap reports 250,000+ resources mapped across 100+ ecosystems nationwide.

providers.name: Edison Scientific
providers.description: Edison Scientific is an AI research company building Kosmos, an autonomous "AI Scientist" for R&D teams in drug discovery and biopharma. Kosmos reads scientific literature, analyzes experimental data, generates and tests hypotheses, and executes research workflows autonomously, collaborating with scientists through tools like Slack and Teams. The model-agnostic platform spans the drug development lifecycle from target identification through clinical development and filing, learning from proprietary organizational and scientific data. Edison Labs publishes open science research including the PaperQA line of multimodal deep research agents. The company is backed by Spark Capital and maintains an enterprise Trust Center with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: EquityZen
providers.description: EquityZen is a New York-based financial technology platform and marketplace for investing in shares of private, late-stage, venture-backed companies before they IPO. Founded in 2013, it connects accredited investors seeking access to pre-IPO equity with employees and early shareholders of private companies who are looking for liquidity, transacting through EquityZen-managed funds and secondary-market share sales. The platform handles the sourcing, legal, and administrative work of private-company share transfers. EquityZen publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GLORRI, INC.
providers.description: Glorri is a cloud-based applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruitment automation platform for talent acquisition teams. It spans the entire hiring process, from sourcing candidates across multiple channels and job boards, to automating recruiting workflows and candidate communication, AI-assisted applicant screening, and analytics on team performance and hiring efficiency, with GDPR-compliant data handling. Glorri markets plans (Pay as you go, Flex, Corporate, and Enterprise Plus) for companies of different sizes, with custom integrations and a branded career page available on higher tiers. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Glorri publishes a web application and marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: HomeToGo
providers.description: HomeToGo is the world's largest marketplace and search engine for vacation rentals, aggregating roughly 20 million offers from thousands of providers worldwide across cabins, condos, houses, and apartments. Its B2B segment, HomeToGo_PRO, powers the supply side of travel with SaaS and tech-enabled services for individual hosts, property managers, and agencies. Through its Doppelgänger program HomeToGo offers partners multiple integration surfaces — API, White Label, Travel Agency Hub, ad placement, and pop-under — to embed its vacation-rental inventory. HomeToGo is a publicly listed company (Frankfurt Stock Exchange) and a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It does not publish a public, self-serve API specification; API access is arranged through its partner and supply programs.

providers.name: Houm
providers.description: Houm (Houm Technologies SpA) is a Chilean proptech operating a digital real-estate brokerage and rental-management marketplace across Chile, Mexico and Colombia, with operations in Santiago, Viña del Mar, Concepcion, Bogota and Ciudad de Mexico. Founded in 2018 by Benjamin Labra and Nicolas Knockaert, the company lets owners list, rent and sell apartments and houses without a guarantor (sin aval), guarantees on-time rent payment to the owner even when the tenant does not pay, and runs a network of freelance field agents ("Houmers") who photograph, show and manage properties. Its ReV pricing algorithm (houm.com/cl/algoritmo-precio) values a property online, and it also runs an investor product and a broker exchange (Houm Aliados / Canje Corredores). Houm raised a $35M Series A in 2021 led by Goodwater Capital. As of this profile Houm publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; its production backend at api.houm.com answers 403 to every anonymous request and carries no published documentation.

providers.name: Ixlayer
providers.description: Ixlayer is a direct-to-patient healthcare technology company that helps biopharmaceutical companies transform the patient experience through an integrated, AI-enabled platform. Its unified platform spans virtual patient onboarding and intake, telehealth for primary and specialty care, at-home and in-center lab testing with mobile phlebotomy, prescription fulfillment (retail, specialty, and home delivery), benefits verification and claims, connected care with provider directories and scheduling, and the ixAI patient concierge for AI-powered support and care coordination. Ixlayer says it has powered more than 1,100 nationwide programs and enabled over 4 million patient care journeys, and states its services are SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. The company is backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Kita Bisa
providers.description: Kitabisa is Indonesia's largest donation-based crowdfunding and mutual-aid platform, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Jakarta. It lets individuals, nonprofits, and corporations raise and give funds transparently for medical causes, disaster relief, education, and community development, and operates a dedicated Islamic-philanthropy surface for zakat, wakaf, and qurban. The group has grown beyond crowdfunding into digital fundraising services for NGOs (ngo.kitabisa.com), a CSR and social-marketing practice for corporate partners (csr.kitabisa.com), a cooperative, and the SalingJaga mutual-protection and insurance product. Kitabisa publishes no public API or developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on any Kitabisa surface, and partner integrations are arranged through business channels. It does run a substantial first-party open source estate of 75 public Go, TypeScript, and GitHub Actions repositories, plus a public responsible-disclosure program backed by an RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: Lavante
providers.description: Lavante was a SaaS supplier information management (SIM) and profit-recovery company built on its patented Lavante Connect platform. Its products — Lavante SIM, Lavante Recovery and Vendor File Cleanse — cleansed vendor master files, verified addresses and TINs, ran OFAC screening, onboarded suppliers onto the Lavante Supplier Network, and drove dispute resolution and recovery audit across the procure-to-pay (P2P) ecosystem for Fortune 1000 clients in hospitality, retail, entertainment, manufacturing and medical. Lavante was acquired by PRGX Global and its standalone site was retired; www.lavante.com now 302-redirects to www.prgx.com, where the supplier-facing capability lives on as PRGX Supplier Connect. Lavante never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or API documentation — the Internet Archive holds no api/developer/docs/swagger paths for the domain.

providers.name: Lunabill
providers.description: LunaBill is an AI revenue cycle management (RCM) platform for hospitals, health systems, and RCM/BPO firms, built by LunaHealth Technologies, Inc. and backed by Y Combinator. A coordinated team of AI agents works the entire accounts receivable queue end to end — placing real calls to payers and waiting on hold, navigating IVR phone trees, checking payer portals (Availity, Waystar), working denials, filing appeals, and resubmitting claims — while running inside the EHR and clearinghouses a provider already uses (Epic, Cerner, GoRev, Waystar, Availity) and leaving a full audit trail on every claim. Pricing is performance based (1.5% of net collections recovered, nothing upfront). LunaBill is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type I (Type II in progress). It does not currently publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through EHR and clearinghouse connectors rather than a documented API surface.

providers.name: M2P Fintech
providers.description: M2P Fintech is Asia's largest API infrastructure company, powering banking, lending, and payment solutions for fintechs, banks, NBFCs, and enterprises. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Chennai, India, M2P operates across 30+ countries and processes 20+ billion transactions for 50+ million end customers. Its modular, cloud-native, API-first product suite lets businesses embed financial services — core banking (Turing CBS), card issuance (credit, debit, prepaid, forex), UPI, cross-border payments, loan origination and management (Finflux), merchant management, BNPL, microfinance, KYC (Syntizen), reconciliation (Recon360), fraud and AML monitoring, 3DS access control, and neobanking — with up to 5X faster go-to-market.

providers.name: Marley Spoon
providers.description: Marley Spoon is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and grocery company that delivers weekly recipe boxes with pre-portioned ingredients to households, operating the Marley Spoon and Dinnerly brands across markets in the United States, Australia, and Europe. It runs a consumer web and mobile storefront for menu selection, subscription management, and delivery; there is no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API program. The company's public GitHub organization hosts only a few internal Ruby infrastructure forks (no client SDKs or specs). Enrichment surfaced no API surface: no /.well-known discovery documents, no security.txt, and no llms.txt. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and remains a company stub with security/identity signals probed rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Martini
providers.description: Martini is a collaborative, AI-native filmmaking platform — "Figma for filmmaking" — that lets teams generate, direct, and edit AI video in real time and export to professional editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve) via XML. Filmmakers compose shots with virtual camera control, keep characters consistent across shots using reusable Subjects, and generate footage across leading models (Google Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0 Pro, OpenAI Sora 2, MiniMax Hailuo 02, ByteDance Seedance, Nano Banana Pro, Flux 2). Its developer surface is a hosted, OAuth-secured Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector at https://www.martini.film/mcp that lets AI assistants (Claude Desktop/Code, Gemini CLI, ChatGPT, Cursor) browse projects, organize canvases and subjects, upload references, and run approved generation inside a user's own account. Martini also publishes open Agent Skills on GitHub, including a Blender-to-Martini camera-faithful handoff. Built by C47 Inc.; Y Combinator Winter 2026.

providers.name: May
providers.description: May is a French digital-health company, operated by LN CARE SAS, whose mobile app supports future and new parents from fertility and pregnancy through the first years of a child's life. It pairs a medical messaging service staffed by French-qualified midwives, pediatric nurses and doctors — answering questions seven days a week from 8am to 10pm — with an expert-reviewed content library, roughly hour-long audio masterclasses, everyday tracking tools for sleep, feeding and weight, and Mya, an in-app AI medical assistant. Founded in Paris in 2020 by Cécilia Creuzet, Antoine Creuzet and Adrien Brunet, it reported more than 400,000 users and a team of around 80 health professionals, raised €7M in September 2024 to expand into Spain and the United Kingdom, and also sells a parental-support benefit to employers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Serena and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog and an Intercom help center, but no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: NEURA Robotics
providers.description: NEURA Robotics is a German deep-tech company building cognitive and humanoid robots for industry, business, and everyday life. It develops robots such as the 4NE-1 humanoid and the MAiRA, MiPA, LARA, and MAV cognitive cobots, powered by its proprietary AI system AURA. Its Neuraverse ecosystem is a connected platform and app marketplace that links robots, developers, and partners so AI models, applications, and hardware come together to make the robots smarter. NEURA Robotics is backed by HV Capital. As of this profile the company exposes no public, documented developer API: neuraverse.com is a gated single-page application portal, and no OpenAPI, developer documentation, or well-known discovery endpoints are published on its public surface.

providers.name: Nexamp
providers.description: Nexamp is a Boston-based clean energy company, founded in 2007 by two U.S. Army veterans, that develops, builds, owns and operates distributed solar generation and battery storage across the United States and is one of the country's largest fully integrated community solar providers. The company runs end-to-end: project development and acquisition, engineering and design, construction, asset operations, and subscriber management for residential and commercial community solar customers, alongside power purchase agreements, land leasing for solar farm hosts, energy storage, and standalone development and asset-management services. Customer-facing software is delivered through the community.nexamp.com subscriber portal and the portal.nexamp.com Decarbonization Platform. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment pass Nexamp publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract; the api.nexamp.com host that exists is gated behind Microsoft Entra ID and is not publicly documented.

providers.name: Ontruck
providers.description: Ontruck is a Spanish road-freight technology platform that connects shippers (cargadores) with a network of professional carriers (transportistas) for full-truckload and less-than-truckload pallet, package, and parcel transport across Spain, France, and wider Europe. Shippers get instant AI-driven pricing, automated carrier assignment, real-time traceability, and digital documentation through service tiers (Economy, Flex, Express); carriers get access to freight loads with dynamic pricing and 24/7 support. Ontruck also packages its stack as "Ontruck AI Tech" — an AI pricing engine, AI routing engine, a predictive incident system, and a forecast/capacity planner — offered as transport-management software. The company operates a marketing and customer web surface plus an in-product shipper/carrier application; it publishes no public developer/API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Open Mainframe Project
providers.description: The Open Mainframe Project is a Linux Foundation project encouraging the use of Linux-based operating systems and open source software on mainframe computers. Founded in 2015 with IBM, it hosts projects such as Zowe (modern interfaces for z/OS), Feilong (z/VM cloud connector), Galasa (testing), and a range of community programs that promote mainframe skills and open source on IBM Z and LinuxONE platforms.

providers.name: Panora
providers.description: Panora is an open-source unified API platform that allows developers to integrate with hundreds of third-party tools through a single API. It provides a unified interface for CRM, HR, accounting, and other integrations.

providers.name: Parallel Universe
providers.description: Parallel Universe Inc. (Parallel Studios) is the Toronto-based game studio behind Parallel, a free-to-play sci-fi trading card game, and the broader Parallel Universe franchise that includes Colony, an AI agent simulation game, and Sanctuary, a third-person extraction shooter. The studio anchors the Echelon Prime web3 gaming ecosystem, where players truly own their cards and in-game items as blockchain assets and the PRIME token powers governance and rewards. Backed by a16z (Andreessen Horowitz) and Paradigm, Parallel is a consumer game franchise distributed via the web, Epic Games, Steam, the Apple App Store, and Google Play. It publishes no public developer / REST API surface today; this profile captures the studio's public web, community, and legal properties as harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Periphery
providers.description: Periphery is a cybersecurity company providing embedded, device-level threat management for critical industrial and defence platforms. Its lightweight, architecture-agnostic agent secures, fingerprints, and continuously monitors devices, detecting unauthorized changes and hardening what is risky even in constrained, offline, or air-gapped environments. The platform spans three products: Insights (point-in-time security evaluation with agent-based pen-testing and SBOM risk analysis), Vantage (on-prem intelligence that establishes a known-good baseline, detects change, and restores devices), and Outpost (real-time on-device threat detection and prevention for air-gapped deployments). Periphery targets regulatory compliance across NDAA, EU CRA, NIS2, UN R155, UN R156, and IEC 62443. It is a Techstars portfolio company.

providers.name: Phononic
providers.description: Phononic is a Durham, North Carolina solid-state cooling company founded by CEO Tony Atti that replaces compressor-based refrigeration with semiconductor thermoelectric devices. Its products cool optical and fiber transceivers, co-packaged optics, GPU high-bandwidth memory, LiDAR sensors, medical and vaccine cold chain, grocery retail merchandising and HVAC. The current focus is AI data centers, where the Thermal Kit and Thermal Fabric combine thermoelectric cooling chips with embedded control firmware that the company markets as API-accessible and Redfish-compatible, delivering millisecond thermal response plus real-time telemetry and analytics. Phononic publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification; technical access runs through sales and customer support.

providers.name: Poshmark
providers.description: Poshmark is a social commerce marketplace where people in the US, Canada, Australia and India buy and sell new and secondhand fashion, accessories, home goods, beauty products, and electronics. Sellers list items from their closets, share and cross-promote listings across the community, host live selling shows, and ship using prepaid labels while Poshmark handles payments and buyer protection. Founded 2011, IPO 2021, acquired by Naver in 2023. Poshmark runs a consumer web and mobile marketplace backed by internal APIs but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Praxis AI (Vortexify)
providers.description: Praxis AI is a Y Combinator (Fall 2024) company that now operates as Vortexify (vortexify.ai). Vortexify is an AI-native platform that generates operational software directly from a company's data: teams connect data sources through 20+ prebuilt connectors (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, NetSuite, Oracle, S3, Azure Blob, Google Sheets/Drive, SharePoint and more), describe requirements in plain English, and AI agents plan, code, test and deploy backend logic plus custom frontends with no infrastructure to manage. The platform emphasizes building complete apps on operational data rather than just dashboards, with built-in scheduling, serverless compute execution, role-based access control, audit logs, sandboxed environments, token-based authentication, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Praxis AI was founded by Aditya Tewari (ex-Palantir) and Ransika Liyanage (ex-Tesla, GM, Deloitte), originally focused on manufacturing-specific AI agents for predicting and preventing machine failures. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator. Vortexify does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: RangeForce
providers.description: RangeForce is a cloud-based cyber range and hands-on cybersecurity training platform that helps organizations build, measure, and validate the defensive skills of their security teams. Through browser-based, real-tool exercises and simulated attack scenarios, RangeForce lets blue teams practice detection, incident response, and threat hunting in realistic environments and benchmark individual and team readiness. Founded in Estonia and backed by Techstars, the company serves enterprises, government agencies, and managed security service providers. RangeForce does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference.

providers.name: Refyne
providers.description: Refyne is an Indian financial wellness platform and the country's first earned wage access (EWA) provider, letting employees draw a portion of their already-earned salary before payday at 0% interest through their employer's payroll. Founded in 2020 and backed by QED Investors, Refyne serves 500+ organizations across 23 industries and more than 8 million employees, and operates additional products including RuPay credit cards, the MoneyGuru financial-literacy service, and an employee privilege/discount club. The company operates under RBI compliance and holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications. Refyne is primarily a B2B2C mobile and payroll-integrated platform and does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rocket Lab
providers.description: Rocket Lab Corporation (Nasdaq RKLB) is an end-to-end space company providing launch services, spacecraft, satellite components, and on-orbit services. Its Electron rocket is the world's most frequently launched orbital small launch vehicle; the medium-lift Neutron rocket is in development. Rocket Lab Space Systems supplies Photon spacecraft, reaction wheels, star trackers, solar arrays, propulsion, separation systems, and composite structures to civil, national security, and commercial customers. Rocket Lab does not currently offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Scrapy
providers.description: Scrapy is an open-source Python web crawling framework for extracting structured data from websites using spiders and built-in data pipelines.

providers.name: ShiftMed
providers.description: ShiftMed is a McLean, Virginia healthcare workforce technology company operating an on-demand clinician marketplace and AI-powered open shift management platform for hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities and post-acute providers. It matches credentialed W-2 CNAs, LPNs and RNs to open shifts, and markets an API that lets a facility tap that clinician network directly from its own scheduling stack. The API surface reaches customers through workforce-management partner integrations — UKG Pro Workforce Management (formerly UKG Dimensions), symplr Smart Square, QGenda, Smartlinx and Attendance on Demand — alongside file-based SFTP feeds. ShiftMed publishes no public developer portal, documentation, specification or SDK; API access is arranged through a workforce consultation.

providers.name: Skupos
providers.description: Skupos is a retail technology platform for the convenience store industry that connects independent c-store retailers, distributors, and consumer brands through a single data network. Its SaaS platform delivers scan-data automation, back-office and financial management, tobacco scan-data incentives, digital loyalty and funded promotions, and GasBuddy integration. Founded in 2016 and backed by Insight Partners, Skupos was acquired by PDI Technologies in 2023 and now operates as part of the PDI Essentials product suite. Skupos runs an authenticated production API at api.skupos.com but publishes no public API specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: SolveBio
providers.description: SolveBio is a platform for biomedical and genomic datasets that lets developers query, harmonize, and automate bioinformatics workflows over curated reference data through a REST API and first-party client libraries (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, and R). SolveBio has been rebranded to QuartzBio, a Precision for Medicine company: the solvebio.com website now redirects to quartz.bio, the legacy API is served as the QuartzBio EDP REST API on per-customer instance hosts, and the SolveBio SDKs are being deprecated in favor of the quartzbio packages (Python client end of maintenance 2026-03-31). Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and enriched from its public GitHub organization and package registries.

providers.name: Spot Runner
providers.description: Spot Runner is an AI-driven advertising technology company (backed by Battery Ventures) focused on contextual media planning for Connected TV (CTV) and online video. Its platform uses proprietary MicroModeling AI through tools such as ContextPlanner and ContextDeals to match advertiser creative to the most relevant, brand-suitable premium video ad opportunities across leading streaming networks, publishers, and TV OEMs, and to send Deal IDs directly to a buyer's DSP seat. Spot Runner also markets an "Agentic Agency" of multi-agent creative tooling for SMBs and DTC brands. The public surface is a marketing site plus an advertiser login portal; there is no published developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK. The site does expose a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access, advertised via its /llms.txt.

providers.name: TapAd
providers.description: Tapad is a digital identity and cross-device graph technology company, founded in 2010 and headquartered in New York City. Its flagship product, the Tapad Graph, is a probabilistic device graph that lets marketers, agencies, and platforms recognize a brand's customer or related household across the many devices they use, powering programmatic targeting, media measurement, attribution, and personalization. Tapad was acquired by the Norwegian telecom Telenor in 2016 and then by the credit-and-data company Experian in 2020, and by 2026 its product and company pages redirect into Experian's Consumer Sync marketing suite while docs.tapad.com redirects to Experian's client-only Marketing Knowledge Base. Tapad runs no public developer program — no portal, no OpenAPI, no pricing and no self-service signup — but it does still operate two live first-party HTTP endpoints, the Tapestry Web API and an event tracking beacon, both requiring a partner id that only Tapad can issue, and it published four open-source mobile SDKs that it has since archived as unmaintained. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Thruster
providers.description: Thruster was a yield-first decentralized exchange (DEX) built natively on the Blast Ethereum Layer 2, offering Uniswap-style v2 and v3 concentrated liquidity AMMs, a stableswap AMM, and a token launchpad. Backed by Pantera Capital, the protocol shut down on July 29, 2025 after completing THRUST holder redemptions; its thruster.finance website is offline, while the GitBook documentation and the ThrusterX GitHub organization (Solidity contracts and audit reports) remain the surviving public record. No REST/HTTP API was published; the developer surface was on-chain smart contracts on Blast.

providers.name: Tia Health
providers.description: Tia Health is a Canadian telehealth platform that connects patients with licensed Canadian providers - family doctors, nurse practitioners, specialists, and naturopaths - for on-demand virtual care by phone, video, and secure messaging. Its services span virtual walk-in and family-practice appointments, prescription renewals, sick notes, lab requisitions, and mental health therapy (via partner Focus Mental Wellness), with visits covered by provincial health plans in Ontario (OHIP), British Columbia (MSP), and Alberta (AHCIP) and paid options elsewhere. Tia Health is part of the WELL Health Technologies Corp. clinic network, one of the largest outpatient networks in Canada. As of this review Tia Health is a consumer-facing virtual-care product with no public developer portal, no documented REST/OpenAPI, and no exposed HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement or SMART-on-FHIR configuration; interoperability in the Canadian market is stewarded federally through Canada Health Infoway's pan-Canadian FHIR (CA Core / CA Baseline) specifications, which this platform does not publicly surface.

providers.name: TIFIN
providers.description: TIFIN is a Boulder, Colorado based fintech company founded in 2018 by Dr. Vinay Nair that builds AI-driven wealth technology for financial advisors, RIAs, broker-dealers, asset managers and insurance firms. Its platforms span TIFIN.AI (an agentic operating system consolidating the group's AI businesses for wealth and asset management workflows), TIFIN Wealth (investment proposal, risk-capacity and client-personalization tooling that integrates with Fidelity, BNY Pershing, Black Diamond, Salesforce, Wealthbox, Redtail, Orion and iRebal), TIFIN AMP/AG for asset-manager distribution intelligence, TIFIN Give for charitable giving accounts, TIFIN @Work for workplace financial wellness, and Magnifi, an AI investing assistant. TIFIN incubated 55ip (sold to J.P. Morgan) and Paralel, and announced a joint venture, TIFIN.AI, with J.P. Morgan Asset Management. The company states its AI capabilities are available as APIs that plug into existing wealthtech stacks, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract; access is gated behind a "Get access" request form.

providers.name: US Capitol Visitor Center
providers.description: The US Capitol Visitor Center (CVC) serves as the main entrance for visitors to the United States Capitol, providing resources and information to enhance the visitor experience. The Center offers guided tours of the Capitol building, allowing visitors to explore the historic rooms and learn about the legislative process. It also houses exhibits and educational materials that highlight the history and significance of the Capitol and its role in American democracy. The CVC operates under the Architect of the Capitol and offers free guided tours, specialty tours, virtual tours, and educational programs for students and visitors from around the world.

providers.name: US Central Command
providers.description: US Central Command (CENTCOM) is a unified combatant command of the United States Department of Defense responsible for overseeing American military operations across a region encompassing the Middle East, Central Asia, and parts of East Africa. Its primary mission is to ensure the security and stability of this strategic area by deterring and defeating threats from terrorist organizations, rogue states, and other adversaries. CENTCOM coordinates joint military operations and exercises, supports partner nation capacity building, and maintains operational readiness across its area of responsibility spanning 21 countries. Headquartered at MacDill Air Force Base in Tampa, Florida, CENTCOM does not currently offer a public developer API. Public information is accessible through its official media and press releases portal.

providers.name: Vested
providers.description: Vested Finance is an investment platform that enables Indian residents to build globally diversified portfolios by investing in US markets. It provides access to 10,000+ US stocks and 2,000+ ETFs, professionally managed portfolios (Vests), global mutual funds spanning 50+ countries, and private-market opportunities, alongside INR-to-USD remittance handling and US tax-reporting tools for Indian investors. Vested also operates a login-gated Partner API developer portal at developer.vestedfinance.com that exposes its brokerage and investing capabilities to partners. The company was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and is profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Walker & Co.
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands is a health and beauty products company founded in 2013 by Tristan Walker, best known for Bevel, an end-to-end shaving and grooming system designed for people of color, and for the Form hair-care line. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and others, the company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and now operates as a consumer brand whose direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify at getbevel.com.
