It unifies gate management, carrier risk assessment and driver ID, dispatch and spotter orchestration, yard visibility, load verification, carrier appointments, and end-to-end yard security from the gate to the dock, using computer vision and agentic AI. It serves third-party logistics, retail and grocery, consumer packaged goods, refrigerated warehousing, contract carriers, manufacturing facilities, and drop lots. Backed by 8vc. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and status surface.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, ranked No. 80 on the 2024 Fortune 500 list. Operating over 4,800 stores across nine countries and three continents under brands including T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Sierra, HomeSense (US), and Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls (Canada), TJX provides supplier and vendor integration through EDI and web-based portal platforms. Supplier connectivity is handled via Oracle iSupplier, SupplierOne, and the DiCentral ASN Vendor Portal, supporting purchase orders, advanced shipping notices, invoicing, and payment tracking.

providers.name: Trudenty
providers.description: Trudenty is a fraud and risk intelligence platform that operates The Trust Network — a distributed, privacy-preserving infrastructure delivering real-time consumer trust and fraud intelligence across the payments ecosystem. It combines behavioural, transactional and network-level signals with machine learning and behavioural science to distinguish trusted consumers from fraudsters and prevent first-party (friendly) fraud, producing an explainable Trust Score across the checkout, claims and dispute lifecycle. Trudenty serves PSPs, acquirers and processors, and merchants, processing data where it lives so that no data leaves a client's organisation. It is a Mastercard Start Path and Techstars-backed startup, ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited.

providers.name: Trust & Will
providers.description: Trust & Will is a digital estate planning platform, headquartered in San Diego, California and founded in 2017, that lets individuals and families create legally valid, state-specific estate planning documents entirely online. Members build will-based or trust-based estate plans and related documents such as guardianship designations, powers of attorney, and advance healthcare directives, and the company also offers probate support and nationwide notarization. Trust & Will distributes through direct-to-consumer subscriptions as well as B2B partnerships with financial advisors, wealth managers, and employers offering it as a benefit. The platform is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; this enrichment pass found no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, but did confirm a live security program and trust posture.

providers.name: Twisty
providers.description: Twisty, operated by Bright Live Inc. (dba Twisty) of Santa Monica, California, is an AI character creation platform that lets creators generate lifelike AI characters and produce personalized, expressive video messages as an alternative to generic talking-head videos. The product ships as a web app plus iOS and Android apps with a free tier and a paid monthly plan, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Twisty does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: UGI Corporation
providers.description: UGI Corporation is a Fortune 500 international energy distribution and services company headquartered in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. UGI distributes natural gas, liquid propane, and electricity primarily through four business segments: UGI Utilities (natural gas and electric distribution in Pennsylvania), AmeriGas Propane (largest US propane marketer), Midstream and Marketing, and UGI International (European energy distribution). No public developer API has been identified; the company primarily uses EDI and utility industry standards for B2B data exchange.

providers.name: UXD Protocol
providers.description: UXD Protocol is a decentralized stablecoin protocol built on Solana, operated by Soteria FZCO, whose UXD token is backed 100% by an Asset Liability Management Module that deploys collateral into delta-neutral positions, on-chain lending, and real-world assets. The protocol is governed by the UXP token, is documented on GitBook, publishes six third-party security audits and a self-run bug bounty, and ships an open-source Solana program with a TypeScript client on npm and a Rust CPI client on crates.io. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: VentureBeat
providers.description: VentureBeat is a leading technology news and media company covering artificial intelligence, enterprise technology, gaming, and the business of innovation. Founded in 2006 and based in San Francisco, VentureBeat does not offer a public developer REST API but provides content access via RSS feeds and content licensing. Its editorial coverage spans AI, machine learning, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and digital transformation for business leaders and technologists.

providers.name: Visibly
providers.description: Visibly is a UK-based workforce compliance management platform that helps enterprises with large, distributed and subcontracted workforces automate their HSEQ (health, safety, environment and quality) obligations. It centralizes worker onboarding, competency and certification tracking, real-time compliance monitoring and alerts, audit and project reporting, and safety broadcast communications, with integrations into existing HR, ERP, LMS and SharePoint systems and mobile-first workflows for field workers. It is used across construction, manufacturing, FMCG, energy, public services, infrastructure and logistics by organizations including Network Rail, National Grid, EDF, Scottish Power, NHS and Danone. Backed by Creandum and Seedcamp.

providers.name: Web3Auth
providers.description: Web3Auth (now MetaMask Embedded Wallets) is a non-custodial threshold-key wallet and authentication platform. It provides client SDKs (Web, React, Vue, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Unreal, Node.js) and a backend Auth Network for OAuth-anchored MPC key shares. Public HTTP surface is limited and SDK-first.

providers.name: Wexler
providers.description: Wexler AI operates a Fact Intelligence Platform built for legal disputes and investigations. Its AI system, including an assistant named Kim, extracts, structures, and verifies facts across large document sets with source attribution, surfaces inconsistencies and contradictions in evidence, builds chronological case timelines, and produces confidence-scored, testable facts grounded in source materials. It is used by enterprise and AmLaw100 law firms for early case assessment. Wexler currently exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Wisq
providers.description: Wisq is an AI platform for human resources that automates HR service management, HR operations, and employee relations. Its conversational AI HR agent, Harper, answers employee requests across chat, email, Slack, Teams, SMS, and mobile, while its proprietary HR Language Model (HRLM) provides HR-specific reasoning, aiming to resolve the majority of routine HR cases without a human in the loop. Founded by Jim Barnett and Chih-Po Wen (formerly of Glint), Wisq is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Shasta Ventures, and True Ventures. Wisq operates a private, login-gated product and publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Zensurance
providers.description: Zensurance is a Toronto-based digital commercial insurance brokerage founded in 2016 that sells small-business and freelancer coverage online across every Canadian province, placing risk with Canadian carriers rather than underwriting it. Its book is commercial property and casualty — general and commercial general liability, professional liability and errors and omissions, cyber liability, directors and officers, commercial property, commercial auto, builder's risk, and a long tail of trade- and profession-specific packages — sold through a quote-to-bind web flow marketed as an instant online price with licensed broker support and claims advocacy behind it. It sits in the thin digital-broker layer beneath Canada's Big-Few carrier oligopoly, in a market with no open-insurance mandate — OSFI supervises federally-regulated insurers prudentially while FSRA, the AMF, and the other provincial regulators own market conduct, and Consumer-Driven Banking excludes insurance outright. Its API posture reflects that. Zensurance publishes no public, self-serve developer portal, no reference documentation, and no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI definition. The company's partnership page advertises "seamless API integrations and co-branded white-label tools" for distribution partners, but the only route to that surface is a partnership application form — the integration is partner-gated and privately negotiated. A first-party host at api.zensurance.com answers on the public internet (HTTP 200, returning a bare version string, with a /health endpoint) but it is the undocumented backend for Zensurance's own quoting and policy application, not a published product API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS, or agency-management-system integration claim appears anywhere on the company's public web properties. The one machine-addressable surface the company does publish for automated consumers is an llms.txt at www.zensurance.com/llms.txt — a 178KB marketing index of its pages, blog posts, and FAQs (which inadvertently lists its zenstage.wpengine.com staging host rather than the production domain). It describes insurance products for AI assistants; it documents no API.

providers.name: Zomma
providers.description: Zomma (Zomma Labs) is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building AI agents that automate repetitive back-office operations for investment firms — hedge funds, asset managers, and fintech companies. Rather than integrating through traditional APIs, its computer-use agents perceive and operate existing portals, desktop applications, and PDFs the way a human would (clicking, reading, typing) to handle reconciliation, client onboarding, KYC, and investor reporting, with human approval required before any submission. Zomma also markets a developer-facing computer-use API ("plug Hermes, Claude, or your own agent into our API") that is currently waitlist / pre-general availability with no public specification, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: Abra
providers.description: Abra is a digital asset wealth and treasury management platform founded in 2014 that provides institutional-grade services for high-net-worth individuals, institutions, corporations, and family offices across all 50 US states. Its products include Vault (segregated-account custody built on Fireblocks MPC wallet technology), proprietary Yield strategies on BTC, ETH, SOL and stablecoins, crypto-backed loans up to 50% LTV, and institutional treasury management, OTC execution, staking, and advisory. The company reports $10B+ in transaction volume and $2.5B+ in loans processed, and is backed by Pantera Capital. Abra does not currently publish a public developer API, API documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its public identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Adalah for IT Systems LLC
providers.description: Adalah for IT Systems LLC operates Qanoniah, a Saudi Arabian legal technology platform that enables companies to access, understand, and act on the latest and most accurate legal information and procedures in seconds. The AI-driven service targets legal and compliance teams across Saudi Arabia. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer surface has been discovered to date.

providers.name: Ambi Robotics
providers.description: Ambi Robotics is a Berkeley, California AI robotics company building parcel-sortation and induction robots for ecommerce, postal, and logistics workflows. Founded in 2018 as Ambidextrous Laboratories — a spin-out of UC Berkeley's Dex-Net Project led by Ken Goldberg — by Jeff Mahler (CTO), Stephen McKinley, David Gealy, and Matt Matl, with Jim Liefer (ex-Walmart, ex-UPS) as CEO. Its flagship products are AmbiSort A-Series (sort-to-sack small parcel sorting), AmbiSort B-Series (sort-to-gaylord parcel induction for middle-mile and reverse logistics), AmbiStack (mixed-case stacking for inbound and outbound), and AmbiVision (3D dimensioning, OCR, defect detection, and visual quality inspection). All robots run AmbiOS, the company's cloud-native "operating system for physical intelligence," comprising the AI Skill Suite (Sort, Stack, Kit, Pack, Induct apps), the PRIME-1 foundation model trained on millions of real-world operations, AmbiVision perception, AmbiAccess fleet management dashboard with heat maps and remote support, and a Sim2Real training pipeline that compresses model training by up to 10,000x. Ambi Robotics' primary commercial deployment is a $23 million expansion with Pitney Bowes, with AmbiSort A-Series and B-Series systems deployed across Pitney Bowes ecommerce hubs in the US (including the Stockton, CA hub that nearly doubled local-direct-delivery throughput in the 2021 peak holiday season, and middle-mile B-Series systems that sorted more than 3 million parcels within four months of deployment). Ambi Robotics does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for AmbiOS, AmbiSort, AmbiStack, or PRIME-1; integration with customer WMS/WES systems is performed by Ambi's solutions team. The company's public GitHub org primarily contains forks of infrastructure tooling (Ray, trimesh, FCL, EIPScanner, tinygltf, rapier, jszmq, CVXPYgen, mongoose-delete) and internal CI/CD workflow utilities — no published API spec, SDK package, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Arta
providers.description: Arta Finance (Arta Finance Wealth Management LLC) is a global digital wealth management platform that gives accredited investors and professionals from leading technology companies access to sophisticated investment strategies historically reserved for the ultra-wealthy and institutions. Its products include a High-Yield Cash Reserve (an automated U.S. Treasuries portfolio), curated private-market funds spanning private equity, private credit, real estate, venture capital and hedge funds, bespoke structured investments, private placement life insurance, and AI-assisted portfolio tools (AI for Wealth). Founded by former Google executives and backed by Ribbit Capital and other venture investors, Arta is an SEC-registered investment adviser (with a Singapore entity regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore), with clearing and custody provided by Pershing LLC. Arta operates as a consumer/member wealth application and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Atoms
providers.description: Atoms is a direct-to-consumer footwear brand founded in 2019 by Waqas Ali and Sidra Qasim and headquartered in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, New York. The company designs, develops, and sells minimalist everyday sneakers - notably its Model 000 and Model 001 lines - and differentiates itself with quarter-size sizing and the ability to buy a pair in two different sizes for each foot. Product features include lightweight foam cushioning, a copper-infused antimicrobial lining, stretch slip-on laces, and an 8mm heel-to-toe drop. Atoms sells online via a Shopify storefront and is backed by Initialized Capital, Kleiner Perkins, DST Global, and Serena Ventures. It has no public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: AWST
providers.description: AWST is the software company behind WorkRamen, a productivity and business-operations platform aimed at small and medium businesses, startups, agencies, and freelancers. WorkRamen brings meeting scheduling (with Google Calendar and Outlook sync, plus Google Meet and Zoom), trackable document sharing, secure e-signatures, routing forms, visitor management, and Stripe-based payment acceptance into a single workspace. AWST is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a SaaS product only — its brand domain awst.io redirects to workramen.com, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or API documentation surface could be found.

providers.name: Backbone
providers.description: Backbone is a mobile gaming company that makes the Backbone One controller — a snap-on gamepad for iPhone and Android — and the Backbone app, a mobile gaming platform that unifies a player's game library across cloud gaming, console Remote Play, and streaming services with game discovery, capture, and social features. The company sells hardware and accessories through a Shopify-hosted storefront (backbone.com) that exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint and Shopify Customer Account OIDC. Backbone is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. This profile was enriched from Backbone's public web surface; the company publishes no first-party developer API.

providers.name: Beewise
providers.description: Beewise is an agricultural technology company building the BeeHome, an AI- and robotics-enabled beehive that autonomously monitors, cares for, and protects honeybee colonies to reduce colony loss and deliver reliable pollination. Founded to address bee colony collapse, Beewise combines computer vision, robotics, and cloud software to detect pests and disease, regulate hive climate, and dispatch precision pollination for growers. The company serves growers with guaranteed pollination services, beekeepers with technology-enhanced hive management, and property owners through its Bees for Buildings program. Beewise is a venture-backed company (Insight Partners portfolio) surfaced into the API Evangelist network; it operates a customer grower portal but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Belong Home
providers.description: Belong is a residential property management platform and rental marketplace that helps homeowners rent out their homes and helps residents find and live in professionally managed homes. Marketed as "Property Management Made Loveable," Belong pairs AI-driven pricing and operations with a human care team to deliver guaranteed rent, resident screening and placement, listing distribution across 26+ sites (Zillow, Apartments.com, and more), 24/7 maintenance via a network of Pros, rent collection, and financial tools for both homeowners and renters. The company operates across a growing set of US markets including the SF Bay Area, Seattle, Arizona, Florida, and the East Coast, and is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Belong is a consumer and homeowner-facing product; no public developer API, SDK, or machine documentation surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: BetterView Marketplace
providers.description: Betterview is a market-leading Property Intelligence platform that delivers actionable insights to property & casualty insurance underwriters, agents, and insureds to increase efficiency and profitability. Its API lets carriers order and retrieve property profiles enriched with the Roof Spotlight Index (RSI), peril risks, flags, and third-party Partner Connect data, subscribe properties to PropertyPulse monitoring, and query PropertyNow pre-processed datasets by address or coordinates. Betterview integrates with core insurance systems including Guidewire (a Marketplace accelerator for PolicyCenter 10), Duck Creek, and Socotra, and supports SSO, Secure FTP, ImageRight drop, an embeddable geospatial iframe UI, and an External Data Warehouse (EDW) SQL connection.

providers.name: Beyond Limits
providers.description: Beyond Limits (trading as BeyondAI) is an enterprise and industrial artificial intelligence company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Glendale, California, built on cognitive and neuro-symbolic AI technology licensed from Caltech and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Its Hybrid AI Platform combines machine learning, generative AI and rule-based symbolic reasoning so that industrial operators get explainable, auditable recommendations instead of black-box predictions. Products include the Hybrid AI Platform (with Data, ML Ops/PRE, KB Ops and a low-code API available under a development license), Operations Advisor, Beyond Search generative AI, AI in a Box on-premises infrastructure, and DocLink document process automation from its Altec subsidiary. The company sells into energy and LNG, oil and gas, refining, petrochemicals, utilities, mining, manufacturing, aerospace and critical infrastructure. Beyond Limits publishes no public developer portal, API reference or self-service sign-up; platform API access is granted to licensed customers, so there is no publicly discoverable machine-readable contract for this provider.

providers.name: Billables Ai
providers.description: Billables AI is a San Francisco based legal technology company that builds AI-powered automatic time tracking software for lawyers, consultants, and professional services firms. Its platform passively captures billable activity as people work across the tools they already use — Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, Zoom, Adobe, and the Chrome and Edge browsers — then uses AI to draft time entries, assign the correct client and matter, and write narrative descriptions, learning and adapting to each user over time. Privacy is user-controlled, with only the individual able to view or edit their own time records before they are submitted. The company is venture-backed (Series A) and was surfaced through the Wing Venture Capital portfolio.

providers.name: Block Renovation
providers.description: Block Renovation is a home renovation and construction platform that connects homeowners with vetted, local contractors and provides free design, cost-estimation, and project-planning tools for kitchen and bathroom remodels, home additions, basement renovations, ADUs, new construction, and commercial projects. It operates across all 50 US states and layers on a protection program covering price assurance, progress-based payments, a workmanship warranty, and dedicated Project Planner support. Backed by Obvious Ventures and the SoftBank Vision Fund, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass Block Renovation publishes a consumer-facing marketplace but no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Boards
providers.description: Boards is a mobile-first collaboration and duplication platform for network marketing and direct sales teams. It lets leaders turn what works for them into a simple, repeatable system that new team members can follow, sharing content, training, and workflows so a business can scale beyond its founder. The product centers on team alignment, faster onboarding of new members, and giving distributors a single place with everything they need to succeed, alongside a Success Academy for training and a brand and referral program. Boards is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; its surface is a consumer web and mobile app.

providers.name: Bosch
providers.description: Bosch is a German multinational engineering and technology company producing automotive components, industrial technology, consumer goods, and energy and building technology. Bosch operates the Bosch IoT Suite, an open IoT platform offering device management, software rollouts, edge services, and IoT data analytics, along with open source contributions to Eclipse Foundation IoT projects.

providers.name: BoxGreen
providers.description: BoxGreen (BoxGreen Pte. Ltd., incorporated 2014 in Singapore) is a Certified B Corporation and social enterprise selling all-natural, individually packaged healthy snacks direct to consumers and to businesses. Its consumer offering is a Shopify-based e-commerce store with build-your-own snack boxes, curated collections (nut mixes, crunchies, vegan and gluten-free ranges), gift and party packs, and a subscription delivery model; its B2B side covers corporate gifting, office pantry supply, and cashless healthy-snack vending machines. Every BoxGreen snack is packed in prison by beneficiaries of Singapore's Yellow Ribbon Project to build skills and employability. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company, BoxGreen publishes no first-party API or developer program; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is Shopify's New Customer Accounts OIDC/OAuth discovery.

providers.name: BridgeU
providers.description: BridgeU is an education technology company providing a university and careers guidance platform for international schools. Used by more than 1,200 partner schools across 150+ countries, the platform helps students from Grade 9 onward explore careers, research over 26,000 global universities, build shortlists, and manage applications in one connected system, with analytics dashboards for counsellors and AI-assisted guidance. BridgeU is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass; integration with school systems (for example ManageBac+) is handled via partner single sign-on rather than an openly documented API.

providers.name: Brightside
providers.description: Brightside (Brightside Benefit, Inc.) is an employer-sponsored financial care benefit that helps working families reduce everyday money stress. Delivered as an employee benefit through employers, Brightside pairs each employee with a human Financial Assistant and a mobile/web app offering emergency cash and loans, debt management and credit-score improvement, savings and early wage access, bill negotiation, crisis support (eviction, utilities, food), and guidance through major life events. The company is backed by a16z, Obvious Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Brightside is a consumer-facing benefits platform and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: buynomics
providers.description: Buynomics is a Cologne, Germany-based software company providing an AI-powered Revenue Growth Management (RGM) platform for consumer goods, retail, telecom, and consumer software companies. Its proprietary "Virtual Shoppers AI" runs agent-based simulations of consumer purchasing behavior so commercial teams can optimize pricing, promotions, price pack architecture (product mix), and trade terms before going to market — capturing cross- effects, cannibalization, and competitive response. The platform's Decision Guide generates prescriptive recommendations from thousands of evaluated scenarios. Buynomics is used by brands including Unilever, Nestle, L'Oreal, Danone, General Mills, Vodafone, and Ferrero, and is backed by Insight Partners and Seedcamp. The product is delivered as a web application; no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: CareLuLu
providers.description: CareLuLu is a consumer marketplace that helps parents find and compare licensed child care — home daycares, child care centers, and preschools. Families can search across roughly 200,000 licensed programs and filter by location, age, hours, tuition, and availability, then view photos, verified parent reviews, and schedule tours or consultations. The service is positioned as an easy, fast, and free way to find safe, high-quality, affordable child care, and it also lets providers list and market their programs to local parents. Backed by 500 Global. Note — CareLuLu runs a consumer web application (an AMP/React SPA) and an internal API host (api.carelulu.com), but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — this profile captures its public website and identity surface only.

providers.name: CarNow
providers.description: CarNow is an AI-enabled conversion platform built specifically for automotive dealerships, helping them turn more website visitors into leads, more leads into sales, and more buyers into lifelong service customers. Its product suite spans website solutions (AI-powered chat, digital retail, and shop-by-payment experiences), sales follow-up automation (Cruise Control, which prioritizes high-intent shoppers and automates nurture workflows), and service retention (Lane Assist, which drives post-sale engagement and service scheduling). CarNow works with more than 4,000 dealer partners and integrates with major OEM programs including Acura, Audi, BMW, Ford, General Motors, Honda, Hyundai, Kia, Land Rover, and Lexus. The company is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina and is backed by Battery Ventures. CarNow does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; its api.carnow.com endpoint is a partner/internal AWS API Gateway that requires authentication.

providers.name: Catalant
providers.description: Catalant is a consulting platform that connects organizations with a global marketplace of experienced independent consultants and boutique firms, positioning itself as "Consulting 2.0" fit-to-purpose consulting that is faster, more flexible, and more cost efficient than traditional large consulting firms. Its network spans 10,000+ vetted consultants (many from Fortune 500 companies and top-tier consulting firms, averaging 19+ years of experience) and serves 700+ businesses across 20+ countries. Catalant covers engagement areas including Digital & AI, Transformation & Value Creation, Operations, Sales & Marketing, M&A / Integration & Separation, Strategy & Finance, and Organization & People. Catalant is a General Catalyst portfolio company. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: Ciao
providers.description: Ciao (meetciao.com) is a home-sharing platform that connects travelers with locals, letting members rent homes at local rates within a private, trust-based community of travellers while homeowners earn income from their properties. The service emphasizes affordability, community trust, and authentic local experiences over commercial short-let alternatives, and operates across major European cities including London, Lisbon, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, and Tbilisi with 20,000+ community members and 1,000+ available homes. Ciao is a Seedcamp portfolio company; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. Ciao is a consumer mobile/web product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Circle Medical
providers.description: Circle Medical is a San Francisco-based online and in-person primary care clinic offering telemedicine and clinic-based visits with same and next-day availability. Founded through Y Combinator, the company operates 20+ physical locations and provides virtual appointments across multiple US states through Circle Medical Care of California, an independent medical practice. Its 400+ board-certified physicians, physician assistants, and nurse practitioners treat primary care, mental health (ADHD, anxiety, depression), hormone and sexual health, urgent care, weight loss (GLP-1s), sleep, and dermatology. Circle Medical is a HIPAA-covered, patient-facing digital health provider; it publishes no public developer API or SDK program, and this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clearco
providers.description: Clearco is a fintech company providing non-dilutive, revenue-based capital to direct-to-consumer ecommerce and SaaS businesses, having deployed over $3 billion across more than 10,000 funded companies. Its funding products include Fixed Funding Capacity, Rolling Funding Capacity, Cash Advance, and Invoice Funding, with capped weekly payments and funding decisions within 24 hours. Clearco connects to a founder's existing commerce and payments stack (Amazon, Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, Square, BigCommerce) to underwrite revenue, rather than exposing a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Emergence Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface is currently published.

providers.name: CLUBZERO
providers.description: CLUBZERO (CLUBZERØ) is a London-based reuse system administrator helping the food and beverage industry transition from single-use to reusable packaging. Its AI-powered platform serializes every reusable item with a GS1-standard QR, RFID, or barcode identifier, then coordinates the drop points, collection, washing, and redistribution logistics that keep packaging in circulation across on-trade, online delivery, and retail channels. CLUBZERO reports 95-98% return rates and 3.3M+ packaging rotations, running reuse programs for brands including McDonald's, Nestlé, Aramark, Compass Group, Just Eat, and the Wimbledon Championships. Backed by Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API surface is currently documented.

providers.name: Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States
providers.description: The Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) is an inter-agency committee chaired by the U.S. Department of the Treasury that reviews certain foreign investment transactions for national security implications. CFIUS reviews are governed by the Defense Production Act and Section 721, and were significantly strengthened by the Foreign Investment Risk Review Modernization Act of 2018 (FIRRMA). On September 15, 2022, President Biden issued Executive Order 14083 directing CFIUS to focus on emerging national security risks. CFIUS work is largely confidential, and the public-facing surface is limited to regulations, annual reports to Congress, FAQs, declarations and notices guidance, and case studies.

providers.name: Creative Market
providers.description: Creative Market is an online marketplace for community-generated design assets, where independent creators sell fonts, graphics, illustrations, templates, photos, icons, mockups, add-ons, and 3D assets to designers and businesses. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, the platform operates a storefront and seller dashboard model with per-product commercial licensing, an affiliate and ambassador program, a design blog, and enterprise sales. As of this enrichment pass Creative Market publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity, published policy and support surfaces, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Curtsy
providers.description: Curtsy is a mobile-first resale marketplace for secondhand women's fashion, focused on Gen Z and young-millennial shoppers roughly ages 15 to 30. Through its free iOS and Android apps, users buy and sell trending clothing, shoes, and accessories from brands like Lululemon, Free People, and SKIMS, saving up to 70% off retail. Curtsy holds no inventory of its own — sellers ship directly to buyers using prepaid shipping labels and free Curtsy-branded starter kits — and the company earns a 20% fee on each completed sale. Founded in 2016 as part of Y Combinator's Summer 2016 batch and headquartered in San Francisco, Curtsy has raised venture funding from Canaan Partners and Index Ventures. Curtsy is a consumer app with no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: CyberTalents
providers.description: CyberTalents is a global cybersecurity platform that ranks and connects security talent with employers based on real, hands-on skills. The platform automates Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, delivers cybersecurity courses and training camps, runs technical assessments for enterprises, and provides recruitment and headhunting services to close the global cybersecurity skills gap. Backed by 500 Global, CyberTalents operates from Egypt, the UAE, and the United States and hosts one of the largest cybersecurity practice communities in the world. This API Evangelist profile tracks CyberTalents as a company; no public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Datumate
providers.description: Datumate is a construction technology company whose cloud-native SaaS platform, DatuBIM, turns drone imagery, laser-scanning, and site data into real-time progress tracking, deviation detection, automated reporting, and actionable analytics for heavy civil infrastructure projects. It serves asset owners, general contractors, and engineering and consulting firms across roads, highways, rail, bridges, and earthworks, giving multi-site visibility from design validation through construction to final inspection. The company reports 125+ active customers, thousands of managed sites, and tens of thousands of processed drone flights. Datumate has Israeli engineering roots (Technion) with leadership based in Miami, Florida, and is backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: DeepScribe
providers.description: DeepScribe is a San Francisco, California ambient AI medical scribe company that automates clinical documentation and coding for specialty healthcare providers. Founded in 2017 (incorporated 2019) by Matthew Ko, Kairui Zeng, and Akilesh Bapu, DeepScribe captures the natural conversation between clinician and patient and produces structured clinical notes inside the provider's existing EHR workflow. The platform is HIPAA-compliant and is deployed across more than 1,500 healthcare organizations, with reported traction of 8 million+ visits captured and a 99.92% note-satisfaction rating. Core products include the AI Medical Scribe (ambient documentation), SmartPrep (pre-visit intelligence), AI Coding (E/M, ICD-10, and HCC automation), Customization Studio (provider-specific note personalization), and DeepScribe Assist (point-of-care insights). DeepScribe ships bi-directional EHR integrations with Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, AdvancedMD, drchrono, ModMed, Flatiron (OncoEMR), Ontada (iKnowMed Generation 2), and Objective Medical Systems, with a focused practice in oncology, cardiology, gastroenterology, neurology, orthopedics, urology, and value-based care. The company partners with AWS, Anthropic, Deloitte, and Panda Health for infrastructure, model, and go-to-market support. DeepScribe is sold as enterprise SaaS through a contact-sales motion; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and authentication into the clinician workspace happens through canvas.deepscribe.ai.

providers.name: DevAI
providers.description: DevAI (DevAI Solutions, Inc.) is a Silicon Valley enterprise IT company, founded in 2024 by Susie Wee (CEO) and Edwin Zhang, that builds agentic AI for IT operations teams. Its DevAI Network Intelligence Engine reconciles data across fragmented IT tools of record (CMDB, vCenter, NetBox and other infrastructure, network, compute, and security systems) into a single trustworthy operational view, and its Network Intelligence Agent "Neo" streamlines IT planning, incident response, patch management, and security and compliance workflows through a chat interface. DevAI reports deployment at Fortune 50 enterprises and won Best-in-Show (Automation) at the AI Networking Summit 2025. The company raised a $6M seed round led by Emergence Capital with Pear VC, Base10 Partners, and Benchstrength. No public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: DoNotPay
providers.description: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer advocacy platform, founded in 2015 by Joshua Browder and marketed as the "robot lawyer." It offers a web-based consumer product with 100+ AI-assisted tools that help people cancel subscriptions and free trials, dispute parking tickets and traffic violations, file chargebacks and refunds, negotiate and lower bills, find unclaimed money, fight robocalls, generate virtual cards for safe trial signups, and automate customer-service interactions. DoNotPay is a direct consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it is tracked here as an API Evangelist company profile.

providers.name: Efficient Computer
providers.description: Efficient Computer builds general-purpose, energy-minimal processors for edge and embedded AI. Its Fabric architecture is a reconfigurable spatial dataflow array that maps application graphs directly onto hardware, eliminating the wasteful data movement of traditional Von Neumann CPUs. The Electron E1 processor pairs the Fabric with an integrated RISC-V scalar core to deliver up to 100x better energy efficiency than low-power CPUs, and the proprietary effcc compiler acts as a drop-in replacement for GCC/Clang that extracts dataflow from C, C++, and TensorFlow Lite while preserving GDB-compatible debugging. Efficient Computer is a silicon and developer-toolchain company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, backed by Union Square Ventures, targeting on-device AI inference, IoT, and industrial and physical-AI systems that must run for years on a single charge.

providers.name: Efflux Systems
providers.description: Efflux (Efflux Systems, Inc.) is a Baltimore, Maryland cybersecurity company founded in 2014 that operates a near real-time asset intelligence and attack-surface platform. Efflux delivers fresh intelligence about the assets of organizations, networks, and services — offered as a one-time Asset Map, scheduled monitoring, or on-demand custom scanning. Its differentiator is radical transparency: rather than opaque risk scores and surface-level abstractions, Efflux records and exposes every scan it runs, every asset it discovers, and every attribution it makes, so teams can see what was found, how it was discovered, and why it matters — raw information and formatted insights side by side. Data is accessible via export, download, share, and a programmatic API. The company is backed by 500 Global, Granite Hill Capital Partners, TEDCO, and Three Tree Ventures, and is currently in early access with a public waitlist.

providers.name: Ergeon
providers.description: Ergeon is a nationwide outdoor residential construction company that installs fencing (wood, vinyl, metal, and chain-link), artificial grass, wooden decks, and concrete driveways, patios, and walkways. It pairs a distributed workforce with technology — live video estimates, a 3D fence-quoting calculator at fencequoting.com, satellite site-plan tooling, and a customer portal — to deliver fast, accurate quotes plus managed installation with permit handling, financing (Wisetack), and workmanship warranties. Ergeon runs internal software and vendor integrations (Stripe, Twilio, Talkdesk, AWS, Lob) but does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, status, and open-source surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: EverBank
providers.description: EverBank, N.A. is a Jacksonville, Florida based national bank (Member FDIC) focused on high-yield consumer deposits, business and treasury banking, and commercial lending, serving customers nationwide online plus a small network of financial centers in Florida, California and New York. The bank operated as TIAA Bank from 2017 until 2023, when it was acquired by an investor group and reverted to the EverBank brand as an independent institution. Like most US banks, EverBank publishes NO first-party public developer API or developer portal; there is no documented open-banking, FDX, or CFPB Section 1033 data-access API exposed directly. Consumer-permissioned account data is reached only through third-party aggregators (e.g. Plaid, MX, Finicity), which is the honest, non-fabricated posture recorded here.

providers.name: exein
providers.description: Exein is a Physical AI and embedded/IoT cybersecurity company (Italy) that secures connected devices, firmware, and Linux/RTOS embedded systems. Its platform pairs on-device runtime threat detection (Exein Runtime) with AI-powered firmware analysis and SBOM ingestion (Exein Analyzer), mapping findings to standards including the EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI EN 303-645, IEC 62443, RED 3.3, and the US Cyber Trust Mark. Exein does not publish a hosted public REST API; its developer surface is open-source security tooling in the exein-io GitHub organization — notably Pulsar (an eBPF-powered runtime security agent) and Kepler (a NIST-based CVE lookup store and API). Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital, hv-capital, and partech.

providers.name: FIFOplus
providers.description: FIFOplus is a B2B smart-procurement marketplace for the HORECA sector (hotels, restaurants, cafes, and catering) in Saudi Arabia, connecting food-service buyers with suppliers across a webstore and mobile app that lists more than 5,000 food and non-food items spanning meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen goods, condiments, beverages, packaging, and cleaning supplies. The platform layers ordering, real-time order tracking, inventory, menu, and finance optimization with AI and integrates with point-of-sale systems and credit-terms payment. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jeddah, FIFOplus operates across Jeddah, Makkah, Riyadh, and Taif and is backed by the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator (500 Global) and Palm Ventures. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; FIFOplus publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Filmhub
providers.description: Filmhub is a global film and television sales and distribution company that operates a self-service marketplace connecting independent filmmakers and rights holders directly to more than 100 streaming channels and platforms worldwide, including Tubi, Plex, Xumo, Amazon, Fandor, and others across AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, and FAST business models. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Los Angeles, Filmhub charges no upfront listing fees and instead earns a 20 percent share of the royalties generated by the distribution deals it facilitates. Filmmakers upload their titles, technical specifications, and metadata to the Filmhub app; channel partners browse the catalog and license the content they want; and Filmhub manages technical delivery, revenue collection, and reporting. The company is backed by a16z and other investors. Filmhub does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Flashpoint
providers.description: Flashpoint is a threat intelligence company delivering decisive intelligence for cybersecurity, fraud prevention, corporate and physical security, vulnerability management, insider threat, and national security teams. Its Ignite platform and Flashpoint API surface data collected from illicit online communities, the deep and dark web, chat services, and open sources — exposing threat actors, compromised credentials, vulnerabilities, and fraud indicators. Flashpoint makes this finished intelligence and raw data available programmatically through a REST API at api.flashpoint.io, documented at docs.flashpoint.io, so security teams can integrate alerting, data feeds, and finished intelligence into SOC, SIEM, and security automation workflows.

providers.name: Fleek
providers.description: Fleek is a B2B wholesale marketplace for vintage and secondhand clothing that connects resellers with a global network of verified suppliers, letting new resellers, full-time resellers, and retail businesses source pre-owned inventory in bulk at wholesale margins. The platform aggregates more than a thousand secondhand suppliers worldwide, handles discovery, ordering, and logistics through its website and mobile apps, and is backed by HV Capital. Fleek operates a consumer/reseller storefront (built on Shopify) and a separate vendor onboarding flow for suppliers; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from the HV Capital portfolio and enriched from Fleek's public web surface.

providers.name: FoodA
providers.description: Fooda is a Chicago-based workplace food-service marketplace that brings meals from local, independent restaurants directly to corporate offices, hospitals, universities, retail locations, and distribution centers. Its technology-enabled platform runs restaurant popup dining events, employer-paid meal programs, contactless lunch delivery, event catering and boxed lunches, coffee, pantry, and micro-market services, plus full cafeteria replacement under the Orange by Fooda brand. Fooda works with 2,000+ restaurant partners and serves upwards of ten million meals per year, using AI predictive modeling and machine learning to match restaurants to locations and schedule thousands of events. Sibling brands include Foodsby and Fooda for Restaurants. Fooda is a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API or partner developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Freshket
providers.description: Freshket is a Thai agri-food supply chain technology company that operates a B2B online marketplace connecting farmers and food producers directly with restaurants, hotels, catering operations, and food manufacturers. The platform uses technology to manage the fresh-produce and ingredient supply chain more efficiently and transparently, giving buyers quality ingredients at fair prices with reliable next-day delivery while giving growers better market access and pricing. Founded in Bangkok and backed by 500 Global, Freshket covers ordering, sourcing, cold-chain logistics, and account management for foodservice businesses across Thailand. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Freshket publishes a customer-facing web and mobile ordering platform but no public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Gamma Technologies
providers.description: Gamma Technologies develops GT-SUITE, the multi-physics system simulation software used by engineers to model, simulate, and optimize complex systems across automotive, HVACR, aerospace, industrial machinery, and shipbuilding. GT-SUITE combines 0D/1D/3D physics-based modeling, prebuilt model libraries, digital-twin workflows, and native AI tooling (GT Intelligence Studio and a Machine Learning Assistant). The company is a desktop/engineering CAE vendor rather than an API-first provider and publishes no public REST API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Garage
providers.description: Garage (Garage Technologies, Inc.) is America's online marketplace for buying and selling specialized vehicles and equipment — fire trucks, ambulances, and heavy-duty municipal apparatus. The platform helps fire departments, EMS services, municipalities, and dealers list surplus equipment and buy what they need in seconds, bundling AI-powered appraisals, virtual inspections, live auctions, payments, freight, financing, and warranties into one consumer marketplace. Garage raised $13.5M and is backed by Initialized Capital. It operates a public consumer web marketplace (shopgarage.com / withgarage.com); no public developer API program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Garmentory
providers.description: Garmentory is a Seattle-based online fashion marketplace that connects shoppers with more than 1,000 independent boutiques and emerging designers across 30+ countries. Backed by Techstars, the platform curates apparel, accessories, and footwear from independent retailers, letting boutiques list inventory manually or sync it through a Shopify integration. Garmentory runs a heavily customized Spree Commerce (Ruby on Rails) storefront and consumes third-party APIs (payments, retail media, and merchant onboarding) rather than publishing a first-party public developer API. This profile tracks Garmentory's identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API reference is published at this time.

providers.name: Gathern
providers.description: Gathern (جاذر) is the first licensed peer-to-peer vacation-rental marketplace in Saudi Arabia, founded in Riyadh in 2016 and licensed by the Saudi Ministry of Tourism. Through its iOS, Android, and web apps, travelers book short-term private accommodations directly from local hosts — chalets, apartments, villas, farms, resorts, rest houses (istrahat), camps, caravans, and rooms — across more than 200 cities and provinces in the Kingdom, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Taif, Al Khobar, Dammam, Mecca, Medina, and AlUla. The platform lists tens of thousands of units, has served more than five million users, and holds a leading share of the alternative-hospitality sector in Saudi Arabia. Backed by 500 Global, STV, Sanabil Investments (a Public Investment Fund subsidiary), and others, Gathern raised a $72M Series B and is preparing for a Tadawul listing. Gathern operates as a consumer marketplace app and does not currently publish a public developer API surface; this profile tracks its public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Genopets
providers.description: Genopets is a free-to-play, move-to-earn NFT game built on the Solana blockchain that gamifies an active lifestyle. Players nurture a digital pet — a Genopet — that evolves from real-world physical activity tracked via step counting, then battle, craft, stake, and trade in-game NFTs and Habitats. The economy pairs the GENE governance token with the in-game KI utility token earned by moving. Genopets is developed by a studio backed by Pantera Capital and operates a consumer mobile/web game rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Georama
providers.description: Georama is now QualSights (qualsights.com), a consumer-insights research technology company that helps brands understand human behavior across the product lifecycle. The platform combines Smart Sensors that passively capture product consumption and usage in real time, a participant app that collects video, photo, and survey feedback, and an AI-powered analytics layer that turns that data into actionable insights. Marquee offerings include UseSights (Physical AI for product usage), VoiceSights (AI-moderated conversations), and the moment-based XMOT feedback method, spanning opportunity identification, concept optimization, product development, pre-launch validation, market launch, and acceleration. Georama entered the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead; QualSights publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: GigFinesse
providers.description: GigFinesse is a live-entertainment talent booking platform that connects hospitality venues — hotels, restaurants, bars, and clubs — with musicians, DJs, and performing artists. Venues discover and book vetted talent and manage contracts, insurance, scheduling, and payments through a centralized dashboard, while artists gain access to consistent, recurring gig opportunities. Clients include premium hospitality brands such as St. Regis, The Ritz-Carlton, Fairmont Hotels, and Hard Rock Hotel. GigFinesse is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Glambot
providers.description: Glambot is an online marketplace for buying and selling gently used and new makeup and beauty products. Shoppers can purchase discounted cosmetics from more than 100 brands including MAC, Urban Decay, Charlotte Tilbury, and Chanel across categories such as eyes, lashes, brows, face, cheeks, lips, skincare, palettes, and brushes, while sellers can mail in their unwanted makeup for cash payouts. Glambot operates a two-sided consumer resale platform and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. The company does not currently publish a public API, SDK, developer portal, or MCP surface.

providers.name: GoWork
providers.description: GoWork is Indonesia's largest premium coworking and flexible office space provider, operating more than 25 locations across Jakarta, Tangerang, Surabaya, Bali, and Medan. Formed from the 2018 merger of GoWork and Rework, the company offers private offices, dedicated desks, coworking memberships, virtual offices, meeting and event spaces, plus podcast and live-streaming studios. It also bundles business services such as company incorporation, tax and accounting, visa and work-permit processing, and legal support. Members discover, book, and manage workspace through the GoWork mobile apps and web booking platform. GoWork is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: GrowthHackers
providers.description: GrowthHackers (Growth Hackers Company, LLC) is a growth-marketing community and software company built around the growth-hacking discipline Sean Ellis named. It runs an invite-only community for founders, heads of growth, marketers and product managers, publishes growth research, case studies, opinion pieces and the State of Growth survey, and hosts webinars, AMAs and a conference. Alongside the community it sells growth and AI marketing services and ships Growth OS, an AI-powered growth and optimization platform for agencies that combines experiment planning, content creation, digital marketing execution and reporting. GrowthHackers publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Harmonya
providers.description: Harmonya is a New York- and Tel Aviv-based product intelligence company for consumer packaged goods manufacturers and retailers. Founded in 2021, it reads live product listings, pack and label copy, manufacturer specs, syndicated feeds and consumer reviews, and turns them into normalized product attributes at the UPC level — claims, ingredients, flavors, pack, dietary positioning and measured nutrition values — plus demand themes and consumer-voice signals layered on top. The platform ships as four modules (Demand Intelligence, Consumer Intelligence, Attribute Intelligence and Product Catalog) delivered through a tenant web application at app.harmonya.com and as an enriched product feed into a customer's PIM, data lake and analytics stack. Harmonya publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract; access runs through a sales conversation and an Auth0-protected tenant.

providers.name: Haz
providers.description: Haz (operated by Vend Solutions Ltd) is a London-based AI social commerce mobile app that connects friends through the things they own and makes it easier to track, buy, and sell second-hand belongings. Its proprietary receipt-reading technology scans digital purchase receipts in a user's email inbox to automatically digitize owned items in real time, removing the manual listing, photography, and description work traditionally required for resale. Users get real-time valuations of everything they own and can offer items to their social circle in a live feed, increasing the liquidity of everyday goods such as clothing and electronics. Haz launched on iOS in March 2024 and raised a $1.4M pre-seed round led by Speedinvest. It is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: HeavyConnect
providers.description: HeavyConnect is a digital documentation and compliance platform purpose-built for agricultural operations, serving growers, harvesters, shippers, and processors. Its mobile-first, offline-capable modules cover food safety compliance, worker training and certification, time and productivity tracking, quality assurance inspections, end-to-end traceability, and supplier management. The platform replaces paper-based recordkeeping with audit-ready digital documentation and real-time analytics dashboards, helping food and agriculture operations stay inspection-ready. HeavyConnect reports 2,600+ active users across operations including Sysco, Naturipe, Talley, and Empire. It is offered as a month-to-month subscription with a request-a-demo onboarding path. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio-company lead (500 Global, Techstars) and enriched from the company's public web presence; no public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: HelloTech
providers.description: HelloTech is a consumer technology-services company providing in-home and online tech support across the United States through a nationwide network of vetted technicians. Services span computer and printer repair, WiFi and home-networking setup, mobile-device support, audio/video and home-theater installation, TV mounting, smart-home device installation, and home-security setup, offered on-demand or through a HelloTech Home membership plan. HelloTech operates as a consumer services brand and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Highstock
providers.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Hubble
providers.description: Hubble (hubblehq.com) is the UK's largest flexible-workspace marketplace, connecting businesses with private offices, coworking desks, day offices, meeting rooms, and on-demand workspace across thousands of buildings in the UK and beyond. Founded in 2014 by Tushar Agarwal and Tom Watson, the platform lets companies configure, deliver, and manage all their space in one place on flexible one-to-24-plus-month terms, and was acquired by Yardi in January 2025. Hubble runs a consumer-facing web platform and internal backend API rather than a published public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web, security, and discovery surface.

providers.name: Hyundai
providers.description: Hyundai Motor Company is a South Korean multinational automotive manufacturer specializing in designing and producing a wide range of vehicles including cars, SUVs, and commercial vehicles. Hyundai operates a developer portal exposing connected vehicle services, mobility solutions, and partner integration touchpoints.

providers.name: Imper.AI
providers.description: imper.ai is an Israeli workforce identity security company that stops AI-driven impersonation, deepfakes, voice clones, and social-engineering attacks in real time across enterprise communication channels such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Slack. Rather than scanning message content for anomalies, the platform correlates hard-to-fake signals — device telemetry, network diagnostics, and behavioral patterns — to validate identity at high-risk lifecycle events including hiring, employee enrollment, and help-desk verification. Founded by cyber-intelligence veterans and backed by Redpoint Ventures and Battery Ventures (about $34M raised), imper.ai integrates with ATS, HRIS, IdP, ITSM, PAM, IVR, and meeting platforms, and is deployed across financial, health care, and technology enterprises. This profile was seeded from Battery Ventures' portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; imper.ai currently publishes a product knowledge base rather than a public developer API program.

providers.name: Imperfect Foods
providers.description: Imperfect Foods is a consumer grocery delivery service focused on reducing food waste. It sources surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and excess-inventory food — produce that is too large or small, packaging overstock, near best-by-date items, and manufacturing byproducts — and delivers them to members at a discount through a weekly, customizable grocery order of produce, meat, seafood, dairy, pantry staples, and snacks. Imperfect Foods was acquired by Misfits Market in 2022 and now operates as part of that company; its consumer web and mobile apps remain live. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment — this profile is maintained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Inspirato
providers.description: Inspirato is a luxury travel subscription company that gives members access to a curated portfolio of 300+ private branded residences, 200+ five-star hotels, and 170+ destinations worldwide, paired with dedicated concierge care, curated experiences, and signature hotel partnerships. Members book vacations through Inspirato's website and app with predictable, service-first delivery. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IVP and added to the API Evangelist network. Inspirato does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Intro
providers.description: Intro is a consumer marketplace, founded in 2020 by Raad Mobrem and headquartered in Los Angeles, that connects people with vetted, in-demand experts for one-on-one advice over scheduled video calls. Experts span career and business, interior design and home decor, style and beauty, health and wellness, fitness and nutrition, astrology, and more, with per-session pricing set by each expert. Intro also lets creators and professionals monetize their audience by publishing a bookable profile. The company raised a $10M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) with participation from Seven Seven Six. Intro operates as a consumer web and mobile product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: JobToday
providers.description: JobToday is a mobile-first hiring marketplace that connects job seekers directly with employers for fast, chat-based hiring, primarily across service industries such as hospitality, retail, and customer service. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Luxembourg (JobToday S.A.), the app lets employers post jobs and message candidates directly, with the company reporting that roughly 70% of matches happen within 24 hours. JobToday operates across 20+ countries including the UK, US, Spain, Mexico, and France, and reports tens of millions of job seekers and hundreds of thousands of hiring businesses. It is backed by Accel. JobToday is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Josh Wood Colour
providers.description: Josh Wood Colour is a UK-based at-home hair colour brand founded by celebrity colourist Josh Wood, selling permanent and semi-permanent hair dye, root touch-up, gloss, toners, blonde and grey-blending products, and haircare direct to consumers through a Shopify-powered online store at joshwoodcolour.com. The brand pairs its retail catalogue with a free personalised colour-matching consultation service and editorial hair-care advice. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail e-commerce brand it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; this profile captures its web identity, security posture, and customer-facing properties.

providers.name: Julaya
providers.description: Julaya is a West African B2B fintech, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, that digitizes corporate financial operations across the UEMOA zone (Cote d'Ivoire, Senegal, Benin and Togo). Its pro account lets businesses send mobile money and bank transfers, collect cash and mobile-money deposits, pay suppliers and run payroll, and receive UEMOA-wide transfers via a Julaya IBAN, with multi-company sub-wallets, approval and signature workflows, real-time transaction tracking and accounting exports. Julaya is licensed as a payment establishment in Cote d'Ivoire and connects businesses to mobile-money rails including Orange Money, Wave, MTN MoMo, Moov and Wizall. A partner integration API (api.julaya.co) exposes disbursement and collection programmatically for enterprise customers.

providers.name: Koordinator
providers.description: Koordinator is a QoS-based scheduling system for hybrid workloads orchestration on Kubernetes, providing colocation, interference detection, and resource optimization capabilities to improve cluster utilization.

providers.name: Laboratory Corporation of America (Labcorp)
providers.description: Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings, doing business as Labcorp, is a leading global life sciences company providing diagnostic, drug development, and technology-enabled solutions to improve health and lives. This repository is an alias of the labcorp index and tracks the same FHIR / HL7 integration surface.

providers.name: LawnGuru
providers.description: LawnGuru is a lawn and landscape services marketplace that connects homeowners with vetted local service providers through a mobile-first platform. It offers instant pricing via aerial property mapping, real-time job tracking, and a satisfaction guarantee, spanning 17+ outdoor services including lawn mowing, snow clearing, yard cleanup, weeding, hedge trimming, gutter cleaning, tree work, seeding, aeration, mulch installation, pressure washing, sprinkler services, and junk removal. The company reports over 1,000,000 completed jobs. As of this enrichment pass, LawnGuru publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Leland
providers.description: Leland is a marketplace for ambitious people to access the coaching, classes, and community they need to reach career and educational goals. It connects individuals with vetted 1-on-1 coaches across MBA and college admissions, management consulting, investment banking, private equity, product management, law, medicine, and executive and career development, and sells structured live programs, bootcamps, and test prep for the GMAT, GRE, LSAT, MCAT, SAT, and ACT. Leland+ is a subscription content library of video guides, essay and resume examples, templates, and expert-built AI tools. For organizations Leland offers AI-native talent training, agentic workflow deployment, recruiting, and outplacement, plus university and HR partnerships. Leland publishes no public API or developer portal as of 2026-07-19.

providers.name: Lendorse
providers.description: Lendorse GmbH is a Berlin-based education-finance company that funds international master's students studying in Europe through Income Share Agreements (ISAs) instead of traditional credit-scored loans. Students receive between EUR 3,000 and EUR 20,000 toward tuition, visa deposits, relocation and living costs, then repay a fixed 6-12% share of gross monthly income for 12 to 60 months once they earn above a EUR 2,500 monthly salary floor, with total repayment capped at 2.3x the funded amount. No collateral, co-signer, parental guarantor or credit check is required, which opens funding to students from developing and emerging markets who are normally excluded. Lendorse also provides mentorship, CV review, mock interviews and industry introductions. It covers universities in Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland, went through the Techstars and ABN AMRO Future of Finance Accelerator, and raised EUR 1.75M co-led by LUMO Labs and Soulmates Ventures. Lendorse publishes no public API, SDKs or developer portal as of July 2026; this profile is a company record rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Luel
providers.description: Luel is a two-sided marketplace and multi-modal data lab for AI training data, connecting companies that need high-quality, rights-cleared datasets with verified contributors who supply and license on-demand video, audio, and image data. Contributors can earn money by submitting media from their own devices (for example, footage from their camera roll) or by completing requested data tasks, while buyers purchase premium, curated, rights-cleared multimodal datasets from the Luel catalog. Positioned as "the frontier of data," Luel powers the foundations of machine perception through a proprietary, continuous data engine. The company is backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Luel does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Misfits Market
providers.description: Misfits Market is a subscription-based online grocery delivery service founded in 2018 by Abhi Ramesh and headquartered in Philadelphia. It rescues surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and near-best-by organic produce, pantry staples, dairy, and meat, then delivers them to customers at a discount to reduce food waste. Members shop a personalized storefront during a weekly delivery window with no subscription fees or order minimums, and can skip or cancel anytime. The company acquired rival Imperfect Foods in 2022 and The Rounds in 2025. Backed by Accel and SoftBank Vision Fund. Misfits Market operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Miyokos
providers.description: Miyoko's Creamery (miyokos.com) is a plant-based dairy company in the planetary-health sector, backed by Obvious Ventures, making vegan butter and cheese from cultured cashews, oats, and legumes. The company does not publish a first-party developer REST API; its digital surface is a Shopify-hosted storefront. That storefront exposes a genuine agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a hosted shopping MCP endpoint for search/cart/checkout, Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth for identity, and an /llms.txt with agent instructions. This profile was enriched by probing that public surface.

providers.name: MonkeyTilt
providers.description: MonkeyTilt is a crypto-native online casino and sportsbook where players deposit, wager, and cash out in cryptocurrency across slots, table games, live dealer, and sports betting. The platform rewards play with points, prize drops, and the Tilt Club VIP program (bonuses and merch drops), and is backed by Pantera Capital. MonkeyTilt is a consumer gaming product: it runs an internal application API (disallowed to crawlers in robots.txt) but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Neara
providers.description: Neara is a physics-enabled digital twin platform for electric utilities and network operators. It builds a single, physics-accurate 3D model of a utility's entire network from LiDAR, GIS, and imagery, then runs engineering-grade simulations across vegetation management, wildfire and flood mitigation, severe-weather response, clearance and conductor-clash analysis, pole utilization and FEA, asset inspection and lifecycle management, and transmission and distribution network design. Utilities use Neara to plan, harden, and operate their grids at scale — forecasting and backcasting resilience, prioritizing risk, and optimizing capital spend across millions of assets. Founded in Australia, Neara operates regionally across ANZ, the USA, and Europe.

providers.name: Netreo
providers.description: Netreo is an IT infrastructure monitoring platform (now part of BMC as BMC Helix Operations Management with Netreo) that provides full-stack observability across networks, servers, applications, cloud services and databases. The platform exposes a documented REST API for programmatic access to monitoring data, configuration, and automation workflows.

providers.name: Novee Security
providers.description: Novee Security (Novee) is a cybersecurity company delivering AI-driven penetration testing that finds vulnerabilities faster, validates defenses, and reduces cyber risk. Its autonomous offensive-security platform performs penetration testing at machine speed across web applications and APIs, and spans solutions including DAST, AI red teaming, manual penetration testing, bug bounty, and compliance testing. Backed by Canaan Partners, Novee is building continuous, AI-native security testing as an alternative to traditional DAST scanning and slow, periodic manual pentest cycles. The company publishes a marketing and product site, a vulnerability glossary, and a blog, but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: OnFrontiers
providers.description: OnFrontiers is the first and largest expert network for U.S. federal contractors, an Expertise Intelligence Platform connecting government contractors with 17,000+ subject matter experts and growth professionals across 1,300+ federal agencies to win and execute more government contracts. Engagements range from one-hour consultations to multi-month projects, with a 92% project success rate across 6,000+ engagements, and the platform is integrated with GovTribe's contractor intelligence tools. Added to the API Evangelist network as a techstars portfolio lead; this enrichment pass found no public developer API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public well-known discovery documents), but the provider does publish a real llms.txt.

providers.name: Paladin
providers.description: Paladin is a legal technology company whose software platform connects the pro bono community and empowers legal teams to run pro bono programs more efficiently. The platform provides centralized program management dashboards, volunteer matching that connects attorneys to pro bono opportunities based on interest and expertise, and impact measurement that visualizes and reports on program outcomes across a nationwide network of legal services organizations, law firms, in-house legal teams, law schools, and bar associations. Customers include Clifford Chance, Dentons, Holland & Knight, and Wilson Sonsini. Paladin is a Techstars portfolio company.
