It exposes a customer-facing web application at app.joinpaladin.com but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Perimeter VRM (formerly ProcessBolt)
providers.description: Perimeter (formerly ProcessBolt) is a vendor risk management (VRM) platform built for regulated industries. It covers the full third-party risk lifecycle through six modules — Monitor (continuous vendor surveillance and alerts), Assess (automated risk assessments with a drag-and-drop template builder), Extract (AI-powered document intelligence), Verify (attack-surface validation), Share (a document management and collaboration hub), and Respond (RFP and assessment response automation). The product centralizes vendor information, scores and reports vendor risk, and supports no-code integration and API-based / CSV vendor imports across US, EU, and Australia data regions. ProcessBolt rebranded to Perimeter and now serves the platform from perimeter.net; processbolt.com redirects there. No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs are published — the platform's integration APIs are exposed to customers rather than through an open developer surface.

providers.name: Piinpoint
providers.description: PiinPoint is an AI-powered location intelligence and site selection platform for retailers, restaurants, brokers, and commercial real estate teams. The software combines demographic, mobile-location, traffic, and competitive data to help teams validate sites, forecast sales, model cannibalization, run network simulations, and plan expansion. Delivered as a B2B SaaS web application (app.piinpoint.com), PiinPoint does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Pillar
providers.description: Pillar is an Italian construction-technology company, founded in 2025 and headquartered in Milan, building what it calls the operating system for the construction industry (il sistema operativo per l'edilizia). Its cloud platform unifies the back office of building firms (imprese edili) — invoicing (fatturazione), cash-flow management (flussi di cassa), bank reconciliation, quotes and estimates (preventivi), procurement, job and project cost control (gestione commessa), and delivery notes and site work reports (DDT e rapportini) — alongside on-site safety (Pillar Sicurezza) and an AI layer (Pillar AI) that automates data entry in real time, including inputs captured from the job site over WhatsApp. Pillar is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital and today reaches customers through a book-a-demo model rather than a public self-serve signup or a developer-facing API; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pintarnya
providers.description: Pintarnya is an Indonesian technology startup, launched in May 2022, that operates an employment and financial-services super-app for the country's blue-collar and entry-level workforce (education levels from elementary school through bachelor's degree, "SD-S1"). The platform aggregates tens of thousands of daily-updated job listings across 300+ Indonesian cities and pairs job search with Cari Cuan side-income tasks, Siap Kerja skill-building video courses, a CV builder, and an employer/recruiter posting product used by tens of thousands of companies. Pintarnya reports more than 10 million registered job seekers and is registered with Indonesia's Ministry of Labor (KEMNAKER). It is a consumer web and mobile product; no public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Planet FWD
providers.description: Planet FWD is a decarbonization software platform that helps consumer brands measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions. It provides AI-powered product life cycle assessments (LCAs), corporate greenhouse-gas inventories across Scope 1, 2, and 3, and supply-chain decarbonization scenario planning for food & beverage, retail, and apparel companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Please
providers.description: Please (Please Platforms) is an AI-powered "thinking" reminders application for iOS that lets people capture a thought, a link, or an image with zero effort, then automatically enriches each reminder with additional context and surfaces intelligent, connected suggestions so nothing gets missed. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. Please ships a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Premise
providers.description: Premise is a global data-intelligence platform that combines machine learning with a distributed network of on-the-ground human contributors to collect, structure, and analyze local ground-truth data across 140+ countries. The platform reports 6M+ contributors, 25M+ submissions per year, and 2.3M+ unique points of interest, and serves three primary markets: precision mapping and geospatial intelligence, international development, and public-sector organizations. Premise is a portfolio company of a16z, Anthemis, and GV. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; data is delivered through managed engagements and its customer platform.

providers.name: Proudly
providers.description: Proudly is a direct-to-consumer baby care brand, co-founded by Dwyane Wade and Gabrielle Union, that centers the unique skin and hair needs of Black and Brown babies to make products better for all. Its Shopify-hosted storefront sells skincare (balms, washes, oils), hair care, baby wipes, absorbent diapers, bath and body kits, apparel and gift bundles under a "No Sketchy Stuff" ingredient-transparency commitment. Backed by Initialized Capital (via A-Frame Brands), Atacama Ventures and VMG Partners. Proudly is a consumer commerce company with no public developer API or SDK program; the only machine surface is its Shopify Customer Account OpenID/OAuth well-known configuration.

providers.name: Provi
providers.description: Provi is a B2B beverage alcohol marketplace that digitizes procurement across the three-tier distribution system, connecting buyers (bars, restaurants, and retail stores) with distributors, sales representatives, and suppliers/brands. The platform consolidates product discovery across distributor catalogs, direct messaging with sales reps, order management and processing, and brand showcase tools into a single ordering experience. Provi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Publishizer
providers.description: Publishizer is a book crowdfunding platform and literary agency that connects authors with readers and publishers. Authors create book proposals and run pre-order campaigns; readers pre-order copies to signal demand; and publishers use data such as pre-order volume and proposal quality to discover and acquire promising manuscripts. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web platform and blog but no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: QwikCilver
providers.description: QwikCilver is India's largest gift card and prepaid commerce company, founded in 2006 and acquired by Pine Labs in 2019. It powers gift card issuance, distribution, and redemption for retailers, banks, and enterprises, and operates the consumer and corporate gifting marketplace Woohoo (woohoo.in), which sells digital and physical gift cards from 300+ brands. Its API platform (hosted on woohoo.in) lets partners programmatically browse catalogs, place bulk gift card orders, activate and redeem cards, check balances, and run reward, incentive, and channel-engagement programs. QwikCilver is an Accel portfolio company in the consumer / fintech sector.

providers.name: Raydiant
providers.description: Raydiant is a digital signage and in-location experience management platform for brick-and-mortar businesses, now operating under the Displai brand (raydiant.com redirects to displai.ai). The platform lets restaurants, retail stores, hospitality venues, commercial buildings, and schools manage branded content across networks of screens and kiosks from a central cloud dashboard. Core products include Displai Signage (multi-location content management), Displai Engage (employee engagement and gamification), Displai InSight (AI foot traffic and visitor analytics), and self-service ordering kiosks integrated with point-of-sale systems. Customers include Chick-fil-A, Macy's, Toyota, T-Mobile, and Red Bull. It runs a production cloud API at api.raydiant.com / api.displai.ai, but that surface is not publicly documented — there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or API reference. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a Bloomberg Beta portfolio lead.

providers.name: Reco
providers.description: Reco is a SaaS security platform using identity-centric analysis to detect threats, prevent data exposure, and manage access across SaaS applications.

providers.name: ReelData AI
providers.description: ReelData AI builds artificial intelligence software for land-based aquaculture, helping recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) fish farms maximize growth, minimize costs, and reduce risk across smolt, post-smolt, and on-growing production. Its integrated AI suite includes AI Smart Feeding (ReelAppetite), which monitors real-time population appetite to optimize feed and cut waste; AI Biomass Monitoring (ReelWeight), a non-intrusive biomass estimation tool returning results within hours; and AI Cameras (ReelVision), dual-function cameras for fish-behavior monitoring, feed counting, and standard IP camera use. Additional tools cover stress monitoring (ReelStress) and early disease detection (ReelHealth). ReelData is a Techstars portfolio company serving major operators including Samherji, Atlantic Sapphire, Kingfish Company, and Salmon Evolution. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface; its products are delivered as on-site AI hardware and software rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Rheaply
providers.description: Rheaply is a circular-economy platform for enterprise asset lifecycle management. It gives organizations real-time inventory visibility, an internal reuse marketplace with approval workflows for reallocating surplus furniture, equipment, IT assets, and lab supplies, and sustainable disposition through a network of 3,400+ verified nonprofit and commercial partners. Rheaply helps companies, universities, and governments cut procurement costs, divert waste from landfill, track embodied-carbon savings, and run decommissioning and office move-outs. Backed by Techstars, the company operates a web application at app.rheaply.com. As of this enrichment pass Rheaply publishes no public developer/API program, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Sabbar
providers.description: Sabbar is a leading local employment and recruitment platform in Saudi Arabia that connects job seekers with employers across many sectors. Job seekers search listings, build a free CV, and apply to roles, while employers use subscription-based recruitment packages and candidate matching. The platform reports more than 12,000 companies and over 1 million Saudi and non-Saudi job seekers, with iOS and Android mobile apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Safqah Holdings Limited
providers.description: Safqah Holdings Limited operates Safqah (Safqah Capital / Safqah Financial), a Saudi Arabian fintech platform headquartered in the Al-Malqa district of Riyadh and regulated by the Saudi Capital Market Authority (CMA). Safqah provides Sharia-compliant, debt-based real estate investment opportunities that let qualified individual and institutional investors fund real estate development deals starting from 1,000 SAR, alongside a financing arm that offers land acquisition, residential development, commercial development, raw land, and bridge financing to real estate developers. Investors track deal performance through periodic reporting and live project camera feeds. The platform is a consumer- and investor-facing web application with no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Sciket
providers.description: Sciket (科研市集, operated by STAREK Scientific / 勢得科研股份有限公司) is Taiwan's specialized online marketplace for scientific research and technology procurement. The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: Scoutbee
providers.description: Scoutbee is an AI-powered supplier discovery and procurement intelligence platform that helps enterprise buyers instantly find, vet, and connect with trusted suppliers. Founded in 2015 in Berlin, Germany, Scoutbee uses large language models, knowledge-graph technology, and a global supplier network to power supplier discovery, sourcing project execution (Streamline), and a centralized supplier data foundation (DeepSee), surfaced through the Scoutbee Intelligence Platform. Its AI gives procurement, sourcing, and category-management teams recommendations for suppliers matched on qualifications, risk, certifications, sustainability, diversity, cost, and experience. Scoutbee integrates with SAP Ariba guided sourcing and, following its October 2025 acquisition by Coupa, is being embedded into the Coupa Supplier Portal. Scoutbee does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Section AI
providers.description: Section AI (formerly Section School) is an enterprise AI training and adoption platform that helps large organizations turn AI investment into measurable workforce transformation and ROI. Its two products are Section HQ, a command center for Heads of AI to track usage, measure "AI fitness," surface real-time insights, and manage transformation roadmaps; and Section Coach, personalized AI coaching that delivers skills training, certification programs, and workflow identification to employees and teams. Section also runs AI transformation planning, leadership coaching, AI strategy support, workflow automation, and agentic AI workshops for enterprises of 100+ employees, with customers including Johnson & Johnson, Nike, Okta, Unilever, Mercer, and Publicis. Backed by General Catalyst and led by founder Greg Shove. As of this profile the company exposes a web/app product surface (app.sectionai.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation.

providers.name: Sellersfi
providers.description: SellersFi is a financial technology company providing working capital and inventory financing to e-commerce merchants, including sellers on Amazon and direct-to-consumer channels. It offers flexible funding lines with approvals in as fast as 48 hours, helping online businesses manage cash flow, purchase inventory, and scale operations. Backed by Northzone, SellersFi operates a lending platform and applicant portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sesh
providers.description: Sesh (Sesh Products US, Sesh+) is an Austin, Texas consumer packaged goods company that manufactures and sells tobacco-free nicotine pouches. Products ship in multiple flavors (Mint, Wintergreen, Clear, Mango, Cappuccino, Raspberry Lemon) and strengths (4mg, 6mg, 8mg), sold direct-to-consumer via subscription and through 5,000+ retailers. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a physical-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront, so the profile carries identity and domain-security only.

providers.name: Shakers
providers.description: Shakers is a Spanish technology platform — "the house of freeworking" — that connects enterprises with vetted, top-tier freelance developers and digital professionals. Its AI-powered products include Shakers AI (a copilot for project scoping and talent matching), Talent Insight (profile and skills analysis), Shakers Verified (technical verification of freelance profiles), and AI Interviews (automated candidate assessment). The platform serves 450+ enterprise clients including Telefónica, EY, BBVA, Microsoft, and HP across a community of 10,000+ tech freelancers. Backed by Partech, Shakers was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; as of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer web platform but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Sidekick
providers.description: Sidekick is a UK-based online wealth management and investing platform that offers expert-led investments and savings products once reserved for the ultra-wealthy, delivered through a mobile app and web platform. Its product range spans managed investment portfolios, savings accounts, private equity access, and cryptocurrency exposure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp, Sidekick is a consumer (B2C) fintech and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Siepe
providers.description: Siepe is a Dallas, Texas fintech providing cloud-based software and technology-enabled services for private credit, CLO and alternative investment managers. Its front-to-back platform spans portfolio management, operations and accounting, collateral administration, compliance and legal, middle-office services, data extraction and a centralized data-management warehouse that normalizes borrower, lender, agent-bank and investor feeds into one real-time view. Siepe also operates managed technology and public-cloud services for asset managers. The company raised a $30M Series B led by WestCap in 2024 and holds SOC 2 Type II certification. Siepe publishes no public developer program: connectivity is delivered as bilateral, managed integrations (for example its 2026 Order Management System integration with Octaura for syndicated loan and CLO trading) rather than as a self-serve, documented public API.

providers.name: Sketchdeck.ai
providers.description: SketchDeck.ai is a B2B SaaS company whose flagship product, LIFT, is AI-powered material takeoff and counting software for the structural steel fabrication and erection industry. LIFT analyzes uploaded blueprints and shop drawings to automatically extract quantities and generate Bills of Materials, with claimed 95-99% accuracy and up to an 80% reduction in takeoff time so estimators can complete bids in minutes rather than hours or days. The platform adds revision management and exports data to industry estimating programs; the company reports more than $25 billion in projects bid through LIFT to date. SketchDeck.ai is a Techstars-backed startup. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and demo-request website only - there is no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification surface to catalog.

providers.name: Slate Auto
providers.description: Slate Auto is an American electric-vehicle manufacturer building a radically simple, affordable, and customizable electric pickup truck. Designed in California and Michigan, engineered in Michigan, and assembled in the Midwest, the "Blank Slate" starts around $24,950 and offers roughly 205 miles of range, with interchangeable body panels and 200+ accessories that let owners reconfigure the vehicle over its life (including SUV and Fastback body styles). Slate sells direct through a preorder/reservation model, rejects mandatory feature packages and large touchscreens in favor of durability and owner control, and offers fleet solutions. Backed by General Catalyst. As a consumer automaker, Slate Auto publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sourceday
providers.description: SourceDay is an AI-driven supplier collaboration and purchase order (PO) management platform for manufacturers and distributors. It synchronizes buyers, suppliers, and ERP systems in real time to prevent supply chain disruptions, automating PO change management, shipment visibility, supplier scorecards, and request-for-quote (RFQ) workflows. SourceDay reports managing more than $5B in quarterly direct spend across 100K+ activated suppliers, with 500+ certified ERP integrations spanning Acumatica, Epicor (Kinetic and Prophet 21), Infor, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through certified ERP connectors rather than a public self-serve developer API; there is no public API documentation, developer portal, or published OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Spline
providers.description: Spline is a web-based, real-time collaborative 3D design platform used to create interactive 3D scenes, animations, and product experiences for the web, iOS, and Android. The Spline editor runs in the browser and supports multi-user collaboration with comments, link sharing, and team workspaces. Designers build scenes using primitives and modeling tools, a layer-based material system, states, events, timeline animation, game controls, physics, and particles. Scenes can be exported as GLTF/GLB, USDZ, STL, video, image sequences, or as code for the web, SwiftUI, and Kotlin. Spline's developer surface centers on runtime libraries — `@splinetool/runtime`, the `@splinetool/react-spline` React component, the `r3f-spline` hook for react-three-fiber, and `spline-ios` for Apple platforms — plus an embeddable Spline Viewer web component. Inside scenes, Spline exposes a Real-time API for dynamic data binding and webhooks for event-driven integrations. The company also ships Hana, a web-based collaborative UI design tool with infinite canvas, vector networks, visual effects, and motion design. Spline's revenue model is SaaS subscription with Free, Starter ($12/mo annual), Professional ($20/mo annual), and Enterprise tiers, plus a Spline AI add-on ($5/seat/month, 2000 AI credits) for prompt-driven 3D generation. There is no publicly documented Spline REST/management API or OpenAPI specification at this time; programmatic surfaces are limited to the runtime SDKs, the Real-time API, and webhooks exposed from within a scene.

providers.name: Tab
providers.description: Tab (tab.travel) is a London-based payment platform built specifically for independent tourism and hospitality businesses — hotels, hostels, tour operators, retreat centers and activity providers. It lets these merchants take card payments wherever their guests are, from in-advance deposits and online booking pages to in-person, on-the-move transactions via a mobile app, and to plug into an existing booking engine, PMS or OTA ecosystem. Tab natively handles 140+ currencies, pays out weekly in the merchant's local currency, and advertises transparent pricing from 2.9% per transaction with no hidden fees. Founded in 2015 by Mark Datta and backed by Y Combinator (W2015), Tab also operates a consumer-facing social-commerce guide for discovering and booking travel. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Tab does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs or API documentation.

providers.name: Talk-A-Bot
providers.description: Talk-A-Bot is a Budapest-based, Techstars-backed enterprise chatbot company building compliance-first conversational AI for regulated industries including banking, healthcare, government, retail, and HR. Its platform emphasizes "zero hallucination" answers grounded only in verified knowledge bases, full conversation logging and audit trails, EU-based infrastructure with on-premise deployment options, and daily human review. Products include an FAQ Chatbot, an Agentic Chatbot, FeedbackHub, and the CHEQ internal-communications assistant, deployed across web, mobile, Messenger, and Viber. The company markets an API-first architecture for integrating with customer systems (CRM, ERP, payments, ticketing, HR) but publishes no public self-serve developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK; engagement is full-service. Compliance posture spans HIPAA, DORA, the EU AI Act, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

providers.name: Tapstitch
providers.description: Tapstitch is a premium, fashion-focused print-on-demand (POD) and dropshipping platform that lets creators and brands design, produce, and sell custom apparel with no inventory, no minimums, and no subscription fees. It provides heavyweight streetwear blanks (250-400+ GSM), DTG and DTF printing, white-label fulfillment, and fashion collection development, with native integrations into Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace, and TikTok Shop for automatic product syncing, order routing, and fulfillment tracking. Founded to empower self-expression through clothing, Tapstitch has served 60,000+ creators, shipped over one million garments, and raised a $24.8M Series A led by Forerunner Ventures. Tapstitch does not currently publish a public developer/REST API for headless or custom storefronts; integration is delivered through its e-commerce platform apps and connectors.

providers.name: Tenkara
providers.description: Tenkara is an AI-powered operations and supply chain platform for material manufacturers across food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, beverages, and OTC products. The platform automates 75+ workflows spanning supplier sourcing and qualification, procurement, freight and logistics booking, order tracking, and compliance documentation (COA, SDS, and audit records), helping manufacturers find better suppliers faster, prevent delays, and run more efficient operations. Tenkara is backed by True Ventures.

providers.name: The Expert
providers.description: The Expert is a consumer marketplace that connects people with top interior designers worldwide through paid one-on-one video consultations, paired with an Expert-curated home shopping marketplace where those designers' product picks can be purchased directly. Founded by celebrity interior designer Jake Arnold and tech entrepreneur Leo Seigal, the company is backed by Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, WndrCo, and others. It operates as a business-to-consumer platform with a trade program for design professionals; it publishes no public developer API. This profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Timberhub
providers.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Titan
providers.description: Titan (Titan Global Capital Management USA LLC) is a New York City wealth-management firm founded in 2017 that offers app-based investing and advisory services to high-performing professionals and emerging high-net-worth individuals. Its product suite spans actively managed Flagship, Smart Treasury and Opportunities funds, direct indexing, automated stocks and bonds, venture-fund access, credit and real-estate strategies, crypto, and dedicated CFP-led wealth advisory, managing over $1.2 billion for 10,000+ clients. Titan is a consumer fintech application delivered via web and mobile apps; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, accel, and general-catalyst.

providers.name: Tolan
providers.description: Tolan is a consumer AI companion application built by Portola and backed by Homebrew. The product is a friendly alien character that users befriend for emotional support, daily check-ins, and relationship guidance through conversational AI on iOS. Tolan reports 100,000+ subscribers, over two million hours of user engagement, and a 4.8-star App Store rating across 160,000+ reviews. It is a mobile-first, direct-to-consumer product with no public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface; this profile captures the company identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Torch
providers.description: Torch (Redfish Labs, Inc. dba Torch Leadership Labs) is a leadership development and executive coaching platform that pairs expert human coaches with AI to help mid-market and enterprise organizations grow leaders and navigate change. Its offerings include Change Coaching (leaders-turned-coaches trained in Torch's change approach), the Spark AI coaching agent (always-on AI guidance for practicing conversations and turning insight into progress), and Organizational Intelligence (real-time visibility into change patterns and people dynamics). Torch focuses on AI transformation, organizational restructuring, organizational resilience, and leadership growth, and counts Airbnb, Reddit, Tripadvisor, FICO, and Twitch among its customers. Torch is a SaaS product with SSO (SAML), Zoom, and Slack integrations but publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Upciti
providers.description: Upciti is a French smart-city company that equips cities with intelligent computer-vision sensors and the Upciti OS platform, turning streets into clear, anonymous data for informed municipal decisions across parking, mobility, energy, water, gas, lighting, temperature, weather, air quality, pollen, illegal dumping, and noise. Sensors process video 100% locally with no image storage (GDPR-native, DTPR-supporting), and the platform advertises an open API for connecting GIS, BI, and business tools with no proprietary lock-in. Product documentation is customer-gated.

providers.name: Vector.ai
providers.description: Vector.ai, now operating as Raft (raft.ai), is an AI-powered logistics automation platform for freight forwarders, customs brokers, and trade finance teams. The Raft Intelligence Engine layers organization data, contextual LLMs, orchestration, and specialized governed agents to automate document processing, invoice matching, data extraction, and exception handling across supply chain operations, reporting 20M+ tasks completed by AI agents and 5M+ shipments processed annually. Raft publishes no public developer API; the platform is an enterprise application that integrates with customers' TMS and ERP systems.

providers.name: Velocia
providers.description: Velocia is a transit ridership solutions company that uses real-time rewards, incentives, and digital tools to increase public-transit ridership and engagement for transit agencies and cities. Its programs include a Rider Incentive Program, Transit Ambassador Program, Mobility Wallet, rider surveys, an Automated Guaranteed Ride Home Program, and Major Event Solutions, integrated into transit apps to drive behavior change. Velocia partners with agencies and mobility services such as Miami-Dade County, King County Metro, Seattle DOT, Lime, Zipcar, Uber, Lyft, and CitiBike Miami. Founded in 2018 and based in Toronto, Velocia is a Techstars-backed company. This profile has no public developer/API surface at enrichment time.

providers.name: Vetted
providers.description: Vetted (formerly Lustre) is a San Francisco based AI-powered shopping research assistant that helps consumers find the best products and lowest prices. The service analyzes reviews and recommendations from trusted sources such as Reddit, YouTube, user reviews, and expert articles to surface the most recommended brands and products for a shopper's needs, then compares retailers to identify the best available price. Vetted is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience, and is backed by Index Ventures. It exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time (api.vetted.ai serves the mobile apps as a private backend). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Vodafone
providers.description: Vodafone Group plc is a UK-headquartered (Newbury, England) multinational telecommunications company and one of the world's largest mobile and fixed network operators, with operations in 15 country markets and partner-market agreements covering 40+ additional countries across Europe and Africa. The group serves 279 million mobile customers, 5 million business customers, and manages 215+ million IoT connections through its Vodafone IoT platform. Beyond mobile and broadband connectivity, Vodafone operates one of the largest IoT/M2M businesses in the industry, invests in 70+ subsea cables, and runs financial services like M-PESA (Africa) and Vodapay. Through Vodafone Business it sells connectivity, cloud, security, and managed-mobility services to enterprises, and through the GSMA Open Gateway and CAMARA initiative it exposes a growing portfolio of standardised network APIs (Number Verify, SIM Swap, Quality on Demand, Device Location, Match, MVNO Discovery, and more) via the Vodafone Developer Marketplace (developer.vodafone.com), which publishes 27+ commercial and CAMARA APIs across Identity, Mobile, Analytics, Boost/QoS, and Partner categories. The Marketplace exposes sandbox and live endpoints under api-sandbox.vf-dmp.engineering.vodafone.com and api.vf-dmp.engineering.vodafone.com, with OAuth2 (Consumer Key / Consumer Secret) authentication and Postman collections for every product. Vodafone is a premier member of the CAMARA alliance hosted at the Linux Foundation, a founding participant in the GSMA Open Gateway, and one of the principal telco operators driving network-as-an-API adoption globally.

providers.name: wayup
providers.description: WayUp is a US early-career job and internship marketplace that connects college students and recent graduates with roles at 3,800+ vetted employers. Founded as Campus Job and rebranded WayUp in 2015, it was acquired by campus-recruiting company Yello in 2021. Candidates upload a resume and are matched to entry-level jobs, internships, and virtual career fairs, while employers use WayUp for early-talent sourcing and diversity recruiting. As of this profile WayUp publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its surface is a consumer web application plus a Help Scout knowledge base. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

providers.name: WiredScore
providers.description: WiredScore is the global standard-setting organization for digital connectivity and smart technology in the built environment. It assesses, benchmarks, and certifies buildings through two programs — WiredScore (digital connectivity) and SmartScore (smart building technology) — across office, residential, industrial, and hotel asset types. Landlords, developers, and occupiers in more than 40 countries use its certifications and its network of Accredited Professionals to demonstrate that a building meets modern technology and connectivity expectations; over 4,000 buildings covering roughly one billion square feet have been certified. WiredScore is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Fifth Wall. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Yogaia
providers.description: Yogaia is a Finnish online fitness company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Espoo, that streams live and on-demand yoga, Pilates, meditation, and workout classes to members on any device. Backed by Point Nine, Inventure, and Sanoma, the service runs as a consumer subscription product (web and mobile apps) with sessions ranging from three-minute quick practices to sixty-minute relaxation programs. As of this enrichment pass Yogaia publishes no public developer program, API reference, or SDKs; its api.yogaia.com host serves the session-based web application backend rather than a documented public API. This profile was surfaced as a Point Nine portfolio lead and is enriched here with verified identity, public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: YQN
providers.description: YQN is a global digital logistics platform and NVOCC / digital freight forwarder founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. It lets shippers compare rates, book, and manage international sea freight, air freight, and rail freight, multimodal transport, trucking, customs clearance, cargo insurance, and overseas warehousing online. YQN operates 25+ global branches across North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East with 1,500+ employees, 300+ shipping and airline partners, and 3,500+ supplier resources. It integrates directly with carriers such as Lufthansa Cargo via carrier APIs for rate-checking, allotment booking, and digital bill-of-lading generation. YQN holds FIATA, IATA, and NVOCC certifications, but publishes no public developer API portal or documentation.

providers.name: Ziro
providers.description: Zíro (somosziro.com) is a Colombian fintech that provides interest-free credit for small retailers in the traditional commerce channel. Its platform lets distributors and manufacturers extend "crédito sin intereses" to the small shops they supply, while the supplier receives guaranteed payment and Zíro assumes the credit risk. The service bundles identity verification (Colombian cédula), automated credit evaluation, and fraud prevention into the ordering flow. Zíro is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes only a public marketing site and a customer-facing credit application (an Angular SPA at creditos.somosziro.com); no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server was found. The api.somosziro.com host exists but responds 403 (internal, not publicly documented).

providers.name: 24Symbols
providers.description: 24Symbols is a digital reading subscription service, often described as a "Spotify for books," giving readers unlimited access to a catalog of more than 500,000 e-books across Spanish, English, German, Italian, Portuguese, and French for a flat monthly fee. Founded in Madrid and backed by Seedcamp, the platform lets subscribers read on smartphones, tablets, e-readers, and the web, build personal bookshelves, track reading progress, and follow other readers and authors through its social reading community. Alongside its consumer premium plan, 24Symbols offers B2B "reading space" solutions that let hotels, telecoms, media outlets, educational institutions, and loyalty or employee programs license library access for their audiences. The company operates as a consumer- and business-facing subscription product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface; this profile captures its verifiable identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Arbor
providers.description: Arbor is a consumer energy savings service operating in deregulated electricity markets across 13 states in the U.S. Northeast, Midwest, and Texas. The Arbor app analyzes a household's current electricity supply rate, matches the customer with vetted alternative suppliers, and automatically switches them to a lower-cost plan when one becomes available, all without changing the utility provider, interrupting service, or charging the customer. Arbor earns revenue through referral fees from energy suppliers rather than from consumers. Founded in 2022 by Andrew Meyer (previously co-founder of Swell Energy), Arbor is backed by First Round Capital, Obvious Ventures, Spring Tide Capital, and Blisce. Arbor is a consumer-facing application and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Auxilius
providers.description: Auxilius is R&D finance automation software for biopharmaceutical companies, purpose-built to manage clinical trial finances. The platform automates clinical expense accruals and financial close with built-in audit controls, tracks investigator grant spend by mapping patient-visit data to site contracts, and models and re-forecasts study spend as trial conditions change. It integrates with clinical (Medrio, Veeva), financial (Oracle NetSuite, Workday, SAP, QuickBooks), procurement (Coupa, Bill.com), and planning (Planful, Anaplan) systems, delivering variance analysis, automated reconciliation, and audit-ready role-based approval workflows. Auxilius is SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and is used by 100+ biopharma companies. It is backed by Bain Capital Ventures. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Boeing
providers.description: Boeing is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and sells airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and telecommunications equipment. Boeing Developer Tools provides aviation data APIs powered by Jeppesen aeronautical databases, covering aircraft models, airport data, airspace information, NOTAMs, flight events, and runway operations.

providers.name: Cadence Design Systems
providers.description: Cadence Design Systems is a multinational electronic design automation (EDA) software and hardware company. Cadence provides tools for designing integrated circuits, systems on chips, printed circuit boards, and pharmaceutical drugs, with a portfolio that includes Virtuoso, Spectre, Genus, Innovus, JasperGold, Xcelium, Palladium, Allegro, OrCAD, and AI tools such as Cerebrus and ChipGPT.

providers.name: caimitech
providers.description: caimitech.com is the domain of Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co.), a Chinese personal-finance and wealth-management company founded in 2009 that offers accounting/bookkeeping apps, personal financial management (PFM) tools, wealth-management services, and credit solutions. Its developer surface is the Wacai Open Platform (挖财开放平台) — an HMAC-signed API gateway addressed by (api_name, api_version) pairs rather than REST paths, with first-party client SDKs in Java (published to Maven Central under com.wacai), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#, plus a separate topic-based message gateway (pull/ack). Access uses an app_key/app_secret credential with MAC or RSA request signing and an optional token service. No OpenAPI document is published; this profile was enriched from the provider's public GitHub SDKs and package registries.

providers.name: Cardinal Health
providers.description: Cardinal Health is a Fortune 15 global integrated healthcare services and products company that provides pharmaceutical distribution, medical-surgical product distribution, and customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. Cardinal Health does not publish a public developer portal, but it exchanges high volumes of B2B trading data with customers and suppliers via standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 810, 855, 856, 846, 832, 867) over AS2, SFTP, and private API channels. Third-party EDI platforms such as Orderful, Crossfire, SPS Commerce, Zenbridge, DataTrans, Alluvia, ConnectPointz, and Spark Shipping offer managed connectors into Cardinal Health for order-to-cash, inventory, and supply-chain automation.

providers.name: CareFusion (BD)
providers.description: CareFusion is a medical technology brand, acquired by BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) in 2015, best known for the Alaris infusion system and the Pyxis automated dispensing product line. CareFusion does not expose a public developer API; instead, its devices and dispensing systems interoperate with hospital EMRs and pharmacy systems over HL7 v2 messaging, smart-pump interoperability middleware, and vendor-managed integration services. The Alaris Infusion Interoperability program wirelessly transmits orders from EMRs (such as Epic and Cerner) into Alaris large-volume and syringe modules and returns infusion status back to the EMR in near real time, using the Alaris Guardrails drug library as a safety layer.

providers.name: Chasi
providers.description: Chasi (Chasi AI) is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company building an AI revenue engine for the equipment industry — sales, rental, and service. Chasi deploys AI agents that plug into an equipment dealer or rental company's existing stack and work around the clock to handle lead intake, quoting, CRM updates, follow-ups, and booking coordination, so teams respond faster, sell more, and maximize fleet utilization without adding headcount. Founded in 2025 by Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh, the company targets an industry where fleet utilization often sits below 60% and reps lose hours each day to email, voicemail, and manual data entry. Chasi ships a Clerk-authenticated tenant application at app.chasi.ai, a first-party iOS app, an interactive demo, a Rootly-hosted status page, and a trust center, and is live with equipment businesses in the US and Europe — but as of August 2026 it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP server, agent card, or SDK, and its go-to-market is sales-led through a booked demo and a 90-day pilot.

providers.name: City National Bank
providers.description: City National Bank is a national bank chartered in the United States and a wholly owned subsidiary of Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) since 2015, headquartered in Los Angeles, California and known historically as "the bank to the stars" for its deep roots in the entertainment industry. With roughly $98 billion in assets, it is an FDIC-insured, super-regional institution offering personal, business, and private banking, wealth management, treasury management, and capital markets services, with industry expertise across entertainment, healthcare, real estate, technology, and law. City National operates as CN Bank in Florida. It runs NO first-party public developer portal or documented public API: developer.cnb.com and developers.cnb.com do not resolve and api.cnb.com returns 404. Consistent with the voluntary, fragmented US open-finance model, consumer-permissioned account data is reached through third-party aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) rather than a direct City National API. As a covered depository institution it falls under the emerging CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule, but no City-National-specific 1033 or FDX participation posture is publicly documented. Its Canadian parent RBC runs a separate developer portal (developer.rbc.com) under a different charter that does not expose City National Bank APIs.

providers.name: Columbia Sportswear
providers.description: Columbia Sportswear is a global designer, marketer, and distributor of outdoor, active, and everyday lifestyle apparel, footwear, accessories, and equipment under the Columbia, Mountain Hardwear, SOREL, and prAna brands. Columbia Sportswear Digital operates a partner-focused developer portal on Microsoft Azure API Management at columbia.portal.azure-api.net, exposing APIs for Order Management, Consumer Management, Product Lifecycle Management, Cognitive, Weather, and Translation. The developer portal is gated: registered partners create an account, browse products and APIs, request subscription keys, and integrate against the published endpoints. The company also exchanges traditional EDI documents (POs, ASNs, invoices) with retail trading partners through providers like TrueCommerce and eZCom.

providers.name: ConnectRN
providers.description: connectRN is a Waltham, Massachusetts based per-diem (PRN) healthcare staffing marketplace that connects nurses, CNAs and allied clinicians with open shifts at hospitals, home health and hospice agencies, and skilled nursing facilities across the United States. Clinicians browse and claim shifts through the connectRN mobile app with no minimum commitment, no required weekends or holidays, and same-day pay; facilities post shifts, auto-backfill open coverage and approve timesheets through a web platform at app.connectrn.com. In April 2026 connectRN merged with SnapCare, combining connectRN's PRN clinician community with SnapCare's Booker workforce technology platform. connectRN operates a public status page but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its API host api.connectrn.com serves the first-party mobile and web applications only.

providers.name: Corca
providers.description: Corca is an AI-native, collaborative workspace for mathematics — a browser-based editor that lets people write math naturally (without special syntax), run calculations in real time, and collaborate the way teams do in Figma or Google Docs. Typing keywords like "sum" or "integral" surfaces the right symbols and functions, documents import from and export to LaTeX, and built-in AI helps solve problems, manipulate expressions, and generate code without switching tools. It is used for lab research, lecture creation, team knowledge bases, and publishing academic work. Founded in 2023 and based in New York, Corca raised a $7.8M round (led by NEA, with Bloomberg Beta, NVIDIA's NVentures, Daft Capital, Slow Ventures, Liquid 2, Path Ventures, and Mana Ventures). The product is a consumer/team SaaS application; no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Culture Biosciences
providers.description: Culture Biosciences is a South San Francisco TechBio company that builds cloud-connected bioreactor systems and bioprocess development services for cell culture. Its platform pairs automated single-use bioreactors (250mL bench-scale and 5L, plus the Stratyx mobile bioreactor) with Console, a cloud-native software product for real-time monitoring, experiment management, data analytics, and remote collaboration. Through its Nexxys services group the company runs clone/strain/construct screening, process characterization, process development, and bioprocess modeling and simulation for customers working on synthetic biology, protein therapeutics, and viral vectors. Culture Biosciences lets teams outsource and scale bioreactor experiments without scaling their own lab infrastructure. Backed by DCVC, Northpond Ventures, Synthesis Capital, S32, and Cultivian Sandbox Ventures. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company operates the Console cloud platform but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Domino's Pizza
providers.description: Domino's Pizza is a major US quick-service restaurant corporation and Fortune 1000 company. Domino's does NOT publish an official public developer API or a developer portal. Its digital ordering surface is delivered through consumer channels - the dominos.com website, the Domino's mobile apps, and the "AnyWare" ordering platform (text, voice, smart TV, Amazon Echo, Google Home, and more), including the "Dom" virtual voice ordering assistant. The undocumented HTTP endpoints behind these first-party apps have been reverse-engineered by the developer community into well-known UNOFFICIAL wrapper libraries (the npm "dominos" / node-dominos-pizza-api package and the Python "pizzapi" / "dominos" packages). These community libraries are not endorsed, supported, or warranted by Domino's. Domino's does expose APIs to select delivery-marketplace partners (e.g. Uber Eats, Just Eat) through direct partnership and a private Postman workspace, but these are not publicly available. No official API specification, pricing, or rate-limit policy is published.

providers.name: Flow Commerce (Global E)
providers.description: Flow Commerce (now part of Global-e) is a cross-border ecommerce platform that lets online merchants localize the entire international shopping experience. It provides localized pricing in 100+ currencies, localized checkout with international payment methods, guaranteed landed-cost (duties and taxes) calculation, international shipping and returns, fraud and compliance handling, and localized product feeds. Flow exposes these capabilities as a REST API defined in APIBuilder, with first-party Ruby and Node.js client SDKs generated from that service definition. Flow.io was acquired by Global-e and now operates as part of the Global-e cross-border enablement platform.

providers.name: Fuse
providers.description: Fuse Energy is a UK retail energy supplier providing gas and electricity to homes and businesses, alongside EV charging, solar and battery storage tracking with grid export, and smart home energy management. The company emphasises savings against the UK price cap, a fast (~3 minute) online sign-up, automated supplier switching, and 24/7 customer support including an AI assistant called "Plugs". Fuse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a consumer/business energy web and mobile experience and does not publish a public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Fuse Energy
providers.description: Fuse Energy (Fuse Energy Supply Limited) is a UK-based residential and business energy supplier providing gas and electricity on variable, fixed, and multi-rate tariffs, alongside EV charging, solar and battery export tracking, multi-property account management, and an in-app AI energy assistant called Plugs. The company positions itself around beating the UK energy price cap, sign-up in under three minutes, and 24-hour customer support. It operates a consumer- and business-facing web and mobile app experience and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Invesdor
providers.description: Invesdor is a pan-European crowdinvesting and digital investment platform that connects private and professional investors with companies raising capital through equity, subordinated loans, and bonds, with minimum tickets starting around EUR 250. Founded in Finland in 2012 and expanded through mergers with Finnest, Kapilendo, and Oneplanetcrowd, Invesdor now serves more than 180,000 investors across Europe and has channeled over EUR 600 million into more than 1,000 renewable-energy, scale-up, and SME financing rounds. It operates as a regulated investment firm under the EU Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP) regime. Invesdor does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, investor, and legal surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: JD Technology
providers.description: JD Technology Group (京东科技集团) is the technology and cloud subsidiary of JD.com, delivering digital-transformation services to government, financial institutions, and enterprises. Its primary developer surface is JD Cloud (京东云), a full-stack public cloud offering compute, storage, databases, networking, AI, security, and industry solutions exposed through the JD Cloud OpenAPI. Developers integrate via signed (access-key / secret-key) OpenAPI calls to per-service endpoints, and JD Technology publishes first-party SDKs for Java, Go, Python, PHP, .NET, Node.js and iOS plus a cross-platform command line (jdc) on GitHub. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and enriched from JD Technology's public developer surfaces.

providers.name: Keystatic
providers.description: Keystatic is an open source, Git-based content management system that stores content as Markdown, JSON, and YAML directly in a project's Git repository. The Keystatic Reader API is a Node.js library that lets applications read Keystatic content from any local directory or GitHub repository server-side, supporting frameworks like Next.js, Astro, Remix, and React Server Components.

providers.name: Lendable
providers.description: Lendable Ltd is a UK consumer lending fintech founded in 2014 and headquartered in London, offering unsecured personal loans directly to borrowers through a fully digital application. The company underwrites with technology and data analytics rather than relying on a credit score alone, describing its approach as looking at all of an applicant's data together to produce a personalised quote in minutes without paper forms or branch visits. Lendable distributes through the major UK price-comparison platforms including ClearScore, Compare the Market, MoneySuperMarket, Experian, TotallyMoney, TransUnion and Go.Compare. It is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA reference 720261, company number 08828186) and is a CIFAS member. Lendable publishes no public developer API or developer portal — its public technical surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt, an llms.txt, and a set of first-party open source PHP/Symfony engineering libraries on Packagist and GitHub.

providers.name: Lore
providers.description: Lore is a multichain wallet for groups to win together, a co-ownership platform that lets collectives launch shared, multi-signature Safe wallets across Solana, Ethereum, Base, Blast, and Arbitrum. Its Co-Ownership Framework is an equity-tracking system over shared Vaults that lets a group start small and grow both assets and members over time, using Proposals, Group Deposits, Exits, Distributions, and Valuations to manage on-chain treasuries and investment clubs together. Lore provides a consumer application and documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Mobagel
providers.description: MoBagel is an AI and automated machine learning (AutoML) company founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Jose, California, with offices across seven global locations. Its flagship Decanter AI platform lets business users build machine learning models and generate predictions without a data science background, spanning AutoML, automated time-series forecasting (AutoTSF), MLOps, DataOps, and a generative-BI suite (Generative BI, Generative ETL, Generative Expert) now surfaced through the 8ndpoint product and a family of vertical AI agents for marketing, supply chain, finance, and manufacturing. MoBagel exposes Decanter AI programmatically through an official first-party Python SDK (decanter-ai-sdk) that authenticates with an API key and drives data upload, model training, and prediction. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Mosaic Manufacturing
providers.description: Mosaic Manufacturing is a Toronto-based additive manufacturing company building automated, high-volume FFF 3D printing systems for factory-floor production of end-use polymer parts. Its flagship Array platform combines integrated robotics, intelligent scheduling software, and high-performance fused-filament-fabrication printers so manufacturers can cut part costs and run true production at scale. Mosaic also makes the Palette line of multi-material hardware and Canvas (canvas3d.io), a cloud/web software platform for file preparation, color/slice, print scheduling, and fleet management. As of this enrichment pass Mosaic publishes no public product API or OpenAPI-described developer surface; its developer-facing presence is the open-source MosaicManufacturing GitHub organization (3MF tooling, slicer post-processing, and firmware) plus a hosted support/knowledge-base portal.

providers.name: Nookly
providers.description: Nookly is a personalized children's content platform that helps the adults who care for a child — parents, teachers, therapists, and early-childhood organizations — turn their intimate knowledge of that child into custom stories, songs, visual schedules, social stories, emotion cards, and behavior supports. Grounded in social-emotional learning and behavioral science, it produces developmentally appropriate, COPPA/FERPA-compliant content for children ages 2-11, with particular value for neurodivergent kids (autism, ADHD, speech delays, anxiety, and sensory processing differences). Used across homes, classrooms, and clinics in 50+ states.

providers.name: Office Luv
providers.description: OfficeLuv is office management and purchasing software that centralizes all of a workplace's ordering into a single platform. It aggregates dozens of vendors and thousands of products (supplies, snacks, cleaning supplies, groceries, and more) into one unified marketplace with consolidated invoicing, spend analytics and reporting, multi-user approval workflows, employee stipends for remote and in-office staff, and optional on-site service for program design, pricing negotiation, and restocking. Customers include Wayfair, Braze, Glassdoor, Hulu, and Upwork. Office Luv was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is delivered as a private SaaS web application (app.officeluv.com); no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Oscar
providers.description: Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR) is a technology-driven health insurance company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City. It offers individual and family health plans, small-business and ICHRA employer benefits, and Medicare Advantage in a growing set of U.S. states, pairing coverage with a consumer mobile app, 24/7 virtual urgent care, telemedicine, primary care, and concierge Care Teams. Oscar's +Oscar division licenses its full-stack technology platform (Campaign Builder and other tools) to other payers and providers. The company is NCQA-accredited across Health Plan, Utilization Management, Credentialing, Provider Network, and Health Equity programs. Oscar is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As a CMS-regulated payer it is subject to the Interoperability and Patient Access rule, though it does not currently publish an open, self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Overstory
providers.description: Overstory provides AI-powered vegetation intelligence for electric utilities and grid operators. The platform fuses high-resolution satellite and aerial imagery with machine learning to detect vegetation encroachment, hazard trees, and wildfire risk along power line corridors, helping utilities prioritize trimming, optimize vegetation management spend, and improve grid reliability (SAIDI). Overstory was founded as 20tree.ai and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company. As of this profile the company delivers its intelligence through a customer platform and services rather than a public developer API; no public API documentation, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: OWASP API Security Project
providers.description: The OWASP API Security Project focuses on strategies and solutions to understand and mitigate the unique vulnerabilities and security risks of Application Programming Interfaces. The project produces and maintains the OWASP API Security Top 10, a community-driven list of the most critical API security risks for developers, architects, and security professionals.

providers.name: Partsimony
providers.description: Partsimony is an intelligent supply chain platform that helps hardware companies turn engineering designs into manufactured products with less time, cost, and friction. Its software analyzes component designs to recommend manufacturing methods, materials, price estimates, and lead times, then matches each part to the optimal manufacturers inside and outside a company's network — batching components for volume leverage across processes like 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, castings, electronics, and assemblies. The platform also coordinates RFPs, proposals, orders, messaging, and payment terms between OEMs and their manufacturing partners. Partsimony operates a web application and product documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and based in Brooklyn, NY; backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Rome Tools
providers.description: Rome Tools, Inc. was the company behind Rome, a unified, Rust-based developer toolchain for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, HTML, Markdown, and CSS, intended to consolidate the roles of a formatter, linter, compiler, and bundler (replacing tools like Babel, ESLint, webpack, and Prettier) into a single fast tool. Rome shipped as a command-line tool and VS Code extension rather than as a hosted web service, so it has no REST/HTTP API, OpenAPI, webhook, or event surface. The project's GitHub repository (github.com/rome/tools) was archived on 2026-07-21 as read-only, the rome.tools domain no longer resolves, and the effort has been succeeded by the community-maintained Biome project (biomejs.dev). Rome Tools was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment confirms it is a defunct open-source CLI toolchain with no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Runwise
providers.description: Runwise provides wireless smart-control systems that automate heating, cooling, water, and gas infrastructure in multifamily and commercial buildings. Its retrofit hardware and cloud platform replace legacy boiler, steam, and HVAC controls, cutting heating, cooling, and water bills by roughly 23% with same-day installation. Runwise reports more than 10,300 buildings under management and over $175 million in cumulative utility savings for customers. The company is backed by Fifth Wall, Initialized Capital, and Menlo Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks Runwise's public web presence; as of this pass no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface has been identified.

providers.name: Solar Mosaic
providers.description: Solar Mosaic, Inc. (trading as Mosaic) was a residential clean-energy lender founded in Oakland, California in 2010, originally as a solar crowdfunding platform and from 2014 as a point-of-sale financing platform for residential solar, battery storage and other sustainable home improvements funded through third-party capital partners. Mosaic originated loans through a dealer/installer channel and backed more than $15 billion in home energy loans across roughly 360,000 households. Its integration surface for installer and capital partners was the Mosaic Financing API, documented on a password-protected ReadMe developer portal at developer.joinmosaic.com. Solar Mosaic filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the Southern District of Texas on 2025-06-09 and its loan portfolio was acquired in September 2025 by Solar Servicing LLC, which stated it would not originate new solar loans. As of this profile the joinmosaic.com website 301-redirects to solarservicingllc.com, the api.joinmosaic.com host returns HTTP 503, and the Mosaic status page reports "Page Inactive".

providers.name: Spectora
providers.description: Spectora is home inspection software used by more than 10,000 inspectors to build inspection reports, schedule jobs, manage clients and agents, run a website, take payments, and automate follow-up. Spectora does NOT publish a public, self-serve developer REST API and there is no developer portal, API reference, or API keys for third-party programmatic access as of this writing. Integration with outside systems is instead delivered three ways: (1) a Zapier integration (requires the paid Spectora Advanced add-on) that fires triggers when agent or client contacts are created or updated; (2) outbound webhooks configured through Advanced Actions that POST event data to a URL you supply (e.g. Zapier, Make, or your own endpoint); and (3) a fixed set of named, vendor-built partner integrations (QuickBooks Online, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Mailchimp, HomeBinder, RecallChek, Repair Pricer, Blipp Reviews, InterNACHI BuyBack, and call-center partners). All of these are configuration-time connectors and one-way (outbound) event flows rather than a documented request/response API you can call.

providers.name: Tamr
providers.description: An enterprise data management company that uses machine learning to automate the mastering, enrichment, and classification of messy data across disparate sources. Helps large organizations unify customer, supplier, and product data to power analytics and AI initiatives.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Vectren (CenterPoint Energy)
providers.description: Vectren Corporation was a Fortune 1000 energy holding company headquartered in Evansville (Newburgh), Indiana providing regulated natural gas and electric distribution services to customers in Indiana and Ohio, along with non-regulated infrastructure services and energy efficiency programs. Vectren merged with CenterPoint Energy on February 1, 2019 in a $6 billion transaction, becoming part of the combined company which serves over 7 million metered customers across Arkansas, Indiana, Louisiana, Minnesota, Mississippi, Ohio, Oklahoma, and Texas. Vectren customer-facing portals continue to operate at vectren.com redirecting to CenterPoint Energy services.

providers.name: 10% Happier
providers.description: 10% Happier (now branded Happier Meditation) is a consumer meditation and mindfulness app founded on the best-selling book "10% Happier" by ABC News anchor Dan Harris. The service delivers personalized, science-backed guided meditations, courses, and sleep content from well-known teachers through native iOS and Android apps and a web player, aimed at helping skeptics and busy people build a sustainable mindfulness practice for stress, sleep, focus, and relationships. It operates on a subscription model. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; 10% Happier is a direct-to-consumer app and does not publish a public developer API, so this record captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: 1stdibs
providers.description: 1stDibs is an online marketplace for luxury antiques, vintage and modern furniture, fine art, jewelry, watches, and fashion. It connects a global network of vetted sellers and design dealers with buyers seeking curated, authenticated high-end goods, backed by purchase-protection and authenticity guarantees. 1stDibs does not operate a public REST/OpenAPI developer program; its documented machine-facing surface is an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, registered as com.1stdibs/1stDibs, that lets agents browse and search the marketplace.

providers.name: 82 Labs
providers.description: 82 Labs, Inc. (doing business as More Labs) is a Los Angeles-based, science-backed wellness beverage company founded in 2016 by former Tesla engineer Sisun Lee. More Labs makes functional drink supplements sold direct-to-consumer, including Morning Recovery (hydration and post-alcohol recovery with electrolytes and DHM), Liquid Focus (a nootropic caffeine energy shot), and Dream Well (a melatonin and lemon-balm sleep aid). It is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) and e-commerce business with no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; it was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Enrichment on 2026-07-17 confirmed no API surface exists to harvest.

providers.name: Agebold
providers.description: Agebold, which operates as Bold, is a digital healthy-aging platform for adults 65 and older, delivered as a covered benefit through Medicare Advantage plans and other Medicare organizations. Bold offers personalized, science-backed exercise programs shown to reduce fall risk, ease musculoskeletal pain, and increase physical activity, alongside nutrition and weight-loss support (including GLP-1 care), live classes, expert talks, and virtual access to doctors, therapists, and nurse practitioners in select states. The company partners with health plans to improve quality measures, Star Ratings, HOS performance, and total cost of care. Agebold is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Air Doctor
providers.description: Air Doctor is a digital health platform that connects travelers and people living abroad with a global network of vetted private doctors and specialists, offering in-person clinic visits, home visits, and telemedicine appointments in multiple languages across more than 75 countries. Users search for and book local doctors through the Air Doctor mobile app and web app, and the company operates a large B2B business embedding its provider network into travel insurance, assistance, and health-plan partners (including brands such as Allianz Global Assistance, ERGO, World Nomads, and Charles Taylor). Air Doctor is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, partner, and web surface; Air Doctor does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time, so this profile is maintained as an identity and web-property record.

providers.name: Aiwyn
providers.description: Aiwyn is a practice-automation platform built for modern accounting and CPA firms, unifying payments, practice management, client experience, and tax into a single relationship-centered system. Aiwyn Payments automates invoicing, card and ACH collection, and reconciliation; Aiwyn Practice covers time, billing, project management and resource planning; Aiwyn Experience delivers a unified client portal for engagement letters and secure document exchange; and Aiwyn Tax adds AI-assisted tax preparation. The company serves 800+ firms and raised $113M from KKR and Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company; Aiwyn publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, its published llms.txt, and probed domain security.

providers.name: Albert
providers.description: Albert Invent (Albert Invent Corp.) builds an AI-native operating system for chemistry and materials R&D, giving scientists a unified platform for electronic lab notebooks, chemical drawing, experiment and formulation management, and machine-learning models trained on millions of molecular structures. The platform centralizes fragmented R&D data and workflows for teams inventing new materials across adhesives, coatings, batteries, and life sciences, with role-based access control and regulatory compliance coverage across hundreds of thousands of chemical substances. Albert Invent does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation (its docs surface is password-protected); this profile captures the company's public web, product, legal, and domain-security surface as a lead awaiting a public API. Headquartered in Oakland, California.

providers.name: Alix
providers.description: Alix is an estate settlement service that pairs technology with human experts — Settlement Specialists, fiduciaries, CPAs, and probate attorneys — to execute the 150+ administrative, legal, financial, and tax tasks required to settle an estate after a death. It coordinates probate court filings, asset discovery (50-state unclaimed-property and federal life-insurance searches, hidden 401(k)s and bank accounts), estate bank-account and IRS EIN setup, creditor and debt negotiation, final personal (1040) and estate (1041) tax filings, property liquidation and estate sales, and the legally compliant distribution of funds to beneficiaries — while keeping the executor informed through a dedicated app. Alix charges a flat 1% of gross estate value (minimum $9,000, $2,500 initial deposit). Backed by Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Apna
providers.description: Apna is India's leading professional networking and job-search platform, headquartered in Mumbai, India. Job seekers use Apna to search and apply to jobs online for free, join profession and location-based community groups, build a professional profile, and prepare for interviews, while employers post job vacancies and hire quality candidates in as little as 48 hours. Apna is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. At the time of this profile Apna does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this entry captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Applied Intuition
providers.description: Applied Intuition builds physical AI software and systems for intelligent machines, helping customers develop, test, validate, deploy, and operate autonomy and vehicle intelligence across automotive, defense, trucking, mining, construction, and agriculture. Its product lines include a Self-Driving System (a unified autonomy stack for land, air, and sea), Vehicle OS (an operating system for intelligent machines), and Tools for Vehicle Intelligence covering simulation, validation, data, training, and evaluation workflows. The company operates as a private enterprise vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API or self-service portal; this profile captures its public identity, security posture, and machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: ARRIS Group
providers.description: ARRIS Group was a global telecommunications equipment company providing entertainment and communications solutions including broadband, video, and wireless products for service providers and consumers. ARRIS was acquired by CommScope in 2019, combining their broadband technology expertise with CommScope's infrastructure solutions.
