The combined company offers cable modem equipment, set-top boxes, network infrastructure, DOCSIS technology, and related telecommunications hardware and software platforms for cable operators, telcos, and internet service providers worldwide.

providers.name: Ascena Retail Group
providers.description: Ascena Retail Group was a specialty apparel retailer that operated multiple women's and tween-girl clothing brands through retail stores, outlets, and e-commerce. The company operated brands including Ann Taylor, LOFT, Lane Bryant, Catherines, Cacique, and others. Ascena filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in July 2020 and sold off its brands. Ann Taylor and LOFT were acquired by Sycamore Partners in 2020 and continue to operate. Lane Bryant and Catherines were also sold to new owners. The company did not expose a public developer API during its operation. Current API resources, if any, exist under the successor brand owners.

providers.name: Bariendo Inc.
providers.description: Bariendo Inc. (now operating as Everself) is a science-forward digital health company pioneering non-surgical, endoscopic weight-loss care. Founded in 2023 by Harvard Medical School physicians Dr. Christopher C. Thompson (the inventor of Endoscopic Sleeve Gastroplasty) and Dr. Pichamol Jirapinyo, the company delivers minimally invasive procedures — ESG Stomach Tightening, gastric balloon, and revision of prior bariatric surgery — alongside weight-loss medication and a 12-month concierge care program. Its consumer platform streamlines access to these interventions across a dozen-plus U.S. locations, with financing, telehealth consultations, and ongoing weight tracking. Bariendo/Everself is a consumer and clinical health service; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: Betr
providers.description: Betr (Betr Holdings, Inc.) is a Miami-based real-money gaming and sports media company founded in 2022 by Joey Levy and Jake Paul on a $50M Series A. Betr operates a consumer "real money gaming super app" spanning Betr Picks (real-money pick'em daily fantasy sports across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, UFC and golf), a micro-betting sportsbook launched in Ohio in January 2023, a social sportsbook and social casino, Betr Arcade, and Betr Media (podcasts, creator content and digital sports programming). Betr is a business-to-consumer operator: it publishes mobile apps, a Webflow marketing site, an Intercom-hosted help center and an llms.txt discovery file, but as of this profiling round it publishes no public developer API program, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, and no SDKs. Its API hosts (api.betr.app, and a staging back-office API documentation host) are private and return 500/403 to anonymous callers.

providers.name: Better Life Partners
providers.description: Better Life Partners is a Hanover, New Hampshire healthcare provider founded in 2018 that delivers same-day, whole-person treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorder across New Hampshire, Maine, Massachusetts, Vermont and North Carolina. It combines FDA-approved medication for addiction treatment (buprenorphine/Suboxone, naltrexone) with group counseling, peer recovery coaching and mental health care, delivered both virtually and in person, on a non-punitive harm-reduction model. The company contracts directly with Medicaid, Medicare and commercial health plans — MaineCare, NH Healthy Families, Anthem, Cigna, Harvard Pilgrim, Tufts, Humana and UnitedHealthcare — and markets value-based arrangements "from bundles to full risk" to payers and community partners. It is a clinical services organization rather than a software vendor: it references "purpose-built technology" internally but publishes no developer program, API, specification, SDK or integration documentation of any kind.

providers.name: Bruce
providers.description: Bruce is a curated professional intro network for licensed real estate, mortgage, title & escrow, and insurance professionals, built by Tanda Technologies, Inc. and founded by Jesse Chor. Rather than a directory, review site, or CRM, Bruce verifies each member's license and role, then lets them log intros and build a portable, verifiable track record. The Bruce Card is each member's living profile — stats, deals, intros, and market rank — that replaces the resume and the "trust me" claim with a sharable credential. Bruce also runs an AI-hosted editorial publication at blog.bruce.bot that profiles verified members in interview-style stories. Backed by Initialized Capital; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

providers.name: CBRE Australia
providers.description: CBRE Australia is the Australian arm of CBRE Group, the global commercial real estate services and investment firm, trading locally as CBRE (Gwsla) Pty Ltd (AU09949) and operating across the Pacific from cbre.com.au. It sits on the advisory and management side of the Australian property value chain rather than the data-infrastructure side: capital markets and investment sales, leasing and occupier advisory, valuation and advisory services, property and asset management, and project and design-and-build delivery across office, retail, industrial and logistics, build-to-rent, and alternative asset classes. Its API posture is closed. As of 26 July 2026 no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable contract, or self-serve onboarding exists for CBRE Australia: developer.cbre.com.au, developers.cbre.com.au, api.cbre.com.au, and docs.cbre.com.au do not resolve, and the global developer.cbre.com host is NXDOMAIN as well. CBRE does run API infrastructure — api.cbre.com sits behind an Imperva WAF that returns 403 to every anonymous request, api-dev.cbre.com serves a default WSO2 API Manager landing page, and eipportal.cbre.com is a login-gated "Integration Platform" SPA — but none of it is published, catalogued, or reachable by an outside developer. Commercial listings are distributed through the cbre.com.au property search and Australia's portal duopoly, and CBRE's terms of use explicitly prohibit scraping property listings from the site. RESO is absent entirely, which is the honest answer for Australia: there is no MLS here, no RESO-certified Australian organization, and the country's mandated machine-readable property rail is PEXA's electronic conveyancing network, not a RESO Web API. Access to CBRE data in Australia is a client or partner relationship, not a developer signup.

providers.name: CLAP
providers.description: CLAP (주식회사 디웨일 / Dwhale Inc.) is a South Korean SaaS company offering an AI-powered, customizable performance management platform for enterprises. It covers the full performance lifecycle — multi-rater evaluations and calibration, OKR-style goal setting and alignment, continuous feedback and 1-on-1 meetings, and CLAP AI for diagnostics, feedback drafting, and automation — with tailored reporting and tool integrations. CLAP serves 1,000+ companies and claims to cut the HR time spent on performance management by up to 80%. The company is headquartered in Gangnam, Seoul, and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. CLAP publishes no public API or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and web properties.

providers.name: Concepts
providers.description: Concepts is a digital sketching and design application built by TopHatch, Inc., offering an infinite, flexible canvas for thinking, planning, illustration, and design across iOS, Android, and Windows. It blends vector and raster drawing with precision tools, adjustable brushes, layers, and a dynamic tool wheel aimed at designers, illustrators, architects, and product teams. Concepts was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer creative application it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or agent surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties along with a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Conservation Labs
providers.description: Conservation Labs is a Pittsburgh-based smart water technology company, backed by Techstars, Amazon, RET Ventures and SustainVC. Its flagship product, H2know, is a clamp-on acoustic smart water monitor that measures a building's inbound pipe every second and uses patented sound-detection technology and machine learning to translate those signals into accurate water-flow estimates, leak alerts and water-usage insights delivered through a companion mobile and web app. The company also offers Sustainable Machines, an edge-to-cloud platform for machine condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Conservation Labs serves residential homes, commercial real estate, restaurants and hotels, and industrial operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing app but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook documentation.

providers.name: Doctor on Demand
providers.description: Doctor on Demand is a telehealth platform offering 24/7 virtual medical care through video visits with board-certified clinicians. Services span urgent care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, primary care, and preventive health, with prescriptions routed to local pharmacies. Now part of Included Health, it serves consumers directly and through employer and health-plan benefit programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, GV, and Shasta Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Doctor on Demand publishes no public developer or partner API program; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Dokku
providers.description: Dokku is an open-source Docker-powered self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service that helps you build and manage the lifecycle of applications from initial push to scaling out. Often described as "the smallest PaaS implementation you've ever seen" and a self-hosted mini-Heroku, Dokku turns a single Linux host (or a multi-host scheduler such as K3s or Nomad) into a git-push deployment target that builds applications from Heroku-compatible buildpacks, Cloud Native Buildpacks, Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfiles, or pre-built Docker images. Dokku is MIT licensed, written primarily in Bash, and maintained by the Dokku organization on GitHub since 2013. It ships an extensive plugin ecosystem covering data stores (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Meilisearch, Typesense), TLS via Let's Encrypt, HTTP basic auth, maintenance mode, redirects, schedulers for Docker, K3s and Nomad, multiple HTTP proxies (Nginx, HAProxy, Caddy, Traefik, OpenResty), CI integrations, and an official GitHub Action. Dokku's primary interface is the `dokku` CLI invoked over SSH; there is no first-party public HTTP REST API in core (the historical `dokku-api` Ruby wrapper is archived and unmaintained).

providers.name: Fable
providers.description: Fable Security is an AI-powered human risk management (HRM) platform that helps security teams reduce incidents by changing employee behavior. It combines behavioral interventions (targeted nudges and AI-generated content), phishing simulations, short-form video awareness briefings, and human-risk reporting into a single platform positioned as a modern replacement for legacy security-awareness training. Fable's AI Studio, Composer, and Briefing Agent generate custom video and audio content - including deepfake and voice-fake simulations - and produce audience-targeted briefings from emerging threats in minutes. The platform reports on human risk and compliance across the workforce and integrates with an organization's identity framework, workspace, and security tooling. Fable serves healthcare, financial services, and technology customers including Sisense, SanDisk, Red Hat, PennyMac, Genesys, and Dayton Children's Hospital, and is backed by Greylock and Techstars.

providers.name: Fable Security
providers.description: Fable Security is a human risk management (HRM) platform that uses AI to reduce employee-driven security risk. The product combines phishing simulations and resilience testing, bite-sized security awareness and compliance training, behavioral interventions (AI-generated video briefings, nudges, and chat), human-risk reporting and analytics, rapid threat-response briefings for emerging threats, and secure AI-enablement programs. Fable is used across healthcare, financial services, and technology organizations to measure employee risk, deliver targeted training, and change unsafe security behavior. The company is backed by Redpoint Ventures. Note: Fable Security does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures the company's public web, security posture, and product changelog surface.

providers.name: Ferra
providers.description: Ferra is a smart home strength-training system for adults aged 50 and over, built by Aroleap Fitness Private Limited in Bengaluru, India. It pairs a compact wall-mounted adaptive-resistance machine with a mobile app that queues a short guided daily workout of seven functional movements, adapts the weight in real time, tracks progress, and lets users share achievements with family. The service is sold as a no-lock-in monthly subscription (Individual, Duo, and Family tiers) billed through UPI auto-debit. Ferra is a consumer product with no public developer platform or API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: Fidocure
providers.description: FidoCure is a translational precision-medicine service for canine cancer, developed by One Health Company and backed by a16z. It combines next-generation genomic sequencing of a dog's tumor at a CLIA-certified (human-grade) lab with tumor profiling and an AI-driven data platform to identify cancer-driving mutations, then recommends personalized targeted therapeutics that veterinarians can prescribe. FidoCure has guided treatment for thousands of dogs across roughly 1,350 clinics and maintains the largest proprietary canine cancer dataset, underpinning peer-reviewed research with Stanford, the Broad Institute, Tufts, and the University of Georgia. FidoCure operates as a veterinarian-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, portal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fortinet
providers.description: Fortinet is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Fortinet API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: FYLD
providers.description: FYLD is an AI-native frontline intelligence platform for the global critical-infrastructure sector, turning field-operations data into real-time, structured intelligence for utilities, energy, and heavy-civils operators. Its products include the FYLD Platform for work execution, FYLD Control Room for remote supervision, and FYLD ShowMe for customer self-service reporting, serving managers, fieldworkers, contractors, and civil engineers via web and mobile (iOS and Android) apps. FYLD is a Partech portfolio company. As of this profile FYLD publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integration is delivered through partnerships such as Procore, and this record captures its public identity, security, and trust surface.

providers.name: Getteal
providers.description: Getteal (Teal Health) is a women's health company offering an FDA-authorized at-home cervical cancer screening kit, the Teal Wand, a self-collection device that lets people collect a sample privately at home and mail it to a laboratory for Primary HPV testing (the same cobas HPV test used in clinics). The service pairs the device with virtual provider consultations, a patient portal for results, insurance and HSA/FSA billing, and support for major U.S. health plans. Getteal is backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it is a consumer digital-health brand with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Grove Health
providers.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

providers.name: Hazel Health
providers.description: Hazel Health is the nation's leading provider of school-based telehealth, delivering virtual physical and mental health care to K-12 students. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hazel partners directly with school districts and families to connect students with licensed, linguistically and culturally diverse clinicians and therapists — at school or at home — often within minutes for medical care and within days for teletherapy, at no cost to families. The company serves more than two million students across 100-plus districts nationwide, helping reduce chronic absenteeism and address gaps in access to care as an extension of the school health team. Hazel operates HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant systems with full encryption and secure access controls. It is a B2B/B2G healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: HEDNA
providers.description: HEDNA (Hotel Electronic Distribution Network Association) is a not-for-profit trade association founded in 1991 and headquartered in Forest Hill, Maryland, United States, that convenes the hotel distribution industry — hotel chains, GDS operators, OTAs, switches, channel managers, payment providers and connectivity vendors — around shared best practice for hospitality electronic distribution. It sits alongside rather than inside the distribution chain: it moves no inventory and processes no bookings, but its Disciplines (Connectivity, Content Distribution, Payments, Data & Analytics, Revenue Optimization) produce recommendation documents, and it co-authored the Open Payments Alliance Standards Specification with HTNG and OpenTravel. HEDNA publishes no developer portal, no API, and no machine-readable specification on hedna.org; every probe of developer./developers./docs./api. subdomains and of /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/ failed (DNS failure or HTTP 404). Its publications library, research reports and HEDNA U courseware are gated behind paid membership at members.hedna.org (HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge unauthenticated) and pathlms.com/hedna. Honest posture: member-gated documents, no public API, no exit path published.

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Imperson
providers.description: Imperson is an enterprise conversational-AI company and creative studio that builds turnkey, premium chatbots to automate the customer journey through natural, two-way dialogue. Its platform spans lead generation, customer support, sales and e-commerce, and engagement/entertainment, with a conversation engine, dashboard analytics, and a knowledgebase, activating across channels including Facebook Messenger, Amazon Alexa, websites, SMS, Google Assistant, native apps, and phone. Imperson operates an enterprise-sales model (no public self-serve developer API is published) and has produced chatbot experiences for brands such as Disney, Microsoft, Amazon, National Geographic, and Universal. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Inovalon
providers.description: Inovalon is a healthcare technology company providing cloud-based data analytics and data-enabled intervention platforms for the healthcare industry. Its Inovalon ONE Platform pairs national-scale primary-source datasets with analytics, workflow, and SaaS applications used by health plans, providers, pharmacies, life-sciences, and specialty organizations for risk adjustment, quality measurement, care-gap closure, and revenue-cycle and claims management (including the ABILITY provider workflow products). Inovalon was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its developer surface is enterprise and auth-gated: the corporate site is WAF-protected and the API host api.inovalon.com requires authentication (HTTP 401); security and compliance posture is published on the public Inovalon Trust Center.

providers.name: Inspire
providers.description: Inspire (Inspire Clean Energy) is a consumer clean-energy company on a mission to transform the way people access clean energy and accelerate a net-zero carbon future. It gives residential customers access to renewable energy for their home electricity supply through flat-rate subscription plans designed to deliver predictability and reduce exposure to electricity rate volatility. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI surface — this is a non-API consumer brand.

providers.name: Insurify
providers.description: Insurify is an insurance comparison marketplace licensed in all 50 U.S. states with real-time API integrations into 120+ carriers (500+ across the carrier network), covering auto, home, renters, pet, commercial auto, life, motorcycle, and travel. Consumers get side-by-side quotes in roughly two minutes and can buy online or through licensed agents. Insurify's Evia AI agent (Expert Virtual Insurance Agent) is a voice-and-chat agent that handles end-to-end shopping conversations with bind-ready quotes and renewal-cycle re-shopping. In February 2026 Insurify launched the insurance industry's first ChatGPT app via OpenAI's app library.

providers.name: Kafene
providers.description: Kafene is a New York-based point-of-sale financing platform that lets retailers offer transparent lease-to-own (LTO) purchase options to prime and non-prime consumers. Founded in 2019 by Neal Desai and James Schuler, the company underwrites shoppers with an AI-driven risk model that pulls 20,000+ data points to return an approval — up to $5,000 — in seconds, then pays the merchant directly on delivery confirmation while the customer pays weekly or biweekly until ownership. Merchants originate applications from their in-store POS or by sending a text-to-apply link; consumers manage leases and payments in a self-service dashboard. Kafene raised a ~$31M Series B and reaches merchants through financing-waterfall networks such as Versatile Credit and LendPro. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment probe Kafene publishes no public developer program, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP contract, no SDKs, and no /.well-known discovery surface; its merchant and consumer surfaces are authenticated single-page web applications and integration is arranged through Kafene's partner team, not self-serve documentation.

providers.name: Kreya
providers.description: Kreya is a GUI client for gRPC, REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and Server-Sent Events APIs. All data is stored in git-diffable files for easy reviews and versioning. Kreya provides automated snapshot and scripted tests, flexible environments, and support for all gRPC streaming modes.

providers.name: Lara AI
providers.description: Lara AI is an AI agent for People and HR teams, built by SIGMA PEOPLE S.R.L. in Argentina and sold across Latin America. Lara talks to every employee in the messaging tools they already use — WhatsApp, Slack, Microsoft Teams and Google Chat — and covers five modules: Employee Experience (continuous listening, custom surveys and people analytics), Helpdesk (an AI help desk the company says automates over 80% of employee FAQs and requests), Onboarding (end-to-end automated flows for new hires), Comunicaciones (personalised, scheduled and segmented employee communications) and People Analytics (dashboards and reports built from people data). It integrates with HR platforms including SAP, BambooHR, Oracle, Buk, Humand, Mandu and Rex+, and targets retail, consumer goods, technology, consulting, banking and finance, education and manufacturing. Lara AI publishes a marketing site, a Spanish help centre and a real llms.txt, but no public API program — there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDK.

providers.name: Legion Security
providers.description: Legion Security is a browser-native AI SOC analyst that learns a security team's real workflows from inside the browser and then helps execute and automate them in phases: Learning Mode captures and maps how analysts actually work, Guided Mode runs those workflows with a human in the loop, and Autonomous Mode takes over the steps the team has signed off on. The platform targets alert triage, investigation, and evidence gathering in the security operations center, positioning agentic AI as a dependable teammate rather than a black box, with every captured insight visible and every action explainable. Legion Security operates a SafeBase trust center and publishes SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, HIPAA, and CSA STAR Level 1 compliance documentation. The company is seed-stage and backed by Accel; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Lentra
providers.description: Lentra is a Pune, India based cloud-native digital lending platform for banks and non-banking financial companies. Built on a microservices architecture with customisable customer journeys, the platform spans loan origination (GoNoGo), loan management (1LMS), data and machine learning operations (Lentra MLOps), and data transfer (TransferX), alongside standalone modules for MultiBureau credit bureau access, identity and video KYC verification, collateral management, document management, co-lending and bank reconciliation. Lentra packages these into pre-built retail, business and agriculture lending journeys - home, personal, education, vehicle, consumer durable and credit card loans, equipment finance, working capital, supply chain finance and agri/KCC lending - delivered SaaS on a per-user or per-transaction basis to institutions including HDFC Bank, State Bank of India, IDFC and TVS Credit. The company is an Open Credit Enablement Network (OCEN) participant and maintains a public trust center covering SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 22301:2019 and CSA STAR. Lentra sells to enterprises directly; it does not operate a public self-service developer portal or publish an open API reference.

providers.name: Lovepop
providers.description: Lovepop is a Boston-based consumer greeting-card and gifting company, founded in 2014 and known for its intricate laser-cut 3D pop-up cards inspired by Vietnamese "kirigami" paper engineering. The company sells directly to consumers through its Shopify-powered storefront at lovepop.com and through retail partners, offering pop-up greeting cards, gift boxes, flowers, and personalized gifting. Lovepop was accelerated by Techstars and appeared on ABC's Shark Tank. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this pass Lovepop publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer portal, and its public digital surface is a standard Shopify commerce storefront (including Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth well-known documents served on the domain).

providers.name: M7 Health
providers.description: M7 Health is an AI-powered workforce operations platform for healthcare, focused on nurse scheduling and labor optimization. The platform forecasts staffing demand, auto-balances schedules, fills open shifts, and deploys staff to close coverage gaps while reducing premium labor spend, administrative burden, and nurse turnover across hospitals and health systems. Surfaced as a portfolio company of threshold-ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer or API surface was found — the product is delivered as an enterprise SaaS engaged via a sales demo.

providers.name: Makrwatch
providers.description: Makrwatch is a creator representation and sponsorship management platform that sits between independent content creators and brands. It sources and filters brand-deal opportunities, negotiates terms and rates, protects creator IP and creative freedom, and handles the administrative work of briefs, timelines, revisions, invoicing, and payment tracking so creators can focus on producing content. Founded out of Y Combinator (W15) and based in New York City, the platform reports $27M+ distributed to creators across 34,000+ sponsorships for 7,400+ creators operating in 118 countries. The company was founded in 2013 as themidgame and still operates its GitHub organization under that name. Makrwatch does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface at this time: there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, SDK, MCP server or agent card anywhere on its public surface, and its two AWS API Gateway hosts (api.makrwatch.com and platform.makrwatch.com) are private backends for its own Creators and Brands applications, answering every unauthenticated request with HTTP 403.

providers.name: Max Retail
providers.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Oatfi
providers.description: OatFi is a fintech infrastructure company that describes itself as "The Modern Credit Network for B2B Payments." It provides embedded credit, lending, and working-capital products that platforms and marketplaces can offer inside their own payment workflows. Its product surface spans Accounts Payable (flexible payment terms for buyers), Accounts Receivable (guaranteed or early supplier payouts), and Commercial Charge Cards (scaled credit and capital for commercial card programs), backed by modular components for KYB and fraud verification, underwriting, origination, loan management, capital-markets access, and collections. OatFi exposes these capabilities through APIs for approvals, settlements, and reconciliation. The developer documentation (docs.oatfi.com, a ReadMe hub) and dashboard are access-gated, so no public OpenAPI or API reference is available for cataloging at this time. Backed by QED Investors.

providers.name: Olive Technologies
providers.description: Olive is an AI-native vendor evaluation and technology procurement platform that runs the full RFP lifecycle in a single workspace — from requirements management and stakeholder collaboration through AI-powered comparative vendor scoring and final selection. It maintains vendor intelligence across more than 12,000 vendors and 380+ categories, and is built for IT leaders, procurement teams, and consultancies who need unbiased, structured software sourcing. Olive is a Techstars-backed company; by design it takes no fees from vendors, funding the platform through buyer subscriptions instead. Olive has no public developer API surface — no documentation, SDKs, or API reference are published at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and security posture.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Om1
providers.description: OM1 is an AI-powered healthcare analytics and real-world data company that generates real-world evidence from clinical, EMR, and claims data. Its PhenOM foundation model is trained on billions of patient-years to identify patient phenotypes, accelerate diagnosis, and predict future medical events, risks, and responses to treatment. OM1 delivers clinical registries, automated observational studies, patient-finding and outcomes-prediction solutions, and curated real-world datasets covering hundreds of millions of patients to life sciences, biopharma, payer, and provider organizations. OM1 does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation surface.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Perfios
providers.description: Perfios is a Bangalore, India-headquartered financial technology (SaaS) company providing an AI-driven operating system for banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and insurers, serving over 1,000 financial institutions globally. Its platform spans four product families: Perfios Analyse (bank statement, ITR, GST, payslip, credit-card and financial-statement analysers), Perfios Verify (KYC/KYB, video KYC, liveness detection, OCR, digital signature and onboarding via OneSDK), Perfios Lens (portfolio monitoring, PFM, credit assessment memos, due diligence), and Perfios Protect (document tamper detection, deepfake detection, and insurance fraud detection). Perfios also runs a digital public infrastructure (DPI) stack for Account Aggregator FIU/FIP roles. Its data-aggregation, decisioning, and verification capabilities are delivered to partners programmatically; public developer documentation is gated behind partner access. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Plink
providers.description: Plink is a personalized commerce and card-linking platform that turns everyday payment transactions into intelligent, permission-based savings and engagement experiences for banks, merchants, and consumers. Its technology enriches transactions in real time, applying business rules and automated actions across payments, digital banking, and customer engagement, and exposes an API that lets any payment network make its transactions "smart" while keeping consumers anonymous. Plink says it has personalized over 700 million transactions and reaches 350+ banks, hundreds of thousands of merchants, and 10+ million consumers through an invitation-only network. The company operates a merchant/business portal and a consumer savings program (Fancoins) built on a PCI-compliant, tokenized card-linking structure.

providers.name: Pomelo Care
providers.description: Pomelo Care is a value-based virtual healthcare company delivering 24/7 clinician-led care for women and children across fertility and preconception, prenatal and postpartum, pediatric and NICU, and midlife and menopause health. Operating as a telehealth platform contracted with employers and health plans, Pomelo pairs licensed clinicians, doulas, and care teams with remote monitoring to close the gaps between doctor visits, reduce NICU admissions, and improve maternal and infant outcomes. The company reports covering 25 million lives across all 50 states and raised a $92M Series C at a $1.7B valuation. Pomelo Care is a patient-, employer-, and payer-facing platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and First Round Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Pontem
providers.description: Pontem is a Web3 product development studio building with the Move language on Aptos and other Layer 1 blockchains, in partnership with Aptos Labs. Its product portfolio spans the Pontem Wallet (a browser-extension and mobile crypto wallet for APT, MOVE, ETH, SOL and more), the Liquidswap decentralized exchange and AMM, the Lumio L2 VM-abstraction framework, and a Move developer tooling suite that includes the Move Code Playground, the IntelliJ Move IDE plugin, the ByteBabel Solidity-to-Move bytecode translator, and the Dove Move package manager. Pontem publishes first-party TypeScript SDKs, an embeddable Liquidswap web-component widget, wallet adapters, and CLIs. Backed by Pantera Capital, Animoca Brands, and Aptos Labs.

providers.name: Presentations.ai
providers.description: Presentations.ai is an AI-powered presentation platform that turns ideas, documents, and data into professional, on-brand slide decks in minutes and exports fully editable PowerPoint files. The product markets programmatic deck generation via a REST API and webhooks, no-code Zapier and Make connectors, white-label embedding, and data-source connections to Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Snowflake, and 50+ others, though it publishes no public developer documentation or API reference. Backed by Accel, the company operates under Singapore terms of service.

providers.name: Rain Financial
providers.description: Rain is a Middle East and North Africa (MENA) cryptocurrency exchange and digital-asset platform, operated through Rain Financial Inc. and its Bahrain entity Rain Management W.L.L. Founded in 2017 by Abdullah Almoaiqel, AJ Nelson, Joseph Dallago, and Yehia Badawy, Rain became the first crypto-asset company accepted into the Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) regulatory sandbox and, in 2019, the first CBB-licensed crypto-asset service provider in the region. Rain Trading Limited later received approval from Abu Dhabi Global Market's Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) to expand across the UAE. Rain lets retail and institutional customers buy, sell, store, and manage Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies against multiple fiat currencies, with a Rain Pro offering for advanced traders and the majority of customer assets held in multi-signature cold storage. The company raised seed, Series A, and a $110M Series B (Paradigm, Kleiner Perkins), and is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: React Native
providers.description: A framework for building native apps using React, enabling cross-platform mobile development for iOS and Android.

providers.name: Rover
providers.description: Rover is the world's largest online marketplace for pet care, connecting pet parents with sitters and dog walkers for boarding, house sitting, drop-in visits, doggy daycare, and dog walking. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Seattle, Rover was a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: ROVR) until Blackstone completed its acquisition of Rover Group for approximately $2.3 billion on February 27, 2024, taking the company private and delisting its stock. As of this catalog entry, Rover does NOT publish a public, documented developer API or a developer portal. Its platform is a closed consumer/provider marketplace; the only outward-facing integration program is a marketing affiliate program offered through third-party affiliate networks (Impact, CJ, Rakuten, Skimlinks, ShareASale, etc.), not a data/booking API. Programmatic access to Rover data today is only available via unofficial third-party web scrapers (e.g. Apify), which are outside Rover's supported surface. This entry is an honest stub documenting the absence of a public API; it should be revisited if Rover launches a partner or developer API.

providers.name: SafelyYou
providers.description: SafelyYou is an ambient-AI platform for senior living communities that reduces falls, reveals resident risk, and surfaces operational and staffing insights without requiring residents to wear devices. Its computer-vision system detects and reviews fall incidents, and the broader product suite spans Safety AI for fall detection, Staffing AI for labor allocation and care tracking, Wellness AI for resident well-being, the Halo next-generation eCall system, and Guardian hardware sensors. SafelyYou reports serving over 1,000 communities and 50,000 residents, with outcomes including roughly 45% fall reduction and longer length of stay. The company integrates with senior-living EHR and eCall systems (Yardi, ALIS, PointClickCare and others) and offers SSO, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Savvy
providers.description: Savvy (Savvy Advisors, Inc.) is a technology-driven, SEC-registered investment advisory firm founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY. It combines licensed fiduciary financial advisors with proprietary technology — including Savvy Intelligence, an AI workspace for advisors — to deliver personalized wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and independent financial advisors. Savvy manages $5B+ in assets across 100+ advisors in 30+ U.S. locations, custodying at Fidelity and Charles Schwab. The firm serves two audiences: clients seeking wealth management (financial planning, investment management, direct indexing, tax optimization, retirement, trust and estate planning) and advisors looking to join or build a practice on its platform. Savvy publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain security posture, and the verbatim /llms.txt it exposes for agents.

providers.name: Serena & Lily
providers.description: Serena & Lily is a California home furnishings and lifestyle brand founded in 2003 in Sausalito by textile designer Serena Dugan and entrepreneur Lily Kanter. It sells furniture, custom upholstery, bedding, rugs, lighting, wallpaper, art and home decor direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, a printed catalog, and a network of physical Design Shops, alongside a Designer Circle trade program for interior designers. The storefront runs on a headless, composable commerce stack — Elastic Path for commerce and Amplience for content, served from a Vercel-hosted front end in front of AWS AppSync and Amazon API Gateway — but Serena & Lily publishes no developer program, no public API documentation, and no machine-readable specification of any kind. The GraphQL endpoint backing the storefront answers anonymous requests with introspection disabled, and the api.serenaandlily.com gateway rejects every unauthenticated path.

providers.name: Sighten
providers.description: Sighten was a San Francisco software company, backed by Obvious Ventures, that built a cloud platform for the residential and commercial solar industry — covering system design, proposal generation, sales, and financing workflows used by solar installers, dealers, and finance providers. The Sighten business was acquired (by GoodLeap) and folded into EverBright; the original sighten.io domain now redirects to goeverbright.com. EverBright operates as a residential solar and home-battery financing platform, connecting homeowners with local installers through lease and Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) products and the MyEverBright monitoring portal. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation is published for the Sighten or EverBright brand; a partner-facing platform (engine.goeverbright.com) and a protected API host (api.goeverbright.com, HTTP 401) exist but are not publicly documented. This profile records the company's current, honest public surface after enrichment.

providers.name: Silq
providers.description: Silq (OneSilq) is a digital freight forwarder delivering fast, transparent global shipping and supply-chain services. Offerings span ocean freight (full container load, less-than-container load and shared container load), air freight, buyer's consolidation, cargo value protection, customs brokerage and trucking/drayage, plus quality-control inspections across China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh. The platform layers real-time shipment visibility, live ocean-carrier freight rates, expert trade advisory and built-in risk protection for importers and small shippers.

providers.name: Slidebean
providers.description: Slidebean is a pitch deck and financial modeling platform for startup founders. It combines AI-powered presentation software that auto-designs investor-ready slides with professional pitch deck design services and financial modeling assistance for fundraising. Founders use Slidebean to build, refine, and share pitch decks, model their startup finances, and prepare for investor conversations. As of this enrichment pass Slidebean operates as a consumer/SMB SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; its GitHub organization contains only forks and small internal JavaScript utilities.

providers.name: Songfinch
providers.description: Songfinch is a Chicago-based direct-to-consumer music gifting platform that pairs customers with a curated community of independent professional singer-songwriters to produce one-of-a-kind personalized songs. A buyer picks an artist by genre, mood and tempo, submits the story and details behind the occasion through a guided song builder, and the artist writes, records and delivers an original recording to a shareable song page, with add-on products spanning lyric prints, vinyl, CDs, sheet music, QR plaques, streaming release and rights upgrades. Songfinch operates a two-sided marketplace — a consumer storefront plus an artist application and artist admin — and has paid out tens of millions of dollars to independent artists. It publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract; api.songfinch.com is a private first-party application backend for its own storefront.

providers.name: SteadyMD
providers.description: SteadyMD is a telehealth infrastructure and clinical-workforce company (a DocGo company) backed by Lux Capital. It supplies board-certified physicians and nurse practitioners, clinical operations, and 50-state licensing and credentialing, plus technology and telehealth APIs that let healthcare and digital-health partners launch branded, fully managed virtual care. Its APIs cover patient data submission, synchronous and asynchronous consult requests, two-way patient-clinician messaging, intake forms, clinician availability, real-time status updates, document attachments, scheduling, and reporting/SLA retrieval, offered as either a Limited (partner-EMR) or Complete (SteadyMD-EMR) integration. API documentation is provided under a business agreement via a request form; there is no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Sunnyside
providers.description: Sunnyside is a digital health platform for alcohol moderation, founded in 2020, that helps members cut back on or quit drinking through personalized weekly plans, drink tracking and analytics, human text-based coaching, habit-building exercises, and a supportive community. Its separate Sunnyside Med telehealth service connects members with licensed providers who can prescribe compounded naltrexone. Sunnyside is a consumer mobile app and telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Sunyur
providers.description: Sunyur (商越科技 / Beijing Sunyur Network Technology Co., Ltd, 北京商越网络科技有限公司) is a Chinese enterprise procurement digitalization company providing AI-driven procurement solutions for large and medium enterprises. Its products include an intelligent procurement middle-platform (采购中台), an SRM supplier relationship management system, an e-procurement SaaS platform, and a procurement mall (采购商城), helping each customer build a dedicated online, digital, and intelligent enterprise procurement platform to raise efficiency and lower cost. Sunyur operates an open integration platform ("聚贤阁", open.sunyur.com) that connects enterprises to 30+ mainstream e-commerce platforms and 10+ third-party applications through a single accessToken-authenticated API surface. Sunyur is backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Tend
providers.description: Tend (Tend Dental) is a consumer dental-care company offering modern, judgment-free dentistry through a network of design-forward "studios" across New York City, Boston, Atlanta, Washington DC, Nashville and Connecticut. The brand pairs a soothing in-person studio experience and top-rated dentists with a fully online booking and patient-intake flow at hellotend.com. Services span preventive hygiene, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, veneers, Invisalign and clear aligners, orthodontics, dental implants, endodontics, sedation and emergency care. Backed by GV and Redpoint Ventures. This is a consumer web/ booking business with no public developer API surface; the profile is enriched with identity, security-posture and discovery-probe artifacts only.

providers.name: Tennr
providers.description: Tennr is a New York City-based healthcare technology company (founded 2021) building agentic patient-orchestration software that automates referral-based care operations for providers and health systems. Its proprietary vision-language model, RaeLM, is trained on over 100 million anonymized medical documents to read faxes, referrals, and unstructured records, then automates document classification, data extraction, patient qualification, insurance eligibility verification, and prior-authorization submission by integrating directly with existing EHR systems. Tennr processes over 10 million documents monthly and is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant. It raised a $101M Series C at a $605M valuation led by IVP, with a16z, Lightspeed, GV, ICONIQ, and Foundation Capital participating. Tennr does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or specification; integrations are delivered through EHR connections and professional services.

providers.name: Tory Burch
providers.description: Tory Burch LLC is an American luxury women's fashion label founded in February 2004 by designer Tory Burch and headquartered in New York City, trading under the legal entity River Light V, L.P. The privately held company designs and sells ready-to-wear clothing, designer shoes, handbags, small leather goods, jewellery, watches, eyewear, fragrance and beauty, swimwear and home decor, together with the Tory Sport activewear line, through roughly 400 boutiques worldwide, wholesale partners and a direct-to-consumer storefront at toryburch.com serving the United States, United Kingdom, the European Union and Asia. Its affiliated Tory Burch Foundation funds and educates women entrepreneurs. Tory Burch is a fashion and retail business rather than a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract, and holds no public GitHub organisation. Its storefront is a Next.js front end on Akamai over a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) commerce platform with Adobe Scene7 media, and an Apigee API gateway fronts www.toryburch.com/api/ for first-party storefront traffic only, exposing no publicly registered proxy. The one machine-readable artifact the company does publish is a site-wide llms.txt.

providers.name: Uni
providers.description: Uni (Uni Cards) is an Indian consumer credit fintech founded in 2020 by Nitin Gupta, Prateek Jindal, and Laxmikant Vyas that delivers clutter-breaking credit products to consumers in India, including pay-later style credit cards and flexible repayment products. Uni is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. The company is a consumer-facing app-first business and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: vAuto
providers.description: vAuto is a Cox Automotive brand providing new and used vehicle inventory management, appraisal, pricing, and merchandising software for automotive dealers (ProfitTime GPS, Provision, Conquest, Stockwave). vAuto exposes partner-gated APIs through the Cox Automotive Integration Platform (developer.coxautoinc.com) - notably the vAuto Inventory API and the vAuto Appraisal API - that let authorized integrators programmatically read vehicle inventory, update list price, and create and access appraisals in the vAuto ecosystem. Access is not open self-service; integrators must be approved partners, authenticate via Cox Automotive Bridge ID / OAuth with an issued API key, and endpoint-level reference documentation is behind the partner developer portal login. Per-path endpoints below are modeled from the published product summaries, not copied from public reference docs.

providers.name: Visual Studio
providers.description: Microsoft Visual Studio is an integrated development environment (IDE) for building applications across .NET, C++, web, mobile, cloud, and game platforms on Windows and macOS. While the Visual Studio IDE itself is not exposed as a SaaS REST API, Microsoft provides developer-facing APIs for Live Share real-time collaboration (consumed via the vsls extension SDK) and the Visual Studio Marketplace REST API for discovering and distributing extensions, themes, and tools.

providers.name: Waterfall
providers.description: Waterfall is a sequential software development methodology where progress flows steadily downward through defined phases including requirements, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance. It emphasizes thorough documentation, fixed-scope planning, and phase-gate reviews before proceeding to subsequent stages. Waterfall remains widely used in regulated industries, government contracting, and projects with well-understood, stable requirements.

providers.name: ZOE
providers.description: ZOE (joinzoe.com, canonically zoe.com) is a personalized nutrition and health science company founded on data from one of the largest nutrition research studies in the world. Its membership program pairs at-home testing (gut health, blood sugar, and blood fat responses) with an AI-powered app that scores meals, tracks personal food responses, and delivers science-backed dietary guidance. ZOE also sells consumer products including the Daily30+ whole-food supplement and Gut Health products, and publishes the ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer health brand rather than an API provider, and is tracked here as a Balderton Capital portfolio company; it currently exposes no public developer platform, API, or developer portal.

providers.name: Acerta
providers.description: Acerta (Acerta Analytics Solutions Inc.) is a Canadian industrial-AI company whose LinePulse platform delivers AI-driven manufacturing quality analytics for discrete manufacturing. Founded in 2017 in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Acerta helps Tier-1 automotive and powertrain manufacturers detect defects early, reduce scrap and rework, and root-cause complex production issues in real time. LinePulse replaces statistical process control software, spreadsheets, and custom querying tools with real-time SPC, predictive monitoring, and machine-learning root-cause analysis, and ingests production data through a proprietary secure ingestion API. The platform is built on Microsoft Azure, is SOC 2 Type 1 certified, and is proven across 300+ production lines in 12 countries with customers including BorgWarner, Dana, Linamar, Ford, ZF, Ballard, and BMW. Acerta is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. Acerta exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, self-serve sign-up, or SDKs; integration is delivered through enterprise deployment with the LinePulse ingestion API.

providers.name: Admittedly
providers.description: myOptions (myoptions.org redirects to encourageme.com; operated as the Encourage platform by Encoura, LLC) is a free college and career planning platform for middle- and high-school students, families, and educators across the United States. Students explore colleges, majors, careers, and scholarships and get matched to institutions, while educators deliver guidance through lesson plans, preference forms, and reporting dashboards. The platform reports serving roughly 4 million students across 5,000 school districts and 10,000+ high schools in all 50 states and D.C., funded through partnerships with colleges and education providers rather than user fees. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or documentation surface, and no real /.well-known/ documents (all such paths return the SPA/404 catch-all). Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead under the stub slug 'admittedly'.

providers.name: Altara
providers.description: Altara is a deep-tech AI company (seed-stage, $7M, backed by Greylock and Jeff Dean) building an agentic scientific intelligence platform for the physical sciences. Its AI agents reason across fragmented technical data — sensor and instrument time series, wafer maps, inspection images, and experimental records — to accelerate R&D-through-manufacturing workflows such as experimental design, yield analysis, anomaly detection, and failure analysis. Altara unifies siloed data in place without migrations, giving agents full operational context across numerical, text, and image sources for semiconductors, advanced materials, batteries, medical devices, specialty chemicals, and industrials. The platform is SOC 2 Type II compliant with encryption, RBAC, SSO, and self-hosted (VPC) or dedicated single-tenant cloud deployment. Altara does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity and security posture as a lead for future enrichment.

providers.name: API Insights
providers.description: API Insights is a free online tool powered by Treblle that provides advanced API analysis and monitoring by evaluating OpenAPI specifications across multiple dimensions including AI readiness, design quality, performance, and security. It scores APIs against industry benchmarks and provides actionable recommendations for improvement.

providers.name: Ara
providers.description: Ara (Ara Labs, Inc.) is a digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising network that finances, installs, and operates rich-media displays across mobility, municipal, parking, and retail settings. It describes itself as the largest U.S. owner-operator of rideshare and taxi car-top digital billboards, running a long-term partnership with Uber alongside in-car, storefront, and parking/municipal kiosk screens. Ara owns the hardware and content-management operations under a monthly subscription model so fleet owners, retailers, parking operators and municipalities avoid cap-ex and operational overhead, and it also sells self-serve NYC taxi-top ad time by the hour or day. Its own site names Founders Fund, Coatue, Rosecliff Ventures, iHeart Media and Kellogg's as investors. Ara publishes NO public API, SDK, developer portal, documentation site or machine-readable specification. Contract discovery in August 2026 found a live private backend at api.arascreens.com (Ruby on Rails on Heroku) that answers every route with an HTTP Basic challenge, a React driver/operations application at app.arascreens.com, and a third-party signage CMS front end at cms.arascreens.com — all credentialed product infrastructure, none of it a developer offering. A second pass enumerated the full host inventory and added four more production hosts to the same finding: outdoor.arascreens.com (an SPA product page for the Ara O49 display), rts.arascreens.com (an unauthenticated Express service serving only its scaffold string), stationary.arascreens.com and assets.arascreens.com. Ara's marketing describes its CMS as "API-driven", meaning its own platform is programmatically operated and can integrate with a partner's existing signage stack — it is not an offer of a public API, and no key issuance, reference or access request mechanism exists anywhere on its surface.

providers.name: Asbury Automotive Group
providers.description: Asbury Automotive Group is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating new and used vehicle dealerships across multiple states and brands. Headquartered in Duluth, Georgia, Asbury operates approximately 200 dealerships representing 30+ automotive brands including luxury and non-luxury vehicles. The company operates under multiple brand names including Coggin Automotive Group, Crown Automotive Group, Park Place Dealerships, Nalley Automotive Group, and others. Asbury does not expose a public developer API but operates digital retail platforms including Clicklane, their proprietary online vehicle purchase platform.

providers.name: Asepha
providers.description: Asepha is an AI workflow automation platform built specifically for pharmacies, positioning itself as "the context graph for the therapy-start journey" with a stated vision to make medication delays impossible. Its AI agents automate repetitive pharmacy operations across automated prescription data entry, back-office work, 340B management (TPA matching, accruals, purchase-order automation), medication reconciliation (Best Possible Medication History), a conversational voice call assistant, benefits verification and prior-authorization (BV/PA) automation, REMS compliance reporting, and medication therapy review. The company reports outcomes such as a 32% reduction in manual labour cost within one month and tasks completed 4x faster than baseline. Asepha is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, with AES-256 encryption at rest. Founded by CEO Eunice Wu, PharmD and CTO Can Uncu, the company operates from New York, NY and Toronto, ON, and is a Techstars portfolio company. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Asepha publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Asserts.ai
providers.description: Asserts.ai is an observability intelligence platform for Prometheus and OpenTelemetry that automatically models the entities in your infrastructure and application metrics, applies golden-signal and SLO PromQL rules to surface anomalies, and correlates related failures into root-cause workbenches to cut mean-time-to-resolution. It also ships a Data Distiller for reducing metric cardinality and observability cost. Asserts was acquired by Grafana Labs in November 2023 and is now delivered as part of Grafana Cloud; its standalone website, docs, and GitHub organization are archived and no longer maintained.

providers.name: AtomBeam
providers.description: AtomBeam Technologies is a Moraga, California software company founded in 2017 that sells "Compaction" — a machine-learning approach to shrinking machine-generated data that replaces recurring bit-level patterns with codewords drawn from a trained codebook, rather than compressing bytes. Its Neurpac product is an on-premises, protocol-agnostic bidirectional compaction tunnel that reduces IoT, telemetry and file payloads by roughly 75% while encrypting and obfuscating them in transit; Neurcom and PCM are earlier-stage research products. AtomBeam licenses the software to IoT device and gateway makers, satellite and LPWAN operators, telcos, and the US Department of Defense, and has raised capital through Regulation A and Regulation CF crowdfunding on StartEngine. There is no public developer API program: the customer-facing surface is the login-gated AtomBeam Customer Portal (codebook generation and simulation) plus a Jira Service Management support portal.

providers.name: Atrandi
providers.description: Atrandi Biosciences (founded 2016 in Lithuania as Droplet Genomics) is a life-sciences tools company building droplet-microfluidic platforms and its patented Semi-Permeable Capsule (SPC) technology for single-cell analysis. SPCs isolate individual cells while letting reagents diffuse freely, enabling complex multi-step single-cell genomics, multiomics, and microbial whole-genome sequencing workflows. Atrandi ships instruments (Flux, Onyx, Styx), application kits, and consumables used by 200+ research groups worldwide. The company is a wet-lab instrumentation and consumables vendor and publishes no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched with verified public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Caresense Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Carta Healthcare
providers.description: Carta Healthcare, Inc. is a San Francisco based clinical data management company that applies a "Hybrid Intelligence" model — proprietary AI paired with certified human clinical abstractors — to extract, validate and submit structured clinical data on behalf of hospitals and health systems. Its product family covers Voyager (the underlying AI data platform trained on electronic medical record content), Lighthouse and Atlas (AI-assisted clinical registry abstraction and submission, including the ACC NCDR, STS/ACC TVT and Vascular Quality Initiative registries), Navigator (clinical data intelligence and analytics), Harbor (cohort selection and clinical trial matching) and outsourced expert abstraction services. Carta Healthcare is an NCDR certified software vendor and has completed a Type 2 SOC 2 examination with an unqualified opinion covering security, availability and confidentiality. The company sells and integrates directly with hospital EMR environments under enterprise agreements; it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract on its public web surface.

providers.name: Chai Research
providers.description: Chai Research Corp. (CHAI) is a Palo Alto consumer AI company building a character-and-story chat platform, where users create and talk to AI characters on iOS, Android and the web. Founded in 2021 by William Beauchamp, the company trains and serves its own conversational language models on an in-house GPU cluster, and runs Chaiverse — a developer platform where outside model builders submit HuggingFace-hosted language models, have them deployed to real Chai App users, and compete on a public leaderboard. A public Chat API (api.chai-research.com) and a chaiverse pip package were previously documented; both have since been withdrawn — see x-coverage.

providers.name: ChangEd
providers.description: ChangEd (Changed) is a consumer financial-technology company whose mobile app helps people pay off debt faster by automatically rounding up everyday purchases to the nearest dollar and directing those micro-savings toward student loans, credit cards, mortgages, personal loans, and auto loans. Founded by brothers Dan Stelmach and Nick Sky, the app launched in 2017, appeared on Shark Tank and took investment from Mark Cuban, and is a Techstars portfolio company. It links to a user's bank account, tracks spending, automates extra debt payments, supports savings goals, and visualizes payoff progress for a $4/month subscription, with banking services provided by nbkc bank (Member FDIC). ChangEd is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cicada
providers.description: Cicada Securities, LLC is a financial technology company revolutionizing the bond markets in Emerging Markets. It operates an Alternative Trading System (ATS) focused on local-currency-denominated government bonds in Mexico (M Bonos, UDI Bonos, and Cetes), enhancing liquidity and facilitating all-to-all access in an anonymous trading environment through central limit orderbook and request-for-quote protocols. Cicada Securities, LLC is an SEC-registered broker-dealer and FINRA member, and Cicada SEF, LLC is an applicant for swap execution facility registration with the CFTC. The company offers a trading platform, live pricing data, and a programmatic API for direct access to LatAm local-currency rates market liquidity, backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Classiq
providers.description: Classiq Technologies is a Tel Aviv, Israel headquartered enterprise quantum software company founded in 2020 by Nir Minerbi (CEO), Amir Naveh (CPO), and Dr. Yehuda Naveh (CTO), positioning itself as a high-level quantum algorithm design platform that lets organizations build, scale, and deploy quantum algorithms across any hardware or simulator without writing low-level gate code. Its flagship offering centers on Qmod, an intuitive quantum modeling language, and a hardware-aware synthesis engine that compiles functional quantum models into optimized circuits with constraint-driven optimization, transpilation, and execution session management across cloud quantum providers including AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, GCP, IBM Quantum, IonQ, OQC, Alice and Bob, and C12. The platform is delivered through the Classiq Studio web IDE at platform.classiq.io, a public Python SDK (`pip install classiq`) currently at version 1.14.0 covering synthesis, execution, analysis, and application libraries for chemistry (QSP), finance (IQAE), and quantum machine learning (QSVM, QML), plus an AI-assisted natural language interface for algorithm design. Classiq publishes the largest open quantum algorithm library on GitHub at github.com/Classiq/classiq-library (2,000+ stars, Jupyter Notebook, MIT license) with reference implementations across optimization, linear solvers, quantum machine learning, chemistry, finance, logistics, cybersecurity, and physical systems. Customers include Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, HSBC, Citibank, BMW, and Rolls-Royce; the company is SOC 2 and GDPR compliant. Classiq has raised over $200M including a $110M Series C in May 2025 with backers such as AMD Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, IonQ, Bank Leumi, Mirae Asset Capital, and SoftBank. Classiq's developer surface is the Python SDK and Qmod language — there is no public REST API or OpenAPI specification; the Mintlify-hosted `docs.classiq.io/api-reference/openapi.json` endpoint currently returns the default Mintlify Plant Store placeholder rather than a real API contract.

providers.name: Clerkie
providers.description: Clerkie, operated by Henry Labs Inc. and founded in San Francisco in 2016, is an AI-powered debt management and loan-recovery platform serving both consumers and institutional lenders. The consumer side offers a conversational financial assistant for budgeting, debt negotiation, and personalized repayment planning, while the B2B side — marketed as Fiber, launched in 2021 and now sold on its own domain getfiber.ai — gives lenders, banks, credit unions, and collection agencies an AI-driven recovery suite spanning CRM, an inventory management system (IMS), an AI agent, omnichannel communications, borrower scoring, a self-service payment portal, and workflow automation. Clerkie markets a RESTful API and multi-currency payment processing for lenders to integrate loan portfolios, real-time reporting, and automated repayment arrangements, but publishes no public developer documentation, machine-readable API contract, or self-serve developer portal — integration is arranged through a sales conversation. The company has raised over $41M from Left Lane Capital, Flourish Ventures, Vestigo Ventures, and Citibank.

providers.name: Command Zero
providers.description: Command Zero, Inc. is an autonomous and AI-assisted security operations center (SOC) platform for enterprise security investigations. Founded in 2023, it applies "Governed AI" and a question-based investigation method to run complete investigations across identity, endpoint, email, cloud, and SaaS data sources — from initial alert through verdict — with every agent step logged, visible, auditable, and reproducible. Rather than a SOAR, SIEM, or XDR, it connects read-only to existing data sources via a federated data model (no ingestion, no data migration) and runs Tier-1 through Tier-3 triage, breach, phishing, malware, identity, insider-threat, incident-response, and threat-hunting workflows. The company reports 500K+ investigations completed, a 90% reduction in Tier-1 escalations, and 40%+ efficiency gains, and holds SOC 2 Type II. Command Zero is a portfolio company of a16z and Insight Partners; this profile was enriched from the provider's public website and llms.txt.

providers.name: CommerceIQ
providers.description: CommerceIQ is an AI-powered ecommerce platform that helps consumer brands win in algorithmic retail across sales, digital shelf, retail media, and content execution. Its unified platform, Ally AI, packages four AI agents (Content, Shelf, Media, and Sales) that optimize product content and SEO, monitor digital-shelf availability and search rankings across 1,450+ retailers globally, manage and automate retail media bidding and spend, and forecast and execute sales strategy from Amazon and Walmart to Instacart and Criteo. Founded in 2019, CommerceIQ serves enterprise brands including PepsiCo, P&G, Coca-Cola, and Colgate-Palmolive, and is backed by Insight Partners, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Trinity Ventures. The company operates as a managed enterprise platform and does not publish a public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Dana Incorporated
providers.description: Dana Incorporated is a global supplier of fully integrated drivetrain and electrified propulsion systems for passenger, commercial, and off-highway vehicles. Dana announced an agreement in 2025 for its Off-Highway business to be acquired by Allison Transmission.
