providers.description: The Clearing House (TCH) is a U.S. banking association and payments company owned by many of the largest commercial banks. It operates three core payment systems: CHIPS (large-value wire clearing), the EPN automated clearing house (ACH), and the RTP network, the private-sector real-time payments rail it launched in 2017 as the first new U.S. payments infrastructure in decades. RTP is a 24/7/365 instant-payments scheme built on the ISO 20022 messaging standard, supporting immediate credit-push transfers up to $10 million with final settlement, plus Request for Payment (RfP), remittance data, and a UID addressing/directory lookup. TCH is the scheme operator for the U.S. market and competes with the Federal Reserve's FedNow service. Its API posture is documentation- and rulebook-first: TCH does not publish an open, self-serve public REST API or downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specification. Instead it publishes ISO 20022 message specifications (pacs, pain, camt, remt) as PDFs, the RTP network operating rules, playbooks, and a technology-provider program. Real-time HTTP/JSON RTP APIs are surfaced to businesses by participating financial institutions (for example U.S. Bank) and registered technology providers that connect to the RTP network on their behalf.

providers.name: Virool
providers.description: Virool is a native video advertising platform that distributes branded video content ("advertainment") across the web to help brands reach and grow targeted audiences. It pairs a proprietary data-management platform of roughly 450 million unique profiles for granular audience targeting with native video placement technology designed to minimize disruption to the user experience, and a real-time performance analytics dashboard that includes emotional insight tracking (eIQ). Virool serves advertisers and publishers through self-service campaign and monetization dashboards rather than a public developer API. The company was backed by 500 Global and a16z and has run campaigns for brands including Turkish Airlines, Under Armour, and WestJet.

providers.name: Zibo
providers.description: Zibo (operating as Azibo) is a financial services and property-management platform for independent landlords and rental property owners. The company offers a free-to-use platform that bundles rent collection, tenant screening, online rental applications, lease agreements and eSignatures, document storage, maintenance and messaging, banking, and rental-property accounting. Azibo monetizes through interest on cash balances, card-transaction fees, paid lease/eSignature and screening products, and renter subscriptions such as credit-boost programs. The product is delivered as a SaaS web application (app.azibo.com) that integrates third-party providers including Stripe, Plaid, TransUnion, Latchel, and signNow; it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. Zibo was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Zolo
providers.description: Zolo is one of Canada's largest national residential real estate marketplaces and a licensed brokerage, operating as Zolo Ventures Ltd. with provincial brokerage subsidiaries — Zolo Realty (Ontario), (Alberta), (British Columbia), (Saskatchewan), (Manitoba) and (Quebec) Inc. — plus Zolo Mortgages Ltd. and Zolo Mortgages (Alberta) Ltd., all owned by Questrade Financial Group Inc. Founded in 2012 as a digital-first brokerage and headquartered at 1900-5700 Yonge Street in Toronto, Zolo reports over 10 million monthly visitors, 750+ active REALTORS®, and $1.5B+ in annual transaction volume across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan and Ontario. It sits in the Canadian challenger layer alongside HouseSigma, Wahi and Properly, below CREA — the single national cooperative that operates REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF) that syndicates member boards' listings — competing on listing speed, sold-price visibility and home-value tooling over data the boards and CREA control. Its API posture is closed. There is no developer portal, no API program page, no partner or data-licensing page, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind — no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI or MCP surface. The subdomains api., developer., developers., docs., data. and partners.zolo.ca do not resolve in DNS and have never appeared in Certificate Transparency, and every conventional contract path on www.zolo.ca is answered by a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge) rather than a specification. What Zolo does publish is syndication, not integration: an unauthenticated RSS 2.0 new-listings feed at /rss_new_listings.php, a family of sitemaps.org XML documents, and a site-wide schema.org JSON-LD block carrying organization identity only. Behind the edge it operates an undocumented JSON endpoint at /gallery_map_json.php and two first-party mobile apps (com.ols.zolo) on a private backend. Zolo's own robots.txt declares that RSS feed as a sitemap and a CREA terms-acceptance route at /crea_accept.php, and Section 23 of its Terms of Use is a Virtual Office Website (VOW) clause requiring registration, a bona fide interest in buying or selling, personal non-commercial use only, and an express prohibition on "scraping" (including "screen scraping" and "database scraping"), data mining, redistribution or sublicensing — enforceable directly by CREA, TRREB, ITSO, REBGV, Pillar9 and OREB. Access is licensed, not open. RESO is absent: Zolo is not among the nineteen Canadian organizations RESO lists as members, and no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, OData $metadata document, or Universal Property Identifier (UPI) usage was found. No open, unlicensed dataset is published.

providers.name: Appalachian Regional Commission
providers.description: The Appalachian Regional Commission (ARC) is a federal-state partnership that invests in Appalachia's economic future by funding projects that promote economic development, infrastructure improvement, workforce training, and community development across 423 counties in 13 states. ARC provides research data, county-level economic reports, and maps via its Data Report Tool at data.arc.gov.

providers.name: Asseta
providers.description: Asseta is a San Francisco-based online marketplace for the secondary market in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. Founded in 2013, the platform lets fabs, refurbishers, and dealers list and discover used, refurbished, and new components, ranging from chamber assemblies and power supplies to smaller parts like o-rings, with more than 450,000 listings from suppliers around the world. Buyers request quotes from global suppliers with a single click and typically save 50-60% versus OEM pricing. Asseta is a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published web properties.

providers.name: Ataraxis
providers.description: Ataraxis AI is a precision-medicine company building clinical AI foundation models that make disease predictable, beginning with oncology. Founded in 2022 by Jan Witowski, MD, PhD, and Krzysztof Geras, PhD (both formerly of NYU), Ataraxis trains multi-modal AI on hundreds of millions of pathology images to assess disease aggressiveness and predict cancer recurrence, treatment response, and survival. Its first product, Ataraxis Breast, is an AI-native, clinically validated prognostic and predictive test suite for breast cancer (Recurrence Risk, Chemotherapy Benefit, and Neoadjuvant Response) delivering same-day results without exhausting physical tissue. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures, AIX Ventures, and Giant Ventures, and advised by Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. Ataraxis operates a clinician portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Avec
providers.description: Avec is a free, AI-powered email application for Gmail, built by Nearly Extraterrestrial Technology, Inc. The iOS app prioritizes a user's inbox and surfaces important messages one at a time in a card-based interface, learning individual preferences over time so the most relevant email rises to the top. Users swipe to mark messages done or save them for later, compose replies by voice in their own writing style, receive smart notifications with email summaries, and search their mailbox with natural-language AI. Founded in 2024 by CEO Jonathan Unikowski and backed at seed stage by Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Avec is a consumer productivity product rather than an API provider - it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: AvoMD
providers.description: AvoMD (Avo) is a clinical AI platform that integrates directly with electronic health record (EHR) systems to power AI copilots for healthcare workflows. It combines EHR data with trusted clinical knowledge bases to support decision-making, documentation, and care delivery across inpatient and outpatient settings. Avo's product line includes Chart Assist, an AI Scribe for ambient clinical documentation, and AI Consult, serving rural and small hospitals, large and mid-size hospitals, and ambulatory care, in partnership with medical societies and knowledge partners. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant and backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Axiamatic
providers.description: Axiamatic is an enterprise-transformation AI platform that aims to de-risk and accelerate large modernization programs, claiming to cut up to 50% off the cost and timeline of enterprise transformations. Its agentic platform combines a Living Context Graph (a digital twin of a transformation program built from structured and unstructured data), autonomous Transformation Agents that detect risks such as translation loss, resistance, and cross-stream drift, role-specific Playbooks delivered into existing workflows, and Axia, an AI assistant available via voice, chat, Microsoft Teams, or Slack. It targets ERP modernization (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365), CRM consolidation (Salesforce, Dynamics), and supply-chain and business transformation. The company is backed by Greylock and announced a $54M raise. It was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it currently publishes a marketing site and a login application (app.axiamatic.com) but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Baania
providers.description: Baania (Baania (Thailand) Co., Ltd.) is a Thai proptech and real-estate marketplace that aggregates new and second-hand houses, condos, and townhomes for sale across Thailand. The consumer portal provides property listings, project data, reviews, and price comparison to help home buyers make decisions in one place, and connects them directly with property developers and real-estate agents. Backed by 500 Global. Baania is a consumer-facing web portal; no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bandana
providers.description: Bandana (operated by Workwise Solutions Inc.) is a two-sided marketplace and job-search platform for hourly and entry-level workers. Job seekers get free tools to find better-paying local jobs with benefits, generate resumes, auto-match to openings via Bandana Apply, and track applications; employers post jobs for free, reach local talent, promote listings across social platforms, and use a built-in ATS or integrate their existing hiring flow. Backed by Craft Ventures and General Catalyst, Bandana operates across California, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Chicago, and Washington, D.C. As of this profile Bandana publishes no public developer/API surface — no docs portal, OpenAPI, GitHub organization, or /.well-known discovery documents were found; this record captures its public identity and product links.

providers.name: Baton Media
providers.description: Baton is a music collaboration and IP-management platform for unreleased music, built by Baton Media Inc. (New York, Techstars '23). It gives musicians, producers, managers, and talent scouts tools to securely upload, organize, version, and share unreleased tracks, beat packs, and sample libraries across iOS and web. A proprietary media player shows creators exactly who is listening to their material, while collaboration spaces (private, invite-only, or public), an in-app audio studio (looping, pitch shifting, EQ, effects, sample pairing), and a creator-to-fan marketplace support discovery, placement opportunities, and monetization. Baton is building collaboration protocols to track IP rights and automate crediting and compensation across the creator economy. As of this enrichment the company publishes a consumer product (iOS app + web) with no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Bindery
providers.description: Bindery (Bindery Books) is a community-driven, influencer-led book publishing platform and marketplace founded by Matt Kaye and Meg Harvey. It pairs established book "tastemakers" — social-media book reviewers and BookTok / Bookstagram creators — with emerging authors, letting each tastemaker run their own micro-imprint (Ezeekat Press, Boundless Press, Skies Press, and others), acquire titles, weigh in on creative decisions, and promote them to their communities in exchange for a share of net earnings. Often described as "Patreon meets publishing," Bindery combines traditional trade distribution and marketing with paid membership communities, a bookshop, exclusive reviews and author interviews, and iOS and Android apps. The company is backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Bravo Sierra
providers.description: Bravo Sierra is an American personal care company founded in New York City in 2018, building high-performance, clean body care for the most active people. Its "military-native" line — deodorant, body wash, cleansing bars, body fragrance, hair styling paste, and antibacterial body wipes — is designed and field-tested with U.S. Special Operations Forces (starting with the 75th Ranger Regiment's 2nd Battalion) and manufactured in the USA. The direct-to-consumer brand runs on Shopify, offers subscriptions, and gives back a portion of every sale to programs supporting active service members, veterans, and their families. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures identity and the store's first-party well-known discovery and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Bureau of Indian Affairs
providers.description: The Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA) is the oldest bureau in the U.S. Department of the Interior. Its mission is to enhance the quality of life, promote economic opportunity, and carry out the federal responsibility to protect and improve the trust assets of American Indians, Indian tribes, and Alaska Natives. The BIA administers services directly or through contracts, grants, and compacts with 574 federally recognized tribes serving approximately 2.5 million people. BIA publishes geospatial datasets, directories, and forms through the Indian Affairs GIS Open Data portal, the Tribal Leader Directory, and official agency websites.

providers.name: Cantina AI
providers.description: Cantina is a social AI platform founded by Sean Parker (Cantina Labs, San Francisco) that lets people create AI-powered social characters that talk, perform, and interact, then turn them into short videos to share and go viral. The consumer product (cantina.com) centers on building characters with personality, chatting with friends and AI, and generating video in seconds across a public directory of trending bots and creators. Backed by a16z, Benchmark, Greycroft, and Salesforce Ventures. Cantina is a consumer social application and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its real public identity and link properties while no external API is available to enrich.

providers.name: Cheaf
providers.description: Cheaf is a mobile food-rescue marketplace that connects supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, and food retailers holding surplus inventory with consumers who buy it as discounted "surprise packages" at pickup, cutting food waste while helping merchants recover value on stock that would otherwise be thrown away. Founded in Mexico in 2020, the consumer app operates across Mexico, Chile, and Argentina, has more than 3.5 million users, and reports millions of kilograms of food rescued and greenhouse-gas emissions avoided. Businesses list surplus through a merchant onboarding portal and pay a commission on sales; consumers browse and reserve packages through the mobile app. This API Evangelist profile tracks Cheaf's public web and developer surface; Cheaf is a consumer/merchant mobile platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Cherrypick
providers.description: Cherrypick is a London-based food-tech company (backed by Speedinvest) behind an all-in-one meal-planning and grocery-shopping mobile app. The app helps home cooks discover personalized recipes tailored to their dietary preferences, automatically plan their weekly meals, and turn those plans into a supermarket basket at real supermarket prices for home delivery or in-store pickup. Positioned as a lower-cost alternative to recipe-box subscription services, Cherrypick combines recipe discovery, meal planning, and grocery ordering into a single consumer experience aimed at saving people time and money while reducing food waste. Cherrypick is a consumer mobile application with no public developer, API, or partner-integration surface at this time; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a network entity rather than an API producer.

providers.name: China Southern Air Logistics
providers.description: China Southern Air Logistics Co., Ltd. (南航物流, CSAL) is the air cargo and logistics arm of China Southern Airlines, established in December 2018 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It combines the airline's freighter fleet with passenger belly capacity into an integrated air logistics network, and sells express (CZ Speed), standard, special cargo, whole-aircraft charter, intermodal truck and door-to-door products through its Tang (唐翼) online cargo system at cargo.csair.com, where agents and shippers book capacity, query freight rates, track air waybills, manage dangerous-goods accounts and request invoices. As of this profile the company publishes no developer program, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification; system-to-system integration is arranged bilaterally with agents and forwarders.

providers.name: Ciro
providers.description: Ciro (Ciro Technologies Inc.) is an AI sales platform that finds a revenue team's best accounts, deeply qualifies each contact, runs a contact data waterfall for verified emails and phone numbers, and writes signal-based outbound that is pushed directly into existing sales tools. Reps command Ciro in plain English from Slack, where it runs prospect searches, enriches contacts, queries the CRM, analyzes CSVs, drafts multi-step personalized email sequences, and recommends the highest-ROI campaigns. It integrates with Salesforce and HubSpot (CRM); Salesloft, Outreach, Gong Engage, and Instantly (sales engagement); Slack; and webhook-based export to Clay and Zapier. Ciro is sold through a sales-led motion with no published pricing, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and was backed by Y Combinator and CRV. On 2026-07-08 Reevo announced it had acquired Ciro and is folding the prospecting agent into its revenue operating system; ciro.io remains live and still sells, and every page now carries an "acquired by Reevo" banner. Ciro was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched into the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, no developer documentation, no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or AsyncAPI contract, no SDK in any package registry, and no /.well-known/ document — every one of those was probed on 2026-08-14 and missed.

providers.name: City Block
providers.description: Cityblock Health is a value-based healthcare provider delivering integrated primary care, behavioral health, and social-services support to Medicaid and lower-income (dual-eligible) Medicare populations across multiple U.S. markets. Cityblock pairs community-based care teams with a proprietary care-delivery technology platform to coordinate wraparound care for historically underserved communities. The company is backed by 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio profile; it operates as a care provider and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Clean Harbors
providers.description: Clean Harbors is the largest provider of environmental and industrial services in North America, delivering hazardous and non-hazardous waste management, emergency response, industrial cleaning, environmental remediation, and used-oil and solvent recycling through its Safety-Kleen subsidiary. Clean Harbors does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose REST API surface; programmatic interfaces are limited to the authenticated customer portal at clhsaas.cleanharbors.com (CLH SaaS) for service requests, manifests, and reporting, and partner-mediated EDI feeds. Customers also use the EPA e-Manifest system for federally regulated hazardous-waste manifest tracking.

providers.name: Comstruct
providers.description: Comstruct is a Munich-based construction technology company that provides AI-powered agents to automate the procurement of construction materials. Its platform runs the full procurement workflow from the bill of materials (Leistungsverzeichnis) through supplier inquiry, offer comparison, contract negotiation, digital delivery notes, AI-based invoice verification, and sustainability reporting. Customers include HOCHTIEF, Implenia, Marti, and Leonhard Weiss. Comstruct is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of enrichment the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network from its public web presence.

providers.name: Constellation Energy
providers.description: Constellation Energy Corporation is a Fortune 500 clean-energy producer and competitive retail electricity and natural gas supplier in the United States, generating power from a fleet of nuclear, hydro, wind, and solar facilities. Constellation does not publish a public developer portal; programmatic interactions are delivered to enterprise and large commercial customers through the Energy Manager platform (account-managed onboarding, no public API specifications) and consumer interactions are handled through the My Constellation account portal. EDI 867 (usage) and 810 (invoice) remain the most common machine-to-machine integration paths and are arranged on a contract-by-contract basis.

providers.name: Construction Monitor
providers.description: Construction Monitor aggregates building-permit data from county and municipal sources nationwide and resells it as construction leads, contractor intelligence, and historical permit research. Programmatic access is offered through a REST + JSON API backed by Elasticsearch and a weekly data-dump option delivered over secure FTP. Both channels are account-managed; partners receive credentials and a documented endpoint contract directly from Construction Monitor.

providers.name: DoorFeed
providers.description: DoorFeed is a technology-led residential real estate investment platform, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Paris, that helps institutional investors, funds, and family offices source and manage single-family rental portfolios at scale across the UK and France. The platform ingests roughly 150,000 new property listings and over 1,000,000 property images every day, structuring market data, comparable transactions, valuation signals, and energy-performance data into a single acquisition and asset-management workflow that takes investors from market screening to investment decision in minutes. DoorFeed is backed by HV Capital, Seedcamp, and Motive Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline; DoorFeed publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: DriveNets
providers.description: DriveNets is a networking software company that applies the disaggregated cloud model to telco-grade and AI networking. Its DriveNets Network Cloud runs DNOS, a cloud-native distributed network operating system, across shared white-box hardware to serve core, aggregation, access, peering, DCI, and AI-fabric use cases. The Network Cloud AI fabric delivers Ethernet-based GPU-cluster interconnect positioned as an alternative to InfiniBand. Founded in 2015, DriveNets powers disaggregated backbones for operators including AT&T, Comcast, Orange, and KDDI. Device management is exposed programmatically via NETCONF/gNMI over OpenConfig and DriveNets YANG models, with a first-party drivenets.dnos Ansible collection for automation; there is no public REST API.

providers.name: DubClub
providers.description: DubClub is an all-in-one platform to create and join sports betting communities. It is a marketplace connecting sports betting content creators known as cappers or handicappers with subscribers who want timely, reliable betting picks and analysis. Creators monetize their expertise by selling picks and predictions through paid subscriptions, while subscribers receive content directly via notifications and messaging rather than scattered across social media and Discord. DubClub has facilitated tens of millions in payments for creators and delivered hundreds of millions of messages containing informational sports betting content. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital; DubClub publishes a consumer web product and does not expose a public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: dwell
providers.description: Dwell is a digital publication and lifestyle brand focused on modern home design, architecture, and interior inspiration, published by Ziff Davis. It offers curated home tours, architectural features, renovation and before/after projects, design photography, real estate listings, shopping guides, and design news, plus a Dwell+ subscription for ad-free access and subscriber exclusives, a shop for furniture and decor, and a "Find a Pro" professional directory. Dwell was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent lead in the API Evangelist network; the public dwell.com property is a consumer media site with no developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so no API artifacts are captured for it.

providers.name: Emtethal
providers.description: Emtethal is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia based smart compliance and inspection management platform for the food service and hospitality sectors, backed by 500 Global. The platform automates inspection scheduling and distribution, provides custom checklists per facility type, captures photo documentation with automatic timestamps and GPS location, detects and categorizes violations automatically, and pushes real-time alerts for critical issues. It layers analytics and compliance reporting on top of an offline-capable mobile field-inspection app (iOS and Android) and AI-powered camera and sensor monitoring. Emtethal serves both individual food facilities and consulting firms managing multiple client sites, offering a 14-day free trial. There is no public API, developer portal, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile is an API Evangelist company lead maintained for enrichment and monitoring.

providers.name: Eventnoire
providers.description: Eventnoire is an event discovery and ticketing platform centered on Black culture, helping attendees find and buy tickets to concerts, festivals, parties, and community events while giving organizers tools to create and manage events, sell tickets, and grow their audiences. A Techstars-backed company, Eventnoire runs consumer discovery at eventnoire.com alongside an organizer/partner portal and a culture-focused blog. It currently exposes no public developer API, so this profile captures the company's public web surface (blog, legal, organizer sign-up, attendee login, support) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Eversettled
providers.description: EverSettled is a digital estate-settlement platform that guides families through the probate process after a death. Positioned between expensive probate attorneys and overwhelming do-it-yourself paperwork, it combines an adaptive, state-specific estate checklist, automated asset discovery across bank accounts, insurance policies and subscriptions, subscription cancellation and debt negotiation, secure document organization, a dedicated human estate-care specialist, and Sage, a 24/7 AI probate assistant. Available across all 50 U.S. states, EverSettled is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. Backed by a $5M seed round led by Emergence Capital with participation from Seedcamp.

providers.name: EverTrue
providers.description: EverTrue is a donor experience and fundraising platform for nonprofit, higher-education, and healthcare advancement teams, serving more than 13,000 teams. Its product suite spans AI-driven prospect identification and research (Signal, DonorSearch), donor outreach and stewardship (ThankView personalized video, Pledgemine direct mail), and endowment reporting (Balance, Impact, ODDER). EverTrue integrates with advancement CRMs such as Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT via an automated data sync. EverTrue operates as a closed B2B SaaS: it runs internal REST APIs behind its iOS, Android, and single-page web applications but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API program. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Techstars.

providers.name: Farther
providers.description: Farther is a technology-driven wealth management and registered investment advisory (RIA) firm that pairs human financial advisors with a proprietary "Intelligent Wealth Platform." The firm has recruited more than $23 billion in client assets and positions itself among the fastest-growing US financial services firms (Inc. Magazine, Deloitte Technology Fast 500). Services span financial and retirement planning, investment and portfolio management, tax-intelligent optimization, trust and estate planning, generational wealth, small-business services, Farther Asset Management, and institutional offerings. The client experience runs through a single-page web/mobile application at app.farther.com and integrates account aggregation via Plaid. Farther does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures the firm's public web, security, and identity surface. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Formic
providers.description: Formic is a Chicago, Illinois-based Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) company founded in 2020 by Saman Farid that delivers full-service industrial automation to American manufacturers on a pay-per-hour, fixed monthly subscription model with no capital expenditure. Formic specializes in end-of-line manufacturing operations — palletizing, case packing, and robotic pallet wrapping — and pairs deployed robots with a 24/7 remote monitoring, support, and field-service operation. The company's software stack includes Formic Core, an embedded operating system that abstracts motion, vision, sensing, and real-time coordination across heterogeneous industrial robot hardware (Fanuc, ABB, Kuka, Doosan) behind unified control interfaces; Formic Cortex; the Colony 2.0 fleet dashboard; FAST configuration tools; and Formic Production Intelligence (FPI), a manufacturer-facing analytics surface. Formic has raised more than $86M across rounds led by Lux Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and other investors, and works through a network of 100+ system-integrator partners with 500+ systems deployed. Formic's revenue model is the RaaS subscription itself; there is no public developer API, no published SDKs, and no public customer-portal API documentation. Formic Core's "unified APIs" are internal abstractions used by Formic engineers and integrator partners to drive robot hardware — they are not exposed to manufacturers or third-party developers.

providers.name: Geneoscopy
providers.description: Geneoscopy is a commercial-stage molecular diagnostics company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, focused on gastrointestinal health. Its platform analyzes stool-derived eukaryotic RNA (seRNA) biomarkers, a proprietary approach the company applies to colorectal cancer screening, inflammatory bowel disease and other gastrointestinal conditions. Its lead product, ColoSense, is a noninvasive multi-target stool RNA (mt-sRNA) colorectal cancer screening test approved by the FDA in May 2024 for adults aged 45 and older at average risk; it evaluates eight colorectal neoplasia-associated RNA markers together with occult hemoglobin, and has since been added to the American Cancer Society and NCCN colorectal cancer screening guidelines. Geneoscopy operates a CLIA-certified (26D2253457) and CAP-accredited clinical laboratory with permits in New York, California, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island and the District of Columbia, and partners with biopharma and research organizations on stool-biomarker diagnostics and prognostics. Geneoscopy is a diagnostics and clinical-laboratory company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Glyf
providers.description: Glyf is an AI-powered creative tool for motion designers, studios, and creative teams, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z Speedrun). It transforms 2D animations into stylized 3D with custom textures and effects, enhances live-action footage, and lets creators train bespoke AI models to match their own artistic direction, with exports into After Effects, Nuke, and other compositing pipelines. The product has since been rebranded and now ships as StyleFrame (www.styleframe.ai), a timeline-based, keyframe-driven video-generation platform where creators place keyframes and prompt tracks to control every frame of an animation. As of this enrichment pass, Glyf/StyleFrame is a consumer-facing creative application with no public API, developer documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: Greenwork
providers.description: Greenwork builds software for the HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) industry and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). Its flagship product, Onsite Pro, is a digital pricebook and proposal platform for HVAC distributors and their dealers: it replaces Excel and PDF catalogs with searchable product data, automated AHRI equipment matchups, incentive and rebate application, and one-click proposal generation, while giving distributors visibility into dealer catalog performance, win rates, and share of wallet. Greenwork does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and its public web and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Grotto AI
providers.description: Grotto AI is an AI sales-coaching platform purpose-built for the multifamily apartment leasing industry. Founded by former EvolutionIQ leaders Nick Deveau (CEO) and Ben Epstein (CTO), Grotto delivers real-time call guidance, tour and call coaching, and prospect-lifecycle support across email and text that help leasing agents handle objections, book tours, and convert more leads to recover net operating income and asset value. The platform works alongside multifamily systems such as Entrata, Funnel, and Yardi and is used by operators including Weidner Apartment Homes and Hillpointe. Grotto is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27701 certified and Fair Housing compliant. It is backed by ICONIQ. Grotto does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it is a demo-led enterprise SaaS product.

providers.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (trading as IHG Hotels & Resorts) is a British asset-light hotel group headquartered at Windsor Dials, 1 Arthur Road, Windsor, Berkshire SL4 1RS, United Kingdom, with an Americas office at 3 Ravinia Drive, Atlanta, Georgia. Its own corporate site states 7,014 hotels and 1,035,589 rooms across more than 100 countries, around 400,000 colleagues, 20 brands and the IHG One Rewards loyalty programme (figures read from ihgplc.com on 2026-07-28). The brand portfolio spans Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, voco, HUALUXE, Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Resorts, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Garner, avid, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites, IHG Army Hotels and Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. In the distribution chain IHG sits on the supply side as a franchisor and manager rather than an owner: it aggregates independently owned and operated properties into a single central reservation system and pushes that inventory out through its own ihg.com and app direct channels, through the three GDSs and their agency terminals, through OTAs and wholesalers, and through corporate and group channels. Critically, IHG does not run its own reservation platform any more. It announced a partnership with Amadeus in 2015 to build a cloud Guest Reservation System to replace HOLIDEX, its proprietary system in service since 1965, and migrated onto it across 2018 and early 2019 — so the hotel group most likely to be a lock-in vendor is itself a customer of a GDS company's platform, and group bookings land in Amadeus Delphi and Meeting Broker. Its API posture, stated honestly, is gated and undocumented. There is no live developer portal. The one that existed — PartnerConnect RoomService at pcroomservice.ihg.com, a TIBCO Mashery portal publishing five rate, availability and hotel-content APIs — is decommissioned: the hostname is NXDOMAIN on Google, Cloudflare and Quad9 resolvers as of 2026-07-28 and the Internet Archive holds no page capture after 2019. What remains live is partnerconnect.ihg.com (HTTP 200), an affiliate marketing programme whose signup routes to Commission Junction and which still advertises "access to real-time hotel rates, availability and hotel content API's" without linking to any technical resource. Real API hostnames exist — api.ihg.com CNAMEs to ihg.api.mashery.com with an sb-ihg.mashery.com sandbox, and apis.ihg.com, b2b.ihg.com, mcp.ihg.com, booking.ihg.com and concerto.ihg.com all sit behind Akamai — but every one returns 403 Access Denied or 401 on every path probed, including /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/. No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, XSD, OpenTravel/OTA or HTNG reference is published anywhere by IHG. apis[] is deliberately empty: listing an Akamai-gated hostname or a decommissioned 2017 portal as a live API would be fabrication. The value of this record is the switchingCost block in review.yml, which captures what published IHG documents actually say about what it costs to leave — including the archived RoomService Terms of Use classing "API parameters" as Confidential Information and binding partners to the Master PartnerConnect Terms and Conditions plus the Six Continents Hotels E-commerce Master Service Agreement, and the current IHG One Rewards member terms stating that members whose accounts are cancelled "by IHG or by the Member, will forfeit all Points, Point vouchers, Reward Nights, and any other benefits associated with the account".

providers.name: Jargon
providers.description: Jargon is a platform for Domain Driven Design for APIs and Enterprise Data Modelling. It provides text-based modelling, template-based API design, real-time validation, version control with breaking change detection, and generation of artifacts including JSON Schema, OpenAPI specifications, and JSON-LD. Jargon supports DevOps-driven collaborative modelling for teams designing and governing domains at enterprise scale.

providers.name: Kyrok
providers.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lenus eHealth
providers.description: Lenus eHealth is a Copenhagen-headquartered health and fitness technology company that builds a coaching platform for online health and fitness coaches, positioning itself as a growth partner rather than a consumer fitness app. Coaching partners run their businesses through the Lenus web dashboard and branded consumer mobile apps: client onboarding and screening, training and nutrition programming, habit and progress tracking, in-app messaging, content delivery, subscription billing and business analytics. The company also operates Lenus Academy, a certified education program for online coaches, and in the United States offers a GLP-1 weight management program delivered with independent medical partner Beluga Health. Lenus operates from 20+ offices including Copenhagen, Berlin, London, Amsterdam, Stockholm, Madrid, New York and Toronto, and is backed by EQT Ventures. The platform is closed and invitation-based: as of July 2026 Lenus publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications, and access is available only to coaching partners under a partnership agreement.

providers.name: Leona
providers.description: Leona is a healthcare communication company building an AI co-pilot for doctors and medical teams who run their practices over WhatsApp. Patients keep messaging WhatsApp as they always have, while the clinician side moves into Leona, where work conversations are separated from personal ones, categorized and prioritized, summarized for context, and voice notes are transcribed. Teams delegate chats by role, keep internal notes on a patient that the patient never sees, and reuse templates for repeated answers. Founded by Caroline Merin (CEO, formerly COO at Rappi), Tom Chokel (CTO, formerly CTO at Modern Fertility) and Arela Solis (Head of Operations), Leona launched publicly in December 2025 and serves physicians across Latin America. It ships as iOS, Android and web clients and publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: Lumeon
providers.description: Lumeon is a clinical automation and care orchestration platform that uses intelligent automation and real-time data integration to remove inefficiencies from care-coordination processes. It lets health systems scale best-practice care pathways across the enterprise so clinicians can focus on patients while operational cost falls and outcomes improve. Lumeon serves 70+ health systems globally — including Optum, NYC Health+Hospitals, and the NHS — and is now part of Health Catalyst. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published; this profile captures the company identity and its security and compliance posture.

providers.name: Material Bank
providers.description: Material Bank is a B2B digital marketplace that lets architects, interior designers, and other design professionals search, sample, and specify building and design materials from 650+ brands across hundreds of categories through a single platform, with free overnight sample delivery. The platform provides project boards, brand collections, sustainability filters (EPDs, CDPH), and a manufacturer portal for brands. Backed by bain-capital-ventures and general-catalyst. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: MEAL PLANET HOLDING LTD
providers.description: MealPlanet (MEAL PLANET HOLDING LTD) is a UAE-based foodtech company, founded in 2024 by Khalid Baareh, that operates a meal-plan aggregation marketplace. Its consumer mobile app lets customers browse, compare, and subscribe to more than 500 personalised meal plans from 100+ trusted brands across the UAE, filtering by goal, calories, and dietary preferences, with flexible delivery and nutrition tracking. In 2024 the company closed a $6M seed round led by Middle East Venture Partners (MEVP) with participation from Sanabil 500 (the Sanabil Accelerator by 500 Global), AlTouq Group, Faith Capital, and Alturki Ventures, funding regional expansion beginning with Saudi Arabia. MealPlanet is a consumer-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mercanto
providers.description: Mercanto (mercanto.mx) is a Mexican B2B wholesale marketplace that supplies restaurants, cafeterias, and food-service businesses with ingredients, groceries, cleaning supplies, and packaging bought at wholesale from vetted suppliers, with negotiated pricing and next-day delivery. Buyers order across categories including produce, groceries and pantry, dairy and eggs, proteins and cold cuts, bakery and desserts, beverages, frozen foods, and non-food items, while Mercanto handles supplier selection, negotiation, and fulfillment. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures. Its customer-facing storefront runs on a private backend (api.mercanto.mx) that is not publicly documented for third-party developers, so there is no public API product, developer portal, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Merchbar
providers.description: Merchbar, Inc. is the official merchandise retailer for top musicians, selling vinyl records, CDs, t-shirts, hoodies, posters, and other band merchandise across thousands of artist storefronts at merchbar.com. It runs a consumer shopping experience alongside a "Merchbar for Artists" program and official merchandise integrations with YouTube and Spotify. Merchbar is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Merchbar publishes no public API, developer program, SDKs, or technical documentation — no developer/api/docs subdomain resolves and there is no /.well-known/security.txt — so this profile captures only its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: MkDocs
providers.description: MkDocs is a fast, simple, and beautiful static site generator designed for building project documentation from Markdown source files. Written in Python, it reads a single YAML configuration file (mkdocs.yml) and converts a directory of Markdown documents into a self-contained static HTML site. MkDocs supports multiple built-in themes (mkdocs, readthedocs), a rich plugin ecosystem via Python entry points, live-reloading development server, and one-command deployment to GitHub Pages.

providers.name: MosaicML
providers.description: MosaicML was a San Francisco-based foundation model training company founded in 2021 by Naveen Rao and Hanlin Tang to make large-scale model training faster and cheaper through algorithmic and systems efficiency. Databricks acquired MosaicML in July 2023 for approximately $1.3 billion and folded the team and platform into Databricks Mosaic AI Research. The MosaicML training platform is now delivered as Databricks Mosaic AI Training (pretraining and finetuning), and the original mosaicml.com domain redirects to the Databricks Mosaic Research microsite. MosaicML's surviving open-source artifacts include Composer (a PyTorch training library with built-in speedup recipes), Streaming (a cloud-native dataset format for efficient distributed training), LLM Foundry (the training code behind Databricks' DBRX foundation model), the Diffusion training stack, and the MCLI command line and Python SDK that orchestrate Pretraining and Finetuning jobs against the managed training service. The Mosaic AI Training service itself is accessed exclusively through the MCLI command line, the mosaicml-cli Python SDK, and Databricks workspace integrations — there is no publicly published REST OpenAPI surface for the training control plane. Commercial access requires a Databricks account; pricing is consumption-based via Databricks DBU billing rather than an independent MosaicML pricing page.

providers.name: Mozi
providers.description: Mozi is a private social network mobile app founded by Twitter and Medium co-founder Ev Williams and Molly DeWolf Swenson, and backed by Obvious Ventures. Rather than public profiles or follower counts, Mozi privately matches your phone contacts so you learn when friends are in the same city, attending the same events, or checking in nearby — designed to spark in-person "social serendipity" and get people off their screens. Launched in December 2024 and available in 135+ countries, Mozi is a consumer iOS/Android application with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: NDBC — National Data Buoy Center
providers.description: The NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC) operates a global network of over 1,000 moored buoys, drifting buoys, Coastal-Marine Automated Network (C-MAN) stations, and partner stations that continuously measure and transmit meteorological and oceanographic conditions. Real-time and historical data — wind direction and speed, wave height and period, sea surface temperature, atmospheric pressure, air temperature, dew point, visibility, and salinity — are distributed freely via HTTP file URLs, a THREDDS/OPeNDAP server (NetCDF), an RSS observation feed, and a latest-observations snapshot updated every five minutes. No API key or authentication is required; data is in the public domain under U.S. government open-data policy.

providers.name: Nirvana Tech
providers.description: Nirvana Insurance (Nirvana Tech, Inc.) is a technology-driven commercial trucking insurance provider that pairs A-rated fleet insurance coverage with an AI-powered active safety platform. Nirvana ingests telematics and connected-vehicle data from motor carriers to price risk more accurately, help fleets save up to 20% on premiums, and reduce accidents through real-time safety alerts, driver coaching, and predictive risk scoring. The company serves fleets and independent insurance agents through a digital quoting and policy-management agent portal, and is backed by General Catalyst. Nirvana raised a Series D round to expand its data-driven insurance and safety products across the trucking industry. As of this profile Nirvana operates a marketing site plus an agent sign-in portal and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Noname Security
providers.description: Noname Security (acquired by Akamai in 2024) is an API security platform that provides complete API discovery, posture management, runtime protection, and active testing capabilities. The platform helps organizations discover all APIs including shadow and rogue APIs, detect misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, and protect against API-based attacks across their entire API estate.

providers.name: Norm Ai
providers.description: Norm Ai (legal name Nomos AI, Inc.) is a legal and compliance AI company that embeds law and regulation directly into autonomous AI agents. Its platform spans Norm Law (an AI-native law firm), Norm Technology (domain-expert-built compliance agents), and Supervisory AI (systems that verify agent compliance), automating legal and regulatory workflows for financial institutions and enterprises. Backed by a $120M Series C round, it serves clients managing over $30 trillion in combined assets. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published; this profile captures the company's security, compliance, and identity surface.

providers.name: Nowports
providers.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder for Latin America, offering technology-enabled international logistics across ocean, air, and ground freight. Its Centraliza platform centralizes shipment tracking, document management, and alerts, while adjacent services cover cargo insurance and GPS tracking (Protege) and inventory financing and factoring (Financia). Backed by Partech and Y Combinator, Nowports serves importers and exporters on major trade routes through its authenticated web app at app.nowports.com. As of this profile Nowports exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; access is via its authenticated web platform.

providers.name: OpenDNS
providers.description: OpenDNS is a cloud-delivered recursive DNS and internet security service founded in 2005 and acquired by Cisco in 2015, where its enterprise capabilities now form the foundation of the Cisco Umbrella platform. OpenDNS continues to offer free consumer products - OpenDNS Home and OpenDNS Family Shield - providing recursive DNS resolution, phishing and malware blocking, and content filtering with parental controls across every device on a home network, all managed through the OpenDNS dashboard. Enterprise DNS-layer security, secure web gateway, and the Investigate threat-intelligence API have migrated to Cisco Umbrella (umbrella.cisco.com). Added to the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company in the cybersecurity sector.

providers.name: Outverse
providers.description: Outverse is an enterprise "service AI operating system" from Outverse Limited, a UK company backed by Seedcamp and Wing Venture Capital. Its platform lets support and operations teams deploy governed AI agents across complex customer-service workflows — email, chat, voice, and API-driven actions — from a single control center. Teams define logic, policies, and human handoffs in natural language SOPs rather than rigid workflow builders, and get observability over every agent decision, tool call, workflow path, and escalation. Outverse integrates with existing CCaaS and CRM stacks (Salesforce, Freshdesk, Genesys, Twilio, Talkdesk) and offers voice agents that verify identity, retrieve data, apply policy, and resolve calls end to end. The company advertises SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification and does not expose a public developer API at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and Wing Venture Capital.

providers.name: Packmatic
providers.description: Packmatic is a Berlin-based packaging procurement platform that helps companies source flexible and paper-based packaging at lower cost. It combines a proprietary supplier database and a smart-matching engine spanning 350+ suppliers with expert packaging engineers and a cloud-based platform for managing quotes, orders, and supplier communication. Customers pay no upfront fees; Packmatic earns a commission when they source through its network, reporting average savings around 16% and reducing supplier search time by roughly 70%. Packmatic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Paraform
providers.description: Paraform is an agentic hiring marketplace where expert recruiters and custom AI agents work together to fill companies' most important roles. Companies post open roles and work with multiple vetted recruiters from a network of 10,000+ professionals in one place, while Paraform's AI toolkit handles sourcing, candidate matching, CRM, notetaking, and scheduling. The platform charges a listing (subscription) fee to publish roles and a success fee when a hire is made. Paraform does not publish a public developer API; instead it integrates into customers' existing ATS and productivity tools (Ashby, Greenhouse, Slack, Gmail, Calendly, Google Calendar) by consuming those partners' APIs and webhooks to keep candidate, role, and interview status in sync bidirectionally.

providers.name: Parkopedia
providers.description: With the roll-out of connected cars, services such as live traffic and live parking have become standard requirements. Parkopedia leads the market in parking data services, with 90 million parking spaces globally across 90 countries, available via the Parkopedia parking API or feed.

providers.name: Parspec
providers.description: Parspec is an AI-native platform for electrical, lighting, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) distributors and manufacturer rep agencies in the construction supply chain. It consolidates fragmented, manual workflows into one system covering quoting for complex projects, automated submittal and O&M document creation, project management (orders, fulfillment, billing), and sales management, with ERP integrations (Epicor Eclipse, Epicor Prophet 21, SAP). Parspec is SOC 2 Type II attested and markets itself to help distributors and rep agencies bid more, win more, and improve profitability. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: Picnic
providers.description: Picnic is a London-based, privacy-first photo-organization app for iOS that helps people declutter and organize their camera roll through a swipe-based, gamified experience — sorting photos into albums, comparing and removing duplicate shots, building streaks, and resurfacing "on this day" memories. All processing happens on-device, so photos never leave the user's phone: no cloud upload, no ads, and no tracking or selling of user data. Founded in 2019 and a certified B Corporation, Picnic grew to more than 1.5 million users and roughly €4M ARR before being acquired by Paris-based mobile app publisher MWM in April 2026. Picnic is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Presto
providers.description: Presto Charging (Presto) is an electric-vehicle charging platform that aggregates access to 180,000+ public chargers across 20+ North American networks — including EVgo, ChargePoint, Blink, BP Pulse, and Flo — behind a single mobile app, payment method, and account. For drivers it offers price comparison, real-time charger availability, and a unified charging experience on iOS and Android. For fleets and enterprises it delivers charge management, granular usage data, and white-label products so operators can "manage charging like they manage fuel." For charging networks it drives utilization and station profitability. Presto exposes OCPI-compliant, mobile-first APIs and SDKs so fleet-solution and mobility partners can embed public charging — including Plug and Charge and Autocharge — under their own brand. Backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Raymond James Bank
providers.description: Raymond James Bank is a Florida-chartered state member bank headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Raymond James Financial, Inc. (NYSE: RJF), a diversified financial services holding company founded in 1962. Supervised by the Federal Reserve and the Florida Office of Financial Regulation, the bank provides securities-based lending, residential mortgages, commercial and industrial and commercial real estate loans, tax-exempt loans, and deposit products (including its Enhanced Savings Program) primarily to Raymond James wealth-management and institutional clients. On open finance, the bank runs no first-party public developer portal and publishes no downloadable API specifications; consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only indirectly through third-party aggregators such as Plaid. No FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is publicly documented for this institution as of this record.

providers.name: ReadyAPI
providers.description: ReadyAPI is SmartBear's enterprise-grade automated API testing platform. It unifies functional, security, performance, and virtualization testing for REST, SOAP, GraphQL, Kafka, JDBC, and JMS APIs. ReadyAPI is delivered as a desktop and CI/CD tool rather than as a public REST API, integrating with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, and other automation platforms via TestEngine.

providers.name: Reflex Careers
providers.description: Reflex (Reflex Careers) is an on-demand labor platform for retail stores, connecting brands and store operators with vetted, background-checked associates for short-notice shift coverage. The platform handles employer-of-record responsibilities including payroll, tax withholding, and compliance, lets retailers post shifts with as little as two hours' notice, and uses a two-way review system to build worker track records and brand-specific training per shift. Reflex serves retail brands including Ariat, Faherty, Fossil, and Everlane and is backed by Canaan Partners. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Canaan Partners portfolio; as of this enrichment pass Reflex publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Rex Airlines
providers.description: Rex Airlines (Regional Express, IATA ZL / ICAO RXA) is Australia's second-largest regional carrier, headquartered in Mascot, New South Wales, flying a Saab 340 fleet to roughly 45 regional destinations across every Australian state. Formed in 2002 from the merger of Hazelton and Kendell Airlines, Rex entered voluntary administration in July 2024 and was acquired by US holding company Air T in December 2025 with Australian federal government debt support. In the distribution chain Rex is the inventory owner, not an intermediary — it runs Sabre's SabreSonic passenger service suite (inventory, reservations, ticketing, ancillaries, check-in) per Sabre's February 2021 announcement, sells direct through its own ASP.NET booking engine at ibe2.rex.com.au, and reaches trade through a web-only Travel Agent portal gated on an IATA, DAPA or TIDS agency number. Its API posture is honest to state plainly: no developer portal, no public documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC claim anywhere on rex.com.au. The only published trace of a programmatic interface is a bare "Request API Access" checkbox on the agent registration form — accreditation required, contract unspecified, nothing documented, and no exit path beyond a privacy-law request to the Customer Contact Centre.

providers.name: Shef
providers.description: Shef is a consumer marketplace for homemade food, connecting home cooks and chefs with nearby customers who order freshly prepared, culturally diverse meals delivered to their door. Cooks build a menu, take orders, and ship weekly; eaters browse local shefs, order meals, and reheat at home. The company operates a business-to-consumer web and mobile ordering experience and does not publish a public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or webhook surface. This API Evangelist profile was created as a lead from venture-capital portfolio data and enriched via live web and DNS/TLS probing; the honest result of that pass is that Shef exposes no public API artifacts, only a consumer storefront and standard company pages.

providers.name: Shweproperty
providers.description: Shweproperty (ShweProperty.com) is Myanmar's leading online real estate marketplace, founded in 2015, connecting buyers, renters, sellers, and agents across the country. The consumer-facing portal lists residential and commercial properties for sale and rent — apartments, condos, houses, land, shops, offices, and industrial zones — in Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, and beyond, alongside new-development project listings, home-loan assistance with Myanmar banking partners, property events and expos, and real estate news and buyer guides. The platform carries over 200,000 listings with 500+ added daily and handles tens of thousands of monthly sales inquiries. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this remains a consumer web and mobile property portal.

providers.name: SmartShoot
providers.description: SmartShoot is a San Francisco-based (founded 2012) photography and video production platform that connects enterprises and marketing teams with a managed network of more than 200,000 professional photographers and videographers to produce custom, on-brand photo and video content at scale. The web-based platform coordinates shoot booking, project collaboration, editing, and cloud-based delivery across many locations, serving e-commerce, real estate, and multi-location brands such as Google, YouTube, Uber, Expedia, and Yelp. SmartShoot is a B2B managed-service marketplace with no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal as of this enrichment pass; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Svbtle
providers.description: Svbtle is a minimalist publishing and blogging platform designed to work the way your brain does, pairing a distraction-free Markdown editor with a simple dashboard for organizing drafts, developing ideas, and publishing to a clean reading experience. Created by Dustin Curtis and operated by Neutral Corporation, Svbtle emphasizes longevity through its "Forever Promise" that published writing remains permanently accessible online. Svbtle is a subscription-based writer's network rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, OAuth authorization server, or .well-known metadata, and each blog is exposed only as a human-readable site with an RSS feed.

providers.name: Swypex
providers.description: Swypex is an Egyptian fintech, founded in 2022 and headquartered at Smart Village in Cairo, that provides an all-in-one financial management platform for businesses. The platform bundles corporate cards, payments, invoice management, and working capital financing into one system, giving finance teams real-time visibility and control over company spend. Swypex launched Egypt's first approval-based corporate card, where each transaction's limit unlocks only after real-time review and approval by the company's finance team, and offers e-invoicing (with an Odoo integration) and Swypextend working-capital financing. Swypex is licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt and operates its card program in partnership with Visa and Mashreq Bank. It raised a $4M seed round led by Accel (Accel's first fintech investment in MENA), with Foundation Ventures and Raba Partnership. Swypex does not publish a public developer API; its products are delivered through web and mobile apps plus a small set of native integrations (Odoo, e-invoicing, Just2Pay).

providers.name: TableApp
providers.description: TABLEAPP (Tableapp Sdn Bhd, part of FunNow Ltd) is a real-time restaurant discovery and reservation platform serving diners across Malaysia (Klang Valley) and Thailand. Consumers discover restaurants and book tables with instant confirmation through the TABLEAPP website and iOS/Android apps, and the TABLEAPP ELITE membership unlocks free signature dishes at partner restaurants, alongside dining vouchers and gift cards. Restaurateurs list on both TABLEAPP and FunNow and manage reservations and guest preferences with the TABLEAPP Manager tools. TableApp is a 500 Global portfolio company; it operates a private mobile-app backend (api.tableapp.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Thyrocare
providers.description: Thyrocare Technologies Limited is an Indian chain of diagnostic and preventive-care laboratories headquartered in Navi Mumbai, founded in 1996. Built around a centralized, highly automated laboratory model, it focuses on affordable preventive health checkups, thyroid and pathology testing, and sells through a nationwide network of DSA (Direct Selling Agent) franchise partners. Norwest Venture Partners invested pre-IPO, and PharmEasy (API Holdings) acquired a majority stake in 2021. Its partner order-booking API (TechSo/BTS) is gated behind the DSA program and publishes no public OpenAPI.

providers.name: Tryadonis
providers.description: Adonis (Adonis Technology, Inc., tryadonis.com redirects to adonis.io) is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) software company that applies AI to medical billing. Its platform connects in real time with a practice's existing EHR, practice-management, billing, and patient-portal systems to surface revenue-related insights, automate claims and billing workflows, and reduce manual work for revenue teams. The company is backed by Homebrew. This is a B2B SaaS product with a private, authenticated product API (api.adonis.io) and a customer app (app.adonis.io); it does not currently operate a public developer program, OpenAPI documentation, or API portal.

providers.name: Vancity Community Investment Bank
providers.description: Vancity Community Investment Bank (VCIB) is a federally regulated Schedule I chartered bank headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Vancouver City Savings Credit Union (Vancity), Canada's largest community credit union. Established to carry the cooperative "community-first" finance model into the national banking system, VCIB is a values-driven, Certified B Corporation and CDIC member that provides impact-focused commercial banking - commercial real estate and affordable-housing lending, clean-energy and green-building finance, social-enterprise banking, Impact GICs, high-interest savings, and business Visa products - to organizations driving social, economic, and environmental change. As a small impact/commercial bank rather than one of the Big Six, VCIB operates no public developer portal, exposes no first-party developer API, and publishes no downloadable API specifications. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and the 2024 Fall Economic Statement under the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, is not yet operational, so any third-party access to VCIB customer data today would be voluntary and aggregator-mediated rather than via a documented open API.

providers.name: Visual Studio Code
providers.description: Visual Studio Code is a free, open-source, cross-platform code editor developed by Microsoft for Windows, Linux, macOS, and the web, built on the MIT-licensed Code - OSS project and distinguished by features such as IntelliSense, debugging, integrated Git, and a marketplace with tens of thousands of extensions. VS Code is not a SaaS REST API; instead, developers extend the editor through the Extension API, a TypeScript / JavaScript programmatic interface that exposes nearly every aspect of the editor for customization. This index points to the Extension API documentation and surrounding developer resources.

providers.name: Vivun
providers.description: Vivun is a B2B software company building AI teammates for revenue and sales teams using structured reasoning. Its flagship product, Hero, is an AI teammate built to help sellers win, and it pioneered the PreSales management category with tooling for sales engineering teams. Vivun also promotes a Sales Reasoning Model (SRM) and Agent Intelligence approach. The company is venture-backed by Accel and Menlo Ventures. As of this profile Vivun exposes a public product and trust surface (website, blog, resources, trust center) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this record captures its verified security, compliance, and web identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: WE11DONE
providers.description: WE11DONE (pronounced "well done") is a Seoul-based fashion label founded in 2015 by Dami Kwon and Jessica Jung, the duo behind the Seoul concept boutique Rare Market. The brand fuses late-1990s and early-2000s streetwear and athleisure aesthetics into a globally distributed designer ready-to-wear line, sold through its own e-commerce storefront at we11-done.com and stockists worldwide. Surfaced as a consumer-sector portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 confirmed the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail website but publishes no developer API surface: no developer portal, API reference, well-known metadata, or llms.txt were found.

providers.name: WellTheory
providers.description: WellTheory is a virtual autoimmune care platform that provides whole-person support for people living with autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, pairing members with a dedicated care team for nutrition, lifestyle, and clinical guidance across more than 100 conditions. The company sells to employers and health plans as a covered benefit as well as direct to consumers, and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. WellTheory publishes no public developer API surface today; its api.welltheory.com backend and docs are private/internal.

providers.name: Yardi Propware
providers.description: Yardi Propware was the original flagship property management software by Yardi Systems, first released in 1984. It was an early desktop-based real estate management platform for residential and commercial property accounting, leasing, and management. Yardi has since evolved its platform into cloud-based offerings including Yardi Voyager and Yardi Breeze. No publicly accessible developer portal or documented REST API has been confirmed for Yardi Propware specifically; Yardi's modern integrations are managed through the Yardi Interface Partnership Program.

providers.name: Z1
providers.description: Z1 is the API Evangelist network profile for the consumer social gaming app operated by Bunch Live, Inc., known publicly as Bunch and now rebranded as Mini Party (mini.party). The product lets friends hang out, play party games, and video chat together in real time on mobile, and connects with external services such as Discord. Bunch raised early venture funding (including a $3.8M round) and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Bunch formerly operated a Bunch Developer Platform (the "Party Kit" voice/video SDK for iOS, Android, and Unity plus a Party Reservation API), but that developer program has been discontinued and the company currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal — this profile captures its identity, legal surface, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Abodu
providers.description: Abodu designs, manufactures, and installs prefabricated accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and backyard homes across California. It offers state-approved plans with fixed all-in pricing and installation as fast as one day, spanning seven models from the 385 sq ft Abodu Studio to the 1,195 sq ft Abodu Three+, plus an Abodu Office. The homes target homeowners seeking rental income, aging-in-place, home offices, and guest houses, as well as multifamily operators, and feature fire-resistant construction with an optional Net Zero solar package. Abodu is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: AI Build
providers.description: AI Build (Aibuild) is a London and Silicon Valley based software company, founded in 2015, that is transforming additive manufacturing with agentic AI. Its flagship Aibuild OS is an autonomous engineering platform whose computer-use AI operates CAD, CAE, and CAM software the way a human engineer would, carrying work from design intent through to manufacturing-ready output. Aibuild CAM provides toolpathing for large-format and robotic 3D printing, CNC machining, mould design, and analysis, while Aibuild FETS delivers finite element thermomechanical simulation. The company is a portfolio company of Seedcamp and SuperSeed and appears in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it currently publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Aino World Inc.
providers.description: Aino World Inc. builds Aino, an AI-powered spatial analytics platform for architecture, urban planning, and real estate development teams. Aino automates site research by pulling zoning, parcel, transit, demographic, and environmental data from 10+ sources (Google Maps, Regrid, Rentcast, OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps, Microsoft Planetary Computer, Kontur.io, and the US Census), runs GIS-free spatial analysis, and generates presentation-ready maps and dashboards inside a shared, collaborative workspace. Coverage spans 400+ cities with thousands of reusable data layers and CAD/GeoJSON (DXF) exports. Backed by 500 Global. Programmatic API access is offered on the enterprise Business tier.

providers.name: Amber Box
providers.description: AmberBox is an indoor gunshot detection company (San Francisco, CA) that builds sensor hardware and a response platform for schools, offices, and public buildings. Its patented tri-factor detection algorithm combines percussion, audio, and infrared signatures to identify a firearm discharge with a near-zero false-alarm rate, then automatically notifies on-site security and law enforcement to cut emergency response time by an average of five minutes. AmberBox integrates with existing physical-security estates (access control, IP video/VMS, PSIM, mass-notification, and fire-alarm-style life-safety systems) via closed-contact relay switches and TCP/IP relay input modules rather than a public developer API. Surfaced as an Uncork Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company publishes no public REST/GraphQL API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Automotus
providers.description: Automotus is a smart-city and urban-mobility technology company that provides automated curb management using computer vision. Its CurbSight AI cameras use automatic license plate recognition (ALPR), 5G connectivity, edge processing, and privacy-by-design to monitor curb activity, while CurbPass handles curb access payment and invoicing and CurbSuite delivers an enforcement and analytics dashboard. Automotus works with cities, airports, and commercial fleets to reduce congestion, improve safety and compliance, cut emissions, and generate new curb revenue. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer/API surface has been found yet.

providers.name: Bevi
providers.description: Bevi is a smart beverage-dispenser company that manufactures connected, filtered-water machines for offices and commercial spaces. Its IoT-enabled Standup and Countertop dispensers deliver still and sparkling water plus dozens of fruit flavors and functional enhancements (vitamins, electrolytes, energy, focus), connect directly to a building's water supply, and track plastic bottles saved in real time.
