Bevi is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Techstars, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API surface (OpenAPI, docs, or developer portal) was found during enrichment; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Bhub
providers.description: BHub (bhub.com) is a Brazilian accounting and financial back-office company serving small and medium-sized businesses across Brazil. It combines bookkeeping and tax accounting (contabilidade), financial business-process outsourcing (BPO financeiro) covering accounts payable/receivable and reconciliation, tax consulting (consultoria tributaria), and corporate/legal structuring (societario), delivered through its online client hub at app.bhub.ai. Specialized divisions Agrocontar (agribusiness) and Quality Associados (nonprofit/third sector) extend its sector coverage. Backed by QED Investors, BHub reports processing tens of millions of invoices and reconciling billions of reais annually. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; BHub currently exposes an internal application backend (api.bhub.com) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: BirdBuddy
providers.description: Bird Buddy (Buddy Bird Inc, backed by General Catalyst) makes the world's most recognized smart bird feeder and companion mobile app for discovering and learning about birds. An AI vision-and-sound model identifies bird species from the photos and audio captured by its camera feeders, notifies owners of feathered visitors, and organizes captures into a personal collection with postcards and monthly reports. Bird Buddy does not publish an official public API; the app is powered by a private, account- authenticated GraphQL backend hosted on AWS, which the community has reverse-engineered through the third-party pybirdbuddy Python library and a Home Assistant integration.

providers.name: Bitstrips
providers.description: Bitstrips was a Toronto-based consumer software company, founded in 2007 by Jacob "Ba" Blackstock, that created the personalized comic platform Bitstrips and the personal-avatar app Bitmoji. Snap Inc. acquired Bitstrips in March 2016, retired the original Bitstrips comic product, and now operates the technology as Bitmoji. The public developer surface today is the Bitmoji Direct API (Bitmoji for Developers): an OAuth2 authorization-code-with-PKCE flow via www.bitmoji.com/connect that grants third-party apps access to a user's avatar ID, sticker packs, and sticker search, served from bitmoji.api.snapchat.com/direct. Note that Snap has deprecated the "Bitmoji For Identity" product; the standalone stickers and search integrations remain documented. This profile was surfaced as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company and enriched from the public Bitmoji developer documentation.

providers.name: BizzyCar
providers.description: BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS platform for automotive dealerships that automates service recall management, customer outreach and mobile service. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Saint Peters, Missouri, the company ingests VIN-level open-recall data from OEM partners, matches it against a dealer's market area and DMS records, then uses AI-driven outreach (SMS, email, voice) to book service appointments and dispatch mobile service vans. Products include Recall Outreach, Recall Scout, Recall Radar, Service Engine, Mobile Service and Fleet IQ. BizzyCar is primarily an API *consumer* rather than an API producer: it ships pre-built connectors into dealer management systems (Dealertrack, DMS Plus, Open/Mate, Asbury, PBS, Tekion, Fortellis, Reynolds & Reynolds) and service schedulers (Xtime, TCC, DealerFX, Affinitiv, Update Promise), but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract of its own.

providers.name: Blend Financial
providers.description: Blend Financial Inc., doing business as Origin Financial (useorigin.com), is a consumer wealth management and personal finance platform that unifies income, net worth, spending, investments, assets, and liabilities into a single application. Origin pairs AI-powered budgeting and spend tracking with investment tools, estate and tax planning, and access to CFP professional advice; investment advisory services are provided through Origin Investment Advisory LLC, a subsidiary of Blend Financial Inc. The company is a consumer (B2C) product backed by 500 Global, Felicis Ventures, Founders Fund, and other investors, and also offers employer-sponsored financial wellness. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network it is a company profile; Origin publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Blue White Robotics
providers.description: Blue White Robotics Ltd. — operating as Bluewhite — is an Israeli off-road autonomy company founded in 2017 by Ben Alfi, Yair Shahar and Aviram Shmueli, headquartered in Tel Aviv with a US operation in Fresno, California. Bluewhite builds an OEM-agnostic autonomy stack that retrofits conventional vehicles into unmanned ground vehicles: Pathfinder, an aftermarket autonomy kit combining control, intelligence and perception modules over a distributed CAN network, and Compass, a cloud fleet-operations SaaS that lets operators remotely supervise, task and monitor an autonomous fleet. The company began in permanent-crop agriculture — autonomous spraying, mowing and harvest support across roughly 150,000 US acres for 20-plus growers — and has since extended the same GPS-denied navigation and perception stack to defense and homeland-security ground robotics. Elbit Systems' FUSE acquired 100% of Blue White Robotics in 2026. Bluewhite markets a Software SDK and an "API platform" for OEM and system integration, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; the Compass operator platform sits behind a Keycloak/OIDC login and integration access runs through a contact-sales form.

providers.name: Boltzbit
providers.description: Boltzbit builds General Learning Intelligence (GLI) — AI systems that organizations can own, train, and control, learning continuously from proprietary data rather than depending on static, vendor-controlled models. Its product suite forms an operating system for AI-native software: BoltzHub, a marketplace where creators sell AI-powered apps and consumers subscribe to them; BoltzAgent, a self-learning assistant for research-backed chat, document editing, and production-ready code generation; BoltzLearn, an LLM fine-tuning platform for building custom models from your own data; and BoltzCloud, a multi-cloud deployment backbone across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Boltzbit is backed by Speedinvest. The company references an API product surface but does not yet publish public API documentation, an OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile will be enriched as those surfaces are released.

providers.name: Bonnet
providers.description: Bonnet is a UK-based electric vehicle (EV) charging app that aggregates multiple charging networks into a single platform, letting drivers find, access, and pay for chargers across Europe through one membership. Headquartered in Bristol and acquired by OVO Energy, it gives consumers real-time charger status, route planning, membership plans with per-charge savings, and weekly charging-credit rewards, while offering charge point operator (CPO) and fleet solutions with white-label integration for businesses. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Bonnet publishes a consumer mobile app but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Boomerang
providers.description: Boomerang, from Baydin Inc, is a productivity software company founded in 2010 that builds email management and meeting scheduling tools. Its products include Boomerang for Gmail and Boomerang for Outlook browser extensions, Boomerang mobile apps for iOS and Android, and GQueues, a task manager for Google Workspace teams. Boomerang lets users schedule email to send later, snooze messages back to the inbox, track responses with read receipts and follow-up reminders, share availability and book meetings without back-and-forth, and use AI writing assistance. With over 2 million active customers, the platform has processed more than 500 million messages. Boomerang is a consumer and team-facing productivity suite delivered as browser extensions and apps rather than a developer API platform; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Botika
providers.description: Botika is an AI fashion-photography platform that helps online clothing and e-commerce brands replace traditional model photoshoots with generative AI. It turns flat-lay, mannequin, and basic on-model product photos into studio-quality images featuring fully AI-generated fashion models, poses, and on-brand backgrounds. Founded by Eran Dagan and Yarin Didi Meir and backed by an $8M seed round with participation from Seedcamp, Botika ships a web console, a native Shopify app, and an iOS app, cutting photoshoot costs by up to 90% and speeding time-to-market roughly 3x. A public API is on the company roadmap but is not yet released, so this profile currently captures company identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Bright Moments DAO
providers.description: Bright Moments is an onchain art organization and decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) that produces live, in-person (IRL) generative NFT minting experiences in cities around the world. Its flagship CryptoCitizens collection (10,000 Art Blocks-powered generative portraits by artist Qian Qian) was minted 1,000 at a time across ten cities including Venice CA (CryptoVenetians), New York, Berlin, London, Mexico City, Tokyo, Buenos Aires, Paris, Venice Italy, and the Metaverse. Holding a CryptoCitizen confers membership and governance rights in the Bright Moments DAO, which was founded on-chain in March 2021. Bright Moments also runs artist collaborations/residencies, a Golden Token minting mechanism, and display software for at-home viewing. It is not a traditional API provider: the public technical surface is Ethereum/Base smart contracts, a documentation site, a DAO portal app, and a public GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Brightmoney
providers.description: Bright Money (Bright) is a San Francisco-based financial technology company that describes itself as the world's first AI Loan Assistant. Its consumer mobile app helps people pay off credit-card debt faster, build credit history, and access affordable credit through products including Bright Builder (a secured 0% APR credit line reported to the major bureaus), Bright Plan debt-payoff and budgeting, Smart Round-Ups automated savings, rent reporting, personal loans up to $10,000 through network partners, and cash advances up to $750 for all credit scores. Bright is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: BrightPlan
providers.description: BrightPlan is a San Jose, California based financial wellness company that sells a Total Financial Wellness platform to enterprise HR and benefits teams, combining a self-service digital financial planning application, an AI-powered financial wellness coach, and access to human CFP fiduciary advisors. BrightPlan LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, and the product is delivered to employees as an employer-sponsored benefit rather than as a self-serve consumer subscription. The employee experience runs at my.brightplan.com and web.brightplan.com with iOS and Android apps; employer value is framed around benefits engagement, retention, and measurable financial wellbeing. BrightPlan markets HRIS and benefits-system integration to employers but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Cars24
providers.description: Cars24 (CARS24 Services Private Limited) is one of India's largest auto-tech companies and an online marketplace for buying and selling used cars, operating across India, the UAE, and Australia. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, Cars24 is an RBI-registered NBFC that combines a used-car transaction platform with financing, insurance, and vehicle-management services. Its offerings include buying and selling pre-owned cars with 300+ point inspections, fixed transparent pricing, warranties, and doorstep delivery; AI-driven used-car valuation; new-car discovery; traffic challan checking and payment; pre-delivery inspections across 220+ cities; vehicle history and service-history reports; car scrapping; FASTag recharge; and used-car loans, loan-against-car, and personal-loan products through Bikes24, Insure24, and related brands. Cars24 is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and 500 Global. It is a consumer platform and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, agent-facing llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: Conduct AI
providers.description: Conduct AI (conduct.ai) is an enterprise "AI operating system" that helps IT teams understand, operate, and transform their business software, starting with SAP and expanding across the wider enterprise stack. Its platform analyzes custom code to reveal dependencies and system relationships (Understand), automates software-development workflows from planning through deployment (Operate), and accelerates system migrations such as S/4HANA with automated analysis and code refactoring (Transform). The company markets outcomes like faster S/4HANA migration planning, reduced manual system analysis, and shorter change-implementation cycles. Conduct raised a $60M Series A and is backed by ICONIQ Capital. It publishes a marketing site, blog, and case studies but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Crosschq
providers.description: Crosschq is a hiring intelligence platform that helps talent acquisition and people-analytics teams improve quality of hire. Its cloud product suite spans AI-powered interview agents, automated reference checks, candidate assessment and screening, identity and interview-fraud detection, and quality-of-hire analytics that tie hiring decisions back to on-the-job outcomes. Crosschq connects to major applicant tracking and HCM systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Oracle, Lever, Ashby, Bullhorn, and others) through pre-built integrations rather than a public self-service API. Founded in Danville, California, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and GGV Capital.

providers.name: Double
providers.description: Double is a New York-based future-of-work company that pairs busy executives and founders with highly vetted, US-based remote executive assistants, augmented by an AI copilot (Mingo) that helps assistants summarize tasks, draft communications, prompt follow-up questions, and report time. Founded in 2018 by the former Sunrise Calendar team (Alice Default, Christophe Lamperti, Pierre-Elie Fauche), Double delivers operations, marketing, scheduling, inbox, and administrative delegation through a managed platform and shared secure workflows built around a per-client 1Password vault. Double is not a public API provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: Drip Capital
providers.description: Drip Capital is a digital trade finance and working capital company founded in 2016, headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with operations in Mumbai, India and Mexico City, Mexico. It provides collateral-free post-shipment finance to small and medium-sized exporters and importers through data-driven underwriting, offering invoice factoring, export finance, an importer credit program, supply chain and vendor financing, receivables financing, and revolving lines of credit. The company has financed over $9 billion in trade transactions for 11,000+ businesses worldwide. Drip Capital does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel, Initialized Capital, Wing Venture Capital, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Dyno Therapeutics
providers.description: Dyno Therapeutics is an AI-driven biotechnology company in Watertown, Massachusetts that combines machine learning with high-throughput in vivo experimentation to engineer adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors for gene therapy. Its CapsidMap platform designs novel AAV capsids optimized for tissue targeting, immune evasion, manufacturability, and payload packaging, advanced through partnerships with pharmaceutical companies. Dyno also open-sources protein-design tooling for the research community, including the dyno-phi CLI for its Phi protein-design platform and the Psi-1 de novo binder-design model.

providers.name: Egab
providers.description: Egab is a journalism platform founded in late 2020 and headquartered in Cairo, Egypt, that connects local journalists across the Global South — the Middle East, Africa, and beyond (60+ countries) — with international media outlets. It specializes in solutions journalism, offering journalists mentoring, editorial support, skills development, and fair compensation from pitch to publication, while giving newsrooms cost-efficient access to authentic, exclusive stories and diverse local contributors without flying in reporters.

providers.name: Eliq
providers.description: Eliq provides energy data and analytics APIs for utilities and energy app developers. The platform combines a decade of analytics and machine learning trained on millions of homes to deliver consumption insights, disaggregation, forecasting, peak detection, tariff comparison, and customer segmentation.

providers.name: Ernesta
providers.description: Ernesta is a direct-to-consumer, custom-sized rug company that lets homeowners and interior-design professionals order high-design rugs made to measure down to the inch. Founded by three Peloton co-founders (John Foley, Hisao Kushi, and Yony Feng) and backed by True Ventures, Addition, and Platform Capital, Ernesta sells online through a Shopify storefront and a growing set of showrooms, and runs a dedicated Trade Program and Trade Portal for designers. Ernesta publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's consumer and trade web properties plus the discovery, security, and identity signals observable on its public hosts.

providers.name: Evie Networks
providers.description: Evie Networks is an Australian electric-vehicle charging infrastructure company, founded in 2017 and backed by the St Baker Energy Innovation Fund, that owns and operates one of the country's largest DC fast and ultrafast public charging networks across 300+ locations in every state and territory. It sits downstream of the electricity retail market as a charge point operator (CPO) and e-mobility service provider, buying energy and reselling it as charging sessions to drivers and fleets, and it also builds and operates charging assets for site hosts, councils, dealerships and commercial property owners. Its API posture is closed: as of 2026-07-27 there is no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no named support for the EV charging interoperability standards (OCPP, OCPI, ISO 15118). Evie is not a designated data holder under Australia's Consumer Data Right energy regime — the CDR Register's public energy data-holder brand summary lists 84 brands and Evie is not among them — so the statutory data mandate that produced identical APIs across Australian banks and energy retailers does not reach the EV charging layer at all. A live production API host exists at api.goevie.com.au serving the Evie Charging mobile app, but it is undocumented, unadvertised and returns a Google Cloud Endpoints 404 to anonymous callers. Neither consumer charging-session data nor network/market data is published through any documented public interface; charger location data reaches developers only through third-party aggregators.

providers.name: Freterium
providers.description: Freterium is a cloud-native AI Transport Management System (TMS) and unified logistics operating system that connects shippers, carriers, and fleets on a single intelligent layer. It spans first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile operations across eight integrated modules — order management, AI-powered route planning, collaborative shipper and carrier portals, real-time GPS tracking with predictive ETAs, fleet management, freight billing and costing, intelligent document control, and analytics and reporting — and exposes a documented REST API for ERP/WMS integration alongside 50+ off-the-shelf telematics and hardware integrations. Surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: Geode
providers.description: Geode Finance is a decentralized, trustless staking infrastructure protocol on Ethereum (with an earlier Avalanche v1 deployment) that lets anyone create and operate permissionless, configurable liquid-staking pools without intermediaries. Through its Portal router, isolated storage, dual governance, staking derivatives (gETH / gAVAX), an operator marketplace, withdrawal contracts, bound liquidity pools, and the Telescope oracle system, entities can launch their own liquid staking derivatives, isolate risk profiles, run KYC/AML-segregated pools, and earn sustainable maintenance-fee revenue. Developers integrate via the geodefi Python SDK and geo-vue UI components.

providers.name: Goldbelly
providers.description: Goldbelly is a curated online marketplace for gourmet food and food gifts, shipping America's most iconic and legendary regional foods, restaurant dishes, and desserts nationwide directly to consumers' doors. The platform connects hundreds of independent restaurants, bakeries, food artisans, and specialty makers with customers through a consumer e-commerce storefront, gift and corporate-gifting programs, subscriptions, and gift cards. Goldbelly is a consumer marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, help, seller, and policy surfaces. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: Goodfellow
providers.description: Goodfellow (Goodfellow Advanced Materials) is a global specialty-materials supplier founded in 1946 and headquartered in Cambridgeshire, United Kingdom, serving research, prototyping and specialized manufacturing markets in more than 111 countries. Its catalog spans over 70,000 stocked products drawn from 700+ different materials in many forms, including metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, compounds and glass, alongside custom fabrication and laboratory testing services. Customers include universities, government research facilities, laboratories and advanced manufacturers, served through subsidiaries in the United States, China, France and Germany. Goodfellow was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2021 to help digitize its operations and fund materials acquisitions. Goodfellow is a business-to-business e-commerce and catalog operation; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks.

providers.name: Grandhood
providers.description: Grandhood is a Danish digital pension provider that lets companies set up and run a modern workplace (company) pension scheme entirely online, without the traditional adviser meetings and paperwork. Employers register with MitID, invite employees, and activate a plan; employees enroll, get built-in digital pension counselling, choose an investment profile, consolidate scattered pension savings, and see real-time savings, returns, and insurance coverage in the Grandhood mobile app. Pensions bundle both long-term savings and present-day insurance protection. Pricing is a simple fixed monthly amount per employee (65-95 DKK/month) plus investment costs, with no deposit-percentage fees and free pension advice. The underlying pension administration is backed by Velliv, Denmark's third-largest pension company. Grandhood is based in Copenhagen (Esplanaden 14B, 1263 København K; CVR 44147750) and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Grandhood publishes consumer web and mobile-app products; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Greyparrot
providers.description: Greyparrot is a London-based AI waste analytics company that turns materials recovery facilities (MRFs) into data-driven operations. Its Greyparrot Analyzer uses computer-vision cameras mounted over waste conveyor belts to identify, count, and measure the composition of waste streams in real time, giving recyclers continuous visibility into what flows through their plant. The Greyparrot Sync product routes that analytics stream into existing operational control systems, ERP platforms, Power BI dashboards, and OEM sortation hardware (robotic arms, air-jet systems, balers, belt control), while Deepnest turns real-world recovery data into design feedback for packaging brands. Backed by Speedinvest, Greyparrot serves recyclers, equipment manufacturers, and consumer-goods companies working to raise recycling rates and automate compliance reporting. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web, product, and content surface.

providers.name: Groover
providers.description: Groover is a music promotion platform that connects independent artists and their representatives with a network of more than 3,000 vetted music-industry professionals — playlist curators, bloggers, journalists, radio stations, record labels, and managers. Artists submit a track and spend credits ("Grooviz", roughly €2 each) to reach individual curators, and Groover guarantees personalized feedback within seven days or refunds the credit. Founded in Paris in 2018, the company also operates Temple by Groover, a fanbase-growth toolset. Groover runs a consumer web application on a credit-based, pay-per-submission model and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Harbor Global
providers.description: Harbor Global is a global professional-services firm delivering technology, operations, strategy, and intelligence consulting to law firms, corporate legal departments, and government legal teams. Its practice areas span legal-technology and operations (application management, process automation, AI enablement), strategic advisory, intelligence and research/library services, and vendor governance, delivered by a global team of specialists. Harbor has grown through acquisitions such as iTrain (UK legal-technology training and AI enablement) and CE Global Partners (HCM/HR and payroll transformation). It is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Harbor Global is a services company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company identity and discovery.

providers.name: Heard
providers.description: Heard (Heard Technologies, Inc.) is the financial management platform built specifically for therapists and wellness practitioners in private practice. Founded in 2019 and based in Seattle, Washington, Heard pairs easy-to-use software with a dedicated human team to handle bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and business banking in a single subscription, so licensed mental health and allied health clinicians can focus on their clients. Heard serves solo and single-owner group practices across the United States, from newer sole proprietors to established S corporations, and connects with tools practices already use such as SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Headway, Jane App, Stripe, and Square. Heard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company identity, its public web properties, and the published llms.txt.

providers.name: Heirloom
providers.description: Heirloom Carbon Technologies, Inc. is a San Francisco Bay Area direct air capture (DAC) company that removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere by accelerating the natural mineralization of limestone. Heirloom spreads calcium oxide on vertical trays where it re-absorbs atmospheric CO2 in days rather than years, then uses electric kilns to release the captured CO2 for permanent geologic or in-concrete storage. The company opened the first commercial DAC facility in the United States, sells permanent carbon removal credits to individuals, businesses and enterprises, and has signed offtake agreements with Microsoft, Frontier, United's Sustainable Flight Fund and CarbonCure. It is an industrial climate-technology company; it does not operate a public developer program or API.

providers.name: Hidden Door
providers.description: Hidden Door is an interactive storytelling platform where roleplay meets fan fiction, letting players step into imaginative worlds and shape branching narratives through their choices. Players pick a pre-built world, add modifiers, create a character, and experience a unique story with a full cast of characters, where every playthrough differs. Creators can build playable worlds in as little as thirty minutes, then share, publish, and get paid when others play. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Homebrew and Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. Hidden Door ships a consumer web experience and publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. Sector: AI / entertainment.

providers.name: HiGuest
providers.description: HiGuests (Hi Guests Vacation Homes Rental LLC, License 765614) is a Dubai-based short-term rental property management company. It offers full-service management for vacation homes and furnished apartments, listing owners' properties across 20+ booking channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, and others), and handling profile creation, dynamic pricing, booking and guest communications, 24/7 guest support, check-in/check-out, housekeeping, and maintenance, alongside transparent owner reporting. HiGuests markets a zero-commission subscription plan for landlords and operates a guest-facing booking site. It is a hospitality services business, not an API/developer platform; no public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Imerso
providers.description: Imerso is a construction management and quality-control software company that connects the onsite as-built reality to BIM models. Using 3D laser scanning (including a free Imerso Capture mobile app for Leica BLK360 scanners) and in-house AI models, its Site Checker automatically compares the built status of a jobsite against BIM plan specifications, surfacing deviations, progress tracking, and as-built data grouped by traffic-light categories. The platform targets general contractors and BIM teams for automated site supervision, progress reporting, and issue detection, and promotes 100% open data with direct integrations into tools such as Autodesk Construction Cloud. Imerso is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record.

providers.name: Impress
providers.description: Impress (legal entity Smile2Impress SL) is a Barcelona-founded chain of clear-aligner orthodontic clinics, launched in 2019 by Vladimir Lupenko, Diliara Lupenko and Dr. Khaled Kasem, and today Europe's largest invisible-orthodontics clinic network. It runs 110+ doctor-led clinics across ten countries — Spain, Italy, Portugal, France, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, Ukraine and the United States — has treated more than 500,000 patients, and pairs in-clinic 3D intraoral scanning and patented diagnostics with AI-assisted treatment planning and remote monitoring through its patient mobile app. Impress publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, CLI, status page, changelog or machine-readable specification of any kind: contract discovery found no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, MCP server, A2A agent card or .well-known document on any host it operates. Its one API host, api.smile2impress.com, is the private backend for the Impress patient app and the Impress Clinics practitioner app; it resolves and is live but answers HTTP 403 to every anonymous request, including every spec and .well-known path probed. Its GitHub organization, github.com/smile2impress, is real but carries only internal engineering tooling — five forks of Node.js/TypeScript infrastructure libraries and one first-party static-analysis tool, fe-explorer — and no client library for any Impress service. Products sold are orthodontic treatment, retainers and teeth whitening, priced and booked through the consumer site.

providers.name: Instaread
providers.description: Instaread is a media and audio technology company with two products. Its consumer app delivers ~15-minute audio and text summaries of bestselling books across business, self-help, history, health, politics, and fiction on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Its publisher product, Instaread Player, is a free embeddable audio widget that uses AI text-to-speech (including custom voice cloning) to convert website articles, blogs, and newsletters into natural-sounding audio, monetized for publishers through programmatic audio advertising. The Player is used by 200+ brands, ships ADA/WCAG accessibility support, an analytics dashboard, podcast distribution, and a WordPress plugin, and works on Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, and custom sites via a single embed code. Instaread does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Invygo
providers.description: Invygo is a car subscription and flexible rental platform founded in 2018 in Dubai, offering an alternative to traditional car ownership across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers subscribe to a car on a weekly or monthly basis, or enroll in a 36-month, Sharia-compliant "Subscribe to Own" plan, with insurance, maintenance, registration, and roadside assistance bundled into an all-inclusive fee and no deposit, salary certificate, or bank loan required. Invygo reports 20,000+ active subscriptions across 15+ cities in the GCC. There is no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its public web, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: iQIYI
providers.description: iQIYI is one of China's largest online video streaming and entertainment platforms, delivering movies, TV dramas, variety shows, animation, documentaries, and original content across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and OTT/smart-TV devices. Beyond its consumer service, iQIYI runs a SaaS / OTT developer platform that lets partners launch their own branded streaming service with a RESTful API covering Video, Channel, Album, Search, and Player resources, plus AVOD/SVOD/TVOD monetization, analytics, audience management, and DRM. iQIYI also operates the QIYU XR developer platform for VR/AR device applications and maintains an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Hongshan and has been enriched from iQIYI's public developer surface.

providers.name: Jome
providers.description: Jome is a real estate technology marketplace for buying new construction homes, describing itself as the most joyful way to buy a new home in the age of AI. Buyers can search and compare thousands of new-construction homes and communities from multiple builders, view pricing and builder incentives, instantly book and confirm home tours, and receive AI-powered personalized recommendations, with new-home experts guiding them from contract to closing. Jome operates as a licensed real estate brokerage across 18+ U.S. metros, primarily in Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Arizona, Georgia, Colorado, South Carolina, and Tennessee, and runs dedicated portals for builders and agents. Backed by Techstars. Jome publishes no public API or developer program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence.

providers.name: KITRO
providers.description: KITRO is a Swiss company founded in 2017 in Zurich that helps professional kitchens measure and reduce food waste through AI-powered automation. Its KITRO TARE device pairs an IoT scale with a camera and computer vision to automatically identify, weigh and categorize discarded food with no change to kitchen workflow, feeding a cloud analytics dashboard that surfaces waste trends by time, item and station, compares performance across properties, and exports reports for sustainability and EU food-waste compliance reporting. KITRO serves hotel groups and resorts, hospitals and care homes, corporate canteens, universities and schools, and river and ocean cruise operators in 20+ countries, with customers including Marriott, Hyatt, TUI BLUE, Pestana, 25hours Hotels and Sydney Opera Bar. KITRO publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer portal — the only customer-facing software surface is the authenticated dashboard at my.kitro.ch — but it does publish an llms.txt agent-readable company description at www.kitro.ch/llms.txt.

providers.name: Kitura
providers.description: Kitura was an open source web framework for server-side Swift, originally developed by IBM, that allowed developers to use Swift for building web applications and REST APIs with support for databases, WebSockets, and OpenAPI. The project is now archived and no longer actively maintained, but remains a useful historical reference for server-side Swift API development.

providers.name: KupiVIP
providers.description: KupiVIP (kupivip.ru) is a Russian online outlet retailer for luxury and premium fashion, selling women's and men's apparel, footwear, bags, accessories and home goods from more than 250 international designer brands at discounts of up to 90% on previous-season collections. The 1C-Bitrix storefront ships across Russia, publishes a 100% authenticity guarantee backed by expert verification, offers free delivery on orders over 30,000 RUB, and runs telephone, email, WhatsApp and Telegram customer support. The company was originally surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment probe KupiVIP publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: La Fraise Pro
providers.description: La Fraise (LA FRAISE PRO SAS) is a French SaaS platform that digitizes the administrative patient journey for dental practices and dental centers: interactive treatment quotes (devis), patient-education video, informed consent, mutual-insurer coverage requests, and compliant electronic signature, all handled remotely. The product integrates natively with the French dental practice-management market — LOGOSw, Julie, Veasy, CS Trophy, Visiodent, Ardion, WeClever, Desmos, Galaxie and Effigie — with real-time bidirectional sync for LOGOSw, Veasy and Desmos. More than 3,500 dentists are equipped. Patient data is hosted on HDS-certified AWS infrastructure in the European Union, in line with article L.1111-8 of the French Code de la sante publique, and electronic signature follows Agence du Numerique en Sante (ANS) norms. La Fraise publishes no public developer API; practice-management integrations are provisioned by its own technical team.

providers.name: lastminute.com
providers.description: lastminute.com N.V. (SIX Swiss Exchange: LMN) is a European travel-tech group and the regional leader in dynamic holiday packages, operating an online travel agency portfolio that includes lastminute.com, Volagratis, Rumbo, Bravofly, Weg.de, Jetcost and Hotelscan alongside the Forward media/advertising business. The group sells flights, hotels and packaged travel across a global network, and runs an engineering organisation that publishes an open technology blog and a Stoplight-hosted API portal at developers.lastminute.com. That portal is a real partner-facing API surface, but its projects are not anonymously readable — API reference content sits behind a workspace sign-in, so lastminute.com currently exposes no public OpenAPI, SDK, or self-service developer onboarding path.

providers.name: LawTrades
providers.description: LawTrades is a legal talent marketplace, founded in 2016, that matches companies with vetted independent attorneys, paralegals, and legal operations professionals on flexible, on-demand terms rather than through traditional law firms or ALSPs. The platform covers eleven practice areas — commercial contracts, corporate law, data privacy and cyber security, intellectual property, labor and employment, legal operations, litigation, M&A, product counsel, real estate, and regulatory compliance — and handles matching, work-log management, invoicing, payments, and real-time spend analytics in-product. A human-in-the-loop AI layer drafts documents and flags risk for lawyer review. LawTrades raised a $6M Series A backed by 500 Global, Draper Associates, Social Capital, and AngelList. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Leta
providers.description: Leta is a pan-African logistics technology company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya, with operations across Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa. Leta builds an AI-driven delivery management platform that helps businesses move goods cheaper and faster while minimising climate impact: route optimization, automated dispatch and broadcast, live GPS track-and-trace, payment on delivery, fleet management, and delivery analytics. The platform is delivered as logistics SaaS plus on-demand and dedicated rider services, including an M-PESA business mini-app, and serves e-commerce, third-party logistics and courier, food and beverage, retail and consumer goods, and pharmacy and healthcare delivery operators. Leta is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: LF Broadband
providers.description: LF Broadband is a Linux Foundation Directed Fund established in late 2023 that supports open source broadband networking projects, including reference designs and virtualization tools for broadband access networks. Its flagship projects, SEBA and VOLTHA, virtualize multi-vendor Passive Optical Network (PON) systems and are deployed by major operators such as Deutsche Telekom and Turk Telekom.

providers.name: LightSource
providers.description: LightSource is an AI-native direct materials procurement platform that connects engineering, procurement, and suppliers across the full sourcing lifecycle from concept to award. The product automates RFX creation and distribution, AI-assisted bid analysis, supplier collaboration and quote normalization across custom quote formats, and ongoing cost tracking, with more than 20,000 suppliers live on the network. It is sold to procurement and supply-chain teams in automotive, electronics, chemicals, medical devices, construction, and forest products, and the company reports sourcing cost reductions of 3-25% for customers including Time Manufacturing (Versalift), Arxada, BRP, and Canada Goose. LightSource is SOC 2 Type 2 attested and supports SSO and role-based access control. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; its docs host is an end-user and supplier help center.

providers.name: LinkPeek
providers.description: Real-time website screenshot service that captures, stores, serves, and refreshes webpage snapshots via a simple GET-based image API. Give it a target URI and it returns a screenshot image.

providers.name: Linux Foundation
providers.description: The Linux Foundation is a nonprofit technology consortium that supports open source projects and ecosystems. It provides a neutral home for collaboration on open source software, hardware, standards, and data, and hosts hundreds of projects including the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, Node.js, PyTorch, OpenSSF, CNCF, RISC-V, and FINOS. The LFX platform offers tooling and insights for open source contributors and member organizations.

providers.name: MedThread
providers.description: MedThread is an AI-powered Health Information Management (HIM) platform built specifically for long-term and post-acute care facilities — skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), nursing homes, assisted living facilities (ALFs), and rehabilitation centers. The platform digitizes paper records with AI-powered scanning, runs continuous automated audits for documentation completeness and regulatory compliance, monitors CMS quality metrics (rehospitalization, pressure ulcers, antipsychotic use), and provides a compliance dashboard, provider portal, and patient-facing Personal Health Record (PHR). MedThread advertises FHIR compatibility and pre-built EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, Allscripts, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, Meditech, athenahealth, Greenway, Practice Fusion) via a secure API. Techstars-backed and based in Miami, FL. No public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Meritfirst
providers.description: MeritFirst is a skills-based hiring platform that replaces resume- and credential-based recruiting with practical, real-world assessments. Candidates prove their craft through work samples (Build, Try, Get Seen) and companies evaluate and match them on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree. MeritFirst exposes a hosted, authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so agents and tools can manage assessments, review candidates, and analyze hiring data. Backed by 8VC and Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Minu Holdings Limited
providers.description: Minu Holdings Limited operates minu.mx, Mexico's leading employee benefits and financial wellness platform. Minu provides employers with more than fifty benefits designed to attract, retain, and engage talent, including on-demand salary access (earned wage access), savings accounts, food and gas vouchers, payroll-linked loans, telemedicine, insurance, discounts, and financial education programs. Backed by 500 Global, Minu delivers these services to employees through its mobile app and integrates with employer payroll and HR systems. No public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI specification was found during enrichment; the company operates a private/internal API surface (api.minu.mx responds but is not publicly documented).

providers.name: Mona Ai
providers.description: Mona AI GmbH (mona-ai.de) is a German AI recruiting-automation company backed by Earlybird. Its platform combines AI agents and digital avatars to automate recruiting and HR processes for staffing agencies and enterprises: 24/7 candidate outreach, automated pre-qualification and candidate-profile generation, and "digital branch" structures — built to be fully GDPR- and EU-AI-Act-compliant. Products include MONA Recruiting, MONA Recruiting Light, MONA Agents, MONA Digital Branch, MONA Consulting and MONA ARS, an autonomous prompt-driven recruiting system that sources, screens, schedules and reports automatically. The website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for AI-agent access; the recruiting product itself runs behind a login and does not publish a public developer API, SDK or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Muuktest
providers.description: MuukTest (MuukLabs) is an AI-powered test automation and managed QA services company founded in 2019 that helps software teams reach high end-to-end test coverage in weeks rather than months. It blends an AI-driven automation platform with expert QA engineers to deliver end-to-end, functional, regression, API, and performance testing across web, mobile, and API surfaces, using self-healing scripts (Playwright, Selenium, Appium), CI/CD integration, and detailed bug reporting with repro steps, logs, recordings, and Slack alerts. MuukTest is a managed testing service delivered through a Chrome recorder and a dedicated team rather than a self-service public developer API; it is backed by Techstars, the NSF SBIR program, MassChallenge, and Google for Startups.

providers.name: Neolink
providers.description: Neolink is an open-source bridge for Reolink cameras that provides an RTSP stream gateway and REST API for managing Reolink IP cameras, enabling integration with NVR software, home automation, and other camera management tools.

providers.name: NoBroker
providers.description: NoBroker Technologies Solutions Pvt Ltd is an Indian proptech company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bengaluru, that operates a brokerage-free real estate marketplace connecting property owners directly with tenants and buyers across Indian metros. Beyond listings for flats, houses, villas, plots, PGs and commercial space, NoBroker sells adjacent home services — rental and lease agreement drafting, legal assistance, packers and movers, painting and cleaning, home loans and rent payments — and operates NoBrokerHood, a gated-community and housing-society management / ERP product covering visitor management, billing, accounting and complaints. NoBroker became India's first proptech unicorn in 2021. The company ships software only as an end-user web and mobile product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its application endpoints under /api/v1..v5 are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: NuORDER
providers.description: NuORDER by Lightspeed is a global B2B commerce platform for wholesale buying and selling between brands and retailers. It combines a fully-branded wholesale eCommerce storefront with account-specific pricing and discounts, an Assortments planning tool for data-driven buying and reduced markdowns, and a Marketplace that connects buyers to 3,000+ brands across fashion, footwear, and apparel. NuORDER exposes a partner-gated REST API at api.nuorder.com for syncing products, orders, catalogs, and customer data with ERP, PIM, and other commerce systems. Acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, it is used by brands including Arc'teryx, Kendra Scott, TOMS, Barbour, and Canada Goose.

providers.name: Nutmeg (J.P. Morgan Personal Investing)
providers.description: Nutmeg is a UK digital wealth manager and robo-advisor founded in 2011 and acquired by JPMorgan Chase in 2021, now operating as J.P. Morgan Personal Investing. It offers consumer investment accounts including Stocks and Shares ISAs, Lifetime ISAs, Junior ISAs, personal pensions, and general investment accounts, with fully managed, Smart Alpha, socially responsible, thematic, fixed allocation, and income portfolio strategies plus free financial guidance and paid advice. Nutmeg is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA register #552016). It is a consumer-facing wealth platform and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Odeko
providers.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

providers.name: On Me
providers.description: On Me is a San Francisco digital gifting company that sells wallet-native, multi-brand eGift cards organised by hobby and interest rather than by single retailer. Founded by former Google product managers Darragh Meaney and Sitar Harel, it emerged from stealth in December 2024 with a five-year Mastercard partnership and $1.7M in pre-seed funding led by Lerer Hippeau and Focal VC. Recipients add a gift to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet and tap to pay across a curated category of brands, and senders can attach photos, video and GIFs. A business portal supports corporate gifting, campaigns and bulk sends. On Me markets a forthcoming Gifting API for programmatic rewards, incentives and webhooks, but as of this pass no public API reference, base URL, or machine-readable specification is published — access runs through a "talk to a specialist" sales conversation.

providers.name: OnDeck Capital
providers.description: OnDeck Capital (ODK Capital, LLC) is one of the largest online small business lenders in the United States, providing term loans and business lines of credit to small and medium-sized businesses. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in New York, OnDeck uses data-driven underwriting and cash-flow analytics to deliver fast funding decisions, and has delivered more than $13 billion in financing to over 100,000 businesses across the U.S. OnDeck operates as a subsidiary of Enova International and also markets under the Headway Capital brand. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP; OnDeck publishes a public marketing site and an llms.txt resource index but does not currently expose a public developer or partner API.

providers.name: Outsite
providers.description: Outsite is a coliving and community platform for remote workers, digital nomads, and distributed teams. It operates a global network of fully-furnished coliving spaces, curated stays, and cowork cafes across more than twenty destinations including Lisbon, Barcelona, Bali, Oaxaca, and Costa Rica, pairing dedicated coworking areas and fast WiFi with a built-in community of remote professionals. Outsite sells yearly and lifetime memberships, curated month-long Outsite Trips, and team retreat and business membership offerings for companies. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Outsite is a consumer hospitality and travel brand and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: Paycor
providers.description: Paycor is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) platform that provides payroll, HR, benefits administration, talent management, time and attendance, and workforce analytics for small and mid-sized businesses. The platform serves HR and finance teams with a unified system of record for employees, pay, time, and benefits data. Paycor exposes a Public REST API authenticated via OAuth 2.0 with authorization at secure.paycor.com and resource endpoints at apis.paycor.com (production) and apis-sandbox.paycor.com (sandbox).

providers.name: Perch
providers.description: Perch is a computer-vision weight-room performance monitoring system that captures athlete movement — velocity-based training, jump testing, and strength programming — from 3D cameras mounted on the rack, without wearables or tethers. Spun out of MIT and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Techstars, Perch was acquired by sports-technology company Catapult; the perch.fit domain now 301-redirects to catapult.com/perch, where the product is sold and supported as part of Catapult's athlete-monitoring suite. Perch exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification — this profile is retained as an identity record for the acquired brand.

providers.name: Plum
providers.description: Plum is a UK-based personal finance "money app" that helps consumers save and invest automatically. Its mobile app pairs automated savings algorithms (eight saving automations) with a range of regulated products including Easy Access Savings, a Cash ISA, a 95-day Notice Account, a money-market Interest pocket, a Stocks & Shares ISA, a Self-Invested Personal Pension (SIPP), and access to thousands of stocks and funds. Plum operates under FCA oversight through multiple entities covering payment services, e-money, investment broking, and account information services, and monetizes via subscription tiers (Basic, Plus, Boost, Max). It is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Partech and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Popsa
providers.description: Popsa is a UK-based, mobile-first photo printing company that uses AI to help customers create photo books, calendars, prints, tiles, boxes and ornaments in minutes. Founded in the UK and a certified B Corporation that offsets 100% of production and shipping carbon emissions, Popsa serves over 10 million customers and ships to more than 50 countries with localised storefronts across Europe, North America and Australia. Its differentiators are AI-powered automatic layouts, generative captions, facial recognition, print-quality scoring and dynamic colour themes, delivering an average five-minute creation time. Popsa was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal; this profile captures its public discovery surface (llms.txt, security.txt) and domain security posture instead.

providers.name: Presso
providers.description: Presso is a garment-care automation company (operated by parent LaundrySucks.io Inc.) that builds robotic, AI-driven systems for dry cleaning and laundry businesses. Its flagship AirTouch product is a compact, plug-and-play unit that runs on a standard 110V outlet and combines automatic fabric recognition, built-in non-toxic cleaning formulas, and smart temperature control to deliver same-day wash, fold, and dry cleaning under one roof. Presso positions itself around faster, greener, and gentler garment care without compressors, boilers, or skilled labor. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Presso publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface — it is a hardware/robotics and equipment business, not an API provider.

providers.name: RapidFort
providers.description: RapidFort is a software supply chain security platform focused on container hardening and automated CVE remediation. Its platform analyzes container vulnerabilities across build and runtime, profiles what software actually executes, and removes unused components to shrink the attack surface - remediating up to 95% of CVEs without code changes. RapidFort publishes a registry of 9,000+ near-zero-CVE curated container images and malware-scanned open-source libraries, and its CART capability automates compliance validation and remediation reporting for programs such as FedRAMP, cATO, CMMC, NIS2, and SOC 2. The company operates its platform through a hosted web application and a command-line workflow (analyze, profile, harden), with an open-source community-images catalog and the Kimia Kubernetes-native OCI image builder published on GitHub.

providers.name: Res
providers.description: Res (ResQ) is an AI-powered operations platform for the service economy, connecting restaurants, hospitality groups, and facilities-management teams with vetted trades vendors to manage repair-and-maintenance work orders end to end. The platform covers work-order intake and dispatch, vendor sourcing and communication, invoicing and payments, and reporting across trades such as HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, and electrical. Backed by Homebrew and surfaced through the API Evangelist network, ResQ operates a web and mobile SaaS product; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, or webhook surface at this time, so this profile captures company identity, website properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rever Moto
providers.description: REVER (Rever Moto) is a motorcycle-focused navigation, ride-tracking, and social platform for riders. It offers a web-based route planner and mobile apps (iOS, Android, and Apple CarPlay) that let motorcyclists discover more than 3,000 curated routes worldwide, plan and sync trips, record rides with offline GPS tracking, and get turn-by-turn voice navigation. Social features include live friend tracking, ride sharing, challenges, and stories. REVER offers a free tier and a paid "Pro" subscription, and partners with brands including Honda, Cycle Gear, and Quad Lock. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass REVER publishes no public developer API, documentation, or integration surface — it is a consumer mobile/web product.

providers.name: Root Global
providers.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rylo
providers.description: Rylo (Nagish Inc. d/b/a Rylo) is a New York-based accessibility technology company building free communication tools for people who are Deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability. Its consumer mobile app provides FCC-certified real-time phone-call captioning, in-person Live Transcribe, and Sign features, with automatic language detection across 50+ languages. Rylo raised $85M and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. The company operates a consumer application only and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: SiMa
providers.description: SiMa.ai is a Silicon Valley machine-learning semiconductor company building a co-optimized hardware and software platform for physical AI at the edge. Its MLSoC (Machine Learning System-on-Chip) family — including the Modalix line delivering roughly 50 TOPS under 10 watts in multiple form factors — targets drones, robotics, automotive, industrial, retail, government, and healthcare. The developer experience centers on the Palette software suite and an agentic development environment that compiles and deploys computer-vision and multimodal models onto SiMa silicon, backed by a Developer Center, a model browser, a Hugging Face model hub (simaai), and a community forum. SiMa.ai ships downloadable SDK/CLI tooling and evaluation hardware (Modalix DevKit) rather than a hosted public HTTP API.

providers.name: Skillshare
providers.description: Skillshare is a New York City–based online learning community for creators, founded in 2010 by Michael Karnjanaprakorn and Malcolm Ong. The platform hosts thousands of on-demand video classes across creative disciplines — illustration, design, photography, animation, lettering, film, productivity, writing, and business — taught by working creators and industry professionals. Skillshare operates on a paid subscription model (Premium membership) that grants members unlimited access to the class catalog, project-based learning, and a discussion community where students submit class projects for feedback. The company has a teacher revenue-share program in which class creators are paid based on watch time and student enrollments, and runs Skillshare for Teams as a B2B offering for organizations to give employees access to the catalog. Skillshare does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, partner API, or SDK. The platform's programmatic surface is limited to internal web/mobile clients and an affiliate/marketing referral program; there is no documented developer portal, public webhook system, or third-party integration API for the Skillshare catalog, enrollments, watch-time, or teacher-payout data.

providers.name: Sol
providers.description: Sol Reader is a wearable e-reader — marketed as the world's first wearable e-reader — built by Sol and backed by Initialized Capital. The device is a lightweight (104g) headset with dual 1.3" 271ppi side-lit E Ink displays, adjustable diopter optics and IPD, a handheld remote, and 25+ hours of battery for a distraction-free reading experience. It reads a connected Kindle library and DRM-free EPUB uploads, offers the Sol Store with over one million titles, plus AI question-answering and an AutoPilot speed-reading mode. Sol is a consumer hardware company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Spring Health
providers.description: Spring Health is a New York City-based digital mental health company that sells a comprehensive mental healthcare benefit to employers, health plans, brokers, channel partners, and healthcare providers. Its platform combines a clinically validated assessment, AI-driven matching, and a curated provider network to deliver therapy, medication management, coaching, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), critical-incident response, work-life services, and self-guided digital exercises through a unified member experience branded Spring Life. For health plans and providers, Spring Health offers Springworks — its enterprise care-coordination and care-management offering — alongside a generative-AI member-facing assistant called Guide and clinician-facing AI tooling. Customers include General Mills, Hearst, and Moda Health, and the company publishes outcomes, research, and ROI evidence on long-term cost savings of mental health benefits. Spring Health operates as a B2B2C benefit: it does not expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documented HTTP API. Integrations with HRIS, SSO, eligibility files, and health-plan partners are delivered through enterprise implementation rather than a self-service API, and its GitHub organization (github.com/SpringHealth) has no public repositories.

providers.name: Start Playing
providers.description: StartPlaying (startplaying.games) is the largest online marketplace connecting tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) players with professional Game Masters for systems including Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder, Starfinder, Warhammer, and many more. Players discover, book, and join online sessions filtered by system, platform, genre, playstyle, and GM reviews, while Game Masters build careers by hosting paid games across virtual tabletops. The platform also offers gift cards, learn-to-play one-shots for beginners, kids' games, and corporate team-building events. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a consumer web product with no public developer API.

providers.name: StatusPRO
providers.description: StatusPRO is a sports technology and gaming company founded by former professional athletes, building extended reality (XR) products that pair competitive training tools for elite athletes with immersive gaming experiences for consumers. Its flagship product, NFL PRO ERA, is an officially NFL- and NFLPA-licensed virtual reality football game for Meta Quest headsets, and its StatusPRO Visualizer powers immersive broadcast perspectives used by ESPN on NFL Live. The company operates a live-services consumer game rather than a developer platform: it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; it carries no API surface at this time.

providers.name: STORI AI Inc.
providers.description: STORI AI is a San Francisco-based AI content-marketing platform that helps brands define their identity — archetype, tone, tagline, and colors — and turn that identity into on-brand social posts, graphics, images, videos, and go-to-market marketing materials. The product generates personalized branded content, schedules and publishes it across digital platforms, and offers analytics, content storage, and multi-brand, multi-language, team-collaboration tiers. A Product Hunt Golden Kitty Award recipient, STORI AI is a web SaaS application for marketers and brand teams; it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Successfactors
providers.description: SuccessFactors is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) company founded in 2001 and an early Canaan Partners portfolio company that IPO'd in 2007 and was acquired by SAP in 2012. It is now delivered as the SAP SuccessFactors HXM (Human Experience Management) Suite, covering core HR (Employee Central), Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Learning (LMS), Succession & Development, and Workforce Analytics. SuccessFactors exposes an extensive integration surface through OData v2 and OData v4 APIs (the SFAPI/OData platform) documented on the SAP Business Accelerator Hub, using OAuth 2.0 SAML bearer-assertion and basic authentication per customer datacenter instance.

providers.name: Sword Health
providers.description: Sword Health is a digital musculoskeletal (MSK) and virtual physical-therapy company that pairs licensed clinicians with an AI Care platform (programs including Thrive for MSK, Bloom for pelvic and women's health, Move, and Mind for mental health, with the Phoenix AI care specialist and the Sword Intelligence division). Founded in Portugal in 2015, it sells to employers, health plans, and governments rather than to individual developers. As of this enrichment pass Sword Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; its digital surface is member/clinician apps and employer client portals. Real public surfaces captured here are its trust center (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR), legal pages, newsroom, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Taxfix
providers.description: Taxfix is a Berlin-based fintech that lets individuals and self-employed people in Germany prepare and file their annual income tax return from a mobile app or web browser. Users either answer a guided set of roughly 70 questions to self-file (Taxfix Basic) or hand the return to an independent tax expert via the Expert Service, with data transmitted to the tax authority over the official ELSTER interface. The company reports more than 10 million tax returns filed and over 5 billion euros in refunds. Taxfix is a consumer (B2C) product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Creandum, Index Ventures and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Teamworks
providers.description: Teamworks is a sports technology company that builds "The Operating System for Sports" — an integrated software platform used by elite collegiate, professional, and national-team organizations to digitize the athlete lifecycle and consolidate their technology stack. The platform spans four product areas: Personnel (roster management, recruiting, scouting, player evaluation), Performance (strength & conditioning, nutrition, and a sports EMR / athlete-management system), Coaching (sport-specific game preparation and strategy for football, baseball, and hockey), and Operations (Hub communication, compliance, academics, inventory, camps, and influencer management), plus Wallet for athlete payments and Teamworks Intelligence for predictive analytics. Teamworks is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes customer-facing SaaS products and a public status page but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: The Ladders
providers.description: Ladders (TheLadders.com) is a New York City based online job-search service founded in 2003 by Marc Cenedella that specializes in vetted executive and professional roles paying $100,000 or more per year. The subscription platform pairs a curated $100K+ job board with recruiter access, resume review and rewrite tools, AI-powered resume and LinkedIn optimization, and a daily career-news and advice product (Ladders News). It runs a consumer-facing web application with free Basic and paid Premium memberships and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or partner integration program.

providers.name: Topia
providers.description: Topia is a global mobility platform for distributed workforces, used by HR, Finance and Legal teams at mid-market and enterprise companies to manage international assignments, relocations, business travel, remote work and cross-border compliance across 190+ countries in a single system. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in the United States, with additional offices in the United Kingdom, Ireland and Estonia, Topia spans global talent mobility, a tax and compliance engine, cost estimation and tracking, global workforce planning, cost and immigration risk management, and business travel. In April 2026 Topia launched Horizon, an agentic AI workspace for mobility teams that the company describes as built natively into MCP (Model Context Protocol) environments. Topia integrates with HRIS, payroll, travel and expense systems including Workday (a Workday Approved Integration), SAP, ADP, Oracle, Ceridian, SAP Concur and BCD Travel. Topia publishes an llms.txt at its marketing host, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification; the support center sits behind a customer login.

providers.name: Ummeed Housing Finance
providers.description: Ummeed Housing Finance Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian affordable-housing finance company registered with the National Housing Bank (NHB), providing home loans, loans against property, business loans, and MSME business loans to low- and middle-income households. Headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, it operates 130+ branches across 9 states and has served 45,000+ families. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Ummeed publishes no public developer portal or API surface; its digital channels are the customer website and a customer mobile app.

providers.name: Versuni
providers.description: Versuni is a global domestic-appliances company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, formed when Philips Domestic Appliances was carved out and acquired by Hillhouse Investment in 2021. With more than 130 years of heritage, roughly 6,400 employees and a presence in over 100 countries, Versuni designs and sells cooking, coffee, garment-care, floor-care and climate-care products under brands including Philips, Saeco, Gaggia, Preethi, Senseo and L'OR Barista. Its connected appliances are supported by the consumer HomeID app (formerly NutriU). Versuni publishes no public developer API program; its public API-adjacent surface is limited to an RFC 9116 security.txt and a responsible-disclosure program.

providers.name: Vuori
providers.description: Vuori is an American athletic and performance apparel brand founded in 2015 in Encinitas, California. It designs and sells men's and women's activewear, athleisure, and lifestyle clothing through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront, its own retail stores, and wholesale partners. Vuori operates as a consumer retail company and does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the public web, security, and LLM-discovery surfaces it does expose. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of softbank-vision-fund.

providers.name: Warbler Labs Incorporated
providers.description: Warbler Labs is the San Francisco-based software company founded in 2020 by former Coinbase engineers Blake West and Mike Sall that builds and maintains Goldfinch, a decentralized credit protocol on Ethereum for stablecoin lending to real-world borrowers without crypto collateral, and UID (Unique Identity), a KYC/KYB-compliant on-chain identity credential. Warbler Labs is the core development team behind the Goldfinch protocol, its smart contracts, oracles, and subgraph data layer, and publishes developer documentation for building on and integrating with the protocol. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Coinbase Ventures, IDEO CoLab, Kindred Ventures, and others, and was surfaced through the a16z portfolio. Its developer surface is primarily on-chain (Solidity smart contracts, The Graph subgraph for querying protocol data, and the UID credential) rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: Zoetis
providers.description: Zoetis is the world's leading animal health company, dedicated to discovering, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing medicines, vaccines, diagnostics, and technologies for animals. The company operates in over 100 countries and provides digital connectivity solutions that integrate veterinary diagnostics, reference laboratory services, and practice management systems through the Vetscan platform, enabling bidirectional communication between point-of-care analyzers and veterinary practice information management systems (PIMS).

providers.name: Zoog.A.I. Ltd.
providers.description: Zoog.A.I. Ltd. (Zoog) is a consumer application that lets families create personalized video books and songs for children. Parents and kids can read classic children's books, sing popular nursery rhymes, and turn them into personalized videos featuring their own family, then share those magical creations. Zoog is delivered as an iOS app (with an Android waitlist) and a companion website, and is backed by 500 Global. It has no public developer API surface, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures its identity and web presence within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zuma
providers.description: Zuma (legally Resident Boost Inc., d/b/a Zuma) is an AI platform for the multifamily / apartment industry, best known for "Kelsey," an AI assistant with human back-up that handles renter engagement across the resident lifecycle. Kelsey automates leasing (responding to inquiries, qualifying prospects, and scheduling tours), rent collections (payment reminders, late-resident follow-up, and commitment tracking), move-outs (notices, inspections, and security-deposit handling), and inbound property calls via VoiceAI. Zuma integrates into property-management and CRM systems used by operators — Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, Knock, and Microsoft/Google calendars — to boost NOI and conversion. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Zuma does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile captures its public web, commercial, and operational surface.

222 is a consumer social app that matches compatible strangers for curated, in-real-life group experiences — dinners, events, and pop-up hangouts — to help people meet new people, discover their city, and deepen relationships. There are no profiles, DMs, or swiping: members complete a personality/values survey that builds a curation profile, then receive invites to nearby experiences where the app seats them with the people they are most compatible with.
