Founded in Los Angeles and now operating in cities including Los Angeles and New York, 222 is backed by General Catalyst and Y Combinator. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; 222 is a consumer mobile application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Achronix Semiconductor
providers.description: Achronix Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in high-performance FPGA (field-programmable gate array) products and embedded FPGA (eFPGA) intellectual property. Its portfolio includes the Speedster7t family of standalone FPGAs, Speedcore eFPGA IP for system-on-chip integration, VectorPath PCIe accelerator cards, and the ACE design tools suite for synthesis, verification, and optimization. Achronix technology targets AI/ML inference, 5G/6G networking, data-center compute acceleration, automotive, SmartNICs, and test-and-measurement workloads. The company is privately held and backed by investors including Battery Ventures. It exposes no public web/REST API or developer API portal; its developer surface is a hardware support portal, product documentation, datasheets, and design tools.

providers.name: AGENT.md
providers.description: AGENT.md is a vendor-neutral AI coding agent configuration file format providing project context and instructions for AI agents. It serves as an alternative to AGENTS.md, unifying agent guidance across tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and other AI coding assistants.

providers.name: Ajax
providers.description: Ajax is an AI-powered timekeeping platform built specifically for law firms. It automatically captures attorney work across applications, documents, emails, phone calls, and video meetings, then generates OCG-compliant, voice-matched time-entry narratives and syncs them with one click to practice-management and billing systems. Ajax integrates with SurePoint, Clio, MyCase, Filevine, PracticePanther, Centerbase, Actionstep, and Soluno, and positions itself around recovering otherwise-lost billable hours. The company is SOC 2 aligned, encrypts data in transit and at rest, does not train models on customer data, and enforces rolling data deletion. Ajax is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface — it is a product/SaaS company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Alexi
providers.description: Alexi is a Toronto, Ontario, Canada based legal artificial intelligence company that operates a private AI platform purpose-built for law firms, unifying legal research, drafting, and analysis into a single, single-tenant environment. Founded in 2017 by Mark Doble and a team of lawyers and technologists, Alexi specializes in litigation workflows — generating research memos grounded in primary law, identifying controlling authority and jurisdiction-specific requirements, framing case strategy, and producing persuasive first drafts that reflect a firm's voice, citation style, and approved structures. The platform also supports transactional work, document review and comparison, knowledge management, and firm-specific playbook application. Alexi's architecture combines a retrieval-first approach grounded in cited authority with agentic reasoning, delivered through a private cloud deployment so that firms retain ownership and sovereignty over their data, models, and workflows. Coverage spans all 50 U.S. states, Washington D.C., federal law, and all Canadian provinces and territories (excluding Quebec). The platform integrates with 20+ tools including iManage, NetDocuments, SharePoint, Elite 3E, Aderant, Litify, Actionstep, Filevine, Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, Zoom, DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Azure, AWS, Datasite, Intralinks, and Firmex. Alexi is SOC 2 certified, employs AES-256 encryption, and reports 99% uptime with customer firms including Dentons, Robins Appleby, Gluckstein Lawyers, MacLean Law, and Mongillo Law. The company's revenue model is SaaS subscription (Alexi Core and Alexi Advanced tiers); there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and integrations are delivered as turnkey enterprise connectors rather than a publicly documented integration platform.

providers.name: ams OSRAM
providers.description: ams OSRAM (ams-OSRAM AG) is a global leader in innovative optical solutions, designing and manufacturing intelligent sensors, emitters, and light-based semiconductors. Formed from the 2020 combination of ams AG (Austria) and OSRAM (Germany), the company builds LEDs, VCSEL and edge-emitting lasers, CMOS image sensors, ambient light and proximity sensors, direct time-of-flight (dToF) sensors, photodiodes, and LED/VCSEL driver ICs. Its sensing, illumination, and visualization technologies serve automotive and mobility (headlamps, interior lighting, ADAS), industrial automation and robotics, medical and healthcare devices, mobile and wearable devices, computing, and general lighting. Headquartered in Premstaetten, Austria and Munich, Germany, ams OSRAM employs roughly 18,500 people across 25 R&D sites and holds over 12,000 patents. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital and enriched from ams OSRAM public web pages; the company exposes product/design support and a download center rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Anagram
providers.description: Anagram (operated by Enigma Analytics, Inc.) is a security-awareness and human-risk training platform for enterprises, positioned in the defense and government sector and backed by General Catalyst. The product replaces check-the-box compliance training with engaging, gamified experiences proven to change risky behavior: role- and geography-adaptive phishing simulations (Smart Phishing), developer-designed secure-coding challenges for engineering teams, and a real-time AI coaching layer (Anagram Agent). Anagram is not currently a public API provider — this profile captures the company identity, product surface, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Apphive
providers.description: Apphive is a no-code, AI-assisted platform for building native iOS and Android mobile applications without writing code. A visual drag-and-drop editor with live phone previews lets makers assemble screens and app logic, add native device capabilities (GPS and maps, push notifications, camera, authentication, databases, in-app purchases), connect third-party APIs and payment gateways such as Stripe and Openpay, and then compile and publish finished apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play. Vertical marketplace templates cover delivery, taxi, e-commerce, real estate, gym management, and more. Apphive is backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: AutoTrac
providers.description: AutoTrac is a Brazilian fleet management and vehicle tracking technology company with over 30 years of experience. As the national market leader, AutoTrac provides satellite and cellular fleet tracking solutions, real-time telemetry, driver journey management, and management intelligence platforms for logistics, agriculture, maritime, and insurance sectors. The company operates its own terrestrial satellite communication station and data center for nationwide coverage.

providers.name: Axial Networks
providers.description: Axial Networks operates Axial (axial.net), a private deal network for mergers, acquisitions and capital raising in the North American lower middle market. Founded in 2010 and based in New York, the platform connects business owners, M&A advisors, private equity buyers, strategic acquirers and lenders around live sell-side and buy-side transactions, and publishes a public member directory, the Middle Market Review editorial forum, industry deal-activity dashboards and business valuation calculators. The member product runs at network.axial.net and product help documentation at guide.axial.net. Axial publishes an llms.txt orientation file for language models and a public status page, but ships no public API, SDK, webhook surface or developer program — the platform is delivered as an authenticated end-user application only.

providers.name: Axtria
providers.description: Axtria is an AI-first cloud software and data analytics company built for the life sciences industry, founded in 2010 and headquartered in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey. Its cloud product suite — Axtria DataMAx (AI-driven data management), Axtria InsightsMAx.ai (agentic AI and cloud analytics), Axtria SalesIQ (sales planning and operations), Axtria MarketingIQ (marketing analytics and omnichannel measurement) and Axtria CustomerIQ (omnichannel customer engagement) — helps pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, animal health and consumer health commercial teams turn data into targeting, segmentation, incentive compensation, field force and brand decisions. Axtria reports 3,600+ employees serving 100+ life sciences companies, including 16+ of the top 20 pharmaceutical enterprises. Axtria publishes no public developer portal and no open API documentation: the product documentation host docs.axtria.com is HTTP Basic-auth gated to customers, and platform integration (Veeva CRM, Salesforce, Marketo and 20+ structured and unstructured life sciences data sources over SFTP and APIs) is delivered under enterprise contract rather than through a self-service developer surface.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Bridgestone
providers.description: Bridgestone Corporation is a Japanese global tire and rubber manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. Bridgestone produces tires for passenger, commercial, off-road, and aircraft applications, plus diversified rubber and chemical products, and is one of the largest tire makers in the world.

providers.name: Careship
providers.description: Careship (operated by Care Companion GmbH, Berlin) is a German senior-care marketplace that connects elderly people and their families with vetted, non-medical everyday helpers ("Alltagshilfen") from their own neighborhoods. The platform covers companionship, shopping, household support, mobility and leisure, light personal care, and dementia support, and helps families finance care through statutory long-term care insurance (Pflegekasse). Careship operates across 20+ German cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, and Dresden. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Creandum; it is a consumer care-services business with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cenos
providers.description: CENOS is an engineering simulation software company founded in 2017 in Riga, Latvia, that packages academically proven open-source solvers (Salome, GetDP, and Elmer FEM) into focused, affordable desktop applications for practical engineers. Its products cover electromagnetic and thermal simulation use cases including induction heating, radio-frequency antenna design, wireless charging, electromagnetic stirring of liquid metals, and busbar heating, promising faster product development and lower cost than traditional CAE suites. CENOS is a subscription desktop product with CAD import, one-click PDF reports, and live expert support; it does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by 500 Global, Startup Wise Guys, and Capitalia.

providers.name: CentralComs
providers.description: CentralComs is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) proptech company building AI agents that automate maintenance coordination and leasing for residential and small-commercial property managers. Its agents field tenant, prospect, and owner messages 24/7, triage and dispatch maintenance work orders to ranked vendors, follow up until tickets close with verification photos, and answer lease/listing/HOA questions with the exact clause cited. A leasing agent captures multi-channel leads, scores qualification, matches units, analyzes documents, and runs background screening. CentralComs bills flat monthly per door with no per-message fees and keeps records aligned with AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, Rent Manager, and DoorLoop via CSV today, with native two-way PMS integrations on the roadmap. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company; the company does not yet publish a public API — it is an AI agent product with PMS integrations planned rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Cerebral
providers.description: Cerebral is an American telehealth company providing online mental health and wellness care, including therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management delivered through its website and mobile app on a subscription basis. Founded in 2020 by Kyle Robertson and Ho Anh, the company treats conditions such as depression, anxiety, insomnia, ADHD, and substance use disorder. Cerebral is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, which led a $300M Series C in December 2021 valuing the company at roughly $4.8B. Cerebral is a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public company and website properties.

providers.name: CERPRO
providers.description: CERPRO is a Berlin-based industrial software company building AI-powered quality-assurance and process automation for small and medium-sized manufacturers. Its flagship product, QualiSpec, uses computer-vision and large-model AI to automatically extract features, dimensions, tolerances and drill-hole specifications from technical drawings (PDF, JPG, DXF) and generate inspection reports and quality documents in customized templates such as VDA, EMPB and inspection plans. This removes manual copy-paste and data-entry work from quality control, cutting documentation time by up to 70-90% and reducing errors while creating a unified data foundation that connects OEMs and suppliers. Since launching in December 2024 the software has been adopted by more than 100 SMEs across aerospace, medical devices and mechanical engineering. CERPRO is a Techstars portfolio company and raised a ~EUR 2M pre-seed round in 2025. The product is delivered as a cloud SaaS platform (platform.cerpro.io) hosted on AWS in Germany, with an ISO 27001 certified, GDPR/BDSG-compliant data-security posture.

providers.name: Chinese Medicine Online
providers.description: Chinese Medicine Online (中医在线) is a Beijing-based traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) continuing-education and academic-exchange platform, founded in 2015 and operated by Beijing Universe In Nutshell Technology Co., Ltd. (北京果壳宇宙教育科技有限公司) on behalf of the Beijing TCM Online Education Center (北京中医在线教育中心). Through its web platform at tcmmooc.com and its iOS/Android app, it publishes recorded and live video continuing-education courses from national TCM masters and senior practitioners, runs the 经方学社 (Classical Formulas Society) learning community and 精医社 membership, livestreams academic conferences, and sells course material through a paid knowledge marketplace. The company states a catalogue of roughly 19,600 courses from 3,900+ TCM experts and around 4 million registered users, the majority of them licensed practitioners. It has since extended into AI and SaaS for grassroots clinics, including the "Yi Yin" (伊尹) TCM classical-reasoning large language model launched in Songxian, Henan in September 2025, and clinic workflow tooling (prescription, patient and follow-up management). The platform is delivered strictly as an end-user web and mobile product — it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Cignara
providers.description: Cignara is an enterprise AI platform that replaces traditional customer support (FAQ bots and IVR menus) with governed voice and chat AI agents that serve, sell, and grow. Its agents handle inbound and outbound phone and chat conversations end to end across 32+ languages, pulling customer context, applying business policy, executing transactions (checkout, scheduling, refunds, retention), and offering a real-time human copilot for support teams. The platform emphasizes in-region data sovereignty and hallucination-free, policy-bound actions grounded in each enterprise's own knowledge base. Founded 2026 (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) in San Francisco; legal entity ShopAdvisor Inc.

providers.name: Citruslabs
providers.description: Citruslabs is a clinical research organization (CRO) that designs and runs clinical trials, consumer perception studies, and randomized controlled trials for consumer health brands across supplements, skincare, pet health, food and beverage, longevity, and women's health. It handles IRB approval, protocol design, participant recruitment, decentralized data collection, and statistical analysis, then turns results into regulator-reviewed, marketing-ready product claims for retailers, advertising, and packaging. Studies range from DIY consumer perception studies to full randomized controlled trials, typically completing in four to sixteen weeks.

providers.name: Commerce Bank
providers.description: Commerce Bank is the principal banking subsidiary of Commerce Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ CBSH), a Missouri-based regional bank holding company with roughly $32 billion in assets and dual headquarters in Kansas City and St. Louis. Commerce Bank is a Missouri state-chartered bank and Federal Reserve member, founded in 1865, offering personal, business, commercial, and wealth-management services across the U.S. Midwest. Its API posture is corporate/embedded-banking oriented rather than a fully open public program: it runs a registration-gated external developer portal (developers.commercebank.com) and a CommercePayments developer platform, and delivers ERP-embedded banking via Commerce Connections Direct. Consumer-permissioned data sharing is largely intermediated through aggregators such as Plaid and platforms like Modern Treasury rather than a documented first-party, self-serve open-banking API. No public FDX or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented, and no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger is publicly available.

providers.name: Conceive
providers.description: Conceive is a telehealth platform for fertility and pregnancy support. It offers 24/7 text access to fertility and pregnancy nurses, coaches, and dietitians, personalized fertility coaching, fertility test interpretation, virtual video visits with providers, expert-led community events, and an educational library. Membership is delivered through Conceive Plus and Conceive Premium tiers. The company is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. As a consumer telehealth app it publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its published identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Coris
providers.description: Coris is an AI platform for merchant and payment risk, providing modern risk infrastructure for vertical SaaS platforms, payment processors, ISOs, PayFacs, and sponsor banks. Its MerchantProfiler product returns 100+ structured data attributes on any business — pulled from Secretary of State records, online presence, customer reviews, website/content signals, adverse media, and operational data — to power faster, more accurate merchant onboarding, KYB, underwriting, and ongoing risk monitoring. The platform also spans transaction monitoring, AI risk agents, and managed risk workflows, exposed through both a no-code console and REST APIs so customers can automate the full merchant lifecycle. Founded in 2022 and based in Palo Alto, Coris is backed by Lux Capital, Exponent Founders Capital, and Y Combinator, and works with companies including GoFundMe, Kajabi, Clio, and Cherry. Developer documentation is published on a password-gated ReadMe portal; this profile was enriched from public surfaces (marketing site, status page, trust center, legal pages).

providers.name: Cowboy
providers.description: Cowboy is a Brussels-based mobility company that designs and manufactures premium connected electric bicycles for urban commuting. Its lineup — the Cruiser, Cruiser ST, Cross, and Cross ST — pairs a lightweight frame with removable batteries, integrated GPS tracking, crash detection, and its proprietary AdaptivePower motor assistance, all managed through the Cowboy mobile app. The company sells direct-to-consumer and through a network of 125+ service centers and mobile technicians across 40+ European cities, complemented by leasing, business, and student programs. Backed by Index Ventures, Cowboy operates a Shopify-based storefront and a connected-bike app platform; it does not publish a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the company's real identity, legal, support, and security surfaces.

providers.name: Dawaai
providers.description: Dawaai is Pakistan's leading digital healthcare platform, operating a licensed online pharmacy alongside telehealth and diagnostic services. Founded on a licensed retail pharmacy (License #1265, 2014) and headquartered in Karachi, Dawaai lets patients order authentic prescription and OTC medicines for temperature-controlled doorstep delivery, book doctor and mental-health consultations, order home-based lab tests and checkups, arrange home nursing and medical services, and subscribe to chronic-care programs for diabetes and obesity. It is a LegitScript-certified healthcare merchant that sources directly from manufacturers and distributors, with qualified pharmacists handling procurement, storage, and dispensing. Dawaai is backed by 500 Global and operates across Pakistan, including Karachi and Rawalpindi. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via the venture portfolio pipeline; Dawaai publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Dawn
providers.description: Dawn (Sleepedy, Inc. dba Dawn) is a digital-health company offering a clinician-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) program delivered through a mobile app. The service pairs users with licensed sleep coaches and therapists for weekly video sessions and between-session chat, daily 5-7 minute sleep lessons, live sleep-performance insights, and weekly progress reports, with the goal of treating primary and chronic insomnia and reducing reliance on sleep medication. Dawn is in-network with major U.S. insurers (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, United Healthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and offers an employer/enterprise workplace-wellness program. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Dawn publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: DigitalAPI
providers.description: DigitalAPI is an API catalog, marketplace, and management platform that unifies APIs across multiple gateways into a single searchable catalog with governance, discovery, access control, and analytics.

providers.name: DiscoverCloud
providers.description: Discover the best SaaS solutions and B2B services on the DiscoverCloud. Our B2B marketplace features an ever-growing number of SaaS solutions and outsourced services. Operated by Chekkt Limited, DiscoverCloud aggregates crowd-sourced ratings and reviews across software categories including CRM, Project Management, Marketing Automation, Business Intelligence, eCommerce, Invoicing, Help Desk, and Security.

providers.name: Dusty Robotics
providers.description: Dusty Robotics is a construction-technology company building automated layout robotics for the building trades. Its flagship product, the FieldPrinter, is a mobile robot that prints digital BIM models and design drawings directly onto the jobsite floor at full scale, laying out walls, penetrations, and other design intent so field teams build to plan with far less manual measurement and rework. The FieldPrinter platform ingests drawings from tools like Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD via native plugins, translating the digital model into precise physical markings on the deck. Dusty Robotics is headquartered in Mountain View, California and is backed by investors including Canaan Partners. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its published surfaces are the product site, a partner program, a support center, and the Dusty Academy training resource.

providers.name: Ethos Systems
providers.description: Ethos Systems is an AI-powered human readiness platform that unifies learning, performance, and outcomes management in a single system built for enterprise and government deployment across both commercial and classified networks. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Ethos delivers personalized training with algorithm-driven interventions, rapid AI content development, and real-time readiness dashboards that connect learning to operational outcomes. It serves the U.S. military, federal civilian agencies, life sciences, manufacturing, freight and logistics, hospitality, athletics, utilities, insurance, and government contractors, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the Westly Group, and Pear VC. The company operates the Ethos and Learn to Win platforms; its developer and product documentation is gated behind authentication and it exposes no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Ezra
providers.description: Ezra (Ezra AI, Inc.) is a preventive-health company offering full-body MRI and CT cancer-screening scans directly to consumers. Its screening service scans up to 13 organs in as little as 22 minutes to detect early signs of cancer and hundreds of other conditions without harmful radiation, with plans spanning a full-body MRI, MRI with spine, a comprehensive skeletal/neurological MRI, and heart and lung CT scans, plus couples pricing and locations across the United States. Ezra was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp; this profile is a consumer healthcare company with no public developer API, and was enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline against its public web surface.

providers.name: Fightcamp
providers.description: FightCamp is a consumer connected-fitness company that sells an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system combining physical equipment (a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and Bluetooth motion-tracking punch trackers) with a subscription app of on-demand classes led by professional fighters. The trackers use motion sensors and AI to measure punch output, speed, and workout stats, syncing to a member app and customer dashboard for progress tracking. FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer hardware-plus-membership business (backed by IVP) and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, commerce, support, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fiture
providers.description: Fiture is a consumer smart-home fitness company that makes interactive AI-powered fitness mirrors for at-home workouts. Its hardware line includes the Fiture Core flagship mirror and the compact Fiture Mini, each pairing a wall-mounted display with a camera and on-device AI that delivers real-time motion tracking, gesture recognition, rep counting, and posture feedback across a library of live and on-demand fitness classes sold through a membership. The company was founded in China and is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Fiture operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership website but does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or SDK; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its public web surface (support, legal, and account pages).

providers.name: Five Lives
providers.description: Five Lives is a health-technology company building evidence-based digital tools for dementia prevention and brain health for adults aged 50 and over. Founded by former Peak brain-training leaders Xavier Louis (CEO) and Sylvain Piquet (COO), the fully remote company operates two consumer mobile apps: Five Lives Brain Health, a prevention app available since 2021 with cognitive tests, brain games, and lifestyle tracking across five pillars (nutrition, sleep, physical activity, mood and social connection, and mental stimulation); and Five Lives Care, an evidence-based memory and autonomy programme for people aged 60+ launched in January 2026 and developed with leading memory centres in the UK and France. Its work draws on the FINGER study and the Lancet Commission's modifiable dementia risk factors, with research partners including the University of Oxford, Trinity College Dublin, the FINGER Brain Health Institute, Dementias Platform UK, and the Gerontopole d'Ile de France. Backed by Speedinvest. Five Lives does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Frontera
providers.description: Frontera (Frontera Health) is an AI-assisted clinical documentation company for behavioral health. Its software automates assessment and diagnosis report writing for Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and clinical psychologists working in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and autism care, cutting report time from 6-10 hours to 2-3 hours. The platform pairs a BCBA-trained AI Assessment Builder and Diagnosis Builder with digital phenotyping, and is delivered as a HIPAA-compliant web application (customer login at portal.fronterahealth.com) rather than a public API. Frontera is a venture-backed portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and security surface; as of this pass Frontera publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Gireve
providers.description: Gireve is a B2B digital platform for electric-vehicle charging and new-mobility services, connecting charge point operators (CPOs), e-mobility service providers (eMSPs), and EV drivers across Europe. Its interoperability hub powers EV charging roaming, clearing and transaction settlement, Plug & Charge, smart charging, and mobility data services, spanning 680,000+ connected charging points and roughly one million monthly roaming transactions across 13,000+ signed agreements. Technical integration is delivered to connected operators over an OCPI-based hub through the Connect Place B2B platform; Gireve does not publish a public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Helm.ai
providers.description: Helm.ai is an AI software company for autonomous driving and robotics, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. It develops camera-first perception, path prediction and end-to-end autonomy stacks — Helm.ai Vision and Helm.ai Driver — alongside the generative AI development and validation tools VidGen-3, GenSim-3 and WorldGen-1, all trained with its proprietary Deep Teaching unsupervised learning method. The software is licensed to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers (Honda, Volkswagen, Ambarella, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments) as embedded, hardware-agnostic components for production vehicle programs rather than as a public developer API. As of 2026-08-22 the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification on any host it controls.

providers.name: Insuretech Connect
providers.description: InsureTech Connect (ITC) is the world's largest insurance innovation event series, produced by Clarion Events. Its flagship, ITC Vegas, brings together 9,000+ insurance carriers, insurtech startups, brokers, reinsurers, and investors for three days of content, networking, and dealmaking, with regional editions in Europe and Asia. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qed-investors and added to the API Evangelist network. ITC is an events and media brand; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or event webhooks, so this entry carries company identity and probed domain-security signals only.

providers.name: IrisVR
providers.description: IrisVR is a virtual-reality software company for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, best known for its two products: Prospect, a desktop application that converts Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Navisworks and other 3D/BIM models into immersive VR walkthroughs in one click, and Scope, a mobile app for viewing and sharing 360-degree panoramas on standalone and phone-based VR headsets. Founded in New York, IrisVR was acquired by The Wild in 2021, and The Wild (together with IrisVR) was subsequently acquired by Autodesk in 2022. The products and support site remain available. IrisVR does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, packages, and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: KitchenMate
providers.description: KitchenMate is a Toronto-based autonomous retail and workplace food-service company that operates 24/7 unattended micro-markets built around two pieces of proprietary hardware, a checkout-free Smart Fridge that uses vision sensors to detect what a customer removes and bill them automatically, and induction-based Smart Cookers that heat chef-prepared entrees in seven to ten minutes. The kiosks are installed in workplaces, condominiums, schools, hospitals and other commercial locations, require roughly seven square feet plus standard electrical and network connectivity, and accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay and Google Pay at the unit. A companion iOS and Android app carries loyalty rewards, dietary filters and meal feedback. The company has since rebranded its platform business as Micromart, which markets the same autonomous smart-store technology under the tagline "Be anywhere. Sell anything." across a stated 2,000+ locations in North America. KitchenMate publishes no public API, developer portal or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and probed security posture only.

providers.name: Lindus Health
providers.description: Lindus Health is a next-generation contract research organization (CRO) that runs clinical trials end to end for biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors. It pairs Citrus, an AI-assisted trial operating system connecting patient identification through final data capture, with centralized patient identification and enrollment (AI-powered EHR querying, digital pre-screening, centralized patient support), flexible site models spanning site-based, hybrid and fully virtual delivery, and integrated clinical services from protocol design through database lock. Its platform surface covers EDC, eSource, ePRO/eCOA, eConsent and CTMS. The company operates across the US, UK and Europe with APAC partnerships, employs over 160 staff, and works in cardiometabolic, respiratory, psychiatry, women's health and dermatology. Commercial engagements are performance-based with milestone pricing. Lindus Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal or API documentation; its public technical footprint is two open-source CDISC clinical-data repositories.

providers.name: Logility
providers.description: Logility is an AI-powered supply chain planning platform providing solutions for demand sensing, inventory optimization, supply planning, S&OP process management, and supply chain analytics. Part of Aptean, Logility serves 600+ clients across 80 countries with capabilities for demand planning, inventory optimization, scenario planning, manufacturing execution, and supplier management across 12+ industry verticals.

providers.name: MaxLinear
providers.description: MaxLinear, Inc. (NASDAQ: MXL) is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Carlsbad, California that designs radio-frequency (RF), high-performance analog, and mixed-signal communications systems-on-chip (SoCs) for critical network infrastructure, the connected home, and industrial and multi-market applications. Its products integrate RF, analog, mixed-signal, digital signal processing, security engines, data compression, networking, and power management into single chips that power cable and fiber broadband modems, Wi-Fi 6/7 and wireline home routers, optical transceivers, 4G/5G base-station and backhaul infrastructure, and high-speed data-center interconnects. MaxLinear exposes developer surface primarily as hardware/firmware SDKs and C APIs (for example the Panther Storage Acceleration SDK and the MxL890x Raw Acceleration API) delivered with its silicon, along with design tools, simulation models, and a technical documentation library — it does not publish a public web/REST API. This profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Medmonk
providers.description: Medmonk is a pharma market access platform that connects brand teams, healthcare providers, pharmacies, and patients on a single real-time infrastructure. It automates point-of-sale copay enrollment, benefit investigations, prior authorizations, financial assistance, hub workflows, and adherence tracking across specialty and rare-disease medications, reaching roughly 98% of U.S. pharmacy and buy/bill network connectivity. Medmonk states it exposes FHIR-compliant APIs to integrate with existing EHR, CRM, and pharmacy systems, and claims SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance, though it publishes no public developer portal or API documentation. Founded in the Y Combinator W12 batch.

providers.name: MelodyArc
providers.description: MelodyArc is an enterprise AI operations platform that orchestrates data, business rules, AI agents, and human workers in one governed system, so the right judgment is applied at the right moment, every time. It turns messy, cross-system, high-consequence operational work into modular building blocks: Points (atomic units of work capturing context, action, state, and ownership), Point Sets (reusable workflow configurations), a Point Engine (a dynamic decision graph routing tasks through rules, automation, AI, and human intervention in real time), AI Operators (configured workers with instructions and tools), a Portal for oversight and intervention, and Record for built-in traceability. It targets enterprise operations teams handling high-consequence work at scale and runs on managed or self-hosted infrastructure. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Mind Foundry
providers.description: Mind Foundry is an Oxford University spin-out, founded in 2016 and headquartered at Ewert House in Oxford, United Kingdom, that builds applied machine learning for high-stakes, real-world problems across defence, national security, insurance, infrastructure and government. Its current products are SENTRY, a multi-modal sensor-fusion capability that detects, classifies and tracks objects in time and space from raw sensor data, and NIGHTINGALE, AI-enabled acoustic intelligence for anti-submarine warfare that has been integrated with Thales systems. Mind Foundry delivers these as deployed and integrated systems for customers and prime contractors rather than as a public, self-serve developer API, and it publishes no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification. The company previously operated OPTaaS (Optimization as a Service), a Bayesian optimisation API with first-party Python and R clients; the OPTaaS service hosts and its GitHub client repositories are no longer reachable, and the PyPI client has had no release since January 2024. Mind Foundry publishes ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus and JOSCAR certifications on its own site.

providers.name: Mindbloom
providers.description: Mindbloom is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering at-home ketamine-assisted therapy for anxiety, depression, and PTSD, combining psychiatric clinician oversight, guided therapeutic sessions, and peer support. Clients complete a psychiatric evaluation, receive either sublingual tablets or subcutaneous injectable treatments, and are supported through a structured program with monitoring and integration guidance. The company reports having facilitated over 200,000 ketamine therapy sessions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, or developer documentation — Mindbloom is a consumer healthcare service, not an API provider.

providers.name: Musely
providers.description: Musely is a telehealth platform, founded in 2012 by Jack Jia and Carrie Jiao and based in San Jose, California, that connects patients with U.S. board-certified dermatologists for personalized, prescription-strength skincare and related care. Patients share skin concerns online, physicians craft personalized treatment plans, and freshly compounded formulas are shipped to the patient. Since pivoting from a wellness community to prescription skincare in 2019, Musely has expanded into hair loss, hormonal/menopause health, and longevity, serving more than 1.2 million patients. Musely is a consumer/health company in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a direct-to-consumer web and mobile telehealth experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: NeonRain, Inc.
providers.description: NeonRain, Inc. is a 500 Global portfolio company whose public product surface resolves to Playabl (playabl.ai), an AI-powered, no-code platform that lets anyone create web games and interactive experiences by chatting with AI. Users describe a game idea in plain English and Playabl's generative AI produces a playable prototype instantly, which can be refined conversationally and published to the web. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in the United States, the product targets educators, indie developers, marketers, and hobbyists. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web application with no developer-facing API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Newton Research
providers.description: Newton Research builds a team of specially trained AI agents for marketing analytics. Pre-built or custom agents connect to a customer's existing data infrastructure, write and execute code, and automate analytics workflows — data exploration and preparation, audience management, Customer 360, planning and activation, cross-channel measurement and attribution, anomaly detection, yield management, and automated reporting — with data remaining on the customer's own instance. Founded by John Hoctor, Matthew Emans, and Steven Bennett, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program. Newton states SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA compliance. No public developer API surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: One
providers.description: OnePay (formerly One / One Finance) is a Walmart-backed consumer fintech that delivers a single mobile app combining banking, high-yield savings, a CashRewards debit card, a credit-building card, buy-now-pay-later, investing, cryptocurrency trading, and tax filing. Banking services are provided through partner banks Coastal Community Bank and Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The product is consumer-facing with no public developer API; a partner/developer portal exists behind authentication at developer.onepay.com. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment.

providers.name: OurCrowd
providers.description: OurCrowd is a global private-market investment platform that gives accredited and institutional investors access to curated venture and alternative-asset deals. Through a single online account, members can invest in pre-vetted startups, thematic and targeted venture funds, and a range of alternatives such as private equity and private credit. The platform handles deal sourcing, due diligence, syndication, and post-investment management. OurCrowd is a consumer-facing investment product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Overview
providers.description: Overview (overview.ai) builds AI-powered machine vision systems for manufacturing quality control. Its edge-computing platform runs vision transformer models directly on smart cameras with on-device NVIDIA GPUs to perform automated defect detection, assembly verification, and real-time inspection without cloud dependency. Overview serves connector, semiconductor, packaging, automotive, pharmaceutical, aerospace, renewable energy, food, and textile manufacturers, and integrates with factory-floor systems (PLCs, ERPs, SCADA) over MQTT and digital I/O rather than a public REST API. Backed by GV and Homebrew. Profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pabbly Connect
providers.description: Pabbly Connect is a workflow automation platform for connecting cloud applications and automating business processes.

providers.name: Paradigm Health
providers.description: Paradigm Health is an AI-native clinical trial platform connecting biopharma sponsors with a research-ready provider network spanning roughly 2,100 care locations across the United States. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, the company operates infrastructure implemented at healthcare provider organizations to make clinical research part of routine care. Its Study Conduct platform captures data directly from electronic health records and other structured and unstructured sources, algorithmically evaluates FDA-defined data points in real time, and transmits the critical safety and efficacy signals needed for regulatory determinations to trial sponsors and the FDA. Paradigm serves both trial sponsors (protocol optimization, feasibility and site selection, patient identification and enrollment, data collection and delivery, post-approval evidence) and research sites. The company acquired Flatiron Health's Clinical Research business, announced a research collaboration with the U.S. FDA, and is backed by ARCH Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and GV. Paradigm currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity, legal, and published security/compliance surface.

providers.name: Playabl
providers.description: Playabl is a no-code, conversational game creation platform that lets anyone build games and interactive experiences by chatting with AI. Operated by Replkt, Inc. and backed by Y Combinator, Playabl turns natural-language prompts into playable games across genres including sports, idle, brainrot, dopamine, and think/puzzle categories, with no coding required. The product is a consumer-facing web application (playabl.ai); as of this profile Playabl does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Plural Ai
providers.description: Plural is an AI platform built for private markets professionals across private debt, private equity, and banking. Its AI agents ingest and analyze complex financial documents and data-room sources (documents, SharePoint, data rooms) to generate auditable, fully-referenced outputs — deal screeners, investment committee (IC) memos, term-sheet drafts, portfolio reports, and compliance documentation. Plural emphasizes EU data residency, end-to-end encryption, ISO 27001-aligned controls, and GDPR/DORA readiness, with no training on customer data. The company is backed by Speedinvest, Creative Destruction Lab, AI SEED, Innovate UK, and the European Commission. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is published; the product references MCP and agent integrations for private-markets workflows.

providers.name: Pylon (formerly Braid Lending)
providers.description: Pylon (formerly Braid Lending) is an AI-native mortgage infrastructure company founded in 2022 and headquartered in New York, New York, backed by investors including 500 Global and Citi. Pylon operates as "America's mortgage rails," an API-first, MCP-native platform that lets brokers, fintechs, lenders, and banks build and automate mortgage origination end to end — from application through underwriting, decisioning, compliance, and capital markets settlement. Every aspect of mortgage fulfillment is powered by APIs, complemented by a white-label "Elements" UI component library for embedding fully digital, autonomous mortgage experiences. The public developer surface (API reference, integration guides, and a live playground) is gated behind a developer-access request form, so no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or hosted docs were discoverable during enrichment.

providers.name: Q Bio
providers.description: Q Bio is a Redwood City, California health-technology company offering the Q Exam and the Q Bio Health Dashboard, sold directly at its clinic and through enterprise partners. The Q Exam is a comprehensive preventive-health assessment that combines whole-body non-contrast MRI, 120+ blood biomarkers, analysis of 163 risk-relevant genes, wearable data, medical history, and board-certified physician review into a single longitudinal health baseline. Imaging is quantified by Constellation, the company's FDA-cleared AI image-analysis software that segments organs and measures anatomy, and results are stored in the Q Bio Health Dashboard for year-over-year comparison. Q Bio is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Qiz Security
providers.description: QIZ Security is a cybersecurity company delivering a cryptography management platform for quantum-safe security. The platform helps organizations discover, prioritize, remediate, and govern their cryptographic assets across on-premises and cloud environments, making hidden cryptography visible and preparing them for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) adoption. Founded by experts in cybersecurity, networking, and post-quantum cryptography, QIZ Security is API-first and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, with offices in Lewes, Delaware (US) and Ra'anana, Israel.

providers.name: Quanta
providers.description: Quanta is a San Francisco-based accounting services company built for SaaS businesses, pairing expert human accountants with proprietary software that "shows its work." The platform delivers continuous accounting and reconciliation, explainable financial reporting through its agentic reporting layer (Prism), SaaS revenue and accounts-receivable insights, and real-time visibility into cash, burn, and runway alongside department-level spend tracking. Quanta is a managed-services and software product for finance teams rather than a developer-facing API provider; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Homebrew and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Replenysh
providers.description: Replenysh is an enterprise circularity platform that runs circular supply chains for brands and recovery facilities. It routes, recovers, verifies, and optimizes material recovery flows across a network of 5,000+ partners, giving enterprises a single control layer for reverse logistics with audit-ready chain-of-custody, pricing, settlement, and compliance documentation. Customers include PepsiCo, Disney, Marriott, and Live Nation. Backed by Kindred Ventures and M13. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Robby
providers.description: Robby is an AI-powered growth and job-documentation platform for home-services businesses, focused on HVAC contractors. It automates job documentation and paperwork for technicians so they can focus on servicing equipment and talking to customers, combines customer and third-party data to surface new leads daily, equips technicians with talking points to increase sales, and gives management a dashboard to monitor the revenue opportunities captured from every visit. Robby is an early-stage Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup that currently publishes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Robco
providers.description: RobCo is a Munich- and Austin-based industrial robotics company building software-defined, modular robotic automation delivered as Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) with zero upfront capital expenditure. Its modular robot arms (up to 8 axes, 40 kg payload, 2.5 m reach, 0.1 mm repeatability), the Alfie autonomous robot, the RobFlow no-code programming platform, RobCo Studio configuration and simulation tooling, and the RobVision AI vision system let manufacturers automate machine tending, palletizing, materials handling, and finishing tasks. RobCo serves manufacturing, food and beverage, logistics, automotive, wood, and defense customers, and is backed by Lightspeed, Sequoia Capital, Lingotto, Kindred Capital, and Promus Ventures.

providers.name: SambaTV
providers.description: Samba TV is a media and advertising intelligence company that measures television and streaming viewership across screens using data collected from millions of opted-in smart TVs and connected devices. Its platform gives advertisers, agencies, and publishers cross-screen audience targeting, campaign measurement, and content analytics built on privacy-first, deterministic viewing signals rather than cookies or traditional identifiers. Samba TV operates a gated partner portal (developer.samba.tv, which redirects to partner-portal.tvp.samba.tv) for licensed data partners; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish an open, public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Scalable CFO
providers.description: The Scalable CFO is an Abu Dhabi (ADGM) based financial-operations platform for small and medium-sized enterprises. Its MADI software delivers real-time cash-flow forecasting, "what-if" scenario simulation, bill-payment planning and invoice-collection tracking, syncing with accounting systems such as Xero and QuickBooks. Alongside the software it runs a marketplace connecting businesses to 6,300+ pre-vetted fractional CFOs and accountants for accounts cleanup, tax compliance, margin optimization and fundraising readiness. The Scalable CFO is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Scuba
providers.description: Scuba (Scuba Analytics, formerly Interana) is a real-time behavioral and customer analytics platform for self-service exploration of large-scale event data, backed by Battery Ventures and DCVC. The company is rebranding to Behavure AI and extending its behavioral query engine to detect drift, explain decisions, and govern AI agents across models, systems, and users. Scuba publishes product user guides, admin guides, a glossary, dated release notes, and a Tableau connector at docs.scuba.io (now docs.behavure.ai), but does not currently expose a public developer REST API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Sentisis Analytics
providers.description: Sentisis (Sentisis Intelligence) is a Spanish-language AI consumer-intelligence and sentiment-analysis platform that turns social media conversations, surveys, emails, and online reviews into actionable business insight using proprietary natural-language-processing built for Spanish and its regional variants. Products span Social Media listening, Customer Experience analytics, Reviews analysis, and sector consulting, serving brands such as Vodafone, Santander, Bancolombia, ALDI, Iberdrola, and Sony Pictures from offices in Madrid, Bogota, and Mexico City. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a domain security probe.

providers.name: Signos
providers.description: Signos is a metabolic health technology company founded by Sharam Fouladgar-Mercer and Bill Tancer that pairs a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) sensor with an AI-powered mobile app to help people understand their individual metabolic responses to food and make data-driven lifestyle changes for weight management. In August 2025 Signos received FDA clearance as the first over-the-counter glucose monitoring system for weight loss, making it available without a prescription to adults not on insulin. The platform integrates with the Dexcom Stelo sensor, Apple Health, Google Health Connect, smartwatches and smart scales, delivers real-time glucose insights, personalized meal and movement recommendations, registered-dietitian support, and daily and weekly metabolism scores, with optional GLP-1 medication access through partner healthcare providers. Signos was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Somnee
providers.description: Somnee is a consumer sleep-technology company behind a smart sleep headband that uses personalized neurostimulation to improve sleep. Developed over roughly eight years by a team of UC Berkeley neuroscientists (co-founders include sleep scientist Dr. Matthew Walker, Dr. Robert T. Knight, Dr. Rich Ivry, and CSTO Dr. Ram Gurumoorthy, with CEO Tim Rosa, former Fitbit CMO), the wearable pairs clinical-grade EEG+ sensors with a companion app and proprietary AI to deliver a 15-minute pre-bedtime session that the company says helps users fall asleep about 50% faster and cut nighttime wake-ups by roughly a third, without medication. Somnee sells the headband, accessories, and a sleep-service membership direct to consumers, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Somnee publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Songtrust
providers.description: Songtrust is a New York City-based music publishing administration platform and a Downtown Music company. The service helps songwriters, producers, composers, and independent publishers register their compositions and collect global publishing royalties — including performance, mechanical, digital, micro-sync, and neighboring rights — through a network of 65+ collection societies and pay sources across 240 countries and territories. Songtrust's web-based dashboard provides song registration, catalog management, writer and publisher splits, royalty statement matching, metadata enrichment, weekly song monitoring, and quarterly payouts, while letting clients retain 100% ownership of their copyrights. The commercial model is a one-time $100 sign-up fee per songwriter plus 15% of collected performance royalties and 20% of non-performance royalties — positioned as a transparent flat-rate alternative to traditional publisher deals. As of this profile, Songtrust does not expose a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or partner integration portal; the platform is consumed exclusively through the Songtrust client dashboard at app.songtrust.com. Integrations and data exchange with PROs, mechanical rights societies, DSPs, and Downtown sister companies are operated internally rather than through a documented public surface.

providers.name: Spoiler Alert
providers.description: Spoiler Alert is a Boston-based software company (a Techstars portfolio company) that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers manage and sell excess, short-dated, and obsolete inventory. Its purpose-built platform digitizes discounting and liquidation processes, matching surplus inventory with the right buyers at the right price through a secondary marketplace, with automated listing generation, dynamic pricing optimization, freight cost management, and performance analytics to recover margin and reduce food and product waste. The platform is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.spoileralert.com); no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: TaTiO
providers.description: TaTiO is a recruitment and candidate-assessment platform that replaces traditional resume-based screening with immersive, AI-driven virtual job simulations. Candidates perform real job tasks - a forklift pre-shift check, a customer service call - so employers see how they actually work rather than how they describe themselves, producing a prediction score, a skills snapshot, and a report drawn from roughly 150 data points per candidate. The platform aims to increase application and engagement rates, reduce hiring mismatches, and integrate with existing hiring tools (ATS) so candidate status syncs automatically. TaTiO is a Techstars-backed company; its public website runs on Wix and exposes a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access.

providers.name: Telephone and Data Systems
providers.description: Telephone and Data Systems (TDS) is a diversified telecommunications holding company providing broadband, video, and voice services across the United States through its subsidiary TDS Telecom, and wireless infrastructure through Array Digital Infrastructure (formerly U.S. Cellular). TDS serves customers in rural and suburban communities across 30 states, delivering fiber-based broadband and advanced connectivity solutions.

providers.name: The Helper Bees
providers.description: The Helper Bees is an Austin-based aging-in-place technology company that operates one connected platform linking benefits, in-home service providers, and support so older adults can safely age at home. Its products include Care Concierge human guidance, an Aging-in-Place Marketplace for OTC products and nonmedical services (home care, safety modifications, meals, transportation), the Helpful benefits card, digital invoicing and claims processing for home and facility care, and digital nurse eligibility assessments for long-term care insurance. The company runs one of the nation's largest networks of vetted in-home care agencies and sells to Long-Term Care Insurance, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid plan administrators. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The Helper Bees publishes member and provider applications (the api.thehelperbees.com app host, the myhomealign.com provider portal, and mobile apps) but does not currently expose a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: ThriveFantasy
providers.description: ThriveFantasy was a New York City daily fantasy sports platform focused on player-prop pick'em contests across NFL, NBA, MLB, esports, and other leagues, backed by Bullpen Capital. The company ceased operations in early 2024 after a failed funding round and a player-withdrawal crisis. It never published a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; its legacy marketing site remains online.

providers.name: TopKey
providers.description: TopKey is an AI-powered financial operating system purpose-built for professional short-term rental, vacation rental, and long-term rental property managers running 50-5,000+ units. It automates property-level and owner-level expense management, corporate and bring-your-own cards (BYOC), bill pay / AP, banking through partner banks (Thread Bank, Member FDIC), AI-assisted accounting, inventory, invoicing, work-order expense tracking, and revenue reconciliation. TopKey integrates deeply with property management systems (Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Streamline, Track, Hostfully) and accounting software (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite). Backed by a16z and Felicis. TopKey consumes partner APIs for its integrations but does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI at this time; it ships a product help center and a machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: Tourlane
providers.description: Tourlane (Tourlane GmbH) is a travel planning company that creates personalized, custom multi-day trip packages. Travelers are paired with English-speaking, native-European destination travel experts for one-on-one consultations, free initial trip planning, complete booking management, and dedicated support throughout their trip, across destinations such as Italy, Greece, Ireland, Spain, Scotland, and France. Tourlane is a portfolio company of HV Capital. Sector: consumer travel. Tourlane publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: TransDigm Group
providers.description: TransDigm Group is a leading global designer, producer, and supplier of highly engineered aerospace components, systems, and subsystems for use on nearly all commercial and military aircraft. The company operates 49 independent operating units producing proprietary, sole-source components including actuation systems, ignition systems, fuel systems, airframe and flight control components, cockpit security systems, seatbelts, airbags, pumps, valves, switches, and cockpit displays. TransDigm serves commercial airlines, defense OEMs, aerospace distributors, and the US Department of Defense.

providers.name: Trim
providers.description: Trim is a consumer fintech company founded in 2015 that built an automated personal finance assistant which finds and cancels unwanted subscriptions, negotiates bills such as cable and internet, and automates savings for its users. Trim was backed by Version One Ventures and was acquired by OneMain Financial; its former asktrim.com home now redirects to OneMain MyMoney (onemainmymoney.com), where the product lives on as a personalized money insights and expense tracking app. Trim/MyMoney is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: UBS Bank USA
providers.description: UBS Bank USA (BUSA) is a Utah state-chartered industrial bank and FDIC-insured depository institution headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, established in 2003 and reporting roughly $122 billion in total assets. It is the primary US banking vehicle of UBS Wealth Management Americas, providing FDIC-insured deposit sweep programs, securities-based lending, mortgages, and credit cards almost exclusively to the high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth advisory clients of parent UBS Group AG. It is supervised by the FDIC, the Utah Department of Financial Institutions, and the CFPB. Unlike a fintech or a Banking-as-a-Service provider, UBS Bank USA exposes no first-party public developer API surface of its own; its services are delivered through UBS Financial Advisors rather than self-serve APIs. The only live UBS developer portal (developer.ubs.com) belongs to UBS Switzerland and serves Swiss and EU products (key4 mortgages, QR-bill, PSD2, TWINT, bLink, KeyPort/EBICS), not this US entity. US consumer-permissioned data access, where available, is mediated by third-party aggregators rather than a documented BUSA API.

providers.name: Umony
providers.description: Umony is a London-based communications compliance platform, founded in 2017 and backed by Seedcamp, that captures, records, and archives employee voice calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and Microsoft Teams conversations at the telecom-network level for banks and other regulated financial institutions. Its platform spans the Umony App (BYOD softphone), Umony Mobile (eSIM carrier-level capture), and Umony Archive with AI risk scoring, and the company holds BSI-certified ISO 27001:2022, ISO 42001:2023, and ISO 22301:2019 certifications. Umony publishes no public developer API surface today.

providers.name: UNest
providers.description: UNest is a Los Angeles-based fintech app that helps parents and families save and invest for their children's futures through UTMA/UGMA custodial investment accounts, with brand rewards contributions, gifting, financial literacy content, and term life insurance offered through Ladder. UNest Advisers, LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, with brokerage through UNest Securities, LLC (FINRA/SIPC) and clearing through Apex Clearing. The company is a consumer mobile-app business and publishes no public developer API, though its site ships a real llms.txt. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Valerie Health
providers.description: Valerie Health is an AI-powered front office platform for independent healthcare provider groups, automating referral management, fax and document classification and data extraction, appointment scheduling, and growth analytics on top of existing EMR and practice management systems. Founded by Pete Shalek and Nitin Joshi and backed by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures with a $30M Series A, the company operates as a HIPAA Business Associate for its provider customers and publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center, but does not currently publish a developer portal or public API documentation.

providers.name: Vitrue Health
providers.description: Vitrue Health is a London-based, Techstars-backed digital health company providing an AI-powered musculoskeletal (MSK) and workplace ergonomics platform. Its VIDA product uses camera-based AI assessments to automate Display Screen Equipment (DSE) compliance, deliver personalized pain-management pathways, and give employers analytics through a VIDA Co-Pilot dashboard, reporting an average 34% reduction in MSK pain. The platform integrates with HR systems, learning management systems, and SSO/provisioning identity providers, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Weekend Health (Found)
providers.description: Weekend Health, Inc. (operating as Found / Found Health) is a consumer telehealth company offering personalized, science-based weight-loss care, including GLP-1 and other obesity medications, clinician oversight, coaching, and habit-change support delivered direct-to-consumer and through employer and health-plan channels. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile carries the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Workhint
providers.description: Workhint is a work orchestration platform that uses AI to configure workflows, roles, and operations from modular components, helping teams manage flexible and on-demand workforces. The platform spans sourcing and onboarding, a workflow engine, tasks and projects, shifts and field visits, delivery management, auto-invoicing, global payments and payout workflows, contract management, and 1099 compliance. Backed by 500 Global and Softeq. API access and custom integrations are offered on the Enterprise plan, but no public developer portal or API documentation is published.

providers.name: Acturis
providers.description: Acturis is a United Kingdom insurance software company founded in 2000 by David McDonald and Theo Duchen, operating the UK's leading multi-tenant SaaS platform for general insurance brokers, insurers and MGAs. The Acturis system covers commercial and personal lines broking, e-trade and digital distribution, policy administration, claims, document management, premium finance and accounting, and it builds and runs eight of the top ten UK insurer extranets. Acturis Group extends the platform into Germany, France and Canada (through the acquisitions of Power Broker and Brovada) and reports over 100,000 users across more than 40 countries. Its API posture is partner-gated and honestly not developer-facing: acturis.com markets an "API-enabled platform" and "API capabilities" but publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, and no self-serve onboarding. developer.acturis.com, developers.acturis.com, docs.acturis.com and api.acturis.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer and /integrations all return 404. Real integration happens through commercial agreements — insurer extranet and e-trade connections, the Polaris imarket digital-trading standards Acturis has traded on since 2005, and named bilateral work such as the Aviva claims Broker API launched in December 2024, which brokers enable through an Aviva Claims Service Manager or an Acturis Account Manager rather than through any public signup.

providers.name: America First Credit Union
providers.description: America First Credit Union is a federally chartered, NCUA-insured credit union headquartered in Riverdale, Utah, founded in 1939. With roughly $19 billion in assets, more than one million members, and about 124 branches across seven western states (Utah, Idaho, Oregon, New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, and California), it is one of the largest credit unions in the United States. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, America First operates no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. It provides no self-serve, publicly documented API surface; consumer-permissioned account data access is handled through third-party data aggregators and its core banking provider rather than a direct first-party API. No public FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented on its public website as of this bootstrap. This record is an honest identity profile with no fabricated API surface.

providers.name: Anker Innovations
providers.description: Anker Innovations is a global consumer-electronics company headquartered in Shenzhen, China, known for its Anker charging and power products, Soundcore audio, eufy smart-home and security devices, Nebula projectors, and Anker SOLIX portable power and solar storage. Through the Anker Open Platform (developer.anker.com) the company exposes a developer surface that lets partners integrate and control Anker devices from their own applications via API and SDK, gated behind an Open Platform login. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and is being enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: AppNeta
providers.description: AppNeta is a network performance monitoring (NPM) platform for the distributed, cloud-connected enterprise, now delivered as a Broadcom product under its IT Operations Management / Network Management portfolio. AppNeta Performance Manager continuously measures network paths, delivery quality, usage, and end-user application experience across SaaS, cloud, and internet paths using a combination of active (synthetic) and passive monitoring from distributed monitoring points. It exposes a RESTful API (v3 for AppNeta Classic and v4 for AppNeta with Intelligent Alarms) for programmatic access to monitoring policies, web paths, web applications, alarm connectors, and event/observer integrations, authenticated with API access tokens. As of February 2026 the API interface and documentation were upgraded from Swagger to OpenAPI 3.0. AppNeta was originally an independent, Battery Ventures-backed company before joining Broadcom.

providers.name: Capim
providers.description: Capim is a Sao Paulo-based vertical SaaS and fintech company for the dental sector in Brazil, founded in 2021 by Marcelo Lutz and Roberto Biselli. Its platform pairs dental-clinic management software - appointment scheduling (Agenda Capim), digital patient records, and AI-driven patient reactivation - with embedded financial products: buy-now-pay-later patient financing (Financiamento Capim, up to 36 installments), direct-credit collections (Carne Capim), and an integrated card/PIX payment terminal (Maquininha Capim). Capim serves more than 6,000 dental clinics, has issued over R$450 million in credit, and raised a US$26.7M Series A co-led by Valor Capital and QED Investors. No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Caremessage
providers.description: CareMessage is a healthcare technology non-profit that operates one of the largest patient engagement platforms serving low-income and underserved populations across the United States. Since 2013 the platform has reached more than 20 million patients and is used by roughly 1 in 7 federally qualified health centers plus 200+ free clinics. Its products include 1:1 direct messaging, appointment lifecycle messaging, population outreach, health coaching, closed-loop referrals, Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) workflows, and Wellness Copilot, an AI-backed diabetes-management automation. CareMessage does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference; access to the platform is through its web application and a login-gated help center. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched from CareMessage's public web surface.

providers.name: Collibra
providers.description: Collibra is a data intelligence company providing a cloud-based platform for data governance, cataloging, quality, lineage, and AI governance. The Collibra Data Intelligence Platform helps enterprises discover, understand, govern, and trust their data assets through automated lineage tracking, policy management, data observability, and collaborative stewardship. The Collibra developer ecosystem includes REST APIs, GraphQL Knowledge Graph API, workflow automation, and a broad library of source connectors.

providers.name: Concirrus
providers.description: Concirrus Ltd is a London-headquartered insurtech founded in 2012 that builds AI-driven underwriting software for the specialty and commercial insurance market — marine (hull, cargo, P&I), aviation, construction, property, and political violence and terrorism. Its platform (Quest, Marine One, the Underwriting Workbench, Exposure Management, Loss Run Intelligence, and an "Enterprise Model" universal submission-ingestion layer) ingests broker submissions, structures the risk data, scores behavioural risk, and returns rating and exposure decisions to carriers, MGAs and brokers — much of it aimed at the Lloyd's and London subscription market. Concirrus is a vendor to insurers rather than an insurer itself, so it touches quote and rating rather than bind, issue or FNOL. Its API posture is partner-gated: marketing describes "a modular, API first platform" and "seamless integration with London Market platforms", but as of 2026-07-25 there is no public developer portal, no published API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, no Postman collection, and no public GraphQL or webhook catalog. Every developer and docs hostname probed (developer./developers./docs./api. on both concirrus.com and concirrus.ai) does not resolve, and every on-site developer path returns 404. Integration is obtained through a commercial engagement or the partner ecosystem programme, not self-serve signup. No ACORD, AL3, NGDS or ACORD XML reference appears anywhere on the public site.
