Concirrus does publish a real compliance posture: in August 2025 it announced ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management), ISO/IEC 27001 (information security) and SOC 2 certification, claiming to be the first insurtech to hold all three — though no trust center or downloadable report accompanies the announcement.

providers.name: Delek US Holdings
providers.description: Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK) is a diversified downstream energy company headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt operations, renewable fuels, and convenience store retailing. Delek operates four refineries in Tyler and Big Spring (Texas), El Dorado (Arkansas), and Krotz Springs (Louisiana) with combined crude throughput capacity of roughly 302,000 barrels per day. Logistics assets are operated through Delek Logistics Partners (NYSE: DKL). The company provides investor relations and ESG reporting on its public website but does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Diligent
providers.description: Diligent Corporation is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software company best known for its board management portal (Diligent Boards / Boardbooks) and the broader Diligent One Platform, which unifies board management, enterprise risk, audit, compliance, entity management, and ESG. The board portal itself is a security-hardened product with no public developer API - it is integrated through SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning, and packaged connectors (Okta, Microsoft 365/Teams, Zoom, DocuSign). Diligent does, however, publish a real developer portal at developer.diligent.com covering the GRC side of the platform - the HighBond (Diligent One) REST API for audit/risk/compliance data, a GraphQL Entities API for legal-entity and subsidiary management, an ESG API for activity/usage data, and a Workflow API for jobs, tasks, and campaigns. API access is customer/partner-gated (a HighBond API key or SSO-scoped token is required) and pricing is quote-based via Diligent sales.

providers.name: Ello
providers.description: Ello is a public-benefit AI education company building a 1:1 AI reading and math tutor for children ages 4-9. Its consumer app pairs proprietary child-speech recognition (trained on 100K+ hours of kids' audio) with generative AI and adaptive teaching agents to deliver personalized, sub-second, voice-based reading instruction grounded in the Science of Reading, plus a large catalog of leveled e-books, a "Storytime" create-your-own story feature, and parent progress reports. Recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions of 2024 and backed by Y Combinator, Goodwater, Project A, and Homebrew, Ello is a consumer (B2C) product with no public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Endowus
providers.description: Endowus is a Singapore- and Hong Kong-based digital wealth management platform founded in 2017 by Gregory Van and Samuel Rhee. It gives retail, accredited, and private-wealth clients access to low-fee institutional share-class funds, advised and self-directed portfolios, and private-market and alternatives strategies across Cash, CPF (Central Provident Fund), and SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) accounts. Its conflict-free model rebates 100% of trailer fees and fund-manager commissions to clients. Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (CMS License 101051), serves 300,000+ clients, and manages over US$10 billion in assets. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company operates consumer apps but publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Ennoble Care
providers.description: Ennoble Care is a physician-led home-based healthcare provider delivering primary care, palliative care, and hospice care to seniors in the comfort of their own homes. Founded to bring the doctor back to the housecall, the company offers in-home primary care and chronic disease management, post-acute care transitions, advance care planning, bereavement services, and respite care across 13 states and Washington, DC (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia). Ennoble Care is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile has been enriched by the API Evangelist network; Ennoble Care is a healthcare-services company and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Enzo Biochem
providers.description: Enzo Biochem, Inc. (operating as Enzo Life Sciences) is a life sciences company specializing in labeling and detection technologies for biomedical research and drug development. Trading under the tagline "Scientists Enabling Scientists," Enzo develops and manufactures research reagents and assays including AMPIVIEW RNA probes for in-situ hybridization and FISH, antibodies, ELISA immunoassays, immunohistochemistry (IHC) products, and CELLESTIAL cell-based assays. Its biopharma arm provides drug discovery services, target identification and validation, assay development, in vitro toxicology, and GMP manufacturing. Products are sold through an online catalog and account portal at enzo.com rather than a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub company lead and enriched with the identity, website, and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.

providers.name: FIGS
providers.description: FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS) is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2013 by Heather Hasson and Trina Spear and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. FIGS designs and sells premium scrubwear and non-scrubwear offerings — lab coats, underscrubs, outerwear, footwear, compression socks, loungewear, and accessories — directly to healthcare professionals through its Shopify-based online store at wearfigs.com. FIGS is a consumer e-commerce and retail brand with a customer help center and investor-relations presence; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: heva
providers.description: heva is an AI-native healthcare and medical-tourism platform that connects patients with vetted medical practices, specialists, and providers across borders, with an initial focus on Spanish-speaking markets. The platform offers practice discovery by specialty and location, deposit-based online appointment booking, a conversational AI booking assistant (Heva AI), an online store for purchasing procedures and services, and secure payments via Stripe. Provider-facing tools cover practice management, patient acquisition, communications, and appointment coordination, delivered through the web and native iOS and Android provider apps. heva is a Techstars-backed company building "care without borders."

providers.name: Hoop
providers.description: Hoop is an AI retention agent for Shopify subscription brands, built by the founding team behind Trello and backed by Index Ventures. It plugs into a brand's helpdesk (Gorgias, Zendesk, or Kustomer), intercepts every subscription-cancellation ticket, and runs a tailored save conversation in the brand's voice: it asks why the subscriber wants to leave, then matches a retention offer (pause, plan swap, discount, or skip) to the stated reason and writes the accepted change back to the billing tool (Recharge or Skio) automatically. Hoop logs every cancellation reason, offer, and outcome so brands learn why subscribers churn, and lets teams A/B test save offers through plain-English policy changes rather than macros. It is an end-user SaaS application rather than an API provider — it consumes the Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Recharge, and Skio APIs and exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation of its own.

providers.name: Hyperpad
providers.description: Hyperpad (hyperPad) is a no-code, visual game development platform for iPad, often described as "HyperCard for iPad." Founded in 2013 and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2014), the London, Ontario company lets non-programmers build media-rich 2D games and interactive apps using a drag-and-drop, node-based behavior system with a built-in physics engine, particle effects, animation and audio tools, and a bundled asset library, then publish them to the Apple App Store as native apps while keeping 100% of royalties. Products include the paid hyperPad app, a free hyperPad Starter edition, and hyperPad Hub, a community arcade for playing games made with the platform. hyperPad is a consumer-facing creation tool and does not currently publish a public web API or developer platform.

providers.name: Invisible AI
providers.description: Invisible AI is a next-generation computer vision company delivering a Vision Execution System (VES) for manufacturing. NVIDIA Jetson-powered edge devices with Intel RealSense 3D depth cameras and on-device SSD storage mount to existing factory infrastructure and, within hours, encode and segment the production floor in real time. The no-code, edge-based platform captures 100% of production cycles across every station without wearables, operator disruption, or cloud integration, then analyzes human motion and objects to surface cycle-time variability, process drift, quality escapes, and safety/ergonomics risk. Founded in 2018 by autonomous-vehicle veterans and backed by Sierra Ventures, it serves automotive and aerospace OEMs including Toyota, Ford, General Motors, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Nissan. Invisible AI publishes no public API or developer platform today; this profile captures its company identity, security posture, and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jack in the Box
providers.description: Jack in the Box Inc. (NASDAQ: JACK), founded in 1951 and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a quick-service restaurant company operating and franchising approximately 2,200 Jack in the Box hamburger restaurants across 21 U.S. states. In December 2021 the company acquired Del Taco for $575M; in August 2025 it announced a strategic review of Del Taco and on October 2025 agreed to divest Del Taco (~600 locations) to Yadav Enterprises for $115M, with the transaction closing December 22, 2025. Digital channels include the Jack in the Box mobile app, Jack Pack loyalty program, online ordering, and integrations with third-party delivery platforms (DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats). The company does not publish a public developer API; all digital ordering, loyalty, and franchise systems are operated via internal platforms and partner integrations.

providers.name: KeyRunner
providers.description: KeyRunner is a local-first API platform combining a desktop API client, request monitor, mock server, and secret manager. It is delivered as desktop applications (Windows, macOS Intel, macOS Apple Silicon), a VS Code extension, and a CLI, with all requests and secrets kept inside the developer environment.

providers.name: Kheiron Medical Technologies
providers.description: Kheiron Medical Technologies is a London-founded medical-imaging AI company best known for Mia (Mammography Intelligent Assessment), a deep-learning solution that supports radiologists in breast-cancer screening as an independent, concurrent, or triage reader. Founded in 2016 and backed by investors including Atomico, Kheiron now operates as part of RadNet's DeepHealth, whose portfolio spans breast, prostate, lung, brain, and thyroid imaging plus the Diagnostic, Operations, and TechLive suites. This API Evangelist profile tracks Kheiron/DeepHealth as a health-AI provider; the company exposes clinical products and enterprise integrations rather than a public self-serve developer API, so most machine-readable API artifacts are not applicable and this record captures its identity, security, and legal surface.

providers.name: LabLabee
providers.description: LabLabee is an AI-powered enablement, testing and troubleshooting platform for telecom teams, positioning itself as "the Copilot for Telco Engineers." The platform delivers on-demand, hands-on labs, sandboxes, learning paths and skill tests covering 4G/5G and Open RAN, IMS, network OAM, SDN and IP networking, telco cloud (OpenStack, OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker), DevOps and GitOps automation (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD), Linux, IAM and cybersecurity, and Industry 4.0 and IoT. Three AI capabilities sit on top of the lab catalog: AI Ask (search across telecom standards, vendor documentation and enterprise knowledge), AI Test (automated test execution and configuration validation) and AI Troubleshoot (automated trace analysis and root-cause identification). LabLabee serves telcos, universities, system integrators, network vendors and industrial private-network operators. Founded by Samir Tahraoui (CEO) and Mahfoud S. A. Mebarek (CPO), the company is backed by Accel, Kima Ventures, Reach Capital, Brighteye Ventures and 500 Global, and has been recognized as Best Telecom Startup by the World Communication Awards and with the TM Forum Growth Challenge Award. As of this enrichment pass LabLabee publishes no public developer program - no API documentation, API reference, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI or public package artifacts were found on any of its surfaces.

providers.name: LDAP
providers.description: LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) is an industry-standard application protocol for accessing and maintaining distributed directory information services over an IP network, formally specified in RFC 4511. It plays a critical role in protecting organizational assets and maintaining a strong security posture through centralized authentication, authorization, and identity management. LDAP underlies directory services such as Microsoft Active Directory, OpenLDAP, and 389 Directory Server, and is widely used for single sign-on, enterprise address books, and application identity stores.

providers.name: Luko
providers.description: Luko is an online home, travel, and auto insurance provider founded in France in 2016 and now operating as Luko by Allianz Direct after its acquisition by the Allianz group. It sells rental, owner-occupied, non-occupant-owner (PNO), student, and co-housing home policies from around EUR 5 per month, plus travel and Eurofil-partnered auto cover, with sub-two-minute online subscription, instant attestations, digital claims declaration through a customer account portal, and 24/7 emergency support. Originally a VC-backed insurtech (Accel, Speedinvest), Luko today runs as a consumer insurance brand with no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable security and identity footprint.

providers.name: Machinations
providers.description: Machinations is a visual platform for designing, simulating, and balancing game economies, tokenomics, and other complex systems. Studios and designers model resource flows as interactive node-and-connection diagrams, run Monte-Carlo simulations to predict outcomes, and balance economies before a single line of production code is written. The product spans Design, Predict, and Balance modules plus an AI Builder that generates runnable diagrams from natural-language descriptions and a spreadsheet integration. It is used by studios such as Amazon Games, Hasbro, and Zynga and taught at MIT, NYU, and Berkeley. Machinations is a Seedcamp portfolio company; at the time of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Mimo
providers.description: Mimo (short for "Money In, Money Out") is a London- and Stockholm-based B2B fintech that gives small and medium-sized businesses a single platform to manage, understand and control their cash flow. Founded in 2023, Mimo bundles supplier payments, invoice collection, multi-currency accounts, access to working capital and automated bookkeeping, and has grown to offer an AI "Associate" that automates recurring accounting workflows such as financial close, bank reconciliation, accounts payable and payroll for finance teams and accounting firms. Mimo integrates with accounting tools such as Xero. It is backed by Northzone, Seedcamp, Cocoa Ventures, Project A and others, and has secured a $125M+ embedded-funding partnership with Froda. This profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network; Mimo currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Minu
providers.description: Minu is Mexico's leading employee benefits and financial wellness platform, serving more than 2,000 companies and over 1 million workers. Its flagship product is Salary On-Demand (earned wage access), which lets employees withdraw wages they have already earned before payday, alongside a high-yield savings account, low-interest payroll loans, food and gas vouchers (vales de despensa y gasolina), a rewards card, a corporate expense card, telemedicine, insurance and assistance coverage, a discount club, and a financial-education program. Employers adopt Minu to reduce talent turnover and improve workforce financial wellness. Minu is a QED Investors portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Minu publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: MYR
providers.description: MYR (formerly Koomi) is a cloud-based point-of-sale (POS) platform built for quick-service restaurants (QSRs) across North America, serving 1,500+ locations including coffee shops, food trucks, burger joints, pizzerias, sushi shops and bubble tea shops. The all-in-one system handles order processing across in-store, online-ordering and delivery channels, inventory management, digital loyalty programs, real-time reporting and hardware (iPads, payment terminals, receipt printers). MYR ships pre-built integrations with delivery marketplaces (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub, Skip, Ritual), accounting (QuickBooks Online, Wave, Sage, Acumatica), scheduling (7shifts), inventory (WISK) and loyalty/gift-card platforms (DataCandy). It does not publish a public developer program or API at this time; the merchant back office runs at admin.koomi.com.

providers.name: Natural Cycles
providers.description: Natural Cycles is a Swedish women's-health company behind the first birth-control application cleared by the US FDA (2018) and CE-marked in Europe as a Class IIb medical device. Its subscription app uses a proprietary temperature-based algorithm to identify fertile and non-fertile days from a user's daily basal body temperature, supporting both preventing and planning pregnancy as well as cycle, ovulation, and perimenopause tracking. Temperature is captured with a paired Bluetooth basal thermometer or through consumer wearables the app integrates with — Apple Watch, Oura Ring, and the NC B1 band. Natural Cycles publishes clinical research, an educational content library (CycleMatters), an e-commerce shop for thermometers and tests, and a public bug-bounty / responsible-disclosure program, but it does not expose a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. Backed by EQT Ventures.

providers.name: Netskope
providers.description: Netskope is a security service edge (SSE) and SASE platform delivering cloud-native Secure Web Gateway, CASB, Zero Trust Network Access, data loss prevention, and threat protection from its NewEdge global network. The Netskope REST API v2 provides tenant-level programmatic access to events, alerts, incidents, policies, IoCs, SCIM provisioning, and configuration so SOC and platform teams can automate SOAR, SIEM, and IGA workflows using service-account bearer tokens in the Netskope-Api-Token header.

providers.name: Nonnatech
providers.description: Nonnatech is a New York-based remote patient monitoring (RPM) and virtual health company that provides HIPAA-secured technology and clinical services for healthcare providers. Its platform integrates biometric sensors and passive home devices to deliver real-time analytics, chronic condition management, and population health programs across hospitals, health systems, physician practices, payers, ACOs, home care, long-term care, and senior living communities. Nonnatech offers turnkey device ordering, EHR data integration, and optional clinical monitoring, with no upfront costs to providers and roughly 30-day implementation. Nonnatech is a 500 Global portfolio company. It does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: On Deck
providers.description: On Deck (now operating as the On Deck Founder Fellowship, ODF) is a founder fellowship and startup community program that helps aspiring entrepreneurs start companies through an intense, in-person cohort experience focused on meeting co-founders, exploring ideas, and gaining conviction. Backed by Canaan Partners, On Deck provides mentorship, a peer community, and startup perks. It is a program and community platform rather than a developer or API product: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Ottonova
providers.description: Ottonova is a Munich-based digital private health insurance provider (private Krankenversicherung) founded in 2015, positioned as "the insurance for the mobile age." It sells private full health insurance and supplementary dental and hospital coverage to consumers in Germany, delivering onboarding, claims, a concierge medical service and digital health records through its mobile app rather than through a public developer API. Ottonova is backed by venture investors including Earlybird and HV Capital and operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-lead stub and has been through one enrichment pass: probing confirmed a consumer web presence with a published RFC 9116 security.txt but no public API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, OAuth/OpenID metadata, or API catalog).

providers.name: Prixtel
providers.description: Prixtel is a French mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) founded in 2004 by David Charles and headquartered in Aix-en-Provence. It is known for "forfaits flexibles" — mobile plans whose monthly price moves automatically between published tiers according to the data a subscriber actually consumed, with the ceiling known in advance — and it rides the SFR (historically also Orange) radio network rather than owning spectrum. Prixtel serves roughly 300,000 to 500,000 subscribers, reported about EUR 63.5M revenue in 2024, and was acquired by Altice France, the owner of SFR, in June 2021 for approximately EUR 415M while continuing to trade under its own brand; the Serena venture attribution that surfaced this profile is therefore a realized exit rather than a current holding. Prixtel publishes no public API, no developer portal, no SDK, no webhook catalog, and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its only first-party software distribution is an end-user iOS/Android app for consumption tracking, invoices and line management; api.prixtel.com is that app's private backend and returns HTTP 404 on every probed path, including its own root.

providers.name: RentSpree
providers.description: RentSpree is a Los Angeles-headquartered rental real estate technology platform that streamlines the long-tail rental transaction for real estate agents, landlords, property managers, and renters. Its consumer-facing product suite covers online rental applications, TransUnion-powered tenant screening (credit, background, eviction, and income verification), e-sign and lease workflows, ACH/card rent payments, AI-assisted listing pages and syndication, rent estimate, and renters insurance. RentSpree positions itself as the rental layer for the MLS and brokerage ecosystem and has built named integrations with Multiple Listing Services (Bright MLS, CRMLS, Beaches MLS, CJMLS, Florida Realtors) and PropTech partners (SkySlope, Lone Wolf, ZipLogix, C.A.R. OnlineEd). It also runs an Enterprise API Integration program for MLSs, associations, brokerages, and PropTech vendors that want to embed rental application intake and tenant screening into their own platforms — documentation is not publicly published; partners are onboarded through a sales/integration process with implementation quoted at as little as three weeks. There is no self-serve developer portal, no public OpenAPI specification, and no public SDK or CLI; the RentSpree GitHub org is effectively empty (only a .github org-defaults repo). RentSpree is SOC 2 Type II certified and reports more than four million agents, landlords, and renters on the platform.

providers.name: Ro
providers.description: Ro (ro.co) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company that connects patients with US-licensed healthcare providers entirely online, offering prescription treatment, provider visits, and pharmacy fulfillment across categories including men's and women's health, weight management (Ro Body), dermatology (Ro Derm), hair loss, fertility (Ro Fertility), and sexual health. Ro deliberately operates a "Zero-API" vertically integrated online-visit experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; its only public machine-readable surface is a security posture (RFC 9116 security.txt and a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure program). Ro is backed by Canaan Partners, General Catalyst, and Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Sidechat
providers.description: Sidechat is an anonymous, campus-based social networking app for college students, built by Flower Ave Inc in New York City and backed by Canaan Partners. Students verify with a school email to join their college's private, location- and campus-scoped community where they post text, images, and polls, vote, and chat anonymously in a Reddit-like feed. Sidechat launched in early 2022, acquired Yik Yak in 2023, and operates primarily as an iOS consumer app. It publishes no official public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; this profile captures the company's public web presence and identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Solv Health
providers.description: Solv Health operates a consumer marketplace (solvhealth.com and the Solv app) for booking same-day urgent care, primary care, and lab appointments, plus a provider-facing platform (scheduling, intake, patient acquisition, reputation management, messaging, payments) sold to clinics and health systems. There is no self-serve public developer API or published API reference on solvhealth.com; API access is gated behind a sales-led partnership. Solv states it exposes "interoperable APIs" that power custom booking experiences on partner websites and apps, a "Final Mile" API/network that lets digital-first and virtual-care partners (e.g. Included Health) hand patients off to real-time same-day appointment availability at Solv's national network of urgent care clinics, and bidirectional EHR interoperability (APIs, HL7, FHIR, and RPA) that syncs patient demographics, appointment status, and documents with systems like Epic, Athena, Cerner, Allscripts, DrChrono, eClinicalWorks, Experity, and NextGen. None of these capabilities have a published base URL, endpoint reference, or self-serve API key signup; access is provisioned per partner/clinic inside a commercial contract.

providers.name: Sondermind
providers.description: SonderMind is a Denver-based mental health company operating a measurement-based behavioral healthcare platform that connects people to licensed therapists and psychiatrists who have availability, accept insurance, and specialize in their needs. It offers virtual and in-person therapy and psychiatry across all 50 U.S. states, along with enterprise offerings for health systems, physician practices, payers, and Veterans. SonderMind is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer and clinician web platform (with a member/provider sign-in at api.sondermind.com) but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this repository tracks SonderMind's public web, content, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Southern Company
providers.description: Southern Company is an Atlanta-headquartered energy holding company and one of the largest producers of electricity in the United States, serving approximately 9 million electric and natural gas customers through Alabama Power, Georgia Power, Mississippi Power, Southern Power, Southern Company Gas (Atlanta Gas Light, Nicor Gas, Virginia Natural Gas, Chattanooga Gas), Southern Nuclear, PowerSecure, Southern Linc and Southern Telecom. It sits at the vertically-integrated regulated-utility layer of the value chain — it owns generation, transmission and distribution, operates its own balancing authority rather than belonging to an ISO/RTO, and runs a FERC-approved bid-based energy auction for wholesale power in the Southeast. Its API posture is honestly closed on both sides of the sector's two-speed split. There is no consumer data mandate in Alabama, Georgia or Mississippi and Southern Company does not implement Green Button Download My Data or Connect My Data, is not listed by the Green Button Alliance, and publishes no ESPI endpoint — a customer can only export their own interval data as a spreadsheet after logging into My Power Usage, and a third party gets billing history only through a signed paper release form. On the market side the FERC-required auction clearing prices and weighted-average hour-ahead transaction prices are posted as public web pages, but they are JavaScript-rendered HTML with no CSV, no feed and no API behind them. A production Apigee API gateway is live at api.southernco.com and developer.southernco.com resolves behind an Imperva edge, so the platform machinery exists internally, but no proxy, no specification and no documentation are published to anyone outside the company.

providers.name: Sphero
providers.description: Sphero designs programmable robots and STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts and math) learning tools for K-12 education. Its product line spans indi, Mini, Snap, BOLT+, littleBits, RVR+ and Blueprint robots, paired with standards-aligned curriculum (NGSS, CSTA, ISTE) delivered through Sphero Central. For developers and educators, Sphero publishes a public robot-control SDK (sdk.sphero.com) that programs Sphero RVR+ / RVR robots from development boards — Raspberry Pi, micro:bit and Arduino — using Python, Node.js/TypeScript and C++. Sphero exposes robot-control SDKs and a locally-run Node.js RESTful interface rather than a hosted public web API. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist as part of the APIs.io network.

providers.name: SuppCo
providers.description: SuppCo is a consumer supplement tracking and optimization platform, describing itself as the world's first real supplement tracker and optimizer. Its iOS and Android app lets people log their supplement stack and get a personalized StackScore across quality, dosing, goal coverage, and nutrient levels, plus a TrustScore that rates products on 29 attributes. It is backed by a database of 160,000+ products, 20,000+ research studies, and 80+ expert protocols from functional-medicine practitioners. SuppCo is in open beta (free, with an optional Pro tier) and was acquired by Function Health. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures its public web, security, and legal surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Theom
providers.description: Theom is a cloud Data & AI Operations Center that governs and secures enterprise data estates, providing automated data security, compliance, and safe generative-AI data activation across multi-cloud environments. Founded in December 2020 by former Cisco, Google, and Yahoo security practitioners (creators of Tetration Analytics), Theom detects active data breaches, maps real-time data lineage, analyzes identity-aware data usage and insider threats, and enforces data-usage policy agentlessly. Its product spans Theom Core (data security and lineage), Theom AI (GenAI leak prevention), and Theom Trust (real-time data contracts). Theom is backed by Wing Venture Capital, Ridge Ventures, Snowflake Ventures, Databricks Ventures, SentinelOne Ventures, and M12, and was named a Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave for Sensitive Data Discovery and Classification. Theom is delivered as an enterprise platform; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API docs.

providers.name: Track Titan
providers.description: Track Titan is a sim racing analytics and coaching platform that records in-game telemetry from simulators including iRacing, Assetto Corsa and ACC, the F1 series, Automobilista 2, Forza Motorsport, and Le Mans Ultimate, turning laps into time-loss analysis, AI coaching feedback, auto-installed esports car setups, and structured Academy learning content for a community of over 295,000 sim racers on PC and console. Founded by former professional sim racer and Porsche coach Max Teichert and backed by investors including Partech, Track Titan is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of July 2026 (api.tracktitan.io serves only an internal backend service).

providers.name: Triblio
providers.description: Triblio is an account-based marketing (ABM) platform now owned by Foundry, the marketing services and data unit of International Data Group (IDG). Originally founded in Reston, Virginia, Triblio was acquired by IDG/Foundry in June 2020 as the cornerstone of a multi-year strategy to combine first- party publisher data, third-party intent signals, and ABM advertising, web personalization, and sales acceleration into a single platform. The product combines account-based advertising, intent-driven audience segmentation, website personalization, and a Smart Score that ranks accounts using behavioral signals from first-party web visits, third-party intent providers (notably Bombora Company Surge and G2 intent), CRM data, and Foundry's own publisher network. Triblio integrates with major CRMs and marketing automation systems including Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SugarCRM, Marketo, Pardot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, and Slack. Foundry positions Triblio as the engine behind its broader Sales Acceleration and Foundry ABM offerings, with intent data feeds from Bombora ingested weekly and G2 intent ingested nightly. Triblio does not publish a public developer API portal, OpenAPI specification, or open-source SDKs; the GitHub organization at github.com/triblio was archived in January 2026 with no public repos. Customer integrations are delivered through pre-built CRM and MAP connectors, an Apps Marketplace, and platform-internal automation rather than a self-serve developer API. As of a 2026-08-12 probe the Triblio brand has no web surface of its own: triblio.com remains registered to MarkMonitor through 2027 but its Route 53 hosted zone has been deleted, so the marketing site, the app.triblio.com login, and the learning.triblio.com knowledge base all fail DNS resolution. The product now ships as "Foundry ABM, powered by Triblio" at foundryco.com, and the knowledge base has moved to learning.foundryco.com — a Cloudflare-fronted CNAME to triblio.zendesk.com. Foundry's sole developer portal covers the KickFire APIs, a different Foundry product, and is not attributed to Triblio.

providers.name: Zoog
providers.description: Zoog is a consumer mobile app platform that lets families create and share personalized video books and songs for children. Users read classic kids' stories or sing popular kids' songs while the app adds filters, effects, and music to produce custom animated videos that connect loved ones across distances. Founded in 2021 by Yoav Oren and Matan Guttman and backed by Techstars, Zoog is used by families worldwide. It is a consumer product with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: AllCare
providers.description: AllCare is a Philippines-based digital employee-benefits and healthcare membership platform for freelancers and small-to-medium enterprises. It aggregates worker benefits that individuals and small teams would otherwise struggle to access, bundling HMO coverage, group life insurance, 24/7 teleconsultation, dental and optical care, mental-health counseling, annual physical exams, and productivity perks into flat-rate membership packages. Its SME Benefits Package is sold on an annual per-employee basis (minimum five employees) and is managed through a web dashboard for enrollment, member management, and benefit utilization. AllCare is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare/insurtech company profile.

providers.name: Andesite
providers.description: Andesite is a cybersecurity company building a Human+AI Security Operations Center (SOC) platform that connects human analysts, AI agents, and security data to automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation, and response. Its Decision Fabric connects data silos and organizational context, while Evidentiary AI provides audit trails for every AI-driven action. Andesite deploys as SaaS or self-managed, carries FedRAMP High Authorization and SOC 2 Type II compliance, and is a General Catalyst portfolio company operating in the defense and government sector.

providers.name: AOne
providers.description: AOne is a Malaysia-based learning-centre management software company (operating publicly as AOneSchools) whose all-in-one platform is used by 4,000+ tuition centres, preschools, enrichment centres, sports academies, and language centres to automate billing, LHDN e-invoicing, attendance tracking, student and class management, and parent communication across connected web and mobile apps. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. The company's public surface today is a marketing website (aone.com.my) and a customer login/app at app.aoneschools.com; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface is currently published.

providers.name: API Stack
providers.description: API Stack is a free directory and discovery platform powered by Apideck that catalogs 213+ third-party API tools and services across 50+ categories including API gateways, management, design, authentication, developer portals, specifications, testing, security, monitoring, and marketplaces, helping developers discover and evaluate the right API tooling for their needs.

providers.name: Appify
providers.description: Appify is an enterprise application platform that lets organizations build, extend, and migrate line-of-business software without traditional development. The company markets a model-driven, AI-native platform — apps are described in natural language and the platform generates the data model, UI, permissions, workflows, and analytics — plus an "Unshackle" AI agent that extends systems of record such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle, or replicates an existing SaaS application on Appify-owned infrastructure. Appify states 40+ enterprise integrations, 12+ industries in production, and 20M+ transactions processed, and its published pricing includes "REST API access" and "unlimited apps, objects, endpoints" as standard capabilities. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification is published; the API surface sits behind the tenant login.

providers.name: Bending Spoons
providers.description: Bending Spoons S.p.A. is a Milan, Italy technology company founded in 2013 that acquires established digital products and operates them for the long term rather than reselling them. Its portfolio spans more than 50 acquisitions and includes AOL, Brightcove, Eventbrite, Evernote, Harvest, Issuu, komoot, Loomly, Meetup, Remini, Splice, StreamYard, Tractive, Vimeo and WeTransfer, serving over 500 million monthly active users and more than 9 million monthly paying customers. The company listed its ordinary shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker BSP on 1 July 2026. Bending Spoons itself publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at the holding-company level: every API surface in the group belongs to an individual acquired product, each profiled separately in the API Evangelist network. What the corporate entity does publish is a PGP-signed RFC 9116 security.txt, a compliance hub, a support center, an investor relations site, and a small set of first-party open-source Swift frameworks (Katana, Tempura).

providers.name: Brain Corp
providers.description: Brain Corp builds BrainOS, an autonomy platform that powers commercial service robots for floor care, inventory scanning, and remote site management across retail, warehouses, education, airports, malls, healthcare, and hospitality. The product portfolio includes the BrainOS Sense Suite, Clean Suite, ShelfOptix scanning-as-a-service, RFID localization, and remote site management tools. Brain Corp integrates with OEM partners and operators rather than offering a public developer portal, and does not publish open APIs.

providers.name: Cajal Technologies
providers.description: Cajal Technologies (Cajal) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (W26) company scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery. Its multi-agent system, Tau, collaborates to discover and verify new mathematical proofs in Lean, deploying AI mathematicians across high-impact applied domains starting with quantum computing and finance. Tau verifies compiled binaries with mathematical certainty down to the machine level. Cajal also partners with frontier AI labs and research institutes to improve their systems through datasets, evals, and RL environments, and open-sources tooling such as Talos, a Wasm interpreter written in Lean designed for reasoning.

providers.name: ClassWallet
providers.description: ClassWallet is a patented digital wallet and public-funds disbursement platform used by government agencies, school districts, and program administrators to distribute, control, and reconcile public money. Recipients access and spend allocated funds online or in-store while administrators get spending controls, approved marketplaces, reimbursement workflows, direct vendor payments (DirectPay), and audit-ready reporting and compliance. ClassWallet powers K-12 education programs, Education Savings Accounts (ESAs), scholarships and grants, government assistance, and vocational rehabilitation initiatives. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes product and program surfaces but no public developer API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Closinglock
providers.description: Closinglock is an Austin, Texas fintech and fraud-prevention company whose platform secures the money movement and identity checks inside a residential real estate closing. Title companies, real estate attorneys, agents, underwriters and their buyers and sellers use it to share wire instructions over an authenticated channel instead of email, verify identity and bank-account ownership before funds move, collect and disburse funds through SecurePay digital payments, retrieve and verify mortgage payoff statements, manage and e-sign closing documents, run two-way text messaging with the parties to a file, and evidence FinCEN and ALTA Best Practices obligations. The company announced SOC 2 Type II certification in August 2023 and raised a $34M Series B led by Sageview Capital in January 2025. Closinglock ships integrations into the major title production systems — SoftPro, RamQuest and ResWare — plus a DocuSign e-signature partnership, but those integrations are built bilaterally with each vendor: as of this profile Closinglock publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Codeium
providers.description: Codeium has been rebranded as Windsurf. The codeium.com URL now redirects to windsurf.com. The legacy Codeium product offered AI-powered code completion, search, and chat across IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains, Vim, Emacs, etc.). Codeium for Enterprise lives on as the enterprise / self-host SKU within Windsurf, alongside the Windsurf Editor and Plugins.

providers.name: DeHaat
providers.description: DeHaat (Green Agrevolution Private Limited) is one of India's largest full-stack agritech platforms, connecting smallholder farmers from "seed to market" through a phygital network of 11,000+ DeHaat Centres and 503 Farmer Producer Organisations across 12+ agrarian states. Founded in 2012 by IIT/IIM alumni, the platform serves 1.8 million+ farmers with agri-inputs (seeds, fertilizers, crop protection), AI-enabled crop advisory in multiple regional languages for 30+ crops, soil analysis, crop-health monitoring, market linkage for harvested produce, and agri-financing. Backed by Prosus Ventures and others, DeHaat operates a franchisee micro-entrepreneur model that raises farmer net incomes 30-50% while making procurement more predictable for buyers. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; the company publishes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, corporate link-properties, and security posture.

providers.name: eGifter
providers.description: eGifter is a digital gift card platform that allows people to easily send and receive gift cards for a wide variety of retailers and brands. Users can choose from hundreds of options including popular stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Whether it's for a birthday, holiday, or just to show appreciation, eGifter makes it simple to find the perfect gift for any occasion.

providers.name: Emeritus
providers.description: Emeritus is a global online education company that partners with more than 80 premier universities — including Wharton, MIT, Columbia, Harvard, Kellogg, and UC Berkeley — to deliver outcome-based executive education, professional certificates, and skill-development programs to over 500,000 learners worldwide. It operates across individual learners, enterprise/corporate training, and university-branded partnership programs, spanning topics such as AI and machine learning, data science, finance, leadership, and digital transformation through instructor-led online and blended formats. Emeritus is backed by Accel and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Emeritus publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Factris
providers.description: Factris is a European fintech that provides invoice financing (factoring) for small and medium-sized enterprises, converting unpaid B2B invoices into working capital within 24 hours. Its services span invoice financing, debtor management and collections, credit insurance, and credit-risk assessment, delivered through the self-service FAB platform where customers upload invoices and track payments. Factris operates across the Netherlands, Lithuania, and other European markets and has financed over two billion euros in receivables. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is being enriched in the API Evangelist network; Factris publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Fetch
providers.description: Fetch (formerly Fetch Rewards) is a consumer rewards and loyalty platform that lets shoppers earn points by scanning receipts and shopping at more than 600 partner brands in-store and online, playing mobile games, and redeeming offers, then exchange those points for gift cards to retailers such as Amazon, Target, and Uber. Its Fetch for Business arm turns verified purchase data into full-funnel brand engagement, consumer spending insights, and campaign tooling (including the Fetch Ad Manager) for CPG, retail, restaurant, and agency partners. Fetch is a private, venture-backed company; it operates a consumer mobile app plus a Chrome extension and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: First American Financial
providers.description: First American Financial is a leading provider of title insurance, settlement services, and risk solutions for real estate transactions, as well as related products and services. First American operates a developer portal exposing APIs for office lookup, order management, document exchange, messaging, and webhook notifications.

providers.name: Forus (fka Tandem Health)
providers.description: Forus (formerly Tandem Health) is a US healthcare technology company building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to bring new therapies to patients. Its platform automates the medication-access workflow end to end: prior authorization submissions, appeal-letter generation, insurance enrollment forms, benefit verification, pharmacy routing, patient status communication, PA renewal tracking, and affordability-program enrollment. It integrates with major EHRs so prescribers can submit directly, covers any drug/plan/pharmacy across all 50 states, and is HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. The company publishes an engineering blog at build.forus.com but does not currently expose a public developer API. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: Galileo
providers.description: Galileo (galileo.io, formerly reached at galileohealth.com) is a value-based, digitally enabled healthcare delivery company founded by Tom X. Lee (previously Epocrates and One Medical). It delivers 24/7 primary and multi-specialty care through a mobile app, in-home visits, mobile clinics, and virtual care, combining a proprietary clinical technology platform, a recruited network of primary-care and specialist clinicians, and hospitality-style member support. Galileo operates a fully bilingual (English/Spanish) platform and serves individuals and families, employers, small businesses, and health plans through membership and population- health partnerships. It is a care-delivery business, not an API platform: as of this profile Galileo publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Good Dog
providers.description: Good Dog is a marketplace that connects people looking for a dog with a vetted national network of ethical breeders, animal shelters, and rescues. The platform screens every source against standards developed with veterinary experts, requires all payments to be processed securely on-platform to protect both buyers and sellers, and supports new owners with a Learning Center, lifetime access to Care Specialists, puppy training resources, and pet insurance options. Over 250,000 families have found their dog through Good Dog. It is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this profile no public developer API, SDK, or integration program is published. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Icon Source
providers.description: Icon Source is a Denver, Colorado marketplace that connects brands, marketing agencies and universities with professional and college athletes for endorsement, appearance, speaking and social-media deals, including Name, Image and Likeness (NIL) engagements. Founded in 2018 by Chase Garrett, the platform lets brands search and filter verified athletes by location, interest, rate, audience size and demographics, build and send contracts, and pay athletes in-platform, charging a 10% transaction fee on each deal that is signed and closed. A companion product, Icon Suite (launched March 2022), gives universities NIL disclosure and compliance tooling. Icon Source is delivered strictly as an end-user product — a web application at prod.iconsource.app plus iOS and Android apps — and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Inductive Bio
providers.description: Inductive Bio is an AI-powered virtual lab for small molecule drug discovery, based in New York and founded in 2022 by Josh Haimson and Ben Birnbaum (both formerly of Flatiron Health). The company pairs medicinal chemists with machine learning to run millions of in silico ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, Toxicity) experiments, surface the strongest compound hypotheses, and accelerate the path to development candidates. Its Beacon-1 models took first place in both the 2025 Polaris/ASAP and 2026 OpenADMET/ExpansionRx blind ADMET competitions, and are delivered through the Compass software platform (with the Indy AI chemistry assistant) and an Embedded Experts services offering. Inductive Bio operates a pre-competitive ADMET data consortium, is SOC 2 compliant, and is backed by a16z, Lux Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Obvious Ventures, Character, and S32. Compass is enterprise/partner software; it exposes an API to partner teams but publishes no public, self-serve developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: Infini-AI (无问芯穹)
providers.description: Infini-AI (无问芯穹 / Infinigence AI) is a Chinese AGI compute and model-service platform, backed by Qiming, that helps teams optimize model development, fine-tuning, and inference across heterogeneous compute. Its GenStudio large-model service (MaaS) exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API over a broad catalog of open- and closed-source models (LLM chat/completions plus image and video generation), with LoRA/SFT fine-tuning and multi-LoRA deployment. The platform also offers a fully managed ComfyUI workflow-hosting service (with a WebSocket API) and an Agent Service Platform for building and deploying agent applications and skills. Developers authenticate with a tenant-managed API Key sent as a Bearer token; tenant/IAM, usage analytics, rate limits, billing, and error-code references are documented at docs.infini-ai.com and the cloud console.

providers.name: JPA
providers.description: Jakarta Persistence (formerly Java Persistence API / JPA) defines a Java specification and binding layer for the management of persistence and object-relational mapping in Java environments. It provides a standardized ORM framework that enables developers to map Java objects to database tables and interact with relational data using Java rather than SQL. Jakarta Persistence 3.2 is the current stable release with Jakarta EE 11, while version 4.0 is under development for Jakarta EE 12.

providers.name: JSF
providers.description: Jakarta Faces (formerly JavaServer Faces / JSF) is an MVC framework for building component-based user interfaces for Java web applications. It simplifies the development of web UIs through a component-driven approach with managed beans, an event-driven programming model, page navigation, state management, input validation, and built-in support for internationalization and accessibility. Jakarta Faces 4.1 is the current stable release with Jakarta EE 11, with 5.0 in development for Jakarta EE 12.

providers.name: JSON Binding
providers.description: Jakarta JSON Binding (JSON-B) defines a standard binding layer for converting Java objects to and from JSON documents. It specifies a default mapping algorithm for serializing and deserializing existing Java classes to and from JSON, while enabling developers to customize the mapping process through a Java API. JSON-B 3.0 is the stable release shipped with Jakarta EE 10, with version 3.1 under development for Jakarta EE 12.

providers.name: Linguatrip
providers.description: Linguatrip is a language-education and language-travel company founded in 2014 and backed by 500 Global. It operates two connected businesses: a booking marketplace for accredited language schools abroad — covering course selection, accommodation, airport transfers and visa support across countries including the United Kingdom, Malta and the United Arab Emirates — and its own online English school offering 25+ self-paced courses, one-to-one tutoring, speaking clubs and exam preparation for IELTS, TOEFL, GMAT, GRE and SAT. It also provides higher-education placement consulting for US, UK and Canadian universities. Linguatrip publishes no public API, developer portal or SDKs; its surfaces are consumer web properties in four languages with pricing in 18 currencies.

providers.name: Loft
providers.description: Loft is a Brazilian real estate technology (proptech) company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Sao Paulo. It operates a marketplace for buying, selling, and renting residential property alongside a broad platform of software and financial services for the real estate sector, including a CRM and property-management tools for agencies, digital proposals and e-signatures, lead generation, rental administration, and fintech products such as rental guarantees (Fianca Aluguel), home financing, credit with property collateral, and residential and commercial insurance. Backed by a16z, QED Investors, Fifth Wall, D1 Capital, Thrive Capital, and Baillie Gifford, Loft is a market leader in Brazil's real estate fintech space. Loft does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization (loft-br) hosts internal engineering and data-science tooling.

providers.name: MindMeld *
providers.description: MindMeld is an open-source conversational-AI platform for building deep-domain voice interfaces and chatbots, originally developed by the GV-backed startup MindMeld (formerly Expect Labs), acquired by Cisco in 2017 and open-sourced in 2019. Distributed as the `mindmeld` Python framework (Apache-2.0), it provides tooling for every step of a modern conversational workflow — domain and intent classification, entity recognition and resolution, and dialogue management — along with reusable application Blueprints for use cases such as food ordering, video discovery, and home-assistant experiences. MindMeld powers the Webex Assistant and other Cisco conversational products.

providers.name: Nitra
providers.description: Nitra is an integrated financial and operational platform — an "operating system" — for independent medical practices, unifying business banking, spend management, payments, accounting, capital, and front-desk automation in one system. Its core products include the Nitra Card (a Visa business card with cashback and vendor pricing), NitraMart (a medical-supplies marketplace), BillPay payment processing, accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Nextech), Trina (an AI assistant for phone reception and invoice matching), and capital products such as lending, equipment financing, and insurance factoring. Nitra primarily serves eye care, aesthetics, dental specialty, and fertility practices as well as multi-site groups. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA-aware, holds funds at FDIC-insured banks, and is backed by a16z and Pantera Capital. Nitra publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nova Benefits
providers.description: Nova Benefits is an India-based employee health and benefits platform that provides group health insurance, super top-up plans, and COVID-19 cover alongside wellness services such as telehealth consultations, mental-wellness support, fitness programs, maternity benefits, and annual health, dental and vision checkups. It gives HR teams an employer dashboard for administering benefits and managing claims, and gives employees web and mobile (iOS/Android) apps to view coverage, book consultations, and file and track claims. The company reports serving 500+ companies covering 200,000+ employees, is ISO 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II compliant, and operates as an IRDAI-regulated insurance broker. Nova Benefits publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: OneHealthCompany
providers.description: The One Health Company is a Palo Alto veterinary precision-oncology company, best known for its FidoCure platform, that brings human-grade precision cancer medicine to dogs. FidoCure sequences a dog's tumor with next-generation DNA sequencing, matches the cancer-driving mutations to targeted therapies, and gives veterinarians an individualized treatment plan grounded in the world's largest proprietary canine cancer dataset (billions of data points across a network of more than 1,300 veterinary clinics). The company was founded in 2015 by Christina Lopes and Ben Lewis on the "One Health" thesis that treating cancer in companion dogs also advances real-world evidence for human oncology. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z bio), Y Combinator, Polaris Partners, Borealis Ventures, Lerer Hippeau and Tau Ventures. As of this profile the company exposes a consumer and veterinarian web experience (including a veterinarian login portal) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: ORAS
providers.description: ORAS (OCI Registry As Storage) is a CNCF project that provides a CLI and a set of client libraries for pushing and pulling arbitrary OCI artifacts to and from OCI-compliant registries, allowing container registries to be used as a generic artifact distribution mechanism.

providers.name: PlanetSpark
providers.description: PlanetSpark is an Indian education-technology company headquartered in Gurugram, founded in 2017 by Kunal Malik and Maneesh Dhooper, that delivers live 1:1 online classes in public speaking, spoken English, creative writing, grammar, debating and vlogging to K-8 learners, along with mental and Vedic mathematics, abacus and school-excellence programmes, plus communication courses for working professionals. It sells directly to parents and learners through www.planetspark.in as a consumer subscription; it operates no public developer programme, publishes no API documentation or machine-readable contract, and its only external integration surface is an affiliate registration programme.

providers.name: PlotAPI
providers.description: Automotive and property data API. The published surface covers US VIN histories and vehicle specifications, UK MOT records, auto parts fitment catalogues, vehicle valuations, and property listings for the UK and US markets, served as typed JSON over a single REST endpoint. Positioned for AI agents and for developers who would otherwise integrate several gated data sources separately. The product is real and live; what is not public is the interface — documentation, the API reference and key issuance all sit behind an account sign-in, and the machine-readable artifacts the site advertises are not currently served.

providers.name: Qolab
providers.description: Qolab, Inc. is a superconducting quantum computing hardware company founded in 2022, with offices in Los Angeles, California and research laboratories in Madison, Wisconsin. Co-founded by 2025 Nobel laureate in physics John Martinis and Alan Ho — both of whom led hardware and product for Google's 2019 quantum supremacy milestone — Qolab builds high-coherence superconducting qubits by applying advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes to qubit fabrication, targeting the yield and integration problems that stand between quantum research and utility-scale machines. Its first deployable offering is Qolab Start, a turn-key superconducting QPU platform for pulse-level and device-level hardware research, sold to university labs, national laboratories and semiconductor R&D teams and delivered either on-premise or through secure cloud connectivity. Qolab has raised roughly $70M across a $16M Series A and a $54.2M Series B led by UC Investments, with strategic investment from Applied Ventures and Western Digital, and leads hardware development for DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. Qolab publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no machine-readable API contract and no self-serve sign-up, and the API and control interface guides that ship with Qolab Start are released to customers after a Request Access review.

providers.name: RACE Protocol
providers.description: RACE Protocol is a multi-chain, on-chain infrastructure for developing and deploying secure and fair web3 games. It is delivered primarily through a TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (sdk-core, sdk-solana, sdk-sui, sdk-facade) and a command-line tool (race-cli) for game bundle publishing, account management, and payment claims, rather than as a traditional REST API. Smart contracts run on Solana and Sui.

providers.name: RACE RESULT
providers.description: The RACE RESULT REST interface allows retrieval of data from systems uploading to RACE RESULT servers, including RACE RESULT decoders that upload via TCP and Track Boxes, and supports remote control commands sent to decoders. Communication with the REST API requires API keys for the Customer ID being accessed.

providers.name: Reedsy
providers.description: Reedsy is a marketplace and toolset for authors and publishers, connecting writers with a curated network of more than 3,700 vetted publishing professionals including editors, book designers, marketers, ghostwriters, web designers, and translators. Beyond the marketplace, Reedsy offers Reedsy Studio (a free writing and book-formatting application), Reedsy Learning (courses and events), Reedsy Discovery (book reviews), and Reedsy Prompts (weekly writing prompts). It supports authors across the full self-publishing journey from manuscript development through market launch. Reedsy is backed by Seedcamp and publishes no public developer API today.

providers.name: Rex Inc
providers.description: Rex Inc, operating as Rex.fit (BabylonAI Inc.), is a Y Combinator (W23) health and fitness company building AI-powered, fully automated nutrition tracking. Its consumer products include Rex Nutribot, a WhatsApp AI nutrition coach; the Drop, a wearable AI camera pendant that detects meals and automatically logs calories, protein, carbs, and fats via computer vision; an AI body scanner; and personalized coaching with daily health reports. Rex also offers a white-label B2B nutrition-and-fitness AI that fitness chains and app builders integrate to add meal logging (photo, barcode, or text), recipe and meal-plan generation, workout logging, 3D body scans, and nutrition analytics under their own brand.

providers.name: Safely
providers.description: Safely (SafelyStay, Inc.) is an InsurTech company providing short-term rental insurance, guest screening, and travel insurance for vacation rental property managers and their guests. The Safely Protection Policy offers up to $1,000,000 in short-term rental insurance covering guest-caused accidental and intentional damage, theft, pet damage, and bodily injury liability, while its guest screening verifies guests before check-in. Safely connects to property management systems through turnkey partner integrations (Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Track, Streamline, Escapia, Lodgify, and more) rather than a public developer API. A Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network; this profile was enriched by the pipeline, which found no public API surface.

providers.name: Science
providers.description: Science Corporation is a clinical-stage medical technology company founded in 2021 by Max Hodak and headquartered in Alameda, California, with offices in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina and Paris, France. Science develops brain-computer interface (BCI) and neural-engineering technologies to restore vision, cognition, and mobility, including the PRIMA retinal implant for patients with macular degeneration, the Biohybrid neural interface, and the Vessel perfusion platform. Through its Foundry division Science also offers MEMS production and neural-engineering services to external partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Science publishes no public web API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Skip
providers.description: Skip (originally Skip Protocol, skip.money) is the interchain infrastructure company that rebranded to Cosmos Labs and is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Interchain Foundation, leading engineering and growth for the Cosmos blockchain stack. Its skip.money and skip.build domains now redirect to cosmos.network. The team maintains the open-source Cosmos SDK, the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol (IBC), the CometBFT consensus engine, and Cosmos EVM — the most widely adopted Layer 1 blockchain toolkit, deployed across 200+ chains. There is no independent Skip-branded hosted API; the public developer surface is the Cosmos SDK node REST + gRPC interfaces documented at docs.cosmos.network, with source on the cosmos GitHub organization.

providers.name: Sofía
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican health insurance company (aseguradora) offering medical coverage for individuals, families, and businesses, delivered primarily through a mobile app with plans that carry no deductibles. Regulated in Mexico by the CNSF, Secretaría de Salud, and CONDUSEF, and backed by Index Ventures. This is a consumer/enterprise insurance provider surfaced as a portfolio-company lead; a live probe of the public surface found no developer program, API, or /.well-known/ discovery documents, so this profile remains identity-only pending any future API exposure.

providers.name: Sonar Mental Health
providers.description: Sonar Mental Health provides 24/7 text-based wellbeing coaching and care navigation for youth. Trained Wellbeing Coaches lead the conversations, supported by AI tooling that surfaces context and flags risk without making independent decisions, delivering between-visit and after-hours support, escalation and care coordination to higher levels of care, and real-time insights dashboards for measurement-based care across schools, health systems, primary care, and EAP pathways. The company reports serving 20,000+ young people with higher engagement between visits, and is backed by 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture (SOC 2, HIPAA), and public web properties.

providers.name: Upkid
providers.description: Upkid is a childcare staffing marketplace that connects early childhood programs such as daycares and preschools with qualified, pre-vetted substitute and full-time teachers. Programs post shifts and roles while educators find flexible teaching opportunities through the Upkid web and mobile apps, with an ATS-style Hiring Hub for full-time childcare hiring. Upkid operates across metro areas in Georgia, Utah, and Arizona and is a Techstars portfolio company. Upkid publishes no public API or developer portal; its web app is a client of a Firebase backend.

providers.name: Vinted
providers.description: Vinted is a European consumer-to-consumer (C2C) online marketplace for buying and selling secondhand clothes, shoes, accessories, and other lifestyle items, operating across web and mobile apps in dozens of markets. Founded in Vilnius, Lithuania, it is one of Europe's largest secondhand fashion platforms and is backed by Accel, Insight Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Vinted does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public identity, legal, and security (security.txt / domain-security) surfaces.

providers.name: Wag!
providers.description: Wag! is a US pet-care marketplace that connects dog and pet owners with local, background-checked caregivers for on-demand and scheduled dog walking, drop-in visits, pet sitting, boarding, daycare, and 24/7 vet chat. Operating across 5,300+ cities in all 50 states, the platform has completed more than 16 million services and is delivered primarily through its iOS and Android consumer apps. Wag! (Wag Labs, Inc.) is backed by Battery Ventures, Bullpen Capital, and General Catalyst. As of July 2026 Wag! exposes no public developer API or documented partner API; its production API hosts (prod-*-api.wagwalking.com) are internal mobile-app backends. This profile captures the company's public security and identity surface pending any future developer program.

providers.name: Wholesail
providers.description: Wholesail is an all-in-one accounts receivable and B2B payments platform for food & beverage wholesalers, distributors, and service vendors. It helps vendors onboard customers, manage credit risk, automate collections, accept ACH and card payments, and drive autopay — all connected to the vendor's ERP or accounting system. Wholesail is a fintech company backed by Foundry Group. As of enrichment it publishes no public developer API; it integrates with ERP systems using their native API protocols, scheduled file exchange, and robotic process automation, and it partners with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, JP Morgan, and SVB for payment processing. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: XSquare
providers.description: XSquare (listed as XSquire in the 500 Global portfolio) is a Dubai-based B2B financial operations platform for the GCC, live across the UAE and Qatar. It unifies e-invoicing, receivables collection via embedded payment links and QR codes (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank), supplier payables on corporate card, and automatic invoice-to-payment reconciliation on a single ledger, with native ERP integrations (Zoho, Xero, Wafeq, Odoo) and a PSP network (Tess, Telr, Geidea). PCI DSS Level 1 v4 certified, UAE FTA e-invoicing ready (PEPPOL, structured XML), and non-custodial by design through licensed PSP partners regulated by CBUAE and QCB. Founded in 2023 by Tanvir Shah and Ashwin Shenoy; operates as XSquare Payment Services LLC (Dubai) and XSquare LLC (Doha). No public developer API, docs, or SDKs are published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Zscaler
providers.description: Zscaler is a cloud security platform delivering Zero Trust Exchange services including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). Zscaler exposes REST APIs across its product suite for configuration, policy management, and reporting, authenticated via API keys, OAuth 2.0, or session-based authentication depending on the product and cloud (zsapi).

providers.name: A24
providers.description: A24 is an American independent entertainment company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City that produces, finances, and distributes films and television, including award winners such as Everything Everywhere All at Once, Moonlight, and Hereditary. Beyond production, A24 runs a direct-to-consumer business spanning a merchandise shop, the AAA24 membership program, editorial "Notes," podcasts, and a mobile app. A24 is a portfolio company of Thrive Capital. A24 does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Acme Markets
providers.description: Acme Markets is a regional supermarket chain founded in 1891 and headquartered in the U.S. Northeast, operating approximately 164 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, New York, Connecticut, and Maryland. Acme is a banner of Albertsons Companies, Inc., one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. The brand has no publicly documented developer program or public API: digital surfaces (store locator, loyalty program "ACME for U", FreshPass subscription, DriveUp & Go, delivery, pharmacy) are delivered through Albertsons-shared web and mobile platforms. The Android package ID (`com.safeway.client.android.acme`) confirms that the Acme app is built on the shared Safeway/Albertsons banner application, suggesting a shared backend API surface across Albertsons banners that is not externally published.

providers.name: ACV Auctions
providers.description: ACV Auctions is a digital wholesale marketplace for the automotive industry, operating the leading online platform for dealer-to-dealer used-vehicle auctions across the United States. Franchise and independent dealers source and sell inventory through daily online auctions backed by third-party vehicle inspections, detailed condition reports, and the company's data and analytics products. ACV also offers complementary services including vehicle transportation, dealer floor-plan financing through ACV Capital, and inventory-management and pricing tools. The company is publicly traded and headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Agile Loop L.L.C.
providers.description: Agile Loop L.L.C. is a London-founded enterprise AI company (founded 2023, backed by 500 Global) building Large Action Models — action-first foundation models trained on thousands of software interfaces so AI agents can operate any user interface and execute multi-step workflows end-to-end from natural-language instructions. Its product suite spans Sector Fusion (telecom network analytics), an Intelligent Evaluation Platform (AI scoring and fraud detection), LLM Ops (governance for LLM applications), an Aviation Ops Suite, and SAM-X (natural-language Excel automation), alongside the open-source Synapse Copilot toolkit for connecting LLMs to APIs and an embeddable Copilot widget for SaaS products. Agile Loop publishes no public OpenAPI, developer portal, or versioned client SDKs at the time of this profile.

providers.name: appearhere
providers.description: Appear Here is the leading online marketplace for short-term retail space, connecting property owners with brands, designers, and entrepreneurs who want to rent shops, pop-up stores, market stalls, showrooms, and event venues on a flexible, short-term basis. Founded in London in 2014 and backed by Balderton Capital, the two-sided marketplace lets tenants search available space by city and date, book securely online with standardized legal agreements, and message landlords directly, while landlords list and monetize idle retail units. Appear Here operates across the UK, US, and France and has facilitated the opening of more than 10,000 stores for over 250,000 brands and creative entrepreneurs. Appear Here does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its public web, brand, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Arena Club
providers.description: Arena Club is a technology-first trading-card and collectibles platform founded in 2022 by entrepreneur Brian Lee and baseball Hall-of-Famer Derek Jeter, operating as Arenaclub.com, Inc.
