The company combines AI- and computer-vision-assisted card grading, an insured physical vault with 24/7 surveillance and climate control, a digital "Showroom" where collectors organize vaulted cards into collections, and an online marketplace for buying, selling and trading slabbed sports and trading-card-game cards. Members submit cards for grading and vaulting, browse and transact in the marketplace, open digital packs, and can retrieve physical cards from the vault on demand. Arena Club ships web and native iOS/Android apps but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Atypical AI
providers.description: Atypical AI is an artificial-intelligence and learning-science lab building generative-AI learning products for educators, learners, and content creators. Its flagship product, ExamJam, is an AI tutor that pairs adaptive, personalized tutoring with trusted exam content from major publishers (Pearson, McGraw Hill, Collins) to help students prepare for and revise toward their exams. Founded in 2023 and based in San Francisco, the woman-owned company builds personalized tutoring, exam preparation, content creation, collaboration, and student-success measurement tools grounded in learning science. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta; it publishes a consumer product surface (web + mobile) and no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Autograph
providers.description: Autograph is a fan engagement and digital collectibles platform co-founded by Tom Brady and operated by LFG NFTs Corp. It recognizes and rewards fans by turning their passion for athletes, artists, and celebrities into access, experiences, and exclusive rewards. The platform consolidates fan communities and content into a single app, using web3 and NFT technology to let creators and public figures collaborate directly with their supporters. Autograph is a consumer product with no public developer API program at this time; api.autograph.io serves the app backend and docs.autograph.io is a private GitBook.

providers.name: Avoice
providers.description: Avoice is an AI-native workspace for architects and engineers that automates the non-design work of running an architectural practice. Its AI agents understand drawings, specifications, schedules, materials, building codes, and research to generate specs, run automated QA/QC quality control on specs and drawings, auto-produce door/window/finish schedules and quantities, draft RFIs and submittals for construction administration, and manage a client portal alongside searchable detail and material libraries. A Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, Avoice positions itself as the operating system for architectural practice, with firms managing over $300 million in active projects using it across five countries. Avoice publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation at this time; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: birchbox
providers.description: Birchbox is a beauty and grooming subscription-box retailer that sends members a monthly assortment of personalized deluxe samples across skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance, then lets them purchase full-size versions of what they like in its online shop. Originally a New York startup and later acquired, the brand today runs a direct-to-consumer subscription and e-commerce storefront at birchbox.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bolster
providers.description: Bolster is an executive search and recruiting platform that pairs experienced recruiters with an AI-powered talent platform to place full-time executives, board members, and fractional or interim leaders for high-growth companies, startups, and venture capital firms. Bolster emphasizes speed (typically five days to a first interview), transparent flat-fee pricing, and a data-driven approach informed by analysis of more than 280,000 executives across 30,000+ companies, with 350+ placements and a 40% repeat-client rate. It is backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Branddu
providers.description: Branddu (Branddu Colombia / Branddu AI) is a B2B MerchTech platform that digitizes corporate merchandising and promotional-product procurement across Latin America. Operating in Colombia and Mexico, it centralizes the full purchasing workflow - product discovery, inventory, quotations, customization, online design, and checkout - through a single online catalog of more than 15,000 fully customizable products across 46+ categories. Branddu AI (formed via a merger with Reno) combines AI, proprietary software, and a regional supplier network to simplify how companies source branded merchandise. The public storefront runs on Shopify. The company is backed by a US$300K pre-seed from 500 Global, bringing total capital raised to roughly US$800K.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Butn
providers.description: Butn is an Australian embedded-finance company that funds business cashflow at the point of transaction, plugging invoice finance, outsourced credit terms, and supplier "pay now, settle later" directly into the platforms its business customers already use. Its funding products — Butn X (invoice finance to draw cash early against receivables), Butn Terms (outsourced buyer credit where Butn carries the risk), and Butn Pay (paying suppliers upfront in exchange for extended repayment) — are designed to be embedded into partner marketplaces, accounting tools, and B2B platforms such as MYOB, Salesforce, and FoodByUs rather than sold as a standalone destination. Butn sits in the spend / accounts payable and accounts receivable financing layer of Australia's payments market, where money movement rides the New Payments Platform and the banks opened by the Consumer Data Right. Its integration and embedding are delivered through private, partner-provisioned APIs: Butn markets "plug and play" embedding for partners but does not operate a public self-serve developer portal, publish downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger definitions, or expose openly documented API reference material as of this profile.

providers.name: Carma
providers.description: Carma is an Australian online used-car retailer that lets consumers buy, sell, and trade in pre-owned vehicles entirely online. Every car is inspected and reconditioned, and the platform bundles financing through partner lenders, home delivery, trade-in valuations, a 7-day money-back guarantee, a 3-month warranty, and NRMA roadside assistance as an alternative to the traditional dealership experience. Backed by General Catalyst since 2022, Carma is headquartered in Sydney, Australia. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and enriched from Carma's public web surface; Carma publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Casana
providers.description: Casana (Casana Care) is a Rochester, New York digital-health company building passive, in-home remote patient monitoring hardware. Its flagship Smart Seat (formerly the Heart Seat) is a toilet-seat replacement that captures vital signs — heart rate, heart-rate variability, blood-oxygen (SpO2), respiration rate, blood-pressure insights, and sit-to-stand power — during normal bathroom use, with no wearables, no daily charging, and explicitly no camera or microphone. Readings sync to companion iOS, Android, and web apps for patients, families, and caregivers. The company operates in the digital health, remote patient monitoring, and connected medical-device space and is backed by General Catalyst and Kaiser Permanente. As of this profile Casana publishes a consumer product, companion apps, and legal/privacy pages, but no public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Casper
providers.description: Casper (Casper Sleep Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer sleep and home goods brand that sells mattresses, bedding, pillows, and sleep accessories online at casper.com and through retail partners. Its casper.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md with agent instructions, the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for AI agents to search, cart, and check out, and Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect authentication. Casper was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP and Slow Ventures and enriched from its live public agent/commerce surface.

providers.name: ChannelMeter
providers.description: ChannelMeter is a creator management and payments platform for multi-channel networks, agencies, and brands. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Francisco, it provides an all-in-one suite for creator discovery, onboarding, contract management, analytics, and automated global payouts. Its Creator Pay product moves money to creators across 21+ currencies and 50+ countries, and Creator Cash offers cash advances to creators. ChannelMeter reports having processed over $1B in payments to more than one million creators, working with Stripe and Fifth Third Bank for financial services. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Circulo de Belleza
providers.description: Círculo de Belleza is an authorized distributor of professional beauty products in Mexico, operating an e-commerce storefront at circulodebelleza.com. It sells salon-quality hair care, hair color, nail, barbershop, and facial/spa supplies from 40+ professional brands (L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Wella, Schwarzkopf, Matrix, Alfaparf Milano) at professional pricing with no minimum purchase, same-day fulfillment, and nationwide Mexico delivery. The store is built on Shopify and exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md, OpenID Connect and OAuth authorization-server discovery documents, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: Clad Labs
providers.description: Clad Labs is a San Francisco developer-tools startup (Y Combinator, Fall 2025) building Chad IDE, a desktop development environment that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor CLI, and OpenAI Codex — from a single interface. Developers spin up teams of parallel agents, keep each task isolated in its own workspace, then merge clean changes back together, while a built-in analytics dashboard tracks coding habits and productivity metrics. The IDE also fills AI-inference downtime with an in-app "Chad Browser" for entertainment that automatically hands focus back to the code when generation completes. Clad Labs ships a downloadable macOS and Windows application rather than a public web API; it exposes no REST/OpenAPI developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Cognichip
providers.description: Cognichip is an AI-first semiconductor company revolutionizing the way chips are designed. Its core technology, Artificial Chip Intelligence (ACI), is built on what the company describes as the world's first physics-informed foundation AI model tailored for chip design, positioning ACI as a new scaling factor for semiconductors. ACI aims to understand, learn, and solve chip design problems with designer-level cognitive abilities, reducing design effort by roughly 75% and cutting completion time in half to address the industry bottleneck where chip development can take three to five years. Founded by semiconductor and AI veterans including CEO Faraj Aalaei and CTO Ehsan Kamalinejad, the company is backed by Lux Capital, Mayfield, and Seligman Ventures, has Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on its board, and was named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes a marketing and corporate presence today with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
providers.description: CONTRIBUTING.md is a community health convention used by open source projects on GitHub and other platforms to document how external contributors can participate. The file communicates contribution guidelines, pull request processes, issue reporting procedures, coding standards, development setup, testing expectations, and code of conduct references. GitHub recognizes CONTRIBUTING.md placed in the repository root, the .github folder, or the docs folder, and surfaces a link to it whenever a contributor opens a new issue or pull request.

providers.name: Cooler Heads
providers.description: Cooler Heads Care, Inc. is a San Diego medical device company founded in 2018 by Kate Dilligan that makes Amma, an FDA-cleared Portable Scalp Cooling System (PSCS) used to reduce chemotherapy-induced hair loss. Amma circulates chilled fluid through a fitted cap to constrict scalp blood vessels and limit chemotherapy delivery to hair follicles, and is designed to be portable enough that patients can keep cooling outside the infusion chair. The company sells to infusion centers and oncology practices and publishes patient, provider, reimbursement and training material on its own site. It ships no developer API, SDK or public API documentation; its only machine-readable public surface is the Wix-platform site MCP endpoint and llms.txt served from its own host.

providers.name: Crosslayer Labs
providers.description: Crosslayer Labs is a network and web-infrastructure security company spun out of a Princeton University security research lab. Its founding team invented Multi-Perspective Issuance Corroboration (MPIC), an industry standard now required of every publicly-trusted Certificate Authority, which secures the issuance of every HTTPS certificate (~8 million per day). The company protects enterprises from website and API hijacks by discovering, analyzing, and continuously monitoring every layer of first- and third-party network infrastructure, correlating attack signals across the network stack for advanced threat detection and rapid mitigation.

providers.name: Cuida Mi Mascota
providers.description: Cuida Mi Mascota (CuidaMiMascota SAPI de CV) is a Mexican pet-care marketplace that connects pet owners with vetted, trusted caregivers for boarding (hospedaje), daycare, in-home visits, and dog walking across cities in Mexico. Delivered primarily as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps, the platform has served more than 250,000 pet owners and lets caregivers register to offer services. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. The company exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK today; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead with identity and domain-security signals captured for discovery.

providers.name: Cur8
providers.description: CUR8 is a carbon removal intelligence platform based in Oxford, United Kingdom, building the global market for high-quality carbon removals with a mission to remove one billion tonnes of carbon a year. Founded in 2021 by Mark Stevenson, Marta Krupinska and Gabrielle Walker, CUR8 combines financial and scientific expertise to source, evaluate and manage diversified carbon removal portfolios spanning nature restoration, biochar, direct air capture, enhanced weathering, superpollutant abatement and sustainable aviation fuel. Its platform surfaces (Discover for sourcing removal assets, Manage for tracking portfolio performance and risk, Finance for capital provision, and the Carbon Planner for strategy) help enterprises invest in carbon impact with confidence on the path to net zero. Clients include Microsoft, Coca-Cola HBC, Standard Chartered, Arup and UBS. CUR8 is backed by Google Ventures (GV) and Airbus Ventures. No public API, SDK or developer program is advertised as of this profile; access is via the CUR8 dashboard and platform.

providers.name: Delphia
providers.description: Delphia (Delphia Technologies Inc., Toronto, Canada) is an AI-driven quantitative investment firm that puts alternative data to work in systematic trading strategies. Originally a consumer robo-advisor and data-reward token platform backed by a $60M Series A led by Multicoin Capital, Delphia pivoted in 2024 to institutional quant investing with its Oracle Alpha hedge fund and Tilt trend platform. As of this writing Delphia publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity plus its live security and well-known surfaces.

providers.name: Ember
providers.description: Ember.js is a productive, battle-tested JavaScript framework for building modern web applications. It includes Ember CLI for scaffolding and builds, a best-in-class router with async data loading, the Ember Data layer, a three-level testing framework, the Glimmer rendering engine, and a six-week release cycle that emphasizes stability and easy upgrades through automated codemods.

providers.name: Enjoei
providers.description: Enjoei is a Brazilian online marketplace (brechó) for buying and selling new and pre-owned fashion, shoes, accessories, electronics, furniture, home goods, and collectibles. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it operates a peer-to-peer resale platform and mobile app ("enjuapp") that connects individual sellers and buyers, handling listings, payments, shipping, and buyer/seller protection. Enjoei is publicly traded on Brazil's B3 exchange (ticker ENJU3). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, MCP server, or SDKs were found during enrichment; this profile carries the consumer-facing identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Entera
providers.description: Entera is an AI-powered SaaS and services platform for single-family rental (SFR) real estate investing, describing itself as the operating system for single-family real estate. It helps operators, funds, new-construction companies, agents, and service partners buy, sell, and operate homes at scale across 34+ U.S. residential markets. The platform spans acquisitions (asset discovery, underwriting, diligence coordination), dispositions (pricing, buyer targeting, offer management), transaction enablement, market data and intelligence, and expert brokerage services. Entera is backed by investors including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Entera exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI/SDK surface; this profile captures its published company, legal, and brand properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Fortem Technologies
providers.description: Fortem Technologies is an airspace security and defense company based in Lindon, Utah that builds counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) for military, government, critical infrastructure, and commercial customers. Its SkyDome System combines TrueView AESA radars, long-range TrueView cameras, RF sensors, and the autonomous DroneHunter interceptor into a single detect-track-defeat capability, orchestrated by SkyDome Manager command-and-control software. SkyDome Manager exposes REST, realtime, and track-only integration APIs so third-party C2 platforms (such as the U.S. Army FAAD C2 and Lockheed Martin systems) can exchange over a hundred fields and commands for airspace awareness and drone mitigation. Fortem is backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, Boeing, and other strategic investors, and its systems have been selected for high-profile deployments including protection of venues at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

providers.name: Getsona
providers.description: Getsona (Sona) is an AI-powered workforce management platform that helps large, multi-site organizations make better workforce decisions across forecasting, scheduling, time and attendance, HR, and payroll. Marketed as "AI for better workforce decisions," Sona serves enterprises in hospitality, hotels, care, retail, and logistics, with customers including Popeyes UK, Paul Bakery, Salutem Healthcare, and Liaise. The platform pairs operational scheduling with an enterprise app builder (Sona Forge) and a catalog of integrations, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, webhooks, or developer portal. Getsona is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Felicis.

providers.name: Glen
providers.description: Glen is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building a shared organizational learning and memory system for fleets of AI agents. The platform acts as a centralized store that every AI agent in a company can read from and write to, so that when one agent learns something the whole organization gains access to it. Glen preserves decisions, customer insights and operational procedures with full audit trails, applies role-based access control per observation at recall time, and connects to coding agents, PR assistants, bug bots and sales agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It integrates with the tools where work already lives (code repositories, pull requests, issues, documentation and meetings) to give both agents and humans unified organizational context, aiming to eliminate knowledge silos, reduce new-hire ramp time and retain institutional knowledge through employee turnover. The company is pre-launch and operating a waitlist; its primary integration surface is an MCP server rather than a traditional REST API.

providers.name: GraniteShares
providers.description: GraniteShares is an independent exchange-traded fund (ETF) issuer that builds alternative, single-stock and thematic investment products for investors who want differentiated exposure. Its lineup spans 2x leveraged and inverse single-stock ETFs (such as NVDL for NVIDIA and TSLR for Tesla), YieldBOOST options-income ETFs, autocallable ETFs, physically-backed gold and broad commodity ETFs, and diversified income and equity strategies across U.S. and European markets. GraniteShares publishes no public developer or data API program; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's public web surface and the machine-readable discovery documents (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 member authentication for its Umbraco-powered site) that were probed from its domain. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: Grapes
providers.description: Grape (Grape Protocol / GrapeDAO, built by Grape-Labs) is Solana-based decentralized infrastructure that gives online communities and DAOs a set of mainnet-ready primitives for identity, reputation, verification, access control, rewards, and governance. Its products include OG (Vine) Reputation Spaces for season-based on-chain reputation, Grape Verification for identity attestation, the Grape Access Protocol (GPASS) for token/credential-gated access, a GSPL DAO directory, a multi-chain Grape Wallet, and a suite of Discord automation bots. Grape ships no REST/OpenAPI surface; developers integrate through first-party TypeScript SDKs (npm) that wrap its Solana programs directly. Backed by Multicoin Capital, it was surfaced as a VC portfolio lead and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Greator
providers.description: Greator (formerly GEDANKENtanken, founded 2012) is Germany's largest personal- development platform, headquartered in Cologne and serving roughly 234,000 customers. It runs a B2C ecosystem of free content (masterclasses, podcasts, a YouTube channel, magazine articles and personality tests) alongside paid, certified training programs such as The School of Life, Momentum Mastery, the Finance Academy and TheKey speaking training. Greator also produces live events including the annual Greator Festival (15,000+ attendees, 400+ speakers) and operates Greator Business, a B2B corporate offering. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Greator publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Grove
providers.description: Grove (Grove Collaborative) is a direct-to-consumer retailer of everyday household essentials for a healthier home and planet, including eco-friendly cleaning products, bamboo paper products, personal care, and vitamins & supplements sourced from hundreds of vetted brands alongside its own private labels. Orders are held to strict ingredient standards, are carbon neutral, and support plastic-waste cleanup. The business runs as a subscription-friendly e-commerce storefront (hosted on Shopify). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Grove operates a consumer retail storefront and publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its identity and web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Harmonic Lightwaves
providers.description: Harmonic Lightwaves (now Harmonic Inc, NASDAQ: HLIT) is a pure-play broadband and video-delivery technology company headquartered in San Jose, California, founded in 1988 as Harmonic Lightwaves. It builds virtualized broadband access (the cOS platform, Distributed Access Architecture nodes, and fiber-to-the-x solutions) and cloud-native video streaming and processing (the VOS platform and VOS360 SaaS). Harmonic exposes a VOS REST API for media management, packaging, DRM, live event and linear-TV workflows, publishes first-party client-side ad-tracking SDKs for iOS, Android and Roku on GitHub, and maintains a technical documentation library. Its developer surface is largely operator- and customer-facing rather than a self-service public developer program.

providers.name: Hashtag Paid
providers.description: Hashtag Paid Inc., which trades as #paid, is a Toronto-headquartered creator marketing platform that connects brands and agencies with social media creators. The product is a marketplace and campaign workspace: brands brief a campaign, are matched to vetted creators, review and approve content, license and amplify that content as paid social advertising across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and Pinterest, then measure results and pay creators automatically. #paid is a badged TikTok Marketing Partner and consumes the social platforms' advertising APIs on its customers' behalf. It runs as an end-user SaaS product with brand and creator web applications; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Helu Io
providers.description: helu.io is a financial management, controlling, and reporting platform for startups and small-to-medium businesses. It connects directly to DATEV accounting data (via a certified DATEVconnect interface) to produce automated, real-time financial reports, customizable dashboards and KPIs, budget vs. actuals comparisons, multi-entity consolidation, and planning, so finance teams can analyze, plan, and collaborate without manual spreadsheet work. The company is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and hosts data on German servers in compliance with DSGVO/GDPR. helu.io is a SaaS product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI — its integrations are product-level (DATEV, plus data upload from HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Excel, and Personio).

providers.name: Highway 9 Networks
providers.description: Highway 9 Networks delivers AI Wireless Infrastructure as a Service, providing secure private mobile networks and deterministic 5G connectivity for enterprise AI workloads. Its Virtual Mobile/AI Cloud (VMC) platform combines a cloud control plane (Mobile Center), distributed edge running a 5G core and AI services (Mobile Edge), private 5G wireless infrastructure (Mobile Network), and connected device and robot fleets (Mobile Zones) to give autonomous robots, cameras, and edge devices ultra-reliable, ultra-low-latency connectivity across manufacturing, warehousing, higher education, and energy environments. Highway 9 exposes Mobile Center streaming APIs for orchestration, telemetry, device management, alerting, and analytics, though the full specification is available only through its partner portal for signed partners. The company is backed by Mayfield and was added to the API Evangelist network as an enriched provider profile.

providers.name: Hobnob
providers.description: Hobnob is a consumer event and community-organizing platform (hobnob.app) for iOS, Android, and web. It lets people create custom video and photo invitations, deliver them by text message, track RSVPs, sell tickets, run sign-up lists, time polls, and announcements, and coordinate private group "Spaces" for chat and content sharing. Built on a Hawaii-inspired philosophy of real-world connection over engagement-maximizing social media, Hobnob reports 20 million invitations sent, roughly 35,000 events per month, 650,000 Spaces created, and 90,000+ five-star reviews. It is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Instil
providers.description: Instil is a purpose-built fundraising CRM and revenue-intelligence platform for nonprofit organizations, built for major-gifts and development teams. It manages the full donor lifecycle across major gifts, capital campaigns, planned giving, grant tracking, and moves management, and layers AI on top with One-Click Briefings that assemble a constituent's giving history and contact record on demand and Voice AI Logging that transcribes calls and writes interactions back to Instil or Salesforce. Instil connects to the nonprofit tech stack through Salesforce, Stripe, Classy, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Eventbrite, Google, Outlook, and Zapier. It is backed by Threshold Ventures. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time; integrations are delivered through packaged connectors and Zapier.

providers.name: Lato
providers.description: Lato (LATO Labs) is a San Francisco company building an agent-native research and simulation platform for investors. Its agents source and conduct hundreds of voice interviews with verified domain experts and customers in any language, each returned with a recording, transcript and thematic analysis, then combine those interviews with thousands of documents from public sources and a fund's own proprietary knowledge into a single commercial study. The study becomes a live simulation of the market that analysts can question and run scenarios against to predict where a market is headed. Investors use Lato for commercial due diligence, expert interviews, market sizing, competitive mapping, customer interviews, pricing studies, deal sourcing, inbound screening and portfolio value creation, compressing research that traditionally costs hundreds of thousands of dollars and takes weeks into hours. The product integrates with the tools investment teams already run on, including Outlook, SharePoint, Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, Teams, Excel, Affinity, Attio, Harmonic and Granola. Lato was founded by Tymek Staniszewski (CEO) and Tien Chu (CTO), is backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026), and builds on Anthropic, OpenAI and ElevenLabs. As of this profile Lato publishes no public developer API, documentation or SDKs; the company surface is captured here for discovery and the repository will be re-enriched when a developer program appears.

providers.name: LF Decentralized Trust
providers.description: LF Decentralized Trust, formerly Hyperledger, is a Linux Foundation project umbrella for enterprise blockchain, distributed ledger technology, and decentralized identity solutions. It hosts frameworks like Hyperledger Fabric, Besu, and Aries for building secure, interoperable enterprise blockchain applications.

providers.name: LF Edge
providers.description: LF Edge is an umbrella organization under the Linux Foundation establishing an open, interoperable framework for edge computing independent of hardware, silicon, cloud, or operating system. It hosts projects like Akraino, EdgeX Foundry, and Open Horizon.

providers.name: LF Research
providers.description: LF Research is the Linux Foundation's research arm that publishes reports and studies on open source trends, OSPO practices, technology adoption, and industry analysis. It provides data-driven insights to help organizations understand and participate in open source ecosystems.

providers.name: Livsn Designs
providers.description: Livsn Designs is a Techstars-backed outdoor apparel brand that makes durable, minimalist technical clothing (its Flex Canvas pants and multi-use travel and hiking apparel) sold direct-to-consumer from a Shopify storefront at livsndesigns.com. It publishes no first-party developer API or documentation portal. Its only programmatic surface is the agent-commerce layer Shopify serves on the merchant's own domain: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) shopping MCP endpoint for agent-driven checkout, a Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth2 authorization server, and an llms.txt / agents.md agent-instructions document. This profile captures that real agent surface; there is no bespoke API to catalog.

providers.name: Minersai
providers.description: MinersAI applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to geoscience data for mineral exploration, mining operations, public geological authorities, and mining & minerals investors. Founded and run by geologists (CEO Tomi de Lophem, CTO Mason Dykstra) and backed by Speedinvest and the Creative Destruction Lab, MinersAI structures, cleans, QCs, feature-engineers, and standardizes geochemical, geophysical, and remote-sensing datasets, then applies anomaly detection, heatmap generation, dimensionality reduction, and geostatistical interpolation to surface high-potential exploration targets. Its "geologists-in-the-loop" approach keeps domain experts central rather than replacing their expertise. The platform is delivered as a gated web application (app.minersai.com); there is no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: NeoTaste
providers.description: NeoTaste is a restaurant discovery and dining-deals mobile app operated by NeoTaste GmbH (Osnabrück, Germany). Under the tagline "Discover more. Pay less." it surfaces curated local restaurants and exclusive member deals such as 2-for-1 main courses and a free starter with a main, letting diners try new places while saving money and helping restaurants attract new guests. The consumer product ships as native iOS and Android apps and currently operates across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. NeoTaste is a venture-backed (Series A) company surfaced through the Earlybird portfolio. It exposes no public developer API — its api.neotaste.com backend is a private, authentication-gated service for the first-party mobile apps — so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an integration surface.

providers.name: Nexus AI
providers.description: Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as "Nexus AI", a 500 Global portfolio lead, but its recorded domain conceptdrop.com now permanently redirects (301) to hiresource.io — the site of Source (formerly ConceptDrop), a freelance creative-talent management platform. Source lets teams find, vet, and manage freelance designers, writers, animators, and consultants through a single contract with a dedicated account manager, replacing traditional creative-agency procurement. The customer application lives at app.hiresource.io; the public site is a WordPress marketing property. During enrichment no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface was found — this remains a non-API company profile.

providers.name: Nissan
providers.description: Nissan is a multinational automaker that designs, manufactures, and sells a wide range of vehicles, including cars, trucks, and SUVs. They are known for their innovative technology and commitment to sustainability, with a focus on producing electric and hybrid vehicles. In addition to their automotive business, Nissan also invests in research and development to create new products and services that cater to the changing needs of consumers.

providers.name: Northrop Grumman
providers.description: Northrop Grumman Corporation is a US global aerospace, defense and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, organized into four segments: Aeronautics Systems, Defense Systems, Mission Systems and Space Systems. It builds autonomous aircraft, strategic bombers and long-range strike weapons, missile defense and integrated battle command systems, radar and electronic warfare sensors, cyber and command-and-control mission software, solid rocket motors, and space vehicles and launch systems for US Department of Defense, intelligence-community, NASA and allied customers. It publishes no public developer program, API portal or machine-readable API contract; its external integration surfaces are the ADFS-authenticated OASIS supplier tools on myngc.com, available only to registered suppliers under contract.

providers.name: Open 3D Foundation
providers.description: The Open 3D Foundation is a Linux Foundation project supporting the Open 3D Engine (O3DE), an open source, real-time 3D engine for building games, simulations, and other 3D applications. With Microsoft as a premier member, it provides a modular, cross-platform engine with advanced rendering capabilities.

providers.name: Open Programmable Infrastructure
providers.description: The Open Programmable Infrastructure (OPI) project is a Linux Foundation initiative demonstrating real-world use cases for offloading key infrastructure management services from host CPUs to DPUs and IPUs. It enables hardware-accelerated security, load balancing, and API gateway functions.

providers.name: Our Place
providers.description: Our Place is a direct-to-consumer kitchenware and cookware brand, best known for the multi-purpose Always Pan, selling cookware, bakeware, appliances, tableware, and kitchen tools at fromourplace.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, its digital storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a native agentic-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect authentication, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the company's live public agent surface.

providers.name: Outtake
providers.description: Outtake is an AI-powered digital risk protection (DRP) platform that autonomously detects and dismantles digital threats — brand impersonation, executive impersonation, fake domains, fraudulent ads, and dark-web activity — across 100+ platforms. Its agentic system combines an Entity Registry, Agentic Search, a Digital Reservoir of contextual intelligence, threat graphing / narrative intelligence, and adaptive takedown workflows to remove threats in hours rather than weeks. The company reports a 99.4% takedown-confirmation rate and a 14.4-hour average resolution time. Backed by CRV and ICONIQ Capital.

providers.name: Pallet
providers.description: Pallet builds an AI-powered logistics workforce: autonomous AI agents that automate supply chain operations for freight brokerages, freight forwarders, FTL and LTL carriers, warehouses, and shippers. Its agents handle end-to-end workflows from quoting through order entry, track-and-trace, billing, and customer service, integrating with existing TMS, WMS, email, and legacy applications. The Atlas product surfaces revenue opportunities across freight operations. Pallet is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pendulum
providers.description: Pendulum (Pendulum Therapeutics, pendulumlife.com) is a microbiome-management and metabolic-health company that develops clinically validated probiotic supplements built on novel, patented anaerobic microbial strains such as Akkermansia muciniphila. Its consumer products - including Glucose Control, Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, and a GLP-1 probiotic - are formulated to fuel and maintain the gut lining, support immunity, relieve gas and bloating, and help keep blood glucose in a healthy range, differentiated by double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials rather than off-the-shelf probiotic blends. Pendulum is a direct-to-consumer health and supplement brand and is a portfolio company of DCVC; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Players Lounge
providers.description: Players' Lounge is a skill-based competitive gaming platform where users win money by completing personalized head-to-head gaming challenges (money matches) or by staking and watching other players compete. The platform supports popular console and PC titles including Madden, NBA 2K, Call of Duty Warzone, Marvel Rivals, and others, and states it has paid out over $200M to players to date. Players' Lounge is a consumer product surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation at this time. This profile captures the company's public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Portex
providers.description: Portex is a freight procurement and management platform that replaces the emails, spreadsheets, and PDFs of traditional freight quoting with a single collaborative workspace. Shippers, brokers, carriers, and forwarders use Portex to create, send, receive, compare, and award freight quotes up to 90% faster, centralize shipment documents and tracking, chat with carriers, and analyze freight spend for cost-saving recommendations. Founded by Brittany Ennix (previously Uber and Flexport) and backed by Cowboy Ventures, Portex is a seed-stage logistics technology company. As of this profile the platform is delivered as a hosted web application at portexpro.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Praxis
providers.description: Praxis is a New York-based company building an internet-native community and city-development venture — "an online community starting a new city" — founded in 2019 by Dryden Brown and Charlie Callinan. It operates a membership community at praxisnation.com whose stated purpose is to create a new culture and a resident-owned physical city, and a members-only account portal at portal.praxisnation.com where members view their PRAX holdings and manage their account. In October 2024 Praxis announced $525M in financing toward development of its first city. Praxis is a real-estate, community and smart-cities company, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Prime Roots
providers.description: Prime Roots is a Berkeley, California foodtech company making koji- and plant-based deli meats and bacon marketed as "the clean deli meat" — no preservatives, nitrates, or celery salt. It sells direct-to-consumer and through foodservice, running its online store on Shopify. That storefront exposes a native agent-commerce surface: an llms.txt / agents.md agent guide, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, https://ucp.dev) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted MCP endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Prosus Ventures portfolio company and enriched from its live public discovery surfaces.

providers.name: Produce Pay
providers.description: ProducePay is an agtech fintech platform for the global fresh-produce supply chain, giving growers, distributors, and buyers a combination of trade financing and operational tooling. Its offerings include Pre-Season Financing (working capital ahead of the growing season), Quick-Pay (converting produce shipments into immediate cash during peak season), Visibility (real-time shipment tracking, quality control, and data-driven insights), Sourcing (connecting buyers and sellers for long-term partnerships), and Predictable Commerce programs that bundle capital, visibility, and partnerships for year-round supply stability. The company operates a marketplace for its members but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Purely B
providers.description: PurelyB is a natural superfood and wellness brand founded by Raja Jesrina Arshad, rooted in ancestral Asian health traditions and selling halal-certified, vegan, gluten-free herbal supplements (Pegaga, Tiger Milk Mushroom, Manjakani, Super Immune-C and a SuperKids line) direct to consumers across Malaysia and Singapore. The storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a standards-based agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a hosted MCP shopping server, Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC, and a published llms.txt for AI shopping agents. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from its public developer/agent surface.

providers.name: Qeepsake
providers.description: Qeepsake is a family memory-keeping and baby-journaling service that helps parents capture their children's milestones and everyday moments by responding to scheduled text prompts or free-journaling in the mobile app, then turning those entries into digital and printed family storybooks. Operated by Tinybeans USA Ltd, Qeepsake is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with membership tiers; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass.

providers.name: Red Access
providers.description: Red Access (redaccess.io) is a cloud-based enterprise browsing and Secure Service Edge (SSE) security platform delivering agentless, browser-native protection — Zero Trust browsing, DLP, SWG, CASB, EDR-for-the-browser and GenAI security governance — without network rewrites or endpoint agents. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners and headquartered in New York, it was named a Leader in the 2025 GigaOm Radar for Secure Enterprise Browsing. As of this enrichment pass Red Access publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: RenoFi
providers.description: RenoFi is a home-renovation financing platform that partners with credit unions and lenders to offer renovation-specific loans underwritten against a home's projected after-renovation value (ARV) rather than its current equity, letting homeowners borrow significantly more without refinancing their first mortgage. RenoFi is not itself a lender: it originates and prepares applications, performs renovation underwriting, and connects homeowners, contractors, realtors, and credit-union partners to its lending network for RenoFi Home Equity Loans and HELOCs. The company maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source Ruby infrastructure libraries (GraphQL and Salesforce tooling) but publishes no public product API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal.

providers.name: Revivn
providers.description: Revivn provides an integrated hardware lifecycle platform for managing end-of-life IT equipment. The company handles secure device pickup, certified data sanitization and destruction, and redistribution of usable hardware to underserved communities through nonprofit partnerships. Its software surface (the Revivn App at app.revivn.com) lets IT and asset-management teams schedule retrievals, track chain-of-custody, generate compliance and sustainability reporting, and — per Revivn's marketing — integrate Revivn's API with their IT software stack for customized workflows. No public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDK is published; the integration API appears to be a private, enterprise-only surface. Revivn is a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Siolla
providers.description: Siolla is a Saudi financial-technology company offering a consumer investment-management mobile application. It provides professionally managed, fully Sharia-compliant investment portfolios, an in-app academy and educational resources covering financial fundamentals, budgeting and investment strategy, and simplified access to investing for modern investors. Siolla is licensed and regulated by the Saudi Capital Market Authority. The company presents a consumer app and website only; no public developer program, API, or developer documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: SiteAware
providers.description: SiteAware is the construction industry's first AI-powered Digital Construction Verification and Quality Management Platform for buildings. It verifies every installed element and flags real-time deviations across structure, envelope, and interior construction, giving field teams and business executives actionable data and analytics to catch issues before they lead to expensive rework. SiteAware is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited
providers.description: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited operates Smart Bricks, an AI-powered real estate investment platform that uses proprietary foundational models and autonomous agents to help retail and institutional investors discover, underwrite, execute, and monitor property deals globally. Backed by a16z, Google, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Techstars, and 500 Global, the company automates deal sourcing, risk modeling across 1,000+ variables per opportunity, diligence, documentation, and portfolio intelligence. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; Smart Bricks currently publishes a consumer and institutional web application but no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Spacetime Studios
providers.description: Spacetime Studios is an Austin, Texas mobile game developer and the creator of the free-to-play "Legends" series of cross-platform MMORPGs, including Arcane Legends, Pocket Legends, Star Legends, and Dark Legends. Founded by veteran game developers, the studio operates a consumer-facing community forum, an in-game item web store, and player support channels. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its verified public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: SPDX
providers.description: The Software Package Data Exchange (SPDX) is an open standard under the Linux Foundation for communicating software bill of materials information including components, licenses, copyrights, and security references. It is an ISO/IEC standard (ISO/IEC 5962) used for software supply chain transparency.

providers.name: Splitero
providers.description: Splitero is a San Diego, California fintech founded in 2021 by Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler that originates Home Equity Investments (HEIs) — a lump sum of cash, up to $500,000, paid to a homeowner today in exchange for a share of the home's future value, with no monthly payments, no income requirement, credit scores accepted from 500, and terms of up to 30 years. The company operates a consumer application and servicing portal at my.splitero.com, funds its originations through institutional capital commitments (including a $350M facility led by Blue Owl Capital), and has expanded into a licensed residential brokerage, Splitero Homes. Splitero is an end-user consumer finance product: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Squares
providers.description: Squares is a marketplace platform for discovering and booking curated, personally-vetted workspaces around the world — lofts, photo studios, rooftops, and villas suited to remote workers, creatives, and digital nomads. Spaces are scouted across 13+ cities including Almaty, Da Nang, and Austin, and hosts can list their own spaces on the platform. Squares is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer marketplace website but no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Stifel Financial
providers.description: Stifel Financial is a financial services holding company whose subsidiaries provide securities brokerage, investment banking, trading, investment advisory, and related financial services to individual investors, corporations, and government entities. Stifel bank accounts are accessible via open banking data aggregators including Plaid and Finicity (Mastercard) for third-party financial applications.

providers.name: Sunday Robotics
providers.description: Sunday Robotics is a consumer robotics company building Memo, an autonomous home robot that handles household chores such as clearing dishes, loading the dishwasher, pulling espresso shots, and folding laundry. The robot is trained on human demonstrations captured with the company's proprietary Skill Capture Glove and runs on the ACT family of robot foundation models. Founded as a physical-AI company and backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Sunday is pre-launch with a beta program opening in late 2026. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation; this record captures its public web and security surface only.

providers.name: Svastia
providers.description: Svastia (Svastia Genetics Inc.) is a precision-genomics and oncology data company that bundles clinical research products with cutting-edge bioinformatics to accelerate precision cancer therapy. It offers DNA/RNA sequencing, exome and gene-panel assays, immune (B/T-cell) repertoire sequencing, cell-based drug-efficacy screening, therapeutic-antibody development toolkits, and siRNA design, together with biomarker analytics (Tumor Mutational Burden, Microsatellite Instability) and clinical reporting based on ACMG/ASCO guidelines. Svastia serves hospitals, diagnostics labs, researchers, and CROs, and runs a bespoke clinical/genetic data-collection service across a hospital network, with HL7-FHIR data exchange between EHR and Clinical Trial Management Systems. Products are delivered through a login-gated web portal; the company does not publish a public developer API. Backed by 500 Global; offices in San Francisco (USA) and Cambridge (UK).

providers.name: swivl
providers.description: swivl is an AI automation platform built specifically for the self-storage industry. It combines a unified CRM and contact center that consolidates calls, texts, emails, and chats with AI agents for sales, billing, support, and review management, plus a tenant mobile app (Spot) for access codes, payments, and referrals. Its self-storage natural-language model is trained on hundreds of thousands of customer conversations and serves 3,500+ locations. Founded in New York City and backed by Techstars, swivl advertises open APIs and integrations with major self-storage management systems, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: SylloTips
providers.description: SylloTips is an enterprise AI platform, founded in Italy and backed by Techstars, that adds a continuous-improvement and reliability layer on top of RAG chatbots and planning agents. It captures a company's undocumented, expert knowledge through human-in-the-loop validation, turns validated expert answers into governed, reusable memory, and monitors AI agents for silent failures — confidently wrong answers, outdated citations, and unadmitted knowledge gaps — routing issues to the right experts. The platform is optimized for Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise identity, ships native connectors to existing tools and data systems, and integrates with 200+ apps via Zapier, AWS, and Pabbly Connect. SylloTips publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration is delivered through those connectors and its Microsoft 365 / Teams application rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Tailorbird
providers.description: Tailorbird is a CapEx orchestration platform for the multifamily real estate industry, replacing spreadsheet-based capital planning with AI-generated property intelligence. The platform produces unit-level as-builts, takeoffs, and interior models, runs renovation ROI and five-year capital plans, and tracks spend and budget variance in real time across apartment portfolios. Tailorbird ingests PCAs and property documents, integrates with major property-management ERPs including Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, and MRI via custom APIs and ELTs, and maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance. Founded in 2020 and based in Princeton, New Jersey, it serves 28 of the NMHC Top 50 operators and manages more than $2B in annual CapEx across over one million mapped units. It is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company.

providers.name: Tenex
providers.description: Tenex is a PropTech platform for real estate and hospitality operators across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, offering an all-in-one suite that unifies property management, tenant and landlord experience, facility and asset management, real estate accounting, VR for off-plan developments, and a hospitality guest experience app. Trusted across 500+ buildings and communities, it advertises integrations with ZATCA, SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft Dynamics to automate compliance and unify operations. Tenex is backed by 500 Global and the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator. As of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is published.

providers.name: The House Of LR&C
providers.description: The House of LR&C (Love, Respect & Care) is a Seattle-based, mission-driven direct-to-consumer fashion company founded in 2020 by Russell Wilson, Ciara, and retail veteran Christine Day. A Certified B Corporation, it operates a portfolio of apparel brands including Good Man Brand, LITA by Ciara, and Human Nation, donating 3% of net revenue to the Why Not You Foundation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its public commerce runs on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. The only machine-readable surface on the storefront host is Shopify's platform-level Customer Account API OIDC discovery document.

providers.name: Tile (thetileapp)
providers.description: Tile is a consumer Bluetooth-tracker company whose Tile Mate, Pro, Slim, and Sticker devices help people find everyday items such as keys, wallets, bags, and phones, backed by the crowd-sourced Tile "Find" network that anonymously relays location when another Tile user passes a lost item. Founded in 2012, Tile was acquired by Life360 in 2021 and now operates as part of the Life360 family-safety platform. Tile publishes consumer apps for iOS and Android and a support and legal surface, but does not offer an official public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; only third-party community libraries wrap its private app API. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web and security-program surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

providers.name: TruEra (Snowflake)
providers.description: TruEra was an AI quality, observability, and governance platform that was acquired by Snowflake in May 2024. The standalone TruEra product is being absorbed into Snowflake's Cortex/AI platform. The open-source TruLens evaluation library (originally from TruEra) remains active as a standalone Python project for LLM and RAG evaluation.

providers.name: Tutor Intelligence
providers.description: Tutor Intelligence builds AI-powered robotic workers for industrial and logistics operations, delivered as robots-as-a-service. Its flagship Cassie palletizing robot handles material-handling tasks — palletizing, depalletizing, and case picking — in warehouses and factories without facility retrofits, and a humanoid robot, Sonny, is slated for late 2026. The company pairs on-robot autonomy with a human-in-the-loop teleoperation and data model, priced per robot-hour with no long-term contracts, and is backed by Union Square Ventures. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this profiling; the company's public GitHub organization hosts internal tooling and open-source forks rather than a first-party product API.

providers.name: Utopia
providers.description: Utopia was an online platform for designing, coding, and shipping React applications, pairing a visual design tool with a code editor over one source of truth. A 2020 Seedcamp portfolio company, it was built in the open as the MIT-licensed concrete-utopia/utopia monorepo (3.8k stars) with a first-party utopia-api npm library. The project has been dormant since mid-2025, utopia.app now serves a parked placeholder page, and no network API was ever published.

providers.name: Vera
providers.description: Vera was a data-centric security company delivering information rights management (IRM) as a service, letting businesses encrypt, track, audit, and revoke access to files anywhere they travel, with an SDK and REST API for embedding AES 256-bit encryption and policy enforcement into applications. Backed by Amplify Partners, Battery Ventures, and Sutter Hill Ventures, Vera was acquired by HelpSystems (now Fortra) in December 2020 and lives on as Fortra's Digital Guardian Secure Collaboration product; its developer surface (SDK/REST API) is now available to Fortra customers rather than as a public developer program.

providers.name: Vital Lyfe
providers.description: Vital Lyfe is a Torrance, California hardware company building portable water purification technology designed to scale where infrastructure cannot reach. Its flagship product, Access, is a portable watermaker that converts naturally occurring water, including saltwater, into clean drinking water through a simple place-a-hose, press-start, hydrate workflow. The company sells the Access device and branded gear through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront and publishes a mission, team, careers, and journal. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Vital Lyfe is a consumer-hardware and e-commerce brand with no public API, SDK, or developer program surface.

providers.name: wacai
providers.description: Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fintech and personal-finance company founded in 2009, best known for its "挖财记账" personal accounting and bookkeeping app and its internet wealth-management platform. Beyond its consumer apps, Wacai operates a partner-facing open API gateway (挖财开放平台) at open.wacai.com that exposes services through a single JSON-over-HTTPS entry point using appKey/appSecret signed requests, with official client SDKs published for Java (Maven Central), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Web Methods
providers.description: Web Methods (webMethods) is an enterprise integration platform pioneer, founded in 1996 by Phillip and Caren Merrick in Fairfax, Virginia to connect software applications in real time using web standards such as HTTP and XML. Its 2000 IPO was one of the largest first-day pops of the dot-com era. webMethods was acquired by Software AG in 2007 for $546 million, and its integration portfolio - now including webMethods.io Integration (iPaaS), API Gateway and API Management, the Developer Portal, B2B/EDI, messaging, managed file transfer, and event-driven integration - was acquired by IBM in July 2024 as IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration. Mayfield was an early venture backer of the company.

providers.name: Wideframe
providers.description: Wideframe is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building an AI agent for video production that automates the work editors do outside the editing timeline. It searches, labels, organizes, and sequences raw footage across local filesystems and cloud storage, indexing large media libraries by meaning and outputting native, editable Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) sequences rather than synthetic video. Delivered as an Apple Silicon (M1+) desktop application, it targets brands, agencies, and professional editors who spend far longer preparing footage than actually cutting it. Wideframe currently ships as a consumer/product application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Wisk Aero
providers.description: Wisk Aero is an autonomous, all-electric eVTOL air taxi developer and a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company. Wisk is developing its Generation 6 aircraft, a four-passenger self-flying eVTOL designed to operate under human supervisor oversight from a multi-vehicle supervision center, pursuing certification under three FAA programs: Type Certification, Production Certification, and Operation Certification. Wisk evolved from earlier Kitty Hawk programs and has logged over 1,750 autonomous test flights across five aircraft generations since 2010. Announced launch communities include Houston, Texas and Brisbane, Australia (in support of the 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games). In March 2026 Wisk was selected by the White House to help lead the safe U.S. introduction of autonomous air taxi flight. Wisk is hardware- and operations-focused, with no public consumer or developer APIs.

providers.name: Zeel
providers.description: Zeel is an on-demand wellness marketplace that connects consumers with licensed, background-checked massage therapists for in-home, in-hotel, in-office, and event chair massage delivered same-day and often within an hour of booking. The platform covers a range of modalities including Swedish, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, sleep, and couples massage, and offers memberships, gift certificates, and a spa-staffing service (Zeel Spa Staffing) that supplies therapists to hotels and spas. Zeel operates a consumer-facing web and mobile booking experience across dozens of US metros; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration program.

providers.name: Zehitomo
providers.description: Zehitomo is a Tokyo-based online marketplace that matches consumers in Japan with local professionals across hundreds of service categories — including photographers, personal trainers, house cleaners, graphic and web designers, videographers, tax accountants, interpreters, construction and repair trades, and business consultants. Clients describe the job they need done and receive quotes and proposals from vetted local pros, while professionals pay to respond to matched leads. Founded in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, Zehitomo runs a consumer-facing web and mobile product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Adentro
providers.description: Adentro (formerly Zenreach) is a WiFi marketing and customer-intelligence platform that connects online marketing spend to real-world, in-store visits for brick-and-mortar businesses. Branded guest-WiFi portals capture and enrich first-party customer profiles, measure foot traffic and a "Walk-Through Rate" attribution metric, and power automated email and audience-targeting campaigns across roughly 100 million verified US consumer profiles. Adentro serves retail, food and beverage, venues and arenas, and entertainment and hospitality brands. It exposes a partner/customer-gated Contacts API and a Location & Scanning API (V2/V3) for syncing captured contacts, visits, and location data into CRMs and loyalty platforms such as Fishbowl and Alpine IQ; access is granted via an Adentro-issued token passed in the Authorization header rather than through a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: AI Palette
providers.description: AI Palette is an AI-first consumer-insights and product-innovation platform for the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. Founded in Singapore in 2018 and later acquired by GlobalData, it aggregates more than 61 billion data points across 24 countries and 18 languages to help food, beverage, and personal-care brands discover emerging trends, generate and screen new product concepts, and bring winning products to market faster. Its platform spans the Foresight Engine for real-time trend discovery, Concept Genie for generative-AI concept creation, Screen Winner for concept validation, and the FoodGPT / Arya agentic co-pilot. Customers include Nestle, Mondelez, Kellogg, Diageo, Cargill, ADM, and Symrise. This is an enterprise SaaS platform accessed by license; no public developer API, SDK, or specification is published.

providers.name: Amperos Health
providers.description: Amperos Health (Amperos) is an AI-native insurance revenue recovery platform for healthcare providers. It uses agentic AI together with experienced revenue cycle management (RCM) specialists to run the full insurance collections process, from claim submission through denial resolution to payment. The platform automates first-touch routine tasks, works complex denials with specialist oversight, and adapts configurable workflows to each organization's procedures across specialties including orthopedics, cardiology, behavioral health, DME/HME, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, dermatology, urology, dental, and oncology. Amperos reports outcomes such as higher claim recovery, reduced accounts receivable backlogs, and lower cost to collect for the healthcare providers it serves. The company is backed by Uncork Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company. Amperos currently exposes a marketing and demo-request surface rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties and security posture.

providers.name: Astera Labs
providers.description: Astera Labs, Inc. (NASDAQ: ALAB) is a semiconductor company building purpose-built connectivity solutions for rack-scale AI and cloud infrastructure. Its Intelligent Connectivity Platform spans the Aries PCIe/CXL Smart DSP Retimers, Smart Cable Modules and Smart Gearboxes, the Taurus Ethernet Smart Retimers and Smart Redrivers, the Leo CXL Smart Memory Controllers, and the Scorpio Smart Fabric Switches, all managed by COSMOS (COnnectivity System Management and Optimization Software). COSMOS is the software layer of the platform: firmware modules on the devices plus platform-level libraries that run on hosts and baseboard management controllers, exposing what Astera Labs describes as a single standardized API for device discovery, configuration, security attestation, firmware update, telemetry, link diagnostics, RAS testing, scripting and fleet management. That API surface is an on-premises host/BMC SDK rather than a public web API: the COSMOS Developer Kit is offered through a "Contact Us" motion and the supporting application notes are released through a document-request form, so no public API reference or machine-readable specification is published.

providers.name: Beamy
providers.description: Beamy is a SaaS discovery and governance platform that helps organizations identify unauthorized cloud applications (shadow IT), manage their SaaS portfolio, track spending, enforce security policies, and ensure compliance. Beamy uses browser extension-based detection and integrates with SSO, expense management, and ITSM systems to provide comprehensive SaaS visibility and control. The platform serves IT, security, and procurement teams seeking to reduce SaaS sprawl and govern their cloud application landscape.

providers.name: Cameo
providers.description: Cameo is a consumer marketplace for personalized video messages from celebrities, athletes, musicians, comedians, and creators. Fans book a custom shout-out by sending a short script with personal details, and the talent records and delivers a bespoke video, typically within seven days, for occasions like birthdays, milestones, and celebrations. Cameo also runs Cameo for Business for branded talent content, sells gift cards, and offers a Red Carpet Rewards loyalty program. Cameo does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; this profile tracks the company's public web, help, and security surface.

providers.name: Chamber Cardio
providers.description: Chamber Cardio is a Washington, D.C.-based healthcare technology company building a cardiology-focused platform for value-based care. Chamber partners with cardiology practices and health plans to align clinical signals, workflows, and patient data so cardiologists can identify high-risk patients earlier, close gaps against treatment guidelines, and reduce administrative burden. Its workflow-integrated AI surfaces clearer signal from the large volumes of cardiovascular data generated in care, supporting better patient outcomes and financial predictability for payers as cardiology moves beyond fee-for-service. The company supports more than 500 cardiologists across seven states and raised a $60M Series A led by Frist Cressey Ventures, with participation from General Catalyst, AlleyCorp, American Family Ventures, Company Ventures, Optum Ventures, Healthworx Ventures, and Black Opal Ventures. Chamber does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; its platform is built on a FHIR-based data stack (Medplum) with internal REST and GraphQL services.

providers.name: CHAOSS
providers.description: CHAOSS (Community Health Analytics in Open Source Software) is a Linux Foundation project that develops metrics, methodologies, software, and practitioner guides for measuring and improving open source community health and sustainability. It produces a metrics catalog organized into focus areas (Common, DEI, Risk, Value, Evolution) and metrics models, along with open source software (Augur, 8Knot, GrimoireLab) that ingests data from Git, GitHub, GitLab, mailing lists, and other community platforms to compute the metrics. CHAOSS-aligned SaaS services such as OSS Compass and Bitergia Analytics also expose the metrics for adopters who do not want to host the software themselves.

providers.name: Docsify
providers.description: Docsify is a lightweight, no-build documentation site generator that turns Markdown files into a website on the fly using client-side JavaScript rendering.

providers.name: Epicor
providers.description: Epicor Software Corporation provides industry-specific enterprise resource planning software for manufacturing, distribution, retail, and service industries. Epicor Kinetic, the flagship ERP platform, exposes an Open REST API built on OData v4 that gives developers service-based access to all business objects, processes, reports, BAQs, and Epicor Functions using standard HTTP methods and API key authentication.

providers.name: General Intuition
providers.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab, founded in 2025 and spun out of Medal, building spatial-temporal world and action models that learn to perceive, anticipate, and act in space and time. Rather than training primarily on the archive of human language, its systems learn from gameplay data, teaching machines to play, dream within compressed simulacra of reality, and improvise within the unfolding dynamics of the world. The company is developing a commercial API for gaming, simulation, and robotics partners, with broader access planned through 2026. General Intuition is backed by Khosla Ventures, which led both its $133.7M seed round (October 2025) and its $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation (2026).

providers.name: GlossGenius
providers.description: GlossGenius is a business management platform for the beauty, wellness, and health services industry, combining appointment scheduling, integrated payment processing (flat 2.6% rate), point of sale, marketing, client management, staff and payroll tools, and AI agents that answer booking inquiries and follow up with clients. It serves solo professionals and multi-location businesses such as salons, spas, barbershops, and medspas, powering more than 120,000 appointment-based businesses. GlossGenius was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GlossGenius publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and public link surface only.

providers.name: Goose Insurance
providers.description: Goose Insurance Services Inc. is a Vancouver, British Columbia based digital insurance distributor — an app-first licensed agency and MGA rather than a carrier — that sells travel medical, Visitors to Canada, term life, whole life, final expense, critical illness, accidental death and dismemberment, hospital cash, kids and renters coverage through the Goose mobile "insurance super app". Founded in 2017 and licensed in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec (AMF firm registration 603913), New Brunswick and Nova Scotia, Goose underwrites nothing itself: every policy is placed with a partner carrier including AIG Canada, iA Financial Group, TuGo, IMG, MSH, American-Amicable, Teachers Life, Lloyd's of London and Sutton National. Its home market is Canada, with a US launch in 2020, and it sits in the thin digital-broker layer beneath the Big-Few Canadian oligopoly alongside Zensurance and APOLLO. Goose's API posture is closed: as of the 2026-07-25 review there is no public developer portal, no self-serve API documentation, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger, and no published ACORD, AL3 or agency-management-system integration. The only host that answers on the api. subdomain is a private Heroku-backed mobile-app backend that returns 404 at every probed path, and the only partner surfaces the company publishes are a marketing affiliate/referral program and a carrier-relationships page — quote, bind, issue and FNOL are all consumer-facing inside the app only.

providers.name: Leaner Technologies
providers.description: Leaner Technologies (株式会社Leaner Technologies) is a Tokyo-based B2B SaaS company founded on February 22, 2019 by CEO Yusuke Ohira, operating under the mission "調達のスタンダードを刷新し続ける" (continuously renew the standard of procurement).
