providers.description: Genome Medical is a telehealth-enabled genetic services provider offering expert genetic counseling, test selection and ordering support, results interpretation, and clinical trial matching for individuals with rare and hereditary conditions. It partners with health systems, life sciences organizations, and genetic testing labs to scale genetic care, reduce diagnostic backlogs, and accelerate diagnoses through a proprietary clinical platform and patient portal. Genome Medical does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gin
providers.description: Gin is a high-performance HTTP web framework for Go that provides a fast and productive way to build microservices and APIs.

providers.name: Global ID
providers.description: GlobaliD (global.id) is a decentralized digital-identity platform that lets people create a portable, self-sovereign identity and lets developers add "Sign in with GlobaliD" login, issue verifiable credentials, and verify identity claims (such as proof of being 18+) through server-side issuer and verifier toolkits built on Hyperledger Aries. Developers create apps in the invitation-based developer portal to obtain OAuth2 client credentials, then integrate using the official @globalid npm SDKs. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Gridware
providers.description: Gridware builds grid intelligence technology for electric utilities. Its Active Grid Response (AGR) platform pairs pole-mounted GridScope sensors with analytics to bring real-time visibility into the physical, electrical, and environmental condition of every span of the distribution grid, closing the "Hazard Awareness Delay" between when a fault or hazard occurs and when a utility detects it. Gridware supports fault prevention, faster power restoration, wildfire and hazard response, and grid asset management. Headquartered in San Francisco with an Applied Research Complex in Richmond, California, the company is backed by True Ventures. Gridware does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity, trust/compliance posture, and domain security.

providers.name: Guidelight Health
providers.description: Guidelight Health is a mental healthcare provider delivering evidence-based day treatment programs — Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHPs) and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOPs) — for people managing anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, and personality disorders. Care combines group therapy, individual psychotherapy, and medication management, offered in-person and virtually across Colorado, California, Massachusetts, North Carolina, and Washington. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company operates a patient-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; its client portal runs on the third-party Kipu (kipuworks.com) EHR platform, so there is no first-party API, SDK, or developer surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Harmonycares
providers.description: HarmonyCares is a physician-led, value-based, in-home primary care organization headquartered in Troy, Michigan, and one of the nation's largest house-call practices. It brings primary care, palliative care, and ancillary services such as in-home laboratory, radiology, and comprehensive health assessments directly to older adults living with serious and complex chronic conditions. Operating across roughly a dozen states, HarmonyCares supports more than 70,000 patients through value-based arrangements with Medicare Advantage plans and Medicare ACO programs. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a public marketing site, a patient portal, and corporate policy documents, but no public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Harris Ambulatory Care Enterprise
providers.description: Harris Ambulatory Care Enterprise (part of Harris Healthcare, a Harris Computer company) provides ambulatory healthcare software solutions including the Pulse electronic health record system. The platform supports a §170.315(g)(10) ONC certified FHIR API for third-party application developers to access patient data, provider information, and clinical resources. Pulse is deployed on-premises, so each provider hosts a separate API instance with its own base URL. Third-party developers must obtain an ONC 2015 Edition Certified API License and register with each provider organization.

providers.name: Hyperproof
providers.description: Hyperproof is a continuous compliance and risk management platform that automates evidence collection, control management, and audit workflows. It exposes a public REST API covering 20+ resources (Controls, Policies, Programs, Risks, Proof, Tasks, Issues, Vendors, Users, Groups, Roles, Scopes, Questionnaires, Custom Apps, Labels, and more) plus the Hypersync SDK for custom integrations.

providers.name: HYPERZ AI
providers.description: HYPERZ AI is a generative-AI company focused on professional photography and headshot generation, offering both consumer (B2C) and enterprise (B2B) products. Its consumer tool, Business Photo AI (businessphoto.ai), turns selfies into professional headshots with customizable poses, outfits, and backgrounds. Its enterprise product, HYPERTURE (hyperture.ai), delivers consistent, studio-grade headshots for teams with brand-consistency controls, member approval workflows, and C2PA provenance verification. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface — the products are end-user applications rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Inductive
providers.description: Inductive Bio is a New York-based AI drug discovery company building a virtual lab for small molecule optimization. It pairs medicinal chemists with AI to run millions of in silico ADMET experiments before synthesis. Its Beacon-1 models — trained on a pre-competitive, anonymized data consortium spanning thousands of drug programs — won consecutive first-place finishes in the 2025 Polaris/ASAP and 2026 OpenADMET blind ADMET prediction competitions, beating 370+ submissions including entries from Merck and NVIDIA. Products include the Compass software platform (accessible via API), the Indy AI chemistry assistant, the ADME-One high-throughput profiling service, and Embedded Experts. Founded in 2023 by Josh Haimson and Ben Birnbaum (both formerly Flatiron Health); SOC 2 compliant; backed by Obvious Ventures, a16z Bio+Health, Lux Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Character, and S32.

providers.name: Inkblot Therapy
providers.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.

providers.name: innRoad
providers.description: innRoad is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) that bundles PMS, a direct booking engine, and a channel manager (OTA distribution to Expedia, Booking.com, Airbnb, and others) into one platform, built for independent hotels, boutique properties, and small hotel management companies. innRoad also offers 40+ pre-built partner connections - point-of-sale (Lightspeed, Oracle Hospitality, Squirrel, Positouch, Uniwell), door locks (RemoteLock, Saflok, ONITY), guest messaging (Akia), accounting (M3, Inn-Flow), and in-house payment processing (innRoad Payments) - that are toggled on inside the application. innRoad does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, no OpenAPI definition, and no documented WebSocket or webhook API as of this cataloging; every listed integration is a pre-built, partner-gated connection rather than an open surface a third-party developer can register for and call.

providers.name: Ipid
providers.description: iPiD (International Payments Identity) is a fintech providing real-time Know Your Payee (KYP) verification for cross-border and domestic payments. Its single, payment-rail-agnostic API lets banks, PSPs, and corporates validate bank account ownership and match payee names before funds move, reducing authorized push payment (APP) fraud, business email compromise losses, and failed transactions. Products include iPiD Validate (global payee / bank account verification with name-matching), iPiD Node (a scheme-compliance layer for EU Verification of Payee, UK Confirmation of Payee, FATF Recommendation 16, and US Nacha), and a Payment Agent agentic verification layer. Founded in 2021, iPiD is backed by QED Investors, Monk's Hill Ventures, Quona Capital, Jungle Ventures, Saison Capital, and others. Public API access is gated behind a sales/demo process; no machine-readable specification is published publicly.

providers.name: Item
providers.description: Item is an AI-native customer relationship management (CRM) platform, part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch. It replaces the traditional CRM with an AI Assistant that handles daily work in plain language and customizable Agents that autonomously execute business processes across sales, support, and account management. Item connects to 100+ customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, discovers leads that match an ideal customer profile, and becomes a company's single source of truth for people, companies, and deals.

providers.name: Its Good
providers.description: It's Good is a social dining recommendation app that reimagines how people discover restaurants and bars by surfacing recommendations from trusted friends rather than crowdsourced reviews from strangers. Founded in 2023 and co-founded by Mike Rosenthal (CEO) and musician John Legend, the iOS app lets people save the places they love, organize their lists, and share personalized recommendations within a curated community of people they know and admire. The company is backed by a seed investment from Lightspeed Venture Partners. It's Good is a consumer mobile product and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Joy
providers.description: Joy (withjoy.com) is a consumer wedding and event planning platform that gives couples a free personalized wedding website, an all-in-one universal registry, guest list management, digital and printed save-the-dates and invitations, smart RSVP tools, hotel room blocks, and a companion mobile app. The company has since expanded into baby planning with Joy Baby. Joy is a business-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI specification; this profile therefore carries identity and link-property metadata and live security probes rather than machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Lawn Love
providers.description: Lawn Love is an on-demand lawn care and outdoor home services marketplace that matches homeowners with vetted, independent lawn care professionals across more than 120 US cities. Customers get instant online quotes and book mowing, fertilization, aeration, seeding, pre-emergent and general weed control, bush trimming, leaf removal, gutter cleaning, yard clean-up and snow removal, on either pay-as-you-go or recurring schedules, and manage jobs through the my.lawnlove.com customer app and iOS/Android apps; providers take and service work through pros.lawnlove.com and the Lawn Love for Providers apps. Lawn Love operates as part of LawnStarter. It publishes no public developer API, no developer portal and no API documentation - the api.lawnlove.com host is an undocumented, noindexed backend serving its own web and mobile clients.

providers.name: Loftia
providers.description: Loftia is a cozy, solarpunk massively-multiplayer online (MMO) game developed by Qloud Games Pty Ltd, a remote-first indie studio founded in 2022 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. Set across floating islands in a warm, sustainable world, players farm, craft, decorate, socialize, and build a life in the sky alongside friends in a shared world that grows over time. The studio (founded by Eric Mallon, Martina Qin, and Michael Su) raised a $5M seed round led by BITKRAFT Ventures and GFR Fund with participation from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and took part in a16z's SPEEDRUN gaming accelerator. Loftia is a consumer game company with no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lumosity
providers.description: Lumosity is a consumer brain-training platform built by Lumos Labs that offers cognitive games and personalized daily workouts targeting memory, attention, problem solving, flexibility, and processing speed. The service adapts difficulty to individual performance, tracks progress over time, and is delivered through the web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the company was surfaced through VC-portfolio discovery; probing its public surface found no developer portal, public API, or documented programmatic integration — it is a direct-to-consumer product with no API surface at this time.

providers.name: Marker
providers.description: Marker is a writing tool for people who believe in writing — a calm, focused space for thinking and writing that acts as your partner and editor from first idea to final draft. Backed by Index Ventures, Marker sits in the future-of-work space and offers a distraction-free web application (my.marker.page) for drafting long-form writing. It is a consumer product web app: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, developer documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface, so this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe only.

providers.name: MiRus
providers.description: MiRus is a Marietta, Georgia life sciences company founded in 2015 that develops and commercializes implants and procedural solutions built on MoRe, its proprietary molybdenum-rhenium superalloy, for spine, orthopaedic and structural heart disease. Its FDA-cleared portfolio spans the Europa pedicle screw system, CYGNUS MoRe anterior cervical plating, 3DR printed interbody and corpectomy systems, the Atlas foot-and-ankle plating line, and the Siegel transcatheter aortic valve, alongside GALILEO — a spine-focused surgical planning, intra-operative alignment measurement and remote physiologic monitoring platform delivered to clinicians as the "Mirus Analytics" web application at rpm.mirusmed.com. MiRus publishes no public developer program: the GALILEO backend, which includes a FHIR route, is bearer/Cognito authenticated and answers 401 on every path, and no OpenAPI, SDK, reference or developer portal is published anywhere on its public surface.

providers.name: Monese
providers.description: Monese is a London-founded fintech that provides mobile money accounts to consumers across Europe. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) rather than a traditional bank, Monese lets over two million users open an account in minutes and then spend, send, and save money directly from a smartphone app. Its product surface covers multi-currency and local accounts, international money transfers, physical and virtual debit cards, budgeting and savings tools, and credit-building features. Monese is a consumer-facing mobile application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mophones
providers.description: Mophones (MoPhones) is a Nairobi, Kenya based fintech and recommerce company building accessible device-financing and re-commerce infrastructure for Africa, starting with premium refurbished smartphones from brands like Apple and Samsung sold with flexible weekly-installment and pay-on-delivery plans. The consumer storefront runs on Shopify at mophones.co and does not expose a first-party developer API; its only programmatic surface is the Shopify-provided agentic-commerce layer — a published Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile at /.well-known/ucp and a live UCP-over-MCP shopping endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp that lets buyer-approved AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and complete Shop Pay checkouts. Mophones is backed by Speedinvest and was noted as the first African startup to secure NICE financing from STV.

providers.name: Motilal Oswal
providers.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited (MOFSL) is a diversified Indian financial services company offering equity and derivatives broking, wealth management, asset management, mutual funds, IPO access, investment banking, private equity, and home finance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. The public surface is a consumer/corporate investing website built on Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services; no public developer API or OpenAPI is published (algorithmic/partner trading access sits behind a partner login).

providers.name: Motivo
providers.description: Motivo is the leading managed clinical supervision platform for behavioral health organizations. It connects pre-licensed and post-graduate mental health professionals with 1,500+ vetted clinical supervisors across all 50 states, enabling organizations to expand their workforce, reduce burnout, and meet licensure requirements. The fully-managed platform handles supervisor vetting, compliance and documentation, scheduling, HIPAA-compliant video sessions, and payment processing, and includes group supervision, peer consultation, webinars, and workforce-development resources. Motivo serves behavioral health centers, treatment facilities, health plans, and digital health companies. As of this profile Motivo publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its platform is delivered as a managed SaaS product and it consumes third-party APIs (e.g. Google Calendar) internally.

providers.name: Nuvocargo
providers.description: Nuvocargo is an AI-powered freight-management platform for North American truckload logistics, focused on the US-Mexico-Canada cross-border corridor. Its "Nuvo AI" system coordinates a network of specialized agents (quoting, negotiation, booking, dispatch, tracking, exception handling, audit, and payment) to automate the freight load lifecycle, and it pairs that software with licensed freight brokerage, managed transportation, and customs-brokerage services. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Homebrew and QED Investors. As of this enrichment pass Nuvocargo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; onboarding is contact-gated ("zero-integration" pilots), so this profile captures the company identity, legal/resource surface, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Open Voice Network
providers.description: The Open Voice Network is a Linux Foundation project advancing open standards for AI-enabled voice assistance systems. Its core initiatives around TrustMark and interoperability promote ethical, accessible, and interoperable voice technology across platforms and devices.

providers.name: OpenAPI Initiative
providers.description: The OpenAPI Initiative is a Linux Foundation project that promotes the OpenAPI Specification for defining standard, language-agnostic interfaces to RESTful APIs. It provides governance, tooling ecosystem support, and community collaboration for the most widely adopted API description format.

providers.name: Oxia
providers.description: Oxia is a scalable metadata store and coordination service designed for distributed systems, providing strong consistency guarantees and high availability. It is developed by StreamNative as an alternative to ZooKeeper.

providers.name: Paz Ai
providers.description: Paz.ai is an AI commerce platform that helps merchants win visibility and sales across AI shopping channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. It runs three autonomous agents — a Monitor agent that benchmarks catalog performance across AI channels, an Optimizer agent that enriches product titles, attributes, and structured data, and a Distributor agent that publishes AI-optimized feeds to agentic commerce endpoints — producing an AI-optimized copy of a product catalog without modifying the live store. It integrates with Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and Salesforce Commerce, plus CSV and a custom API on enterprise plans. Backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: PB Health
providers.description: PB Health (PB Healthcare Service Pvt Ltd) is an India-based consumer healthcare network offering end-to-end care through a single app - online doctor consultations, hospital visits and admissions, lab tests and radiology scans, medicine ordering, diabetes and obesity management, preventive health packages, and structured home care and recovery. The platform spans top specialities including cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics, pulmonology, internal medicine, gynaecology, ENT, paediatrics, and minimal-access and bariatric surgery, and helps families coordinate their complete health and insurance journey. PB Health is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and website; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: PCA SKIN
providers.description: PCA SKIN is a professional skincare brand specializing in dermatologically tested chemical peels and result-oriented corrective products, positioned as a leading professional chemical-peel brand among estheticians and skincare professionals. The brand's direct-to-consumer store at pcaskin.com is built on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: it implements the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) with a hosted MCP endpoint plus read-only storefront JSON, so AI shopping agents can discover the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the store's published agent surface (/llms.txt, /.well-known/ucp).

providers.name: PeopleOne Health
providers.description: PeopleOne Health is a nationwide provider of value-based, employer-funded advanced primary care, delivering comprehensive physical and mental health services with no copays, deductibles, or coinsurance for members. Its model pairs dedicated care teams with a prevention-first approach to lower total cost of care for self-funded employers while improving member health outcomes, and it was named a 2024 Best Nationwide Primary Care Provider by the Validation Institute. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, PeopleOne Health operates as a healthcare services provider rather than an API platform: member access is delivered through a healow-based patient portal and a member portal, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Perfectly
providers.description: Perfectly is an AI-native recruiting platform (Y Combinator W2026) that automates the hiring process end to end, from candidate sourcing and outreach through screening and qualification. Its employer-facing AI recruiting agent, Paul, sources, engages, and qualifies candidates to help startups fill roles in days rather than weeks, delivered as an AI-native recruiting agency paired with a forward-deployed recruiter for onboarding and configuration. Its job-seeker agent, Parker, is an AI career super-connector on iMessage and WhatsApp that helps candidates find relevant industry contacts and craft personalized outreach before roles are publicly posted. Founded by former ML scientists and engineers from Meta and TikTok, Perfectly operates as a chat- and agent-delivered hiring service rather than a public developer API; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Phil
providers.description: PHIL (PHILRx) is a healthtech company operating a digital hub and direct-to-patient platform that helps pharmaceutical brands maximize prescription starts, insurance coverage, affordability, and medication adherence. Its all-in-one platform connects pharma manufacturers, patients, and healthcare providers to streamline the prescription access experience, run affordable direct-to-patient and cash-pay programs, and improve commercial performance across the medication access journey. PHIL is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Pic-Time
providers.description: Pic-Time is an online gallery, proofing, and print-sales delivery platform for professional photographers - client galleries, slideshows, an integrated print store, and studio-management integrations. Pic-Time does not publish a public developer API, API reference, or OpenAPI specification. Automation is limited to a Zapier integration (three triggers - New Gallery Visitor, New Order Placed, Main Client Gallery Invite Sent - and one action, Create New Gallery) plus private, bilaterally-arranged partner integrations (HoneyBook, Studio Ninja, Light Blue, StyleCloud, the Pic-Time Connect WordPress plugin) that are not documented for third-party developers. No API keys, endpoints, or SDKs are published for general developer use.

providers.name: Plenna
providers.description: Plenna is a women's healthcare provider operating a network of integrated medical clinics across Mexico City, redefining health for women across every life stage. Its services span gynecology, maternity and prenatal care, fertility, menopause, contraception, gynecological surgery, psychology, nutrition, laboratory studies, vaccines and lactation support, delivered across six physical clinics (Tlalpan, Coapa, Del Valle, Polanco, San Angel and Satelite) and through Portal Plenna, a patient portal and iOS/Android mobile app for scheduling appointments, virtual consultations, test results, prescriptions and pregnancy tracking. Plenna is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pop.in
providers.description: Pop.in is a consumer social gaming platform that connects people through real-time multiplayer games including Spades, Hearts, Dominoes, Liar's Dice, crosswords, Pop Quiz trivia, and Just Chatting. Delivered as iOS and Android apps plus a web play surface at play.pop.in, the service reports over 100M downloads and 20M active users with a 4.75+ average rating. The company is backed by 500 Global and was surfaced through its portfolio; it operates a purely consumer-facing product and publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Prized
providers.description: Prized is an AI-powered platform that lets non-technical operations, support, and finance teams build, deploy, and share secure internal tools without engineering. Users describe a workflow in natural language (or bring their own coding agent such as Claude Code) and Prized builds real software on company data that is pre-connected and scoped, with least-privilege database access per tool, credential isolation, outbound-traffic proxying, and an audit trail on every access. Tools deploy behind corporate authentication and connect to 20+ services including Salesforce, Postgres, Slack, Stripe, and Notion. Prized is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company founded by Hudson Griffith and Marinos Eliades, both formerly of Gander (YC F24, acquired by Archer Aviation). Added to the API Evangelist network via the VC-portfolio pipeline and enriched from the company's public web surface.

providers.name: Radish Health
providers.description: Radish Health is a healthcare company that provides employers with a modern employee health benefit, pairing each member with a dedicated care team and physicians who handle medical issues directly or coordinate specialist referrals. The service emphasizes direct-access primary care over phone, video, and in-person visits, with rapid response times and appointment coordination aimed at reducing employer healthcare costs while improving the patient experience. Radish Health is delivered through patient-facing web and mobile apps (iOS and Android) and an employer benefits program; it is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Radish Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation — this profile captures its identity, legal/support surfaces, and domain security posture only.

providers.name: Ray Browser
providers.description: Ray Browser is an AI-powered web browser that learns a user's interests and browsing habits to personalize their internet experience. It ships a built-in agent that can run web searches and automate tasks, a curated daily Discover feed, and Ray Studio for building custom tools and dashboards without writing code. The product is currently in public beta with a free Starter plan that grants weekly credits for its AI features. Ray Browser is a consumer product; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking and enrichment.

providers.name: Reken
providers.description: Reken is an AI security company building a trust layer for the Internet to combat generative-AI-enabled fraud, phishing, scams, deepfakes, and automated social engineering. Co-founded by Shuman Ghosemajumder (who founded Google's Trust & Safety group) and Rich Griffiths, both formerly of Shape Security, Reken centers on the on-device Reken Private Core: the Reken Model Zero detection ensemble, the Reken Trust Sensor for verifying human activity, and an embedded Reken API that lets applications connect to the core while keeping data on-device with local AI models and zero AI token cost. Protected applications form the Reken Network, a self-assembling zero-trust mesh. The company is pre-launch, offering an Early Access Program; it does not yet publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Rezilient Health
providers.description: Rezilient Health is an employer-sponsored primary and specialty care provider that combines physical CloudClinics with telehealth to deliver unlimited, zero-cost care to employees on behalf of employers, health plans, health systems, and brokers. Its hybrid CloudClinic model pairs on-site medical staff with remote physicians and connected diagnostic equipment so members can access in-person and virtual visits, with the goal of lowering total healthcare spend and improving clinical outcomes. Rezilient offers patient-facing web and mobile apps for scheduling and care, but publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the honest result is that Rezilient operates a consumer/enterprise healthcare service rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Saffron
providers.description: Saffron (trysaffron.ai) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI-native technical assessment platform for engineering hiring. Candidates build real features on a company's actual codebase using AI coding tools such as Claude Code inside a sandboxed environment, while Saffron captures every keystroke and AI interaction to score submissions against custom rubrics. It provides line-by-line attribution distinguishing human-written, AI-generated, and AI-modified code, and replaces traditional phone screens, take-homes, and on-site interview loops with a single AI-integrated assessment.

providers.name: Season Health
providers.description: Season Health is a food-as-medicine platform that helps people living with chronic conditions eat well and live well. It connects patients with registered dietitians, personalized nutrition and meal plans, and medically-tailored groceries and meals, and works with health plans and care providers to deliver nutrition care as a covered benefit. The consumer and provider experiences run through app.seasonhealth.com; the company is a HIPAA-covered digital health service. Season Health is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — api.seasonhealth.com is a private application backend — so this profile captures the company's real public web properties rather than an API program.

providers.name: Shred Video
providers.description: Shred Video automates cinematic video and photo production for adventure tourism operators. Using LiDAR, GPS, smart camera technology, and proprietary algorithms, the platform automatically captures, edits, and delivers finished cinematic videos and photos to a customer's phone within seconds of an activity. It serves adventure tour operators such as skydiving centers, bungy jumping and giant swing operators, river rafting outfitters, and paragliding services, with documented clients including Skydive Utah and AJ Hackett locations in Australia and Singapore. Shred Video is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a marketing and demo-request website but publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sira Medical
providers.description: Sira Medical develops augmented reality software that transforms 3D radiological imaging into patient-specific holographic models projected onto real-world backgrounds. Delivered through head-mounted AR devices (such as Microsoft HoloLens) and mobile platforms, the technology helps surgeons perform preoperative planning with greater confidence, clinicians educate patients with understandable visualizations, medical schools train students on patient-specific anatomy, and medical-device makers design and validate implants. The company is backed by 500 Global, Eileses Capital, UCSF Innovation Ventures, and Microsoft for Startups. Sira Medical operates as a clinical AR software vendor and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: SkySpecs
providers.description: SkySpecs is a renewable energy asset management company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan that combines autonomous drone inspections, condition-monitoring hardware, and its cloud-based Horizon software platform to help wind and solar operators manage the health and performance of their assets. Horizon consolidates blade inspection imagery, drivetrain and sensor data, SCADA-based performance analytics, repair-vendor coordination, and financial reporting into one hub, with third-party data ingestion and custom integrations for fleet owners. The company reports assets under contract across six countries and is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management. SkySpecs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve developer portal today; integrations are arranged directly with the Horizon team.

providers.name: Sonans
providers.description: Sonans is an AI software company building an intelligence layer for fashion merchandising. Its collaborative AI agents replace manual coordination with autonomous workflows that bridge buying decisions and cross-functional execution, turning raw design sketches and purchase orders into production-ready assets including photorealistic product imagery, marketing copy, and catalog data synchronized across ERPs, Shopify, and B2B commerce platforms. Sonans serves fashion brands and designers (streamlining design cycles, asset enrichment, and multi-channel product launches) as well as retailers and merchants (automating assortment planning, catalog enrichment, and inventory management). The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Sonans operates a web application at app.sonans.ai but publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Sonnet Insurance
providers.description: Sonnet Insurance is a Canadian direct-to-consumer digital property and casualty insurer launched in 2016 and a member of the Definity family of companies, underwriting its own auto, home, condo, tenant, landlord and pet policies through Sonnet Insurance Company. It sells auto, home, condo, tenant and landlord coverage in Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island, and home-only coverage in British Columbia and Alberta, positioning itself as "Canada's original digital-first home and auto insurance company" with a fully online quote-and-buy flow and licensed agents for support. Sonnet is an explicit direct writer -- its own FAQ states that "a third party -- even a licensed broker -- cannot purchase a Sonnet policy on your behalf" -- so it operates no broker or agency distribution channel and therefore no ACORD/AL3 agency-download path. Its API posture is closed -- no developer, developers, docs or api subdomain resolves in DNS, every first-party developer path probed returns HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, Postman collection, webhook catalog or partner technical onboarding surface is published. The only third-party integrations Sonnet describes -- the Kanetix.ca (RATESDOTCA) quote-and-buy partnership and the Sonnet Connect brand referral program -- are privately negotiated commercial arrangements with no public technical documentation. Two machine-readable surfaces do exist and are captured here. Sonnet serves a real llms.txt at www.sonnet.ca/llms.txt that declares per-agent AI-Training, AI-Generation, AI-Summarization and AI-Crawling directives (Allow for OpenAI, Google-DeepMind and Anthropic) alongside a curated reference-content index -- an AI consent signal rather than an API contract. And the secure.sonnet.ca quote-and-buy application is driven by an undocumented first-party REST/JSON surface under /api/v1 covering quoting, binding, policy servicing, payments and identity; it is observable from Sonnet's own public JavaScript bundle but carries no documentation, no specification and no third-party terms of use, so it is recorded as observed evidence, not as an integratable API.

providers.name: Spotter
providers.description: Spotter is a creator-economy platform that invests in YouTube creators through capital, catalog licensing, and brand partnerships, and connects brands with top long-form YouTube creators for marketing and content opportunities. Its Spotter Studio product provides AI-assisted tooling that helps creators plan, ideate, and optimize their content and titles. The company reports more than $1 billion invested in creators and over 43 billion monthly views across a network that includes creators such as MrBeast, Critical Role, and Sam and Colby. Spotter is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. Spotter publishes no public developer API: contract discovery on 2026-08-13 found no OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, MCP server or A2A agent card on any Spotter host, and the Spotter Studio application backends return 503 to anonymous callers. Spotter Studio is a consumer of the YouTube Data and Analytics APIs via Google OAuth, not a provider of one.

providers.name: Startup Buffer
providers.description: Startup Buffer is a community-driven directory and platform for discovering new startups, products, and innovations across various industries. The platform offers startup submission, browsing, and discovery features through web and mobile applications.

providers.name: Startup Ranking
providers.description: Startup Ranking is a platform that tracks, ranks, and indexes startups worldwide based on web presence, social metrics, and growth signals. It provides startup discovery, competitive benchmarking, and market intelligence for investors, entrepreneurs, and researchers.

providers.name: Subway
providers.description: One of the world's largest fast-food restaurant chains specializing in submarine sandwiches and salads. Operates over 36,000 locations in more than 100 countries through its franchise model. Subway has no public developer API or self-service developer portal; ordering, store locator, nutrition, and MyWay/MVP loyalty integrations are handled through internal systems and direct franchise/partner agreements.

providers.name: TAAI Labs, Inc
providers.description: TAAI Labs, Inc operates Sparkle (sparkle.security), an AI-first secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, currently in beta, that aims to prevent vulnerabilities across the entire SDLC by embedding AI-powered security analysis into existing engineering workflows. Sparkle works across five phases — contextualize, design, build, validate, and govern — and deploys "Secure Agents" that surface risks, gather evidence, and track security decisions to give product security, AppSec, platform engineering, and engineering leadership teams audit-ready visibility across the secure SDLC. The company markets outcomes such as increased security-team productivity, reduced AI-generated risk, and full visibility, and is backed by 500 Global. The product is pre-general-availability and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation as of this profile.

providers.name: TandemAI
providers.description: TandemAI is an integrated drug discovery contract research organization (CRO) that combines proprietary AI and physics-based computational methods with in-house high-performance computing and extensive wet-lab operations to accelerate pharmaceutical research. Its cloud-enabled, data-centric, browser-based platform, TandemViz, spans hit finding, hit-to-lead and lead optimization, digital assays and workflows, medicinal chemistry and synthesis, biological assays, and a peptide platform. TandemAI is offered as an FTE-based service model that bundles wet-lab services with complimentary access to its AI and computational tools, or as a stand-alone SaaS software license. The company merged with Perpetual Medicines and is backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: The Atavist
providers.description: The Atavist is a pioneering digital longform-storytelling brand founded in 2009 by Evan Ratliff, Jefferson Rabb, and Nicholas Thompson. It comprises The Atavist Magazine, which publishes one immersive work of narrative nonfiction each month and has earned National Magazine Award and Emmy recognition, and the Atavist multimedia publishing platform for building rich, media-driven stories. Automattic (the company behind WordPress.com) acquired both the magazine and the platform in 2018; the platform's storytelling features were folded into WordPress.com and the magazine now runs on Newspack by Automattic. The Atavist exposes no public developer API or documented developer program — it is a reader-facing publication at magazine.atavist.com.

providers.name: True Anomaly
providers.description: True Anomaly is a defense-technology company building spacecraft, software, and payloads for space superiority. Its products include Jackal, a multirole space-superiority platform positioned as a tactical fighter-interceptor for contested orbital environments, and Mosaic, an autonomy software platform that transforms commander intent into autonomous action. The company serves U.S. government and allied defense customers from facilities in Centennial and Colorado Springs, Colorado; Long Beach, California; and Washington, DC. True Anomaly publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; its only machine-readable public surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact.

providers.name: TTRacing
providers.description: TTRacing is a Malaysian gaming chair and gaming furniture brand selling ergonomic gaming chairs, office chairs, and accessories through an online Shopify storefront at ttracing.my. The store is agent-commerce ready: it publishes an llms.txt and agents.md with explicit agent instructions, a UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and run buyer-approved checkout. Human customer accounts are handled via Shopify's OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 authorization server. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from live probes of its public agent-facing surface.

providers.name: Tugboat Logic
providers.description: Tugboat Logic is a security assurance and compliance automation platform acquired by OneTrust in 2021. It supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and NIST. As of 2024, the product has been rebranded under OneTrust's Certification Automation offering; legacy Tugboat Logic APIs are not publicly documented and integrations now flow through OneTrust's developer platform.

providers.name: TuneCore
providers.description: TuneCore is a Brooklyn, New York based independent music distribution and publishing administration company founded in 2006 (as YourTunes, Inc., rebranded TuneCore in 2008) and acquired by French music company Believe in 2015. TuneCore lets self-releasing artists and labels deliver recorded music to 150+ digital stores and streaming services — Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, TikTok, Tidal, Deezer, Beatport, and others — while retaining 100% of their rights and master ownership, in exchange for a flat annual distribution fee starting at $24.99/year for unlimited releases. TuneCore Publishing Administration registers compositions with performance rights organizations, mechanical rights societies, and digital service providers worldwide to collect songwriter royalties, sync, and neighboring rights income. Additional services include the TuneCore Accelerator artist development program, TuneCore Social (monetization on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts), TuneCore Direct Advance (royalty-backed capital, powered by RoyFi), mastering, and Splits for collaborator revenue sharing. TuneCore operates across 5 continents with local teams in 15+ countries through Believe's global network. There is no current public TuneCore developer API, SDK, or partner portal — an earlier white-label REST/XML "TuneCore Direct" partner API existed circa 2008-2012 (with a community Ruby gem `tunecore_direct`) but is no longer actively documented or promoted. TuneCore's public-facing surface is the artist web app at web.tunecore.com and the support/help center; any current B2B integrations run through Believe's enterprise partnerships.

providers.name: Underdog Fantasy
providers.description: Underdog (Underdog Sports, formerly Underdog Fantasy) is a Brooklyn, New York based sports gaming company founded in 2020 by Jeremy Levine that operates daily fantasy sports, pick'em, and — since 2025 — federally regulated sports prediction markets on its own proprietary technology stack. Its consumer products include Classic Pick'em, Pick'em Champions, Best Ball and other Draft Games, Streaks, Team Picks, and the Underdog Predict prediction-markets exchange, delivered through iOS, Android, and web apps rather than a public developer API. Underdog reached roughly $500M in annual revenue within five years, was valued at $1.2B after a Spark Capital-led Series C in March 2025, acquired CFTC-registered derivatives infrastructure in March 2026, and in July 2026 was the subject of a proposed acquisition by IG Group. The company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its public technical surface is limited to an RFC 9116 security.txt with a PGP key, a Honeybadger-hosted status page covering its API and Stats services, and the Underdog-Inc GitHub organization.

providers.name: User Stories
providers.description: A curated collection of API user stories following agile methodology formats. User stories capture software requirements from the end-user perspective using the format "As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]". This repository indexes user story patterns for API consumers and producers across product management, developer experience, integration design, and platform engineering contexts. Teams use these to align stakeholders, prioritize API features, track progress, and adapt to evolving requirements throughout the API lifecycle.

providers.name: Verisian
providers.description: Verisian is an AI infrastructure platform for clinical trials, giving pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs the information infrastructure required to deploy AI across their experts and processes. The platform provides full study traceability and automates statistical programming workflows: automating the validation of SDTM and ADaM analysis datasets (turning time-consuming QC double-programming into value-generating QA oversight), and generating complete define-XML files and draft reviewer's guides that are guaranteed consistent with the underlying analysis, so teams are submission-ready in hours. Verisian is cloud native, compatible with any statistical computing environment (SCE), storage, or compute, and integrates through simple file transfer with no complex API integration required. It serves statistical programmers, statisticians, data managers, medical writers, clinicians, and regulatory teams across in-house and CRO-outsourced operating models; Bayer is a named customer. There is no public developer API surface — the product is an enterprise application (app.verisian.com) accessed after sales onboarding.

providers.name: VetSource
providers.description: VetSource is a veterinary technology and pharmacy company founded in 2008 that delivers a suite of pharmacy, technology, and business services for the pet health industry. Its offerings span home-delivery prescription management (an online pharmacy and prescription workflow that lets veterinary practices prescribe and fulfill medications with compliance and revenue tools), the Vet2Pet client-engagement platform (a custom-branded app connecting practices with pet owners for communication, reminders, loyalty, and telehealth), and data/analytics services that provide industry benchmarking and practice performance insights. VetSource serves veterinary practices and pet owners across North America. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation is published; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Wabi
providers.description: Wabi is a consumer AI mini-app platform — billed as "the first personal software platform" and a "YouTube of apps" — where anyone can create, discover, share, and remix AI-generated mini-apps from a single natural-language prompt while Wabi handles the underlying infrastructure, UI, hosting, and data. Founded by Eugenia Kuyda (founder of the AI companion app Replika) and backed by a roughly $20M pre-seed round (investors include Naval Ravikant, Garry Tan, Justin Kan, and Forerunner Ventures), Wabi is an invite/beta consumer product. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation — only the consumer web app and its Terms/Privacy pages.

providers.name: Watch Club
providers.description: Watch Club is a mobile streaming and social platform for young adults, built around original coming-of-age teen drama series that viewers watch and then discuss with other fans through polls, episode reactions, and community threads. Its first original series, RETURN OFFER, launches February 2026, with a slate of additional YA series in development. The app is available on iOS and is operated by Kino Technologies Inc. Watch Club is a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company in the consumer sector; it publishes no public developer API surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Wizard
providers.description: Wizard is an AI-powered personal shopping agent for consumers. Shoppers describe what they want in natural language and Wizard searches across retailer websites, customer reviews, trusted editorial, and social content to return a tightly curated set of product recommendations, with direct checkout from retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Apple, and Target. The company is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass Wizard is a consumer-facing web/app product and exposes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface (developer/docs/api subdomains and /.well-known/security.txt all return 404).

providers.name: alphin
providers.description: alphin is a Berlin-based marketing platform for local small businesses, giving restaurants, cafes, salons, and similar SMBs an all-in-one app to manage and automate their online presence. Its product suite spans review collection (alphin Reviews), Instagram and social management (alphin Socials), professional photography (alphin Photos), local influencer marketing (alphin Local Influencers), targeted Instagram advertising (alphin Local Ads), and multi-platform profile management across Google, TripAdvisor, and Yelp (alphin Portals), consolidated into one dashboard with daily reporting and analytics. Founded in 2016 (as Freachly GmbH), alphin serves 1,000+ local businesses across Germany, Austria, the UK, and Israel, and is backed by HV Capital, Partech, Scale Capital, and Wille Finance. alphin publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; the product is delivered through its web and mobile Business App.

providers.name: Aprende
providers.description: Aprende (Aprende Institute) is an online vocational education platform delivering Spanish-language courses and diplomados to Hispanic entrepreneurs and professionals across the United States and Latin America. The platform offers on-demand, mobile-friendly training across six main areas — gastronomy, entrepreneurship, wellness, beauty, skilled trades, and hospitality/events — taught by expert instructors, and is backed by 500 Global. It operates as a consumer education company with no public developer API surface; this profile tracks its identity and web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Backstartup
providers.description: Backstartup is a Colombian tech-enabled accounting and legal services firm for startups and small businesses (notably SAS entities). It automated company formation, bookkeeping, tax filing, payroll, and legal/DIAN compliance for founders in Latin America. Backstartup has since been integrated into Numbi (numbi.ai), a tech-enabled accounting firm that operates monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN compliance on top of the accounting systems companies already use (Siigo and Alegra), pairing expert accountants with automation and AI. Backstartup's legacy domain (backstartup.com) now redirects to numbi.ai and Backstartup operates as a sub-organization within Numbi's Colombia operation. This is a services-company profile: no public developer API or OpenAPI is published. It entered the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Beengo
providers.description: Beengo operates as Appfront (appfront.ai), an all-in-one restaurant engagement and eCommerce platform backed by 500 Global. The platform gives restaurants branded online ordering, dine-in scan-and-pay, loyalty and CRM, SMS/push/email marketing campaigns, gift cards and payments, branded native iOS/Android apps, and data analytics. It integrates with major point-of-sale systems (Toast, Revel, SpeedLine, Square, Clover, PAR/Brink, Oracle Hospitality MICROS, NCR) and third-party delivery (DoorDash, Postmates). No public developer program, OpenAPI, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company identity, web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: BeyondHQ
providers.description: BeyondHQ is a distributed workforce planning platform that combines talent, cost, and location data to enable cross-functional decision making for hybrid and distributed teams. It equips HR, Real Estate, and Finance teams with a single, integrated experience that centralizes hiring and location-planning processes, providing real-time interactive comparisons across 500+ markets, 70,000+ searchable job skills, 750+ searchable occupations, and 50,000+ market-data combinations. The platform helps companies determine where to hire and physically locate their workforce using trusted, real-time data. BeyondHQ is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. BeyondHQ does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: BloomNation
providers.description: BloomNation is a flower-delivery marketplace that connects consumers with independent local florists for same-day and next-day delivery of handcrafted floral arrangements across 40+ U.S. cities and the UK. Customers shop florist-designed bouquets for occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, sympathy, and get-well, then pay with credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, or Afterpay. Distinctive features include BloomSnap photo delivery confirmation and video message cards. BloomNation also runs a florist-facing SaaS side (point-of-sale, website, and order management, now part of Promenade) that powers member shops. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company; no public developer API or documentation program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bright Machines
providers.description: Bright Machines is a San Francisco-based software-defined manufacturing company founded in 2018 by Amar Hanspal and Lior Susan that builds a full-stack intelligent automation platform for electronics and AI-infrastructure assembly. Its Microfactory pairs modular Bright Robotic Cells with Brightware, a platform operating system that orchestrates hardware, runs a machine-vision "Smart Skills" perception stack, and provides manufacturing-execution services for work orders, material management and real-time production KPIs. Bright Data, the company's data layer, unifies component, process and enterprise-system data through secure APIs and auditable data flows, and Bright Designer turns product CAD into assembly-ready digital twins using NVIDIA Omniverse on Microsoft Azure. The company has raised roughly $279M from Eclipse, BlackRock, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Jabil and others. All platform and data interfaces are delivered to customers under commercial engagement; Bright Machines publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contracts.

providers.name: Briya
providers.description: Briya builds AIRE (AI Research Environment), a privacy-first AI platform for healthcare and clinical research that lets researchers analyze real-world medical data without writing code. AIRE trains AI models on real-world data and provides domain-specific agents for literature review, hypothesis testing, population and cohort analysis, study design, and manuscript-ready output with built-in validation. Data is accessed across multiple sources without centralizing it into a warehouse, with a compliance posture aimed at HIPAA, GDPR, and FDA/EMA regulatory standards. Briya serves emerging biotech, life sciences organizations, academic institutions, and healthcare systems, with offices in New York, Nashville, and Tel Aviv. The company is backed by Insight Partners. This API Evangelist profile is an enrichment pass on a portfolio lead; Briya publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cheerz
providers.description: Cheerz is a French direct-to-consumer photo-printing brand. Customers pick photos from their phone camera roll or a connected cloud gallery in the Cheerz iOS/Android app or on cheerz.com, and Cheerz prints and ships the result as photo prints, fridge magnets, photo books and albums, wall canvases, framed prints and posters, calendars including advent calendars, puzzles, greeting and invitation cards, and the branded Cheerz Box and Memory Box gift formats. Founded in Paris in 2012 under the legal entity Printklub, backed by Serena Capital and Iron Capital, and acquired by the German photo-finishing group CEWE Stiftung & Co. KGaA in February 2018 for roughly EUR 45 million; it continues to operate as CEWE's Paris site. Cheerz publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind — it is an end-user retail product, and partnership, bulk-order and affiliate enquiries are handled by a human contact channel rather than a developer programme.

providers.name: Cino
providers.description: Cino (getcino.com) is a European consumer fintech that offers the first shared virtual card that splits and pays a group bill at the same time. Members connect their existing debit or credit cards, create a group with configurable split ratios, and each person is charged only their proportional share at the moment of payment with no pre-funding required. The shared card works online and in person for one-off or recurring expenses, integrates with Apple Pay and Google Pay, supports per-transaction and monthly spending limits, and positions itself as a replacement for bill-splitting tools like Splitwise, Tricount, PayPal, and Tikkie. Cino is available across 29 European countries and is a portfolio company of Balderton Capital. This is a consumer mobile app with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Clearing
providers.description: Clearing (WTUK Limited trading as Clearing) is a cross-border financial infrastructure provider offering multi-currency accounts, global payments, cross-currency liquidity, and digital-asset settlement to businesses operating internationally. It is a regulated electronic money institution: authorised by the UK FCA under the Electronic Money Regulations (ref 900536), licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore as a Major Payments Institution (PS20200445), and registered with FINTRAC in Canada. This record was surfaced as a stub via VC-portfolio tagging (sector originally recorded as healthcare); on enrichment the clearing.com domain resolves to this fintech/payments company, and no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: Coco Robotics
providers.description: Coco Robotics is a Santa Monica, California urban robotics company operating a fleet of zero-emission, remotely-supervised sidewalk delivery robots ("Cocobots") for last-mile food, grocery and retail delivery. Merchants do not integrate with Coco directly: Coco is consumed as a delivery service provider through Uber Eats, DoorDash, Wolt and Olo Dispatch, and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or webhooks of its own. Its public software surface is limited to a marketing site, a customer order-tracking web app, and a GitHub organization of forked ROS and infrastructure tooling.

providers.name: Compose
providers.description: Compose (Compose, Inc., compose.io) was a database-as-a-service (DBaaS) provider that offered production-ready, auto-scaling, hosted deployments of open-source databases — MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, RethinkDB, ScyllaDB, etcd, MySQL, and Disque — each provisioned with high availability, automated backups, and a REST API for programmatic management. Founded in 2010 as MongoHQ and rebranded to Compose in 2014, the company was backed by DCVC (Data Collective) and was acquired by IBM in 2015, after which the offering was folded into IBM Cloud as "IBM Compose" / IBM Cloud Databases. The standalone Compose service and its developer surface (compose.com, compose.io, apidocs.compose.com) have since been deprecated and taken offline. This profile documents the surviving, verifiable first-party artifacts — the archived GitHub organization at github.com/compose, the official Go SDK (gocomposeapi) wrapping the Compose REST API, and the official command-line tools (bach, cocli).

providers.name: Cytovale
providers.description: Cytovale is a San Francisco-based medical diagnostics company that develops early-detection technology for sepsis. Its flagship product, IntelliSep, is the first and only FDA-cleared in vitro diagnostic test for sepsis: it uses microfluidics, high-speed video, and computer-vision algorithms to measure the biophysical rigidity of tens of thousands of white blood cells, detecting the immune activation that signals sepsis risk and returning a risk stratification in roughly eight minutes. The test runs on the Cytovale System medical device in emergency-department settings. Cytovale is venture-backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Sands Capital, and the Global Health Investment Corporation. The company operates as a clinical/diagnostics device maker and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Datakrew
providers.description: Datakrew is a Singapore-based deep-tech company, a spin-off from NTU Singapore supported by Enterprise Singapore, building EV battery intelligence, fleet management, and AI-driven telematics for logistics and delivery, public transport, vehicle OEMs, rental/leasing and shared mobility operators, and mining and construction fleets. Its integrated hardware, software, and AI stack spans the OxRed (MyFleet) fleet-management and intelligence platform, OxRed Lens camera-based visualization telematics, OxRed AutoCert automated certification and compliance, GuardianAI driver-safety and collision-warning analytics, the Ask OX natural-language fleet assistant, and the ITUS Max and ITUS AutoScan edge terminals for telemetry, CAN-bus integration, and vehicle diagnostics, all aimed at optimizing battery health, safety, and operational efficiency.

providers.name: Detect Technologies
providers.description: Detect Technologies is an industrial AI company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Chennai, India, focused on transforming workplace safety, security, productivity, and asset inspections across asset-intensive industries such as oil and gas, steel, manufacturing, and energy. Its flagship platform, T-Pulse, is an AI-powered Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) management system that aggregates data from cameras, sensors, equipment, and processes to deliver near real-time risk and efficiency insights through computer vision and machine learning. The T-Pulse suite spans Workplace Safety, Workplace Operations, Workplace Inspections, and Workplace Security modules, complemented by predictive maintenance and turnaround (STO) orchestration capabilities. Detect Technologies is backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: DICE
providers.description: DICE is a mobile-first live events discovery and ticketing platform founded in London in 2014 by Phil Hutcheon. Through the DICE app (iOS and Android) and dice.fm, fans discover concerts, club nights, festivals, tours and livestreams, buy fee-transparent tickets that live securely in-app, join waiting lists for sold-out shows, and resell tickets at face value to curb touting. DICE also runs a partner business serving venues, promoters, artists and festivals with tools to reach fans, sell tickets and grow their audiences, and owns the Boiler Room brand. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, DICE operates across the UK, Europe and the US. DICE publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, security and legal surface.

providers.name: DietlyAPI
providers.description: Food & nutrition data REST API with 4.2M+ foods, calories, macros, 17 micronutrients, barcode lookup, and confidence-ranked full-text search. Data primarily from Open Food Facts (ODbL), EU-hosted, with key-optional read access.

providers.name: dopay
providers.description: dopay is a digital payroll platform operating in Egypt that lets employers register employees and disburse salaries in minutes through a single system, including permanent, temporary, and seasonal workers across construction, agriculture, hospitality, retail, healthcare, education, and manufacturing. Supervised by a bank and regulated by the Central Bank of Egypt, dopay digitizes cash-based wage payments and pairs core Salary Disbursement with an Early Pay earned-wage-access product that lets employees withdraw part of their salary before payday. Originally a Techstars-backed fintech focused on banking the unbanked, dopay is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a business web app and login but no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Douglas Elliman
providers.description: Douglas Elliman Inc. (NYSE: DOUG) is a residential real estate brokerage founded in 1911 and headquartered at 575 Madison Avenue, New York City. It is one of the largest brokerages in the New York metropolitan area and among the largest in the United States, with roughly 6,000 agents across New York, Florida, California, Texas, Colorado, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Nevada, New Jersey, Vermont, the Mid-Atlantic, and international outposts in France and Monaco. Its home market is the United States. In the value chain Douglas Elliman sits on the SELL side as a licensed brokerage and MLS participant — it consumes MLS listing data under IDX and broker agreements rather than originating a syndicated feed — and it extends into development marketing, property management, commercial brokerage, title and escrow (Douglas Elliman Title), relocation, and PropTech venture investment through New Valley Ventures. Its API posture is honest and thin: no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published access path of any kind. developer.elliman.com, developers.elliman.com, and docs.elliman.com all resolve to the marketing homepage via a wildcard catch-all rather than to a portal, and api.elliman.com exists as an IIS/ASP.NET host that returns HTTP 403 at its root with no documentation behind it. On RESO, Douglas Elliman Real Estate is listed as a Class D member (Brokers, Agents and Appraisers) on the RESO membership roster but does NOT appear in the RESO certified-organizations directory — it is a RESO member, not a RESO-certified data provider, and it publishes no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData endpoint, and no UPI surface. The single public engineering artifact the company ships is a GitHub fork of a third-party .NET RETS client library, which is consumer-side evidence that Elliman pulls MLS data in rather than producer-side evidence that it exposes any.

providers.name: Duranta
providers.description: Duranta Labs is an applied AI laboratory building geospatial and computer-vision technology to understand the physical world. Its foundation vision model, Aidan, generates accurate, current 4D digital twins from optical imagery. That model powers a Landscapers solution that lets professionals measure, design, and bid any property directly from imagery without a site visit, a general-purpose World Model for spatial intelligence, and a forthcoming AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) product that turns an address into a precise digital model. Duranta is backed by Fifth Wall.

providers.name: Earnest
providers.description: Earnest is a technology-driven consumer finance lender headquartered in San Francisco, offering student loan refinancing, private student loans, Parent PLUS loan refinancing, and personal loans through Earnest Operations LLC and its bank partner FinWise Bank. Founded in 2013 and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Battery Ventures, and Slow Ventures, Earnest uses data-driven underwriting and merit-based pricing to serve borrowers, reporting more than $24 billion in student loans refinanced and over 420,000 clients. Earnest is a consumer-facing lending brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile captures its public web, security, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Epsor
providers.description: Epsor is a French fintech, founded in 2017, that manages employee savings and retirement plans (épargne salariale et retraite) for companies and helps them turn that benefit into an HR lever. A certified B Corp and mission-driven company, Epsor ranks among the top 10 employee-savings and retirement providers in France and serves more than 2,500 corporate clients. It targets HR, Compensation & Benefits, and Finance teams at mid-size and large French firms, combining a pedagogical, personalized saver experience, an open-architecture fund range (40+ funds from 15+ asset managers, with a strong ESG/SRI focus), and year-round support to run and promote the plan. Epsor is neither an asset manager nor a bank: it is the single point of contact for companies and their employees, and delegates account-keeping to Société Générale Securities Services (SGSS). Products span PEE, PER Collectif (PERECO), PER Obligatoire, intéressement, participation, abondement, and employee share ownership. Epsor exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fastwork
providers.description: Fastwork is Thailand's leading freelance and services marketplace, connecting businesses and individuals with roughly 200,000 vetted service providers across about 300 categories — including design and graphics, web and app development, AI development and automation, marketing and advertising, writing and translation, photography and video, and lifestyle services. An escrow-based "Fastwork Guarantee" holds payment until work is delivered, protecting both buyers and freelancers. The platform serves individuals, SMEs, and enterprises with a dedicated business portal, and is expanding from Thailand into Indonesia and Vietnam. Fastwork is backed by 500 Global and Partech. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Feesable
providers.description: Feesable is a fintech infrastructure company providing embedded finance and debt capital management (treasury) tooling that connects platforms, lenders, and capital markets. Its Embedded Finance product delivers white-labeled loan origination infrastructure — KYC/KYB verification, credit decisioning, dynamic pricing, fraud detection, and servicing/collections — exposed through APIs, SDKs, and embeddable widgets so SaaS platforms, marketplaces, and B2B lenders can launch embedded lending without building fintech from scratch. Its Debt Capital Management (DCM Engine) product provides institutional-grade treasury management — credit facility modeling, covenant monitoring, borrowing-base calculations, and automated lender/regulatory reporting connected to live portfolio data. Feesable targets GCC markets with Shariah-compliant options and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. The developer surface (APIs, SDKs, sandbox keys, documentation) is partner-gated behind a partnership onboarding process rather than publicly self-serve.

providers.name: First Hawaiian Bank
providers.description: First Hawaiian Bank is Hawaii's oldest and largest financial institution, founded in 1858 and headquartered at First Hawaiian Center in Honolulu. It is a Hawaii state-chartered commercial bank and member FDIC, operating as the principal subsidiary of First Hawaiian, Inc. (NASDAQ ticker FHB), a publicly traded bank holding company. The bank serves consumer and commercial customers through roughly 57 branches in Hawaii plus locations in Guam and Saipan, offering deposit accounts, lending, wealth management, treasury/cash management, and merchant services. On the open-finance front, First Hawaiian operates no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; probes of developer.fhb.com, api.fhb.com, and fhb.com/en/developers returned no host or HTTP 404. Consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only through third-party aggregators (notably Plaid), not a direct bank API. No documented Financial Data Exchange (FDX) participation or published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture was found as of this record. Its commercial online banking product (FHB Commercial Online, formerly OBC) is a traditional web application rather than a developer-facing API surface.

providers.name: Freckle Education
providers.description: Freckle is an adaptive learning platform from Renaissance that delivers differentiated, standards-aligned math and English Language Arts (ELA) practice for K-12 students. Teachers assign work and monitor progress while students practice at their own level, with the platform adapting question difficulty to each learner across 70,000+ math questions and 1,000+ ELA passages. Administrators manage rosters and dashboards at the school and district level. Freckle is a school- and classroom-facing application acquired by Renaissance Learning; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal, so this profile captures its identity, published web properties, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Gametime
providers.description: Gametime is a mobile-first ticket marketplace for last-minute tickets to live sports, concerts, comedy, and theater across the United States and Canada. Founded in 2012 by Brad Griffith and headquartered in San Francisco, Gametime United, Inc. lets fans buy tickets up to roughly 90 minutes after an event begins, with all-in (fee-inclusive) pricing, a two-tap checkout, mobile ticket delivery, and buyer guarantees (Lowest Price Guarantee and lightning refunds). The company is backed by Accel, GV, and others. Gametime does not publish a public developer API; it runs a B2B "API Seller" program for professional point-of-sale sellers. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: GE Vernova
providers.description: GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy through its innovative portfolio of electrification, power, and decarbonization technologies. Spun off from General Electric, GE Vernova brings together the legacy GE Power, Renewable Energy, Digital, and Energy Financial Services businesses to help solve the world's energy transition challenges.

providers.name: Gebeya
providers.description: Gebeya is an Ethiopian talent-cloud and marketplace technology company headquartered in Addis Ababa, founded in 2016 by Amadou Daffe and Hiruy Amanuel. It trains, vets, and connects African tech talent with organizations, and provides a Marketplace-as-a-Service platform (Gebeya-Jenga) that lets entrepreneurs launch branded, multi-tenant service marketplaces with built-in payments and analytics.
