The company sells physical robotics kits and companion apps such as the browser-based Cubelets Console with Blockly and C coding rather than a public HTTP API; programmatic access is provided through first-party open-source Python driver libraries published on PyPI and maintained under the official DexterInd GitHub organization.

providers.name: Nth Cycle
providers.description: Nth Cycle is a critical mineral refining company headquartered in Beverly, Massachusetts, that recovers production-grade nickel, cobalt, copper and rare earth elements from mined ore, low-grade tailings and recycled industrial scrap. Its patented OYSTER platform uses electro-extraction — an alternative to conventional hydrometallurgy and pyrometallurgy that combines electrochemistry, filtration and chemical precipitation into a single continuous, closed-loop architecture — to deliver modular refining at roughly 70% lower capital intensity, 75% less waste, and economic viability at 5-10x smaller scale than a centralized refinery. Systems install inside existing buildings and can be deployed in as little as two years including permitting, under licensing, build-own-operate tolling, or multi-feedstock off-take models. The company operates the first domestic commercial-scale nickel and cobalt scrap refining system in Fairfield, Ohio, holds a $1.1 billion offtake agreement with Trafigura, was selected by the U.S. Department of Energy for award negotiations of up to $100 million toward a new critical mineral refining facility, and has announced a NYSE listing via business combination with Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI. Enrichment probing on 2026-08-26 found no public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger/GraphQL/AsyncAPI contract, developer portal, SDK or package-registry entry, CLI, MCP server, A2A agent card, gRPC/Protobuf or WSDL contract, webhook surface, or served /.well-known document — Nth Cycle is a materials refining company, not an API provider.

providers.name: Omnidian
providers.description: Omnidian, Inc. is a Seattle-based clean energy performance assurance company, founded in 2015, that protects and accelerates investments in residential and commercial solar and battery storage. Its proprietary, machine-learning driven software platform continuously monitors distributed solar assets, diagnoses hardware, communication and environmental faults such as soiling, shading and snow, dispatches a nationwide field service technician network across 48 states, Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico, and underwrites a 95% energy production guarantee that reimburses owners for covered shortfalls. Omnidian serves installers, EPCs, developers, IPPs, solar financing providers, commercial real estate owners and asset investors, and is a Certified B Corporation and a member of the SunSpec Alliance. Its monitoring platform, client portal and field service partner portal are operated as private, authenticated systems; Omnidian publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Oshi Health
providers.description: Oshi Health is a virtual, whole-person gastrointestinal (GI) care clinic delivering insurance-covered telehealth to patients with digestive conditions such as IBS, GERD, Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis. Care is provided by a coordinated team of GI providers, registered dietitians, and gut-brain behavioral health specialists, and is offered to members through major health plans and employers. Oshi Health is a patient-facing healthcare services company rather than an API producer; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched with the artifacts the company genuinely publishes.

providers.name: Parklio
providers.description: Seamlessly integrate your existing systems or products with Parklio API so you can scale your operations and monitor parking space usage in real time. It provides access to your data in a way that works best for you, whether through integration, automation, or full customization. The API is RESTful with JSON responses, and Android and iOS SDKs are available on request.

providers.name: Presidio Inc
providers.description: Presidio Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Presidio Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Quaise Energy
providers.description: Quaise Energy is a deep-geothermal energy company and MIT spinout, founded in 2018 by Carlos Araque and Matthew Houde out of a decade of millimeter-wave research by Paul Woskov at the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center. Quaise is developing millimeter-wave (MMW) drilling — using a gyrotron to vaporize rather than grind rock — to reach supercritical conditions several kilometers down, where temperatures approach 500 degrees C, and to convert existing fossil-fuel power stations to superhot geothermal baseload. The company drilled 100 meters with the technique at its Central Texas field site in 2025. Quaise is an energy and hardware company: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract. Its only public web application is a levelized-cost-of-energy (LCOE) calculator whose full functionality sits behind an AWS Cognito login.

providers.name: Raisin
providers.description: Raisin is a fintech savings and investment marketplace that gives consumers access to high-yield savings accounts, CDs, and cash deposit products from a network of banks and credit unions through a single account and login. Founded in Berlin (originally as WeltSparen / SavingGlobal) and operating in the US, Germany, and across Europe, Raisin connects more than one million customers with partner banks, handling onboarding, KYC, account management, and deposit brokerage. Its sister entity Raisin Bank provides a Banking-as-a-Service platform for fintechs. Raisin exposes no public, self-serve developer API or documentation portal; integrations are partner-only and its consumer surface is web and mobile apps. Backed by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead.

providers.name: Rephrase.ai
providers.description: Rephrase.ai is a Bengaluru-based generative-AI startup whose text-to-video platform, Rephrase Studio, turns plain text scripts into videos of digital human avatars ("actors") that speak the script with lip-synced, natural voices. It exposed a Rephrase Studio API for programmatic video generation (list actors and voices, create and export videos, poll video status) secured with OAuth2 bearer tokens. Backed by Techstars, Rephrase.ai was acquired by Adobe in November 2023 and its technology folded into Adobe's video and generative-AI offerings; the standalone product hosts have since been decommissioned, though the legacy API reference remains hosted on ReadMe. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist for historical and enrichment purposes.

providers.name: Robert Half International
providers.description: Robert Half International is the world's first and largest specialized staffing and talent solutions firm. Founded in 1948, it provides contract, temporary, and permanent placement solutions across finance and accounting, technology, marketing, legal, and administrative fields. The company is the parent of Protiviti, a global consulting firm. Robert Half does not publicly expose a developer API; integration is available through partner programs and ATS ecosystem connectors. Listed in the Fortune 500.

providers.name: SafeShepherd
providers.description: Safe Shepherd is a consumer privacy and identity-protection service that proactively removes an individual's personal information from the internet and from marketing and data-broker databases. It continuously scans public websites and private databases for a subscriber's personal data, sends real-time email alerts when records are found, and submits opt-out and deletion requests on the subscriber's behalf (with manual removal instructions where automated removal is not possible). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the public site is a consumer product with no developer/API surface.

providers.name: Sanctuary AI
providers.description: Sanctuary AI is a Vancouver, British Columbia humanoid robotics company on a mission to create and deploy industrial-grade general-purpose humanoid robots to help address growing labor challenges. Its flagship product is Phoenix, a bipedal humanoid robot designed for dull, dirty, and dangerous work in automotive, manufacturing, and logistics environments. Phoenix is driven by Carbon, Sanctuary AI's proprietary AI control system that mimics human cognitive subsystems — memory, sight, sound, and touch — to translate natural-language tasks into dexterous physical actions. The company is vertically integrated, designing everything from motors and actuators through to generative AI algorithms in-house. Co-founded by James Wells (CEO) and Olivia Norton (CTO/CPO), Sanctuary AI has a private GitHub organization with no public repositories, no developer portal, no public API, no SDK, and no published OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications. The commercial model is hardware sales and enterprise deployments; Carbon is a proprietary on-board system and there is no public developer surface.

providers.name: Securian Financial
providers.description: Securian Financial Group is a Saint Paul, Minnesota-based mutual holding company offering life insurance, annuities, institutional retirement solutions, trust services, investment management and group workplace benefits to individuals, employers, financial institutions and institutional clients across the United States and Canada. Its operating companies include Minnesota Life Insurance Company, Securian Life Insurance Company, Securian Asset Management and Securian Canada. Securian does not run a public developer program: its integration surfaces are partner-facing and sales-gated. Securian Platform Connect exchanges benefits data with employer benefits-administration platforms using LIMRA LDEx standards (Evidence of Insurability and Benefits Enrollment Management) plus SSO, API notifications and file feeds, and FlexTech - launched March 2026 with Walnut - embeds payment protection into digital lending journeys through API-based integration. Neither publishes a machine-readable contract, developer portal or self-service onboarding.

providers.name: Shoreline
providers.description: Shoreline Software Inc. built an incident-automation platform for cloud operations, letting SRE and platform teams close the loop between detection and repair: an alarm defines when there is an issue, an action defines the command that fixes it, and a bot binds the two into an auto-remediation loop that runs without a human. The platform also shipped runbooks, notebooks, resource queries, file distribution and an Op query language, driven from a UI, a CLI, notebooks or Terraform. NVIDIA acquired Shoreline in July 2024 and the independent product surface has since been decommissioned — shoreline.io and docs.shoreline.io no longer resolve, and www.shoreline.io redirects in full to nvidia.com. The only first-party developer artifact still published is the Terraform provider, now archived.

providers.name: Sparkles
providers.description: Sparkles (sparkles.dev) is a San Francisco developer-tools startup in Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch building AI coding agents for a whole team, not just engineers. A technical owner connects the company's GitHub repositories and configures environment variables, after which any teammate on a company email address can describe a change and have an agent implement it inside an isolated sandbox and open a GitHub pull request for developer review. Positioned as "Lovable for existing projects," it lets marketers, designers, and operations staff ship safe code changes without needing to know Git or the command line. As of this profile Sparkles exposes only a marketing and product website plus legal pages; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, CLI, or OpenAPI, so this record captures verified company identity rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Swytchcode
providers.description: Deterministic API-execution layer for AI agents and developers that sits between an agent and production APIs, handling auth, retries, idempotency, and policy control across 2,000+ APIs. Consumable via a public npm-installable CLI and a local MCP server, with a published llms.txt.

providers.name: Sykes Enterprises
providers.description: Sykes Enterprises is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sykes Enterprises API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Travelstop
providers.description: Travelstop (rebranded WegoPro) is a modern corporate travel and expense management platform founded in Singapore and backed by Accel. Companies use it to book flights and hotels from multiple supply partners, enforce travel policy and approval workflows, and automate expense reporting with receipt scanning (OCR), duplicate detection, and fraud prevention. Expense and accounting data syncs to Xero and QuickBooks, and native iOS and Android apps support travelers on the move. The product exposes prebuilt in-app accounting integrations rather than a public, self-serve developer API; this profile enriches its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: TreeHouse Foods
providers.description: TreeHouse Foods is one of the largest manufacturers of private label packaged foods and beverages in North America, producing snack and convenience foods for retail grocery and foodservice customers. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE (THS) and is headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois. TreeHouse Foods produces over 1,600 SKUs across snacking, beverage, and meal preparation categories.

providers.name: Tronox Holdings
providers.description: Tronox Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Tronox Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TTEC Holdings
providers.description: TTEC Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The TTEC Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Twill
providers.description: Twill is a referral-based recruiting platform with the tagline "talent recommended talent." It makes hiring easier and faster by having a network of more than 50,000 vetted, experienced professionals across engineering, product, sales, and growth recommend their peers and friends for open roles, producing warm introductions to passive candidates instead of recruiter cold outreach. Twill advertises an average 22-day time to hire, a 90-day retention guarantee on placements, flat-fee pricing, and intelligent matching built in partnership with MIT's Generative AI Lab. The company is backed by Bloomberg Beta and does not currently publish a public developer API or API documentation; api.withtwill.com serves its private platform backend.

providers.name: Up&Up
providers.description: Up&Up (legal name Homevest Inc.) is a New York-based rental housing platform that lets renters build wealth while they rent. Instead of a traditional security deposit, renters contribute to an Up&Up Wallet that grows through their own contributions, a share of monthly rental profits, and appreciation in the home's value; at lease end they can buy the home, transfer the wallet to another Up&Up rental, renew, or cash out. Founded by Michael Wong, Ryan Brown, and Ben Wong, and backed by Khosla Ventures, Up&Up operates a consumer web application and a private backend at api.upandup.co, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Vela
providers.description: Vela is an AI scheduling assistant from Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch that handles the ambiguity that breaks scheduling. Added to any email thread or messaging conversation, it negotiates on the user's behalf — reading context, proposing meeting times across timezones, following up with participants, detecting calendar conflicts, rescheduling, and sending invites once scheduling is finalized. It works across Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone, and is used by enterprise recruiters coordinating thousands of multi-party interviews a week as well as executives who need white-glove coordination at scale.

providers.name: Westlake Chemical
providers.description: Westlake Chemical (now Westlake Corporation) is a global manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals, polymers, building products, and specialty chemicals. The company produces ethylene, polyethylene, PVC, chlor-alkali, epoxy resins, and fabricated building products serving packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction markets worldwide.

providers.name: Zmanda
providers.description: Zmanda is an enterprise backup and recovery software provider and the commercial steward of the open-source Amanda (Advanced Maryland Automatic Network Disk Archiver) project. Its products protect Linux, Windows and macOS systems, databases, and application data with agent-based and agentless backups that write to local disk, tape, and public-cloud object storage. The company maintains an active GitHub organization (github.com/zmanda) around the Amanda backup engine and related tooling, operates a customer-facing management portal at the Zmanda Network (network.zmanda.com), and publishes API documentation for programmatic backup and recovery management at api.zmanda.com. Zmanda was an early portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: ABILITY Network (Inovalon)
providers.description: ABILITY Network is a healthcare SaaS business acquired by Inovalon in 2018 and now delivered as part of the cloud-based Inovalon ONE Platform. It provides US healthcare providers with software for medical billing and claims management, eligibility verification, revenue cycle management, clinical quality reporting, patient access, and workforce/staffing and care coordination. Inovalon pairs these provider-facing applications with large national datasets and analytics to support data-driven healthcare across payers, providers, pharmacies, and life-sciences organizations. Developer access to Inovalon ONE APIs is offered through the authenticated Inovalon developer portal at developer.inovalonone.com, which exposes sandbox, staging, and live environments.

providers.name: AfterHour
providers.description: AfterHour is a social copy-trading and investing community for retail investors, founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco. The mobile app lets verified traders connect their real brokerage accounts and share live, proven positions — more than $300M in live trades every day — so members can follow top traders, copy trades, discuss tickers in real-time stock chat rooms, receive alerts, and track their own portfolios. AfterHour is backed by Founders Fund and General Catalyst. This provider was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Alto Pharmacy
providers.description: Alto Pharmacy is a San Francisco-based digital pharmacy and pharmacy-technology company (founded 2015 as ScriptDash) that combines a full-service licensed pharmacy with a proprietary pharmacy operating system, Alto OS. Alto fills retail, specialty and fertility prescriptions with same-day courier delivery, pharmacist care and automated benefits investigation, and it sells that stack to industry partners as Alto Hub+, Alto Dispensing and Alto Complete — hub services, dispensing and end-to-end pharmacy-as-a-service for pharmaceutical manufacturers, health plans, health systems and digital health companies. Alto markets intake, transfer and Surescripts-based integrations to those partners, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable specification; technical access runs through its partnerships team.

providers.name: Arima Genomics
providers.description: Arima Genomics is a San Diego based cancer diagnostics company built on Hi-C sequencing and 3D genome science. Founded in 2015 to study how DNA is organized in three dimensions, the company now develops clinical tests and technology platforms that detect cancer-driving structural alterations — noncanonical fusions, enhancer hijacking, extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) and complex rearrangements — from routine FFPE tumor tissue that conventional DNA and RNA profiling can leave unresolved. Its surface spans research products (Arima-HiC+, Arima High Coverage HiC, Promoter and Custom Capture HiC, HiC FFPE, Arima CiFi), lab services including Single Cell Methyl-3C and multi-omics, the Aventa FusionPlus and Aventa Lymphoma clinical tests, and biopharma partnership programs. Arima publishes open-source bioinformatics pipelines on GitHub (Arima-HiC mapping pipeline, Arima-CHiC, Arima-SV-Pipeline) but operates no public web API, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Arrive AI
providers.description: Arrive AI (Nasdaq: ARAI) is an autonomous last-mile delivery company headquartered in Fishers, Indiana, founded by Dan O'Toole and originally operating as DroneDek. Its patented Autonomous Last Mile (ALM) platform is anchored by the Arrive Point, an AI-powered smart mailbox that accepts and dispatches parcels to and from drones, ground robots and human couriers, with temperature-controlled compartments, real-time tracking, smart logistics alerts and chain-of-custody controls aimed at healthcare, pharmacy and e-commerce logistics. The company markets hardware plus a network service; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Asimov
providers.description: Asimov is a synthetic biology company building an integrated platform for the intelligent design of living systems. Its Edge Systems (CHO for biologics, LV for cell therapies, AAV for gene therapies, and RNA for RNA medicines) combine engineered mammalian host cells, a library of more than 1,000 validated genetic parts, and cloud-based genetic design software so biopharma partners can design and manufacture advanced therapeutics at higher titers and on faster timelines. Backed by a16z, DCVC, Wing Venture Capital, and Y Combinator. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Assemble
providers.description: Assemble builds autonomous AI agents that help enterprise IT and business-systems teams automate development work inside core platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, and NetSuite. The agents scope changes across integrated ERP, CRM, and HRIS systems, understand cross-system dependencies, implement and validate modifications, and keep a complete audit trail so teams can review agent work, approve modifications, and revert individual changes or restore a system to a prior state. Assemble is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company targeting IT and business-systems teams managing complex enterprise transformations. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or OpenAPI, so only its verified public identity and website properties are captured.

providers.name: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings
providers.description: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings is a global airfreight, charter, and aircraft leasing group headquartered in Purchase, New York and operating across more than 80 countries and 330+ airports. The holding company positions itself as the "Leader in Aviation Outsourcing" and runs three operating businesses: Atlas Air (ACMI, CMI, charter, and military/government cargo and passenger operations on Boeing 747-400F, 747-8F, 777F, 767, and 737-800BCF freighters), Polar Air Cargo (scheduled airport-to-airport cargo network, historically a joint venture with DHL), and Titan Aviation Leasing (commercial aircraft acquisition, leasing, and sale-leaseback services). Atlas is the largest operator of the Boeing 747 freighter, the Dreamlifter operator for Boeing, and one of the principal lift providers for Amazon Air's middle-mile network. In August 2022 a consortium led by Apollo Global Management with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital agreed to take the company private in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.2 billion; the deal closed in March 2023, delisting the company (formerly Nasdaq: AAWW). As a freight carrier the group does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs — integrations with shippers, forwarders, and customers are delivered through private B2B channels (EDI, Cargo-IMP/XML messaging, airwaybill tracking on polaraircargo.com, and account-managed connectivity). A "Track Shipment" tool and a Special Loads request form (specialloads.atlasair.com) are the principal self-service surfaces; an internal-facing GitHub organization (Atlas-Air-Data-Platform) exists but publishes no public repos.

providers.name: AutoZone
providers.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

providers.name: Avenue One
providers.description: Avenue One is a New York-based technology service platform and investment marketplace for institutional owners, buyers, sellers, lenders and borrowers of residential rental real estate. Founded in 2020, it connects institutional debt and equity capital to local operating partners and property owners across 21+ U.S. markets, combining proprietary property data, automated valuation, and a vetted partner network to find, finance, buy, renovate, lease, manage and sell single-family rental homes at scale. Its service lines span lending (bridge and SFR portfolio loans), strategy development, acquisitions, renovations, asset management, title and brokerage or dispositions. The company reports $2.2B+ of capital deployed. Its software runs as a private, login-gated product suite ("AvenueOS") for internal, builder, investor and partner users; no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: BabyCenter
providers.description: BabyCenter is an online pregnancy and parenting media company founded in 1997 and operated today by Everyday Health Group, a division of Ziff Davis. It provides medically reviewed information and interactive tools covering conception, pregnancy, birth, and early childhood development, and publishes the widely used "My Pregnancy & Baby Today" mobile app for iOS and Android used by hundreds of millions of expecting and new parents worldwide. BabyCenter operates as a content and community destination rather than an API platform: it does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or hosted API, and its verified GitHub organization contains only forked iOS libraries. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public operational surface — domain security posture, a live RFC 9116 security.txt with a Ziff Davis Bugcrowd vulnerability disclosure program, and its editorial/legal properties.

providers.name: Bacca.ai
providers.description: Bacca.ai is an AI-driven Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) platform that deploys an autonomous agent functioning as a Tier-1 on-call engineer. It ingests operational context from Slack, Jira, documentation, logs, traces, and metrics to build a proprietary Knowledge Graph of an organization's systems, then contextualizes and deduplicates alerts, identifies root causes with high accuracy, automates incident war rooms and post-mortem generation, and surfaces reports on system failures and hotspots. Bacca reports cutting Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) by roughly 40-60%. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company deploys on Google Cloud (cloud or on-prem) with single-tenant data isolation and SOC 2 Type I & II attestation. Backed by Homebrew.

providers.name: BillTrim
providers.description: BillTrim is a consumer bill-management and negotiation service that helps households lower, monitor, and pay their recurring bills. Its team negotiates with providers on the customer's behalf (up to twice a year), watches for price increases before autopay processes, and can pay bills automatically from a connected bank account. BillTrim advertises support for 20,000+ service providers across internet, cable, phone, insurance, and other recurring household expenses. Backed by 500 Global, it operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile application; no public developer API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Braiins
providers.description: Braiins is a Bitcoin mining technology company operating the world's longest-running Bitcoin mining pool (Slush Pool, now Braiins Pool), developing Braiins OS+ mining firmware, and pioneering the Stratum V2 next-generation mining protocol. Braiins Academy provides educational resources on Bitcoin mining, and the company publishes a public Mining Insights API with network statistics. Stratum V2 increases mining security, bandwidth efficiency, and miner autonomy through decentralized transaction selection.

providers.name: Brilliant
providers.description: Brilliant is an online learning platform for interactive STEM education, covering mathematics, computer science, data, and science. Headquartered in San Francisco and used by over ten million learners worldwide, Brilliant pairs guided, problem-first lessons with adaptive practice that blends classic intelligent tutoring systems, machine-learning recommender systems, and natural-language conversations. The platform is delivered through brilliant.org and native iOS and Android apps, with a freemium model and a Brilliant Premium subscription that unlocks the full course catalog, including expanding AI-powered features such as personalized tutoring conversations and on-the-fly generation of interactive content. Brilliant operates as a direct-to-consumer subscription business with an educator program for classroom access; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program, and the `github.com/brilliant` org on GitHub is an unrelated namespace of personal projects rather than an official Brilliant presence.

providers.name: Brinks
providers.description: Brink's is a global leader in secure cash management, armored transport, ATM services, and financial security solutions. The company serves retail, restaurant, financial institutions, and entertainment businesses with its Total Cash Management platform, combining hardware, software, and logistics services. Brink's digital customer portal 24SEVEN ACCESS enables businesses to track cash deposits, order change, and manage operations via mobile and desktop interfaces. Additional products include the Brink's Armored Account payment processing service, Brink's Money paycard for employee payments, and RetailBox point-of-sale cash management.

providers.name: Camfer
providers.description: Camfer is a Y Combinator-backed startup (S24) building an AI mechanical engineer — an AI-powered CAD tool that plugs into SolidWorks and lets engineers generate parametric designs from natural language prompts and images. Its camfy text-to-CAD model produces editable feature-tree geometry, automates repetitive modeling tasks, answers questions about a model without manual feature-tree navigation, and gives real-time design feedback. The product is a downloadable desktop application (currently in invite-only beta), not a public API; the company is backed by Y Combinator, Next47, Bloomberg Beta, Octave Fund, and the founders of Dropbox, Airtable, and Clari.

providers.name: Capstan Medical
providers.description: Capstan Medical is a Santa Cruz, California medical device company founded in 2020 out of the Occam Labs incubator by Dan Wallace, with Maggie Nixon as CEO. The company is developing a surgical robotics platform for structural heart disease, merging robotic catheter navigation with next-generation transcatheter mitral and tricuspid valve implants so heart valves can be repaired or replaced without open heart surgery. In 2025 Capstan completed what it describes as the world's first robotic catheter mitral valve replacements in humans, and it raised a $110M Series C led by Eclipse with participation from Intuitive Ventures and Yu Galaxy, bringing total funding past $150M ahead of a second-generation system planned for 2026. Capstan is pre-commercial and regulated medical device focused: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contracts.

providers.name: Carreira Beauty
providers.description: Carreira Beauty (carreirabeauty.com) is a Brazilian online job marketplace connecting beauty, aesthetics, and wellness professionals with employment and freelance opportunities. The platform operates as a two-sided network that lets professionals — manicurists, hairdressers, estheticians, makeup artists, barbers, masotherapists, eyebrow designers, and salon receptionists — create a free professional profile and discover nearby openings, while salons, aesthetic clinics, spas, and studios post jobs and freelance ("freelas") shifts. It offers geographic filtering to match professionals with local roles, direct employer-to-professional communication over WhatsApp, and one free job posting per business with no credit card required. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carreira Beauty is a consumer web application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Clear Labs
providers.description: Clear Labs builds automated next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms that combine laboratory robotics, cloud software, and bioinformatics to deliver genomic data and actionable insights. Its product lines span oncology research (Clear Dx), infectious-disease and microbial genomics (Clear Ix), and food-safety pathogen testing (Clear Safety) for organisms such as Listeria and Salmonella. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, Menlo Ventures, and Wing Venture Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Clear Labs publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation as of this profile; the record captures company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Click Therapeutics
providers.description: Click Therapeutics, Inc. is a New York-headquartered digital medicine company founded in 2012 by David Benshoof Klein that develops, validates, and commercializes software as prescription medical treatments — the category it named Digital Therapeutics. Its AI-enabled platform targets diseases with an underlying neurological or behavioral component through cognitive and neurobehavioral mechanisms, delivered as smartphone software used independently or alongside biomedical therapy (Software-Enhanced Drugs). Authorized and commercial programs include CT-152 (Rejoyn, major depressive disorder, developed with Otsuka), CT-132 (episodic migraine) and AspyreRx (type 2 diabetes), with a pipeline spanning schizophrenia (CT-155 with Boehringer Ingelheim, CT-156), opioid use disorder, multiple sclerosis, atopic dermatitis, obesity, oncology, insomnia and acute coronary syndrome. Click publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK — its software is distributed as regulated prescription therapeutics, not as a platform.

providers.name: Clickable
providers.description: Clickable is a marketing analytics and digital advertising platform founded in 2006 that serves as an ads and analytics partner for businesses and agencies. The company builds award-winning pay-per-click (PPC) advertising tools for search and social campaigns and delivers customized reporting that cuts through data overload so marketers can focus on the metrics that matter. Clickable also offers VIN retention reporting purpose-built for automotive dealerships to improve customer retention. Backed by Union Square Ventures, the company focuses on relationship-driven managed advertising and analytics services rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Converge Bio
providers.description: Converge Bio is a generative-AI platform for life sciences that accelerates drug development across discovery, molecular design, and manufacturing. It trains Bio-LLM foundation models directly on biological languages (DNA, RNA, and protein sequences) and delivers them through the Converge Computational Lab, whose applications include ConvergeAB (AI antibody design across IgG/VHH/bispecific formats), ConvergeGEO (protein gene-expression optimization across CHO/HEK293/E. coli and other cell systems), ConvergeCELL (virtual cell simulation for target and biomarker discovery), and a Patent Extractor for mining antibody sequences. The platform is delivered to biotech and pharmaceutical customers under a Request Access engagement model; there is no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve documentation surface today. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners ($25M Series A, January 2026); founded 2023.

providers.name: Cooleaf
providers.description: Cooleaf is an employee engagement, recognition, and rewards platform built by ITA Group that helps HR and people leaders create lasting engagement across their organizations. The platform lets teams recognize peers, reward performance and KPIs, celebrate milestones and anniversaries, run pulse surveys and challenges, deliver training and programming, and surface engagement analytics through manager dashboards. Cooleaf meets employees where they already work by embedding recognition into Slack and Microsoft Teams and syncing people data through connectors like Zapier and Workday. Cooleaf is delivered as a closed SaaS product with a hosted web application and login; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference, so this API Evangelist profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and the integration surface it exposes to customers rather than a developer program.

providers.name: Current
providers.description: Current (Finco Services, Inc.) is a New York City-based U.S. financial technology company operating a mobile-first consumer banking platform serving over six million members. Through partner banks Choice Financial Group and Cross River Bank it offers fee-free spending accounts with early direct deposit (up to two days early), fee-free overdraft, and paycheck advances; Savings Pods earning competitive APY with automated Round-Ups; the Build Card for responsible credit building without a traditional credit check; fee-free cryptocurrency trading; and teen banking accounts with parental controls and automatic allowances. Current is a technology company, not a bank. It does NOT publish a first-party public developer API or developer portal — no developer.current.com (does not resolve), current.com/developers and current.com/api return 404, and api.current.com is an undocumented mobile-app backend. Programmatic access to member account data is available only through third-party open-finance aggregators (Plaid), on a consumer-permissioned basis. This profile captures the company's public web, legal, and security surface and its aggregator-only data-access posture.

providers.name: CUUP, Inc.
providers.description: CUUP, Inc. is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer intimates brand founded in 2018 by Abby Morgan and Kearnon O'Molony, offering precision-fit bras, underwear, loungewear, apparel, and swim across an extended range of cup and band sizes sold through its shopcuup.com online store. Backed by Insight Partners and Forerunner Ventures, CUUP was acquired by FULLBEAUTY Brands in July 2023 and now runs on the FULLBEAUTY commerce platform. As a consumer retail company it exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web presence, domain security posture, and commercial policy pages.

providers.name: Dejbox (Refectory)
providers.description: Dejbox is a French corporate-catering company founded in Lille in 2015 by Adrien Verhack and Vincent Dupied, acquired by the Carrefour Group in January 2020 and since rebranded as Refectory (refectory.fr). It delivers prepared, seasonal meals to employees of companies located in the peripheral zones of major French cities via a digital canteen (click-and-collect precommande before 10:30) and connected self-service fridges, controlling 100% of its value chain through its own Manufactures and a national network of 23 logistics hubs. Originally surfaced as a Partech portfolio company, it operates in Bordeaux, Grenoble, Lille, Lyon, Nantes, Paris and other French cities. Its consumer platform runs on a public OAuth2/OIDC identity server (customers.refectory.fr) and an API gateway (gateway.refectory.fr).

providers.name: Draxon
providers.description: Draxon is a Berlin-based company (founded 2025, backed by HV Capital and Point Nine) that provides IATA-certified virtual reality training for airport ground handling operations. The platform ships pre-configured Meta Quest VR headsets and an immersive training library covering ramp equipment such as belt loaders, tractors, pushback tugs, GPUs and towable stairs, plus safety procedures and hand signals for frontline ramp personnel. Its Trainer Hub delivers automated, IATA-compliant certification tracking with self-paced or instructor-led modules. Draxon operates as a B2B SaaS training provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: EDITED
providers.description: EDITED is an AI-powered retail intelligence platform that helps retailers, buyers, merchandisers, planners, designers, and eCommerce teams make data-driven decisions across assortment, pricing, and promotions. Its Market API (the EDITED Data product) exposes a large normalized retail market data set — SKUs, brands, categories, pricing, and assortment signals across thousands of retailers and many countries — so organizations can benchmark against competitors in real time, spot emerging trends early, and integrate competitive intelligence into their own systems. The company is a Seedcamp portfolio company; access to the Market API is sales-gated (demo / contact sales) with no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Ejen2u
providers.description: Ejen2u is a Malaysian reseller and agent-management technology company that operates one of the country's largest cloud-based reseller ecosystems for MSME brand owners, stockists, agents, dropshippers, and affiliates. Its platform spans EjenGO, a digital reseller and stockist management system; WEMAP, an entrepreneurial education program; and EjenVenture, custom reseller-network solutions for corporate brands, alongside fintech and logistics integrations (Pos Laju, Boost, Curlec, Delyva, J&T). Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seri Kembangan, Ejen2u is backed by 500 Global, Gobi Partners, and Artem Ventures, and has facilitated hundreds of millions of ringgit in reseller commerce across a network of hundreds of thousands of agents. It exposes no public developer API today; this profile is an API Evangelist network entry enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Ellis
providers.description: Ellis is a modern business immigration platform and law firm that helps company People and HR teams secure U.S. work visas and green cards for skilled talent. The platform combines licensed immigration attorneys with software for centralized case management, document storage, status tracking, and program analytics, covering employment-based visas (H-1B, TN, O-1, L-1, J-1, E-1/E-2, E-3), green cards (EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, EB-2/EB-3 PERM), and naturalization. Ellis is a Kindred Ventures portfolio company. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Ellis publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable artifacts at this time.

providers.name: EPAM Systems
providers.description: EPAM Systems is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EPAM Systems API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Execthread
providers.description: ExecThread is a selective, invitation-based network where successful executives discreetly share confidential, recruiter-led job opportunities with one another that are not posted on public job boards. The membership platform matches vetted senior professionals with unadvertised executive-level roles, offers executive branding services and resume review, and runs a points-based referral economy for members who contribute opportunities. Founded as a private career marketplace, it has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 and by the Financial Times. It is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it exposes no public API or developer surface as of this profile.

providers.name: EyeLights
providers.description: EyeLights is a French deep-tech company building augmented reality head-up display (HUD) technology for riders and pilots. Its products project GPS navigation, speed, intercom, radar and call information into the rider's line of sight: EyeRide, a universal HUD accessory compatible with any motorcycle helmet; the GT-AIR 3 Smart, an integrated head-up display visor built into a SHOEI helmet; the APEX HUD glasses for general aviation; and Pulse Ultra, a universal Bluetooth intercom. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at eye-lights.com and runs customer support on Odoo. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; EyeLights publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time, so this record captures its consumer web, identity, and security posture rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Fashinza
providers.description: Fashinza is a tech-enabled apparel manufacturing and supply-chain platform that connects fashion brands and retailers with a vetted global network of garment manufacturers. It streamlines end-to-end production: sourcing designs and fabrics, AI-powered supplier matching, tech-pack and sample creation, real-time production tracking, quality control, and merchandising and forecasting support so brands can move from design to delivery in shortened 30-45 day cycles. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates a buyer login and a supplier onboarding surface but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: FirstCry
providers.description: FirstCry (operated by Brainbees Solutions Ltd) is India's largest omnichannel retailer of baby, kids, and maternity products, founded in 2010 by Supam Maheshwari and Amitava Saha and headquartered in Pune, India. It sells apparel, footwear, toys, diapers, feeding and nursery gear, and personal-care products across its website, mobile apps, and a large network of physical stores, alongside in-house brands such as BabyHug. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and listed publicly on the NSE and BSE in 2024. FirstCry publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, policy, and security-disclosure surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Flick
providers.description: Flick is an AI filmmaking studio that lets creators direct short films with AI on an infinite, node-based canvas. Rather than a linear prompt-to-clip generator, Flick gives directors a nonlinear workspace to plan, iterate and assemble complete narratives of any length — generating scenes, keeping character faces and styles consistent across shots, controlling shot composition, and editing images by reference. The product is a web app with a free tier (300 credits) and paid plans from $5/month, plus a Creative Partner Program and a Filmmaker Residency for AI filmmakers. Flick was founded by Ray Wang (previously a founding engineer on the Instagram AI team) and award-winning filmmaker Zoey Zhang, and is Y Combinator- and GV-backed. Flick publishes product documentation, a blog and a verbatim llms.txt, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, webhooks or an MCP server — the /api/ surface is an internal application API that robots.txt explicitly disallows.

providers.name: fomo
providers.description: fomo (FOMO Labs Inc.) is a social-first cryptocurrency trading platform available as a mobile app and web platform. It lets mainstream retail investors trade memecoins, altcoins, and stablecoins across multiple blockchains without managing wallets, paying gas fees, or transferring assets manually, wrapping on-chain trading in a social layer where users discover tokens, follow top traders, view real-time buy alerts, copy trades, and compete on leaderboards. Onboarding is quick with Apple Pay funding, and trading is multichain and gasless. Founded in 2025 by former Deutsche Bank and dYdX team members (CEO Paul Erlanger, Se Yong Park, Prashan Dharmasena), the New York company reports 500,000+ active traders, 625,000+ total users, and $4B+ in trading volume. In June 2026 it raised a $75M Series B led by Index Ventures with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark at a $550M valuation. fomo is a consumer-facing product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Fraud.net
providers.description: Fraud.net provides AI-driven fraud prevention and risk management APIs. The Public API offers pre-authorization Cart Check, Transaction Check, post-event Update, and supporting device, identity, and email risk signals powered by the Collective Intelligence Network.

providers.name: Freddie Mac
providers.description: Freddie Mac (Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation) provides liquidity, stability, and affordability to the U.S. housing market. Its Single-Family API solutions span origination, selling and delivery, and servicing, delivering data and decisioning at each stage of the mortgage lifecycle.

providers.name: Funding Societies | Modalku
providers.description: Funding Societies (known as Modalku in Indonesia) is Southeast Asia's largest SME digital financing and investment platform, connecting small and medium enterprises seeking working capital with individual and institutional investors. Operating across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam and Hong Kong, the platform offers micro loans, business term loans, invoice and accounts-payable/receivable financing, startup financing and property-backed secured lending, alongside investment products for lenders. It is licensed and regulated (Capital Markets Services License, Monetary Authority of Singapore) and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Gustav
providers.description: Gustav is a vendor management platform (VMS) and sub-vendor marketplace for the staffing industry, enabling staffing firms to source talent from their trusted vendor network, share open jobs, collect and screen candidate submissions, run standardized hiring pipelines, schedule interviews, message vendors, and track performance in one place. Vendors organize into "Gustav Circles" with tiered job-release controls, and candidate submissions sync to applicant tracking systems including Bullhorn and JobDiva. Originally a Speedinvest-backed startup, Gustav is now operated by the member-owned Fuse Cooperative (a Colorado Limited Cooperative Association) and bills itself as the staffing industry's largest sub-vendor marketplace. Gustav is a SaaS web application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — integrations are delivered through the Bullhorn and JobDiva marketplaces.

providers.name: Halara
providers.description: Halara is a direct-to-consumer athleisure and activewear fashion brand for women, best known for its versatile Active Dress and its Halara Flex fabric technology. Its Shopify-based online store sells exercise dresses, leggings, tennis skirts, joggers, pants, sports bras, loungewear, sweaters, and denim under the tagline "Athleisure for 365 Versions of You." Halara runs a mobile shopping app and a customer loyalty program (The Halara Circle), and is backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Halara publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web, brand, and policy properties for network discovery.

providers.name: Hamilton Lane
providers.description: Hamilton Lane is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Hamilton Lane API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Healthera
providers.description: Healthera is a United Kingdom digital-health and patient-engagement company, founded in 2015 by Cambridge University students and headquartered in Cambridge, England. It runs a patient-facing pharmacy app and website for ordering NHS prescriptions and medicines online and booking pharmacy services (Pharmacy First, treatments, vaccinations), alongside a pharmacy-facing SaaS "Patient Experience Platform" used by 1,700+ community pharmacies to manage repeat prescriptions, bookings, marketing, and delivery. In November 2022 Healthera became the first pharmacy app to integrate with the NHS Electronic Prescription Service (EPS), and it connects to NHS Digital / NHS England systems plus third-party platforms such as myGP, eConsult, Cegedim Rx Pharmacy Manager, Medpoint, Royal Mail, and Uber for same-hour delivery. Healthera markets custom integration APIs to pharmacy and brand partners, but as of this review it publishes no public developer portal, no self-serve API documentation, and no machine-readable contract; its api.healthera.co.uk "Healthera Core" host is a private backend and exposes no FHIR CapabilityStatement. Integration is partner-gated rather than self-serve.

providers.name: Hokan
providers.description: Hokan, Inc. (株式会社hokan) is a Japanese InsurTech company that builds hokan®, a cloud-based customer and contract management (CRM) system for insurance agencies and brokerages. The platform consolidates customer and policy information, digitizes proposal and activity workflows, and adds modules for intent capture (意向把握), case management (案件管理), dashboards, accounting/cashiering (出納), and staff management (People). It targets paperless operations, stronger audit and compliance controls, renewal and aftercare tracking, and mobile access for agents. Customers include Orix Life, ANA, Sekisui, and other Japanese insurers and agencies. Hokan is backed by 500 Global. The company exposes API-based website integration for its product but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Holberton School
providers.description: Holberton School is a Silicon Valley-born technology education company that trains software and AI engineers through project-based, peer-driven learning rather than traditional lectures. Students build real applications from day one, using AI as a learning partner while developing the collaboration and problem-solving skills employers need, and the school reports a 92% employment rate among alumni. Holberton operates campuses and partner programs globally and delivers curriculum in software engineering, AI/machine learning, cybersecurity, and cloud. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Partech; the school publishes no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Joggr
providers.description: Joggr is a documentation platform purpose-built for software teams. It bridges the gap between traditional dev docs and modern development workflows, helping engineering teams create and maintain technical documentation. Joggr ships native MCP integration with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) and APIs for building custom Slackbots, agents, and workflows on top of the platform. The primary domain has moved from joggr.io to joggr.ai.

providers.name: Jolly
providers.description: Jolly is an AI-powered workforce engagement platform that uses a points-based rewards system, gamification, and performance-based incentives to drive engagement, utilization, compliance, and recruitment for frontline and part-time workforces. Employees earn points by completing work-related missions (taking shifts, arriving on time, hitting productivity goals) and redeem them for real-world rewards from partners such as Walmart, Amazon, and Visa. Employers use an AI campaign builder, programmatic employee referrals, an internal social recognition platform, real-time analytics (flight-risk detection, employee NPS, engagement metrics via ERP/EMR integrations), and white-label branding. Jolly serves healthcare, logistics, manufacturing, staffing, farming, retail, warehousing, construction, and military employers. Based at Cornell Tech in New York City, the company raised a $16.5M Series A and is backed by Bullpen Capital along with executives from Tesla, Coinbase, Stripe, PayPal, and Discord. Jolly does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: KLA
providers.description: KLA Corporation (formerly KLA-Tencor) is a leader in process control and process-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. KLA delivers advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, and computational analytics for the semiconductor industry. KLA does not publish a public developer portal or open API program; customer-facing software and tool APIs are provided to KLA customers under contract and are not publicly available.

providers.name: LedgiFi
providers.description: LedgiFi (formerly Krypto Ledgers) is a Latin American cryptocurrency tax and portfolio-tracking platform founded in 2020 and headquartered in Antofagasta, Chile. The product syncs a user's transaction history from exchanges and wallets — Binance, Coinbase, Kraken and MetaMask among them — normalizes it across more than 25,000 assets, and computes realized capital gains using the valuation methods and monetary-correction adjustments each jurisdiction requires, so investors can file a compliant return. Its Chilean profile applies the SII's specific rules (IPC indexation and dollar-variation adjustments, Impuesto de Primera Categoría and Impuesto Global Complementario), and the platform has since expanded to Mexico, Spain, Colombia and Argentina. Alongside tax reporting it offers a portfolio view spanning crypto, stocks and ETFs, with per-asset performance and allocation. LedgiFi is a 500 Global (500 LatAm B18) portfolio company. It runs a monitored production API at api.ledgifi.com that backs its own web and mobile apps, but publishes no developer portal, no API specification and no self-service API program.

providers.name: Lifesum
providers.description: Lifesum is a Stockholm-based digital health company whose consumer mobile application helps people improve their well-being through food logging, calorie and macronutrient tracking, personalized meal plans, recipes, and habit building. Backed by Balderton Capital, the company operates a subscription business-to-consumer product across iOS and Android in a dozen languages. As of this profile Lifesum publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or partner API portal, so this entry is an identity-only company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Lola
providers.description: Lola is a consumer travel booking platform at lola.com that lets travelers discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and trips in one place, built around insider access to the world's leading travel brands, competitive rates, and a simple "just ask" booking experience. The lola.com domain was previously the Boston-based corporate travel and expense-management startup founded by Kayak veterans Paul English and Bill O'Donnell (backed by Accel and GV, more than $80M raised) which wound down operations in 2021 with its technology acquired by Capital One; the domain now hosts this new consumer travel product. No public API or developer program is currently published — this profile captures the provider's public web and security posture.

providers.name: Matsmart
providers.description: Matsmart (operating internationally as Motatos) is a Swedish e-commerce company that fights food waste by selling surplus, short-dated, and overstocked groceries and household goods at a discount, with average savings of up to 50%. Its catalog spans pantry staples, beverages, snacks, candy, baby food, health and beauty, cleaning supplies, pet food, and non-food surplus, sourced from manufacturers and retailers and shipped across Sweden and other European markets via partners including Bring, Airmee, and PostNord. The company runs a consumer web storefront and iOS/Android apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or documentation, so this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Matterworks
providers.description: Matterworks is a Boston-based life-sciences AI company building foundation models for biochemical omics. Its Large Spectral Model is trained on billions of small-molecule, lipid, peptide, and protein mass-spectrometry spectra across millions of biological contexts, and its Pyxis platform turns raw omics data into quantitative, untargeted biochemical annotations and predictions used for asset and target discovery, mode-of-action elucidation, and life-science R&D pipeline decisions. Matterworks positions biochemical omics as explaining orders of magnitude more biological variation than sequence data alone. The product is accessed through the Pyxis web application (app.matterworks.ai, Auth0 sign-in); no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Meadow
providers.description: Meadow is a financial technology company delivering modern student financial services to colleges and universities. Its platform spans the full student financial lifecycle — Meadow Price (a mobile, SAI-compliant net price calculator), Meadow Pay (student billing and payments with automated workflows), Meadow Pre (pre-collections for recovering unpaid tuition), and Meadow Checkout (campus-wide collection of non-tuition fees). Meadow helps institutions improve enrollment, retention, and payment outcomes from application through graduation. Backed by Matrix Partners and Y Combinator. No public API or developer platform is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Moai.cash
providers.description: Moai.cash is a Telegram-native cryptocurrency super app operated by Sloika Industries, Inc. that bundles digital-wallet, payments, and Web3 financial services into a familiar messaging interface. It advertises zero-fee transactions, support for 1,000+ tokens, multi-chain deposits, token swapping, peer-to-peer money transfers, prediction markets for real-world events, and an on-chain lottery (Megapot). The company promotes an embedded-apps "API" that lets third-party applications run inside the Moai experience (payment processing, wallet management, token operations, lending/borrowing, real-world assets, Web3 gaming, and tokenized stocks), but that API is gated behind an email access request with no public documentation, OpenAPI specification, base URL, or self-service developer portal at this time. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nalu Medical
providers.description: Nalu Medical, Inc. is a privately held, commercial-stage medical device company headquartered in Carlsbad, California, that develops the Nalu Neurostimulation System for the management of chronic pain. The system pairs a battery-free micro implantable pulse generator (mIPG) with an externally worn Therapy Disc that powers it wirelessly, and is controlled by the patient through a smartphone-based remote-control application; it is FDA-cleared for both spinal cord stimulation (SCS) and peripheral nerve stimulation (PNS). Nalu publishes patient and provider resources, instructions for use, clinical evidence and peer-reviewed publications on nalumed.com. It operates no public developer program - as of the 2026-08-26 enrichment pass there is no API reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, no SDK, no MCP server and no developer portal on any host the company controls.

providers.name: Outpost Bio
providers.description: Outpost Bio builds frontier AI foundation models for the human microbiome. Its "lab-in-the-loop" platform pairs high-throughput wet-lab experiments with machine learning in a continuous cycle to predict how drugs and ingredients interact with microbial ecosystems, helping de-risk drug and ingredient R&D decisions around metabolism, toxicity, and efficacy. The company's public developer surface is the open-source Waypoint Python library and CLI (published to PyPI as waypoint-bio) plus gated Waypoint model checkpoints, the Atlas pretraining dataset, and the Compass benchmark suite on the Hugging Face Hub. Outpost Bio is a Seedcamp portfolio company and does not currently publish a hosted web API.

providers.name: Paradromics
providers.description: Paradromics is a clinical-stage neurotechnology company headquartered in Austin, Texas, with a machine-learning and data-science office in Oakland, California, developing high-data-rate implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCI). Founded in 2019 by Matt Angle, the company builds the Connexus BCI, an investigational fully implantable system that records high-resolution intracortical neural activity and transmits it through the skin to an external system that decodes intended speech, text and digital device control for people with severe motor impairment. Connexus holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designations for speech decoding (2023) and digital device control (2024), was accepted into the FDA Total Product Life Cycle Advisory Program, and received an Investigational Device Exemption in November 2025 for the Connect-One Early Feasibility Study (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07357428). Tempo BCI is a pre-clinical-trial pipeline product. Paradromics publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract; its only machine-readable public surface is an llms.txt AI-context file at paradromics.com/llms.txt.

providers.name: Pi Health
providers.description: Pi Health is an AI-native clinical trial technology company and contract research organization (CRO) building FICS, a unified operating system for oncology and global clinical trials. Its platform consolidates traditionally fragmented systems — Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF), electronic Investigator Site File (eISF), and an EMR-to-EDC Orchestrator — into a single AI-validated master record spanning study startup through closeout. Pi Health pairs the platform with CRO services and a global research network with oncology sites across the US, Brazil, Australia, and India. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this remains an identity profile in the API Evangelist network awaiting a public API.

providers.name: Pixyalbum
providers.description: Pixyalbum is a Mexican consumer photo-printing service that turns digital photos from a mobile device into physical printed products delivered across Mexico. Its catalog includes Fotolibros (soft- and hard-cover photo books of 40-100 pages), Imanes (packs of square photo magnets), and Pixycuadros (photographic prints with optional framing). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. Pixyalbum is a direct-to-consumer product with no public API, developer portal, or documentation at the time of enrichment; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: PlanSwift
providers.description: PlanSwift is Windows desktop takeoff and estimating software for construction estimators - turning digital plans (PDF/image/CAD) into measurable, countable, exportable material takeoffs and estimates across trades like roofing, concrete, earthwork, flooring, and electrical. PlanSwift is owned by ConstructConnect. IMPORTANT - PlanSwift does NOT publish a public web/REST API. Its developer surface is a desktop extensibility SDK embedded in the Windows application - OLE Automation (COM), an internal scripting engine, and a plugin/starter-pack model - exposed through a password-gated "Under-The-Hood" (U-T-H) tab enabled by contacting ConstructConnect (takeoff@constructconnect.com). The public SDK examples on GitHub target PlanSwift9 and are written in Pascal (2008) and Visual Basic (2010). There is no documented HTTPS base URL, no API keys/OAuth token surface, and no web endpoints to model - this entry is an honest stub reflecting a desktop-plugin/COM SDK, not a web API.

providers.name: Plush
providers.description: Plush is an AI-powered fashion discovery and shopping platform at plush.shop that lets shoppers describe what they want in natural language and returns curated results from trusted and emerging brands. Rather than rigid keyword search, Plush matches on mood, aesthetic, and intent, layering image search, smart real-time filters, influencer edit collections, and wishlists on top of its proprietary AI curation. Founded by Chang Liu (CEO) and Ying Zhu (CTO) — who met through Y Combinator's co-founder matching — Plush is backed by the Anthemis Female Innovators Lab Fund and the Oxford Seed Fund. It is a consumer-facing web application; no public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Pointee
providers.description: Pointee is an agentic automation platform for enterprise business process automation, guiding organizations through the full automation journey from discovery to running AI at scale. Its Process Discovery maps how work actually runs to surface automation potential and ROI, Workflow Automation orchestrates people, bots, and AI agents in unified workflows, and Guardian Agents continuously monitor automation to detect quality drops, automate incident response, and prevent cost overruns and security threats. Pointee also offers a dedicated offering to maximize existing RPA investments. The product is operated by Pointee Interactive s.r.o. (Liberec, Czech Republic) and is a portfolio company of Earlybird; customers include KBC, Intel, Deloitte, AXA, Microsoft, and Mutual of Omaha.

providers.name: Polymorph
providers.description: Polymorph is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building adaptive consumer internet infrastructure that personalizes user experiences with AI agents. Founded in San Francisco by Andrew Sy, the platform runs thousands of continuous product and lifecycle-engagement experiments for its customers, each carrying the craft of that product's direction and brand, so consumer teams can scale experimentation in product surfaces without being bottlenecked by headcount or design capacity. Its stated vision is to make the consumer internet polymorphic — one that adapts to each user and optimizes for delightful experiences. As of this profile the company operates a marketing site only; it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Preql
providers.description: Preql (preql.ai) is an enterprise data platform that automates data cleaning, reconciliation, and semantic modeling to deliver the trustworthy context layer that AI agents and business analytics depend on. Its agentic platform combines Agentic Semantic Modeling, Data Cleaning Agents, and AI-Powered Reporting to automatically resolve data mismatches, schema drift, and anomalies across ERP, CRM, HR, and expense systems without manual intervention, serving finance, operations, revenue, and executive decision-making at large enterprises. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Felicis, and added to the API Evangelist network. Preql does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile captures its public company identity, help center, and web properties.

providers.name: Second Home
providers.description: Second Home is a flexible workspace and cultural venue provider committed to supporting entrepreneurship, innovation, and community, with locations in London (Spitalfields and Holland Park) and Lisbon (Mercado da Ribeira). It offers coworking (resident and roaming desks), private offices, day passes, meeting-room and venue hire, and a program of cultural events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a consumer/business workspace brand rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Secret Escapes
providers.description: Secret Escapes is a members-only luxury travel and holiday flash-sales platform that negotiates exclusive, time-limited discounts on hand-picked hotels, city breaks, and package holidays for its members, surfacing over 200 curated sales each week across the UK and international markets. Founded in London and backed by GV and Index Ventures, it operates on an invitation/membership model rather than a public developer platform; no public API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Segway-Ninebot
providers.description: Segway-Ninebot is a global personal-transportation and robotics company, formed when Ninebot acquired Segway in 2015. It designs and manufactures electric kickscooters (the world's top-selling e-kickscooter brand, 13M+ units sold across 100+ countries), self-balancing personal transporters, e-bikes, and — through its Robotics division — RMP mobile-robot chassis and delivery/service robots (Nova Carter, NVIDIA Isaac-powered developer kits). Backed by HongShan. Its public developer surface is limited to Segway Robotics' open-source ROS / NVIDIA Isaac integration packages on GitHub; no first-party REST or OpenAPI product API is currently published.

providers.name: Skello
providers.description: Skello is a European (French) workforce management SaaS for shift-based businesses in retail, hospitality, restaurants, and health. It provides employee scheduling and shift planning, time and attendance tracking, absence and leave management, labor-cost and legal-compliance controls, team communication, and payroll preparation exports. Skello is a Partech portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Skello publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or status page; integrations are delivered through its own partner program rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Smile Digital Health
providers.description: Smile Digital Health (formerly Smile CDR) is a Toronto-based health interoperability software company and the commercial steward of the open source HAPI FHIR project (the world's most widely deployed Java implementation of the HL7 FHIR standard). Its flagship product, Smile CDR — marketed under the broader Smile Omni portfolio as the OmniVera Health Data Platform — is a FHIR-native clinical data repository and integration platform that ingests HL7 v2.x, CDA, CSV, JSON, XML, and FHIR payloads, normalizes them into FHIR (R4, R5, STU3, DSTU2), and exposes them through a hardened FHIR REST API, SMART on FHIR / OAuth2 / OIDC security, Bulk Data export, Subscriptions, MDM, Terminology Services, CQL-based Quality Measures, and a JSON Admin API. The platform is deployed on-prem and across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with HITRUST v9.4, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ONC 2015 Edition certifications, and is used by 190+ global customers, including 30+ US payers running CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization (CMS-0057-F) workloads on its CMS Suite. Adjacent Smile Omni product families include OmniCompli (regulatory compliance, including CMS Suite and CMS Concierge), OmniQ (digital quality measures / HEDIS, Intelligence Hub), and OmniConcierge (managed and professional services). The primary developer surface is the FHIR REST API, with per-endpoint auto-generated OpenAPI / Swagger UI at `{baseUrl}/swagger-ui/`, plus a separate JSON Admin API for cluster, module, user, audit, batch job, MDM, and OpenID Connect administration.

providers.name: Smol
providers.description: Smol is a UK-based direct-to-consumer home-care brand founded in 2018 by Paula Quazi and Nick Green, delivering concentrated, plant-based, cruelty-free cleaning products — laundry capsules, dishwasher tablets, fabric conditioner, surface sprays and personal-care bars — on a flexible subscription that ships refills through the letterbox. The company positions itself as a sustainability challenger to legacy home-care brands, emphasizing reduced plastic, carbon and chemical load, and became a certified B Corporation in July 2022. Backed by Balderton Capital and GV, Smol operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription business; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer program.

providers.name: Splash Financial
providers.description: Splash Financial is a Cleveland, Ohio financial technology company and online lending marketplace, founded in 2013, that matches consumers with loan offers from a network of partner banks and credit unions rather than lending directly itself. The platform uses automated underwriting to prequalify borrowers and present competing offers across student loan refinancing, personal loans, debt consolidation, home equity lines of credit, in-school private student loans, and medical school loan refinancing. The company reports having helped more than 125,000 people refinance over $6 billion in loans. Splash also sells its origination technology to credit unions and community banks as a partner channel, but that integration is arranged through a business development contact form and no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification is published.

providers.name: Stellar Sleep
providers.description: Stellar Sleep (Y Combinator S23, backed by Initialized Capital) is a mobile app that helps people with chronic insomnia sleep better using psychology rather than medication. Its personalized program is based on CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia), the first-line treatment recommended by sleep experts, delivered through iOS and Android apps published by Merlin Collective, LLC.
