Its lightweight single-use biosensor patch continuously measures fluid and electrolyte losses and provides personalized hydration guidance to athletes, service members, and laborers. The company ships two consumer/enterprise offerings: Nix Solo, an individual app for self-monitoring hydration, and Nix Pro, a group-monitoring platform that lets coaches and supervisors track multiple users. Nix is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and mobile-app business with no public developer program, API documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Ooak Data
providers.description: Ooak Data is an applied AI research lab building the data infrastructure for frontier AI. It turns real company data into reinforcement-learning environments where AI agents learn to work in the real world — sourcing multimodal enterprise data, anonymizing it into digital twins of tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion and Jira, and generating expert-calibrated, multi-step, multi-tool workflow tasks calibrated on the latest frontier models. It serves frontier AI labs, enterprise AI teams, and AI startups that need real-world evaluation infrastructure rather than synthetic benchmarks. Backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026) and based in Paris, France. Ooak Data publishes research essays and an AI-friendly content surface (llms.txt + Markdown content negotiation) but does not currently expose a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Overture Maps Foundation
providers.description: The Overture Maps Foundation is a Linux Foundation project created in partnership with Meta, Microsoft, AWS, and TomTom to build reliable, open map data as an alternative to proprietary mapping platforms. It provides openly available datasets for places, buildings, transportation, and administrative boundaries.

providers.name: Polymateria
providers.description: Polymateria Ltd is a British materials-science company, based at the Imperial College I-HUB on the White City Campus in London, that develops Biotransformation — a masterbatch additive blended into polyethylene and polypropylene at roughly 2% by weight so that plastic which escapes a waste stream weathers into a bioavailable wax and fully biodegrades in the open environment without leaving microplastics behind. The company co-authored BSI PAS 9017, the first standard for measuring the biodegradability of polyolefins, is a World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer and a Terra Carta signatory, and sells to converters, brand owners and packaging manufacturers rather than to developers. Its product is a chemical additive, not software: the public website is a WordPress marketing and media site, and the only credentialed surface it operates is a customer portal that serves third-party test datasets as documents. No developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract of any kind was found in this pass.

providers.name: PreciTaste
providers.description: PreciTaste is an AI kitchen management platform for restaurants and foodservice operators. Founded as PreciBake by Ingo and Laura Stork-Wersborg, with offices in New York City, Munich, and India, the company applies demand forecasting and computer vision to kitchen operations: forecasting demand from sales, weather and event signals, telling crews what to prep and cook and how much, planning hourly production, driving predictive inventory ordering, and tracking food levels on the line in real time. Its modules include Do'Cast demand forecasting, Daily Prep Management, Hourly Production Planning, Predictive Ordering, Recipe Viewer, Checklist, Label Printer, Real-Time Food Tracking and Data Analytics, sold into QSR, fast-casual, full-service, c-store and in-store bakery operations and deployed across 5,000+ locations. PreciTaste consumes restaurant point-of-sale data through partner integrations such as Toast rather than publishing a developer API of its own.

providers.name: Roby
providers.description: Roby (Imageous, Inc.) is a Seattle-based building-management software company whose HVAC automation product connects room and space calendars with a building's BMS (building management system) to automatically switch HVAC to an unoccupied/energy-saving mode when spaces are not in use, delivering measured energy savings and extended equipment lifetime for K-12, higher-education, and office facilities without added staff effort. Roby is deployed through building system integrators (ATS, Climatec, Syserco, ABM Systems, Oprizon, NSF-E) and also offers Receptionist and Helpdesk workplace applications. The product uses Auth0-managed authentication with token-based, SSL-only API access, but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Safety Wing
providers.description: SafetyWing is a fintech and insurtech company providing global health and travel insurance for remote workers, digital nomads, and distributed teams. Its consumer product Nomad Insurance offers travel-medical and full health coverage across 180+ countries, while Remote Health lets companies cover employees and contractors worldwide under a single plan. Backed by Creandum, the company positions itself as building a global social safety net so that geography is no barrier to equal opportunity. As of this enrichment pass SafetyWing publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Saphlux
providers.description: Saphlux is a quantum dot Micro-LED (QD-MLED) display technology company founded in 2014 out of Yale University and headquartered in San Diego, California, with additional operations in China and Japan. It commercialized semi-polar (20-21) GaN-on-sapphire epitaxial wafers to address efficiency droop and the green gap in nitride emitters, and now mass-produces NPQD quantum-dot Micro-LED devices. Its product lineup spans QD-COB and QD-COB Pro Series panels for large-format commercial and home-theater displays and the T-Series monolithic full-color micro-displays for all-day wearable AR eyewear and AI smart glasses. Saphlux is a semiconductor materials and display-module manufacturer that sells hardware to OEMs and display integrators; it publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: SkenarioLabs
providers.description: SkenarioLabs is a Helsinki-based real estate finance data intelligence company (founded 2015) that turns fragmented building data into auditable, asset-level intelligence for European banks and financial institutions. From a single address it reconstructs complete building profiles covering automated valuation, climate and transition risk, energy performance, technical condition, and renovation potential — aligned with CRREM, EU Taxonomy, ECB, EBA, CRR3, MEPS, and SFDR frameworks. It serves 200+ institutional clients monitoring over 60 billion euros of collateral and scores more than one million assets monthly. SkenarioLabs delivers its intelligence ad hoc into loan origination, portfolio audit, and continuous risk-monitoring workflows rather than through a public self-serve developer API.

providers.name: SnapCare
providers.description: SnapCare is an Atlanta-based healthcare workforce company, founded in 2017 as SnapNurse and relaunched under the SnapCare name in 2023, that pairs a national clinician marketplace with Booker, its SaaS workforce platform for hospitals, post-acute facilities, agency suppliers and clinicians. Booker combines predictive scheduling against census and historical demand trends, real-time per-diem shift fulfillment, internal float-pool management, same-day pay, and escalation of unfilled shifts to approved contingent suppliers. SnapCare acquired predictive staffing analytics vendor Medecipher in 2024 and merged with the nurse community connectRN in April 2026, raising a Series A led by Suvretta Capital. SnapCare sells the platform to healthcare organizations rather than to developers; no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract was found on its public surface.

providers.name: Snapdocs
providers.description: Snapdocs is a digital mortgage closing platform that connects lenders, title and settlement companies, notaries, and signing services on a single system to automate the loan closing process. The platform provides eClosing and hybrid closing workflows, Notary Connect for scheduling and coordinating signing agents, automated document quality control, and an eVault for secure eNote registration and management. Snapdocs is used across roughly one in four U.S. residential mortgage transactions and connects to the major loan origination, point-of-sale, title production, and RON systems through pre-built partner integrations rather than a public self-serve developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SV Angel and Y Combinator and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Spark Car Wash
providers.description: Spark Car Wash is an express-tunnel car wash operator running a network of high-throughput drive-thru locations across New Jersey, Pennsylvania and New York. The company pairs a conveyorized tunnel — neoglide washers, custom non-acidic cleaning formulas, high-intensity dryers, and a closed-loop water reclamation and filtration system — with self-service "Spark Park" terminals offering multi-nozzle vacuums, anti-scratch towels and automated mat cleaners. Revenue is driven by unlimited-wash memberships sold in Standard, Select and Signature tiers, with additional-vehicle discounts, alongside single-wash purchases. Membership signup and account management run on a third-party hosted portal rather than a Spark-operated application. Spark Car Wash is a physical services operator: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Spinny
providers.description: Spinny (Valuedrive Technologies Ltd.) is an India-based online marketplace for buying and selling used cars. Every Spinny Assured car undergoes a 200-point quality check and comes with a 1-year warranty, a 5-day money-back guarantee, and hassle-free RC ownership transfer. The platform also offers instant online car valuation, doorstep evaluation, used-car finance and EMI, car insurance, RC transfer, scrap-car service, e-Challan and RTO lookups, servicing, the Spinny Max luxury tier, and a Partners auction platform for dealers. Backed by Accel and General Catalyst. Spinny publishes a consumer web experience and an llms.txt for AI agents but does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: str8bat
providers.description: str8bat is a Bangalore, India based sports-technology company that builds a pocket-sized IoT sensor which attaches to a cricket bat and captures batting metrics in real time — bat speed, impact speed, back-lift angle, timing, sweet-spot placement and a 360-degree view of every shot. The sensor pairs with the str8bat mobile app (iOS and Android) to deliver instant, visual and actionable insights plus an AI cricket coach. The company reports 30,000+ active users, 6+ million shots recorded and operations across 350+ Indian cities and 14+ countries. str8bat is a consumer hardware and mobile-app company and publishes no first-party developer API; its str8bat.com storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes standard commerce discovery surfaces (customer-account OIDC and a Universal Commerce Protocol agent-commerce MCP endpoint).

providers.name: Tenex AI
providers.description: TENEX.AI is an AI-native, human-led Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider that fuses agentic AI, automation, and elite human security analysts to run security operations at scale. Its platform triages every alert and investigates every threat, orchestrating workflows across 300+ security tools to deliver faster detection, high-fidelity triage, and autonomous response with human guardrails for Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Crosspoint Capital, and Shield Capital, TENEX.AI operates as a managed cybersecurity service rather than a public developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Three Chord Bourbon
providers.description: Three Chord Bourbon, Inc. is an American whiskey blending house founded in 2017 by Rock & Roll Hall of Fame guitarist, producer and songwriter Neil Giraldo, who serves as founder, creative director and chairman. The company blends straight bourbon whiskeys aged a minimum of four years using a proprietary process it calls "Perfectly Tuned Taste," and has extended the line into rye and cask-finished expressions including a pinot noir cask finish and the Amplify rye. Product is co-packed at Ugly Dog Distillery in Chelsea, Michigan, and the corporate office is in Clarence, New York. The brand sells through wholesale distribution and a direct-to-consumer online store at store.threechordbourbon.com. It is a consumer packaged goods company: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Timeless
providers.description: Timeless (Timeless Investments GmbH) is a Berlin-based fintech that lets people invest in fractions of authenticated collectibles - luxury watches, classic cars, sneakers, fine wine, art, and memorabilia - starting at 50 EUR through its iOS and Android app. Assets are curated, authenticated, and securitized so users can buy, hold, and trade shares and exit when an asset sells. Backed by EQT Ventures. Timeless is a consumer mobile-app platform and publishes no public developer portal or API; its api.timeless.investments backend is private and authenticated.

providers.name: TRIDITIVE
providers.description: TRIDITIVE is an automated additive manufacturing company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Meres, Asturias, Spain, with offices in Hartford, Connecticut and London. It builds the AMCELL family of automated industrial 3D printing machines (Amcell 1300, 4300, 8300, Bulkam), the Traced traceability system, and the EVAM Software platform for additive manufacturing workflow management, digital warehousing, and on-demand production of polymer and metal parts. A Techstars portfolio company, TRIDITIVE publishes no public API, developer portal, or client SDKs as of July 2026.

providers.name: Unacademy
providers.description: Unacademy is a Bangalore-based online learning platform — one of India's largest — offering live classes, courses, study material, and test preparation for competitive exams including UPSC Civil Services, IIT JEE, NEET-UG, SSC, CA Foundation, and CSIR UGC NET, delivered through its web platform and dedicated learner, educator, and parent mobile apps. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Unacademy runs a consumer platform on an internal API (api.unacademy.com) but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: UPSIDE Foods
providers.description: UPSIDE Foods is a cultivated meat company that grows real chicken directly from animal cells instead of raising and slaughtering animals. Starting from a master cell bank derived from a single heritage-breed chicken egg, cells are fed vitamins, minerals, and nutrients and grown in cultivator tanks, becoming cultivated chicken in about three weeks. The company supplies cultivated chicken to foodservice partners and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Threshold Ventures. UPSIDE Foods publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interfaces as of July 2026.

providers.name: Vay
providers.description: Vay is a Berlin-headquartered teledriving (remote driving) mobility company, founded in 2018 by Thomas von der Ohe, Fabrizio Scelsi, and Bogdan Djukic, that operates the first commercial remotely driven car service. Customers in Las Vegas rent cars by the minute that are delivered and parked driverless by professional remote drivers from a Remote Driving Center; the company runs a 175-vehicle fleet, has served 50,000+ trips, and raised a Series C from Grab in December 2025. Vay is a consumer mobility service and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Vaya
providers.description: Vaya is an AI-powered Vedic astrology platform from Anuvaya Labs Technologies Pvt Ltd (New Delhi, India) that connects users with classically trained Parashari astrologers for live chat consultations, alongside free tools for Kundli (birth chart), horoscope, dasha, kundli matching, marriage prediction, navamsa, and panchang. Founded by Maahin Puri and Nitesh Kumar Niranjan (previously co-founders of Atlys), Vaya is backed by Accel, Arkam Ventures, and Weekend Fund, and ships as iOS and Android apps with no public API or developer program.

providers.name: World Golf Tour
providers.description: World Golf Tour (WGT Golf), operated by World Golf Tour, LLC out of San Francisco, is a free-to-play online golf simulation launched in 2008 that recreates more than twenty real championship courses like Pebble Beach, St Andrews, and Bethpage Black using photorealistic imagery, played by over 15 million players on web, iOS, and Android, with virtual equipment from Callaway, Titleist, and TaylorMade and integrations with SkyTrak launch monitors. The company is a Battery Ventures portfolio company and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: World View
providers.description: World View (World View Enterprises) is a Tucson, Arizona-based stratospheric balloon company focused on remote sensing and persistent intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR). Its uncrewed high-altitude balloons carry EO/FMV, IR, SAR, and hyperspectral sensors for defense, government, and commercial missions. Acquired by Ondas Holdings in 2026, it now operates as part of the Ondas Sentinel multi-domain intelligence platform, with partnerships including Palantir and Sierra Nevada Corporation. World View publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: 42Maru
providers.description: 42Maru is a South Korean AI deep-tech company building a Deep Semantic TA (Text Analytics) and QA (Question Answering) platform that understands the true intent behind a user's question and returns a single answer drawn from large sets of unstructured documents. Its cognitive-search stack pairs document retrieval with Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) and is delivered as enterprise chatbots (CHAT42), question-answering engines (QA42), natural-language processing (NL42), and the Platform42 SaaS. 42Maru ranked #1 on Stanford's SQuAD 2.0 machine-reading benchmark, won an AWS AI Challenge award, and is a Techstars London alumnus. It was added to the API Evangelist network from the Techstars portfolio and enriched from its public marketing site, GitHub organizations, and gitbook documentation; no public REST API, OpenAPI, first-party SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found — Platform42 API access appears to be provisioned per enterprise customer.

providers.name: 9GAG
providers.description: 9GAG is a Hong Kong-based global entertainment platform founded in 2008 with the mission to "make the world happier." It is one of the largest meme and user-generated humor communities on the internet, distributing funny images, GIFs, and videos across its website and iOS/Android apps to an audience of 150-200 million people and billions of monthly video views. 9GAG operates consumer-facing products (the 9GAG feed, 9GAG Pro subscription, and related community features) rather than a public developer API program; it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-backed company (500 Global, Y Combinator, Freestyle Capital, True Ventures, First Round Capital, Greycroft) and has been enriched with its real public web, policy, and security surfaces. No official public API or developer portal is published as of this enrichment; the community libraries that exist are unofficial and reverse-engineered.

providers.name: Accolade
providers.description: Accolade is a personalized healthcare and benefits navigation platform for employers and health plans. It pairs members with a care team of advocates, registered nurses, physicians, and mental-health specialists to help them understand their benefits, find in-network care, book appointments, and manage chronic and complex conditions. Accolade combines this human advocacy with virtual primary care, expert medical opinion, and mental-health services delivered through its member web and mobile apps. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. Accolade is a member-facing benefits platform and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Airspace Intelligence
providers.description: Air Space Intelligence (ASI) builds AI software for mission-critical, geospatial operations across aviation, defense, logistics, and energy. Its Prescience platform fuses data, models operational domains, runs predictive simulations, and optimizes complex operations in real time — spanning airline operations, air traffic management, global logistics, defense (space, air, land, sea), and energy grids. ASI holds an $875M FAA contract to help modernize the U.S. National Airspace System and works with partners including Alaska Airlines, National Grid, and the U.S. Air Force. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Alcoa
providers.description: Alcoa Corporation is a global industry leader in bauxite, alumina, and aluminum production. Founded in 1888, Alcoa operates mines, refineries, and smelters across Australia, Brazil, Canada, Iceland, Norway, Saudi Arabia, and the United States. The company is a Fortune 500 member and one of the world's largest aluminum producers, supplying lightweight, high-strength materials to automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, and industrial markets. Alcoa is committed to sustainability through low-carbon aluminum production, responsible bauxite mining, and advancing aluminum recycling.

providers.name: AlternativeTo
providers.description: AlternativeTo is a crowdsourced software discovery platform that helps users find alternatives to software products based on user recommendations across desktop, mobile, and web applications. The platform does not currently offer a public API, but provides partner integration opportunities for software vendors.

providers.name: Amer Sports
providers.description: Amer Sports is a global group of premium sports and outdoor brands with Nordic roots and more than 75 years of history, employing roughly 15,400 people and selling products in over 100 countries. Its portfolio spans ten brands including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, Atomic, Armada, ATEC, DeMarini, EvoShield and Louisville Slugger, covering technical apparel, footwear, winter sports, racquet sports and ball sports equipment. Amer Sports was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). As a consumer sports and outdoor manufacturer it publishes a corporate and investor web presence and a security.txt contact, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Anchor Protocol
providers.description: Anchor Protocol is a Terra-based decentralized finance (DeFi) savings protocol that offered a low-volatility yield on Terra stablecoin (UST) deposits, borrowing against bonded-asset (bAsset) collateral such as bLUNA and bETH, and cross-chain access through EthAnchor and xAnchor. Its developer surface is a set of first-party JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs (Anchor.js and Anchor Earn) plus on-chain CosmWasm smart contracts rather than a REST or OpenAPI web API. The project is part of the Terra ecosystem and is backed by Pantera Capital; its main web application deployment is currently disabled, though its developer documentation and npm SDK packages remain published.

providers.name: Astro
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia, astronauts.id) is an Indonesian quick-commerce grocery and daily-needs delivery service that fulfills orders in as little as fifteen minutes across the Greater Jakarta (Jadetabek) area. The consumer mobile app offers more than 15,000 SKUs spanning fresh produce, meat and seafood, frozen and prepared meals, beverages, snacks, baby and maternal care, personal care and beauty, household supplies, and the private-label Astro Goods line, operating 24/7 from a network of dark stores. Astro is venture-backed by Accel, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint Ventures. It is a consumer B2C app and publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Atom Power
providers.description: Atom Power, Inc. is a Charlotte, North Carolina electrical technology company founded in 2014 that invented the Atom Switch, the world's first commercial UL-listed digital solid-state circuit breaker. The company builds SiC (silicon carbide) power modules, solid-state switchgear and panel-level Level 2 electric-vehicle charging hardware for commercial, industrial, data-center and grid-edge deployments, paired with cloud software for energy management, load balancing and charger operations. Atom Power previously ran an "Atom Cloud" developer portal on Azure API Management at developers.atompower.com with a gateway at api.atompower.com; both hostnames are now dangling CNAMEs to deleted Azure API Management instances, so no public API contract is currently reachable.

providers.name: Atticus
providers.description: Atticus is a consumer legal-technology law firm, launched in 2019 and backed by Forerunner Ventures, True Ventures, and GV, that helps Americans in crisis get the benefits and aid they deserve. It began with Social Security Disability and has expanded to workers' compensation, VA benefits, and other government-aid programs. Atticus combines a free online qualification quiz, on-staff lawyers and client advocates reachable by phone, text, or chat, and a matching engine that connects each client with vetted attorneys from a network of 100+ top firms who work on contingency. It has helped tens of thousands of people access billions of dollars in life-changing aid. Atticus is a consumer-facing service company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Baba
providers.description: Baba Care, Inc. is a healthcare company that provides patient advocacy and care-navigation services for Medicare beneficiaries in the United States. Operating under the tagline "Healthcare simplified," Baba pairs each member with a dedicated advocate who handles their healthcare headaches — coordinating care, benefits, and administrative tasks — with the service covered by Medicare. The member experience is delivered through a login-gated web application at baba.care; the company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Ball Corporation
providers.description: Ball Corporation is a global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, food, personal care, and household products, as well as aerospace and other technologies and services for commercial and government customers. Ball operates more than 80 manufacturing plants worldwide and is a leader in aluminum can sustainability and recycling.

providers.name: Betdex
providers.description: Betdex Labs is the team behind BetDEX, a decentralized sports betting exchange, and the Monaco Protocol — an open-source, permissionless liquidity and betting-exchange protocol built on the Solana blockchain. Rather than a traditional REST API, Betdex exposes an on-chain integration surface: Solana programs plus first-party TypeScript client libraries (@monaco-protocol/client and @monaco-protocol/admin-client on npm) that let developers create markets, place and match orders, and settle outcomes directly against the protocol. Developer resources are published at betdex.com/developers with source under the MonacoProtocol GitHub organization.

providers.name: Blocks
providers.description: Blocks is a cloud cost-optimization service that guarantees up to 20% savings on AWS spend by aggregating the purchasing power of hundreds of companies into group-buying negotiations, then layering automated cloud management on top. Its AI-powered DevOps agent, Major Tom, continuously monitors connected AWS accounts through read-only billing access, surfaces cost-saving and security findings in Slack, and can propose Terraform fixes without requiring root or code access. Onboarding is a one-click read-only AWS cost-data integration with no long-term contracts and no infrastructure changes. Blocks is backed by Speedinvest and is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it currently exposes a marketing and product surface rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Bowery Valuation
providers.description: Bowery Valuation is a New York-headquartered, technology-enabled commercial real estate appraisal firm that pairs state-certified appraisers with a proprietary cloud platform for comparable-sales research, rent-roll and income analysis, mobile property inspection capture, adjustment grids, narrative report components and XML report generation. The firm appraises multifamily, mixed-use, office, retail, industrial, self-storage, condo/co-op, affordable housing, land and ground-up construction assets across all 50 U.S. states for banks, agency (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) lenders, funds and private lenders. The appraisal platform is used internally by Bowery's own appraisers rather than sold or exposed as a developer product; the company publishes no public API, SDK or developer portal, and directs external technology interest to enterprise partnership conversations.

providers.name: Briza
providers.description: Briza helps insurance carriers stop losing premium to slow integrations and submission errors, treating carrier API reliability as a manufacturing discipline. A team of Six Sigma Black Belts, Briza applies Kaizen principles to API connectivity across commercial insurance, focusing on submission integrity and moving premium reliably between distributors and carriers. Briza is a 500 Global portfolio company. The team also maintains open-source developer libraries under the briza-insurance GitHub org, including illogical (a JSON DSL rules engine) and wegood (a validation library). Briza does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Bunch
providers.description: Bunch is a Berlin-based financial technology company building AI-native infrastructure for private markets. Its all-in-one platform combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and expert fund services so venture capital and private equity funds and investors can seamlessly transact, close, and securely operate — spanning fund administration, SPV and vehicle setup, investor onboarding and KYC, capital calls, and reporting. Bunch was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Northzone and profiled into the API Evangelist network. Bunch operates a private, customer-facing product at app.bunch.capital and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Cabot Corporation
providers.description: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment, and consumer industries. The company's products include reinforcing carbons, specialty carbons, fumed silica, inkjet colorants, and engineered elastomer composites.

providers.name: Califia Farms
providers.description: Califia Farms, LLC is a Los Angeles, California based plant-based beverage company founded in 2010 by Greg Steltenpohl and named for the mythical Queen Califia. It manufactures and distributes non-dairy oatmilks, almondmilks and organic soymilks, coffee creamers, barista blends, cold brew coffees and teas, and ready-to-drink creamy refreshers, sold through grocery retail, foodservice distribution and direct-to-consumer channels across North America and Europe. Its public web presence is a marketing, recipe and where-to-buy site built on Gatsby and hosted on Netlify; the company publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Choose Energy
providers.description: Choose Energy is a free online energy marketplace, founded in 2008 and operated by Red Ventures, that helps consumers and businesses in deregulated U.S. energy markets compare electricity and natural gas plans, view transparent all-inclusive pricing, and switch providers online in minutes. The platform serves customers across Texas, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and other deregulated states, and also offers solar cost estimation, business energy procurement, and educational energy resources. Choose Energy is a consumer-facing web marketplace and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Civica Digital
providers.description: Cívica Digital is a Mexican civic-technology company, founded in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, that helps governments, public institutions, and organizations design, build, and launch digital services for citizens. Its product portfolio includes Urbem, a platform for digitizing government procedures and citizen-facing services; Signum, a digital document and official-records management system with electronic signatures; and a suite of conversational AI agents that support citizens over WhatsApp, phone, and web. The company focuses on digital government transformation across Latin America. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface has been located; this profile captures the company's public web presence, legal pages, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CoConstruct
providers.description: CoConstruct is a residential construction management software platform originally founded in 2005 in Charlottesville, Virginia by Donny Wyatt to help custom home builders and remodelers manage projects, budgets, selections, client communications, scheduling, and financial workflows in a single web and mobile application. The product served thousands of custom builders across the United States and was paired with CBUSA, a homebuilder group purchasing organization CoConstruct previously acquired. On February 24, 2021, CoConstruct was acquired by Buildertrend of Omaha, Nebraska, with growth funding from Bain Capital Tech Opportunities, HGGC, and Serent Capital, creating a combined company serving 23,000+ clients, 1.1M+ users, and $200B+ in annual construction project value. By 2022 Buildertrend had merged the two products into a single unified Buildertrend platform and migrated CoConstruct customers off the legacy product. CoConstruct historically operated a developer portal at developer.coconstruct.com exposing APIs for project, financial, and scheduling data, but as of the merger CoConstruct has paused new API development — "we are not establishing new API endpoints or connecting additional users to existing endpoints" — and the developer portal now redirects to a static notice page. Existing API connections are reportedly maintained but no public OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source release is published. Net-new integration work is directed to Buildertrend's own platform and partner program.

providers.name: CodeSecure
providers.description: CodeSecure is an application security testing company whose CodeSonar static application security testing (SAST) engine performs deep whole-program analysis of C, C++, Java, and other languages to find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and coding-standard violations, and whose CodeSentry binary software composition analysis (SCA) tool generates SBOMs and detects vulnerabilities in third-party and binary components. CodeSecure merged with AdaCore in 2025, combining SAST and SCA tooling with high-integrity software development for aerospace, automotive, defense, medical, and industrial customers. The tools support SARIF, CWE, MISRA, CERT, and OWASP as well as safety standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, EN 50128, and DO-178C, and integrate with CI/CD, IDE, and issue-tracking pipelines rather than exposing a public developer REST API.

providers.name: Comun
providers.description: Comun (Común) is a fintech company providing digital banking and money-transfer services designed for Latino immigrants in the United States. Through a bilingual (Spanish/English) mobile app, users open an FDIC-insured U.S. checking account with a valid national ID and no SSN required, get a Visa debit card, receive early direct deposit up to two days ahead of payday, and send international remittances to 17+ Latin American countries via the app or WhatsApp. Banking services are provided through Community Federal Savings Bank; remittance and P2P rails run on UniTeller and Cross River Bank. Comun is backed by Costanoa Ventures and Redpoint Ventures. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; Comun operates as a consumer neobank and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Covalto
providers.description: Covalto (formerly Credijusto) is a Mexican digital bank for small and medium-sized businesses, headquartered in Mexico City. It offers business and personal checking accounts, fixed-rate investment products, quick working-capital credit (Agil Covalto), factoring, leasing (arrendamiento), and fiduciary trust services (fideicomisos). Covalto acquired a regulated Mexican banking license, making it one of the first fintechs in Mexico to become a fully licensed bank. Its digital surface spans online banking, digital account opening, and a credit application flow. Covalto is backed by QED Investors. As of the latest review it publishes no public API developer portal; its developer documentation at docs.covalto.com is gated behind Google Identity-Aware Proxy for internal use.

providers.name: Credibly
providers.description: Credibly is a small business lending platform offering a REST API (API V2) for originating merchant cash advances, working capital loans, business lines of credit, equipment financing, and SBA loans through an approved broker and referral partner network. The API supports application submission, multi-part document uploads, stipulation identification, and webhook-based status notifications within a SOC 2-compliant environment.

providers.name: Cyence
providers.description: Cyence is a cyber risk analytics and modeling solution — originally an independent InsurTech startup (backed by IVP and others) and acquired by Guidewire in 2017 — that helps insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and managing general agents quantify, underwrite, and manage cyber insurance risk in financial terms. It combines internet-scale data collection, data science, and economic loss modeling to produce exposure signals, breach-probability estimates, and portfolio accumulation and catastrophe scenarios. Cyence data and scores are delivered to carriers through Guidewire Cloud and are available via a REST API for pricing, risk selection, and underwriting workflow automation. API access is partner-gated through a Guidewire account rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Darwin
providers.description: Darwin AI is an AI governance platform built exclusively for state, local, and education (SLED) government agencies, providing a centralized, secure hub for the public sector to safely adopt, manage, and govern AI tools while ensuring compliance, accountability, and public records requirements are met. The platform serves IT departments, innovation and digital services teams, city and county management, and data governance professionals across municipal and state government. Its core product surface includes the Control Center, which delivers cross-departmental visibility into AI usage along with records management and FOIA compliance tracking; the Policy Wizard, which helps agencies establish and refine AI policies aligned to regulatory requirements using 30+ policy frameworks and 15+ city and county regulation packs; Risk Management, which detects unauthorized or unvetted AI applications; the AI Navigator, which monitors departmental adoption patterns and surfaces actionable insights; and the Marketplace, an organization-wide hub of approved AI applications. Darwin AI was named to Government Technology's 2026 GovTech 100. The company also publishes a free public Policy Wizard tool. Darwin is backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a government-sector company profile. As of this enrichment pass Darwin publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Dronecode Foundation
providers.description: The Dronecode Foundation is a vendor-neutral Linux Foundation project for open source drone projects. It hosts PX4 autopilot flight control software and MAVLink communication protocol used worldwide for unmanned aerial vehicles, providing a complete open source platform for drone development.

providers.name: Empower Semiconductor
providers.description: Empower Semiconductor is a fabless power-semiconductor company founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Jose, California, with an R&D office in Munich. It designs integrated voltage regulators (IVRs), silicon capacitors (ECAP) and vertical power-delivery platforms for AI, high-performance computing and embedded systems, built on its FinFast architecture combining FinFET-based design, advanced packaging, advanced magnetics and integrated silicon capacitors. Its Crescendo platform targets kilowatt-class vertical power delivery for AI and HPC processors and its Forte family delivers multi-domain integrated regulation up to 25W. Analog Devices completed its acquisition of Empower Semiconductor on 7 July 2026. Empower ships silicon, not software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Enclave
providers.description: Enclave (enclave.ai) is an AI-powered application and cloud security platform that operates as an "agentic security engineer." It continuously builds a living model of an organization's attack surface across services and cloud providers, then autonomously triages and investigates vulnerability findings against known CVEs to determine real-world exploitability and reachability. Rather than flooding teams with signature-based noise, Enclave traces data flows to confirm whether a CVE is actually reachable, surfaces cross-service exploits that traditional scanners miss, and routes prioritized remediation plans with proof to the owning teams. Founded by veterans from Stripe, Box, VMware, Salesforce, and Yelp, the company is backed by 8VC and Marc Benioff. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Ent
providers.description: Ent is an intent-aware security platform for the enterprise that protects work as it happens. The company reads human, AI agent, and application activity in real time to understand intent and act at the moment of risk, rather than relying on after-the-fact logs and static policies. Ent is an early-stage security company backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security-disclosure surface. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI have been published to date, so API and specification artifacts are not yet applicable.

providers.name: Exodigo
providers.description: Exodigo is a subsurface intelligence company that maps what is underground and above ground without digging. Founded in 2021 by former Israeli intelligence officers and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, it fuses ground-penetrating radar, electromagnetic (TDEM/FDEM), magnetic gradiometry and electrical sensing with GPS-RTK positioning, then processes the combined signal with AI to produce geolocated 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations and geotechnical conditions. Products span ExoInfo remote data intelligence (AI compilation of public records, engineering documents and imagery), on-site reality capture, AI engineering and digitization, and utility relocation services. Deliverables are handed to customers as GIS and CAD artifacts (Esri ArcGIS, AutoCAD, BIM) and through a client portal rather than a public developer API — as of this profiling pass Exodigo publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK or MCP server. Customers include LA Metro, Caltrans, National Grid, VINCI Construction and state DOTs.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Finni Health
providers.description: Finni Health is a telehealth company that connects families of children on the autism spectrum with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapists and mental health providers. Operating across more than 30 states, Finni offers both in-home and in-clinic ABA therapy with flexible scheduling, handles insurance coordination and billing for its provider network, and gives parents a portal for progress tracking and family-led goal setting. The company positions itself as an operating platform for ABA practices as well as a care provider for families, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Girlboss
providers.description: Girlboss is a community and media brand for ambitious women, positioned as a navigator for the future of work — created to spark the thrill of possibility and to inspire and inform so members can find success on their own terms. Founded by Sophia Amoruso (author of #GIRLBOSS and founder of Nasty Gal), Girlboss grew from editorial content, newsletters, and the Girlboss Rally events into a community brand. Today girlboss.com runs as a Shopify-hosted storefront and brand site. Girlboss was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners; it publishes no first-party developer API, so this profile captures its public web, policy, and agent-facing (llms.txt / well-known) surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Green Software Foundation
providers.description: The Green Software Foundation is a Linux Foundation project founded by Accenture, GitHub, Microsoft, and ThoughtWorks to build standards, tools, and best practices for reducing the carbon emissions of software. It developed the Software Carbon Intensity specification and provides patterns for building green software.

providers.name: Grouper
providers.description: Grouper, operated by Element3 Health, Inc. (d/b/a Grouper) and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, is a healthy-aging benefit company that connects older adults to social clubs, group activities, and virtual community programming through health plans. Its consumer product, "Hello by Grouper," is a membership platform offering live and on-demand instructor-led virtual classes, research-based monthly brain-health challenges, and members-only online events, with the goal of keeping members active, socially connected, and healthier as they age. Grouper distributes primarily through Medicare Advantage and other health-plan partners rather than a direct developer channel; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface as of this profile, which was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture (a16z-associated) portfolio lead.

providers.name: Happypal
providers.description: Happypal (HappyPal) is a Paris-based HR-tech and fintech company, founded in 2019, that operates the most widely used digital platform for French works councils (Comite Social et Economique, or CSE). The SaaS and payment platform lets CSE administrators distribute employee benefits and perks, manage budgets and accounting, run ticketing and gift-voucher (cheques-cadeaux) programs, and engage more than 500,000 beneficiaries through a mobile app. Happypal replaces paper gift vouchers with a dematerialized SaaS-plus-fintech model targeting France's employee-benefits market. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. Happypal does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and identity surface.

providers.name: HighRadius
providers.description: HighRadius is an AI-powered autonomous finance platform for the Office of the CFO, automating the Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable (AP), and Treasury processes with a network of orchestrated AI agents. The platform covers invoicing, collections, cash application, deductions, credit, dispute management, financial close, reconciliation, consolidation, and cash forecasting. HighRadius serves 1,500+ enterprise customers and ships pre-built integrations with 50+ ERPs and systems including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through those pre-built ERP connectors and partner engagements rather than a public self-serve developer API; the company publishes a Trust Center documenting SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and GDPR posture.

providers.name: Hippo Harvest
providers.description: Hippo Harvest is a controlled-environment agriculture company based in Pescadero, California, founded in 2019, that grows USDA-certified-organic leafy greens in modular greenhouses run by custom autonomous mobile robots and machine learning. Its closed-loop, direct-to-root watering and nutrient system is published by the company as using 92% less water, 55% less fertilizer and 94% less land than conventional field agriculture, while pricing to compete with field-grown product. Hippo Harvest sells packaged salad greens (spring mix, spinach, 50/50 blend, butter lettuce) into grocery retail rather than selling software: the robotics, computer vision and growing-control stack is internal operating infrastructure, not a product. It raised a $21M Series B led by Standard Investments in February 2024 and a $30M Series C led by Cox Farms in July 2026, and is permitting a 30-acre facility in Hollister, California. No public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind was found on any host the company controls.

providers.name: HumanQ
providers.description: HumanQ is an execution-capability and intelligence platform that helps organizations move critical work forward through structured, live execution sprints called QPods. Each QPod is a 60-minute facilitated session, led by trained "Catalysts," for small groups of up to six participants working through decision drag, unclear ownership, and cross-team stalls. HumanQ is offered as HumanQ Scale (an enterprise-wide program with weekly and monthly tracks, on-demand drop-ins, and deep customization) and HumanQ Teams (a manager-led tool for up to four groups, live in two weeks with no contract). Progress is tracked through the QStart, QImpact, and QSignal measurement framework, with delivery across 74 countries. HumanQ is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. It is a managed-services platform and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Intrinsic
providers.description: Intrinsic is a Mountain View, California industrial robotics software company spun out of Alphabet's X "moonshot factory" and led by CEO Wendy Tan White. Its mission is to make industrial robots radically easier to program, use, and innovate with so that automation is accessible to a much broader range of businesses. Intrinsic's flagship product is Intrinsic Flowstate, an all-in-one web-based developer environment for designing, building, simulating, and deploying production-grade robotics solutions, paired with Intrinsic Intelligence — a portfolio of AI-powered capabilities including pose estimation, motion planning, grasp planning, and sensor-guided control — and IntrinsicOS, a robot operating system that spans cloud to edge. Developers extend Flowstate by writing Skills and Services in Python and C++ via the open-source Intrinsic SDK (Apache-2.0), or compose them visually via behavior trees in the Flowstate Process Editor. The platform integrates deeply with ROS through Intrinsic's 2022 acquisition of Open Source Robotics Corporation (OSRC) — the commercial arm of Open Robotics — while ROS, Gazebo, and Open-RMF stewardship remain with the independent OSRF non-profit. Flowstate is currently in a gated beta / trusted-tester program; production access is granted to enterprise customers, systems integrators, and participants in programs such as the AI for Industry Challenge. Pricing is not publicly disclosed and there is no self-service developer signup.

providers.name: Iontra
providers.description: Iontra Inc. is a Denver, Colorado battery technology company that develops proprietary Charge-Control technology for rechargeable lithium batteries. Founded in 2013 and publicly launched in 2022, Iontra applies electrodynamic sensing and signal processing during charging to suppress lithium plating, dendrite growth and SEI-layer expansion, claiming up to 4x cycle life, 2x faster charging, improved cold-weather charging and better safety without changing cell chemistry. The technology is chemistry agnostic across Li-ion, Li-metal, Li-S, solid-state and Na-ion cells, and is delivered to OEMs as custom charging algorithm "recipes" flashed onto an application-specific microcontroller, or as a software-only library. Iontra closed a $45M Series C led by Volta Energy Technologies to launch an integrated RISC-V charge-control and fuel-gauge MCU. Iontra is an embedded/silicon company: it publishes no public web API, no OpenAPI, and no public SDK packages — its SDK is firmware delivered to OEM customers through a login-gated Document Portal under commercial engagement.

providers.name: Jones
providers.description: Jones is a full-service SaaS platform purpose-built for insurance compliance in construction and commercial real estate, unifying Certificate of Insurance (COI) collection, deep insurance auditing, workflow automation, and a licensed brokerage in one platform. It pairs hundreds of insurance specialists with AI agents to review COIs and policies at enterprise scale, and is used by general contractors, construction managers, owner-operators, REITs, property management teams, and insurance brokers to manage compliance across large portfolios of subcontractors, vendors, and tenants. Jones offers two engagement models: Jones Software (self-managed) and Jones Operator (an AI-driven concierge that runs day-to-day insurance tasks). Reported scale: 40,000+ projects, 3 billion+ square feet, and 50 million+ insurance documents processed for 300+ industry leaders. Headquartered in New York, NY, Jones was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Foundry Group.

providers.name: KoBold Metals
providers.description: KoBold Metals is a critical-minerals exploration and development company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to the search for the copper, lithium, nickel and cobalt deposits needed for electrification. The company combines three capabilities: novel sensor hardware and software that collect higher-quality subsurface data faster, centralized data systems that organize disparate geological information about the Earth's crust, and predictive models that rank and target exploration prospects. Its stated aim is to "turn exploration into a repeatable science." Its flagship project is Mingomba in Zambia, described by the company as one of the best copper deposits ever found and positioned to become one of the world's largest copper mines. KoBold is venture-backed (investors include a16z and Bond Capital) and operates as a private exploration company. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the public surface is a corporate marketing, science, careers and news site.

providers.name: Lance
providers.description: Lance (Lance AI, Inc.) is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company building autonomous AI agents for hotel operations. Its platform handles guest interactions and back-of-house coordination end to end: a Receptionist agent answers guest calls, SMS, email, and hotel messaging platforms 24/7 in multiple languages, resolving questions and routing service requests; a Sales agent responds to booking inquiries and RFPs, qualifies leads, and follows up on opportunities; and Lance Pad is a tablet-based coordination surface that replaces walkie-talkies and tracks guest requests, housekeeping, work orders, and scheduling in real time. Lance reports use across brands including Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt and more than 50 hotels, citing an 89% call success rate and a 30%+ reduction in front-desk call volume. Architecturally the company is notable for deliberately avoiding integration APIs: it uses computer-use and computer-vision agents to drive legacy property management, task, and reservation systems through their user interfaces rather than through vendor APIs. Lance is surfaced here as a portfolio company of Y Combinator. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Loctax
providers.description: Loctax is a collaborative tax compliance, risk, and governance platform built for global in-house tax teams. Founded in 2020 and based in Gent, Belgium, its Global Tax Intelligence Platform lets teams ask any tax question grounded in their own company data and IBFD's authoritative tax content spanning 220+ jurisdictions, then act on the answer with workflow, compliance-monitoring, risk, and controversy-management tooling. Loctax is backed by Index Ventures, Cavalry Ventures, and Seedcamp, and in 2026 was acquired by Tax Systems to build a combined EMEA tax-technology platform. Loctax is a closed enterprise SaaS product with no public developer API, portal, or specification at the time of this profile.

providers.name: MayMaan Research
providers.description: MayMaan Research is a clean-energy engineering company that redesigns the internal combustion engine around its patented AquaStroke platform, a piston engine that runs on a blend of roughly 70% water and 30% bio-alcohol (ethanol or methanol) instead of gasoline or diesel. The company builds modular generator sets and powertrains that scale from a 35 kW unit (A35) through the AV2 to multi-megawatt installations, and it positions them as drop-in replacements for diesel gensets in power generation, EV charging infrastructure, data centers, telecommunications, marine, construction, agriculture, defense and off-grid deployments, with near-zero NOx, SOx, CO2 and particulate output. MayMaan is headquartered in Hollywood, Florida with a European office in Paris, holds engine and fuel-system patents internationally, and raised a $30 million Series A led by WAVE Equity Partners. It is a hardware manufacturer: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Medely
providers.description: Medely is a healthcare workforce orchestration platform and staffing marketplace that connects healthcare facilities with a network of qualified nurses and allied health professionals. What began as a marketplace to match facilities with per-diem talent has grown into a full workforce management platform, helping hospitals, surgery centers, skilled nursing facilities, and other providers fill open and per-diem shifts, support their core clinical teams, and maintain high-quality patient care. Medely offers credentialing, scheduling, and flexible workforce management tools, and holds the Joint Commission's Gold Seal of Approval for its staffing services. The company is backed by General Catalyst and Wing Venture Capital. Medely does not currently operate a public developer program or documented API; its GraphQL backend at api.medely.com powers the first-party web and mobile applications only.

providers.name: Meshcrafts
providers.description: Meshcrafts, operating publicly as CURRENT (Current Eco AS, formerly Meshcrafts AS, of Oslo, Norway), is a charge point management system (CPMS) provider for electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. Its cloud platform lets location owners and charge point operators manage EV charging points, handle payment and invoicing, apply smart energy management and load balancing, and offer white-label charging experiences to drivers. The platform is hardware-agnostic and OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) certified for OCPP 1.6 and OCPP 2.0.1, including Advanced Security, and advertises 99% uptime. Current was the first in the Nordics to reach OCPP 2.0.1 CORE and Advanced Security. The company is backed by 500 Global and surfaced in the API Evangelist network through that portfolio.

providers.name: MoveYou
providers.description: Our scaled based platform meets all your business requirements in the fields of mobility and energy. Explore the powerful solutions or consult one of our experts for advice. Together, we are building a sustainable future for your organization.

providers.name: Nave Bank
providers.description: Nave Bank is a digital-first business bank based in Puerto Rico, offering FDIC-insured deposit accounts, business savings, and business loans through an easy-to-navigate online and mobile banking platform. Its product surface centers on business checking ("Cuenta Nave Business"), interest-bearing savings, real-time payments, ACH and wire transfers, and mobile check deposit, with a bilingual (Spanish/English) experience and human customer support. Nave was surfaced as a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Nave Bank publishes a consumer/business banking website and help center but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Nomad Homes
providers.description: Nomad Homes is a Partech-backed proptech company originally launched as a real-estate marketplace. It has since rebranded and pivoted to RemyAI (getremy.ai) — "the 24/7 intelligent assistant for real estate agents." RemyAI listens to agents' calls and texts, transcribes and summarizes them, auto-creates follow-up tasks and reminders, organizes buyer/seller contacts, and manages voicemail across iOS, Android, and desktop. The company's original domain nomadhomes.co now 301-redirects to getremy.ai. RemyAI publishes a public /.well-known/ai-plugin.json and an llms.txt describing the product, but it exposes NO public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal (its ai-plugin manifest explicitly declares api.type=none and auth.type=none).

providers.name: Ohmium
providers.description: Ohmium International designs, manufactures and deploys modular, vertically-stackable proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzer systems for cost-competitive green hydrogen production. Its Lotus PEM electrolyzer platform integrates power electronics, water treatment and controls into skid-mounted modules for industrial, energy and mobility customers, and is paired with EPC and remote monitoring and maintenance (RM&M) services. Ohmium is a hardware and clean-energy engineering company: it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its customer-facing monitoring and service portals are third-party SaaS products hosted on Ohmium subdomains behind login.

providers.name: Omnee
providers.description: Omnee (Omnee AI) is a Techstars-backed startup providing an AI-powered customer care platform built for residential homebuilders. It pairs a per-home digital "home twin" data record with a personalized, multilingual AI assistant that handles buyer support and warranty management 24/7, claiming to increase warranty-department capacity by over 60%. Products are sold per-home (Warranty Triage, AI Customer Care, and an Enterprise Partner tier with custom integrations). The company operates a marketing and product website but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was enriched from its public site.

providers.name: Paraglide
providers.description: Paraglide is a British-Swedish AI company building autonomous agents that automate accounts receivable for high-volume B2B finance teams. Its agents handle two-way billing communication across the order-to-cash lifecycle: answering customer billing questions, chasing overdue invoices, resolving disputes and deductions, running collections, operating a supplier portal, and applying cash — integrating with ERPs, CRMs, and billing software to cut Days Sales Outstanding and improve cash flow. Founded in 2025 by Rasmus Areskoug and Andreas Astrom with offices in London and Malmo, Paraglide raised a $5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and DN Capital in January 2026. As of this profile the company is a product/agent platform with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Partender
providers.description: Partender is a bar and beverage inventory management platform that lets hospitality operators complete a full physical liquor, wine, beer, and keg inventory in roughly fifteen minutes by tap-and-swipe estimating how full each bottle is, at up to 99.2% accuracy. The subscription SaaS spans iOS, Android, and web apps and adds online ordering, purchase orders auto-sorted by distributor, pour-cost and variance reporting, and lightweight accounting so venues can cut time, labor, and inventory loss. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, Partender serves bars, restaurants, hotels, and stadiums. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Partender exposes a consumer mobile/web product rather than a publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Pawfinity
providers.description: Pawfinity is pet service business management software for grooming salons, mobile groomers, kennels, dog daycares, pet sitting, training, and pet therapy businesses - handling online booking, client and pet records, scheduling, point of sale, and staff management. Pawfinity does not publish a public or partner developer API or developer portal. The product is a closed, single-tenant SaaS web application; the only outbound data integration is a built-in, one-way nightly QuickBooks Online sync bundled with the subscription, not a documented API a third party can call.

providers.name: Peregrine
providers.description: Peregrine Technologies is a public-safety operational-intelligence platform that unifies fragmented data sources into actionable context for law enforcement, corrections, fire-rescue, EMS, emergency management, and 911 agencies. Its full-stack platform pairs Peregrine Foundation for data integration with Peregrine AI for analysis, surfacing connections across otherwise disconnected datasets to speed decision-making and situational awareness. FedRAMP High authorized and operating within AWS GovCloud, it is used by agencies including the Atlanta, Miami, and Edmonton police departments and Ada County Paramedics. The product is delivered as a login-gated enterprise/government SaaS with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Phasecraft
providers.description: Phasecraft is a quantum algorithms company building software that combines classical and quantum computing to solve real-world problems in materials discovery, advanced biochemistry, and optimization. Its algorithms are engineered to run efficiently across multiple quantum hardware platforms, and its published results include scalable approaches to the Fermi-Hubbard model and QAOA-based optimization. Founded by Profs. Ashley Montanaro (CEO) and Toby Cubitt (CTO), the company operates from London, Bristol, and Washington DC, and is backed by Playground Global. Phasecraft exposes no public developer API; its programmatic surface is limited to open research code on GitHub and two interactive web tools (a materials database and an optimization graph library).

providers.name: Photoneo
providers.description: Photoneo is a Slovak (Bratislava, founded 2013) machine-vision company and a global pioneer of high-resolution structured-light 3D measurement. Its flagship products are the PhoXi 3D Scanner family and the MotionCam-3D, a parallel structured-light camera that captures moving scenes in real-time 3D, together with AI-enabled software such as Bin Picking Studio, Locator, and Palletizing for robotic automation. Rather than a hosted web/REST API, Photoneo exposes a developer surface through the PhoXi Control software and its official C++, C#, and Python device APIs, GenICam/GigE Vision standard connectivity, TCP/IP robot interfaces (UR, ABB, FANUC, Staubli, Mitsubishi, Kawasaki, Yaskawa), and a set of BSD-licensed example repositories on GitHub. Documentation lives in the Photoneo Knowledge Base (docs.photoneo.com) and the 3D scanning wiki. Photoneo (now part of the Brightpick Group) was acquired by Zebra Technologies.

providers.name: Pocket Gems
providers.description: Pocket Gems is a San Francisco mobile games and interactive entertainment studio founded in 2009, employing over 200 people and backed by Sequoia Capital and Tencent. It builds and operates the Episode interactive-storytelling network, Episode XOXO, and the 3D real-time strategy title War Dragons on its proprietary mobile-first Mantis Engine, with products downloaded more than 325 million times. Pocket Gems ships consumer mobile applications rather than a developer-facing API program: there is no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification. Its public developer surface is a GitHub organization and four first-party Apache-2.0 Node.js libraries published to npm under the @pocketgems scope (the internal "Todea" service stack), plus an Episode Writer's Portal used by story authors.

providers.name: Provide
providers.description: Provide is a financial services division of Fifth Third Bank offering banking and financing built specifically for owners of professional practices — dental, medical, veterinary, optometry, childcare, financial advisory, funeral, and insurance businesses. The company provides conventional and SBA loans to start, acquire, or expand a practice, alongside a full suite of customized banking products. Provide was acquired by Fifth Third Bank and operates as a specialty lending and banking brand. Surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Qomplx
providers.description: QOMPLX, Inc. is a Reston, Virginia research and technology company building risk-analytics and cybersecurity products — Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) for Active Directory and cloud credentials, Managed Detection and Response (MDR), attack-surface monitoring, Active Directory security assessment, offensive security services and vCISO engagements — sold into finance, legal and insurance. Its underlying data platform, QOMPLX:OS (Q:OS), includes TimeEngine, a multi-dimensional time-series database and analytics engine that QOMPLX exposes over an HTTP and WebSocket interface. QOMPLX publishes first-party TimeEngine client libraries for Python, Java and Erlang on GitHub, but ships no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL or Postman collection, and operates no public developer portal, API reference or pricing page. As of this pass its own website has been reduced to a single-page Ghost install and every content page listed in its sitemap returns a 301 self-redirect loop.

providers.name: Saber
providers.description: Saber is a decentralized automated market maker (AMM) on the Solana blockchain, optimized for trading and providing liquidity between mean-reverting assets such as stablecoins and wrapped or pegged tokens. Its StableSwap program delivers low-slippage swaps and capital-efficient liquidity pools. Saber does not expose a REST/HTTP API; developers integrate through its on-chain StableSwap program using first-party TypeScript SDKs (the @saberhq/* packages on npm) and Rust crates (crates.io) that construct and submit Solana transactions. The project also maintains open-source Solana tooling, an asset/pool registry, and on-chain governance. Saber was surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Sakana AI
providers.description: Sakana AI is a Tokyo-based AI R&D company founded by ex-Google researchers focused on collective intelligence, evolutionary optimization, and nature-inspired AI methods. The company's first commercial product is Sakana Fugu - a multi-agent orchestration system with an OpenAI-compatible API (currently in beta). Sakana also publishes Sakana Chat (consumer) and Sakana Marlin (beta).

providers.name: Simpleclosure
providers.description: SimpleClosure is a business-dissolution and wind-down platform for founders, startups, and business owners, positioning itself as "the shutdown standard." It guides a company through the full closure process end to end - from the first decision to wind down through the final state and federal filings - covering entity dissolution (Delaware corporations, LLCs, S-corps), final tax returns, creditor and vendor notifications, asset liquidation, distributions to stakeholders, and compliance obligations. The company offers software plus expert handling, with tailored solutions for lawyers, investors, and financial services firms managing portfolio-company or client wind-downs. SimpleClosure was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list and operates a customer application at app.simpleclosure.com. It is a services-and-software company rather than a developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Solaren
providers.description: Solaren is a combination energy and aerospace company headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California, founded in 2001 by a team of satellite engineers and space scientists. Solaren designs, develops, integrates, deploys and operates space solar power (SSP) plants: solar arrays on a patented lightweight solar power satellite in geosynchronous orbit convert sunlight to electricity, convert that electricity to radio-frequency power, and beam it to an earth receiving station that returns it to the grid as baseload power. The company's business model is to own and operate its SSP plants and sell continuous, zero-emission electricity to utility and government customers; it signed the world's first power purchase agreement for space solar electricity, with Pacific Gas & Electric. Solaren is a hardware and energy-generation company and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Solvo.ai
providers.description: Solvo.ai is a revenue-orchestration company building the decision layer for revenue management in container logistics. Its live pricing engine ingests market rates, capacity manifests, booking history, port congestion, customer behaviour and contract terms, then uses models trained on tens of millions of historical bookings to produce a ranked, capacity-aware rate recommendation per lane, equipment type and segment. Trade managers accept, adjust or override these recommendations on Solvo's Decision HUB, and every decision feeds back as training signal through a bidirectional integration with the carrier's commercial stack. Founded in 2021 and backed by Speedinvest, Solvo positions itself as the only proven, live pricing engine built specifically for container shipping, with one of the world's top carriers in production. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Speedinvest portfolio company; Solvo currently publishes a marketing and insights site only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs or specifications.

providers.name: Sound.xyz
providers.description: Sound.xyz was a web3 music platform and suite of on-chain tools that let artists release music as digital collectibles and host listening parties for new releases, building direct economic relationships with their communities. The consumer platform went offline on 2026-01-16 (with a successor project, Vault.fm), but Sound.xyz's first-party developer surface remains publicly published: the open-source Sound protocol (a permissionless Solidity smart-contract framework for music collectibles) and the official @soundxyz npm SDK ecosystem (@soundxyz/sdk, sdk-viem, legacy-sdk) for on-chain development, alongside GraphQL and caching infrastructure libraries. Added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; this profile now reflects the enrichment pipeline's findings.

providers.name: Standard Practice
providers.description: Standard Practice builds voice AI for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) teams. Its AI agents place and handle outbound phone calls to insurance payers to automate administrative work — claim status follow-up, benefits verification, prior authorization, and EDI enrollment — so billing teams can scale collections and get paid more, faster. The platform is delivered as a private, login-gated web application. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Wing Venture Capital and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Stitch Fix
providers.description: Stitch Fix is an online personal styling service that pairs data science and machine learning with expert human stylists to send customers curated shipments ("Fixes") of apparel, footwear, and accessories selected to their size, budget, and style preferences. Founded in 2011 and publicly traded (NASDAQ: SFIX), the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail model across womens, mens, and kids categories. Stitch Fix does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its engineering team shares its data-science and platform work through the Multithreaded technology blog and open-source projects on GitHub. This profile captures the company's public web, security, and engineering surfaces.

providers.name: StoreDot
providers.description: StoreDot is an Israeli battery technology company founded in 2012 by Doron Myersdorf, Simon Litsyn and Gil Rosenman, headquartered in Herzliya with an advanced technology campus in Irvine, California.
