It develops extreme fast charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells built on proprietary silicon-dominant anode chemistry and synthesized organic and inorganic compounds optimized with machine-learning models, targeting the range and charging anxiety that gate mainstream electric-vehicle adoption. Its "100inX" product roadmap sets 100 miles of range charged in 5 minutes (100in5, 2024), 3 minutes (100in3, 2028) and 2 minutes (100in2, 2032); the company has demonstrated pouch and prismatic XFC cells sustaining more than 1,000 and later 2,000 extreme fast charging cycles while retaining over 80 percent of original capacity, and designs its chemistry to drop into existing Li-ion production lines. Strategic investors and partners include Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, BP, VinFast, Volvo, Polestar, Ola Electric, Samsung Ventures, TDK and manufacturing partner EVE Energy. In 2026 a planned SPAC merger with Andretti Acquisition Corp. II was terminated and the company returned to private fundraising. StoreDot is a hardware, materials and cell-manufacturing business: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server or machine-readable API contract, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, llms.txt or developer subdomain resolves on store-dot.com.

providers.name: Syncloop
providers.description: Syncloop is an advanced API development and management platform that enables organizations to design, deploy, and manage APIs efficiently. The platform provides a low-code/no-code API builder with support for REST, SOAP, and third-party integrations, running on cloud or on-premise infrastructure. Syncloop offers built-in authentication, rate limiting, monitoring, analytics, and a developer portal for API discovery and documentation.

providers.name: Tangerine
providers.description: Tangerine is a Canadian direct (branchless) bank headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and a federally regulated Schedule I bank chartered as Tangerine Bank (institution number 614). Founded in 1997 as ING Direct Canada, it was acquired by Scotiabank in 2012 and rebranded as Tangerine in 2014; it remains a separate legal entity operating as Scotiabank's digital-banking arm, serving roughly two million clients with no-fee chequing and savings accounts, GICs, mortgages, mutual funds, and a cash-back Mastercard delivered entirely through mobile and web. On API and open-finance posture, Tangerine publishes no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications; Canada has no operational consumer-driven-banking mandate yet (the federal framework is legislated but not live), so third-party access to Tangerine account and transaction data today is aggregator-based via Plaid and Finicity (Mastercard) rather than through a documented first-party API.

providers.name: Total Attorneys (Internet Brands)
providers.description: Total Attorneys is a legal marketing and lead-generation brand owned by Internet Brands. Originally a legal practice-management and client-intake SaaS backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the service was folded into the Martindale-Avvo network, and as of April 1, 2019 its attorney lead-generation offering transitioned to the Martindale-Nolo Pay Per Lead program. The totalattorneys.com site today markets pay-per-lead attorney marketing across practice areas such as bankruptcy, criminal defense, DUI/DWI, divorce, and personal injury. No public developer program or API is currently published.

providers.name: Trackonomy
providers.description: Trackonomy is a supply chain visibility company that digitizes real-world operations with barely-there smart label sensors. Its SmartTape and THL Tape products provide item-level tracking, monitoring location, temperature, humidity, and light in real time, while its platform connects, automates, controls, and remediates operations processes at global scale for logistics, industrial, utilities, healthcare, government, and airline customers. Trackonomy is backed by 8VC. It advertises a customizable RESTful API and webhook-based real-time data exchange for platform customers, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Trade Republic
providers.description: Trade Republic is a Berlin-based digital bank and Europe's largest savings platform, offering commission-optimized trading of stocks, ETFs, derivatives, and crypto, ETF and stock savings plans, interest on uninvested cash, and a Visa card. Trade Republic Bank GmbH holds a full German banking license and serves customers across European markets. The company publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or first-party SDKs — its mobile and web apps run on a private WebSocket-based backend (api.traderepublic.com) that a community ecosystem of unofficial clients has grown around.

providers.name: Twelve
providers.description: Twelve is a carbon transformation company that converts CO2, water, and renewable electricity into fuels and chemicals that serve as drop-in replacements for petroleum-based products. Its proprietary eManufacturing technology powers AirPlant One in Moses Lake, Washington, which produces E-Jet sustainable aviation fuel and E-Naphtha, while its eMade program partners with consumer brands on CO2-made materials. Investors include TPG, DCVC, Microsoft, Carbon Direct, Breakout Ventures, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. Twelve publishes no public developer API, but its Wix-hosted site exposes an llms.txt and a live site MCP endpoint for agentic access.

providers.name: Utilidata
providers.description: Utilidata is an Ann Arbor, Michigan software company building Karman, a distributed AI platform that runs on a custom NVIDIA system-on-module embedded directly into electrical infrastructure — smart meters and grid-edge devices on the utility side, PDUs and power trays inside AI data centers. Karman processes high-resolution AC metrology locally (single-cycle waveform statistics at 1+ MS/s sample rates) to produce "data products" such as Power Quality Analytics, enabling millisecond-level power control, GPU/PSU failure prediction, phase balancing and power-aware scheduling. Utilidata publishes the Karman Power Aware Module as Apache-2.0 open source: a Rust reference implementation that serializes Karman data products as Protocol Buffers (package utilidata.karman.bibimbap.v1), transports them over ZeroMQ, and exposes them to Prometheus and TimescaleDB through a Helm-packaged Kubernetes stack. The company has raised a $100M Series C and counts NVIDIA, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, American Electric Power and Renown Capital Partners among its backers.

providers.name: Wooga
providers.description: Wooga is a Berlin-based mobile game developer founded in 2009 and a subsidiary of Playtika, specializing in story-driven casual games such as June's Journey, Ghost Detective and Pearl's Peril. Wooga publishes no public API or developer portal, but maintains an active open-source GitHub organization with its atlas Gradle plugin suite for Unity and mobile build automation, published to the Gradle Plugin Portal and RubyGems. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and hv-capital.

providers.name: Workhelix
providers.description: Workhelix is an enterprise platform for measuring and growing the return on investment of AI initiatives. Its Nucleus product connects workforce data and AI usage history to rank AI opportunities by impact, identify high-performing superusers, surface adoption gaps, and estimate time and cost savings. The company was co-founded by economists Erik Brynjolfsson (Stanford) and Andrew McAfee (MIT) with CEO James Milin and research director Daniel Rock (Wharton), is backed by Bloomberg Beta, and serves enterprise customers including Autodesk, Nasdaq, and LogicMonitor. Workhelix publishes no public API or developer program as of July 2026.

providers.name: Zentist
providers.description: Zentist is a cloud-based revenue cycle management (RCM) platform built specifically for dental support organizations (DSOs) and multi-location dental practices. Its flagship product, Remit AI, uses artificial intelligence to automate electronic remittance advice (ERA) and explanation of benefits (EOB) parsing, payment posting, denial and adjustment categorization, and claims status tracking, while Cavi AR drives intelligent accounts-receivable follow-up. Executive dashboards deliver practice-level and organization-wide analytics. Trusted by more than 400 DSOs, Zentist reports doubling RCM productivity and cutting the cash-to-claim cycle in half within the first 100 days. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Zentist operates as a login-gated SaaS application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: ZeroAvia
providers.description: ZeroAvia is a UK/US hydrogen-electric aviation company founded in 2017 by Valery Miftakhov, developing hydrogen fuel cell and electric propulsion systems for commercial aircraft. Its powertrain line runs from the ZA600 (600kW, 10-20 seat regional turboprops) through the ZA2000 (2-5MW, 40-80 seat turboprops) to the ZA2000 RJ (5MW+, up to 90 seat regional jets), alongside a component business selling electric propulsion systems, inverters, electric motors and HTPEM/SuperStack fuel cell stacks to other clean-aviation manufacturers, plus a hydrogen airport refuelling ecosystem of electrolyzers, mobile refuelers and LH2 development. It operates from Cotswold Airport in Kemble, UK and from Everett, Washington, and holds FAA and CAA experimental certificates for its flight-test aircraft. ZeroAvia sells certified aerospace hardware to airframers, airlines, lessors and defense customers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: actnano
providers.description: actnano, Inc. is a Massachusetts-based advanced materials company that develops and manufactures PFAS-free protective nanocoatings for electronics. Its flagship Advanced nanoGUARD technology is a gel-state, 100% fluorine-free conformal coating applied to printed circuit board assemblies, connectors, antennas, LEDs and high-heat-generating components, delivering up to IPx8 moisture and condensation protection without trapping heat or degrading signal integrity. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a Munich center of excellence and operations in Mexico and Japan, actnano serves mobility and automotive electronics, consumer electronics, AI and data-center infrastructure, solar, industrial electronics, medical devices and optical anti-fog applications. The company states REACH and RoHS compliance and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and is backed by BMW i Ventures, Porsche Ventures and Emerald Technology Ventures. actnano is a materials manufacturer: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: AGTools
providers.description: Agtools, Inc. is an agricultural technology (AgTech) company providing a real-time data analytics and market-intelligence SaaS platform for the global food supply chain. The platform aggregates and curates hundreds of official government, institutional, university, and weather data sources covering 450+ specialty crops and commodities across 189+ countries, exposing 70+ variables and 25+ years of historical records (pricing, supply, demand, exchange rates, weather, CO2 footprint, and transportation costs) through dashboards, daily commodity reports, and a price analyzer so growers, shippers, buyers, and retailers can forecast demand, manage purchase orders, and reduce food waste. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, California, Agtools is a Techstars Farm to Fork alumnus and Microsoft Machine Learning & AI award winner. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface has been published to date.

Commercial products include fermentation-derived thebaine, oripavine and scopolamine, with a development pipeline of 70+ KSMs and APIs spanning neurology, gastrointestinal and oncology programs. It integrates with existing CRMs, custodians, and core systems, and is SOC 2 compliant with enterprise-grade architecture. Avantos raised a $35M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, announced February 2026.

providers.name: Bamboo Health
providers.description: Bamboo Health (formerly Appriss Health + PatientPing) is a healthcare technology company delivering Real-Time Care Intelligence across the physical and behavioral health continuum. It operates one of the nation's largest care-collaboration networks, connecting health systems, health plans, pharmacies, and state agencies through prescription drug monitoring (PDMP), care coordination, and behavioral healthcare navigation. Flagship solutions include Bamboo Bridge, OpenBeds, Pings, NarxCare, and the PMP AWARxE state monitoring platform. Backed by Insight Partners, the company supports over a billion patient encounters annually. Bamboo Health does not publish a public developer API; integrations are delivered through EHR workflows and partner/state programs. Security posture is documented in a public Trust Center (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST CSF, HIPAA, NIST 800-53).

providers.name: Beam
providers.description: Beam is a construction financial management platform for residential and commercial contractors, headquartered in San Francisco. Its cloud software unifies estimating and proposals, progress invoicing with online payment collection, job costing and real-time profitability, expense management via the Beam Card, bill-pay automation, lien-waiver and compliance tracking, project management (daily logs, scheduling, change orders), and a cash-management account that earns cash back. Beam integrates with QuickBooks Online, CompanyCam, RenoFi and XactRemodel, and relies on vetted partners including Stripe, Footprint and CapitalOS for payments and KYC/KYB. Beam does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation surface, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Biobot Analytics
providers.description: Biobot Analytics is a wastewater intelligence company that measures human health signals in sewage to deliver population-level public health data. Founded out of MIT in 2017, Biobot analyzes wastewater samples for pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, mpox), substances (opioids and other drugs), and other biomarkers, turning them into de-identified, community-scale intelligence. It serves federal government, state and local government, pharmaceutical and life-science organizations, healthcare systems, and wastewater treatment plants, who access results and dashboards through Biobot's customer data-exploration platform. Biobot is a venture-backed company in the DCVC portfolio. This profile currently exposes no public developer API; Biobot delivers data via reports and a login-gated platform rather than an open API program.

providers.name: Biofourmis
providers.description: Biofourmis is a health technology company founded in 2015, with offices in Boston, Singapore and India, that partners with health systems, hospitals, payers and life science companies to deliver care in the home. Its platform combines medical-grade device connectivity, FDA-cleared algorithms and digital biomarkers, a patient mobile app and clinician dashboard, and 70+ dynamic care pathways to support Hospital at Home, Timely Discharge, SNF at Home and Remote Patient Monitoring programs. Biofourmis merged with CopilotIQ in October 2024 to form an end-to-end platform for AI-driven in-home care; ActiGraph acquired the Biofourmis life science business in January 2025. The company markets EMR integration and device-agnostic connectivity to enterprise healthcare customers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Cagent Vascular
providers.description: Cagent Vascular is a privately held endovascular medical device company based in Wayne, Pennsylvania, that develops and commercializes Serration Remodeling Therapy (SRT). Its flagship product, the Serranator PTA Serration Balloon Catheter, embeds stainless-steel serrated strips into a semi-compliant angioplasty balloon to create linear, interrupted micro-fissures along the artery wall, producing controlled lumen expansion at lower pressures when treating peripheral artery disease (PAD) and chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI). The Serranator is FDA 510(k) cleared and CE marked, and the portfolio has expanded to include Serranator SL-PRO and the Serranator SONIC intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) system. Cagent Vascular is a device manufacturer rather than a software or platform company: it publishes clinical data, case studies, webinars and reimbursement material on its website, but no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: CargoWise
providers.description: CargoWise is WiseTech Global's logistics execution platform - a single-database ERP for international freight forwarding, customs, warehousing, transport, and landside logistics. Its integration surface is delivered primarily through eAdaptor, which pairs a RESTful XML inbound service (push, query, add, and update records) with a SOAP-based outbound service (a webhook equivalent that emits messages on milestones). Payloads use CargoWise's Universal XML schemas - Universal Shipment (XUS), Universal Event (XUE), and Universal Transaction - or the legacy Native XML format. Newer REST integration (eAdaptor Next / xHub) adds OAuth 2.0 authorization-code access. The integration API is real but heavily gated - the eAdaptor Developers Guide and endpoint details are released only after a customer purchases the eAdaptor modules, and partner access runs through WiseTech accreditation and certification. Endpoints below are modeled from public developer references; the authoritative specification is not publicly published.

providers.name: Catena-X
providers.description: Catena-X is the automotive industry's data space standard, published by Catena-X Automotive Network e.V. — a non-commercial German registered association founded on 15 May 2021 by BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Bosch, SAP, Siemens, Schaeffler, ZF, BASF, Henkel, Deutsche Telekom and Fraunhofer, with backing from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action. It publishes a numbered CX-xxxx library of 77 standards covering how a supply chain exchanges part data, carbon footprints, quality records, demand and capacity signals and digital product passports without any participant surrendering its data to a central platform. Standards move forward together in named releases — Jupiter, Io, Saturn, Titan — gated by a Technical Committee for Standardization, and conformance is certified by nominated third-party assessment bodies including TÜV Rheinland and TÜV SÜD. The reference implementation is open source as Eclipse Tractus-X, and the network is operated commercially by Cofinity-X. It is the most institutionally complete industry API standard in Europe, and the one whose endpoints an outside developer can never call: in a data space every participant runs its own connector and registry, so there is nothing to call until you are onboarded, credentialed and certified.

providers.name: Fluxx

Its lead product, Fertilo, is an engineered line of ovarian support cells that mature immature eggs outside the body to reduce the hormonal burden of IVF and egg freezing, and is in a Phase 3 clinical trial (FIRST). Additional programs include Deovo, an organoid of the female reproductive system for drug discovery, and Ameno, a cell-based therapeutic targeting menopause and primary ovarian insufficiency. Halo reports more than $45.5B in transactions since 2015 and employs 100+ people. Its affiliate Halo Securities LLC is an SEC-registered broker-dealer and a member of FINRA/SIPC, acting as distributor and selling agent for structured note products. providers.name: Imbria Pharmaceuticals

Ninerafaxstat is in the global FORTITUDE-HCM Phase 2b trial (NCT07023614) for symptomatic non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM), which has no approved treatments, and holds FDA Orphan Drug Designation for that indication; a Phase 2b in cardiometabolic HFpEF is planned. Users sign up with a phone number (no password) and enable push notifications to be alerted when their favorite mobile vendors are nearby — artisanal food trucks, farmers'-market sellers, and one-click services such as bike repair, car wash, manicures, pedicures, and knife sharpening — then request a "jingle" to summon them. Deliveries are handled directly by the businesses themselves, cutting out delivery middlemen. Merchants use the app at their discretion to broadcast their presence to nearby neighborhoods, and residential complexes can partner to bring vendors on-site. Jingle is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public consumer and merchant surface.

providers.name: Justlife
providers.description: Justlife is the Middle East's leading home-services super app, connecting customers with vetted professionals for on-demand cleaning, beauty and wellness, healthcare-at-home, laundry, and home maintenance. Founded in 2015 by Cagatay Ozcan and Kerem Kuyucu, the company operates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain through its consumer mobile apps and website. Justlife publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, policy, security, and AI-agent (llms.txt) surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Karat.io
providers.description: Karat (trykarat.com) is a fintech platform providing integrated business banking and financial tools built for entrepreneurs, content creators, agencies, and small businesses managing irregular income. Its product suite spans FDIC-insured business checking accounts with high APY, the Karat Card and Karat Max charge/credit cards with rewards and no annual fees, mass and international contractor payments, AI-powered bookkeeping with automatic transaction categorization, invoicing, and multi-entity team management. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass Karat publishes a consumer web and mobile app but no public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Kasheesh
providers.description: Kasheesh is a consumer fintech platform that lets people split a single purchase across up to five credit and debit cards in one transaction. Instead of a traditional buy-now-pay-later loan, Kasheesh combines the funds and credit a customer already holds into a single digital Kasheesh Card that works at any Mastercard-accepting merchant online or in-store via tap-to-pay. The service charges a flat service fee, returns card rewards on spend, and requires no sign-up fee or credit check. Kasheesh is offered through iOS and Android apps and a web app, targeting everyday shopping, bill payment, and rent. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Anthemis; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kestrl: Muslim Money App
providers.description: Kestrl is a UK-based, FCA-regulated ethical fintech offering a values-aligned money app for Muslim and ethically-minded consumers. In partnership with Maybank Islamic, it provides interest-free (Sharia-compliant) banking, a Mastercard debit card with values filtering, goal-based sub-accounts, interest purification and Zakat calculation, transaction monitoring that alerts users to payments toward ethically questionable companies, and security features such as card freezing and biometric authentication. Kestrl is a consumer mobile application on iOS and Android; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: Knight-Swift Transportation
providers.description: Knight-Swift Transportation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Knight-Swift Transportation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Kouper Health
providers.description: Kouper Health (Kouper) is a healthcare technology company building an AI-agent orchestration layer for care navigation, deployed on top of a provider organization's existing EHR. The platform spans the full patient journey through three named agents: PRIMUS for patient access and inbound coordination (appointment scheduling, intake, insurance verification, missed-call recovery), ARCHIE for inpatient and post-acute navigation (discharge planning, home health attachment, LUPA risk), and CURA for ongoing care coordination and management (proactive outreach, reminders, check-ins, escalation). Kouper sells to health systems, independent and specialty provider groups, clinically integrated networks, risk-bearing entities, and payers, with multilingual patient engagement, human escalation, and HIPAA-compliant workflows. The company emerged from stealth in May 2025 with a $10M seed round led by General Catalyst with 25Madison and CVS Health Ventures, and operates out of New York, San Francisco, and Nashville. As of this profile Kouper publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts — the product is delivered as a managed EHR-integrated service rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
providers.description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Kratos Defense & Security Solutions API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: La Haus
providers.description: La Haus is a Latin American proptech company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Medellín and Bogotá, Colombia, that operates the residential real-estate marketplaces lahaus.com (Colombia) and lahaus.mx (Mexico) together with an in-house brokerage. The platform lists de-duplicated, verified new-construction and resale housing from vetted developers, adds mortgage and down-payment simulators, buyer guides and an AI assistant, and takes buyers through negotiation and closing at no cost to the buyer. It has raised more than $135M in equity plus debt facilities from Kaszek, NFX, Acrew Capital, Greenspring Associates, SoftBank and Bezos Expeditions. La Haus publishes NO public developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract: the consumer sites are server-rendered applications whose /api/* paths are disallowed in robots.txt, and api.lahaus.com is a private AWS API Gateway that answers every anonymous request with MissingAuthenticationToken. Partner/portal syndication runs through access-controlled marketing feed integrations (Trovit). This profile therefore records the company's public web surface and security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: LabGenius Therapeutics
providers.description: LabGenius Therapeutics is a London-based drug discovery company that combines machine learning, high-throughput robotic experimentation and synthetic biology to discover and co-optimise next-generation therapeutic antibodies for solid tumours. Its EVA (Experimental Vector Automation) platform is a closed-loop, modality-agnostic discovery engine that runs a design-build-test-learn cycle in under six weeks — computationally designing multispecific antibodies in the dry lab, then cloning, expressing, purifying and functionally screening up to 2,300 multispecifics per cycle in an automated wet lab, and feeding the resulting proprietary data back into multi-objective ML models. The company operates a wholly-owned pipeline of selectivity-enhanced T-cell engagers alongside partnered antibody-optimisation programmes with Sanofi. LabGenius is a pre-clinical therapeutics company and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and machine-readable surface only.

providers.name: LEAP
providers.description: LEAP is cloud-based legal practice management software for law firms, covering matter and contact management, document automation and court forms, time recording, billing, and trust accounting, tightly integrated with Microsoft 365. LEAP operates a LEAP Developer Console and LEAP Marketplace (developer.leap.build / console.leap.build) through which approved third-party developers build REST-based integrations (an "API Reference" is versioned there, e.g. v1.0.4, v1.0.5), but the technical reference - endpoint paths, base URL, and authentication schema - sits behind developer registration and an app review process rather than a public, self-serve API reference. There is no publicly published OpenAPI document, public base URL, or anonymous API key signup. Existing Marketplace integrations (Xero, Zoom, InfoTrack, LawTap, and others) confirm the API surface is real and in production use, but its concrete shape is not publicly disclosed.

providers.name: LevitasBio
providers.description: LevitasBio is a Menlo Park, California life-science instrumentation company, founded in 2017, that commercializes magnetic levitation technology developed at Stanford and Harvard for label-free separation and characterization of living cells. Its LeviCell family of benchtop instruments (LeviCell 1.0, LeviCell Access 1.0, LeviCell EOS and the high-throughput LeviCell 96) suspends cells in three-dimensional space and separates viable cells from dead cells and debris without antibodies, beads or other labels. The platform is surrounded by LeviPrep tissue dissociation and nuclei extraction kits, the Nuvo automated tissue prep system, LeviSelect untouched depletion kits (tissue RBC, immune cell, mouse myelin, cell debris) and LeviMetrics, an AI-based analysis software layer that reads bright-field and fluorescence imagery captured during a run to characterize the sample. Customers use the platform for viable cell enrichment, single-cell genomics, cancer profiling and 3D culture/organoid workflows. LevitasBio sells instruments and consumables through a direct and distributor channel and, as of this profiling pass, publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Lina
providers.description: Lina is a medical coworking company providing space, community, and support for independent healthcare practitioners in private practice. Founded by Vicrum Puri and Rachel Puri, Lina offers turnkey private office suites alongside on-demand medical, therapy, and bodywork spaces that are HIPAA and OSHA compliant and bookable by the hour or by the day. Locations operate in NoMad and Grand Central in New York City and Aventura, Florida, with expansion announced for Washington DC, West Palm Beach, the Upper West Side, and Brooklyn. Lina is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. It operates a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: M&T Bank
providers.description: M&T Bank is a US super-regional bank holding company (M&T Bank Corporation, NYSE: MTB) headquartered in Buffalo, New York, operating through its national bank subsidiary Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company. With roughly $200 billion in assets it is one of the twenty largest US commercial banks, serving consumers, businesses, and institutional clients across the eastern United States, and it owns Wilmington Trust, its custody, fund-administration, and wealth arm. Unlike UK/AU open banking there is no single mandated contract in the US, so M&T's public API posture is split: it runs a real first-party Developer Portal / "API Store" at developer.mtb.com for institutional and wholesale clients (Banking & Treasury plus Wilmington Trust Custody APIs), gated behind Microsoft Entra login and Azure API Management subscription keys with per-product OpenAPI reference available only after authentication. Consumer-permissioned account data is shared through aggregators (Plaid) rather than a public first-party consumer API. No public FDX conformance or CFPB Section 1033 data-access API is documented on the portal at review time.

providers.name: Marine Mammal Commission
providers.description: The Marine Mammal Commission is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government established by the Marine Mammal Protection Act of 1972. The Commission provides science-based oversight of federal agency actions and domestic and international policies affecting the conservation of marine mammals and their ecosystems.

providers.name: Mavenoid
providers.description: Mavenoid is an AI agent platform for product support, helping hardware and consumer-electronics companies deflect and resolve customer issues through self-service troubleshooting across voice, text, image, and video. Its products include Voice Assist (AI call routing and self-service), a Dynamic Help Center that surfaces AI-powered support in search results, an embeddable Virtual Assistant, and an Insights analytics dashboard. Mavenoid connects to CRM, ticketing, ERP, e-commerce, and IoT systems. The company is backed by Creandum and Point Nine. As of this enrichment pass Mavenoid publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or well-known discovery surface; integrations are configured within its product rather than via a documented public REST API.

providers.name: Mettler-Toledo International
providers.description: Mettler-Toledo International is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Mettler-Toledo International API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Mia-Platform
providers.description: Mia-Platform is an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that harmonizes infrastructure, applications, and data for intelligent engineering at scale. It provides an API-first platform for building and managing microservices and cloud-native applications.

providers.name: Minerals Technologies
providers.description: Minerals Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Minerals Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Modine Manufacturing
providers.description: Modine Manufacturing is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Modine Manufacturing API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: MOO
providers.description: MOO is a London-founded online print and design company that produces premium custom business cards, postcards, flyers, stickers, notebooks, packaging, and branded promotional merchandise for individuals and businesses. Backed by Index Ventures, MOO combines a browser-based design experience with commercial printing, and sells tiered business plans (Business, Advanced, Enterprise) with team management and design services. MOO does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; its developer-style subdomains resolve to the main storefront rather than an API surface. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Nava
providers.description: Nava (Nava Benefits) is a modern employee benefits brokerage that pairs benefits advisors with AI-powered technology to cut administrative work, simplify renewals, and support employees around the clock. Its HQ platform helps HR teams manage benefits and renewals while an employee app acts as a 24/7 digital benefits concierge for workers and their families, integrating with BenAdmin and carrier systems. Backed by Homebrew, Nava positions itself as an alternative to traditional brokers focused on cost savings and administrative relief. No public developer program, API, or OpenAPI surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Neuros Medical
providers.description: Neuros Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Arden Hills, Minnesota, and the maker of the Altius Direct Electrical Nerve Stimulation System — an implantable, patient-controlled high-frequency nerve block indicated as an aid in the management of chronic intractable phantom and residual lower limb post-amputation pain in adult amputees. The system pairs a nerve cuff electrode placed around a peripheral nerve with an implantable pulse generator and a handheld patient controller, and received FDA approval in 2024 after FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and the QUEST pivotal trial. The company sells an implantable therapy to health systems, pain physicians and amputees; it operates a marketing and patient-education website and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: New Lantern
providers.description: New Lantern is a cloud-native, AI-native radiology platform that unifies the worklist, PACS/DICOM viewer, and AI-powered reporting into a single browser-based workspace, replacing the fragmented multi-system software stack most radiology practices run today. Its cloud-native DICOM viewer offers 3D/MPR/MIP reconstruction, mammography and PET/CT modes, and AI hanging protocols; its Curie AI reporting assistant drafts reports that a licensed radiologist reviews, edits, and signs; and NL-Vox provides radiology-tuned speech recognition, alongside intelligent worklist and case distribution, analytics, and native Epic/Oracle Health EHR integration. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, New Lantern is backed by a $19M Series A led by Benchmark and is FDA registered as a Class I medical image communications device (21 CFR 892.2020). New Lantern does not currently expose a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web/security posture.

providers.name: Nordson Corporation
providers.description: Nordson Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Nordson Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Nuvaira
providers.description: Nuvaira, Inc. is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, founded in 2008 to treat overactive airway nerves in people living with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Its dNerva Lung Denervation System is a catheter-based, radiofrequency device used in a bronchoscopic procedure called Targeted Lung Denervation (TLD), which the FDA has designated a Breakthrough Device. The company holds more than 70 issued and pending patents worldwide, has treated over 500 patients across its AIRFLOW clinical program, and is currently running the pivotal AIRFLOW-3 trial. Nuvaira sells a regulated physical therapeutic device to hospitals and interventional pulmonologists; it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Nym
providers.description: Nym is a healthcare technology company providing autonomous medical coding for health systems, hospitals, and physician groups. Its proprietary Clinical Language Understanding (CLU) engine reads clinical documentation and assigns accurate medical codes (ICD-10, CPT, and E/M) without human intervention, combining machine reading with transparent, rules-based coding logic rather than generic natural language processing. Nym automates revenue cycle management to reduce coding costs, accelerate billing, and improve charge capture across 400+ US healthcare facilities, and is used by health systems including OSF, Ochsner Health, Inova, and Henry Ford. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Nym does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Oasdiff
providers.description: Oasdiff is an open-source tool for detecting breaking changes and generating changelogs from OpenAPI specifications.

providers.name: Onco.com
providers.description: Onco.com is a comprehensive cancer care platform operated by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd that connects cancer patients across India with oncologists and treatment services. The platform offers priority expert oncology consultations, pan-India cancer medicine delivery at discounted rates, diagnostic testing and imaging, curated treatment packages with negotiated hospital rates, and the CanWin peer support group for survivors and caregivers. Onco.com reports a network of 400+ oncologists and 23+ treatment centers, having served more than 100,000 patients. It also publishes extensive patient-education content covering many cancer types (breast, lung, blood, prostate, colon, and others) through its About Cancer library and blog. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company; the platform is consumer/patient facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Open Port Technology
providers.description: Open Port Technology (OpenPort) is a pan-Asian logistics and supply chain technology company that digitizes trucking, freight, and supply chain operations across emerging markets through an open, neutral, AI-based platform. Headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, its product suite spans transport management (OpenTM), a digital trucking marketplace (OpenMarket), customs clearance (OpenClear), warehouse picking operations (OpenPick), and FBR digital invoicing (Open Invoice). The company reports millions of completed shipments, 1,600+ transport partners, and integrations across 100+ ERP systems, offering ERP integration and custom API development to clients, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: Opna Bio
providers.description: Opna Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on oncology, developing novel small-molecule and targeted-degrader therapeutics against key regulators of cancer, including the Hallmarks of Cancer. Its pipeline features OPN-6602 (an EP300/CBP inhibitor in Phase 1 for multiple myeloma, granted FDA Fast Track designation), zavabresib (OPN-2853, a BET inhibitor with Orphan Drug designation for myelofibrosis), multi-functional protein degraders, and additional programs targeting hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. The company operates from South San Francisco and San Diego, California, and Lausanne, Switzerland.

providers.name: Pacto
providers.description: Pacto is a Mexican fintech company modernizing payment acquisition for banks and hospitality businesses, moving them "de lo legacy a lo digital" (from legacy to digital). Pacto builds point-of-sale (POS) software and payment terminals: a miniPOS terminal and "Ordena y Paga" (order-and-pay) terminals plus value-added modules for banks, and a full restaurant POS suite (Pacto POS, Pacto GetNet, Order & Pay QR ordering, bill splitting, inventory, and reporting) for restaurants, cafes, bars, and fast-food counters. Backed by 500 Global and Banco Santander's GetNet, Pacto helps traditional financial institutions and merchants accept digital card payments and manage operations. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Pacto publishes a marketing site, blog, and pricing but no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Patrick Industries
providers.description: Patrick Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Patrick Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Pedestal Health (formerly Target RWE)
providers.description: Pedestal Health, formerly Target RWE (and NoviSci), is a Durham, North Carolina real-world evidence and health-data company serving life sciences organizations and health systems. It generates regulatory-grade real-world evidence from large-scale observational data and longitudinal patient cohorts across hepatology, dermatology, and gastroenterology (including the TARGET-NASH, TARGET-Derm, and TARGET-Gastro registries), supporting clinical development, regulatory strategy, and care delivery. The company operates as a data, research, and services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched from the company's public website (targetrwe.com now redirects to pedestalhealth.com).

providers.name: Peel Therapeutics
providers.description: Peel Therapeutics is an evolutionary-medicine biotechnology company headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, with research teams in the United States and Israel. Co-founded in 2015 by pediatric oncologist Dr. Joshua Schiffman, the company translates molecules that evolution has already validated in nature into therapeutics for patients with cancer and inflammatory disease. Its founding program is built on elephant p53 (EP53) — elephants carry roughly forty copies of the p53 tumor-suppressor gene against the human two — delivered as liposomal protein nanoparticles, alongside PEEL-224, a TOP1 inhibitor in clinical development. Discovery runs on the company's proprietary, internal Darwin.AI platform and the Darwin Biobank, a comparative-oncology sample collection. Peel is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Petco Animal Supplies
providers.description: Petco Animal Supplies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Petco Animal Supplies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Pluro
providers.description: Pluro is India's fertility and IVF platform, built as a co-creation model with doctors for patients. It delivers personalised, evidence-based reproductive care through a growing network of 15+ clinics across India, combining advanced clinical science, AI-assisted embryology, standardised treatment protocols, and transparent pricing. Founded by Dr. Bhaskar Shah, Dr. Jaydeep Tank, and Dr. Parikshit Tank, Pluro raised a Rs 125 crore Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners in 2025. It offers IVF/ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, and a range of diagnostic and surgical fertility treatments. Pluro publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: PotlatchDeltic
providers.description: PotlatchDeltic is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The PotlatchDeltic API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Quaker Houghton
providers.description: Quaker Houghton is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Quaker Houghton API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: QurAlis
providers.description: QurAlis Corporation is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded on December 12, 2016 in Cambridge, Massachusetts by Drs. Kasper Roet, Kevin Eggan and Clifford Woolf together with Q-State Biosciences, and staffed by neurodegenerative biologists out of Harvard Medical School and Harvard University. The company develops precision medicines for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and other neurodegenerative and neurological diseases, built on the discovery — published in Nature Neuroscience by co-founder Kevin Eggan's lab — that loss of normal TDP-43 function drives a decrease in STATHMIN-2 (STMN2) expression and impairs neuronal repair. Its lead candidates are QRL-201, a first-in-class molecule intended to restore STMN2 expression in ALS (ANQUR trial), and QRL-101, a potentially best-in-class selective Kv7.2/7.3 ion channel opener for hyperexcitability-induced disease progression in ALS as well as epilepsy and pain; a third program targets UNC13A cryptic-exon mis-splicing. Therapies are built on the proprietary FlexASO® anti-sense oligonucleotide splice-modulator platform. QurAlis publishes a corporate site covering its story, pipeline, platform, people, patient resources, presentations and press releases, but runs no developer program: no API documentation, no SDKs, no developer portal, no GitHub organisation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Regal Rexnord
providers.description: Regal Rexnord is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Regal Rexnord API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Remedio
providers.description: Remedio is an autonomous cybersecurity remediation platform that detects and automatically fixes misconfigurations, configuration drift, and emerging Shadow AI risks across hybrid IT environments at machine speed. Its platform spans five modules — Baseline (secure configuration baselines), AI Govern (discovery and governance of AI tools, agents, and connections), Fortify (autonomous vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation), Gate (application and software control), and Assure (continuous compliance monitoring) — with predictive impact preview, auditable rollback, and ROI measurement. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Remedio publishes a marketing site and blog but no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: ROMTech
providers.description: ROMTech (ROM Technologies, Inc.) is a privately held medical technology company headquartered in Brookfield, Connecticut that builds connected orthopedic rehabilitation technology. Its flagship product, the PortableConnect Adaptive Telemed Technology, is a prescription, clinician-delivered home rehabilitation device for patients recovering from total knee replacement, total hip replacement, joint manipulation and ACL repair. Adaptive pedal technology adjusts automatically to a patient's current range of motion across four therapy modes (passive, active-assisted, active and resistance); the AccuAngle Bluetooth wearable measures knee flexion and extension during each session; and the PortableConnect App runs a prescribed protocol of three to five daily sessions over a typical four-to-eight-week plan. Session data — range of motion, adherence and key health metrics — streams to a Clinician Portal where the prescribing surgeon reviews real-time reports and adjusts the protocol remotely, with in-app telemedicine for face-to-face follow-ups. The technology began as the ROM3 Rehab device. ROMTech was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list for 2025 and to the LexisNexis Top 100 Global Innovators for 2026, and sells to clinicians, health systems and the Department of Veterans Affairs. ROMTech runs no public developer program: it publishes no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer documentation, and the Clinician Portal at portal.romtech.com is a closed single-page application backed by a private, undocumented API at middleware.romtech.com/api.

providers.name: RPM International
providers.description: RPM International Inc. is a multinational specialty coatings and sealants company headquartered in Medina, Ohio, with annual revenues of approximately $7.4 billion. RPM operates a portfolio of over 100 leading brands across three segments: Consumer (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Zinsser), Construction (Tremco, Dryvit, Flowcrete), and Performance Coatings (Carboline, Stonhard, Plasite). RPM International does not currently offer a public developer API, but its subsidiaries and brands serve the construction, maintenance, and protective coatings markets globally.

providers.name: Scape
providers.description: Scape (Scape Wellness) is an on-demand wellness technology platform in Latin America that lets customers book professional spa experiences delivered to their home, apartment, hotel, Airbnb, office, or corporate event. Certified, identity-verified therapists arrive with all required equipment — professional massage table, towels, oils, and materials. The catalog spans relaxing, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, lymphatic drainage, reflexology, and couples massages; facials; body treatments; and combined facial-plus-massage experiences, alongside personal and corporate gift cards and workplace wellness programs. Scape operates in Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and the Dominican Republic via iOS and Android apps, with payments through MercadoPago and PayPal. It is a consumer booking platform and does not publish a public developer API or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Scimplify
providers.description: Scimplify is a Bengaluru-based advanced specialty chemicals company that combines deep chemical expertise, software, and global manufacturing capacity to make complex chemical supply predictable at scale. Founded in 2023, it operates as a contract research (CRO) and contract manufacturing (CMO) organization across the specialty-chemicals lifecycle, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flavors & fragrances, industrial, beauty & personal care, food & nutrition, dyes & pigments, oleochemicals, flame retardants, and critical-metals industries. Its integrated Scinode platform, IONS R&D and ATOMS manufacturing ecosystems, and Scira AI agentic layer coordinate discovery, sourcing, and production. Scimplify publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web, content, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sensata Technologies
providers.description: Sensata Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sensata Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Sensorum Health
providers.description: Sensorum Health is a healthcare technology company that provides home-based, fully passive sensor technology and integrated clinical services to identify and triage the earliest signs of health decline in older adults living with chronic conditions. The platform monitors patients 24/7 in their own homes without requiring wearables, smartphones, or WiFi, then coordinates clinical interventions when concerning health patterns emerge — with the goal of preventing avoidable hospital admissions. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). Added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; no public API, specification, or developer program has been published as of this profile.

providers.name: ShardSecure
providers.description: ShardSecure is a data security company providing agentless, file-level data protection that keeps sensitive data private, resilient, and compliant across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid or multi-cloud environments. Its platform uses microsharding to cryptographically fragment and distribute data so exfiltrated fragments are unintelligible, adds ransomware detection with self-healing data integrity, and extends to securing AI inference data through an MCP Secure Gateway. ShardSecure is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API or developer portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Sketchpro
providers.description: SketchPro is an AI copilot for Autodesk Revit that helps architects and engineers automate construction documentation directly inside their live project models. Delivered as a native Revit plugin (not a public developer API), it executes natural-language instructions to handle dimensioning, tagging, view creation, sheet setup, and scheduling, while adapting to each firm's standards, naming conventions, and documentation logic through an admin-configured AI Knowledge Base. Founded in 2023 and used by architecture practices including SOM, 10 Design, and Little, SketchPro is backed by Khosla Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or event/webhook surface; API access is described as "contact vendor / not publicly documented."

providers.name: Skyline Champion
providers.description: Skyline Champion is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Skyline Champion API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Stepan Company
providers.description: Stepan Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Stepan Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Swing Therapeutics
providers.description: Swing Therapeutics is a San Francisco digital therapeutics company founded in 2019 that develops evidence-based, smartphone-delivered treatments for chronic illness. Its lead product, Stanza, is a 12-week prescription digital therapeutic delivering Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) for the management of fibromyalgia symptoms in adults, and in 2023 it became the first digital therapeutic to receive FDA De Novo marketing authorization for that indication. Stanza is prescribed by clinicians and dispensed to patients as a native iOS/Android application; the company also operates Swing Care, a virtual fibromyalgia clinic offering physician visits, medication management and coaching. Swing Therapeutics and Swing Care were acquired by XRHealth in July 2026. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification — its software is delivered exclusively as a regulated end-user therapy, and it is an API consumer (its clinical operations run on the Healthie EHR API) rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Sym
providers.description: Sym was a developer-first authorization and access-management platform for platform, security, and infrastructure engineering teams. Rather than a REST API, Sym exposes its control plane as infrastructure-as-code: teams declare access flows, environments, targets, and user-facing fields with the Sym Terraform provider, customize runtime behavior with the Python SDK (hooks and reducers in impl.py), and operate the platform with the symflow CLI. It automated context-based, time-bound access requests and approvals across AWS (IAM, SSO), Okta, GCP, Jira, Slack, and other targets with centralized governance embedded in an organization's existing SDLC. The Sym product is now largely wound down — the docs root is sunset and most source repositories under github.com/symopsio are archived — but its published packages, Terraform provider, and changelog remain available.

providers.name: Synapsor
providers.description: Synapsor (legal entity Ottai Technology (Wuxi) Co. Ltd.) is a Chinese medical-device company based in Wuxi, Jiangsu that develops AI-powered, medical-grade smart wearable devices. Its flagship product is the Ottai continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system - a waterproof, calibration-free wearable sensor paired with a mobile app and AI assistant for 24/7 glucose tracking and diabetes management, sold in China and internationally via ottai.com. Investors include Qiming Venture Partners, Huatai Zijin Investment, Wuxi Industry Development Group, YuanBio Venture Capital, and Shunwei Capital. Synapsor publishes no public developer API, portal, or machine-readable API specifications as of July 2026.

providers.name: Tembo Health
providers.description: Tembo Health is a telemedicine practice (founded 2018) that partners with skilled nursing facilities and senior living communities to deliver 24/7 virtual specialty and urgent care to elderly residents. Its board-certified clinicians provide treat-in-place emergency medicine, psychiatry, cardiology, and dementia care, reducing avoidable ER transfers by roughly 75 percent, and the company works with senior-care operators and EHR platforms such as PointClickCare. Tembo Health is a healthcare services provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Terremoto Biosciences
providers.description: Terremoto Biosciences is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, building a covalent drug discovery and development engine around lysine-based covalency. Founded in 2022 by veterans of Principia Biopharma and backed by OrbiMed and Third Rock Ventures across Series A ($75M), Series B ($175M) and Series C ($108M) financings, the company designs highly selective small-molecule medicines aimed both at improving on known drug targets and at reaching targets previously considered undruggable. Its lead program, TER-2013, is an AKT1-selective inhibitor granted FDA Fast Track designation for breast cancer, with additional work in oncology and hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia. Terremoto is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable API contract, and its public web surface is a corporate marketing site covering science, pipeline, news and careers.

providers.name: TheraNest
providers.description: TheraNest (now marketed as Ensora Mental Health) is a behavioral and mental health practice management and EHR platform for therapists, counselors, psychologists, and social workers. It covers client intake, scheduling, telehealth, clinical documentation and notes, treatment plans, client portals, insurance billing and claims, and reporting. TheraNest is the flagship mental health product of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands). As of this review, Ensora does not publish a documented, self-serve public developer API for TheraNest - integration is via partnerships, HIPAA-gated interoperability, and contact-sales arrangements rather than an open developer portal. The API entries below are logical resource groupings modeled from the product surface; their endpoints are NOT documented public endpoints (endpointsModeled true).

providers.name: Third Arc Bio
providers.description: Third Arc Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Lower Gwynedd, Pennsylvania, developing multifunctional antibodies that build immune synapses to precisely activate or inhibit T cells. Its ARCStim platform targets solid tumors and its ARCTag platform pursues tissue-specific precision immune regulation for immunology and inflammation (I&I) indications; lead program ARC101 is a bispecific T-cell engager in a Phase 1 trial in patients with CLDN6-expressing solid tumors. The company launched in 2022 with seed financing from Omega Funds, raised an oversubscribed $165M Series A, and closed a $52M Series A extension in February 2026 with Andreessen Horowitz joining the syndicate. Third Arc Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification — it is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor.

providers.name: TradeLink
providers.description: TradeLink is a Munich-based logistics SaaS company building the first collaboration platform for supply chain and inbound/outbound logistics. Its cloud software gives warehouses, suppliers, carriers, and dispatchers a shared system for time-slot (dock) booking, dock and yard management, load-carrier and empties management, driver check-in terminals, and analytics insights, replacing phone and email coordination with real-time, transparent workflows. TradeLink integrates with existing ERP and transport-management systems and serves production, retail, and contract-logistics companies across the DACH region and Europe, with customers including MAN, SPAR, Liebherr, and Emons. It is backed by Insight Partners and Point Nine.

providers.name: Trex Company
providers.description: Trex Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Trex Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Trunk Tools
providers.description: Trunk Tools is a construction-technology company building an AI/ML platform that helps general contractors, specialty contractors, and owners make sense of project data buried in documents and automate repetitive, time-intensive workflows. Founded in 2021 with offices in New York, Austin, and Santa Barbara, its products include TrunkText (instant answers from project documents via a construction AI agent), TrunkSubmittal and an auto-generated Submittal Register, TrunkReview (drawing-revision change detection), TrunkRFI, and TrunkBid. The platform ingests structured and unstructured construction data (PDF, XER, MPP, CSV) and connects to major project and document management systems such as Procore, Autodesk, CMiC, SharePoint, Box, Dropbox, and Egnyte. Backed by Insight Partners and Redpoint Ventures.

providers.name: Upsight
providers.description: Upsight was a mobile analytics and marketing platform for apps and games — positioning itself as a "user lifecycle management platform" combining omnichannel analytics, integrated web and mobile marketing, ad optimization, and a DataMine SQL analytics product behind a single SDK for iOS, Android, tvOS, Unity, and Web. A Battery Ventures portfolio company, the platform is now defunct - upsight.com no longer resolves, the help.upsight.com developer docs survive only in the Internet Archive, and the GitHub org has been dormant since 2020, though the UpsightKit CocoaPods SDK and the doctor PyPI package remain published.

providers.name: Venwiz
providers.description: Venwiz is a Bengaluru, India based B2B digital platform for the procurement of industrial and infrastructural project services, covering both CapEx and MRO requirements for the manufacturing sector. Founded in 2020 by Rajesh Reddy and Sandesh Paturi, it operates a marketplace that connects industrial buyers with a verified, pan-India database of service vendors, adding vendor discovery, order expediting, project management tooling and vendor intelligence on top. Backed by Accel and other investors (~$11.4M raised), Venwiz digitises what has traditionally been an offline, relationship-driven industrial services procurement process. No public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this enrichment pass; the public presence is a marketing/content website plus a login-gated application.

providers.name: Warrior Met Coal
providers.description: Warrior Met Coal is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Warrior Met Coal API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Waters Corporation
providers.description: Waters Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Waters Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Watts Water Technologies
providers.description: Watts Water Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Watts Water Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Web3 Foundation
providers.description: Web3 Foundation is a Swiss nonprofit founded in 2017 by Gavin Wood that funds research and development teams building the foundation of a decentralized web (Web3). It stewards and supports the Polkadot and Kusama networks, operates a research hub and an education/wiki program, and historically ran the Web3 Foundation Grants Program (now discontinued) to seed open-source software and protocol research. It is a funding and research organization rather than a traditional API provider: it publishes no public REST/OpenAPI surface, but does maintain an RFC 9116 security.txt and a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program.

providers.name: Whill
providers.description: WHILL, Inc. designs and manufactures enhanced personal mobility solutions — electric power chairs and mobility scooters, including the Model C2, Model F, the Modo Breeze ultralight foldable wheelchair, and the Model R three- and four-wheel scooters — and operates an autonomous personal mobility service that has completed over 700,000 rides worldwide across airports and other venues. WHILL was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this writing it is a consumer hardware and mobility-service company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record and will be enriched if WHILL launches a developer program.

providers.name: WNS Holdings
providers.description: WNS Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The WNS Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Xayn (now Noxtua)
providers.description: Xayn is a Berlin-based AI company founded in 2017 as XAIN out of research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbaek and Prof. Michael Huth at Oxford and Imperial College London. Rebranded to Xayn in 2020, it built the Xaynet privacy-preserving federated learning framework and a privacy-protecting search and discovery engine. In February 2024 the company pivoted to legal AI and rebranded as Noxtua AG (noxtua.com), Europe's sovereign Legal AI for research, document analysis, and drafting, backed by a Series A of EUR 10M (2021, Global Brain/KDDI, with Earlybird) and a Series B of roughly EUR 81M led by legal publisher C.H. Beck. xayn.com is offline and the company publishes no public API or developer portal today; its former open-source SDKs and packages are archived.

providers.name: Zed
providers.description: Zed is a BSP-supervised fintech building a premium consumer credit card for Southeast Asians, headquartered in Manila with an engineering team in San Francisco. Its flagship product is the Zed Card, a Titanium Mastercard with no foreign transaction fees, no annual fees, flexible installments, and an accompanying mobile app that offers real-time statements, spend notifications, and unlimited self-destructing virtual cards for online purchases. The company raised a $16.5M Series A led by Accel with participation from Valar Ventures and fintech operators from Nubank, Square, and Mercury. Zed is a consumer-facing financial product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Alvarez & Marsal
providers.description: Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a leading global professional services firm, founded in 1983 by Tony Alvarez II and Bryan Marsal and headquartered in New York City. Privately held, the firm employs more than 10,000 people across six continents and is best known for turnaround and restructuring engagements (Lehman Brothers, HealthSouth, Tribune, FTX, Arthur Andersen) and for performance improvement, tax advisory, transaction advisory, disputes and investigations, valuation, and private equity performance improvement (PEPI) services. A&M does not operate a public developer portal; technology is delivered through client engagements, internal proprietary tools, A&M Capital Partners (the firm's investment arm), and a public Insights / thought-leadership surface published on alvarezandmarsal.com.

providers.name: Avant
providers.description: Avant is a Chicago-based financial technology company that provides consumer credit products to middle-income U.S. consumers, primarily unsecured personal loans of roughly $2,000-$35,000 (9.95%-35.99% APR, 24-60 month terms) for debt consolidation, emergencies, home improvement, and other needs, alongside the Avant Credit Card issued through WebBank. Founded in 2012 and backed by investors including QED Investors and 500 Global, Avant operates a mobile-first lending and card-servicing platform with a customer help center, personal-finance blog, and SCRA support for military members. Avant is a consumer-facing product company and does not publish a public developer API or portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and support surfaces.

providers.name: Bank Jago
providers.description: PT Bank Jago Tbk is a technology-based digital bank in Indonesia, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX: ARTO) and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital and GoTo. Rather than a branch network, Bank Jago is delivered through the life-centric Jago mobile application and is deeply embedded into partner ecosystems — Gojek/GoPay for payments, and Bibit/Stockbit for investing — via API-based integrations. Its Open API payment surface is exposed through Indonesia's national SNAP (Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran) programme, administered through the ASPI developer directory, rather than a self-hosted public developer portal. Bank Jago is regulated by the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) and Bank Indonesia. This API Evangelist profile is compiled from public sources as a fintech company lead; the bank publishes no self-hosted OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Based
providers.description: Based is a consumer crypto super app built on Hyperliquid that unifies trading, prediction markets, and real-world payments in a single self-custody account. Users trade spot and perpetual futures with sub-second execution and deep liquidity, speculate on prediction markets, and spend crypto from Solana, Arbitrum, and Polygon at 70+ million Visa merchants across 160+ countries via Based debit cards, including the premium Gold+ card. BasedCloud lets partners spin up white-label Hyperliquid trading frontends (web, mobile, desktop, Telegram), and a three-tiered affiliate program amplifies Hyperliquid referral fees. Based is backed by Pantera Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Hashed, Ethena, and Spartan Group. It publishes consumer product docs on GitBook and an agent-oriented llms.txt index, but exposes no public developer API of its own — programmatic trading runs on the underlying Hyperliquid API.

providers.name: Cactos
providers.description: Cactos is a Finnish clean-energy company that designs, manufactures, and operates smart battery energy storage systems (BESS) for commercial, industrial, and grid-scale use. Its hardware line (Cactos Mylo commercial storage and Cactos Cardo backup power, built in part from second-life Tesla EV batteries) is paired with Cactos Spine, a cloud software platform that optimizes each unit for load shifting, peak shaving, demand-charge reduction, solar self-consumption, backup power during outages, and participation in electricity and grid-balancing markets. Cactos serves logistics, manufacturing, EV charging, agriculture, real estate, and commercial-property operators. It is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. As of this profile, Cactos publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; the Cactos Spine app at app.cactos.com is a customer-facing management console rather than a documented developer API.

providers.name: COMSOL
providers.description: COMSOL is a Swedish-American engineering software company best known for COMSOL Multiphysics, a desktop platform for physics-based simulation. The platform exposes a unified COMSOL API that powers the GUI, the Application Builder (Java-based Method Editor), LiveLink for MATLAB, LiveLink for Excel, and the LiveLink family of CAD/CAE interfacing products (SOLIDWORKS, Inventor, AutoCAD, Revit, Solid Edge, CATIA V5, MATLAB, Simulink, Excel). COMSOL is primarily licensed desktop software with web deployment via COMSOL Server and standalone applications via COMSOL Compiler. There is no public web REST API and no public GitHub SDK organization; programmatic surfaces are the Java API, the MATLAB LiveLink interface, and the module-specific LiveLink integrations bundled with the licensed product.

providers.name: Cornerstone Robotics
providers.description: Cornerstone Robotics (CSR) is a Hong Kong-headquartered surgical robotics manufacturer founded in 2019 at Hong Kong Science Park, building the Sentire Endoscopic Surgical System (C1000) — a multi-specialty, minimally invasive robot-assisted surgery platform developed entirely in-house and indicated for general surgery, gynecology, thoracic and urology. The Sentire system has received regulatory clearance in China (NMPA), the European Union and Singapore, and has completed multicenter clinical trials in China and the United Kingdom. The company operates three global R&D hubs, six business centers and a 30,000 square meter manufacturing facility, and sells a regulated physical medical device rather than software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Curve
providers.description: Curve is a London-based fintech, founded in 2015 by Shachar Bialick, that consolidates multiple debit and credit cards into a single smart card and mobile wallet. Its "over-the-top" banking platform lets customers spend from any linked Mastercard or Visa card, switch the funding source of a past purchase up to 120 days later with "Go Back in Time", avoid foreign-exchange fees, earn cashback, and pay in instalments with Curve Flex. Premium tiers (Curve Pay X / Pro / Pro+) add insurance, lounge access, and richer rewards. Curve is backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest among others. Curve does not publish a public developer API — it acts as an open-banking consumer to aggregate customer account balances rather than exposing a provider API.

providers.name: DNS Coffee
providers.description: DNS Coffee collects, analyzes, and archives changes to root zone files provided by various top-level domains (TLDs), offering one of the most comprehensive views of the current state of the Domain Name System (DNS). By continuously tracking these changes, DNS Coffee uncovers valuable trends over time, making it a powerful resource for analysis and research. What began in 2011 with just 4 zones has grown into a robust platform that now processes data from over 1,200 zones daily.

providers.name: DRINKOTEC
providers.description: DRINKOTEC is a beverage technology company that specializes in creating innovative solutions for the production and packaging of beverages. They offer a range of equipment and services designed to streamline the beverage manufacturing process, from filling and sealing machines to labeling and packaging solutions. DRINKOTEC also provides consulting services to help companies optimize their production processes and improve efficiency.

providers.name: Efficient Capital Labs
