A Techstars-backed company, Monitaur has been recognized as a Gartner Magic Quadrant Visionary and is SOC 2 Type II certified. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Mubit
providers.description: Mubit is a temporary storage and logistics service based in Guadalajara, Mexico, offering on-demand collection, climate-controlled warehousing, digital photo inventory, and delivery for both individuals and businesses. Customers pay only for the space they use, with free pickup and drop-off, optional professional packing, and 24/7 CCTV-monitored facilities across three warehouses (Colli, Tijera, and Casuarina). Backed by 500 Global and Techstars, the company reports 4,000+ customers and a 4.9-star Google rating, and operates a mobile/web customer portal at clientes.mubit.co for scheduling pickups and deliveries and viewing stored items. Mubit publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Much Better Adventures
providers.description: Much Better Adventures is a B Corp certified adventure travel company that runs 250+ solo-friendly, expert-led outdoor group trips across the world's trails, rivers, coasts and mountains, matching travellers with certified local guides and hosts. It is a consumer-facing booking platform with financial protection via ABTOT/ABTA/ATOL and contributes 5% of every booking to its foundation for conservation. Surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; an enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Nebex
providers.description: Nebex operates Nebra Exchange, an exchange platform for the global space economy that connects commercial space suppliers, sovereign buyers such as governments and space agencies, and financial institutions. The platform aims to standardize space-commerce infrastructure so demand can find supply faster, workflows can be coordinated across multilateral participants, and capital can participate through transparent structures, facilitating complex transactions from demand to delivery including sourcing, coordination, and settlement. Founded by Tejpaul Bhatia (CEO) and Anand Subramanian (COO), both formerly of Axiom Space, Nebex is backed by GV. The company currently offers early, invite-based access to the Nebra Exchange platform and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK program.

providers.name: Newfront Insurance
providers.description: Newfront is a technology-native insurance brokerage ("a brokerage for the 21st century") serving startups through Fortune 500 enterprises, and now part of WTW. It places business insurance (property, casualty, cyber, executive risk, workers' compensation, surety, aviation, M&A and global programs) alongside Total Rewards services (employee benefits, compensation, retirement/401(k), HR, payroll and benefits compliance), pairing brokerage expertise with in-house software such as the Navigator benefits platform, RiskPulse analytics, and contract/coverage-gap review tools. Newfront reports roughly 20% of U.S. unicorns as clients and $3.1B in annual premiums placed. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks; client and employee interaction happens through the authenticated app.newfront.com application. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched with company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nightingale
providers.description: Nightingale REST Client is a modern, resource-friendly REST API client for Windows.

providers.name: Novi
providers.description: Novi Connect is an AI shopping optimization platform for consumer packaged goods (CPG) and retail brands. Its AI Shopping Optimizer structures and optimizes product data feeds so that AI systems, agentic search, and commerce assistants can accurately understand, trust, and recommend products, while its Product Authority Builder verifies and distributes product data through direct feeds with major retailers and marketplaces. Novi Connect is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Greylock.

providers.name: Novus
providers.description: Novus (operating as SEI Novus) is a portfolio intelligence and investment analytics platform for institutional investors — endowments, foundations, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, pension funds, and asset managers. The platform provides manager monitoring, performance analysis, risk assessment, attribution, and reporting across public and private markets at the position, fund, and portfolio level, along with data integration and maintenance services. Originally venture-backed (Index Ventures among its investors), Novus was acquired by SEI and now operates as SEI Novus. It has been recognized as Best Portfolio Management Vendor (Family Wealth Report Awards) and Best Multi-Asset Class Portfolio Management System (PAM Awards). No public developer API is currently published on its website.

providers.name: O-RAN
providers.description: O-RAN supports the Open Radio Access Network architecture under the Linux Foundation for more interoperable and virtualized mobile network infrastructure. It defines open interfaces between RAN components enabling multi-vendor deployments and network intelligence through AI and machine learning.

providers.name: Onefinestay
providers.description: Onefinestay is a British luxury hospitality company founded in 2009 that curates and manages a portfolio of upmarket private homes, villas, apartments and chalets for short-term and extended vacation rentals, pairing hand-picked properties with hotel-grade concierge service. AccorHotels acquired Onefinestay in 2016 for around $168 million; in 2025 Exclusive Resorts took a controlling operational stake while Accor retained a majority interest. Onefinestay operates as a consumer travel brand with a booking website and a technical/engineering organization on GitHub, but it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK program, or developer portal. This profile is maintained as a network company record.

providers.name: Oosto
providers.description: Oosto (formerly AnyVision) is an enterprise vision-AI company providing real-time facial recognition, watchlist alerting, and video analytics for physical security, safety, and touchless access control. Its platform spans OnWatch real-time watchlist monitoring, OnAccess touchless facial-recognition access control, and Oosto Protect edge-to-cloud video analytics (person-of-interest detection, body/skeleton and pose/action recognition, and liveness detection), delivered via cloud, on-premises, and SDK deployments and integrating with existing VMS and camera systems. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. Oosto exposes no public self-serve developer API; its technical documentation lives in a login-gated partner knowledge base.

providers.name: Oriient
providers.description: Oriient provides software-only, hardware-free indoor positioning ("indoor GPS") and navigation delivered as a SaaS SDK. Its geomagnetic technology reaches roughly 1-meter (3-foot) accuracy indoors without Wi-Fi, beacons, or installed infrastructure, powering product finding, order picking, visitor navigation, asset tracking, and in-store analytics for retail, grocery, and smart-building customers across thousands of locations. Oriient New Media Ltd is based in Tel Aviv and is a Techstars portfolio company. Oriient ships first-party mobile SDKs (including a React-Native Product Location AI package on npm) rather than a public REST API; integration is gated behind a customer dashboard and sales.

providers.name: Orus
providers.description: Orus is a French online insurance broker ("l'assurance professionnelle en ligne") offering professional-liability and business insurance to independent professionals and small businesses across France. Products include RC Pro (professional liability), Multirisque Professionnelle, Assurance Décennale (ten-year construction liability), Assurance Bureau (office insurance), Mutuelle Santé TNS (self-employed health), and Prévoyance TNS (income protection), serving sectors from consultants and construction to hospitality, retail, and wellness. Backed by Partech and Speedinvest, Orus operates a self-service quote-and-buy app (app.orus.eu) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at this time. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched via public web and domain probes.

providers.name: Plus One Robotics
providers.description: Plus One Robotics is a San Antonio, Texas warehouse-automation company founded in 2016 by Erik Nieves and Shaun Edwards that builds AI-powered computer-vision software and robotic work cells for parcel handling, depalletizing, palletizing and induction. Its PickOne perception system tells a robot arm how to grasp each item and verifies placement, while Yonder provides supervised autonomy — remote human "Crew Chiefs" who take over when the robot hits an exception. Packaged work cells DepalOne and InductOne wrap that stack in deployable hardware. The company reports more than 1.5 billion lifetime picks across robots fielded in 15 countries, with additional offices in Eindhoven (Netherlands) and Boulder, Colorado. Plus One Robotics publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; product integration is handled through its partner channel and a login-gated partner portal.

providers.name: Plus Simple
providers.description: +Simple (Plus Simple) is a French digital insurance underwriting agency (agence de souscription) founded in 2015 and headquartered in Marseille. Operating as one of France's largest wholesale insurance brokers, it runs a fully digital extranet platform that lets partner insurance brokers prospect, price, underwrite, issue, and manage professional insurance contracts across more than 1,200 covered activities and 30+ niche product lines, including RC Décennale (ten-year construction liability) coverage. +Simple distributes on a 100% brokerage model in partnership with carriers such as Hiscox, Allianz, Wakam, QBE and Beazley, serving a network of 8,000+ partner brokers. The company is backed by Anthemis and Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time (its broker and insured portals are authenticated web applications, not open APIs).

providers.name: PostgreSQL
providers.description: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development that has earned a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance. It supports advanced SQL features, JSON, full-text search, custom data types, extensions, and transactional DDL. PostgreSQL does not expose a native HTTP REST API; client applications connect via the libpq C client library, JDBC, ODBC, or one of dozens of language-specific drivers using the PostgreSQL wire protocol (default port 5432).

providers.name: Precision Neuroscience
providers.description: Precision Neuroscience is a New York City brain-computer interface company founded in 2021 by Benjamin Rapoport, Michael Mager, Demetrios Papageorgiou and Mark Hettick, with additional sites in Santa Clara, California and Addison, Texas. Its product is the Layer 7 Cortical Interface, a thin-film microelectrode array that lies on the surface of the cortex rather than penetrating brain tissue, and is designed to be removable and upgradable. The array received FDA 510(k) clearance for recording, monitoring and stimulating on the brain surface for implantation durations of up to 30 days, and the company reports 95+ clinical study participants across 15+ hospital partnerships — Mount Sinai, Penn Medicine, Johns Hopkins, Mass General Brigham, Northwestern, Emory, Barrow Neurological Institute and others — plus a strategic partnership with Medtronic. Precision sells a regulated medical device, not software services. It runs no developer program: no public API, SDK, webhooks, developer portal or machine-readable specification is published anywhere on its domain. Its only public engineering surface is a verified GitHub organization whose single public repository is an Apache-2.0 research notebook accompanying a 2025 neural-decoding result.

providers.name: Propseller
providers.description: Propseller is a Singapore-based, technology-powered real estate brokerage founded in 2018 by Adrien Jorge. It helps property owners sell, buy, and rent residential real estate — HDB flats, condominiums, and landed homes — pairing top-performing human property agents with data and technology to deliver an end-to-end transaction experience at a transparent commission starting from 1%. Backed by Vertex Ventures and Partech, Propseller operates a consumer-facing real estate service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: ProPublica Data Store
providers.description: Enhance your own applications with fast, reliable access to the data that powers our newsroom.

providers.name: Proxyman
providers.description: Proxyman is a modern, native macOS app for HTTP/HTTPS debugging proxy with advanced features for API development and testing.

providers.name: Qsic
providers.description: Qsic (styled QSIC) is an Australian-founded, AI-driven in-store audio and retail media platform, headquartered in Melbourne with a North American office in Dallas, Texas. The platform blends curated music, targeted audio advertising and store-level intelligence, deploying either over a retailer's existing speaker infrastructure or over premium smart speakers, and adapting playback to ambient conditions, dayparts and shopper behaviour. Qsic sells three connected products — In-Store Audio, Ads and Intelligence — and positions the combination as a way to turn physical stores into measurable retail media networks with store-level performance reporting and demand-side platform integration. Publicly reported deployments include 7-Eleven ("Gulp Radio"), Dollar General, Coles Liquor and Mecca. Qsic runs a live JSON API host at api.getqsic.com and a Vanta-hosted trust center, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification as of this profile.

providers.name: Rabbit
providers.description: Rabbit Inc. is a consumer technology company building AI-powered devices, best known for the Rabbit R1, a $199 handheld AI companion with industrial design by Teenage Engineering. The R1 runs rabbitOS and centers on a Large Action Model (LAM) that automates tasks across operating systems and applications (DLAM), alongside features like the Magic Camera, voice recording with transcription, and vibe-coded "creations." Rabbit is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this profile, Rabbit is a consumer hardware and device company with no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, support center, blog, and newsroom.

providers.name: RadixArk
providers.description: RadixArk is a deep-tech AI-infrastructure company on a mission to make frontier-level AI infrastructure open and accessible to everyone ("Build AI for all"). Backed by a $100M seed round announced in May 2026, RadixArk builds open-source infrastructure and managed tooling for training and serving modern AI models at scale. Its flagship open-source projects are SGLang, a fast and flexible inference/serving engine for large language and vision-language models, and Miles, an enterprise-facing reinforcement-learning framework for LLM and VLM post-training (with a companion Miles Diffusion framework for large-scale diffusion training). RadixArk also operates a managed platform at platform.radixark.com serving developers, enterprises, and research labs. The company does not yet expose a public REST/HTTP API; this profile captures its open-source packages, identity, and security posture pending an API surface.

providers.name: Rentomojo
providers.description: Rentomojo is India's largest tech-driven, full-stack direct-to-consumer furniture and appliance rental platform, converting ownership into flexible monthly subscriptions. Customers rent beds, sofas, wardrobes, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, water purifiers and other home essentials on plans from roughly three to thirty-six months, with delivery, installation, maintenance, relocation and upgrades handled in-house. Per its March 2026 draft red herring prospectus the company operates across 22 Indian cities with 227,511 live subscribers and 1,688 in-house technicians, carpenters and painters. Backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; this pass found no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: Route
providers.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Saia Inc
providers.description: Saia Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Saia Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: SEI Investments
providers.description: SEI Investments Company (NASDAQ: SEIC) is a publicly traded financial services and technology provider founded in 1968 and headquartered in Oaks, Pennsylvania. SEI delivers end-to-end technology, operations, and asset management solutions to asset managers, banks and wealth managers, financial advisors, and institutional investors. Marquee platforms include the SEI Wealth Platform (front-to-back wealth management technology and outsourced operations), SEI Data Cloud (managed near-real-time data platform), SEI Sphere (managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, and network operations), and SEI Novus (institutional portfolio analytics). SEI does not run a public developer portal — partner and client integrations are delivered through contractual onboarding to the SEI Wealth Platform, SEI Connect advisor channels, and managed-service engagements rather than self-serve OpenAPI or SDK distribution.

providers.name: Semperis
providers.description: Semperis provides identity-first cybersecurity and disaster recovery for hybrid Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta environments. Its platform prevents, detects, and responds to identity-based attacks and enables rapid recovery to a trusted state. Products include Directory Services Protector (AD/Entra ID threat prevention, detection, and response), Active Directory Forest Recovery, Disaster Recovery for Entra Tenant, Recovery for Okta, Lightning Intelligence security posture assessment, Delegation Manager, Migrator for AD, and the Ready1 crisis-response platform, alongside the free community tools Purple Knight and Forest Druid. Backed by Insight Partners, Semperis serves enterprises defending the identity attack surface. This profile was enriched from public sources; Semperis publishes no public developer/REST API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Simplyinsured
providers.description: SimplyInsured is a small-business health insurance brokerage and online enrollment platform. It aggregates medical, dental, and vision plans from major carriers, provides unbiased plan recommendations, and lets small employers compare, quote, and enroll their teams entirely online at no cost to the business. Founded in 2012 and backed by Y Combinator, SimplyInsured is frequently embedded as the health-insurance offering inside partner payroll and HR platforms. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing web application and a support/help surface but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sioma
providers.description: SIOMA is a Colombian precision-agriculture (agtech) software platform for tropical crops such as oil palm, banana, and cacao. It helps plantations monitor field labor, track harvest and weighing (pesaje) operations with GPS, and make data-driven decisions to raise productivity. The product combines a mobile field-management app, GPS-based labor tracking, smart weighing hardware (Nukak, Sigma, Jaco, and Bascula-G scales), and Siomi, an AI assistant for agriculture. SIOMA is delivered as a customer web and mobile application and is backed by 500 Global. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: Siteline
providers.description: Siteline is billing and accounts receivable software built specifically for commercial subcontractors (trade contractors). It centralizes pay applications (including AIA G702/G703 progress billing), lien waivers, lien rights, compliance documents, change orders, collections, and A/R reporting in one workflow, replacing the spreadsheets, PDFs, and GC payment-portal logins that AP/AR teams juggle every month. Siteline integrates with construction accounting systems (Sage, Foundation, Viewpoint/Vista, Spectrum, QuickBooks, Acumatica, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, CMiC, and others) and with GC payment portals (Textura, GCPay, Procore Pay) so billing data flows without double entry. Founded in 2019 by Claire Wilson and Gloria Lin, backed by Menlo Ventures and First Round Capital; subcontractors have billed over $10B across 200,000+ projects on the platform. Siteline publishes no public developer API — integrations are managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: SLB (Schlumberger)
providers.description: SLB (Schlumberger) is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The SLB (Schlumberger) API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Sonatus
providers.description: Sonatus, Inc. is a Sunnyvale, California automotive software company, founded in 2018, that builds cloud-to-edge vehicle AI software for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Its Fastlane platform pairs in-vehicle Fastlane Edge software with Fastlane Collector for dynamic, policy-driven vehicle data collection, Fastlane Insight for cloud-side analysis, and Fastlane Copilot for quick-start integration, alongside the Sonatus Automator vehicle-automation product. Sonatus states its technology is deployed in more than eight million vehicles worldwide, and it is backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Kia, LG, Marvell, NEC, Foxconn and Translink Capital. Sonatus sells to vehicle OEMs and tier-one suppliers rather than to individual developers: it markets an SDK comprising Sonatus Automator, APIs and documentation, but that developer surface is delivered to contracted OEM customers and is not published on any public developer portal.

providers.name: SquareTrade (Allstate)
providers.description: SquareTrade, an Allstate company, provides consumer product protection plans and extended warranties for smartphones, electronics, appliances, furniture, and other goods, marketed in North America as Allstate Protection Plans. It serves more than 140 million customers through partnerships with major retailers and mobile carriers across the US, Europe, Japan, and Australia, handling plan registration, claims filing, same-day repairs, and in-home service. SquareTrade was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its digital surface is consumer- and partner-facing (plan portal, claims, partnerships).

providers.name: Squint
providers.description: Squint is a Manufacturing Intelligence platform that uses AI and augmented reality to help industrial and frontline operations teams lower downtime and improve quality at scale. Its mobile app captures and digitizes tribal knowledge from video and real work, orchestrates workflows and work assignments across employees and locations, provides AI-powered troubleshooting and expert guidance, and delivers analytics on performance across teams and sites. Founded by Devin Bhushan, Squint began in manufacturing and serves automotive, food and beverage, oil and gas, heavy industrials, equipment, consumer packaged goods, and energy customers, expanding into healthcare and hospitality. Backed by Menlo Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Squint exposes no public developer API; its documentation and application are gated behind a Squint workspace login.

providers.name: Stage
providers.description: Stage is a code review tool that reorganizes local git changes and pull requests into logical, ordered "chapters" so engineers can review and merge changes far faster — a workflow built for teams shipping large volumes of AI-generated code. Stage ships an open-source (MIT) command-line tool, "stagereview", that runs entirely on the developer's machine and works with any AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, opencode): it diffs the current branch or a GitHub PR, clusters the hunks into narrated chapters with a prologue, and opens them in a local browser SPA for review. The full hosted Stage experience lives at stagereview.app. Stage is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company founded by Charles Pan and Dean Stratakos.

providers.name: Starship Technologies
providers.description: Starship Technologies is an autonomous last-mile delivery company that operates a global fleet of self-driving, sidewalk-going delivery robots. Founded in 2014 by Skype co-founders Ahti Heinla and Janus Friis, the company runs commercial robot delivery on university campuses, in residential neighborhoods, on industrial sites and for grocery and restaurant partners across the United States, the United Kingdom, Estonia, Finland, Germany and Denmark, and has completed more than 10 million autonomous deliveries. Its commercial product, Delivery by Starship, is a delivery-as-a-service offering that partners integrate into their own ordering apps: Starship states that its APIs let a partner create delivery jobs, load robots, obtain status updates and handle delivery cancellations, backed by a developer toolkit, documentation, ready-made components and support. That developer surface is not published to the open web — Starship provides it to partners after a commercial conversation via business@starship.co, so no public specification, reference or portal exists to profile.

providers.name: Statespace
providers.description: Statespace is the company behind Aimlabs (aimlabs.com, formerly statespace.gg), the leading AI-powered aim-training platform for FPS gamers. Aimlabs delivers personalized training tasks, real-time performance analytics, and game-specific tools, serving over 40 million players and operating as an official partner of Valorant and Rainbow Six Siege. Statespace is venture-backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lux Capital. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web/desktop product but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: StatMuse
providers.description: StatMuse is a natural-language search engine that answers sports and financial questions in plain English, returning instant stats, tables, and visual answers. It covers MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL, WNBA, PGA, college football, and soccer, along with StatMuse Money for stock-market and finance data. Users ask questions conversationally ("How many points did LeBron score last night?") and get sourced answers with charts and shareable cards. Backed by Techstars, the company is consumer-facing and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic access surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: SuperAgent
providers.description: SuperAgent is an open-source framework for building and deploying AI agents with APIs.

providers.name: Teamshares Inc
providers.description: Teamshares is a tech-enabled acquirer of small businesses that offers a permanent home for companies whose owners are retiring. It programmatically buys profitable companies with $0.5-5 million of EBITDA from retiring owners, integrates them onto the Teamshares operating platform of financial products, software, and education, and helps employees earn company stock through employee ownership. Backed by QED Investors and other fintech investors, Teamshares runs a login-gated operating platform (os.teamshares.com) for its portfolio companies plus an investor portal. As of this profile Teamshares publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Time is Ltd
providers.description: Time is Ltd. is a collaboration analytics company that turns workplace communication and productivity data into actionable insights for HR, sales, and operations teams. Its platform connects to tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce, Webex, and Tableau to measure meetings, focus time, and collaboration patterns, then reports on team performance, employee engagement, and revenue outcomes. Backed by Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network, Time is Ltd. exposes no public developer API; integrations are configured through its hosted analytics application rather than a documented REST or GraphQL surface.

providers.name: TRDATA
providers.description: TRDATA (TRDATA Technology Limited) is a real-time financial information and communication platform for professional traders, aggregating over-the-counter (OTC) quotes, prices, news, and analytics from market makers across fragmented fixed-income and emerging-market instruments. It covers Ukrainian, CEEMEA, and global bonds, currencies, commodities, and derivatives from local and international data providers, and bundles analytics tools such as a Bond Calculator, Bond Calendar, Swap Curves, real-time asset charts, and a TRDATA Excel add-in. More than 800 institutions -- including Societe Generale, UniCredit, Raiffeisen, BNP Paribas, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, and Commerzbank -- use the platform to read and exchange market information. TRDATA is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; access is via registration and the hosted platform.

providers.name: TrueCar
providers.description: TrueCar is a Santa Monica, California based online automotive marketplace that connects car buyers with a nationwide network of certified dealers, publishing upfront, transparent pricing on new and used vehicles alongside what other buyers in the same area actually paid. The company operates truecar.com, the TrueCar+ end-to-end digital retail experience, a sell-your-car / instant cash offer service, and white-label car-buying programs for affinity partners such as credit unions, insurers and large employers. Founded in 2005 by Scott Painter, TrueCar traded on NASDAQ as TRUE until January 2026, when Fair Holdings, Inc. - led by Painter, with PenFed Credit Union, Zurich North America, AutoNation and Atlantic Coast Automotive - completed a $227 million take-private acquisition. TrueCar publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract; its dealer, DMS and OEM integrations are arranged privately through the dealer portal under commercial agreement.

providers.name: TurbineOne
providers.description: TurbineOne builds a frontline AI/ML platform that turns raw sensor data into real-time detection, classification, and targeting at the edge for defense and national-security missions. Its product suite spans Frontline Perception (edge computer vision on live sensor feeds), Frontline Command, Frontline Autonomy, a Model Hub for managing and deploying ML models, and EdgeWorks, a program that brings warfighters, mission teams, and engineers together to develop and validate mission capabilities for contested, disconnected environments. The company was founded on expertise in artificial intelligence, mesh networking, and sensing technology, and positions its work as "Responsible AI for our nation's heroes." It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. TurbineOne publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity, GitHub organization, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Udaan
providers.description: Udaan is India's largest eB2B trade platform, connecting small businesses - kirana stores, chemists, hotels, restaurants, and offices - with manufacturers, brands, and wholesalers across categories including FMCG, staples, fruits and vegetables, pharma, and general merchandise. The platform combines supply chain and logistics operations with financial services for small businesses through udaanCapital, its working-capital fintech arm. Udaan is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and GGV Capital. It publishes no public developer API; buyer and seller experiences are delivered through its web and mobile apps, with api.udaan.com serving as the private app backend.

providers.name: Verdant Robotics
providers.description: Verdant Robotics is an agricultural robotics company building precision farming systems for specialty crop growers. Its flagship SharpShooter uses "Aim & Apply" technology - machine learning and computer vision that identify crops and weeds in real time, build a three-dimensional map of the field, and deliver microliter-precise applications directly onto weeds without contacting the crop, doing over 240 targeted applications per second. The Robotics-as-a- Service platform reduces herbicide use by up to 99% and manual labor costs by up to 85% across carrots, leafy greens, cabbage, onions, and grass seed and sod production. Founded by leaders from the self-driving vehicle industry and commercial agriculture, Verdant is backed by DCVC. This profile was surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company; Verdant publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - its GitHub organization hosts robotics tooling and forks (cbuf message serialization, Jetson build scripts, YOLO/ultralytics forks) rather than a product API.

providers.name: Virtuo
providers.description: Virtuo (govirtuo.com) is a Paris-based, next-generation car rental company founded in 2015 and backed by Balderton Capital. It replaces the traditional rental counter with a mobile app: customers book, unlock, and return premium connected vehicles (Mercedes, BMW, Audi, Peugeot, Renault, Toyota, Volkswagen and others) entirely from their phone, with delivery options, free cancellation, and 24/7 support across 100+ locations in Europe. Virtuo also runs a "Virtuo for Business" corporate program and has committed to offsetting 100% of trips and electrifying its fleet by 2030. Virtuo does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile captures the company's public web properties and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vise
providers.description: Vise is an SEC-registered investment adviser that provides an AI-powered wealth management platform for financial advisors, RIAs, enterprise wealth firms, and asset managers. The platform helps advisors build personalized, tax-aware portfolios and supports direct indexing, fixed income management, long/short strategies, tax-loss harvesting, portfolio rebalancing, and client reporting, managing over $100B in platform assets across 135K+ accounts. Vise publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public company, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wiser
providers.description: Wiser Solutions is a retail and commerce intelligence company that provides pricing, market, and MAP (minimum advertised price) intelligence to brands and retailers. Its platform collects online and in-store data, tracking billions of products daily across hundreds of thousands of stores, to power price optimization, competitive price monitoring, promotion and assortment tracking, review analytics, and unauthorized-seller enforcement. Wiser serves hundreds of brands and large retailers and integrates with major eCommerce platforms and marketplaces. As of this profile Wiser publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through its platform, dashboards, and partner connectors.

providers.name: Yoona.ai
providers.description: Yoona.ai is an enterprise agentic-AI platform for product innovation, originally built for the fashion industry. It creates an adaptive "Enterprise Twin" of a brand by connecting PLM, ERP, e-commerce and market data into a single intelligence layer, then uses AI agents to autonomously generate product designs, optimize assortments and validate sell-through. Capabilities include text-to-image and sketch-to-design generation, trend and data analysis, and a Sales Confidence Algorithm. Integration with a customer's stack (Shopify to SAP) is offered via a flexible REST/GraphQL API, but that API is delivered as an Enterprise-tier custom integration — there is no public self-serve API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification published as of this enrichment pass. Backed by Techstars.
